abstract: One of the major challenges in neuroscience is understanding how the human brain develops into a highly organized and functionally integrated organ, because many developmental processes cannot be investigated directly in humans and are not fully recapitulated in animal models. Brain organoids derived from human pluripotent stem cells have emerged as powerful three-dimensional (3D) experimental models that recapitulate key features of human neurodevelopment, including regional patterning, cellular diversification, and neural circuit assembly. Recent advances in long-term organoid culture, organoid bioengineering, vascularization, assembloid technology, transplantation, multi-omics, and artificial intelligence have substantially expanded the applications of brain organoids to investigate human neurodevelopment, model neurological disorders, support drug discovery, and advance therapeutic development. Integration of single-cell and spatial multi-omics with computational approaches has enabled robust molecular benchmarking, assessment of developmental fidelity, and evaluation of organoid reproducibility, facilitating direct comparison with primary human fetal brain tissue. However, current organoid systems remain limited owing to incomplete cellular and tissue complexity, inter-organoid variability, limited vascularization, limited functional maturation, and incomplete physiological integration. Continued advances in tissue engineering, computational biology, and standardized differentiation protocols are expected to enhance the biological fidelity and translational utility of brain organoids for basic and translational neuroscience, as well as mechanistic and translational research.
abstractZh: 神经科学面临的主要挑战之一是理解人脑如何发育成一个高度组织化且功能整合的器官，因为许多发育过程无法直接在人类中研究，并且在动物模型中也不能完全重现。源自人类多能干细胞的大脑类器官已成为强大的三维（3D）实验模型，可重现人类神经发育的关键特征，包括区域模式形成、细胞多样化和神经回路组装。长期类器官培养、类器官生物工程、血管化、组装体技术、移植、多组学和人工智能的最新进展，极大地扩展了脑类器官在研究人类神经发育、模拟神经系统疾病、支持药物发现和推进治疗开发方面的应用。单细胞和空间多组学与计算方法的整合，使得稳健的分子基准测试、发育保真度评估和类器官可重复性评价成为可能，促进了与原发性人类胎儿脑组织的直接比较。然而，由于细胞和组织复杂性不完整、类器官间变异性、血管化有限、功能成熟度有限以及生理整合不完整，当前的类器官系统仍然受限。组织工程、计算生物学和标准化分化方案的持续进步，有望提高脑类器官在基础神经科学和转化神经科学以及机制和转化研究中的生物学保真度和转化实用性。

title: p53 knockout drives stage-specific long non-coding RNA reprogramming during human neural differentiation and glioma organoid tumorigenesis.
titleZh: p53敲除在人类神经分化和胶质瘤类器官肿瘤发生过程中驱动阶段特异性的长链非编码RNA重编程。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Stasi F, Manzari AR, Siciliano V, Binda E, Pazienza V, Brunetti V, De Vittorio M.
abstract:
Background: 

 Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are emerging regulators of tumor initiation and progression through their effects on stemness, lineage commitment, and transcriptional plasticity. The contribution of lncRNA reprogramming during early p53-deficient gliomagenesis remains poorly understood. Methods:

 Human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) carrying a complete TP53 knockout were differentiated into neural progenitor cells (NPCs) and cerebral organoids. Bulk RNA sequencing was performed at multiple differentiation stages and compared with established glioblastoma cell lines (U87 and U118) to identify lncRNA expression changes associated with p53 loss and tumor-like transformation. Results:

 p53 deficiency induced a progressive and stage-specific remodeling of the lncRNA landscape, with the most pronounced transcriptional shift observed in 40-day NPCs. This late-stage profile partially overlapped with glioblastoma-like cell lines and was characterized by the upregulation of five lncRNAs enriched in both p53-deficient neural models and glioma cells. Principal component analysis showed that these lncRNAs clustered with tumor-associated samples and were strongly co-expressed with mitotic cell-cycle genes. In particular, LINC00973 and LINC01583 were highly expressed in primary glioblastoma datasets, while RP5-875H18.9 and RP11-1094H24.4 emerged as previously unrecognized glioma-associated transcripts. Conclusion:

 Loss of p53 drives stage-dependent lncRNA reprogramming during neural differentiation and promotes the emergence of glioma-associated transcriptional features. These findings identify candidate lncRNAs that may contribute to early gliomagenesis and represent potential biomarkers or therapeutic targets in glioblastoma.
abstractZh:
背景：

 长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）通过其对干性、谱系定向和转录可塑性的影响，正在成为肿瘤起始和进展的调节因子。在早期p53缺陷的胶质瘤发生过程中，lncRNA重编程的贡献仍知之甚少。方法：

 携带完全TP53敲除的人诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）被分化为神经祖细胞（NPCs）和大脑类器官。在多个分化阶段进行了批量RNA测序，并与已建立的胶质母细胞瘤细胞系（U87和U118）进行比较，以识别与p53缺失和肿瘤样转化相关的lncRNA表达变化。结果：

 p53缺陷诱导了lncRNA景观的进行性和阶段特异性重塑，其中在40天NPCs中观察到最显著的转录变化。该晚期阶段特征与胶质母细胞瘤样细胞系部分重叠，并以五个lncRNAs的上调为特征，这些lncRNAs在p53缺陷的神经模型和胶质瘤细胞中均富集。主成分分析显示，这些lncRNAs与肿瘤相关样本聚集在一起，并与有丝分裂细胞周期基因强烈共表达。特别是，LINC00973和LINC01583在原发胶质母细胞瘤数据集中高表达，而RP5-875H18.9和RP11-1094H24.4则作为先前未被识别的胶质瘤相关转录本出现。结论：

 p53的缺失在神经分化过程中驱动阶段依赖性的lncRNA重编程，并促进胶质瘤相关转录特征的出现。这些发现确定了可能有助于早期胶质瘤发生的候选lncRNAs，并代表了胶质母细胞瘤中潜在的生物标志物或治疗靶点。

title: A Closed-Loop Robot Scientist for Autonomous Biological Discovery
titleZh: 用于自主生物发现的闭环机器人科学家
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Bielawski K, Srinivasan K, Gaylinn N, Beaulieu S, Brucker R, Levin M, Bongard J, Blackiston D.
abstract: Biological systems respond to a wide range of physical inputs and an overarching goal of biological research is understanding how these signaling events coordinate cellular, tissue, and organism-level outcomes. Yet the vast combinatorial space of physical and chemical interventions that influence these processes remains largely unexplored. Thus, a search process is required that efficiently learns how inputs affect a biological target via a series of automatically generated interventions, and a robot scientist that can conduct them. To this end we here introduce the Multimodal Organismal Modulation Robot (MOMbot), a robot scientist that integrates four physical intervention modalities - chemical delivery, electrical field application, mechanical vibration, and thermal modulation -within a single hardware platform. MOMbots multimodal hardware is paired with high-resolution imaging and an online active learning algorithm that autonomously generates, executes, and refines interventions based on accumulated data. We validate the system across biological materials spanning three orders of magnitude in scale, including Xenopus laevis embryos, motile mucociliary organoids, and disaggregated ectodermal stem cells, to show the utility of this approach across diverse biological disciplines. Using these biological models, we demonstrate precise thermal control of embryonic developmental rate, automated chemical perturbation with behavioral readouts, programmable electrical field stimulation, and vibrational assembly of functional mucociliary organoids from loose cells. We also describe the active learning algorithm that autonomously concentrates interventions near regions of maximal outcome uncertainty, yielding sample-efficient discovery of an electrical duration-response relationship for motile organoids. These results establish MOMbot as a scalable robot/AI scientist team for biological discovery, enabling autonomous, multimodal physical experimentation and AI-driven exploration of complex biological systems.
abstractZh: 生物系统对广泛的物理输入作出反应，生物学研究的一个总体目标是理解这些信号事件如何协调细胞、组织和器官层面的结果。然而，影响这些过程的物理和化学干预的巨大组合空间在很大程度上仍未得到探索。因此，需要一种搜索过程，通过一系列自动生成的干预措施高效地学习输入如何影响生物靶标，以及一个能够执行这些干预措施的机器人科学家。为此，我们在此介绍多模态生物体调控机器人（MOMbot），这是一种在单一硬件平台上整合四种物理干预模式——化学递送、电场施加、机械振动和热调控——的机器人科学家。MOMbot的多模态硬件与高分辨率成像和一种在线主动学习算法配对，该算法基于累积数据自主生成、执行和完善干预措施。我们在跨越三个数量级尺度的生物材料上验证了该系统，包括非洲爪蟾胚胎、可运动的黏膜纤毛类器官和分离的外胚层干细胞，以展示这种方法在多种生物学科中的实用性。利用这些生物模型，我们展示了胚胎发育速率的精确热控制、具有行为读数的自动化化学扰动、可编程电场刺激，以及从松散细胞振动组装功能性黏膜纤毛类器官。我们还描述了主动学习算法，该算法自主地将干预集中在最大结果不确定性区域附近，从而实现对可运动类器官的电持续时间-反应关系的样本高效发现。这些结果确立了MOMbot作为用于生物发现的可扩展机器人/AI科学家团队，实现自主、多模态物理实验和AI驱动的复杂生物系统探索。

title: A mechanically actuated lung microvascular model reveals that breathing-like deformation enhances tumor cell extravasation
titleZh: 一种机械驱动的肺微血管模型揭示类呼吸变形增强肿瘤细胞外渗
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Floryan M, Stoll R, Fleps I, Coates R, Kamm R, Cambria E.
abstract: The lung is a common site of metastasis and is continuously deformed by breathing. Whether physiological breathing mechanics influence tumor cell extravasation is unknown. To address this, we developed a mechanically actuated microphysiological system combining perfusable lung-specific microvascular networks with breathing-like cyclic deformation. Under static conditions, lung-specific networks exhibited more lung-like vascular features and higher tumor cell extravasation rates than generic networks. The mechanically actuated device reproduced physiological tissue and vascular deformation, while 24 h of cyclic actuation did not alter vessel viability, permeability, or morphology compared with unactuated controls. Pre-actuation for 24 h, followed by tumor cell perfusion under static conditions, did not alter subsequent extravasation, whereas actuation initiated immediately after perfusion significantly increased extravasation compared with unactuated controls. This biomimetic platform enables direct investigation of how breathing-like vascular deformation influences metastasis and provides a versatile tool for studying vascular mechanobiology in the lung and other mechanically active organs.
abstractZh: 肺是转移的常见部位，并且持续受到呼吸的变形作用。生理性呼吸力学是否影响肿瘤细胞外渗尚不清楚。为了解决这一问题，我们开发了一种机械驱动的微生理系统，将可灌注的肺特异性微血管网络与类呼吸周期性变形相结合。在静态条件下，肺特异性网络表现出比通用网络更多的肺样血管特征和更高的肿瘤细胞外渗率。机械驱动装置再现了生理性组织和血管变形，而24小时的循环驱动与未驱动的对照组相比，未改变血管活力、通透性或形态。预驱动24小时，随后在静态条件下灌注肿瘤细胞，并未改变后续的外渗，而在灌注后立即启动驱动则显著增加了外渗，与未驱动的对照组相比。这种仿生平台能够直接研究类呼吸血管变形如何影响转移，并为研究肺及其他机械活动器官中的血管机械生物学提供了一种多功能工具。

title: Activation of a STAT3/LATS1 Signaling Axis by Folate Receptor α Enables Breast Cancer Cells to Resist Physiological Ferroptotic Stress
titleZh: 叶酸受体α激活STAT3/LATS1信号轴使乳腺癌细胞能够抵抗生理性铁死亡应激
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ambegaokar PP, Goel HL, Karner ER, Dimitrov BS, Silva CA, Mercurio AM.
abstract: Understanding mechanisms that enable cancer cells to evade ferroptotic stress such as that imposed by detachment from extracellular matrix (ECM) is a significant problem that has important ramifications for tumor biology and therapy. We addressed this problem initially by analyzing single cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq) data obtained from breast tumor organoids that had been treated with the ferroptosis inducer IKE. This bioinformatic analysis revealed that expression of folate receptor α (FRα) is increased in ferroptosis-resistant sub-populations. Subsequent experiments established a causal role for FRα in mediating resistance to ferroptosis triggered by ECM detachment, as well as by IKE treatment. The ability of FRα to resist ferroptosis is dependent on the non-canonical activation of STAT3, which has a key role in ferroptosis resistance. Our experimental data revealed that under ECM-detached conditions, ferroptosis resistant cells have increased LATS1, a core kinase in the Hippo pathway. We established that FRα regulates LATS1 expression and identified a novel signaling axis that involves the regulation of LATS1 transcription by STAT3 that results in YAP inhibition and the consequent repression of acyl-CoA synthetase long-chain family member 4 (ACSL4), a lipid-modifying enzyme that is essential for ferroptosis. Together, these results highlight an unexpected role for FRα in resisting the ferroptotic stress caused by ECM detachment and IKE treatment that is associated with its non-canonical signaling functions.
abstractZh: 理解使癌细胞能够逃避铁死亡应激（如脱离细胞外基质（ECM）所施加的应激）的机制是一个重要问题，对肿瘤生物学和治疗具有重要影响。我们首先通过分析经铁死亡诱导剂IKE处理的乳腺肿瘤类器官获得的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据来解决这个问题。这一生物信息学分析揭示，叶酸受体α（FRα）在铁死亡抵抗亚群中表达增加。随后的实验确立了FRα在介导由ECM脱离以及IKE处理引发的铁死亡抵抗中的因果作用。FRα抵抗铁死亡的能力依赖于STAT3的非经典激活，STAT3在铁死亡抵抗中起关键作用。我们的实验数据表明，在ECM脱离条件下，铁死亡抵抗细胞中LATS1（Hippo通路中的核心激酶）表达增加。我们确定FRα调节LATS1表达，并发现了一个新的信号轴，涉及STAT3对LATS1转录的调节，导致YAP抑制，进而抑制酰基辅酶A合成酶长链家族成员4（ACSL4），这是一种对铁死亡至关重要的脂质修饰酶。总之，这些结果突显了FRα在抵抗由ECM脱离和IKE处理引起的铁死亡应激中的意外作用，这与其非经典信号功能相关。

title: Bridging scale-up to transplantation: pluripotent stem cell-derived pancreatic islet encapsulation in emulsion-generated high concentration alginate beads
titleZh: 从规模化生产到移植的桥梁：多能干细胞来源的胰岛样细胞簇在乳液生成的高浓度海藻酸盐微球中的封装
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Castro Rojas A, Brassard J, Billaud M, Lemaire F, Chen R, Orimi HE, Tian JJ, Paraskevas S, Hoesli CA.
abstract: Pluripotent stem cell-derived pancreatic islet-like cell clusters (SC-islets) have emerged as potential cellular therapy for type 1 diabetes. While SC-islets can theoretically be produced in bioreactors to meet transplantation needs of many recipients per batch, biomanufacturing and translational challenges remain. SC-islet can be cultured in suspension using stirred tank or vertical wheel bioreactors, but these can impart hydrodynamic damage and lead to cellular agglomeration, particularly upon scale-up. We previously described a robust emulsion-based process to encapsulate murine pancreatic beta cells in high-concentration alginate beads which improved graft survival in allogeneic recipients. Here, we present a full pipeline for scalable microencapsulated SC-islet biomanufacturing with extended in vitro bioreactor culture leading into transplantation. We hypothesized that encapsulation would prevent cellular agglomeration, reduce mechanical stress, and preserve differentiation potential during scale-up. Encapsulation of Stage 6 SC-islets prevented cellular agglomeration during extended suspension culture (25 days) and increased cell recovery (91 +/- 3%) compared with non-encapsulated aggregates (60 +/- 10%). No significant differences in glucose-stimulated insulin secretion were observed with vs without microencapsulation. Stage 7 SC-islets matured in the bioreactor were transplanted either as encapsulated islets via the intraperitoneal route or as free SC-islets under the kidney capsule, where they displayed glucose-responsive human C-peptide secretion and remained functional in vivo for up to 98 days. Overall, this work establishes a scalable, robust, transplantation-ready encapsulation platform that supports SC-islet maturation and delivery, providing a generalizable strategy for scaling and transplanting encapsulated organoid systems.
abstractZh: 多能干细胞来源的胰岛样细胞簇（SC-胰岛）已成为1型糖尿病的潜在细胞疗法。虽然理论上SC-胰岛可以在生物反应器中生产，以满足每批次多位受者的移植需求，但生物制造和转化方面仍存在挑战。SC-胰岛可以在搅拌槽或垂直轮式生物反应器中以悬浮方式培养，但这些方法可能造成流体动力学损伤并导致细胞聚集，尤其是在规模化生产时。我们先前描述了一种基于乳液的稳健工艺，将小鼠胰腺β细胞封装在高浓度海藻酸盐微球中，该工艺在同种异体受者中改善了移植物存活。在此，我们展示了一个完整的可扩展微囊化SC-胰岛生物制造流程，包括延长的体外生物反应器培养并进入移植阶段。我们假设封装可以防止细胞聚集、减少机械应力，并在规模化过程中保持分化潜能。将第6阶段SC-胰岛封装后，在延长悬浮培养（25天）期间防止了细胞聚集，并提高了细胞回收率（91±3%），而未封装的聚集体回收率为60±10%。在有无微囊化的情况下，葡萄糖刺激的胰岛素分泌没有观察到显著差异。在生物反应器中成熟至第7阶段的SC-胰岛，以封装胰岛形式通过腹腔途径移植，或以游离SC-胰岛形式移植到肾囊下，它们均表现出葡萄糖反应性人C肽分泌，并在体内保持功能长达98天。总体而言，这项工作建立了一个可扩展、稳健、可直接用于移植的封装平台，支持SC-胰岛的成熟和递送，为封装类器官系统的规模化生产和移植提供了一种通用策略。

title: Smart organoid-on-chip systems: From microfluidics to sensors, control, and AI.
titleZh: 智能类器官芯片系统：从微流控到传感器、控制与人工智能。
journal: The International journal of artificial organs
dateSource: Crossref published-online
authors: Wajid H, Begum S.
affiliations: Stem Cells Research Laboratory, Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT), Karachi, Pakistan.
abstract: Organoid systems have opened the door to modeling human tissues with a level of biological realism that conventional 2D cultures could never achieve. Yet, as many laboratories have experienced firsthand, organoids are extremely sensitive to their microenvironment and difficult to standardize across experiments. The growing shift toward smart, sensor-integrated organoid-on-a-chip platforms reflects an attempt to address these persistent challenges. These hybrid systems combine organoid biology with microfluidics, real-time sensors, microcontroller-based actuation, and increasingly, AI-driven interpretation. Together, these layers create a setting where physicochemical cues, nutrient flow, oxygen levels, and even mechanical forces can be monitored and adjusted continuously. This evolution marks a departure from the largely descriptive nature of organoid culture toward a more quantitative and automated framework. Such systems not only improve reproducibility and long-term stability but also allow organoids to reach levels of maturation and physiological behavior that are difficult to obtain in static conditions. As the technology matures, smart organoid-on-a-chip platforms are likely to play a central role in disease modeling, drug evaluation, and personalized medicine, particularly in contexts where dynamic environmental control and continuous data resolution are essential.
abstractZh: 类器官系统为模拟人体组织打开了大门，其生物学真实程度是传统二维培养所无法达到的。然而，正如许多实验室亲身经历的那样，类器官对其微环境极为敏感，且难以在实验间实现标准化。向智能、集成传感器的类器官芯片平台发展的趋势日益增长，反映了解决这些长期挑战的尝试。这些混合系统将类器官生物学与微流控、实时传感器、基于微控制器的驱动以及日益增多的人工智能驱动解释相结合。这些层次共同创造了一个环境，其中物理化学线索、营养流、氧水平甚至机械力都可以被持续监测和调整。这种演变标志着从类器官培养的本质上描述性向更定量和自动化框架的转变。这类系统不仅提高了可重复性和长期稳定性，还使类器官能够达到在静态条件下难以获得的成熟度和生理行为水平。随着技术的成熟，智能类器官芯片平台很可能在疾病建模、药物评估和个性化医疗中发挥核心作用，特别是在动态环境控制和连续数据解析至关重要的情境中。

title: Effects of commonly used pesticides and their mixtures on the upper airway epithelium using porcine organoid-derived models.
titleZh: 常用农药及其混合物对猪类器官来源的上气道上皮模型的影响
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Gerritse ME, Boekhorst J, Fernandes AM, Voulgari Kokota A, Vellalara OM, Huss A, Aparicio V, Scheepers PTJ, Wells JM.
affiliations: Host Microbe Interactomics, Wageningen University, Netherlands.
Institute for Risk Assessment Sciences, Utrecht University, Netherlands.
Instituto Nacional de Tecnologia Agropecuaria, Argentina.
Department of Environmental Science, Radboud University, Netherlands.
abstract: Airborne pesticide contamination can result in widespread respiratory exposure particularly among agricultural workers, yet its impact on respiratory health remains poorly understood. In this study, we assessed the effects of ten commonly used pesticides and the synergist piperonyl butoxide, individually and in mixtures, on the viability of porcine proximal airway epithelial organoid-derived monolayers. Eight of the eleven compounds reduced cell viability, with pendimethalin, glyphosate, cyprodinil and piperonyl butoxide inducing pronounced effects at low concentrations. Mixture exposure caused stronger reductions in viability than individual compounds, consistent with additive toxicity. Transcriptomic analysis of seven selected compounds revealed alterations in pathways related to epithelial barrier integrity, immune signalling, and mucociliary function. These findings indicate that pesticide exposure of the upper airway may impair airway epithelial function and could contribute to respiratory dysfunction, highlighting the need to incorporate inhalation exposure and mixture effects in pesticide risk assessment. Moreover, this study provides a basis for the development of physiologically relevant models and targeted assays to evaluate respiratory effects of environmental pesticide mixtures.
abstractZh: 空气中的农药污染可导致广泛的呼吸道暴露，尤其是在农业工人中，但其对呼吸健康的影响仍知之甚少。在本研究中，我们评估了十种常用农药及增效剂胡椒基丁醚，单独及混合使用时，对猪近端气道上皮类器官来源的单层细胞活力的影响。十一种化合物中有八种降低了细胞活力，其中二甲戊灵、草甘膦、嘧菌环胺和胡椒基丁醚在低浓度下即产生显著影响。混合物暴露比单一化合物引起更强的活力降低，与加性毒性一致。对七种选定化合物的转录组分析揭示了与上皮屏障完整性、免疫信号传导和黏液纤毛功能相关的通路改变。这些发现表明，上气道农药暴露可能损害气道上皮功能，并可能促进呼吸功能障碍，强调在农药风险评估中需纳入吸入暴露和混合物效应。此外，本研究为开发生理相关模型和靶向检测方法以评估环境农药混合物的呼吸效应提供了基础。

title: Synergistic proline-based deep eutectic solvent enables low-toxicity microdroplet cryopreservation of 3D cell spheroids.
titleZh: 基于脯氨酸的协同低共熔溶剂实现三维细胞球体的低毒性微滴冷冻保存。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Chen X, Zhan T, Dang H, Han H, Guo N, Xu Y.
affiliations: Institute of Bio-thermal Science and Technology, Shanghai Co-innovation Center for Energy Therapy of Tumors, Shanghai Technical Service Platform for Cryopreservation of Biological Resources, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, Shanghai 200093, China.

School of Medical and Information Engineering, Jiangxi Provincial Key Laboratory of Tissue Engineering, Scientific Research Center, Gannan Medical University, Ganzhou 341000, China; Institute of Bio-thermal Science and Technology, Shanghai Co-innovation Center for Energy Therapy of Tumors, Shanghai Technical Service Platform for Cryopreservation of Biological Resources, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, Shanghai 200093, China.

Institute of Bio-thermal Science and Technology, Shanghai Co-innovation Center for Energy Therapy of Tumors, Shanghai Technical Service Platform for Cryopreservation of Biological Resources, University of Shanghai for Science and Technology, Shanghai 200093, China. Electronic address: xuyi@usst.edu.cn.
abstract: Establishing in vitro organoid biobanks-three-dimensional (3D) self-organized microtissues derived from stem cells or patient tissues-holds great value for clinical disease modeling, drug screening, and regenerative medicine applications. However, current cryopreservation approaches are often constrained by the use of chemically harsh cryoprotectants (CPAs) and multi-step operation procedures, which may compromise biological integrity and limit practical applicability. To address these challenges, we report a low-toxicity cryopreservation strategy that integrates an L‑proline‑based deep eutectic solvent (DES) with controlled evaporative dehydration (CED) under negative pressure, thereby reducing reliance on high concentrations of conventional CPAs during the microdroplet cryopreservation of 3D cell spheroids. As a proof-of-concept study, NIH/3T3 spheroids were used as a reproducible 3D model to evaluate the feasibility of this strategy. The amino acid architecture of L-proline DES provides intrinsic biocompatibility, abundant hydrogen-bonding sites, and strong water-structuring capacity, enabling the formation of a protective microenvironment around 3D spheroids while reducing dependence on CPAs. During CED, the L‑proline DES establishes a non‑permeating protective microenvironment around spheroids, significantly alleviating osmotic injury. A low concentration of DMSO was introduced to form a binary synergistic system that optimized cryoprotectant mass transfer and intracellular concentration dynamics, thereby providing coordinated extracellular and intracellular protection during microdroplet quenching. Quenching after 4-6 min of CED was identified as the optimal cryopreservation window. Under these conditions, post-warming viability was approximately 30 percentage points higher than that obtained with conventional slow freezing. Further molecular analyses demonstrated that this L-proline DES system was associated with enhanced antioxidant defense and attenuation of ferroptosis-related oxidative injury. This work establishes an amino acid-derived DES system for CED-based microdroplet cryopreservation and elucidates its cryoprotective mechanisms at macroscopic and microscopic levels. Crucially, it offers an efficient, low-toxicity strategy for preserving complex 3D biological systems. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: Cryopreservation of three-dimensional cell spheroids remains challenging because dense multicellular architectures limit cryoprotectant transport and increase sensitivity to osmotic and chemical injury. Here, we develop a biomaterial-enabled cryopreservation strategy combining an L-proline-based deep eutectic solvent with controlled evaporative dehydration (CED). This approach reduces dependence on high DMSO concentrations while enabling ice-free preservation and high post-thaw viability of 3D spheroids. Mechanistically, the DES-rich microenvironment buffers dehydration stress and suppresses ferroptosis-associated lipid peroxidation through regulation of iron homeostasis and GPX4/GSH antioxidant defense. This work provides a low-toxicity materials strategy for preserving complex 3D cellular constructs.
abstractZh: 建立体外类器官生物库——由干细胞或患者组织衍生的三维（3D）自组织微组织——对于临床疾病建模、药物筛选和再生医学应用具有重要价值。然而，当前的冷冻保存方法常受限于使用化学性质严苛的冷冻保护剂（CPAs）和多步骤操作流程，这可能损害生物完整性并限制实际应用。为解决这些挑战，我们报告了一种低毒性冷冻保存策略，该策略将基于L-脯氨酸的低共熔溶剂（DES）与负压下的受控蒸发脱水（CED）相结合，从而在3D细胞球体的微滴冷冻保存中减少对高浓度传统CPAs的依赖。作为概念验证研究，使用NIH/3T3球体作为可重复的3D模型来评估该策略的可行性。L-脯氨酸DES的氨基酸结构提供了固有的生物相容性、丰富的氢键结合位点和强水结构化能力，能够在3D球体周围形成保护性微环境，同时减少对CPAs的依赖。在CED过程中，L-脯氨酸DES在球体周围建立非渗透性保护微环境，显著减轻渗透损伤。引入低浓度DMSO形成二元协同系统，优化冷冻保护剂的质量传递和细胞内浓度动态，从而在微滴淬火期间提供协调的细胞外和细胞内保护。CED 4-6分钟后的淬火被确定为最佳冷冻保存窗口。在这些条件下，复温后的存活率比传统慢速冷冻高出约30个百分点。进一步的分子分析表明，该L-脯氨酸DES系统与增强的抗氧化防御和铁死亡相关氧化损伤的减轻相关。这项工作建立了一种氨基酸衍生的DES系统用于基于CED的微滴冷冻保存，并从宏观和微观层面阐明其冷冻保护机制。至关重要的是，它为保存复杂的3D生物系统提供了一种高效、低毒性的策略。意义声明：三维细胞球体的冷冻保存仍具挑战性，因为致密的多细胞结构限制了冷冻保护剂的传输并增加了对渗透和化学损伤的敏感性。在此，我们开发了一种生物材料辅助的冷冻保存策略，结合基于L-脯氨酸的低共熔溶剂与受控蒸发脱水（CED）。该方法减少了对高浓度DMSO的依赖，同时实现3D球体的无冰保存和高解冻后存活率。机制上，富含DES的微环境缓冲脱水应激，并通过调节铁稳态和GPX4/GSH抗氧化防御抑制铁死亡相关的脂质过氧化。这项工作为保存复杂的3D细胞结构提供了一种低毒性材料策略。

title: Three-dimensional cell culture models in oncology: From tumour spheroids to integrated microphysiological systems.

abstract: Traditional two-dimensional (2D) cell cultures fail to capture the structural, mechanical, and biochemical complexity of living tissues, prompting a major paradigm shift toward three-dimensional (3D) cell culture models. 3D systems faithfully replicate in vivo physiological architectures, dynamic cell-to-cell contacts, and extracellular matrix (ECM) interactions, bridging a critical gap in preclinical studies by predicting human therapeutic responses more accurately. This review explores the technological evolution from simple multicellular tumor spheroids to sophisticated microphysiological networks. Scaffold-free methods-including the hanging drop, low-adherent plates, magnetic levitation, and dynamic bioreactors-efficiently recreate the pathophysiological oxygen, nutrient, and metabolic gradients characteristic of solid tumor zonation and drug-resistance pathways. Conversely, scaffold-based systems leverage hydrogels, synthetic polymers, and decellularized matrices to dissect the biomechanics of matrix stiffness and mechanotransduction. At a higher tier of biological fidelity, patient-derived organoids preserve cellular heterogeneity, native tissue polarity, and accurate patient-specific mutational profiles, serving as critical pipelines for personalized medicine and precision drug screening. Furthermore, the integration of advanced microfluidic technologies has facilitated the engineering of tumor-, organ-, and multi-organ body-on-a-chip platforms. These microphysiological systems reconstruct dynamic fluid flow, functional tissue-vascular interfaces, physiological barriers (such as the blood-brain barrier), and systemic pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (ADME) drug profiles. Beyond deepening mechanistic insights into oncology, these interconnected 3D models provide highly ethical, predictive, and cost-effective alternatives to animal experimentation in strict alignment with the 3Rs principles. Ultimately, these complementary 3D culture technologies are transforming oncology into a highly predictive, patient-tailored discipline.
abstractZh: 传统的二维（2D）细胞培养无法捕捉活体组织的结构、机械和生化复杂性，促使向三维（3D）细胞培养模型的重大范式转变。3D系统忠实地复制了体内生理结构、动态细胞间接触和细胞外基质（ECM）相互作用，通过更准确地预测人类治疗反应，弥合了临床前研究中的关键差距。本综述探讨了从简单多细胞肿瘤球体到复杂微生理网络的技术演变。无支架方法——包括悬滴法、低附着板、磁悬浮和动态生物反应器——有效地重现了实体瘤分区和耐药途径特征性的病理生理氧、营养和代谢梯度。相反，基于支架的系统利用水凝胶、合成聚合物和脱细胞基质来剖析基质刚度和机械转导的生物力学。在更高层次的生物保真度上，患者来源的类器官保留了细胞异质性、天然组织极性和准确的患者特异性突变谱，作为个性化医疗和精准药物筛选的关键管道。此外，先进微流体技术的整合促进了肿瘤、器官和多器官体芯片平台的工程化。这些微生理系统重建了动态流体流动、功能性组织-血管界面、生理屏障（如血脑屏障）以及全身药代动力学/药效学（ADME）药物谱。除了加深对肿瘤学的机制见解外，这些相互连接的3D模型为动物实验提供了高度伦理、预测性和成本效益高的替代方案，严格遵循3Rs原则。最终，这些互补的3D培养技术正在将肿瘤学转变为一个高度预测性、患者定制化的学科。

abstract: Diabetic kidney disease involves hyperglycemia, inflammation, and epithelial cell dysfunction, but the relationship between these factors is not well understood. We demonstrate that human kidney organoids treated with elevated glucose exhibit a phenotype of epithelial detachment driven by tissue-intrinsic upregulation of proinflammatory cytokines, which can be targeted therapeutically. High glucose induces morphological deterioration of organoids featuring podocyte and tubular cell detachment without cytotoxicity. Cytokine addition sensitizes organoids to intermediate concentrations of elevated glucose. Transcriptomic analysis reveals that high glucose levels affect cytokine, inflammation, signaling, and cell adhesion pathways, resembling changes in human diabetic kidneys. Inhibitors of cytokines and signaling pathways rescue the high glucose phenotype, which is independent of osmotic effects. Thus, elevated glucose triggers a tissue-intrinsic inflammatory cascade to produce an organ-specific phenotype in epithelial cells. This paradigm is relevant for understanding and potentially treating diabetic complications in the kidneys and possibly other organs.
abstractZh: 糖尿病肾病涉及高血糖、炎症和上皮细胞功能障碍，但这些因素之间的关系尚不明确。我们证明，用升高的葡萄糖处理的人肾类器官表现出由促炎细胞因子的组织内在上调驱动的上皮细胞脱落表型，这可以作为治疗靶点。高糖诱导类器官形态恶化，表现为足细胞和肾小管细胞脱落，且无细胞毒性。细胞因子的添加使类器官对中等浓度升高的葡萄糖敏感化。转录组分析显示，高糖水平影响细胞因子、炎症、信号传导和细胞粘附通路，类似于人糖尿病肾脏的变化。细胞因子和信号通路抑制剂可挽救高糖表型，且该表型独立于渗透效应。因此，升高的葡萄糖触发组织内在炎症级联反应，在上皮细胞中产生器官特异性表型。这一范式对于理解和潜在治疗肾脏及其他器官的糖尿病并发症具有重要意义。

abstract: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is a leading cause of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but how metabolic zonation drives regional transformation remains unclear. We identify sirtuin 2 (SIRT2) as a zonated cholesterol sensor that initiates reprogramming to drive MASLD-HCC. Lineage tracing establishes zone 1 hepatocytes as the cellular origin of tumors. SIRT2 overexpression in zone 1 triggers HCC, whereas its deletion prevents carcinogenesis by restoring cholesterol and bile acid metabolism and CD8+ T cell recruitment. Mechanistically, cholesterol binds and activates SIRT2, which deacetylates sterol carrier protein 2 (SCP2) at Lys546, thereby blocking peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor α (PPARα) recruitment to the Cyp7b1 promoter, suppressing alternative bile acid synthesis, and permitting 27-hydroxycholesterol accumulation. SIRT2 inhibition reverses this cascade in mice and human hepatic organoids. Patient specimens confirm zonal SIRT2 and cytochrome P450 7B1 (CYP7B1) dysregulation. Our findings establish spatially compartmentalized cholesterol sensing as a new regulatory layer and identify SIRT2 as a druggable target in liver cancer.
abstractZh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）是肝细胞癌（HCC）的主要原因，但代谢分区如何驱动区域性转化仍不清楚。我们确定sirtuin 2（SIRT2）是一种区域性胆固醇传感器，可启动重编程以驱动MASLD-HCC。谱系追踪确定1区肝细胞是肿瘤的细胞起源。SIRT2在1区过表达触发HCC，而其缺失通过恢复胆固醇和胆汁酸代谢以及CD8+ T细胞募集来预防癌变。机制上，胆固醇结合并激活SIRT2，后者在Lys546位点去乙酰化固醇载体蛋白2（SCP2），从而阻断过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体α（PPARα）向Cyp7b1启动子的募集，抑制替代胆汁酸合成，并允许27-羟基胆固醇积累。SIRT2抑制可逆转小鼠和人肝类器官中的这一级联反应。患者标本证实了区域性SIRT2和细胞色素P450 7B1（CYP7B1）的失调。我们的发现确立了空间区室化的胆固醇感知作为一个新的调控层，并确定SIRT2是肝癌中一个可药物靶点。

abstract:
Background

Endoderm-derived organs, including the gastrointestinal tract, play central roles in nutrient digestion and absorption. They simultaneously function as an "internalized external environment" that continuously interfaces with exogenous substances, thereby constituting a frontline of host defense. Chemosensory cells within the gastrointestinal epithelium, such as enteroendocrine cells and tuft cells, use molecular mechanisms analogous to those of taste reception to detect nutrients and xenobiotic compounds. However, because these populations are sparse, a comprehensive understanding of their functions is limited.Highlight

Organoid culture systems have been developed to investigate rare chemosensory cells in endoderm-derived organs, including the gastrointestinal tract, pancreas, and taste buds, with studies progressing from mouse to primate models to improve translational relevance. Here, recent findings using primate-derived organoids of the gastrointestinal tract, pancreatic ducts, and taste buds are introduced, with particular emphasis on tuft cells.Conclusion

A working hypothesis is proposed in which sustained low-level chemical stimulation of tuft cells helps maintain the host defense system in a primed state, a state termed "immune idling," and this framework is discussed in relation to the possible biological significance of human bitter preference. Thus, endodermal chemosensory mechanisms may function as an integrated system linking metabolic regulation and host defense.
abstractZh:
背景

内胚层来源的器官，包括胃肠道，在营养物质的消化和吸收中发挥核心作用。它们同时作为一个“内化的外部环境”，持续与外源性物质接触，从而构成宿主防御的前线。胃肠道上皮内的化学感觉细胞，如肠内分泌细胞和簇细胞，利用与味觉感受类似的分子机制来检测营养物质和异生物质。然而，由于这些细胞群数量稀少，对其功能的全面了解受到限制。

亮点

类器官培养系统已被开发用于研究内胚层来源器官（包括胃肠道、胰腺和味蕾）中的稀有化学感觉细胞，研究从小鼠模型进展到灵长类模型，以提高转化相关性。本文介绍了使用灵长类来源的胃肠道、胰管和味蕾类器官的最新发现，特别强调了簇细胞。

结论

提出了一种工作假说，即簇细胞的持续低水平化学刺激有助于维持宿主防御系统处于一种“免疫怠速”状态的预备状态，并讨论了这一框架与人类苦味偏好可能的生物学意义。因此，内胚层化学感觉机制可能作为一个整合系统，连接代谢调节和宿主防御。

abstract: Targeting metabolic dependencies of leukemic stem cells (LSC) may open avenues to improve outcomes of patients suffering from acute myeloid leukemia (AML). LSCs rely heavily on an active tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle and mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation whereas healthy hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) possess more metabolic flexibility. Here, we identify the TCA cycle enzyme isocitrate dehydrogenase 3 (IDH3) as a critical and selective regulator of LSC maintenance. IDH3 is more abundant in LSCs compared to healthy HSPCs, and TCA cycle activity correlates with inferior clinical outcomes of AML patients. Knockdown of IDH3A, the catalytic subunit of the complex, impairs colony-forming potential and bone marrow organoid as well as in vivo engraftment of AML, while sparing healthy hematopoiesis. Mechanistically, IDH3A downregulation reduces TCA cycle flux and leads to accumulation of intracellular citrate, impairing both glycolysis and oxidative phosphorylation. The resulting bioenergetic crisis activates AMPK and suppresses mTORC1, leading to reduced translational activity and an imbalance of anti-apoptotic proteins. Consequently, IDH3A-KD cells show enhanced susceptibility to BCL2 inhibition by venetoclax in vitro and in vivo. In a clinical cohort, LSCs from patients resistant to venetoclax/azacitidine (Ven/Aza) exhibit transcriptomic programs indicative of active TCA cycle and glycolysis. We demonstrate that downregulation of IDH3A activity and subsequent citrate accumulation directly affect these pathways and shift AML stem cells towards a metabolic state of increased vulnerability. In summary, we establish IDH3 as a metabolic rheostat in LSCs and suggest targeting the IDH3A-citrate axis to overcome Ven/Aza resistance of AML patients.
abstractZh: 靶向白血病干细胞（LSC）的代谢依赖性可能为改善急性髓系白血病（AML）患者的预后开辟新途径。LSCs高度依赖活跃的三羧酸（TCA）循环和线粒体氧化磷酸化，而健康的造血干细胞和祖细胞（HSPCs）则具有更强的代谢灵活性。在此，我们确定TCA循环酶异柠檬酸脱氢酶3（IDH3）是LSC维持的关键且选择性调节因子。与健康HSPCs相比，IDH3在LSCs中更为丰富，且TCA循环活性与AML患者的较差临床结局相关。敲低IDH3A（该复合物的催化亚基）会损害集落形成能力、骨髓类器官以及AML的体内植入，同时不影响正常造血。机制上，IDH3A下调减少TCA循环通量并导致细胞内柠檬酸积累，从而损害糖酵解和氧化磷酸化。由此产生的生物能量危机激活AMPK并抑制mTORC1，导致翻译活性降低和抗凋亡蛋白失衡。因此，IDH3A-KD细胞在体外和体内对venetoclax的BCL2抑制表现出增强的敏感性。在一个临床队列中，对venetoclax/阿扎胞苷（Ven/Aza）耐药的患者来源的LSCs表现出指示活跃TCA循环和糖酵解的转录组程序。我们证明IDH3A活性下调和随后的柠檬酸积累直接影响这些通路，并将AML干细胞转向代谢脆弱性增加的状态。总之，我们确立IDH3为LSCs中的代谢调节器，并建议靶向IDH3A-柠檬酸轴以克服AML患者的Ven/Aza耐药性。

title: Parallel regulation of tissue morphogenesis and cell fate specification by RAR:RXR signalling during pancreas formation.
titleZh: RAR:RXR信号在胰腺形成过程中对组织形态发生和细胞命运决定的平行调控。
dateSource: Crossref published-online
authors: Kulik I, Tian C, Chubanava S, Villalba A, Krahmer N, Scharfmann R, Semb H.
affiliations: Institute of Translational Stem Cell Research (ITS), Helmholtz Center Munich, Munich, Germany.
Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Stem Cell Biology (DanStem), University of Copenhagen, Copenhagen, Denmark.
Institute for Diabetes and Obesity (IDO), Helmholtz Center Munich, Munich, Germany.
Institut Cochin, CNRS, INSERM, Université Paris Cité, Paris, France.
Department of Clinical Sciences, Lund University, Malmö, Sweden.
abstract: During embryogenesis, morphologically diverse epithelial organs bud from different regions of the embryonic gut. The unique features of each nascent organ result from distinct cell fate specification and morphogenetic events elicited by organ-inducing cues. Retinoic acid is a powerful inducer of the pancreas, yet, how it regulates pancreas specification and budding from the foregut endoderm remains poorly understood. By modeling these processes using a new hESC organoid system, we demonstrate that both pancreas budding and specification are induced by RAR:RXR signalling. On the molecular level, we identify β-CATENIN as an important downstream target and propose that the reduction of β-CATENIN at the cell membrane weakens cell-cell adhesion (resulting in perturbed apical-basal cell polarity and gut epithelium multi-layering), while its nuclear depletion relieves β-CATENIN-mediated repression of FOXA2-dependent Pdx1 transcriptional activation. Our findings provide a new framework of how developmental cues coordinate both morphogenetic and cell specification events by targeting proteins with dual roles in cell-cell adhesion and transcription, such as β-CATENIN.
abstractZh: 在胚胎发生过程中，形态多样的上皮器官从胚胎肠道的不同区域出芽。每个新生器官的独特特征是由器官诱导信号引发的不同细胞命运决定和形态发生事件所导致的。视黄酸是胰腺的强效诱导剂，然而，它如何调控胰腺特化以及从前肠内胚层的出芽仍知之甚少。通过使用一种新的hESC类器官系统对这些过程进行建模，我们证明胰腺出芽和特化均由RAR:RXR信号诱导。在分子水平上，我们确定β-CATENIN是重要的下游靶点，并提出细胞膜上β-CATENIN的减少削弱了细胞间粘附（导致顶端-基底细胞极性紊乱和肠道上皮多层化），而其核内耗竭则解除了β-CATENIN介导的FOXA2依赖性Pdx1转录激活的抑制。我们的发现提供了一个新的框架，说明发育信号如何通过靶向在细胞间粘附和转录中具有双重作用的蛋白质（如β-CATENIN）来协调形态发生和细胞特化事件。

title: Flagellar regulation in enterotoxigenic E. coli modulates innate immune activation.
titleZh: 产肠毒素性大肠杆菌的鞭毛调控调节先天免疫激活。
dateSource: Crossref published-online
authors: Ikpa P, Nengel A, Kaper JB, Donowitz M, Foulke-Abel J.
affiliations: Division of Gastroenterology and Hepatology, Department of Medicine, Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, Baltimore, Maryland, USA.
Department of Microbiology & Immunology, University of Maryland School of Medicine, Baltimore, Maryland, USA.
abstract: Enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli (ETEC) remains a leading cause of diarrheal disease in low- and middle-income countries, yet vaccine efforts have struggled to achieve broad and durable protection. To better understand early steps in host-pathogen interactions, we utilized human stem cell-derived jejunal organoid monolayers to compare epithelial responses to ETEC H10407 and E24377A, prototypical strains frequently used in controlled human infection challenges. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that H10407 uniquely stimulated a robust innate immune response, characterized by upregulation of TLR5-dependent genes, including IL-17C and CXCL6. This response was found to be driven by sustained expression of flagella, the result of a naturally occurring fliZ gene disruption in H10407, which allows flagellin production despite ample nutrient availability. Complementation with fliZ restored repression of flagellar genes, confirming its regulatory role. In epithelial-macrophage co-cultures, H10407-expressed flagella enhanced macrophage sampling of bacteria as well as IL-6 production, effects that were not replicated by recombinant flagellin alone. However, exogenous flagellin did induce epithelial IL-17C release, a cytokine implicated in adaptive immune priming. These findings identify constitutive flagellar expression as a key factor in the heightened innate immune response and virulence of H10407, and highlight its potential utility in optimizing mucosal vaccine design against ETEC.
abstractZh: 产肠毒素性大肠杆菌（ETEC）仍然是低收入和中等收入国家腹泻病的主要原因，然而疫苗研发努力一直难以实现广泛而持久的保护。为了更好地理解宿主-病原体相互作用的早期步骤，我们利用人干细胞来源的空肠类器官单层培养，比较了上皮细胞对ETEC H10407和E24377A（常用于受控人类感染挑战的原型菌株）的反应。转录组分析显示，H10407独特地刺激了强烈的先天免疫反应，其特征是TLR5依赖性基因（包括IL-17C和CXCL6）的上调。这一反应被发现是由鞭毛的持续表达驱动的，这是H10407中自然发生的fliZ基因破坏的结果，使得即使在营养充足的情况下也能产生鞭毛蛋白。用fliZ进行互补恢复了鞭毛基因的抑制，证实了其调控作用。在上皮-巨噬细胞共培养中，H10407表达的鞭毛增强了巨噬细胞对细菌的摄取以及IL-6的产生，这些效应不能仅由重组鞭毛蛋白复制。然而，外源性鞭毛蛋白确实诱导了上皮细胞释放IL-17C，这是一种与适应性免疫启动有关的细胞因子。这些发现确定了组成性鞭毛表达是H10407增强先天免疫反应和毒力的关键因素，并强调了其在优化针对ETEC的黏膜疫苗设计中的潜在用途。

title: Universal donor plasmids for biallelic degron-tagging in mammalian cells and organoids
titleZh: 用于哺乳动物细胞和类器官双等位基因降解决定子标记的通用供体质粒
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Pohl SÖ, Morán BAH, Cardozo CG, Taylor GC, Giller A, Myant KB, Macias S, Wood AJ.
abstract: Degron tags enable rapid, tuneable and reversible control of protein expression, and have become a critical tool for target validation and elucidating biological mechanisms. Tag engineering uses genome editing to generate biallelic gene fusions, though this process remains laborious and requires new donor vectors to be generated for each locus. Here, we have generated a series of universal donor vectors to enable biallelic integration of different degron tags (AID, dTAG, BromoTag, SMASh) using different selection strategies (FACS, drug selection). Using this system, tags can be fused in-frame to endogenous protein C-termini via homology-independent repair following Cas9-induced double strand breaks, as shown here using human lymphoma cells, mouse embryonic stem cells and colonic tumour organoids. This workflow simplifies the genetic engineering of degron tags and is applicable in contexts where homology-dependent repair is challenging.
abstractZh: 降解决定子标签能够实现对蛋白质表达的快速、可调节和可逆控制，已成为靶点验证和阐明生物学机制的关键工具。标签工程利用基因组编辑生成双等位基因融合，但该过程仍然费力，且需要为每个基因座生成新的供体载体。在此，我们生成了一系列通用供体载体，以通过不同的选择策略（FACS、药物选择）实现不同降解决定子标签（AID、dTAG、BromoTag、SMASh）的双等位基因整合。使用该系统，标签可以通过Cas9诱导的双链断裂后的非同源修复，与内源蛋白的C末端进行框内融合，如本文所示，在人淋巴瘤细胞、小鼠胚胎干细胞和结肠肿瘤类器官中。该工作流程简化了降解决定子标签的基因工程，并适用于同源依赖修复具有挑战性的环境。

title: Evidence for early kidney vasculature development by vasculogenesis and angiogenesis based on advanced in vivo chimeric model and depletion of CD31+/CD146+ intrinsic endothelial progenitors
titleZh: 基于先进体内嵌合模型及CD31+/CD146+内在内皮祖细胞耗竭的早期肾脏血管系统发育证据：血管生成与血管发生
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Kaisto S, Ahmad S, Halmbacher S, Glumoff V, Dönges L, Raykhel I, Skovorodkin I, Vainio SJ.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Kidney diseases are a significant health concern worldwide, with a growing demand for fundamental treatments, such as generation of transplantable organs from programmed cells. The generation of kidney organoids has led to significant advances in disease modeling. However, failure to establish a robust endothelial vasculature network in kidney organoids remains a barrier to oxygen support and gas exchange in renal tissue engineering. We targeted the development of early kidney vasculature system by advancing the classic mouse embryonic kidney organ culture and organoid model system by introducing a novel mini reservoir setup. The method improved integration with the highly vascularized chicken Chorion Allantois Membrane (CAM), enabling host blood flow to developing kidney organoids. We examined the origin and role of the CD31+ endothelial cells (ECs) and their CD146+ progenitors by applying a dissociated embryonic kidney approach. This enabled selected depletion of specific cell populations, followed by regeneration of the kidney organ primordia by reaggregation and placement on the CAM to assess organogenesis. The cell lineage and fate tracing with constitutively labelled cells revealed that the intrinsic endothelial CD146+ progenitor and those of CD31+ ECs in the kidney initiating organogenesis established the kidney vasculature. If the intrinsic EC progenitors were depleted, the mouse glomerular vascularization was rescued by the CAM derived ECs.
abstractZh:
摘要

肾脏疾病是全球范围内的重要健康问题，对基础治疗的需求日益增长，例如从程序化细胞生成可移植器官。肾脏类器官的生成在疾病建模方面取得了显著进展。然而，在肾脏类器官中未能建立稳健的内皮血管网络，仍然是肾脏组织工程中氧气支持和气体交换的障碍。我们通过引入一种新型微型储液器装置，推进了经典的小鼠胚胎肾脏器官培养和类器官模型系统，从而针对早期肾脏血管系统的发育进行研究。该方法改善了与高度血管化的鸡胚绒毛尿囊膜（CAM）的整合，使宿主血流能够进入发育中的肾脏类器官。我们通过应用解离胚胎肾脏方法，研究了CD31+内皮细胞（ECs）及其CD146+祖细胞的起源和作用。这使得能够选择性耗竭特定细胞群体，随后通过重新聚集并在CAM上放置来再生肾脏器官原基，以评估器官发生。使用组成性标记细胞的细胞谱系和命运追踪显示，肾脏中启动器官发生的内在CD146+内皮祖细胞和CD31+ECs建立了肾脏血管系统。如果内在EC祖细胞被耗竭，小鼠肾小球血管化则由CAM来源的ECs所挽救。

title: Glutamine-regulated VCP acetylation creates a proteostasis vulnerability in RB1-deficient tumor
titleZh: 谷氨酰胺调控的VCP乙酰化在RB1缺陷肿瘤中产生蛋白质稳态脆弱性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Yang B, Cao Y, Tao Y, Wang H, Dong H, Yang X, He X, Zhao B, Liu K, Wang Z, Shen J, Yan Y, Zhang Q, Wang Z, Lv Y, Yang L, Xu J, Zhang T, Hua Y, Cai Z, Mu H, Zuo D, Wang H, Sun W.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  RB1 deficiency defines an aggressive tumor state with limited therapeutic options. Osteosarcoma represents a clinically relevant model of RB1-deficient malignancy, as RB1 alterations are among the most frequent genomic events in this tumor type. However, the non–cell cycle vulnerabilities created by RB1 loss remain incompletely understood. We therefore used osteosarcoma to identify therapeutic dependencies associated with RB1 deficiency. Through high-throughput compound screening, we identified a selective vulnerability of RB1-deficient tumor cells to VCP inhibition. NMS-873 and other VCP-targeting compounds preferentially suppressed RB1-deficient cells across two-dimensional cultures, three-dimensional spheroids, patient-derived organoids, and in vivo tumor models. Mechanistically, VCP inhibition exacerbated proteostasis stress and activated endoplasmic reticulum stress responses in RB1-deficient cells. We further found that VCP function was regulated by glutamine-dependent acetylation, with lysine 615 serving as a dominant acetylation site that modulated sensitivity to VCP inhibition. Glutamine restriction phenocopied, whereas glutamine supplementation partially rescued, the effects of NMS-873 on VCP acetylation and tumor cell growth. Clinical and transcriptomic analyses further linked VCP expression and protein-folding stress programs to aggressive disease features. Together, these findings identify glutamine-regulated VCP acetylation as a metabolic–proteostasis dependency in RB1-deficient tumors and nominate VCP inhibition as a therapeutic strategy for this difficult-to-target tumor state. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE

  Glutamine-regulated VCP acetylation exposes a proteostasis vulnerability in RB1-deficient tumors, supporting VCP inhibition as a therapeutic strategy.
abstractZh:
摘要

  RB1缺陷定义了一种侵袭性肿瘤状态，治疗选择有限。骨肉瘤代表了RB1缺陷恶性肿瘤的临床相关模型，因为RB1改变是该肿瘤类型中最常见的基因组事件之一。然而，RB1缺失产生的非细胞周期脆弱性仍未完全了解。因此，我们使用骨肉瘤来识别与RB1缺陷相关的治疗依赖性。通过高通量化合物筛选，我们确定了RB1缺陷肿瘤细胞对VCP抑制的选择性脆弱性。NMS-873和其他靶向VCP的化合物在二维培养、三维球体、患者来源的类器官和体内肿瘤模型中优先抑制RB1缺陷细胞。机制上，VCP抑制加剧了RB1缺陷细胞中的蛋白质稳态应激并激活了内质网应激反应。我们进一步发现VCP功能受谷氨酰胺依赖性乙酰化调控，其中赖氨酸615作为调节VCP抑制敏感性的主要乙酰化位点。谷氨酰胺限制模拟了NMS-873对VCP乙酰化和肿瘤细胞生长的影响，而谷氨酰胺补充则部分挽救了这些影响。临床和转录组分析进一步将VCP表达和蛋白质折叠应激程序与侵袭性疾病特征联系起来。总之，这些发现确定了谷氨酰胺调控的VCP乙酰化作为RB1缺陷肿瘤中的代谢-蛋白质稳态依赖性，并提名VCP抑制作为这种难以靶向肿瘤状态的治疗策略。意义声明

  谷氨酰胺调控的VCP乙酰化暴露了RB1缺陷肿瘤中的蛋白质稳态脆弱性，支持VCP抑制作为一种治疗策略。

title: Lab-on-a-chip device integrating a human stem cell-based blood-brain barrier model with neural organoids for translational research
titleZh: 集成人干细胞血脑屏障模型与神经类器官的芯片实验室装置用于转化研究
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Vigh JP, Kocsis AE, Santa-Maria AR, Kucsápszky N, Bató E, Bolognin S, Schwamborn JC, Kincses A, Valkai S, Szecskó A, Veszelka S, Mészáros M, Porkoláb G, Phan THM, Jan J, Wirth R, Szabó Z, Culot M, Morofuji Y, Dér A, Deli MA, Walter FR.
abstract: For advanced biomedical research on central nervous system pathologies and brain targeting of nanotherapeutics, complex and well described human blood-brain barrier (BBB) models are crucial. Here we established and characterized a complex lab-on-a-chip (LOC) system integrating a BBB model with neural organoids (NO). We optimized the conditions for BBB-NO models under static and dynamic conditions. The combination of a human stem cell-derived BBB co-culture model with human midbrain organoids in a microfluidic LOC allowed the observation of BBB and neural tissue changes and the separate analysis of the barrier and brain units. The LOC design enabled phase contrast and fluorescent microscopy on the whole brain endothelial culture surface, barrier integrity and permeability measurements across the BBB model, and molecule passage into NOs. BBB-specific endothelial morphology, gene and protein expression, and good barrier integrity were demonstrated, corroborating the strength of the LOC engineering and cellular design. The transport of targeted nanoparticles across the BBB model followed by their entry to neural organoids validated the barrier integrity and transporter functionality of the dynamic, integrated and complex model. As a proof-of-concept experiment to confirm the translational value of the BBB-NO model integrated in the LOC device, we examined a clinically used hyperosmolar iodinated contrast agent, iopamidol, with confirmed neurological side effects. We corroborated that iopamidol induces transient BBB dysfunction and neural effects in the complex system, not only validating the complex dynamic BBB-NO model but also pointing to the necessity to study BBB changes together with NO functions.
abstractZh: 对于中枢神经系统病理学及纳米治疗药物脑靶向的高级生物医学研究，复杂且描述清晰的人血脑屏障（BBB）模型至关重要。在此，我们建立并表征了一个复杂的芯片实验室（LOC）系统，该系统将BBB模型与神经类器官（NO）集成在一起。我们优化了静态和动态条件下BBB-NO模型的条件。将人干细胞来源的BBB共培养模型与人中脑类器官在微流控LOC中结合，使得能够观察BBB和神经组织的变化，并分别分析屏障单元和脑单元。LOC设计使得能够在整个脑内皮培养表面上进行相衬和荧光显微镜检查，测量跨BBB模型的屏障完整性和通透性，以及分子进入NO的情况。BBB特异性的内皮形态、基因和蛋白质表达以及良好的屏障完整性得到了证实，这证实了LOC工程和细胞设计的优势。靶向纳米颗粒跨BBB模型的转运及其随后进入神经类器官，验证了动态、集成和复杂模型的屏障完整性和转运体功能。作为概念验证实验，以确认集成在LOC装置中的BBB-NO模型的转化价值，我们检查了一种临床使用的高渗性碘化造影剂碘帕醇，该造影剂已确认有神经系统副作用。我们证实碘帕醇在复杂系统中诱导了短暂的BBB功能障碍和神经效应，这不仅验证了复杂的动态BBB-NO模型，而且指出了必须将BBB变化与NO功能一起研究的必要性。

title: Hepatotoxicity assessment of antimalarial compounds from microorganisms using a liver organ-on-a-chip system
titleZh: 利用肝脏器官芯片系统评估微生物来源抗疟化合物的肝毒性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Mad-adam N, Kyaw HA, Poonsawaeng I, Ketsawatsomkron P, Bunbamrung N, Pittayakhajonwut P, Thawai C, Muta K.
abstract: Malaria remains a critical public health threat in sub-Saharan Africa and Southeast Asia owing to the emergence of resistance to gold-standard artemisinin-based combination therapies. This epidemiological shift drives an urgent need to explore novel bioactive compounds for malaria treatment. Microorganisms produce diverse secondary metabolites with potent biological activities. To develop microbe-derived antimalarial drugs, rigorous safety evaluations are crucial, particularly regarding hepatotoxicity. Therefore, we evaluated the hepatotoxic potential of three compounds with antimalarial attributes: thiolutin (NATPP0650), cochliodinol (NATPP0437), and 4’-hydroxy-mycophenolic acid (NATPP0604). Acute hepatotoxic responses were determined by biochemical assays for cell viability and damage in HepG2 cells following 24 h exposure, comparing conventional two-dimensional cultures with an organ-on-a-chip (OOC) system featuring in vivo-like functionality and long-term culture capabilities. In both culture platforms, NATPP0650 and NATPP0437 caused significant toxicity at concentrations of 10 and 50 µM, whereas NATPP0604 was relatively non-toxic. Based on the OOC data, NATPP0650 and NATPP0437 exhibited CC  50 values of 3.04 and 2.21 µM, respectively, whereas NATPP0604 had a CC  50 value > 50 µM, offering a superior safety profile with a selectivity index > 23.7. Functional assessment of HepG2 OOCs showed that NATPP0650 and NATPP0437 markedly suppressed albumin production at 10 and 50 µM, whereas NATPP0604 showed minimal inhibition. However, long-term (7 days) toxicity testing on the OOC model revealed a critical finding: NATPP0604 exerted delayed hepatotoxic effects that were undetectable in the 24-h study, as evidenced by partial reductions in cell viability at 10 and 50 µM and decreased albumin production across all tested concentrations. These findings demonstrate the therapeutic safety potential of NATPP0604 for further development as an antimalarial drug and underscore the importance of the long-term OOC data in establishing accurate safety margins for future clinical trials.
abstractZh: 由于对金标准青蒿素联合疗法耐药性的出现，疟疾仍然是撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚地区的一个严重公共卫生威胁。这种流行病学转变推动了对新型抗疟生物活性化合物的迫切需求。微生物产生多种具有强效生物活性的次级代谢产物。为了开发微生物来源的抗疟药物，严格的安全性评估至关重要，尤其是肝毒性方面。因此，我们评估了三种具有抗疟特性的化合物的肝毒性潜力：硫藤黄菌素（NATPP0650）、毛壳素（NATPP0437）和4'-羟基霉酚酸（NATPP0604）。通过生化检测评估HepG2细胞暴露24小时后的细胞活力和损伤，比较了传统二维培养与具有体内样功能和长期培养能力的器官芯片（OOC）系统。在两种培养平台中，NATPP0650和NATPP0437在10和50 µM浓度下均引起显著毒性，而NATPP0604相对无毒。根据OOC数据，NATPP0650和NATPP0437的CC50值分别为3.04和2.21 µM，而NATPP0604的CC50值>50 µM，提供了更优的安全性，选择性指数>23.7。对HepG2 OOC的功能评估显示，NATPP0650和NATPP0437在10和50 µM浓度下显著抑制白蛋白产生，而NATPP0604的抑制作用极小。然而，在OOC模型上的长期（7天）毒性测试揭示了一个关键发现：NATPP0604表现出延迟的肝毒性效应，这在24小时研究中未被检测到，表现为在10和50 µM浓度下细胞活力部分降低，以及在所有测试浓度下白蛋白产生减少。这些发现证明了NATPP0604作为抗疟药物进一步开发的治疗安全性潜力，并强调了长期OOC数据在确定未来临床试验准确安全边际中的重要性。

title: Targeting super elongation complex-driven RNA polymerase II elongation reduces plaque vulnerability.

abstract: Atherosclerotic plaque rupture is a major cause of myocardial infarction and stroke, yet the mechanisms governing plaque stability remain incompletely understood. Endothelial activation can trigger endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition, a program linked to endothelial dysfunction and lesion vulnerability. Here we investigated whether transcriptional pause release and RNA polymerase II elongation constitute an early regulatory layer that promotes endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition and atherosclerosis. Analysis of human plaque single-cell transcriptomics indicated increased expression of super elongation complex components in endothelial cells with a transition signature. In primary human endothelial cell models, pharmacological inhibition of the super elongation complex attenuated the induction of mesenchymal markers. AFF4, pCDK9, and pSMAD2/3 showed physical interaction during endothelial transition. Genome-wide profiling of RNA polymerase II occupancy revealed reduced promoter-proximal pausing during early transition, accompanied by a rapid increase in nascent transcriptional elongation rates. Super elongation complex inhibition restored pausing and suppressed fast-responding transition-associated target genes. In a human cardiac organoid model, inhibition of the super elongation complex prevented EndMT-induced fibrillar collagen deposition and prevented the loss of beating rate. In a hyperlipidemic Pcsk9 gain-of-function mouse model, super elongation complex inhibition administered both prophylactically and therapeutically after established atherosclerosis reduced plaque burden and reduced features of plaque vulnerability. Finally, analysis of 1048 human plaque segments from the Athero-Express biobank showed significant associations between the elongation axis and multiple vulnerability-related plaque traits. Together, these findings identify rapid transcriptional elongation as a mechanistic driver of endothelial plasticity and features of plaque vulnerability and support targeting the elongation machinery as a potential strategy to reduce features of plaque vulnerability in atherosclerotic disease.
abstractZh: 动脉粥样硬化斑块破裂是心肌梗死和卒中的主要原因，然而控制斑块稳定性的机制仍未完全阐明。内皮激活可触发内皮-间质转化，这是一个与内皮功能障碍和病变易损性相关的程序。在此，我们研究了转录暂停释放和RNA聚合酶II延伸是否构成促进内皮-间质转化和动脉粥样硬化的早期调控层。对人斑块单细胞转录组学的分析表明，具有转化特征的内皮细胞中超延伸复合物成分的表达增加。在原代人内皮细胞模型中，超延伸复合物的药理学抑制减弱了间质标志物的诱导。AFF4、pCDK9和pSMAD2/3在内皮转化过程中显示出物理相互作用。RNA聚合酶II占据的全基因组分析显示，在早期转化过程中启动子近端暂停减少，伴随新生转录延伸速率的快速增加。超延伸复合物抑制恢复了暂停并抑制了快速响应的转化相关靶基因。在人心脏类器官模型中，超延伸复合物的抑制阻止了EndMT诱导的纤维状胶原沉积，并防止了搏动率的丧失。在血脂异常的Pcsk9功能获得性小鼠模型中，在已建立的动脉粥样硬化后预防性和治疗性给予超延伸复合物抑制均减少了斑块负担并降低了斑块易损性特征。最后，对来自Athero-Express生物库的1048个人类斑块节段的分析显示，延伸轴与多种易损性相关的斑块特征之间存在显著关联。总之，这些发现将快速转录延伸确定为内皮可塑性和斑块易损性特征的机制驱动因素，并支持将延伸机制作为靶向策略以减少动脉粥样硬化疾病中斑块易损性特征的潜在方法。

title: Microdomes: Micro-engineered Microdome arrays enable standardised and shear-free 3D biology with full-spectrum optical imaging compatibility
titleZh: 微穹顶：微工程化微穹顶阵列实现标准化、无剪切力的三维生物学研究，并具备全光谱光学成像兼容性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Cheam MS, Binte Mohamad Raffi S, Ong HT, Ghayad SE, Le Grand M, Pasquier E, Dunbabin P, Poole K, Chin Fei Li J, Jun L, Karatas E, Lim Sheng Jie N, Lim Tze Chin J, Ganguly M, Ferguson A, Angeli V, Toyama Y, Grenci G, Beghin A.
abstract: Three-dimensional cellular models such as organoids and spheroids hold major promise for developmental biology, disease modelling and precision medicine, yet their large-scale production and analysis remain constrained by handling-induced shear stress, sample fragility, positional instability and limited compatibility with advanced imaging workflows. Here, we introduce Microdomes, dense arrays of open-top, dome-shaped microcavities. Each cavity holds a single specimen in its own miniature aquarium, accessed through a narrow apical opening that admits cells, medium, matrix and staining reagents while shielding it from the shear generated during routine pipetting. Each Microdomes chip accommodates more than 100 spheroids or organoids, supporting diverse cell types, co-culture formats and both matrix-free and matrix-embedded culture. All specimens are retained through prolonged culture, repeated medium exchange, fixation and immunostaining. Because every specimen occupies a fixed, addressable position against a thin transparent film, the same spheroid can be relocated and re-imaged over weeks of culture and across microscopes, from array-wide overviews to subcellular details, without transfer, embedding or other perturbation. Microdomes also support AI-based automated segmentation, from whole-spheroid outlines to individual nuclei in 3D, using common image analysis software. Microdomes thereby turn each array into a self-contained quality control unit, providing specimen-level traceability that organoid production pipelines currently lack.
abstractZh: 三维细胞模型，如类器官和球体，在发育生物学、疾病建模和精准医学中具有重大前景，但其大规模生产和分析仍受限于操作引起的剪切应力、样本脆弱性、位置不稳定以及与先进成像工作流程的兼容性有限。在此，我们介绍了微穹顶，即密集排列的开放式穹顶形微腔阵列。每个腔体在其自己的微型水族箱中容纳单个样本，通过狭窄的顶端开口进入，该开口允许细胞、培养基、基质和染色试剂进入，同时保护样本免受常规移液操作产生的剪切力影响。每个微穹顶芯片可容纳超过100个球体或类器官，支持多种细胞类型、共培养格式以及无基质和基质嵌入培养。所有样本在长期培养、反复更换培养基、固定和免疫染色过程中均能保留。由于每个样本都固定在薄透明膜上的可寻址位置，同一个球体可以在数周的培养期间以及跨显微镜下被重新定位和重新成像，从阵列级概览到亚细胞细节，无需转移、包埋或其他扰动。微穹顶还支持基于AI的自动分割，从整个球体轮廓到3D中的单个细胞核，使用常见的图像分析软件。因此，微穹顶将每个阵列转变为自包含的质量控制单元，提供样本级可追溯性，这是类器官生产流程目前所缺乏的。

title: Strategies in Genetic Engineering for Human Space Survival
titleZh: 基因工程策略在人类太空生存中的应用
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Imran A.
abstract: Long-duration spaceflight exposes the human body to interacting hazards, particularly space radiation and altered gravity. Radiation can induce DNA damage, oxidative stress, and genomic instability, while microgravity can alter cellular signaling, DNA-repair processes, and immune function. This narrative review examines three conceptual approaches through which genetic engineering might contribute to biological resilience during future missions. First, endogenous protective pathways could be regulated to strengthen DNA-damage responses and antioxidant defenses, including pathways involving ATM, ATR, BRCA1, BRCA2, RAD51, TP53, NRF2, and SOD2. Second, protective mechanisms from extremotolerant organisms may provide design principles or experimental candidates; examples include the tardigrade Damage suppressor protein (Dsup) and the coordinated stress-response systems of Deinococcus radiodurans. Third, these approaches could potentially be combined using regulated, context-dependent responses. None of these concepts is currently an astronaut-ready intervention. Major barriers include off-target effects, excessive pathway activation, metabolic burden, delivery constraints, immune responses, uncertain long-term effects, and ethical concerns. Progress toward any human application would require staged validation from molecular and cellular models through organoids and animal studies, followed by rigorous safety assessment, independent ethical oversight, and appropriate international governance.
abstractZh: 长期太空飞行使人体暴露于相互作用的危害中，特别是太空辐射和改变的重力。辐射可诱导DNA损伤、氧化应激和基因组不稳定性，而微重力可改变细胞信号传导、DNA修复过程和免疫功能。本叙述性综述探讨了三种概念性方法，通过这些方法，基因工程可能在未来任务中有助于生物韧性。首先，可以调控内源性保护途径，以增强DNA损伤反应和抗氧化防御，包括涉及ATM、ATR、BRCA1、BRCA2、RAD51、TP53、NRF2和SOD2的途径。其次，来自极端耐受生物的保護机制可能提供设计原则或实验候选方案；例如，缓步动物的损伤抑制蛋白（Dsup）和耐辐射奇球菌的协调应激反应系统。第三，这些方法可能通过受调控的、情境依赖的反应相结合。目前，这些概念均非宇航员可用的干预措施。主要障碍包括脱靶效应、过度途径激活、代谢负担、递送限制、免疫反应、不确定的长期影响以及伦理问题。任何人类应用的进展都需要从分子和细胞模型到类器官和动物研究的分阶段验证，随后进行严格的安全性评估、独立的伦理监督和适当的国际治理。

title: Alamandine/MrgD pathway modulates gut-bone marrow axis in ageing.
titleZh: Alamandine/MrgD通路调节衰老中的肠-骨髓轴。
dateSource: Crossref published-online
authors: Chittimalli K, Rozario HE, Martinez V, McAdams ZL, Adkins SA, Ericsson AC, Jarajapu YPR.
affiliations: Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences, College of Health and Human Sciences, North Dakota State University, Fargo, North Dakota, USA.
University of Missouri Metagenomics Center, Department of Pathobiology and Integrative Biomedical Sciences, College of Veterinary Medicine, University of Missouri, Columbia, Missouri, USA.

abstract:
Background and purpose

Ageing is associated with colon epithelial barrier disruption and up-regulation of myelopoiesis in the bone marrow (BM). Alamandine (Ala) and MrgD are novel members of the renin angiotensin system (RAS). This study tested the hypothesis that Ala restores the colon epithelial barrier integrity in ageing via modulating gut-BM axis.Experimental approach

Mice, 2-3 (Young) or 22-24 months (Old), were treated with saline or Ala by using Osmotic pumps. The intestinal permeability was evaluated using FITC-dextran. Lgr5+Olfm4+ intestinal stem cells (ISCs), Wnt3a and β-catenin were evaluated by immunohistochemistry or western blotting. Faecal microbiome was analysed by 16S rRNA sequencing. Monocyte-macrophages were characterized by flow cytometry. Caecal or serum bacterial metabolites were analysed and the caecal supernatants (CS) were tested for myelopoietic potential.Key results

MrgD was expressed in ISCs, which was decreased in the Old. Increased intestinal permeability in ageing was reversed by Ala. In the colon organoids, Ala increased Wnt3a levels and this was antagonized by NF449, SQ22536 or 666-15. Ala restored phospho-CREB and active β-catenin levels that were decreased in the Old colon-organoids. Ala increased the richness and β-diversity of the microbiota with decreased Bacillota/Bacteroidota in ageing. Ala decreased the CD80+ and increased CX3CR+ macrophages in the Old colons. Old-CS induced myelopoiesis in BM cells with higher number of pro-inflammatory macrophages, which was prevented by Ala treatment.Conclusions and implications

Targeting Ala/MrgD pathway is a promising approach for ameliorating the inflammatory stress in ageing by restoring homeostasis in the gut-BM inter-organ communication.
abstractZh:
背景与目的

衰老与结肠上皮屏障破坏和骨髓（BM）中髓系造血上调相关。Alamandine（Ala）和MrgD是肾素-血管紧张素系统（RAS）的新成员。本研究检验了以下假设：Ala通过调节肠-骨髓轴恢复衰老中结肠上皮屏障的完整性。实验方法

将2-3个月（年轻）或22-24个月（年老）的小鼠通过渗透泵给予生理盐水或Ala处理。使用FITC-葡聚糖评估肠道通透性。通过免疫组织化学或蛋白质印迹评估Lgr5+Olfm4+肠道干细胞（ISCs）、Wnt3a和β-连环蛋白。通过16S rRNA测序分析粪便微生物组。通过流式细胞术表征单核细胞-巨噬细胞。分析盲肠或血清细菌代谢物，并测试盲肠上清液（CS）的髓系造血潜力。主要结果

MrgD在ISCs中表达，在年老小鼠中表达降低。衰老中增加的肠道通透性被Ala逆转。在结肠类器官中，Ala增加了Wnt3a水平，而NF449、SQ22536或666-15可拮抗这一效应。Ala恢复了年老结肠类器官中降低的磷酸化CREB和活性β-连环蛋白水平。Ala增加了微生物群的丰富度和β多样性，并降低了衰老中Bacillota/Bacteroidota的比例。Ala降低了年老结肠中CD80+巨噬细胞的数量，并增加了CX3CR+巨噬细胞的数量。年老-CS诱导BM细胞中的髓系造血，产生更多促炎性巨噬细胞，而Ala处理可防止这一效应。结论与启示

靶向Ala/MrgD通路是通过恢复肠-骨髓器官间通讯的稳态来改善衰老中炎症应激的一种有前景的方法。

abstract: Deregulated alternative splicing (AS) is a hallmark of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet the specific splicing factors driving oncogenic programs remain largely uncharacterized. Here, we identify RNA-binding motif protein 25 (RBM25) as a potent oncogenic driver that is overexpressed in HCC and correlates with dismal patient prognosis. Functionally, RBM25 depletion impairs HCC progression across in vitro models, in vivo xenografts, and patient-derived organoids. Integrated transcriptomic and interactome profiling reveals that RBM25 orchestrates a specific AS landscape, most notably promoting exon 13 inclusion of MYPT1. Mechanistically, RBM25 recruits PRPF40A to facilitate the production of the oncogenic MYPT1-L isoform. This isoform switch acts as a molecular stabilizer for the transcriptional co-activator YAP, thereby sustaining Hippo pathway dysregulation and tumor growth. Finally, a high-throughput screen of the US drug collection identified candicidin as a small-molecule inhibitor that suppresses RBM25 expression, effectively phenocopying RBM25 knockdown. Our findings define the RBM25-MYPT1-YAP axis as a critical vulnerability in HCC and nominate RBM25 as a viable prognostic biomarker and therapeutic target.
abstractZh: 异常的选择性剪接（AS）是肝细胞癌（HCC）的一个标志，然而驱动致癌程序的特异性剪接因子在很大程度上仍未明确。在此，我们鉴定出RNA结合基序蛋白25（RBM25）是一个强效的致癌驱动因子，在HCC中过表达，并与患者预后不良相关。功能上，RBM25的缺失在体外模型、体内异种移植瘤和患者来源的类器官中均损害HCC的进展。整合转录组学和相互作用组学分析揭示，RBM25协调了一个特定的AS景观，最显著的是促进MYPT1外显子13的包含。机制上，RBM25招募PRPF40A以促进致癌性MYPT1-L亚型的产生。这种亚型转换作为转录共激活因子YAP的分子稳定剂，从而维持Hippo通路失调和肿瘤生长。最后，对美国药物集合的高通量筛选确定制霉菌素为一种小分子抑制剂，可抑制RBM25表达，有效模拟RBM25敲低的效果。我们的发现将RBM25-MYPT1-YAP轴定义为HCC的一个关键脆弱点，并提名RBM25作为可行的预后生物标志物和治疗靶点。

abstract: Plants produce a considerable number of metabolites, and many of them appear to interfere with certain cellular processes such as cell division. For example, taxanes produced by Taxus are known as anti-cancer drugs that stabilize microtubules and prevent the cell from dividing normally. Disorder of cell division also leads to abnormal growth and development in plants. It is worthy of consideration whether these metabolites have negative effects on plants per se. In this study, we developed an efficient screening system for identifying plant metabolites affecting rapeseed seedling root growth. One compound, 7-epi-10-deacetyltaxol, inhibited tissue elongation by adversely altering cell division and elongation. And it was applied to plant cell lines, rat vascular smooth muscle cells, and human tumor organoids, resulting in similar cell division suppression. Transcriptome and proteomics analysis indicated the suppression in plant growth was through brassinosteroid-regulated expression of cell cycle proteins, while cytological observation reveals microtubule morphology anomalies. Single-nucleus transcriptome sequencing revealed inhibitory effects of ovarian cancer organoids. Together, our findings identified a universal cell division inhibitor and characterized its conserved function with respective regulatory mechanisms, providing new insights into what role "harmful" plant metabolites are playing in plants.
abstractZh: 植物产生大量的代谢物，其中许多似乎干扰某些细胞过程，如细胞分裂。例如，红豆杉产生的紫杉烷类化合物已知是抗癌药物，它们稳定微管并阻止细胞正常分裂。细胞分裂紊乱也会导致植物生长和发育异常。值得考虑的是，这些代谢物是否对植物本身有负面影响。在本研究中，我们开发了一个高效的筛选系统，用于鉴定影响油菜幼苗根生长的植物代谢物。其中一种化合物，7-表-10-去乙酰紫杉醇，通过不利地改变细胞分裂和伸长来抑制组织伸长。并将其应用于植物细胞系、大鼠血管平滑肌细胞和人肿瘤类器官，结果显示出类似的细胞分裂抑制。转录组和蛋白质组分析表明，植物生长的抑制是通过油菜素甾醇调节的细胞周期蛋白表达实现的，而细胞学观察揭示了微管形态异常。单核转录组测序揭示了卵巢癌类器官的抑制作用。总之，我们的研究确定了一种通用的细胞分裂抑制剂，并表征了其保守功能及各自的调控机制，为“有害”植物代谢物在植物中扮演的角色提供了新的见解。

abstract: The inaccessibility of human brain tissue limits the study of human development and function, a challenge that human stem-cell-derived neural models are beginning to address1,2. Transplantation of neural organoids into rodent hosts enables the in vivo study of aspects of human neurodevelopment and circuit function, alongside behavioural phenotyping of the host animals. However, spatial limitations and competition with host circuits constrain the integration of neural organoids, which is critical for studying disease. Here we establish a transplantation platform using a genetic strategy to effectively deplete glutamatergic neurons from mouse neocortex and hippocampus (apallial) and neonatally engraft the cortical cavity with human stem-cell-derived cortical organoids (hCO) to generate xenocortical mice. This leads to robust graft growth with hCOs occupying most of the cortical volume and generating a diversity of human cortical cell types, including layer 5 extratelencephalic projection neurons. Human cortical neurons integrate with the mouse nervous system, and in vivo cortical graft-wide calcium imaging and electrophysiological analyses revealed patterns of organized activity resembling developing circuits. Behavioural analyses of apallial and xenocortical mice revealed broadly preserved locomotion alongside selective differences in limb coordination and altered organization of spontaneous behaviour. Lastly, this platform enabled behavioural readouts in a model of injury to developing human cortical cells. We envision that xenocortication will be useful for obtaining circuit- and behaviour-level readouts using human neurons to study neurodevelopment, model disease and develop therapeutics.
abstractZh: 人类脑组织的难以获取限制了人类发育和功能的研究，而人类干细胞来源的神经模型正开始解决这一挑战1,2。将神经类器官移植到啮齿动物宿主体内，可以在体内研究人类神经发育和回路功能的各个方面，同时对宿主动物进行行为表型分析。然而，空间限制和与宿主回路的竞争限制了神经类器官的整合，而这对于研究疾病至关重要。在这里，我们建立了一个移植平台，利用遗传策略有效耗竭小鼠新皮层和海马中的谷氨酸能神经元（无皮层），并在新生期将人类干细胞来源的皮层类器官（hCO）移植到皮层腔隙中，以生成异种皮层小鼠。这导致移植物强劲生长，hCO占据大部分皮层体积，并产生多种人类皮层细胞类型，包括第5层端脑外投射神经元。人类皮层神经元与小鼠神经系统整合，体内皮层移植物范围的钙成像和电生理分析揭示了类似于发育中回路的组织化活动模式。对无皮层和异种皮层小鼠的行为分析显示，运动能力大致保留，同时肢体协调存在选择性差异，自发行为的组织发生改变。最后，该平台能够在发育中的人类皮层细胞损伤模型中实现行为读数。我们设想，异种皮层化将有助于使用人类神经元获得回路和行为水平的读数，以研究神经发育、模拟疾病和开发治疗方法。

abstract: Developing reproducible human disease models is a central goal of biomedical research and personalized medicine. Induced pluripotent stem (iPS) cell-derived models enable investigation of underlying cellular and molecular mechanisms in humans. However, obtaining reprogrammable somatic cells is a challenge, especially when patients have limited access to hospital and research facilities. Here we provide a step-by-step protocol for noninvasive isolation of human keratinocytes via trypsinization from scalp hair with intact follicles. The samples can be collected remotely by the donor, a family member or a healthcare provider using a kit and shipped long distance at ambient temperature. This offers a major advantage over widely used methods for iPS cell generation from other somatic cells, for example, dermal fibroblasts or peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) (from invasive skin biopsies or blood collection), or renal epithelial cells (from urine). Keratinocytes can be reprogrammed to iPS cells that give rise to all three cell lineages, including the neural lineage, and used to generate cerebral organoids. The protocol yields iPS cells within 2 months of receiving the hair samples and requires basic familiarity with mammalian cell culture techniques without the need for specialized equipment. Generation of cerebral organoids from iPS cells requires 30-40 d and specialized equipment (an orbital shaker) for culture.
abstractZh: 开发可重复的人类疾病模型是生物医学研究和个性化医疗的核心目标。诱导多能干细胞（iPS细胞）衍生的模型能够研究人类潜在的细胞和分子机制。然而，获取可重编程的体细胞是一个挑战，尤其是当患者难以接触到医院和研究设施时。在此，我们提供了一份逐步操作方案，通过胰蛋白酶消化法从带有完整毛囊的头皮毛发中非侵入性分离人类角质形成细胞。样本可由捐赠者、家庭成员或医疗保健提供者使用试剂盒远程采集，并在环境温度下长途运输。这相比于广泛使用的从其他体细胞（例如，来自侵入性皮肤活检或血液采集的真皮成纤维细胞或外周血单核细胞（PBMCs），或来自尿液的肾上皮细胞）生成iPS细胞的方法，具有显著优势。角质形成细胞可以被重编程为iPS细胞，这些细胞能够产生所有三个胚层谱系，包括神经谱系，并可用于生成大脑类器官。该方案在收到毛发样本后2个月内即可产生iPS细胞，要求具备哺乳动物细胞培养技术的基本熟悉度，无需专门设备。从iPS细胞生成大脑类器官需要30-40天，并需要专门设备（轨道摇床）进行培养。

abstract: Neuroendocrine bladder carcinoma (NEBC) is a highly aggressive malignancy with unresolved lineage determinants and limited preclinical models, hindering mechanistic investigation and therapeutic development. Here, we sought to assess whether bladder epithelial-derived models are competent to acquire neuroendocrine lineage programs under defined tumor suppressor alterations and to identify candidate therapeutic vulnerabilities in these systems. We integrated genomic and transcriptomic analyses of human NEBC with genetically engineered mouse models, epithelial-derived bladder organoids, and patient-derived NEBC models. Human NEBC exhibited dominant RB1 and TP53 alterations and an epithelial transcriptional continuum consistent with lineage plasticity. In vivo, intravesical Adeno-Cre-mediated tumor suppressor deletion predominantly generated sarcoma-like tumors, whereas epithelial-restricted organoid models recapitulated the molecular and neuroendocrine features of human NEBC, supporting epithelial lineage competence for neuroendocrine differentiation. Patient-derived models and human NEBC specimens further supported epithelial identity in NEBC. Using these complementary platforms, drug screening identified homoharringtonine (HHT) as a candidate therapeutic vulnerability in the tested NEBC systems. HHT suppressed neuroendocrine marker expression, induced apoptosis, and attenuated IL6-JAK-STAT3 signaling. Together, these findings describe complementary epithelial-derived NEBC models and support further investigation of HHT as a candidate therapeutic vulnerability.
abstractZh: 神经内分泌膀胱癌（NEBC）是一种高度侵袭性的恶性肿瘤，其谱系决定因素尚未明确，且临床前模型有限，阻碍了机制研究和治疗开发。在此，我们旨在评估膀胱上皮来源的模型是否能够在特定的肿瘤抑制因子改变下获得神经内分泌谱系程序，并识别这些系统中的候选治疗弱点。我们整合了人类NEBC的基因组和转录组分析，以及基因工程小鼠模型、上皮来源的膀胱类器官和患者来源的NEBC模型。人类NEBC表现出显性的RB1和TP53改变，以及符合谱系可塑性的上皮转录连续体。在体内，膀胱内注射Ad-Cre介导的肿瘤抑制因子缺失主要产生肉瘤样肿瘤，而上皮限制性类器官模型重现了人类NEBC的分子和神经内分泌特征，支持上皮谱系具有神经内分泌分化的能力。患者来源的模型和人类NEBC标本进一步支持NEBC中的上皮身份。利用这些互补平台，药物筛选确定高三尖杉酯碱（HHT）为所测试NEBC系统中的候选治疗弱点。HHT抑制神经内分泌标志物表达，诱导凋亡，并减弱IL6-JAK-STAT3信号传导。总之，这些发现描述了互补的上皮来源NEBC模型，并支持进一步研究HHT作为候选治疗弱点。

abstract: Despite major advances in liver-on-a-chip and organoid technologies, most current in vitro liver models remain limited. Here, it is argued that these limitations are fundamentally conceptual rather than purely technical. Reverse bioengineering is introduced as a unifying design framework for liver-on-a-chip systems, in which human liver development is treated as the primary engineering blueprint rather than adult hepatic phenotype as the endpoint. Existing cell sources, liver organoids, and liver-on-a-chip platforms are critically evaluated, demonstrating that each capture complementary but incomplete aspects of liver development. Pluripotent stem cells uniquely enable access to intrinsic developmental programs and cellular diversity, organoids partially reconstruct early developmental trajectories through self-organization, and microphysiological systems provide extrinsic cues without fully encoding developmental execution. Finally, futured directions are outlined, highlighting developmentally coordinated multi-organ systems, quantitative developmental benchmarks, and the emerging role of multi-omics-enabled Digital Twins and artificial intelligence in guiding and interpreting liver-on-a-chip design.
abstractZh: 尽管肝脏芯片和类器官技术取得了重大进展，但当前大多数体外肝脏模型仍然存在局限性。本文认为，这些局限性从根本上讲是概念性的，而非纯粹技术性的。逆向生物工程被引入作为肝脏芯片系统的统一设计框架，在该框架中，人类肝脏发育被视为首要的工程蓝图，而非以成人肝脏表型作为终点。本文对现有的细胞来源、肝脏类器官和肝脏芯片平台进行了批判性评估，表明它们各自捕获了肝脏发育中互补但不完整的方面。多能干细胞独特地能够获取内在的发育程序和细胞多样性，类器官通过自组织部分重建早期发育轨迹，而微生理系统提供外在线索，但未完全编码发育执行过程。最后，本文概述了未来方向，强调了发育协调的多器官系统、定量发育基准，以及多组学驱动的数字孪生和人工智能在指导和解读肝脏芯片设计中的新兴作用。

abstract: Supplemental oxygen in premature neonates risks bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD). Although the metabolite itaconic acid (ITA) promotes transcription factor EB (TFEB) nuclear translocation to alleviate BPD, the upstream mechanism driving hyperoxia-induced TFEB sequestration remains unclear. Here, we investigated whether hyperoxia exploits liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) to trap cytoplasmic TFEB, and if ITA directly dissolves these pathological condensates. Using hyperoxia-induced BPD mice (85 % O2) and MLE12 cells, we analyzed TFEB LLPS via FRAP, fusion, and in vitro phase separation assays. ITA-TFEB binding was evaluated by surface plasmon resonance (SPR). Autophagic/mitophagic flux and apoptosis were assessed, and the necessity of TFEB was validated using shRNA knockdown in vivo and in 3D lung organoids. We found that hyperoxia promoted TFEB accumulation into cytoplasmic condensates with liquid-like properties, which was associated with the blockage of its nuclear import. ITA directly bound TFEB with high affinity (confirmed by SPR) and effectively disrupted these pathological condensates without altering basal expression. Consequently, ITA restored TFEB nuclear translocation, reactivated mitophagy, cleared dysfunctional mitochondria, and reduced AT2 cell apoptosis in BPD lungs. These protective effects of ITA were abolished by TFEB knockdown in vivo and in lung organoids. Collectively, our findings suggest that hyperoxia-triggered TFEB phase-separation-like behavior represents a novel biophysical mechanism of autophagic arrest in BPD. By acting as an endogenous metabolite capable of disrupting biomolecular condensates, ITA alleviates pathological TFEB condensates, restoring mitophagy and alveolar development, thereby proposing a paradigm of targeting aberrant macromolecular condensation for neonatal lung injury.
abstractZh: 早产儿补充氧气有患支气管肺发育不良（BPD）的风险。尽管代谢物衣康酸（ITA）促进转录因子EB（TFEB）核转位以减轻BPD，但驱动高氧诱导的TFEB隔离的上游机制仍不清楚。在此，我们研究了高氧是否利用液-液相分离（LLPS）来捕获胞质TFEB，以及ITA是否直接溶解这些病理性凝聚体。使用高氧诱导的BPD小鼠（85% O2）和MLE12细胞，我们通过FRAP、融合和体外相分离实验分析了TFEB LLPS。通过表面等离子体共振（SPR）评估ITA-TFEB结合。评估了自噬/线粒体自噬通量和凋亡，并使用shRNA敲低在体内和3D肺类器官中验证了TFEB的必要性。我们发现高氧促进TFEB积聚到具有液体样性质的胞质凝聚体中，这与核输入受阻有关。ITA直接高亲和力结合TFEB（经SPR证实），并有效破坏这些病理性凝聚体而不改变基础表达。因此，ITA恢复了TFEB核转位，重新激活了线粒体自噬，清除了功能失调的线粒体，并减少了BPD肺中AT2细胞凋亡。ITA的这些保护作用在体内和肺类器官中通过TFEB敲低被消除。总的来说，我们的发现表明，高氧触发的TFEB相分离样行为代表了BPD中自噬停滞的一种新的生物物理机制。通过作为一种能够破坏生物分子凝聚体的内源性代谢物，ITA减轻了病理性TFEB凝聚体，恢复了线粒体自噬和肺泡发育，从而提出了针对异常大分子凝聚体治疗新生儿肺损伤的范式。

abstract: Brainstem gliomas, particularly H3K27M-mutant diffuse midline gliomas (DMGs), lack effective therapies owing to anatomic inaccessibility, intact blood-brain barrier, and treatment resistance. Conventional models have low establishment rates and fail to preserve the native tumor microenvironment, limiting translational study for this rare disease. Here, we established a patient-derived brainstem glioma organoid (BSGO) platform with high success, faithfully recapitulating parental tumor features. Multi-omics and functional assays revealed that DMGs maintain oligodendrocyte precursor cell (OPC) stemness by dysregulating ACTIVIN signaling. To overcome delivery barriers and target stemness, we conducted an intrathecal drug screening and identified triple intrathecal therapy (methotrexate + cytarabine + dexamethasone, TIT) as a potent regimen against DMGs. In DMG patients, organoid-avatar guided personalized therapy induced sustained responses, with TIT-associated reductions in OPC markers reliably tracked by cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) proteomic profiling. Together, our study provides an organoid-based platform for mechanistic investigation and personalized intrathecal therapy screening and proposes TIT as a promising translational strategy for DMG.
abstractZh: 脑干胶质瘤，特别是H3K27M突变的弥漫性中线胶质瘤（DMGs），由于解剖学上难以触及、血脑屏障完整以及治疗耐药性，缺乏有效的治疗方法。传统模型建立成功率低，且无法保留原始肿瘤微环境，限制了这种罕见疾病的转化研究。在此，我们建立了一个患者来源的脑干胶质瘤类器官（BSGO）平台，具有高成功率，忠实地再现了亲本肿瘤的特征。多组学和功能分析显示，DMGs通过失调ACTIVIN信号通路来维持少突胶质前体细胞（OPC）的干性。为了克服递送障碍并靶向干性，我们进行了鞘内药物筛选，并确定三联鞘内治疗（甲氨蝶呤+阿糖胞苷+地塞米松，TIT）是对抗DMGs的有效方案。在DMG患者中，类器官“替身”指导的个性化治疗诱导了持续反应，TIT相关的OPC标志物减少可通过脑脊液（CSF）蛋白质组学分析可靠追踪。总之，我们的研究提供了一个基于类器官的平台，用于机制研究和个性化鞘内治疗筛选，并提出了TIT作为DMG的一种有前景的转化策略。

title: Prime editing models the MTARC1 A165T variant in human liver organoids, demonstrating reduced steatosis, inflammation, and fibrosis.
titleZh: Prime编辑在人肝脏类器官中模拟MTARC1 A165T变异，证明其减少脂肪变性、炎症和纤维化。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ben Saad A, Arghiani N, Weilheimer AD, Gentile SD, Toles BJ, Tripathi S, Mohsin Sayed S, Chandraker A, Mullen AC.
