title: Organoids as brain tumour models: bridging the translational gap.
titleZh: 类器官作为脑肿瘤模型：弥合转化差距。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Willott T, Marino S.
affiliations: Brain Tumour Research Centre of Excellence, Blizard Institute, 4 Newark Street, Queen Mary University of London, London E1 2AT, UK.
abstract: Advances in stem cell-derived brain organoids, enabled by the generation of human reprogrammed pluripotent stem cells, have significantly expanded the repertoire of models available for brain tumour research. These approaches have predominantly been applied to glioblastoma and medulloblastoma, leveraging brain region-specific cerebral/cortical or cerebellar organoids, respectively. Organoids have the potential to close the gap between current two-dimensional cell-based brain tumour models and patients, while helping to address the limitations of animal models. In this At a Glance article, we outline current stem cell-derived organoid-based brain tumour models and how they have expanded our understanding of paediatric and adult brain tumours, including their onset, heterogeneity and treatment. We also describe how these organoids are currently being refined toward more accurate, clinically relevant models and highlight future directions to improve their translatability.
abstractZh: 干细胞来源的脑类器官的进展，得益于人类重编程多能干细胞生成技术的实现，显著扩展了可用于脑肿瘤研究的模型库。这些方法主要应用于胶质母细胞瘤和髓母细胞瘤，分别利用脑区域特异性的大脑/皮层或小脑类器官。类器官有潜力缩小当前二维细胞为基础的脑肿瘤模型与患者之间的差距，同时有助于解决动物模型的局限性。在这篇“一览”文章中，我们概述了当前基于干细胞来源类器官的脑肿瘤模型，以及它们如何扩展了我们对儿童和成人脑肿瘤的理解，包括其发生、异质性和治疗。我们还描述了这些类器官目前如何被优化为更准确、临床相关的模型，并强调了提高其可转化性的未来方向。

title: Translational Progress of Inorganic Nanotheranostic Platforms for Gynecologic Malignancies: A Narrative Review of Endometrial, Ovarian, and Cervical Cancer Focusing on Fertility Preservation, Biosafety, and Industrial Translation.

abstract: Endometrial, ovarian, and cervical cancers differ substantially in epidemiology, anatomy, and unmet clinical need, yet the same inorganic nanomaterial toolbox is often discussed without disease-specific translational context. This narrative review synthesizes preclinical and clinical literature on gold, magnetic, mesoporous silica, carbon-based, and metal-organic framework nanotheranostic platforms identified through PubMed and Web of Science searches from database inception through August 2026, using a structured comparison across endometrial, ovarian, and cervical cancer. Particular attention is given to biosafety, reproductive toxicity, patient-derived organoid (PDO) models, AI-assisted design, manufacturing, and regulatory translation. Clinically, carbon nanoparticle suspensions have direct evidence for sentinel lymph node mapping in endometrial cancer, whereas the strongest ovarian cancer precedents for locoregional and nanomedicine delivery remain non-inorganic, including hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy and pegylated liposomal doxorubicin. In cervical disease, organic hexaminolevulinate photodynamic therapy for CIN2, approved by China's NMPA in March 2026, provides a relevant local drug-device comparator. We identified no inorganic nanomedicine currently approved specifically for a gynecologic malignancy; ferumoxytol is approved as an intravenous iron replacement product, and AuroLase gold nanoshells remain investigational, with no gynecologic trial identified. Route-matched delivery - intrauterine or hysteroscopic for endometrial cancer, intraperitoneal for ovarian cancer, and topical or intracervical for cervical disease - may therefore be more clinically relevant than increasing platform complexity alone. EC- and OC-derived organoids provide increasingly mature disease models that could support nanotherapeutic screening, but direct nanomedicine validation remains limited, while AI-assisted design is constrained by small heterogeneous datasets and limited external validation. Future progress will depend on reproductive-safety endpoints, appropriately validated PDO models, standardized manufacturing and characterization, and regulatory strategies that clearly distinguish established evidence from preclinical promise.
abstractZh: 子宫内膜癌、卵巢癌和宫颈癌在流行病学、解剖学和未满足的临床需求方面存在显著差异，然而，相同的无机纳米材料工具箱常常在没有疾病特异性转化背景的情况下被讨论。本叙述性综述综合了通过PubMed和Web of Science检索（从建库至2026年8月）获得的关于金、磁性、介孔二氧化硅、碳基和金属有机框架纳米诊疗平台的临床前和临床文献，并对子宫内膜癌、卵巢癌和宫颈癌进行了结构化比较。特别关注生物安全性、生殖毒性、患者来源类器官（PDO）模型、人工智能辅助设计、制造和监管转化。临床上，碳纳米颗粒悬浮液在子宫内膜癌前哨淋巴结定位中有直接证据，而卵巢癌局部区域和纳米药物递送的最强先例仍是非无机的，包括腹腔热灌注化疗和聚乙二醇化脂质体多柔比星。在宫颈疾病中，有机的氨基乙酰丙酸己酯光动力疗法治疗CIN2（2026年3月获中国国家药品监督管理局批准）提供了一个相关的局部药物-器械对照。我们未发现目前专门批准用于妇科恶性肿瘤的无机纳米药物；ferumoxytol被批准为静脉铁替代产品，AuroLase金纳米壳仍处于研究阶段，未发现妇科试验。因此，匹配给药途径的递送——子宫内膜癌采用宫内或宫腔镜给药，卵巢癌采用腹腔给药，宫颈疾病采用局部或宫颈内给药——可能比单纯增加平台复杂性更具临床相关性。EC和OC来源的类器官提供了日益成熟的疾病模型，可支持纳米治疗筛选，但直接的纳米药物验证仍然有限，而人工智能辅助设计受到小型异质性数据集和有限外部验证的制约。未来的进展将取决于生殖安全性终点、经过适当验证的PDO模型、标准化制造和表征，以及明确区分既有证据与临床前前景的监管策略。

Our findings suggest that LRRC32 plays a pivotal role in modulating the sensitivity of breast cancer cells to Everolimus.

title: Prophage landscapes in clinical MRSA: safety profiling and discovery of Lys81, a broad-spectrum bacteriolytic enzyme.

abstract:
Introduction

Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) poses a significant threat to global healthcare, requiring novel therapeutic strategies. Prophages, latent phage genomes integrated into bacterial chromosomes, are important resources for antimicrobial development due to their genomic stability and genetic engineering potential.Methods

In this study, we performed genomewide sequencing on 329 MRSA isolates to predict prophage sequences, followed by analyses of these prophages-including examinations of virulence genes, antibiotic resistance genes, homologous proteins of pathogenic MRSA phages, and functional predictions of these homologous proteins-to evaluate their safety and value as genetic engineering scaffolds and to screen for novel broadspectrum bacteriolytic enzymes.Results

Our data indicate that 85.7% (282/329) of strains carried complete prophage sequences; 64 strains lacked virulence factors or genes, meeting the core criteria for safe vectors. Resistance screening found only 6 prophages carried msrA, confirming the biosafety of the remaining strains. A significant correlation existed between prophage virulence gene capacity and genomic structure (R2 = 0.99986684, p = 3.64e-69). High-virulence clusters (>10 factors) showed high structural similarity; 10 characteristic sequences linked to S. aureus phages and their prevalence patterns were identified via conserved motif analysis. Collinearity analysis with reference to virulent MRSA phages and 3D structural predictions of orthologous proteins identified two lysozymes and a host-recognition device. Notably, Lys81, an N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanine amidase ortholog, was prioritized and characterized as a broad-spectrum lytic enzyme. Our data show Lys81 has key properties: (1) Broad-spectrum antibacterial activity, lysing 52.3% (23/44) of clinical S. aureus strains and cross-acting against Gram-positive bacteria such as Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Listeria; (2) Excellent environmental adaptability, maintaining activity at pH 5.0 and 0°C, with 25 mM Na+ and Ca2 + enhancing function; (3) Potent biofilm clearance, achieving 83% MRSA biofilm reduction at 50 μg/mL; and (4) Favorable in vivo safety/efficacy, eradicating MRSA infections in lung organoid models with minimal cytotoxicity.Discussion

This study establishes a theoretical foundation for the clinical translation of MRSA prophages, positioning Lys81 as a novel candidate for treating drug-resistant bacterial infections.
abstractZh:
引言

耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）对全球医疗保健构成重大威胁，需要新的治疗策略。原噬菌体是整合在细菌染色体中的潜伏噬菌体基因组，因其基因组稳定性和基因工程潜力而成为抗菌药物开发的重要资源。方法

在本研究中，我们对329株MRSA分离株进行了全基因组测序以预测原噬菌体序列，随后对这些原噬菌体进行了分析——包括毒力基因、抗生素耐药基因、致病性MRSA噬菌体同源蛋白的检测，以及这些同源蛋白的功能预测——以评估其作为基因工程支架的安全性和价值，并筛选新型广谱溶菌酶。结果

我们的数据表明，85.7%（282/329）的菌株携带完整原噬菌体序列；64株缺乏毒力因子或基因，符合安全载体的核心标准。耐药性筛选发现仅6个原噬菌体携带msrA，证实其余菌株的生物安全性。原噬菌体毒力基因容量与基因组结构之间存在显著相关性（R² = 0.99986684，p = 3.64e-69）。高毒力簇（>10个因子）显示出高度结构相似性；通过保守基序分析鉴定了10个与金黄色葡萄球菌噬菌体相关的特征序列及其流行模式。以致病性MRSA噬菌体为参考的共线性分析和直系同源蛋白的3D结构预测鉴定出两种溶菌酶和一种宿主识别装置。值得注意的是，Lys81，一种N-乙酰胞壁酰-L-丙氨酸酰胺酶直系同源物，被优先选择并表征为广谱溶菌酶。我们的数据显示Lys81具有关键特性：（1）广谱抗菌活性，可裂解52.3%（23/44）的临床金黄色葡萄球菌菌株，并对革兰氏阳性菌如铜绿假单胞菌和李斯特菌具有交叉作用；（2）优异的环境适应性，在pH 5.0和0°C下保持活性，25 mM Na⁺和Ca²⁺增强其功能；（3）强大的生物膜清除能力，在50 μg/mL浓度下使MRSA生物膜减少83%；以及（4）良好的体内安全性和有效性，在肺类器官模型中根除MRSA感染且细胞毒性极小。讨论

本研究为MRSA原噬菌体的临床转化奠定了理论基础，将Lys81定位为治疗耐药细菌感染的新型候选药物。

abstract: tooth-on-chip platforms recapitulate dental epithelial-mesenchymal (DE-DM) interactions, offering physiologically relevant in vitro models for tooth regeneration. However, broader adoption requires chip-scale analytical methods capable of resolving cell-type-specific transcriptional programs and characterizing mineral formation. Here, we present a multi-modal workflow adapting five established approaches to fibrin hydrogel-based tooth-on-chip constructs. Whole-construct RNA extraction yielded high-integrity RNA suitable for bulk RNA sequencing, enabling pooled transcriptional comparisons between dental epithelium and mesenchyme. Magnetic-activated cell sorting achieved efficient recovery and enrichment from chip-relevant cell inputs, while translating this approach to intact constructs revealed a platform-level incompatibility between fibrin dissolution and downstream sorting. Fixation strategies preserved tissue morphology for spatial transcriptomics but came at the cost of RNA quality, and Raman spectroscopy combined with transmission electron microscopy enabled ultrastructural assessment of calcium phosphate deposition, though confirming mature hydroxyapatite required further validation. Together, this workflow establishes a practical framework for benchmarking analytical readouts in fibrin-based tooth-on-chip and related organ-on-chip co-culture systems. Established whole-construct RNA extraction for bulk transcriptional profiling of DE-DM co-cultures Adapted cell sorting and dissociation strategies for cell-type-specific enrichment, identifying key compatibility constraints Applied spatial transcriptomics preparation and spectroscopic/ultrastructural imaging to characterize tissue architecture and calcium phosphate deposition.
abstractZh: 牙芯片平台重现牙上皮-间充质（DE-DM）相互作用，为牙齿再生提供了生理相关的体外模型。然而，更广泛的采用需要能够解析细胞类型特异性转录程序并表征矿物质形成的芯片规模分析方法。在这里，我们提出了一种多模态工作流程，将五种已建立的方法适应于基于纤维蛋白的牙芯片构建体。全构建体RNA提取产生了适合批量RNA测序的高完整性RNA，使得牙上皮和间充质之间的汇总转录比较成为可能。磁激活细胞分选实现了从芯片相关细胞输入中的高效回收和富集，而将这种方法转化为完整构建体则揭示了纤维蛋白溶解与下游分选之间的平台级不相容性。固定策略保留了组织形态以用于空间转录组学，但以RNA质量为代价，拉曼光谱结合透射电子显微镜能够对磷酸钙沉积进行超微结构评估，尽管确认成熟羟基磷灰石需要进一步验证。总之，该工作流程为在基于纤维蛋白的牙芯片及相关器官芯片共培养系统中基准化分析读数建立了一个实用框架。建立了用于DE-DM共培养物批量转录谱分析的全构建体RNA提取方法；调整了细胞分选和解离策略以实现细胞类型特异性富集，识别了关键相容性限制；应用了空间转录组学制备和光谱/超微结构成像来表征组织结构和磷酸钙沉积。

abstract: The convergence of microfluidic engineering and organ-on-a-chip (OoC) technology is redefining the development and preclinical validation of polymer-based drug delivery systems and biomedical preparations. This review presents a bidirectional framework: first, how microfluidics enables precision synthesis of polymer particles with controlled size, morphology and multifunctionality; second, how OoC platforms serve as physiologically relevant testbeds to evaluate these particles under dynamic, human-mimetic conditions. We examine droplet microfluidics principles for generating monodisperse polymer particles (spheres, Janus, core-shell, porous architectures) from natural and synthetic polymers. These particles are explored as functional additives within OoC systems, as embedded sensors for real-time oxygen/pH monitoring, as controlled-release depots for localized growth factor delivery and as building blocks (microscaffolds, bioinks, spheroid templates) for constructing three-dimensional tissue microenvironments. Conversely, we critically analyze how OoC platforms, including vascularized tumor models, liver-kidney multi-organ chips and blood-brain barrier systems, enable more physiologically relevant assessment of micro- and nanoparticle transport, extravasation, toxicity, immunogenicity and metabolism under fluidic shear and multi-cellular complexity, which are capabilities inaccessible to static cultures. Current challenges (scalability, GMP compliance, standardization, regulatory context-of-use) and emerging opportunities (smart responsive particles, personalized screening using patient-derived organoids, AI-driven automation and closed-loop optimization) are critically discussed. This review demonstrates that microfluidic particle engineering and OoC technology together form an iterative framework for advancing next-generation biomaterials and supporting their preclinical-to-clinical development pathway.
abstractZh: 微流控工程与器官芯片（OoC）技术的融合正在重新定义基于聚合物的药物递送系统和生物医学制剂的开发及临床前验证。本综述提出了一个双向框架：首先，微流控如何实现具有可控尺寸、形态和多功能性的聚合物颗粒的精确合成；其次，OoC平台如何作为生理相关的测试平台，在动态、模拟人体的条件下评估这些颗粒。我们探讨了液滴微流控原理，用于从天然和合成聚合物生成单分散聚合物颗粒（球形、Janus、核壳、多孔结构）。这些颗粒被探索作为OoC系统内的功能添加剂，作为实时氧/ pH监测的嵌入式传感器，作为局部生长因子递送的控释储库，以及作为构建三维组织微环境的构建块（微支架、生物墨水、球体模板）。相反，我们批判性地分析了OoC平台，包括血管化肿瘤模型、肝-肾多器官芯片和血脑屏障系统，如何在流体剪切和多细胞复杂性下实现微米和纳米颗粒转运、外渗、毒性、免疫原性和代谢的更生理相关评估，这些能力是静态培养无法实现的。当前挑战（可扩展性、GMP合规性、标准化、监管使用环境）和新兴机遇（智能响应颗粒、使用患者来源类器官的个性化筛选、AI驱动的自动化和闭环优化）得到了批判性讨论。本综述表明，微流控颗粒工程和OoC技术共同构成了一个迭代框架，用于推进下一代生物材料并支持其从临床前到临床的开发路径。

abstract:
Purpose

Gastric cancer is a heterogeneous disease in which cancer stem cell-associated properties may contribute to tumor heterogeneity and progression. This study aimed to establish paired normal and tumor gastric organoids, characterize stemness-related gene expression, and explore its association with organoid formation.Methods

Normal and tumor tissues were obtained from 12 patients with advanced gastric cancer. A total of 28 independent organoid cultures were established from 24 tissue specimens (12 normal and 12 tumor), with selected serial strip specimens divided into segments and cultured independently. Expression of stemness-associated markers (AQP5, CD44, ALDH1A, STMN1, and SOX2) was evaluated by quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction and compared according to tissue origin, histological subtype, and organoid formation status.Results

Normal organoids tended to exhibit higher CD44 expression, whereas tumor-derived organoids showed relatively higher ALDH1A expression, although these differences were not statistically significant. Margin-derived normal organoids tended to show higher expression of multiple stemness-associated markers than those derived from tissue adjacent to tumors. Diffuse-type organoids tended to show higher CD44 expression, whereas AQP5, ALDH1A, STMN1, and SOX2 tended to be higher in intestinal-type organoids. Organoid-forming cultures consistently showed higher stemness-marker expression than non-forming cultures, particularly among tumor-derived organoids.Conclusion

Stemness-associated gene expression varied according to tissue origin, histological subtype, and organoid formation status. Higher stemness-marker expression in organoid-forming cultures suggests a potential association between stemness-related programs and organoid-forming capacity.
abstractZh:
目的

胃癌是一种异质性疾病，其中癌症干细胞相关特性可能有助于肿瘤的异质性和进展。本研究旨在建立配对的正常和肿瘤胃类器官，表征干性相关基因的表达，并探讨其与类器官形成的关系。方法

从12名晚期胃癌患者获取正常和肿瘤组织。从24个组织标本（12个正常和12个肿瘤）中建立了总共28个独立的类器官培养物，选定的连续条状标本被分割成段并独立培养。通过定量实时聚合酶链反应评估干性相关标志物（AQP5、CD44、ALDH1A、STMN1和SOX2）的表达，并根据组织来源、组织学亚型和类器官形成状态进行比较。结果

正常类器官倾向于表现出更高的CD44表达，而肿瘤来源的类器官显示出相对较高的ALDH1A表达，尽管这些差异在统计学上不显著。边缘来源的正常类器官倾向于表现出比肿瘤邻近组织来源的类器官更高的多种干性相关标志物表达。弥漫型类器官倾向于表现出更高的CD44表达，而AQP5、ALDH1A、STMN1和SOX2在肠型类器官中倾向于更高。形成类器官的培养物始终表现出比未形成培养物更高的干性标志物表达，尤其是在肿瘤来源的类器官中。结论

干性相关基因的表达因组织来源、组织学亚型和类器官形成状态而异。形成类器官的培养物中干性标志物表达更高，表明干性相关程序与类器官形成能力之间存在潜在关联。

abstract: Microplastics (MPs, 5 μm particles show negligible internalization, 3D HOs exhibited significant accumulation of intact micron-scale MPs via tissue-layer penetration and paracellular retention, with PP uptake peaking at ∼40% within 48 h and ∼18% retained long-term. This triggered dose- and time-dependent hepatotoxicity (40-4000 ng/mL), marked by CD36 upregulation from 8 h, mitochondrial impairment, and elevated LDH and AST levels. Notably, NR fluorescence intensity was governed by polymer chemistry rather than surface roughness, enabling material-specific detection. This work provides novel label-free techniques within 3D in vitro models to explore the depot and effective concentration of micron-scale MPs, advancing understanding of MP-induced cellular damage upon uptake and deposition.
abstractZh: 微塑料（MPs，5 μm颗粒显示出可忽略的内在化，3D HOs通过组织层穿透和细胞旁滞留表现出显著的完整微米级MPs积累，其中PP摄取在48小时内达到峰值约40%，长期保留约18%。这引发了剂量和时间依赖性的肝毒性（40-4000 ng/mL），表现为从8小时开始的CD36上调、线粒体损伤以及LDH和AST水平升高。值得注意的是，NR荧光强度受聚合物化学性质而非表面粗糙度控制，从而实现材料特异性检测。这项工作在3D体外模型中提供了新颖的无标记技术，以探索微米级MPs的储库和有效浓度，增进了对MPs摄取和沉积引起细胞损伤的理解。

title: A ferroptosis nanoplatform for overcoming radioresistance in KRAS-mutant colorectal cancer.
titleZh: 一种铁死亡纳米平台用于克服KRAS突变结直肠癌的放射抗性。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Deng L, Zhang P, Qin X, Tang L, Liu R, Li F, Xiao J, Zhao M.

abstract: KRAS mutations drive poor outcomes in colorectal cancer (CRC), largely by conferring resistance to radiotherapy. In clinical samples, we trace this resistance to an upregulated SLC7A11/GPX4 axis, a defense that shields cancer cells from ferroptosis. Targeting this pathway to re-enable ferroptosis, therefore, represents a rational strategy to restore radiosensitivity. Sulfasalazine (SAS), an FDA-approved drug, inhibits SLC7A11 and induces ferroptosis, but its clinical application is restricted by systemic toxicity and poor tumor accumulation. To bypass these limitations, we develop multifunctional SAS-loaded hafnium oxide nanoparticles (HfO2@SAS). Ultra-small HfO2@SAS enables efficient local drug retention and subsequent clearance, minimizing long-term retention risks and supporting favorable biocompatibility. HfO2@SAS serves a dual function: HfO2 amplifies radiotherapy via physical radiosensitization through X-ray energy deposition, while SAS disables antioxidant defenses to induce ferroptosis. In KRAS-mutant CRC, this nanoplatform overcomes radioresistance by integrating physical and biochemical mechanisms. Consistent with clinical sample data, we validate the efficacy of HfO2@SAS in cell and animal levels. Patient-derived organoids provide a human-relevant platform that further supports these findings. Collectively, these findings validate the potential of nanomedicine in combating refractory KRAS-mutant CRC and provide a proof-of-concept for advancing radio-drug combination therapy.
abstractZh: KRAS突变导致结直肠癌（CRC）预后不良，主要通过赋予放射治疗抗性。在临床样本中，我们将这种抗性追溯到上调的SLC7A11/GPX4轴，这是一种保护癌细胞免受铁死亡（ferroptosis）的防御机制。因此，靶向该通路以重新启用铁死亡，代表了一种恢复放射敏感性的合理策略。柳氮磺吡啶（SAS）是一种FDA批准的药物，可抑制SLC7A11并诱导铁死亡，但其临床应用受到全身毒性和肿瘤蓄积不良的限制。为了绕过这些限制，我们开发了多功能SAS负载的氧化铪纳米颗粒（HfO2@SAS）。超小尺寸的HfO2@SAS能够实现高效的局部药物滞留和随后的清除，最大限度地降低长期滞留风险并支持良好的生物相容性。HfO2@SAS具有双重功能：HfO2通过X射线能量沉积的物理放射增敏作用放大放射治疗，而SAS则通过削弱抗氧化防御来诱导铁死亡。在KRAS突变的CRC中，该纳米平台通过整合物理和生化机制克服了放射抗性。与临床样本数据一致，我们在细胞和动物水平上验证了HfO2@SAS的疗效。患者来源的类器官提供了一个与人类相关的平台，进一步支持了这些发现。总的来说，这些发现验证了纳米药物在对抗难治性KRAS突变CRC方面的潜力，并为推进放射-药物联合治疗提供了概念验证。

title: Materials and Surface Chemistry of Organ-on-Chip Microdevices: Polymer Networks, Interfacial Functionalization, and Small-Molecule Partitioning in Pharmaceutical Microphysiological Systems
titleZh: 器官芯片微器件的材料与表面化学：聚合物网络、界面功能化及药物微生理系统中的小分子分配
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Odibo A.
abstract: Organ-on-chip (OoC) systems — microfluidic devices lined with living human cells that reconstitute organ-level structure and function in vitro — are, at the materials level, chemical constructs: cross-linked siloxane or hydrocarbon polymer networks, plasma-activated and silanized at defined interfaces, coated with adsorbed or covalently immobilized extracellular-matrix proteins, and in continuous chemical exchange with the small-molecule drugs and metabolites they are built to study. This extensively referenced perspective takes that materials- and surface-chemistry foundation as its organizing frame. It first details the polymer network chemistry of poly(dimethylsiloxane) (PDMS) device fabrication — hydrosilylation cross-linking, epoxide-based photoresist chemistry in mold production, oxygen-plasma-driven silanol (Si–OH) generation, siloxane (Si–O–Si) covalent bonding, the thermodynamically driven hydrophobic recovery that constrains device assembly windows, and silane-coupling and carbodiimide bioconjugation chemistry used to immobilize extracellular-matrix proteins at defined interfaces. It then addresses, in quantitative chemical terms, the single limitation most consequential to pharmaceutical use of these devices: PDMS's bulk absorption of lipophilic small molecules, contrasted against surface-adsorption-dominated, more chemically inert alternatives such as cyclic olefin copolymer (COC) and styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene (SEBS) elastomers, drawing on partition-coefficient data spanning logP values from below zero to above five. Building on this materials-chemistry foundation, the article reviews organ-specific pharmaceutical evidence across the systems most developed for drug testing — liver (drug-induced liver injury, DILI), kidney (drug-induced kidney injury, DIKI, and transporter-mediated clearance), heart (torsadogenic and structural cardiotoxicity), blood-brain barrier (CNS drug permeability), gut (absorption and peristalsis-dependent differentiation), and immune-competent chips (cytokine release syndrome and immuno-oncology) — before detailing the regulatory landscape on both sides of the Atlantic, market trajectory, the organoid-versus-chip comparison, and the technical and institutional barriers, including chemistry-rooted ones, that continue to separate OoC technology from routine pharmaceutical use. As of mid-2026, no organ-chip has achieved full FDA qualification, though several sponsors have submitted chip-derived data directly within individual investigational new drug (IND) applications, and one hepatotoxicity chip has cleared the first of three ISTAND qualification stages. This article argues that organ-chip material and surface chemistry is not a peripheral fabrication detail but a first-order determinant of whether a given platform's pharmacological data can be trusted, and that organ chips are best understood today not as animal-testing replacements but as a maturing, chemistry-constrained, regulator-engaged evidentiary category whose near-term value is organ-system-specific and accrues fastest where substrate chemistry has been matched to the physicochemical properties of the compound class under study.
abstractZh: 器官芯片（OoC）系统——内衬活体人类细胞、在体外重建器官级结构和功能的微流控器件——在材料层面上是化学构造物：交联的硅氧烷或烃类聚合物网络，在特定界面经等离子体活化和硅烷化处理，涂覆有吸附或共价固定的细胞外基质蛋白，并与其所研究的小分子药物和代谢物持续进行化学交换。这篇引用广泛的视角文章以材料和表面化学基础作为其组织框架。它首先详细介绍了聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）器件制造的聚合物网络化学——氢化硅烷化交联、模具制造中的环氧基光刻胶化学、氧等离子体驱动的硅醇（Si–OH）生成、硅氧烷（Si–O–Si）共价键合、限制器件组装窗口的热力学驱动的疏水恢复，以及用于在特定界面固定细胞外基质蛋白的硅烷偶联和碳二亚胺生物偶联化学。然后，它以定量化学术语阐述了这些器件在制药用途中最具后果性的单一限制：PDMS对亲脂性小分子的本体吸收，并与以表面吸附为主、化学性质更惰性的替代材料（如环烯烃共聚物（COC）和苯乙烯-乙烯-丁烯-苯乙烯（SEBS）弹性体）进行对比，利用了logP值从低于零到高于五的分配系数数据。在此材料化学基础之上，文章回顾了在药物测试中发展最成熟的系统中的器官特异性药理学证据——肝脏（药物性肝损伤，DILI）、肾脏（药物性肾损伤，DIKI和转运体介导的清除）、心脏（致心律失常和结构性心脏毒性）、血脑屏障（中枢神经系统药物通透性）、肠道（吸收和蠕动依赖性分化）以及免疫活性芯片（细胞因子释放综合征和免疫肿瘤学）——然后详细介绍了大西洋两岸的监管环境、市场轨迹、类器官与芯片的比较，以及继续将OoC技术与常规制药用途分开的技术和制度障碍，包括源于化学的障碍。截至2026年中期，尚无器官芯片获得FDA的完全资格认定，尽管已有多个申办方在个别研究性新药（IND）申请中直接提交了芯片衍生数据，且一个肝毒性芯片已通过ISTAND资格认定的三个阶段的第一个阶段。本文认为，器官芯片的材料和表面化学不是外围的制造细节，而是决定特定平台的药理学数据是否可信的一阶因素，并且今天最好将器官芯片理解为不是动物试验的替代品，而是一个成熟的、受化学约束的、监管参与的证据类别，其近期价值是器官系统特异性的，并且在底物化学与所研究化合物类别的理化性质相匹配的地方积累最快。

abstract: Diabetic kidney disease has increasingly emerged as a global public health concern, yet substantial challenges persist in its mechanistic research and drug development. Traditional 2-dimensional cell cultures and animal models frequently lack the capacity to faithfully recapitulate human pathophysiological conditions, and the use of animal models is increasingly limited by ethical and policy-related hurdles. In vitro models such as organoids and organs-on-a-chip have demonstrated remarkable advantages, enabling more faithful simulation of the in vivo microenvironment. The advancement of 3-dimensional bioprinting, microfluidic, and vascularization technologies has further propelled the maturation and progress of in vitro kidney models. This review summarizes and discusses in vitro kidney models and their advances, including kidney cell lines, spheroids, kidney organoids, and kidneys-on-a-chip. It also elaborates on the establishment of diabetic kidney disease models based on these in vitro platforms, which provides robust support for both basic and clinical research.
abstractZh: 糖尿病肾病日益成为全球性的公共卫生问题，然而其机制研究和药物开发仍面临巨大挑战。传统的二维细胞培养和动物模型往往无法忠实再现人类病理生理状况，且动物模型的使用日益受到伦理和政策障碍的限制。类器官和器官芯片等体外模型已显示出显著优势，能够更忠实地模拟体内微环境。三维生物打印、微流控和血管化技术的进步进一步推动了体外肾脏模型的成熟和发展。本综述总结并讨论了体外肾脏模型及其进展，包括肾脏细胞系、球体、肾脏类器官和肾脏芯片。它还详细阐述了基于这些体外平台建立糖尿病肾病模型的方法，为基础和临床研究提供了有力支持。

abstract: The choroid plexus (ChP) secretes cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and forms the blood-CSF barrier (BCSFB), playing indispensable roles in brain development and homeostasis. However, tractable human ChP models remain limited, with current organoid protocols largely overlooking the stem cell niche as a determinant of lineage commitment. Here, we report that a small number of ChP organoids sporadically emerge during skin organoid induction, and switching human embryonic stem cells (hESCs) culture from E8 to mTeSR1 medium-preconditioning cells toward a neural-primed state-substantially enhances ChP organoid induction efficiency from <3% to ∼68%. Mechanistically, mTeSR1 culture suppresses BMP and WNT activity while upregulating neuroepithelial programs, thereby enabling robust ChP differentiation upon BMP4 exposure. The resulting organoids recapitulate key structural and functional attributes of native ChP, including polarized epithelium and CSF-like fluid (iCSF) secretion. Notably, iCSF-derived exosomes closely mirror the protein composition of native CSF exosomes. Furthermore, expression of the early ChP markers OTX2 and MSX1 suggest progressive specification toward the ChP fate. These ChP organoids likely represent a mixed ventricular identity with predominant hindbrain characteristics and exhibit selective susceptibility to SARS-CoV-2 infection, validating their physiological relevance. This niche-driven priming strategy provides a scalable platform for modeling ChP development, barrier transport, and neurological disorders.
abstractZh: 脉络丛（ChP）分泌脑脊液（CSF）并形成血-脑脊液屏障（BCSFB），在大脑发育和稳态中发挥不可或缺的作用。然而，易于处理的人ChP模型仍然有限，目前的类器官方案在很大程度上忽视了干细胞生态位作为谱系决定的决定因素。在这里，我们报告说，在皮肤类器官诱导过程中，少量ChP类器官零星出现，将人胚胎干细胞（hESCs）培养从E8切换到mTeSR1培养基——将细胞预条件化至神经预启动状态——显著提高了ChP类器官诱导效率，从<3%提高到约68%。机制上，mTeSR1培养抑制BMP和WNT活性，同时上调神经上皮程序，从而在BMP4暴露时实现稳健的ChP分化。由此产生的类器官重现了天然ChP的关键结构和功能属性，包括极化上皮和CSF样液体（iCSF）分泌。值得注意的是，iCSF来源的外泌体密切反映了天然CSF外泌体的蛋白质组成。此外，早期ChP标志物OTX2和MSX1的表达表明向ChP命运的渐进特化。这些ChP类器官可能代表混合心室身份，以主要后脑特征为主，并表现出对SARS-CoV-2感染的选择性易感性，验证了它们的生理相关性。这种生态位驱动的预启动策略为模拟ChP发育、屏障转运和神经系统疾病提供了一个可扩展的平台。

abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a multifactorial neurodevelopmental condition marked by heterogeneity in its clinical presentations, which complicates both its diagnosis and treatment. Despite advancements, the molecular mechanisms underlying ASD remain largely unclear. In recent years, two independent yet highly promising technological domains have made significant advancements: organoids and artificial intelligence (AI). Brain organoids can simulate critical processes of human neurodevelopment in both physiological and pathological states, providing an unprecedented window into the mechanisms and potential therapeutics of ASD. Simultaneously, AI has demonstrated formidable capabilities for processing and analyzing large-scale, high-dimensional biomedical data, and has been effectively applied to ASD imaging analysis, genomics research, and behavioral data interpretation. However, these two fields have developed mainly in parallel, leaving their potential for cross-disciplinary integration untapped in ASD research. This review aims to fill this gap by reviewing the current status and limitations of both fields in the context of ASD, and to elucidate a promising research paradigm that integrates AI with brain organoids, called "organoid intelligence", to enhance our understanding of predictive models, unravel ASD pathogenesis, and develop more effective and individualized therapies.
abstractZh: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种多因素神经发育状况，其临床表现在个体间存在异质性，这使其诊断和治疗变得复杂。尽管取得了进展，但ASD背后的分子机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。近年来，两个独立但极具前景的技术领域取得了显著进展：类器官和人工智能（AI）。脑类器官可以模拟人类神经发育在生理和病理状态下的关键过程，为理解ASD的机制和潜在治疗方法提供了一个前所未有的窗口。同时，AI在处理和分析大规模、高维生物医学数据方面展现出了强大的能力，并已有效应用于ASD影像分析、基因组学研究和行为数据解读。然而，这两个领域主要平行发展，它们在ASD研究中的跨学科整合潜力尚未被开发。本综述旨在通过回顾这两个领域在ASD背景下的现状和局限性来填补这一空白，并阐明一种将AI与脑类器官相结合的有前景的研究范式，称为“类器官智能”，以增强我们对预测模型的理解，揭示ASD的发病机制，并开发更有效和个体化的治疗方法。

title: Immune-mediated rheumatoid arthritis: from single-cell genomics to new therapies.
titleZh: 免疫介导的类风湿关节炎：从单细胞基因组学到新疗法。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ivashkiv LB.
affiliations: Research Institute and David Z. Rosensweig Genomics Research Center, Hospital for Special Surgery, New York, NY, USA. ivashkivl@hss.edu.

Immunology and Microbial Pathogenesis Graduate Program, Weill Cornell Medicine, New York, NY, USA. ivashkivl@hss.edu.
abstract: The recent application of single-cell genomics to the investigation of immune-mediated arthritis has resulted in an explosion of information, including the discovery of lymphocyte, myeloid and fibroblast cell subsets proposed to be pathogenic. A challenge in the field is how to leverage these exciting but largely descriptive and correlative datasets to gain insights into causality and mechanisms of disease. In this Perspective, I describe emerging data and discuss ideas about how spatial transcriptomics, ex vivo mechanistic and organoid studies, and improved use of animal models based on human disease data can advance the understanding of immune-mediated arthritis pathogenesis, with a focus on rheumatoid arthritis. These insights can form the basis for designing new therapeutic strategies and implementing clinical trials. The concepts and approaches described here for arthritis may have broader applicability to other tissues and immune-mediated diseases.
abstractZh: 最近将单细胞基因组学应用于免疫介导的关节炎研究，产生了大量信息，包括发现被认为具有致病性的淋巴细胞、髓系细胞和成纤维细胞亚群。该领域的一个挑战是如何利用这些令人兴奋但主要是描述性和相关性的数据集，来深入了解疾病的因果性和机制。在这篇观点文章中，我描述了新兴数据，并讨论了空间转录组学、体外机制和类器官研究，以及基于人类疾病数据改进动物模型使用如何能促进对免疫介导的关节炎发病机制的理解，重点关注类风湿关节炎。这些见解可以为设计新的治疗策略和实施临床试验奠定基础。这里描述的关节炎概念和方法可能对其他组织和免疫介导的疾病具有更广泛的适用性。

title: ATR inhibitors synergise with mitomycin C to enhance cytotoxicity in patient-derived non-muscle invasive bladder cancer organoids.
titleZh: ATR抑制剂与丝裂霉素C协同增强患者来源的非肌层浸润性膀胱癌类器官的细胞毒性。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract:
Background

There is a high recurrence rate in non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) patients treated with intravesical chemotherapy or BCG, indicating the need for novel treatment options. Synergy between DNA damage response inhibitors and chemotherapy has been shown for different solid tumours. Here, we explore whether combining chemotherapeutic agents with Ataxia telangiectasia and Rad3-related (ATR) kinase inhibitors is a suitable strategy to reduce recurrence in NMIBC.Methods

NMIBC patient-derived organoids (PDOs; n = 6) were exposed to mitomycin C (MMC) for 2 h, to mimic intravesical instillation, and subsequently to ATR inhibitors (berzosertib, ceralasertib, tuvusertib) for 72 h. Additionally, combination treatments with gemcitabine/epirubicin were analysed (n = 1 PDO). Cell viability and PDO regrowth potential were determined by microscopy and CellTiter-Glo luminescence assays 6 weeks post-treatment.Results

PDO viability was severely impaired after combination treatment with chemotherapy and ATR inhibitors. This effect was maintained for 6 weeks after drug exposure. In contrast, PDOs treated with only chemotherapy or ATR inhibitors showed similar proliferation rates as untreated controls in week 6.Conclusions

This study demonstrates synergy between ATR inhibitors and chemotherapy in NMIBC PDOs. Combining intravesical chemotherapy instillations with DNA damage response inhibitors should be further evaluated as a promising strategy to reduce recurrence rates for NMIBC.
abstractZh:
背景

非肌层浸润性膀胱癌（NMIBC）患者接受膀胱内化疗或BCG治疗后复发率高，表明需要新的治疗选择。DNA损伤反应抑制剂与化疗之间的协同作用已在不同的实体瘤中得到证实。在此，我们探讨将化疗药物与共济失调毛细血管扩张突变和Rad3相关（ATR）激酶抑制剂联合使用是否是降低NMIBC复发的合适策略。方法

将患者来源的NMIBC类器官（PDOs；n=6）暴露于丝裂霉素C（MMC）2小时，以模拟膀胱内灌注，随后暴露于ATR抑制剂（berzosertib、ceralasertib、tuvusertib）72小时。此外，还分析了吉西他滨/表柔比星的联合治疗（n=1 PDO）。治疗后6周，通过显微镜和CellTiter-Glo发光测定法确定细胞活力和PDO再生长潜力。结果

化疗与ATR抑制剂联合治疗后，PDO活力严重受损。这种效应在药物暴露后持续6周。相比之下，仅用化疗或ATR抑制剂处理的PDO在第6周显示出与未处理对照相似的增殖率。结论

本研究证明了ATR抑制剂与化疗在NMIBC PDOs中的协同作用。应将膀胱内化疗灌注与DNA损伤反应抑制剂联合使用作为降低NMIBC复发率的有前景策略进行进一步评估。

title: Three current approaches to preclinical oral squamous cell carcinoma research: a practical, stepwise framework integrating cell lines, organoids, and animal models.
titleZh: 口腔鳞状细胞癌临床前研究的三种当前方法：一个实用的、分步框架，整合细胞系、类器官和动物模型。
journal: International journal of oral and maxillofacial surgery
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Maruyama T, Matsuzaki G.
affiliations: Comprehensive Health Professions Education Center, The University of the Ryukyus Hospital, Okinawa, Japan. Electronic address: h075324@cs.u-ryukyu.ac.jp.

Department of Host Defense, Graduate School of Medicine, University of the Ryukyus, Okinawa, Japan; Molecular Microbiology Group, Tropical Biosphere Research Center, University of the Ryukyus, Okinawa, Japan; Advanced Medical Research Center, Faculty of Medicine, University of the Ryukyus, Okinawa, Japan.
abstract: Oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) continues to be associated with a poor prognosis despite recent advances in surgical and adjuvant treatment. Although a variety of experimental models are available, no widely accepted or practical framework has combined cell lines, patient-derived organoids, and in vivo transplantation models in translational OSCC research. This review summarizes the main preclinical models used in OSCC research and discusses how they can be used together in a stepwise manner for drug development. A narrative review of the literature was conducted focusing on OSCC research cell lines, organoids, and transplantation smodels, as well as studies that have applied artificial intelligence (AI) and multi-omics analyses. Cell lines are useful for reproducible mechanistic studies and initial drug screening. Organoids better preserve tumour heterogeneity and allow patient-specific testing. Orthotopic transplantation models reproduce local invasion, metastatic spread, and interactions with the tumour microenvironment. When data from these platforms are analysed together and, where appropriate, supported by AI-based imaging and molecular profiling, their translational relevance may be enhanced. Combining cell lines, organoids, and in vivo models in a planned, stepwise approach provides a practical framework for OSCC research. This approach may help bridge the gap between experimental studies and clinical practice, particularly in oral and maxillofacial surgery.
abstractZh: 尽管手术和辅助治疗取得了近期进展，但口腔鳞状细胞癌（OSCC）的预后仍然较差。尽管有多种实验模型可用，但在转化性OSCC研究中，尚无广泛接受或实用的框架将细胞系、患者来源的类器官和体内移植模型结合起来。本综述总结了OSCC研究中使用的临床前主要模型，并讨论了如何将它们以分步方式联合用于药物开发。对文献进行了叙述性综述，重点关注OSCC研究细胞系、类器官和移植模型，以及应用人工智能（AI）和多组学分析的研究。细胞系适用于可重复的机制研究和初步药物筛选。类器官能更好地保留肿瘤异质性，并允许患者特异性测试。原位移植模型可重现局部侵袭、转移扩散以及与肿瘤微环境的相互作用。当这些平台的数据被一起分析，并在适当情况下由基于AI的成像和分子谱分析支持时，其转化相关性可能会增强。以计划性、分步方式结合细胞系、类器官和体内模型，为OSCC研究提供了一个实用框架。这种方法可能有助于弥合实验研究与临床实践之间的差距，特别是在口腔颌面外科领域。

title: Podocyte injury damages podocytes in chimeric organoids.
titleZh: 嵌合体类器官中足细胞损伤导致足细胞受损。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Udagawa T, Araoka T, Osafune K, Matsusaka T.
affiliations: Department of Physiology, Tokai University School of Medicine, Isehara, Japan.
Department of Pediatrics and Developmental Biology, Graduate School of Medical and Dental Sciences, Institute of Science Tokyo, Japan.
Center for iPS Cell Research and Application (CiRA), Kyoto University, Kyoto, Japan.
abstract: We have previously shown that injury to a subset of podocytes can trigger indirect damage in neighboring podocytes, but whether this phenomenon depends on direct intercellular interaction is unknown. To address this, kidney organoids were generated from nephron progenitor cells of two mouse lines: one expressing a receptor for a podocyte-specific immunotoxin and another expressing a tagged ribosomal protein. In chimeric organoids containing a mosaic of these podocyte types, immunotoxin exposure selectively injured the targeted podocytes and also induced indirect injury in adjacent, non-targeted podocytes. This was evidenced by reduced podocin staining and decreased expression of podocyte-specific genes in the non-targeted podocytes. The indirect injury was absent when organoids of each type were cultured separately but in close proximity, indicating that direct cell-to-cell contact within the same glomerular structure is required. These findings show that podocyte injury can propagate locally within kidney organoids, independent of glomerular filtration or other glomerular cell types, and suggest that local podocyte interactions may contribute to the progression of chronic kidney disease.
abstractZh: 我们之前已证明，对一部分足细胞的损伤可引发邻近足细胞的间接损伤，但这一现象是否依赖于直接的细胞间相互作用尚不清楚。为解决此问题，我们利用两种小鼠系的肾单位祖细胞生成了肾脏类器官：一种表达针对足细胞特异性免疫毒素的受体，另一种表达带标签的核糖体蛋白。在包含这些足细胞类型镶嵌体的嵌合类器官中，免疫毒素暴露选择性地损伤了靶向足细胞，并同时诱导了邻近非靶向足细胞的间接损伤。这通过非靶向足细胞中podocin染色减少和足细胞特异性基因表达降低得到证实。当每种类型的类器官分别培养但紧密相邻时，间接损伤消失，表明同一肾小球结构内的直接细胞间接触是必需的。这些发现表明，足细胞损伤可在肾脏类器官内局部传播，且不依赖于肾小球滤过或其他肾小球细胞类型，并提示局部足细胞相互作用可能有助于慢性肾病的进展。

title: Developmental Extracellular Matrix as a Bioactive Niche for Spinal Cord Organoid Maturation and SCI Repair.
titleZh: 发育性细胞外基质作为脊髓类器官成熟和脊髓损伤修复的生物活性微环境。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Khalil AAK, Büyüker SM, Rahman SU.
affiliations: Department of Biotechnology, Yeungnam University, Gyeongsan, 38541, Republic of Korea. atif.ali@yu.ac.kr.
Department of Pharmaceutical Toxicology, School of Pharmacy, Istanbul Medipol University, Istanbul, Türkiye.
Department of Pharmacy, Shaheed Benazir Bhutto University, Sheringal, Dir, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.
abstract: Spinal cord injury (SCI) causes permanent sensorimotor deficits due to the inhibitory extracellular microenvironment that forms post-injury, hindering regeneration. The extracellular matrix (ECM) plays a critical role in neural development and repair, with the developmental spinal cord ECM being enriched in pro-regenerative molecules and containing relatively low levels of inhibitory components. In contrast, the ECM of the adult injured spinal cord is characterized by an abundance of growth-inhibitory molecules. Human pluripotent stem cell-derived spinal cord organoids have emerged as promising in vitro models for studying spinal cord development and disease; however, their application is limited by incomplete structural and functional maturation. The incorporation of developmental ECM components into organoid cultures has been shown to promote maturation, neuronal connectivity, and functional integration. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the regenerative properties of developmental spinal cord ECM and discusses its applications in organoid engineering and SCI repair, including decellularized ECM biomaterials, hydrogels, synthetic analogs, and combinatorial approaches. Collectively, developmental ECM-based strategies represent a promising platform for the development of precision regenerative therapies aimed at enhancing functional recovery after SCI.
abstractZh: 脊髓损伤（SCI）由于损伤后形成的抑制性细胞外微环境阻碍再生，导致永久性的感觉运动功能障碍。细胞外基质（ECM）在神经发育和修复中发挥关键作用，发育中的脊髓ECM富含促再生分子，且抑制性成分含量相对较低。相比之下，成年损伤脊髓的ECM以生长抑制分子丰富为特征。人 pluripotent 干细胞来源的脊髓类器官已成为研究脊髓发育和疾病的有前景的体外模型；然而，其应用受到结构和功能成熟不完全的限制。将发育性ECM成分整合到类器官培养中已被证明能促进成熟、神经元连接和功能整合。本综述全面概述了发育性脊髓ECM的再生特性，并讨论了其在类器官工程和SCI修复中的应用，包括脱细胞ECM生物材料、水凝胶、合成类似物和组合方法。总的来说，基于发育性ECM的策略代表了开发旨在增强SCI后功能恢复的精准再生疗法的一个有前景的平台。

title: Generation and characterization of a patient-specific human induced pluripotent stem cell line from a Skogholt syndrome patient (ASCFi003-A)
titleZh: 来自Skogholt综合征患者的人诱导多能干细胞系（ASCFi003-A）的生成与特征鉴定
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Przybala W, Gupta S, Fjerdingstad HB, Selnes P, Sharma K.
abstract: We report the generation and characterization of a human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) line derived from dermal fibroblasts of a patient with Skogholt’s disease, a rare maternally inherited neurodegenerative syndrome associated with choroid plexus dysfunction and impaired cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) homeostasis. Patient fibroblasts were reprogrammed using the non-integrating Repro-OSKGM kit. The resulting iPSC line exhibited typical pluripotent morphology, expressed canonical pluripotency markers, maintained a normal karyotype, retained the disease-associated genetic variant, was mycoplasma-free, and demonstrated trilineage differentiation potential. We also made choroid plexus (ChP) like organoids from the generated iPSCs. This patient-specific iPSC line provides a valuable resource for generating choroid plexus organoids and neurons to investigate disease mechanisms and develop therapeutic strategies.
abstractZh: 我们报告了来自一名Skogholt病（一种罕见的母系遗传性神经退行性综合征，与脉络丛功能障碍和脑脊液（CSF）稳态受损相关）患者皮肤成纤维细胞的人诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）系的生成与特征鉴定。使用非整合性Repro-OSKGM试剂盒对患者成纤维细胞进行重编程。所得iPSC系表现出典型的多能性形态，表达经典多能性标记物，保持正常核型，保留疾病相关遗传变异，无支原体污染，并展示三胚层分化潜能。我们还利用生成的iPSC制备了脉络丛（ChP）样类器官。该患者特异性iPSC系为生成脉络丛类器官和神经元以研究疾病机制和开发治疗策略提供了宝贵资源。

title: Organoid transplantation in the adult endometrium restores fertility and uncovers epithelial lineage plasticity
titleZh: 成年子宫内膜类器官移植恢复生育能力并揭示上皮谱系可塑性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Mopure D, Kim HI, Ang CJ, Davis DJ, Spencer TE, McKinley KL, Kelleher AM.
abstract: The adult endometrium regenerates repeatedly, yet the cells and mechanisms that rebuild its epithelium remain poorly defined. To control the cell types available for regeneration, a genetic model to extensively ablate the uterine epithelium was combined with transplantation of lineage-labeled organoids. Ablation without organoid transplantation triggered re-epithelialization, but resulted in infertility. Transplanted endometrial epithelial organoids engrafted into the ablated uterus, reconstructed both the luminal and glandular epithelia, and restored fertility. Depleting organoids of the glandular lineage before transplantation revealed that luminal epithelial-derived cells acquire glandular identity and function after engraftment. The same luminal-to-glandular epithelial differentiation trajectory emerged during endogenous repair following targeted glandular ablation. Together, these findings establish luminal-to-glandular epithelial conversion as an intrinsic regenerative property of the adult uterine epithelium and establish an endometrial organoid transplantation platform with therapeutic potential.
abstractZh: 成年子宫内膜会反复再生，但重建其上皮的细胞和机制仍不清楚。为了控制可用于再生的细胞类型，我们将一种用于广泛消融子宫上皮的遗传模型与谱系标记类器官的移植相结合。未进行类器官移植的消融触发了上皮再形成，但导致不孕。移植的子宫内膜上皮类器官植入消融的子宫后，重建了腔上皮和腺上皮，并恢复了生育能力。在移植前去除类器官中的腺体谱系，揭示了腔上皮来源的细胞在植入后获得腺体身份和功能。在靶向腺体消融后的内源性修复过程中，也出现了相同的腔上皮向腺上皮的分化轨迹。总之，这些发现确立了腔上皮向腺上皮的转化是成年子宫上皮的一种固有再生特性，并建立了一个具有治疗潜力的子宫内膜类器官移植平台。

title: Survivin Promotes the Formation of a Microtubule-Based Glycolytic Hub
titleZh: Survivin促进基于微管的糖酵解中心的形成
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Neumann J, Chang W, Ackermann SE, Zanotelli MR, Markovich T, Yang R, Lefkowitz JR, Enomoto S, Le HH, Lee M, Bryant KL, Cerione RA, Antonyak MA.
abstract:
KRAS is one of the most frequently mutated oncoproteins in cancer. Its ability to induce malignant transformation relies on metabolic reprogramming that causes cells to become dependent on aerobic glycolysis as a primary source of energy and for generating biological building blocks. Thus far, the signaling mechanism used by oncogenic KRAS to promote these changes in cancer cell metabolism has not been fully elucidated. However, through studies in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) cell lines and patient-derived organoids, we now demonstrate how oncogenic KRAS triggers an increase in glycolytic activity and identify Survivin as a newly discovered and critical KRAS-signaling partner essential for promoting these metabolic changes. We show that oncogenic KRAS potently upregulates the expression of Survivin in PDAC cells and patient-derived organoids undergoing increased glycolysis, whereas depleting Survivin expression inhibits their glycolytic activity and growth. Through a combination of cellular, biochemical, and imaging approaches, we further show that Survivin promotes the formation of unique microtubule-based structures that resemble invadosome rosettes, allowing for the recruitment of the glycolytic enzymes triose phosphate isomerase (TPI) and glyceraldehyde-3-phosphate dehydrogenase (GAPDH) to these super-structures which drives the increases in glycolysis. These findings demonstrate that by directing the assembly of a microtubule-based complex of metabolic enzymes, Survivin serves as a vital link in a KRAS signaling pathway responsible for promoting the metabolic changes necessary for the accelerated growth of PDAC cells, and thus potentially highlight new therapeutic strategies for treating KRAS-dependent cancers. Significance Statement

  Oncogenic forms of the signaling protein KRAS promote the rapid growth of pancreatic cancer cells by rewiring their cellular metabolism such that they become dependent on aerobic glycolysis. However, how this metabolic adaptation is achieved has remained a critical open question in the field. In this study, we now show that there is a tight signaling connection between oncogenic KRAS and increases in the expression of the cell survival protein/cancer marker Survivin in pancreatic cancer cell lines and patient-derived organoids, with the upregulation of Survivin being essential for promoting aerobic glycolysis. The mechanism underlying this effect involves the formation of a unique Survivin-microtubule-based metabolic hub that enables the recruitment of key enzymes responsible for increasing glycolytic activity and cell growth.
abstractZh:
KRAS是癌症中最常突变的致癌蛋白之一。其诱导恶性转化的能力依赖于代谢重编程，使细胞依赖有氧糖酵解作为主要能量来源和生成生物构建模块。迄今为止，致癌KRAS促进癌细胞代谢变化的信号机制尚未完全阐明。然而，通过胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）细胞系和患者来源类器官的研究，我们现在展示了致癌KRAS如何触发糖酵解活性的增加，并鉴定Survivin为新发现的、对促进这些代谢变化至关重要的KRAS信号伙伴。我们显示，在糖酵解增强的PDAC细胞和患者来源类器官中，致癌KRAS强烈上调Survivin的表达，而消耗Survivin表达则抑制其糖酵解活性和生长。通过细胞、生化和成像方法的结合，我们进一步显示，Survivin促进形成独特的基于微管的结构，类似于侵袭体玫瑰花结，允许将糖酵解酶磷酸丙糖异构酶（TPI）和甘油醛-3-磷酸脱氢酶（GAPDH）招募到这些超结构中，从而驱动糖酵解的增加。这些发现表明，通过指导基于微管的代谢酶复合物的组装，Survivin在KRAS信号通路中充当关键连接，负责促进PDAC细胞加速生长所需的代谢变化，因此可能突出治疗KRAS依赖性癌症的新策略。意义声明

致癌形式的信号蛋白KRAS通过重编程其细胞代谢，使其依赖有氧糖酵解，从而促进胰腺癌细胞的快速生长。然而，这种代谢适应如何实现仍然是该领域的关键开放问题。在本研究中，我们现在显示，在胰腺癌细胞系和患者来源类器官中，致癌KRAS与细胞存活蛋白/癌症标志物Survivin表达增加之间存在紧密的信号连接，Survivin的上调对于促进有氧糖酵解至关重要。这种效应背后的机制涉及形成独特的基于Survivin-微管的代谢中心，使得招募负责增加糖酵解活性和细胞生长的关键酶成为可能。

title: Development of iPSC-derived urothelial organoids towards investigating the effect of hormones on host-defense to urinary tract infections
titleZh: 开发iPSC来源的尿路上皮类器官，用于研究激素对尿路感染宿主防御的影响
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Bindas AJ, Fang Z, Boekhorst J, Fernandes AM, Wells JM.
abstract: Recurrent urinary tract infection represents a substantial unmet public health in women. Local administration of estradiol has been shown to reduce recurrence, however  in vitro models of the female urinary tract remain limited and the mechanisms underlying the effects of estradiol are incompletely understood. Here, we describe a novel iPSC organoid differentiation protocol and its application to establish a multilayered Transwell barrier culture model. Estradiol treatment resulted in reduced expression of innate antimicrobial peptides and cytokines, together with increased expression of demannosylation pathways. To our knowledge, this is the first iPSC organoid-derived model of the urinary tract, which provides a platform for investigating interactions between the urothelium, urobiome and hormonal environment.
abstractZh: 复发性尿路感染是女性中一个重大的未满足的公共卫生问题。局部给予雌二醇已被证明可以减少复发，然而女性泌尿道的体外模型仍然有限，且雌二醇作用的机制尚未完全了解。在此，我们描述了一种新型的iPSC类器官分化方案及其在建立多层Transwell屏障培养模型中的应用。雌二醇处理导致先天抗菌肽和细胞因子的表达降低，同时脱甘露糖化途径的表达增加。据我们所知，这是第一个iPSC类器官来源的泌尿道模型，为研究尿路上皮、尿微生物组和激素环境之间的相互作用提供了一个平台。

title: 3D µEFPocket for Multimodal Communications with Brain Organoids
titleZh: 3D µEFPocket：用于脑类器官多模式通信的微流控平台
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Wang Y, Cuevas M, Zhang Z, Chung G, Zhang J, Yin Y, Luo Q, Lipman W, Henderson J, Lu L, Zeng W, Zhang A, Jia C, Luan H, Stein J, Bai W.
abstract: Abstract  Human brain organoids are powerful three-dimensional models for studying neural development, disease mechanisms, and pharmacological responses, but precise spatiotemporal chemical modulation and activity recording within intact organoids and in a simultaneous fashion is difficult due to their three-dimensional (3D) complexities. Here, we introduce the microElectroFluidicPocket (µEFPocket), a conformal, ultrathin microfluidic 3D biointerface that integrates microscale spatiotemporal control of chemical and electrical stimulation in human cortical organoids with simultaneous optical and electrical readout. Fabricated entirely from parylene C using standard wafer-scale deposition, photolithography, and etching, µEFPockets form integrated, mechanically compliant architectures that wrap around spherical organoids without attachment factors, enabling repeated use of the same organoid. Engineered and independently addressable microchannels enable localized, time-locked delivery of neurotransmitters with hundreds-micron spatial resolution and second-level temporal control while preserving global culture conditions. Using glutamate delivery or electrical stimulation of GCaMP-expressing human cortical organoids, we demonstrate spatially localized calcium responses at regional and single-neuron resolution, revealing network propagation and stimulus-dependent adaptation. This scalable platform provides a foundation for spatially patterned pharmacology, multimodal biointerfaces, and closed-loop functional assays in organoids.
abstractZh: 摘要 人类脑类器官是研究神经发育、疾病机制和药理学反应的强大三维模型，但由于其三维（3D）复杂性，在完整类器官内同时进行精确的时空化学调节和活动记录非常困难。在此，我们介绍了微电极流体口袋（µEFPocket），这是一种共形、超薄微流控3D生物界面，将人类皮层类器官中化学和电刺激的微尺度时空控制与同步光学和电学读出相结合。µEFPocket完全由聚对二甲苯C通过标准晶圆级沉积、光刻和蚀刻制造，形成集成、机械柔顺的结构，无需附着因子即可包裹球形类器官，从而能够重复使用同一类器官。工程化且可独立寻址的微通道能够实现神经递质的局部、时间锁定递送，具有数百微米的空间分辨率和秒级的时间控制，同时保持整体培养条件。通过使用谷氨酸递送或电刺激表达GCaMP的人类皮层类器官，我们展示了在区域和单神经元分辨率下的空间局部钙响应，揭示了网络传播和刺激依赖性适应。这种可扩展平台为类器官中的空间模式药理学、多模式生物界面和闭环功能分析提供了基础。

title: Berberine Ameliorates Primary Biliary Cholangitis by Modulating the Gut–Liver Axis and Attenuating Cholangiocyte Oxidative Stress in Murine Models and Human Organoids
titleZh: 小檗碱通过调节肠-肝轴和减轻胆管细胞氧化应激改善原发性胆汁性胆管炎：小鼠模型和人器官oid研究
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Wu Y, Zhao Y, Wang K, Song T, Yin P, Wang F, Ni J, Pan Y, Xie Q, Teufel A, Li L, Chen Y.
abstract: Abstract  Background  Primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) is a chronic autoimmune cholestatic liver disease characterized by progressive destruction of intrahepatic bile ducts, resulting in liver inflammation and fibrosis. Despite ursodeoxycholic acid as the standard therapy, a substantial proportion of patients show incomplete responses. Berberine hydrochloride (BBR), a bioactive alkaloid derived from traditional Chinese medicine, exhibits anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and microbiota-modulating properties. While BBR has shown therapeutic potential in primary sclerosing cholangitis, its efficacy and underlying mechanisms in PBC remain largely unexplored. Purpose  This study was designed to explore the therapeutic potential of BBR and elucidate its underlying mechanisms in the treatment of PBC. Methods  We established a murine PBC model by intraperitoneal injection of 2-octynoic acid–BSA. BBR was then administered to the mice via oral gavage. Liver injury and fibrosis were evaluated using hematoxylin and eosin staining, Sirius red staining, immunohistochemistry, reverse transcription-quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR), liver function tests, and transcriptomic analysis. Gut microbiota composition was analyzed by 16S rRNA gene sequencing. To address how BBR protects biliary epithelial cells from oxidative stress injury, we employed an in vitro H₂O₂‑induced injury model in human bile‑derived cholangiocyte organoids. Mechanistic insights were then sought through transcriptomic and Olink proteomic analyses, with key findings validated by RT‑qPCR, immunofluorescence, transmission electron microscopy, and ELISA. Results  BBR markedly ameliorated liver inflammation and fibrosis in PBC mice and significantly modulated gut microbiota composition. Mechanistically, these effects were associated with the upregulation of bile secretion–related pathways,peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor and glutathione metabolic pathways. In cholangiocyte organoids, BBR attenuated oxidative stress–induced injury by suppressing pro-inflammatory cytokine signaling, restoring mitochondrial function, and enhancing metabolic adaptation. Conclusion  These findings indicate that BBR exerts protective effects against PBC by targeting the gut–liver axis and cholangiocyte oxidative stress responses, supporting its potential as a promising therapeutic candidate for PBC.
abstractZh:
摘要
背景
原发性胆汁性胆管炎（PBC）是一种慢性自身免疫性胆汁淤积性肝病，其特征是肝内胆管进行性破坏，导致肝脏炎症和纤维化。尽管熊去氧胆酸是标准治疗，但相当比例的患者反应不完全。盐酸小檗碱（BBR）是一种源自中药的生物活性生物碱，具有抗炎、抗氧化和调节微生物群的作用。虽然BBR在原发性硬化性胆管炎中显示出治疗潜力，但其在PBC中的疗效和潜在机制在很大程度上尚未探索。目的
本研究旨在探讨BBR的治疗潜力并阐明其在PBC治疗中的潜在机制。方法
我们通过腹腔注射2-辛炔酸-BSA建立了小鼠PBC模型。然后通过口服灌胃给予小鼠BBR。使用苏木精和伊红染色、天狼星红染色、免疫组织化学、逆转录定量PCR（RT-qPCR）、肝功能测试和转录组分析评估肝损伤和纤维化。通过16S rRNA基因测序分析肠道微生物群组成。为了解决BBR如何保护胆管上皮细胞免受氧化应激损伤，我们在人胆管源性胆管细胞类器官中采用了体外H₂O₂诱导损伤模型。随后通过转录组和Olink蛋白质组学分析寻求机制见解，并通过RT-qPCR、免疫荧光、透射电子显微镜和ELISA验证关键发现。结果
BBR显著改善了PBC小鼠的肝脏炎症和纤维化，并显著调节了肠道微生物群组成。机制上，这些效应与胆汁分泌相关通路、过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体和谷胱甘肽代谢通路的上调有关。在胆管细胞类器官中，BBR通过抑制促炎细胞因子信号传导、恢复线粒体功能和增强代谢适应来减轻氧化应激诱导的损伤。结论
这些发现表明，BBR通过靶向肠-肝轴和胆管细胞氧化应激反应对PBC发挥保护作用，支持其作为PBC有前景的治疗候选药物的潜力。

title: Evaluation of Estrogen Responsiveness and Sensitivity to Endocrine Therapy in ER-Positive Breast Cancer Organoids Using an Optimized Culture Medium
titleZh: 在优化培养基条件下评估ER阳性乳腺癌类器官的雌激素反应性和内分泌治疗敏感性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Uematsu H, Coppo R, Saito C, Kondo J, Takada M, Inoue M.
abstract: Abstract    Background  Approximately 20–30% of estrogen receptor (ER)-positive breast cancers exhibit early resistance to endocrine therapy. Conventional patient-derived organoid (PDO) culture media utilize high concentrations of growth factors that mask estrogen-dependent signals, thereby hindering functional sensitivity assays. This study aimed to develop an optimized culture medium to evaluate estrogen responsiveness and assess the tamoxifen sensitivity of ER-positive breast cancer organoids.  Methods  Growth factor concentrations in the conventional breast cancer organoid medium (BCOM) were systematically reduced to establish a modified medium (mBCOM) and a subsequent hormone therapy sensitivity assay medium (BH-SAM). Estrogen-dependent growth and 4-hydroxytamoxifen (4-OHT) sensitivity were evaluated in MCF7 spheroids and PDO lines. Additionally, ER-targeted gene expression (  TFF1  ,  CCND1  , and  MYC  ) was specificallyanalyzed in the PDO lines.  Results  Reducing heregulin β1 (HRG1) to 0.04 nM and removing EGF, FGF7, and FGF10 successfully restored estrogen-dependent proliferation in both MCF7 spheroids and PDO lines, and robustly induced ER-targeted gene expression in the organoids without causing cell death. In the optimized BH-SAM platform, 4-OHT significantly inhibited the growth of six of nine ER-positive organoid lines. Notably, the in vitro resistant organoid lines included an organoid derived from a patient who clinically relapsed during postoperative endocrine therapy. Resistant lines demonstrated distinctheterogeneous sensitivities to alternative cytotoxic chemotherapies and molecularly targeted drugs.  Conclusion  The newly established BH-SAM platform successfully restored estrogen responsiveness, providing a reliable and dynamic functional assay to screen for endocrine therapy resistance and explore personalized alternative treatments for ER-positive breast cancer.
abstractZh: 摘要 背景 约20-30%的雌激素受体（ER）阳性乳腺癌对内分泌治疗表现出早期耐药。常规患者来源类器官（PDO）培养基使用高浓度生长因子，掩盖了雌激素依赖性信号，从而阻碍了功能性敏感性检测。本研究旨在开发一种优化培养基，以评估ER阳性乳腺癌类器官的雌激素反应性并评估他莫昔芬敏感性。方法 系统降低常规乳腺癌类器官培养基（BCOM）中的生长因子浓度，建立改良培养基（mBCOM）和后续激素治疗敏感性检测培养基（BH-SAM）。在MCF7球体和PDO系中评估雌激素依赖性生长和4-羟基他莫昔芬（4-OHT）敏感性。此外，在PDO系中特异性分析了ER靶基因表达（TFF1、CCND1和MYC）。结果 将heregulin β1（HRG1）降至0.04 nM并去除EGF、FGF7和FGF10，成功恢复了MCF7球体和PDO系中雌激素依赖性增殖，并在类器官中强烈诱导ER靶基因表达，且未导致细胞死亡。在优化的BH-SAM平台中，4-OHT显著抑制了九个ER阳性类器官系中六个的生长。值得注意的是，体外耐药类器官系包括来自一名在术后内分泌治疗期间临床复发的患者的类器官。耐药系对替代细胞毒性化疗药物和分子靶向药物表现出不同的异质性敏感性。结论 新建立的BH-SAM平台成功恢复了雌激素反应性，为筛选内分泌治疗耐药和探索ER阳性乳腺癌的个性化替代治疗提供了可靠且动态的功能检测方法。

title: Intestinal infection and fecal shedding of infectious SFTS virus reveal a potential fecal–oral transmission route
titleZh: 肠道感染和感染性SFTS病毒的粪便排出揭示潜在的粪-口传播途径
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Xu G, Liu X, Li X, Xu J, Wang K, Song X, Wei W, Tang H, Xu Z, Zhou J, Du Y, Ding X, Gao Y, Cao W.
abstract: Abstract  Severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) is an emerging tick‑borne viral disease with a case fatality rate of 7.8% and no approved therapy. Gastrointestinal symptoms are frequently reported in patients, yet whether the intestinal tract serves as a site of viral infection or contributes to transmission has remained unclear. To address this, we combined clinical cohort analysis with mouse models and human intestinal organoids. In a multicenter cohort of 752 patients, 62.9% presented with gastrointestinal symptoms that correlated with serum viral load. Fecal calprotectin was elevated in the majority of tested samples, pointing to frequent intestinal inflammation during SFTS. In mice, the virus infected enterocytes and intestinal stem cells, causing epithelial injury, barrier disruption and diarrhea. These cellular and histopathological findings were recapitulated in human intestinal organoids, which also showed inflammatory reprogramming of the epithelium. Notably, replication‑competent virus could be isolated from the feces of infected mice and from patients with acute SFTS. Together, these observations indicate that SFTSV targets the intestinal epithelium and that infectious virus shed in feces may enable a fecal–oral transmission route. This adds to the growing evidence for non‑vector‑borne transmission and carries implications for infection control and public health surveillance.
abstractZh: 摘要 严重发热伴血小板减少综合征（SFTS）是一种新出现的蜱传病毒性疾病，病死率为7.8%，目前尚无获批的治疗方法。患者中经常报告胃肠道症状，但肠道是否作为病毒感染部位或是否参与传播仍不清楚。为解决这一问题，我们结合了临床队列分析、小鼠模型和人肠道类器官。在一项包含752名患者的多中心队列中，62.9%的患者出现胃肠道症状，且这些症状与血清病毒载量相关。大多数检测样本中粪便钙卫蛋白升高，表明SFTS期间肠道炎症频繁发生。在小鼠中，病毒感染肠上皮细胞和肠道干细胞，导致上皮损伤、屏障破坏和腹泻。这些细胞和组织病理学发现在人肠道类器官中得到了重现，类器官也显示出上皮的炎症重编程。值得注意的是，从感染小鼠的粪便和急性SFTS患者的粪便中均可分离出具有复制能力的病毒。总之，这些观察结果表明SFTSV靶向肠道上皮，粪便中排出的感染性病毒可能促成粪-口传播途径。这为非媒介传播的证据增添了新内容，并对感染控制和公共卫生监测具有重要意义。

title: Bioengineered In vitro bone marrow models of acute myeloid leukemia for novel drug discovery.
titleZh: 用于新型药物发现的急性髓系白血病生物工程体外骨髓模型。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ribes-Balanza C, Clarke L, Dalby MJ, Donnelly H.
affiliations: Centre for the Cellular Microenvironment, University of Glasgow, Glasgow, UK.
Paul O'Gormon Leukaemia Research Centre, University of Glasgow, Glasgow, UK.
abstract:
Introduction

Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is an aggressive hematological malignancy associated with poor prognosis, high rates of chemoresistance and disease relapse. High attrition rates in the drug development pipeline highlight the need for improved modeling strategies that provide more reliable translation from preclinical to clinical outcomes. Bioengineered human cell-based bone marrow models are emerging as promising platforms capable of recapitulating key aspects of disease biology and therapeutic response more faithfully than conventional models.Areas covered

This review discusses advances in bioengineered bone marrow models of AML, including systems capable of reproducing chemoresistance, off-target toxicities, leukemic niche remodeling, and microenvironment-mediated disease mechanisms that are often overlooked by conventional two-dimensional cultures and current animal models. The physical, cellular, and biochemical properties to be considered in next-generation models are also examined. Literature was identified through searches of PubMed, Science Direct, and Google Scholar.Expert opinion

Bioengineered AML bone marrow models have the potential to improve drug development by identifying ineffective compounds earlier and enabling investigation of patient-specific disease heterogeneity. Future progress will depend not only on increasing biological complexity through technologies such as organoids and organ-on-chip systems, but also on rigorous validation against patient data, standardization, scalability, and regulatory acceptance.
abstractZh:
引言

急性髓系白血病（AML）是一种侵袭性血液恶性肿瘤，预后差，化疗耐药和疾病复发率高。药物开发管线中的高失败率凸显了改进建模策略的需求，这些策略能提供从临床前到临床结果更可靠的转化。基于生物工程的人源细胞骨髓模型正成为有前景的平台，能够比传统模型更真实地重现疾病生物学的关键方面和治疗反应。

涵盖领域

本综述讨论了AML生物工程骨髓模型的进展，包括能够重现化疗耐药、脱靶毒性、白血病微环境重塑以及微环境介导的疾病机制的体系，这些机制常被传统二维培养和当前动物模型忽视。还探讨了下一代模型中需考虑的物理、细胞和生化特性。文献通过检索PubMed、Science Direct和Google Scholar确定。

专家意见

生物工程AML骨髓模型有潜力通过更早识别无效化合物和实现患者特异性疾病异质性研究来改善药物开发。未来进展不仅取决于通过类器官和器官芯片等技术增加生物学复杂性，还取决于对患者数据的严格验证、标准化、可扩展性和监管接受度。

title: Metabolite co-variation networks reveal keystone functions and an emergent pathogen state in the human urobiome
titleZh: 代谢物共变网络揭示人类泌尿微生物组中的关键功能和涌现的病原体状态
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Vedova LD, Bindas AJ, Dias MT, Brons JK, Fang Z, Fernandes AM, Molina PG, Giron-Villalobos D, Hackl T, Jansen J, Wells JM, de Vos MG, Berkers CR, van der Hooft JJ.
abstract: Microbial communities are dynamic, adaptive ecosystems whose collective behavior emerges from metabolic interactions such as cross-feeding, competition, and cooperation, rather than taxonomic diversity or individual metabolic potential alone. This distinction is clinically significant in the postmenopausal urinary tract, where recurrent urinary tract infections (rUTIs) are associated with complex, persistent infection dynamics including multiple contributing bacterial species. The ability of resident microbial communities to prevent pathogen establishment, known as colonization resistance, is increasingly attributed to the metabolic interactions within the urobiome itself rather than any single resident species. However, current approaches, such as taxonomic profiling and classical differential abundance analysis, can only partially describe the presence or maintenance of such interactions. Consequently, the community-level metabolic architecture determining pathogen resistance remains incompletely understood. To address this gap, we developed PhenoRewire, a network-based framework that quantifies how metabolite co-variation is rewired between biological states using untargeted metabolomics data. We applied this framework to an induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) urothelial organoid-derived barrier co-cultured with synthetic urobiome communities as a model of urobiome-pathogen dynamics relevant to rUTIs in two approaches. In an infection model, clinically isolated uropathogens  Escherichia coli and  Enterococcus faecalis, were co-cultured with a three-member urobiome community consisting of  Lactobacillus gasseri ,  Lactobacillus crispatus , and  Gardnerella vaginalis . Here we show how  E. coli drove the metabolic reorganization, while  E. faecalis amplified it disproportionately. PhenoRewire disentangled the 6-fold metabolic network amplification mediated by  E. faecalis as a metabolic facilitator, revealing an emergent urobiome-pathogen co-variation architecture (1,781 vs 227 edges) not recapitulated by either community alone. Moreover, in a six-member urobiome single-strain dropout experiment, we revealed that removal of the sole Actinomycete  Winkia anitrata caused significant network collapse (Louvain modularity falls from 0.707 to 0.038), identifying it as the single non-redundant keystone of the community.  More broadly, these results demonstrate how untargeted metabolomics co-variation network analysis can be applied to defined synthetic urobiomes in combination with a urothelial host model to elucidate community dynamics. This framework provides a template that can be extended beyond the urobiome to investigate any complex microbial community where ecological behavior remains an open question.
abstractZh: 微生物群落是动态的、适应性的生态系统，其集体行为源于代谢相互作用，如交叉喂养、竞争和合作，而非仅由分类多样性或个体代谢潜力决定。这一区别在绝经后泌尿道具有临床意义，因为复发性尿路感染（rUTIs）与复杂的、持续性的感染动态相关，涉及多种致病菌。常驻微生物群落防止病原体定植的能力，即定植抵抗，越来越多地被归因于泌尿微生物组内部的代谢相互作用，而非任何单一常驻物种。然而，当前的方法，如分类学分析和经典的差异丰度分析，只能部分描述此类相互作用的存在或维持。因此，决定病原体抵抗力的群落级代谢结构仍未完全明了。为解决这一空白，我们开发了PhenoRewire，一个基于网络的框架，利用非靶向代谢组学数据量化代谢物共变在生物状态之间的重连。我们将该框架应用于诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）尿路上皮类器官衍生的屏障，与合成泌尿微生物组群落共培养，作为与rUTIs相关的泌尿微生物组-病原体动态模型，采用两种方法。在感染模型中，临床分离的尿路病原体大肠杆菌和粪肠球菌与由格氏乳杆菌、卷曲乳杆菌和阴道加德纳菌组成的三成员泌尿微生物组群落共培养。我们在此展示了大肠杆菌如何驱动代谢重组，而粪肠球菌则不成比例地放大了这种重组。PhenoRewire解析了由粪肠球菌作为代谢促进因子介导的6倍代谢网络放大，揭示了一种涌现的泌尿微生物组-病原体共变架构（1781条边对比227条边），该架构无法由任一单独群落重现。此外，在六成员泌尿微生物组的单菌株剔除实验中，我们揭示了唯一放线菌Winkia anitrata的去除导致显著的网络崩溃（Louvain模块度从0.707降至0.038），将其确定为群落中唯一的非冗余关键种。更广泛地，这些结果证明了如何将非靶向代谢组学共变网络分析应用于定义的合成泌尿微生物组，并结合尿路上皮宿主模型来阐明群落动态。该框架提供了一个模板，可扩展到泌尿微生物组之外，用于研究任何生态行为仍属开放问题的复杂微生物群落。

abstract: Selecting effective chemotherapy after immunotherapy remains a major clinical challenge in advanced gastric cancer because patient responses are highly heterogeneous. A major obstacle is the lack of personalized preclinical models that faithfully recapitulate the immune-activated tumor microenvironment (TME) following immunotherapy and enable evaluation of subsequent chemotherapy responses while preserving immune-tumor interactions. Here, we developed an immune-activated co-culture model comprising patient-derived gastric cancer organoids and autologous peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs). Immune activation was achieved using anti-PD-1-loaded gold nanocages (aPD-1@Au NCs), which integrate near-infrared-triggered photothermal tumor ablation with sustained anti-PD-1-mediated immune modulation. The resulting model recapitulates key features of the post-immunotherapy TME, including enhanced immune-cell infiltration, increased tumor-cell apoptosis, and CD8+ T-cell activation. We then applied this model to evaluate five clinically relevant chemotherapeutic agents, including oxaliplatin, irinotecan, fluorouracil, doxorubicin, and docetaxel, for personalized chemotherapy screening after immunotherapy. Compared with monoculture organoids or non-activated co-cultures, the immune-activated model revealed drug-specific differences in tumor-killing efficacy, immune-mediated chemosensitization, and PBMC toxicity. Among the tested agents, oxaliplatin showed the strongest immune-mediated chemosensitization, whereas docetaxel achieved favorable tumor cell killing with relatively low immunotoxicity. These findings demonstrate that chemotherapy responses after immune activation are highly drug-specific, underscoring the importance of personalized chemotherapy selection following immunotherapy. As a proof-of-concept study, this work establishes an immune-activated patient-derived gastric cancer organoid-PBMC co-culture model that partially recapitulates the post-immunotherapy TME. This model provides a promising framework for developing personalized chemotherapy screening strategies after immunotherapy. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: Selecting effective chemotherapy after immunotherapy remains a major challenge in advanced gastric cancer because of substantial interpatient heterogeneity. Progress in personalized treatment is limited by the lack of preclinical models that faithfully recapitulate the post-immunotherapy tumor microenvironment (TME). Here, we developed an immune-activated co-culture model integrating patient-derived gastric cancer organoids with autologous peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs). Immune activation was achieved using anti-PD-1-loaded gold nanocages (aPD-1@Au NCs), which combine near-infrared-triggered photothermal tumor ablation with sustained aPD-1-mediated immune modulation. This platform preserves patient-specific tumor characteristics while capturing key immune-tumor interactions following immunotherapy. Using this model, we evaluated five clinically relevant chemotherapeutic agents and identified distinct drug-specific differences in tumor-killing efficacy, immune-mediated chemosensitization, and immunotoxicity. As a proof-of-concept study, this work establishes a promising framework for personalized chemotherapy screening after immunotherapy and supports the development of precision treatment strategies for gastric cancer.
abstractZh: 在晚期胃癌中，免疫治疗后选择有效的化疗仍是一个主要的临床挑战，因为患者的反应高度异质。主要障碍是缺乏能够忠实再现免疫治疗后免疫激活的肿瘤微环境（TME）并能在保留免疫-肿瘤相互作用的同时评估后续化疗反应的个性化临床前模型。在此，我们开发了一种免疫激活的共培养模型，包含患者来源的胃癌类器官和自体外周血单个核细胞（PBMCs）。通过使用负载抗PD-1的金纳米笼（aPD-1@Au NCs）实现免疫激活，该纳米笼整合了近红外触发的光热肿瘤消融和持续的抗PD-1介导的免疫调节。所得模型再现了免疫治疗后TME的关键特征，包括增强的免疫细胞浸润、增加的肿瘤细胞凋亡和CD8+ T细胞活化。然后，我们应用该模型评估了五种临床相关的化疗药物，包括奥沙利铂、伊立替康、氟尿嘧啶、多柔比星和多西他赛，用于免疫治疗后的个性化化疗筛选。与单培养类器官或非激活共培养相比，免疫激活模型揭示了药物特异性的肿瘤杀伤效力、免疫介导的化疗增敏和PBMC毒性差异。在测试的药物中，奥沙利铂显示出最强的免疫介导化疗增敏，而多西他赛在相对较低的免疫毒性下实现了良好的肿瘤细胞杀伤。这些发现表明，免疫激活后的化疗反应具有高度药物特异性，强调了免疫治疗后个性化化疗选择的重要性。作为概念验证研究，这项工作建立了一个免疫激活的患者来源胃癌类器官-PBMC共培养模型，部分再现了免疫治疗后的TME。该模型为开发免疫治疗后的个性化化疗筛选策略提供了一个有前景的框架。意义声明：在晚期胃癌中，由于患者间显著的异质性，免疫治疗后选择有效的化疗仍是一个主要挑战。个性化治疗的进展受到缺乏忠实再现免疫治疗后肿瘤微环境（TME）的临床前模型的限制。在此，我们开发了一种免疫激活的共培养模型，整合了患者来源的胃癌类器官和自体外周血单个核细胞（PBMCs）。通过使用负载抗PD-1的金纳米笼（aPD-1@Au NCs）实现免疫激活，该纳米笼结合了近红外触发的光热肿瘤消融和持续的aPD-1介导的免疫调节。该平台保留了患者特异性肿瘤特征，同时捕获了免疫治疗后的关键免疫-肿瘤相互作用。使用该模型，我们评估了五种临床相关的化疗药物，并确定了肿瘤杀伤效力、免疫介导的化疗增敏和免疫毒性方面的明显药物特异性差异。作为概念验证研究，这项工作为免疫治疗后的个性化化疗筛选建立了一个有前景的框架，并支持胃癌精准治疗策略的开发。

abstract: Primary renal neuroendocrine tumors (PRNETs) are exceptionally rare neoplasms that account for less than 1% of genitourinary neuroendocrine neoplasms and pose considerable diagnostic difficulty because of their non-specific clinicoradiological presentations and diverse histomorphology, which frequently mimics conventional renal epithelial tumors. We describe two adult patients with well-differentiated PRNET managed by partial nephrectomy including a 41-year-old male with a complex bosniak category IV cystic renal lesion, and another 43-year-old female with a tumor arising from the isthmus of a horse-shoe kidney. Both tumors showed organoid, trabecular, nested, tubulocystic, and focal cribriform architecture with low mitotic activity. Case 1 additionally showed focal capsular and perineural invasion despite of low-grade morphology. Tumor cells were diffusely positive for synaptophysin, chromogranin, and CD99, and negative for PAX8, CK7, CK20, WT1, TTF1, and CDX2, with a Ki-67 index below 2% in both. Electron microscopy confirmed dense-core neurosecretory granules, and both patients remain disease-free on radioimaging based follow-up. These cases illustrate that PRNET should be considered whenever a renal mass, including a complex cystic lesion or arising in a congenital anomalous kidney, not confirming thetypical epithelial morphology, and a combined histomorphological, immunohistochemical, and ultrastructural approach with prolonged surveillance is essential for accurate diagnosis and management.
abstractZh: 原发性肾脏神经内分泌肿瘤（PRNETs）是极其罕见的肿瘤，占泌尿生殖系统神经内分泌肿瘤的比例不足1%，由于其非特异性的临床和影像学表现以及多样的组织形态学特征，常与常规肾脏上皮性肿瘤相似，因此诊断相当困难。我们描述了两例接受部分肾切除术的成人高分化PRNET患者，包括一名41岁男性，患有复杂的Bosniak IV类囊性肾病变，以及另一名43岁女性，其肿瘤起源于马蹄肾峡部。两例肿瘤均表现出器官样、小梁状、巢状、管囊状和局灶性筛状结构，有丝分裂活性低。病例1尽管为低级别形态，但还表现出局灶性包膜和神经周围侵犯。两例肿瘤细胞均弥漫性表达突触素、嗜铬粒蛋白和CD99，而PAX8、CK7、CK20、WT1、TTF1和CDX2均为阴性，两例Ki-67指数均低于2%。电子显微镜证实存在致密核心神经分泌颗粒，两例患者在基于影像学的随访中均无病生存。这些病例表明，当肾脏肿块（包括复杂囊性病变或发生于先天性异常肾脏的肿块）不符合典型上皮形态时，应考虑PRNET，结合组织形态学、免疫组织化学和超微结构检查并进行长期监测，对于准确诊断和管理至关重要。

abstract:
Background

Persistent airway epithelial abnormalities contribute to chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), but it remains unclear whether smoking- and COPD-associated epithelial remodeling is retained in airway basal cells and transmitted during differentiation. We determined whether current smoking and COPD are associated with methylation-linked regulatory programs in airway basal cells that shape epithelial differentiation in patient-derived bronchial organoids.Methods

We integrated DNA methylation profiling and bulk transcriptomics in patient-derived airway basal cells and matched three-dimensional bronchial organoids. Methylation-defined gene sets were mapped to organoid epithelial cell states using single-cell RNA-seq and contextualized with publicly available airway epithelial datasets.Results

In this exploratory cohort, current smoking was associated with a predominant shift toward promoter hypomethylation in airway basal cells and matched organoids. Hypomethylated promoters were enriched for genes preferentially expressed in secretory epithelial cells, including BPIFB1, BPIFA2, MSMB and GALNT6. These genes showed little smoking-associated expression difference in basal-cell culture but were upregulated after organoid differentiation, indicating a differentiation-dependent epithelial memory of smoking. In COPD-derived basal cells, promoter methylation changes involved reduced xenobiotic metabolism and enhanced immune- and infection-related programs. Consistently, COPD-derived organoids showed reduced expression of detoxification-associated pathways and increased lysosomal, endocytic and host-defense programs.Conclusions

Current smoking and COPD are associated with persistent methylation-linked regulatory alterations in airway basal cells that become functionally apparent during epithelial differentiation. These findings support a model in which airway basal-cell memory contributes to secretory, inflammatory and host-defense remodeling in chronic airway disease.
abstractZh:
背景

持续的气道上皮异常导致慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD），但尚不清楚吸烟和COPD相关的上皮重塑是否保留在气道基底细胞中并在分化过程中传递。我们确定了当前吸烟和COPD是否与患者来源的支气管类器官中气道基底细胞的甲基化相关调控程序相关，这些程序塑造上皮分化。方法

我们整合了患者来源的气道基底细胞的DNA甲基化谱和批量转录组学，并匹配了三维支气管类器官。使用单细胞RNA-seq将甲基化定义的基因集映射到类器官上皮细胞状态，并与公开的气道上皮数据集进行背景化。结果

在这个探索性队列中，当前吸烟与气道基底细胞和匹配类器官中启动子低甲基化的主要转变相关。低甲基化启动子富集于在分泌上皮细胞中优先表达的基因，包括BPIFB1、BPIFA2、MSMB和GALNT6。这些基因在基底细胞培养中显示出与吸烟相关的表达差异很小，但在类器官分化后上调，表明吸烟的分化依赖性上皮记忆。在COPD来源的基底细胞中，启动子甲基化变化涉及减少的异生物质代谢和增强的免疫及感染相关程序。一致地，COPD来源的类器官显示出解毒相关通路表达减少，以及溶酶体、内吞和宿主防御程序增加。结论

当前吸烟和COPD与气道基底细胞中持续的甲基化相关调控改变相关，这些改变在上皮分化过程中功能上变得明显。这些发现支持一个模型，其中气道基底细胞记忆有助于慢性气道疾病中的分泌、炎症和宿主防御重塑。

title: Engineered Nanozymes for Colorectal Cancer Therapy: Catalytic Reprogramming of the Tumor Microenvironment.

abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains difficult to treat because redox adaptation, metabolic plasticity, mucin-associated delivery barriers, immune exclusion, and microbiota-dependent signaling jointly limit conventional therapy. Engineered nanozymes provide a reaction-centered strategy for exploiting these CRC-specific vulnerabilities. This review critically compares metal, metal-oxide, carbon-based, porous-framework, and single-atom nanozymes with respect to catalytic mechanism, enzyme-mimicking activity, substrate dependence, controllability, biosafety, and translational suitability. We examine how acidity, hydrogen peroxide, hypoxia, glutathione enrichment, metabolic dysregulation, mucin barriers, and the gut microbiota influence catalytic performance. We further evaluate evidence for chemotherapy sensitization, chemodynamic, photothermal, photodynamic, sonodynamic, immunotherapeutic, and multimodal treatment, emphasizing both mechanistic synergy and limitations of the available preclinical models. Major translational barriers include non-standardized catalytic assays, heterogeneous intratumoral substrates, off-target reactive oxygen species toxicity, uncertain degradation and long-term fate, microbiome disruption, manufacturing reproducibility, and limited validation in orthotopic, immunocompetent, organoid, and patient-derived systems. We therefore position CRC nanozyme therapy as a disease-oriented catalytic medicine platform whose clinical value will depend on biomarker-guided selection, programmable activation, and degradable, locally controllable designs.
abstractZh: 结直肠癌（CRC）仍然难以治疗，因为氧化还原适应、代谢可塑性、黏蛋白相关的递送屏障、免疫排斥和微生物群依赖性信号传导共同限制了常规治疗。工程化纳米酶提供了一种以反应为中心的策略，利用这些CRC特有的脆弱性。本综述严格比较了金属、金属氧化物、碳基、多孔框架和单原子纳米酶在催化机制、模拟酶活性、底物依赖性、可控性、生物安全性和转化适用性方面的差异。我们探讨了酸性、过氧化氢、缺氧、谷胱甘肽富集、代谢失调、黏蛋白屏障和肠道微生物群如何影响催化性能。我们进一步评估了化疗增敏、化学动力学、光热、光动力、声动力、免疫治疗和多模式治疗的证据，强调了机制协同作用和现有临床前模型的局限性。主要的转化障碍包括非标准化的催化测定、异质性的瘤内底物、脱靶活性氧毒性、不确定的降解和长期命运、微生物组破坏、制造可重复性以及在原位、免疫活性、类器官和患者来源系统中的验证有限。因此，我们将CRC纳米酶治疗定位为一种以疾病为导向的催化医学平台，其临床价值将取决于生物标志物指导的选择、可编程激活以及可降解、局部可控的设计。

abstract:
Background

Lipids represent a significant component of the human brain, exerting crucial functions in both physiological and pathological conditions. Mapping brain lipids distribution is an emerging area of research, with mass spectrometry imaging allowing the detection of lipid species and their localization within tissue sections. However, comprehensive spatial mapping of lipids in the human brain remains to be achieved. This systematic review addresses this gap by critically synthesizing the available literature in the field.Methods

A bibliographic search on PubMed, Scopus and Web of Science for original articles employing mass spectrometry imaging to analyze lipids and their distribution in the human brain was performed. The included articles were grouped according to the clinical characteristics of the studied populations, including healthy subjects and selected neurological and psychiatric disorders. Studies on human brain tissue from tumoral specimens, animals, or in vitro models such as organoids were excluded to maintain focus on translational findings directly applicable to human neurological and psychiatric diseases.Results

Following the inclusion criteria, 34 articles were selected. Alzheimer's disease, schizophrenia and multiple sclerosis were the most frequently investigated conditions, alongside studies in healthy subjects describing lipid distribution under physiological conditions. We observed considerable heterogeneity across studies in terms of research questions and methodological approaches. Nevertheless, our critical synthesis allowed us to identify both consistencies and discrepancies in experimental strategies and in the lipid signatures reported.Conclusions

Studying lipids by mass spectrometry imaging enables the identification of spatially defined profiles in distinct brain areas, providing valuable insights into both human neurobiology and brain disorders' pathophysiology. In this context, spatial information is crucial for linking lipid alterations to specific structures or lesions, thereby supporting translational applications. Finally, we identified key methodological issues that must be addressed to advance this emerging field.
abstractZh:
背景

脂质是人脑的重要组成部分，在生理和病理条件下都发挥着关键作用。绘制脑脂质分布图是一个新兴的研究领域，质谱成像技术能够检测组织切片中的脂质种类及其定位。然而，人脑中脂质的全面空间图谱仍未实现。本系统综述通过批判性地综合该领域的现有文献来填补这一空白。方法

在PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science上进行了文献检索，查找使用质谱成像分析人脑脂质及其分布的原创文章。纳入的文章根据所研究人群的临床特征进行分组，包括健康受试者和选定的神经及精神疾病。为了保持对直接适用于人类神经和精神疾病的转化研究结果的关注，排除了来自肿瘤标本、动物或类器官等体外模型的人脑组织研究。结果

根据纳入标准，共筛选出34篇文章。阿尔茨海默病、精神分裂症和多发性硬化症是最常被研究的疾病，同时也有研究描述了健康受试者在生理条件下的脂质分布。我们观察到各研究在研究问题和方法学方法上存在相当大的异质性。尽管如此，我们的批判性综合使我们能够识别出实验策略和所报告的脂质特征中的一致性和差异。结论

通过质谱成像研究脂质能够识别不同脑区中空间定义的图谱，为人类神经生物学和脑部疾病的病理生理学提供了宝贵的见解。在此背景下，空间信息对于将脂质改变与特定结构或病变联系起来至关重要，从而支持转化应用。最后，我们确定了必须解决的关键方法学问题，以推动这一新兴领域的发展。
