abstract: Skin aging is a multifactorial, multiscale process driven by the interplay between intrinsic cellular decline and extrinsic environmental exposures. Increasing evidence positions the skin as a dynamic interface and sensitive "window" reflecting systemic aging. However, research remains fragmented across scales, and existing models fail to capture the full complexity of systemic regulation. In this review, we introduce a hierarchical four-dimension framework of skin aging to systematically benchmark experimental models against core aging hallmarks. This framework integrates: (i) molecular and cellular hallmarks including DNA damage, mitochondrial dysfunction, epigenetic drift, senescence, and senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP); (ii) extracellular matrix remodeling and mechanosignaling-driven stiffness changes; (iii) tissue-level deterioration involving stem cell niche disruption and appendage dysfunction; and (iv) systemic neuroendocrine-immune-exposome regulation, where hormonal, inflammatory, and environmental signals converge. Applying this framework, we evaluate current platforms such as 2D cultures, 3D skin equivalents, organoids, and bioengineered models for their strengths and limitations in recapitulating specific aging dimensions. In summary, research into skin aging is undergoing a transformative shift from reductionist 2D monolayers to complex integrated systems. The establishment of multiscale models spanning 2D cell cultures, 3D bioprinting, organoids, and skin-on-a-chip platforms provides superior predictive power for evaluating anti-aging therapeutics. As these platforms move toward regulatory standardization, they hold the potential to mitigate clinical translation risks and overcome the inherent limitations of animal models, ultimately catalyzing the development of precision interventions tailored to individual aging trajectories.
abstractZh: 皮肤衰老是一个多因素、多尺度的过程，由内在细胞衰退与外在环境暴露之间的相互作用驱动。越来越多的证据将皮肤定位为一个动态界面和反映全身衰老的敏感“窗口”。然而，研究在不同尺度上仍然分散，现有模型未能捕捉全身调控的全部复杂性。在本综述中，我们引入了一个皮肤衰老的分层四维框架，以系统地将实验模型与核心衰老标志进行基准比较。该框架整合了：（i）分子和细胞标志，包括DNA损伤、线粒体功能障碍、表观遗传漂移、细胞衰老和衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）；（ii）细胞外基质重塑和机械信号传导驱动的刚度变化；（iii）涉及干细胞生态位破坏和附属器功能障碍的组织水平退化；以及（iv）全身神经内分泌-免疫-暴露组调控，其中激素、炎症和环境信号汇聚。应用该框架，我们评估了当前平台，如2D培养、3D皮肤等效物、类器官和生物工程模型，在重现特定衰老维度方面的优势和局限性。总之，皮肤衰老研究正在经历从还原论2D单层向复杂集成系统的变革性转变。跨越2D细胞培养、3D生物打印、类器官和皮肤芯片平台的多尺度模型的建立，为评估抗衰老疗法提供了更优的预测能力。随着这些平台走向监管标准化，它们有望降低临床转化风险并克服动物模型的固有局限性，最终促进针对个体衰老轨迹的精准干预措施的开发。

abstract: Organ-on-a-Chip (OoC) systems use microfluidic and tissue engineering techniques to recreate key features of organ microenvironments. They have become a common platform for disease modeling and drug screening. As OoC technologies advance, they generate larger and more diverse datasets. Traditional manual analysis and endpoint measurements are therefore no longer sufficient to capture dynamic processes or long-term responses. Artificial intelligence (AI) enables efficient data analysis and supports functional prediction. This review focuses on how AI is used in OoC experiments, including data acquisition during experiments, post-experimental data analysis, and application-oriented predictive tasks. Current studies mainly apply AI to support real-time sensing and monitoring, computational phenotyping and behavioral analysis, and drug response evaluation. We further discuss several AI approaches that have seen limited use in OoC but may offer new opportunities. Realtime monitoring and intelligent control could improve data acquisition. Multimodal data fusion and deep learning-based prediction may enhance data analysis. At the application level, these methods may further support pharmacology and toxicology studies. These developments indicate a move toward data-driven OoC platforms with improved reliability for precision medicine and drug development.
abstractZh: 器官芯片（OoC）系统利用微流控和组织工程技术来重现器官微环境的关键特征。它们已成为疾病建模和药物筛选的常用平台。随着OoC技术的进步，它们产生了更大、更多样化的数据集。因此，传统的人工分析和终点测量不再足以捕捉动态过程或长期反应。人工智能（AI）能够实现高效的数据分析并支持功能预测。本综述聚焦于AI在OoC实验中的使用方式，包括实验期间的数据采集、实验后的数据分析以及面向应用的任务预测。当前研究主要应用AI来支持实时传感与监测、计算表型分析和行为分析，以及药物反应评估。我们进一步讨论了在OoC中应用有限但可能提供新机遇的几种AI方法。实时监测和智能控制可以改善数据采集。多模态数据融合和基于深度学习的预测可能增强数据分析。在应用层面，这些方法可能进一步支持药理学和毒理学研究。这些发展表明，OoC平台正朝着数据驱动的方向发展，并为精准医学和药物开发提供更高的可靠性。

abstract: Disruption of the photoreceptor-retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) interface, with loss of photoreceptor outer segments (POSs) in the retina, is a pathological hallmark of several neurodegenerative and retinal diseases, including lysosomal storage disorders like juvenile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis (CLN3) disease. However, in vitro stem cell models that enable investigation of the photoreceptor-RPE interface are lacking. Here, we developed a 3D human pluripotent stem cell-derived retina organoid-RPE (hPSC-RO-RPE) model to investigate the photoreceptor-RPE interface in healthy and diseased tissues. Using this 3D hPSC-RO-RPE retina model, we showed that the most common disease-causing CLN3 mutation (CLN3Δex7-8) leads to reduced levels of acid ceramidase (AC), sphingosine 1 phosphate, and POS loss. Furthermore, by analyzing control versus CLN3 mutant (CLN3Δex7-8) hPSC-derived RPE monoculture and hPSC-RO-RPE model, (i) we identified a pathogenic role of AC-mediated lysosomal sphingolipid metabolism in promoting CLN3 disease pathobiology, and (ii) we showed a cell autonomous role of the RPE dysfunction in promoting POS loss/retina degeneration in CLN3 disease. We validated the molecular and structural changes observed in the CLN3Δex7-8 hPSC-RO-RPE model in the CLN3 miniswine model (CLN3Δex7-8) and donor eyes from two patients with CLN3 disease. High-resolution retinal imaging of the living eye in two patients with CLN3 disease suggested decreased RPE autofluorescence in early-stage CLN3 disease. Treatment with recombinant human acid ceramidase (rhAC) ameliorated photoreceptor degeneration in both the CLN3 disease RO-RPE model and CLN3 miniswine eyes. These findings suggest that rhAC could be a therapeutic approach for retinal degeneration in CLN3 disease.
abstractZh: 光感受器-视网膜色素上皮（RPE）界面的破坏，伴随视网膜中光感受器外节（POSs）的丢失，是多种神经退行性疾病和视网膜疾病的病理标志，包括溶酶体贮积症如青少年神经元蜡样脂褐质沉积症（CLN3病）。然而，目前缺乏能够研究光感受器-RPE界面的体外干细胞模型。在此，我们开发了一种3D人多能干细胞来源的视网膜类器官-RPE（hPSC-RO-RPE）模型，以研究健康和病变组织中的光感受器-RPE界面。利用这种3D hPSC-RO-RPE视网膜模型，我们证明了最常见的致病性CLN3突变（CLN3Δex7-8）导致酸性神经酰胺酶（AC）、1-磷酸鞘氨醇水平降低以及POS丢失。此外，通过分析对照与CLN3突变体（CLN3Δex7-8）hPSC来源的RPE单培养和hPSC-RO-RPE模型，（i）我们确定了AC介导的溶酶体鞘脂代谢在促进CLN3疾病病理生物学中的致病作用，并且（ii）我们展示了RPE功能障碍在促进CLN3疾病中POS丢失/视网膜变性中的细胞自主作用。我们在CLN3小型猪模型（CLN3Δex7-8）和两名CLN3疾病患者的供体眼中验证了在CLN3Δex7-8 hPSC-RO-RPE模型中观察到的分子和结构变化。对两名CLN3疾病患者活体眼的高分辨率视网膜成像提示，早期CLN3疾病中RPE自发荧光降低。使用重组人酸性神经酰胺酶（rhAC）治疗在CLN3疾病RO-RPE模型和CLN3小型猪眼中均改善了光感受器变性。这些发现表明，rhAC可能是CLN3疾病视网膜变性的治疗方法。

title: Dynamic Landscape Analysis of cell fate decisions provides predictive models of neural development from single-cell data.

abstract: Building a mechanistic understanding of cell fate decisions remains a fundamental goal of developmental biology, with implications for stem cell therapies, regenerative medicine and understanding disease mechanisms. Single-cell transcriptomics provides a detailed picture of the cellular states observed during these decisions, but building dynamic and predictive models from these data remains a challenge. Here, we present dynamic landscape analysis (DLA), an integrative framework that applies dynamical systems theory to identify stable cell states, map transition pathways, and generate a predictive cell fate decision landscape from single-cell data. Applying this framework to vertebrate neural tube development revealed that progenitor specification by Sonic Hedgehog (Shh) can be captured in a landscape with an unexpected topology in which initially divergent lineages converge to the same fate through multiple distinct routes. The model accurately predicted cellular responses and cell fate allocation for unseen dynamic signalling regimes. Cross-species validation using human embryonic organoid data demonstrated conservation of this decision-making architecture. By modelling the dynamic responses that drive cell fate decisions, the DLA framework provides a quantitative and generative framework for extracting mechanistic insights from high-dimensional single-cell data.
abstractZh: 建立对细胞命运决定的机制性理解仍然是发育生物学的基本目标，对干细胞治疗、再生医学和理解疾病机制具有重要意义。单细胞转录组学提供了在这些决定过程中观察到的细胞状态的详细图景，但根据这些数据建立动态和预测模型仍然是一个挑战。在这里，我们提出了动态景观分析（DLA），一个整合框架，应用动力系统理论来识别稳定的细胞状态，绘制转变路径，并从单细胞数据生成预测性的细胞命运决定景观。将该框架应用于脊椎动物神经管发育，揭示了由Sonic Hedgehog（Shh）驱动的祖细胞特化可以被捕获在一个具有意外拓扑结构的景观中，其中最初分化的谱系通过多条不同路径汇聚到相同的命运。该模型准确预测了未见过的动态信号模式下细胞反应和细胞命运分配。使用人类胚胎类器官数据的跨物种验证证明了这种决策架构的保守性。通过模拟驱动细胞命运决定的动态反应，DLA框架提供了一个定量和生成性的框架，用于从高维单细胞数据中提取机制性见解。

title: The Leiden  ex vivo  human growth plate model in severe tall stature: a proof-of-concept study
titleZh: 莱顿离体人生长板模型在严重高身材中的应用：一项概念验证研究
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Tuerlings M, Ramos YFM, Suchiman HED, Sayedipour SS, Joustra SD, Rabelink-Hoogenstraaten A, van Duyvenvoorde HA, Kempink DRJ, de Witte PB, Meulenbelt I, de Bruin C.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Background

  Viable human growth plate (GP) tissue is rarely available for translational research, limiting direct investigation of human longitudinal bone growth and pediatric growth disorders. In this proof-ofconcept study, we aimed to determine feasibility to establish a clinically integrated  ex vivo human growth plate model using tissue obtained during routine percutaneous epiphysiodesis (PE) procedures in adolescents treated for extreme tall stature or leg length difference due to trauma.  Methods

  Growth plate tissue and cells were collected during PE and processed using protocols adapted from established methods of human osteoarthritic cartilage collection within the RAAK study. Collected tissues and three-dimensional cartilage pellets generated from isolated cells were assessed by histology. Proliferation of GP-derived chondrocytes was compared with osteoarthritis-derived articular chondrocytes. Results

  Across consecutive surgical procedures, viable GP tissue could be obtained reproducibly including the node of Ranvier, with only few samples failing to yield cells and no contamination. Isolated GP chondrocytes expanded successfully in two-dimensional culture and showed a stronger early proliferative response compared with RAAK-derived chondrocytes. In addition, GP-derived cells formed threedimensional organoids and histology confirmed cartilage-like matrix deposition supporting their capacity to generate neo-cartilage tissue  in vitro .  Conclusion

  This study demonstrates feasibility to obtain, culture, and functionally assess viable human growth plate tissue from routine PE surgery. As such, the Leiden  ex vivo human growth plate model provides a unique platform to study local mechanisms of endochondral bone growth, link genetic determinants of height to functional growth plate biology, and support future therapeutic research in pediatric growth disorders.
abstractZh:
摘要

  背景

  可用于转化研究的活体人生长板（GP）组织很少，限制了对人类纵向骨生长和儿科生长障碍的直接研究。在这项概念验证研究中，我们旨在确定建立临床整合的离体人生长板模型的可行性，该模型使用在常规经皮骨骺阻滞术（PE）中获得的组织，这些手术针对因创伤导致的极端高身材或腿长差异的青少年进行。 方法

  在PE期间收集生长板组织和细胞，并使用改编自RAAK研究中已建立的人骨关节炎软骨收集方法的方案进行处理。通过组织学评估收集的组织和由分离细胞生成的三维软骨微球。将GP来源的软骨细胞的增殖与骨关节炎来源的关节软骨细胞进行比较。结果

  在连续的外科手术中，可以可重复地获得活体生长板组织，包括Ranvier结，只有少数样本未能产生细胞且无污染。分离的GP软骨细胞在二维培养中成功扩增，并显示出比RAAK来源的软骨细胞更强的早期增殖反应。此外，GP来源的细胞形成三维类器官，组织学证实软骨样基质沉积，支持其在体外生成新生软骨组织的能力。 结论

  本研究证明了从常规PE手术中获取、培养和功能评估活体人生长板组织的可行性。因此，莱顿离体人生长板模型为研究软骨内骨生长的局部机制、将身高的遗传决定因素与功能性生长板生物学联系起来，以及支持儿科生长障碍的未来治疗研究提供了独特的平台。

title: Tumor control of lysosomal acidification promotes lipoprotein assimilation and ferroptosis resistance
titleZh: 溶酶体酸化的肿瘤调控促进脂蛋白同化与铁死亡抵抗
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Wu R, Hsu S, Sang L, Yu M, Kim YJ, Choe M, Hauer C, Cai L, Hanker AB, Chan IS, Shin HR, Garcia Bermudez J.
abstract: Lysosomes are acidic organelles that fuel cancer progression by facilitating nutrient acquisition and metabolic adaptation, yet the determinants through which cancer cells sustain specialized lysosomal functions are not fully delineated. Notably, assimilation of dietary antioxidants within lipoproteins, a lysosome-dependent process, protects tumors from ferroptosis, an oxidative form of cell death, raising the possibility that tumors evolve mechanisms to enhance this process. Here, we applied genetic screens to identify regulators of lysosome-dependent lipoprotein assimilation and ferroptosis resistance and identified ZNF217, a frequently amplified transcriptional regulator in human cancers, as a driver of tumor lysosomal function and ferroptosis resistance. ZNF217 promoted lipoprotein assimilation through transcriptional maintenance of RAB11FIP4, an endolysosomal protein. Loss of either ZNF217 or RAB11FIP4 impaired lysosomal acidification across multiple cancer types, leading to defective lipoprotein assimilation, increased lipid peroxidation, ferroptosis sensitivity, and impaired tumor growth. Mechanistically, RAB11FIP4 boosts lysosomal acidity through maintenance of RAB7A activity. Finally, disruption of ZNF217 in breast cancer cell lines and patient-derived organoids, a tumor context linked to ZNF217 expression, reduced lysosomal acidity and impaired cancer growth through increased ferroptosis sensitivity. Together, we identify transcriptional regulation of lysosomal acidification as a key metabolic adaptation that enables extracellular antioxidant acquisition and tumor progression.
abstractZh: 溶酶体是酸性细胞器，通过促进营养获取和代谢适应来推动癌症进展，但癌细胞维持特化溶酶体功能的决定因素尚未完全阐明。值得注意的是，脂蛋白中膳食抗氧化剂的同化是一个依赖溶酶体的过程，可保护肿瘤免受铁死亡（一种氧化性细胞死亡形式）的影响，这提示肿瘤可能进化出增强该过程的机制。在此，我们应用遗传筛选来识别依赖溶酶体的脂蛋白同化和铁死亡抵抗的调节因子，并鉴定出ZNF217（人类癌症中频繁扩增的转录调节因子）作为肿瘤溶酶体功能和铁死亡抵抗的驱动因子。ZNF217通过转录维持内溶酶体蛋白RAB11FIP4来促进脂蛋白同化。在多种癌症类型中，ZNF217或RAB11FIP4的缺失均损害溶酶体酸化，导致脂蛋白同化缺陷、脂质过氧化增加、铁死亡敏感性增强以及肿瘤生长受损。机制上，RAB11FIP4通过维持RAB7A活性来增强溶酶体酸性。最后，在乳腺癌细胞系和患者来源的类器官（与ZNF217表达相关的肿瘤背景）中破坏ZNF217，可降低溶酶体酸性并通过增加铁死亡敏感性损害癌症生长。总之，我们确定溶酶体酸化的转录调控是一种关键的代谢适应，能够实现细胞外抗氧化剂的获取和肿瘤进展。

title: Granulocyte-macrophage colony stimulating factor targets lung stem cell niches to accelerate alveolar repair after virus-induced lung injury
titleZh: 粒细胞-巨噬细胞集落刺激因子靶向肺干细胞微环境以加速病毒性肺损伤后的肺泡修复
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Vazquez-Armendariz AI, Schäfer TM, Pervizaj-Oruqaj L, Khadim A, Alexopoulos I, Heiner M, Sperling L, Humpert K, Ferrero MR, Ott B, Vadász I, Morty RE, Hain T, El Agha E, Herold S.
abstract: Influenza virus pneumonia causes severe damage of the lung parenchyma, resulting in respiratory failure. Timely and coordinated epithelial tissue repair is crucial for re-establishment of gas exchange. We identify granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF) as a niche-derived growth factor produced in response to viral lung injury by distal epithelial progenitor cell populations, including alveolar epithelial type II cells (AECII) and bronchioalveolar stem cells (BASCs). Using complementary  in vivo infection models, loss- and gain-of-function approaches, and lung organoid systems, we reveal that GM-CSF directly promotes distal epithelial progenitor cell expansion and alveolarization. Mechanistically, GM-CSF suppresses AMP-activated protein kinase activation and enables mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) signaling, driving epithelial progenitor cell proliferation. Administration of recombinant GM-CSF during the initial days of infection enhances AECII proliferation and differentiation into AEC type I, accelerating lung barrier repair. Together, our findings establish GM-CSF as a key regulator of distal lung progenitor cell niches that couples cytokine signaling to metabolic control of tissue regeneration. These results uncover a previously unrecognized epithelial-intrinsic function of GM-CSF and highlight its therapeutic potential to promote lung repair in acute injury.
abstractZh: 流感病毒肺炎导致肺实质严重损伤，引发呼吸衰竭。及时且协调的上皮组织修复对于恢复气体交换至关重要。我们鉴定出粒细胞-巨噬细胞集落刺激因子（GM-CSF）是一种由远端上皮祖细胞群（包括肺泡上皮II型细胞（AECII）和支气管肺泡干细胞（BASC））在病毒性肺损伤时产生的微环境衍生生长因子。利用互补的体内感染模型、功能缺失和功能获得方法以及肺类器官系统，我们揭示GM-CSF直接促进远端上皮祖细胞扩增和肺泡形成。机制上，GM-CSF抑制AMP活化蛋白激酶的激活，并使雷帕霉素机制靶标复合物1（mTORC1）信号传导得以进行，从而驱动上皮祖细胞增殖。在感染初期给予重组GM-CSF可增强AECII增殖并分化为I型肺泡上皮细胞，加速肺屏障修复。总之，我们的发现确立了GM-CSF作为远端肺祖细胞微环境的关键调节因子，将细胞因子信号传导与组织再生的代谢控制相耦合。这些结果揭示了GM-CSF先前未被认识的上皮内在功能，并强调其在急性损伤中促进肺修复的治疗潜力。

title: NELLY enables patient-centric drug prioritization through interpretable drug-conditioned gene weighting
titleZh: NELLY通过可解释的药物条件基因加权实现以患者为中心的药物优先级排序
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Peralta Viteri C, Harnischfeger N, Szabo L, Hartmann S, Kretzschmar K.
abstract: Precision oncology seeks to match each tumor with the most effective anti-cancer therapy. Advances in pharmacogenomics and machine learning enabled drug response prediction models with strong performance in cancer cell lines. Nonetheless, patient-centric evaluation of drug prioritization and systematic assessment of model generalization in patient-derived systems across cancer types remain largely absent. Here we introduce a translational framework combining patient-centric benchmarking with a pan-cancer pharmacogenomic atlas of patient-derived organoids, together with NELLY, a deep learning model integrating transcriptomic and chemical information to predict drug response and prioritize therapies. NELLY outperformed existing methods for patient-specific drug prioritization across cancer cell lines and patient-derived organoids, including under out-of-distribution evaluation. Its dynamic weighting mechanism provided patient-specific gene attributions, offering a route to connect predicted drug response to molecular programs associated with drug resistance. Our results support NELLY as a promising framework for translationally relevant and interpretable drug response prediction in precision oncology.
abstractZh: 精准肿瘤学旨在为每个肿瘤匹配最有效的抗癌治疗。药物基因组学和机器学习的发展使得药物反应预测模型在癌细胞系中表现出强大的性能。然而，以患者为中心的药物优先级评估以及跨癌症类型在患者来源系统中模型泛化能力的系统性评估仍然 largely 缺失。在此，我们引入了一个转化框架，结合以患者为中心的基准测试与患者来源类器官的泛癌药物基因组图谱，以及NELLY——一种整合转录组和化学信息以预测药物反应并优先排序疗法的深度学习模型。NELLY在癌细胞系和患者来源类器官中，包括在分布外评估下，均优于现有方法，用于患者特异性药物优先级排序。其动态加权机制提供了患者特异性基因归因，为将预测的药物反应与耐药相关的分子程序联系起来提供了途径。我们的结果支持NELLY作为精准肿瘤学中具有转化相关性和可解释性的药物反应预测的有前景框架。

title: AI-driven framework modeling perturbation in brain organoids reveals candidate genes for autism
titleZh: AI驱动框架模拟脑类器官中的扰动揭示自闭症候选基因
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Koh IG, Chang E, Choi Y, Kim S, Kim Y, Lee H, Byeon G, Ryu Y, Kim S, Lee J, Park H, Sim H, Ryu Y, Shim W, Lee J, Salazar NB, de Aquino MM, Engchuan W, Zhou X, Son JH, Lee J, Bong G, Kim IB, Han JH, Werling DM, Kim SH, Oh M, Kim M, Lee D, Kim J, Lee Y, Sun W, Kim E, Scherer SW, Jeon M, Yoo HJ, An J.
abstract: Autism gene discovery is constrained by the rarity and heterogeneity of damaging variants, requiring large cohorts to identify susceptibility genes. Neural organoids and single-cell foundation models enable perturbation modeling in neurodevelopmental contexts. Here, we show that perturbation-informed foundation modeling of neural organoids can provide functional context for prioritizing candidate genes with genomic and clinical support. We constructed a 3.6-million-cell organoid atlas and trained models to predict genome-wide perturbation responses. Benchmarking 17 models identified a telencephalic neuron-specific model best preserving autism-relevant perturbation structure. Genome-wide profiling revealed two clusters associated with mid-fetal synaptic neuronal processes and early radial glia ubiquitin signaling. These clusters were supported by damaging-variant enrichment and clinical phenotypes across 89,916 family-based samples. Logistic-regression prioritization identified 343 candidates, including 167 in the key clusters, with convergence across TADA signals and recurrent evidence for  NBEA and  KLHDC10 . This framework integrates predicted perturbation effects with genomic evidence to support autism candidate prioritization.
abstractZh: 自闭症基因发现受到罕见且异质性破坏性变异的限制，需要大型队列来识别易感基因。神经类器官和单细胞基础模型使得在神经发育背景下进行扰动建模成为可能。在此，我们展示了扰动信息化的神经类器官基础建模可以为优先排序具有基因组和临床支持的候选基因提供功能背景。我们构建了一个包含360万个细胞的类器官图谱，并训练模型来预测全基因组扰动反应。对17个模型的基准测试确定了一个端脑神经元特异性模型，该模型最能保留自闭症相关的扰动结构。全基因组分析揭示了两个与中胎儿突触神经元过程和早期放射状胶质细胞泛素信号传导相关的聚类。这些聚类得到了来自89,916个基于家系样本的破坏性变异富集和临床表型的支持。逻辑回归优先排序确定了343个候选基因，其中包括关键聚类中的167个，与TADA信号和NBEA和KLHDC10的反复证据收敛。该框架整合了预测的扰动效应与基因组证据，以支持自闭症候选基因的优先排序。

title: LSD1 Expression is Associated with Immune Exclusion and Hypoxia-Related Transcriptional Programs in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer
titleZh: LSD1表达与三阴性乳腺癌中的免疫排斥和缺氧相关转录程序相关
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Lee DY, Hong JH, Guan P, Lee B, Perna S, Cui J, Lin C, Chen JM, Lau HX, Poh J, Tan PH, Teh BT, Iqbal J.
abstract: Abstract  Background  Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) exhibits aggressive biology and heterogeneous immune infiltration. Lysine-specific demethylase 1 (LSD1/KDM1A) is an epigenetic regulator implicated in oncogenic transcriptional programs; however, its association with hypoxia signaling and immune exclusion in TNBC remains incompletely defined. Methods  LSD1 expression was evaluated by immunohistochemistry in TNBC specimens and correlated with survival outcomes. Functional studies using shRNA-mediated knockdown and pharmacologic inhibition were performed in TNBC cell lines and patient-derived organoids. Differential gene expression analyses were conducted in institutional and TCGA cohorts. Genome-wide LSD1 binding was assessed using ChIP-seq with motif enrichment analysis and co-immunoprecipitation. Multiplex immunofluorescence and GeoMX digital spatial profiling characterized intratumoral immune subsets. Immune-competent 3D organoid–PBMC co-cultures were used to evaluate tumor-intrinsic effects. Results  LSD1 positivity was associated with inferior overall survival and identified a phenotype enriched for hypoxia-associated transcriptional signatures and immune exclusion. Transcriptomic analyses demonstrated enrichment of HIF-1 and MYC-associated programs alongside suppression of interferon and immune activation pathways in LSD1-high tumors. ChIP-seq identified LSD1-binding sites enriched for AP-1 motifs, supported by co-immunoprecipitation of LSD1 with AP-1 complexes. Clinically, LSD1-positive tumors exhibited reduced infiltration of CD3+, CD4+, CD8 + T cells, B cells, CD3 + CD56+ NK/T-like cells, and CD68 + macrophages. Spatial profiling revealed suppression of innate immune response genes within B-cell regions and type-1 interferon signaling within T-cell regions. In patient-derived organoids, LSD1 inhibition induced cytokine remodeling and reduced tumor volume in both monoculture and co-culture conditions without substantial immune cell depletion, supporting a tumor-selective mechanism of action. Conclusions  LSD1 expression is associated with poor survival, reduced immune infiltration and hypoxia-related transcriptional programs in TNBC. Integrative chromatin, spatial, and organoid analyses support a link between LSD1-associated states and altered tumor immunogenicity, including AP-1 motif-enriched chromatin occupancy and modulation of immune-associated pathways following LSD1 perturbation. These findings support further investigation of LSD1 as a biomarker-associated therapeutic vulnerability in immune-cold TNBC.
abstractZh: 摘要 背景 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）表现出侵袭性生物学行为和异质性免疫浸润。赖氨酸特异性去甲基化酶1（LSD1/KDM1A）是一种表观遗传调控因子，参与致癌转录程序；然而，其与TNBC中缺氧信号和免疫排斥的关联尚未完全明确。方法 通过免疫组织化学评估TNBC标本中LSD1的表达，并与其生存结局相关联。在TNBC细胞系和患者来源类器官中，使用shRNA介导的敲低和药理学抑制进行功能研究。在机构队列和TCGA队列中进行差异基因表达分析。使用ChIP-seq评估全基因组LSD1结合，并进行基序富集分析和免疫共沉淀。多重免疫荧光和GeoMX数字空间谱分析表征了瘤内免疫亚群。使用免疫活性3D类器官-外周血单个核细胞共培养来评估肿瘤内在效应。结果 LSD1阳性与较差的总生存期相关，并识别出富集缺氧相关转录特征和免疫排斥的表型。转录组学分析显示，在LSD1高表达肿瘤中，HIF-1和MYC相关程序富集，同时干扰素和免疫激活通路受到抑制。ChIP-seq鉴定出富集AP-1基序的LSD1结合位点，并通过LSD1与AP-1复合物的免疫共沉淀得到支持。临床上，LSD1阳性肿瘤表现出CD3+、CD4+、CD8+ T细胞、B细胞、CD3+CD56+ NK/T样细胞和CD68+巨噬细胞浸润减少。空间分析显示，B细胞区域内的先天免疫应答基因和T细胞区域内的I型干扰素信号传导受到抑制。在患者来源类器官中，LSD1抑制诱导细胞因子重塑，并在单培养和共培养条件下均减少肿瘤体积，而不会显著耗竭免疫细胞，支持肿瘤选择性作用机制。结论 LSD1表达与TNBC中较差生存、免疫浸润减少和缺氧相关转录程序相关。整合染色质、空间和类器官分析支持LSD1相关状态与肿瘤免疫原性改变之间的联系，包括AP-1基序富集的染色质占据以及LSD1扰动后免疫相关通路的调节。这些发现支持进一步研究LSD1作为免疫冷性TNBC中生物标志物相关的治疗脆弱性。

title: Establishment of a Porcine Small Intestinal Organoid Model for Porcine Rotavirus Infection.
titleZh: 猪轮状病毒感染的小肠类器官模型的建立。
journal: Animals : an open access journal from MDPI
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Wei H, Wu W, Liu M, Li M, Zhang J, Deng S.
affiliations: Department of Preventive Veterinary Medicine, College of Animal Science and Technology, Jiangxi Agricultural University, Nanchang 330045, China.
Lushan Botanical Garden, Jiangxi Province and Chinese Academy of Sciences, Lushan 332900, China.
abstract: Porcine rotavirus (PoRV), a major enteric pathogen, causes severe diarrhea, dehydration, high morbidity, and mortality, leading to significant economic losses in the porcine industry. In this study, we established a porcine small intestinal organoid culture system and developed an in vitro model for PoRV infection. Jejunal crypts were isolated from neonatal piglets and subsequently cultured to generate porcine small intestinal organoids in both three-dimensional (3D) and two-dimensional (2D) organoid formats, properties of which were verified via morphological assessment and immunostaining for Lgr5, villin, Ki-67, and lysozyme. Furthermore, a PoRV infection model was established in both 3D and 2D organoid cultures, and growth kinetics demonstrated efficient PoRV replication. PoRV infection also significantly increased the expression of inflammatory cytokines, including IL-6 and IFN-α. Collectively, these results demonstrate that the established porcine small intestinal organoid models support efficient PoRV replication and provide a physiologically relevant platform for studying PoRV pathogenesis and evaluating potential antiviral strategies.
abstractZh: 猪轮状病毒（PoRV）是一种主要的肠道病原体，可引起严重腹泻、脱水、高发病率和死亡率，导致养猪业重大经济损失。在本研究中，我们建立了猪小肠类器官培养系统，并开发了PoRV感染的体外模型。从新生仔猪中分离空肠隐窝，随后培养生成三维（3D）和二维（2D）形式的猪小肠类器官，并通过形态学评估和Lgr5、villin、Ki-67和溶菌酶的免疫染色验证其特性。此外，在3D和2D类器官培养中建立了PoRV感染模型，生长动力学表明PoRV有效复制。PoRV感染还显著增加了炎症细胞因子（包括IL-6和IFN-α）的表达。总之，这些结果表明，所建立的猪小肠类器官模型支持PoRV的有效复制，并为研究PoRV发病机制和评估潜在抗病毒策略提供了生理相关平台。

title: An hiPSC-derived multi-lineage lung model exhibiting proximal-distal epithelial features for modeling pulmonary fibrosis.
titleZh: 一种源自hiPSC的多谱系肺模型，展现近端-远端上皮特征，用于肺纤维化建模。
journal: Frontiers in cell and developmental biology
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Hua C, Qu C, Yang L, Zhao W, Zhao J, Jia Y, Ma C, Shang P, Li X, Xie F, Nie C.
affiliations: Key Laboratory of Tobacco Chemistry, Zhengzhou Tobacco Research Institute of CNTC, Zhengzhou, China.
Beijing Life Science Academy, Beijing, China.
Department of Respiratory and Critical Care Medicine, The Fifth Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou, China.
Henan Institute of Medical and Pharmaceutical Sciences, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou, China.
abstract:
Background

Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive and irreversible interstitial lung disease with limited therapeutic options. Existing hiPSC-derived lung organoid models are largely restricted to single epithelial lineages and cannot endogenously integrate multiple pulmonary cell types, limiting mechanistic studies and drug screening.Methods

We established a staged directed differentiation protocol to sequentially differentiate hiPSCs into definitive endoderm, anterior foregut endoderm, and lung progenitor cells, ultimately generating a multi-lineage lung model on Transwell inserts. The model was characterized by bright-field microscopy, hematoxylin-eosin (H&E) staining, scanning and transmission electron microscopy, immunofluorescence, quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR), enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), and single-cell RNA sequencing. Fibrosis-like phenotypes were induced by transforming growth factor-beta 1 (TGF-β1) stimulation. Transcriptomic similarity to human IPF was assessed by RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) combined with bidirectional gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA), and drug responsiveness was validated with pirfenidone.Results

Without genetic editing or exogenous cell supplementation, the model endogenously generated proximal duct-like epithelium, distal alveolar epithelium, fibroblasts, endothelial cells, and CD68+ macrophage-like cells confirmed by immunofluorescence. Single-cell sequencing identified 13 transcriptional subclusters and revealed epithelial-mesenchymal co-development. TGF-β1 stimulation induced epithelial barrier disruption, ferroptosis-like mitochondrial ultrastructural alterations, extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling, and aberrant secretion of multiple IPF-associated biomarkers. Transcriptomic analysis showed that upregulated genes in the fibrosis model group were significantly enriched in ECM organization, cell adhesion, and the PI3K-Akt pathway. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis identified COL1A1, FN1, and integrin family members as central hubs. Bidirectional GSEA validation confirmed that the transcriptomic signature of the model was highly similar to human IPF, with differentially expressed genes significantly enriched in three independent IPF cohorts. Pirfenidone reversed TGF-β1-induced ECM deposition and myofibroblast activation, and partially restored type II alveolar epithelial (AT2) cell marker expression.Conclusion

We successfully established a humanized multi-lineage lung model that captures epithelial-mesenchymal co-development in vitro. Its responsiveness to TGF-β1 stimulation and sensitivity to pirfenidone highlight its potential for antifibrotic drug screening. This platform offers a humanized tool with the potential to be standardized for investigating cell fate determination during early lung development and the pathogenesis of IPF.
abstractZh:
背景

特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种进行性且不可逆的间质性肺疾病，治疗选择有限。现有的hiPSC来源的肺类器官模型主要局限于单一上皮谱系，无法内源性整合多种肺细胞类型，限制了机制研究和药物筛选。方法

我们建立了一个分阶段定向分化方案，将hiPSCs依次分化为定型内胚层、前肠前段内胚层和肺祖细胞，最终在Transwell插入物上生成多谱系肺模型。通过明场显微镜、苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色、扫描和透射电子显微镜、免疫荧光、定量实时PCR（qRT-PCR）、酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）和单细胞RNA测序对该模型进行了表征。通过转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1）刺激诱导纤维化样表型。通过RNA测序（RNA-seq）结合双向基因集富集分析（GSEA）评估了与人类IPF的转录组相似性，并用吡非尼酮验证了药物反应性。结果

无需基因编辑或外源性细胞补充，该模型内源性生成了近端导管样上皮、远端肺泡上皮、成纤维细胞、内皮细胞和CD68+巨噬细胞样细胞，并通过免疫荧光确认。单细胞测序识别出13个转录亚簇，并揭示了上皮-间充质共同发育。TGF-β1刺激诱导了上皮屏障破坏、铁死亡样线粒体超微结构改变、细胞外基质（ECM）重塑以及多种IPF相关生物标志物的异常分泌。转录组分析显示，纤维化模型组中上调的基因在ECM组织、细胞粘附和PI3K-Akt通路中显著富集。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络分析确定COL1A1、FN1和整合素家族成员为核心枢纽。双向GSEA验证证实，该模型的转录组特征与人类IPF高度相似，差异表达基因在三个独立的IPF队列中显著富集。吡非尼酮逆转了TGF-β1诱导的ECM沉积和肌成纤维细胞活化，并部分恢复了II型肺泡上皮（AT2）细胞标志物表达。结论

我们成功建立了一个人源化多谱系肺模型，在体外捕获了上皮-间充质共同发育。其对TGF-β1刺激的反应性和对吡非尼酮的敏感性突显了其在抗纤维化药物筛选中的潜力。该平台提供了一种人源化工具，有望标准化用于研究早期肺发育过程中的细胞命运决定和IPF的发病机制。

title: Tetrazine-based bioorthogonal reactions to image hypoxia in cancer cells.
titleZh: 基于四嗪的生物正交反应用于癌细胞中缺氧成像。

abstract: Suboptimal oxygen supply in solid tumors controls a variety of cancer hallmarks and impairs responsiveness to anticancer treatments. Yet, tools to visualize hypoxia in cancer are still limited. Here we present an application of the tetrazine-dienophile inverse-electron demand Diels-Alder (IEDDA) reaction for hypoxia visualization. In this approach, trans-cyclooctene-clickable 2-nitroimidazoles work in combination with tetrazine-functionalized probes for live imaging of differential levels of hypoxia in two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) models. We used tetrazine-based fluorescent probes to determine oxygen levels in cell monolayers, spheroids, and patient-derived organoids, and applied a "click-to-release" approach to evaluate the diffusion of the released probe in the surrounding peripheral regions, allowing to quantify the bystander effect. Given the compatibility of the tetrazine-dienophile click reaction with living organisms, the combination of clickable 2-nitroimidazoles with tetrazine-based reporters opens a new avenue for in vivo hypoxia imaging.
abstractZh: 实体瘤中次优的氧气供应控制着多种癌症标志物，并削弱对抗癌治疗的反应性。然而，用于可视化癌症中缺氧的工具仍然有限。在此，我们展示了四嗪-亲二烯体逆电子需求Diels-Alder（IEDDA）反应在缺氧可视化中的应用。在该方法中，反式环辛烯可点击的2-硝基咪唑与四嗪功能化探针结合，用于二维（2D）和三维（3D）模型中不同缺氧水平的活细胞成像。我们使用基于四嗪的荧光探针来测定细胞单层、球状体和患者来源类器官中的氧水平，并应用“点击释放”方法评估释放探针在周围外周区域的扩散，从而量化旁观者效应。鉴于四嗪-亲二烯体点击反应与生物体的相容性，可点击的2-硝基咪唑与基于四嗪的报告分子的结合为体内缺氧成像开辟了新途径。

title: Validating the Role of TRAF2 and Nck-Interacting Kinase as a Potential Target in Colorectal Cancer Progression: A Deeper Insight from Expression Profiling and Epigenetic Analysis.

abstract:
Introduction

Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a significant global health burden; therefore, a better understanding of its molecular underpinnings is needed to develop more effective therapeutic methods. Traf2 and Nck-interacting kinase (TNIK) have emerged as key regulators in various malignancies, including CRC, but their exact roles and regulatory mechanisms remain only partially understood. The present study aimed to characterize TNIK expression in colorectal cancer through integrative analysis of two independent GEO microarray datasets (GSE9348 and GSE21510) comprising a total of 193 CRC and 37 normal tissue samples.Methods

Differential gene expression (DEG) analysis was conducted using GEO2R with the limma package, and protein-protein interaction network analysis was performed using STRING v12.0 and visualized in Cytoscape v3.8.2 to identify TNIK's functional partners within the Wnt signaling pathway. This work highlights genes that are up- and downregulated in CRC using a significance threshold of p  1. Additionally, to investigate the epigenetic regulation of TNIK, an exploratory differential methylation analysis was performed on a murine CRC RRBS dataset (PRJNA589067) that models Wnt hyperactivation in APC-mutant CRC organoids. The data were processed through Bismark v0.24.2 for alignment and the Bioconductor package edgeR for DMR identification in the CpG context. Therefore, an epigenetic analysis of colorectal cancer was conducted to identify differentially methylated regions, using the thresholds p  1.Results

DEG analysis reveals that TNIK is significantly upregulated in cancer samples. From DMR analysis, TNIK was observed to be relatively hypomethylated in the murine experimental model, while expression analysis of human CRC microarray data identified TNIK as an upregulated gene, an inverse relationship consistent with established epigenetic regulatory trends.Discussion

The data analyses and interpretations in this work provide a molecular basis for future pharmacological studies targeting TNIK kinase activity and aberrant DNA methylation in CRC, with potential implications for drug discovery efforts to restore normal Wnt pathway regulation. The study links changes in DNA methylation patterns to gene expression and provides important mechanistic definitions of how epigenetic modifications affect gene regulation.Conclusion

The overall contribution of TNIK overexpression to carcinogenesis and tumor progression through epigenetic modulation in CRC could be applied as a clinical biomarker or candidate for tumor suppressor genes in future studies.
abstractZh:
引言

结直肠癌（CRC）仍然是全球重大的健康负担；因此，需要更好地理解其分子基础，以开发更有效的治疗方法。Traf2和Nck相互作用激酶（TNIK）已成为包括CRC在内的多种恶性肿瘤的关键调节因子，但其确切作用和调控机制仍仅部分了解。本研究旨在通过整合分析两个独立的GEO微阵列数据集（GSE9348和GSE21510），共包含193个CRC和37个正常组织样本，来表征TNIK在结直肠癌中的表达。方法

使用limma包通过GEO2R进行差异基因表达（DEG）分析，并使用STRING v12.0进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析，并在Cytoscape v3.8.2中可视化，以识别TNIK在Wnt信号通路中的功能伙伴。本研究使用显著性阈值p < 0.05和|log2FC| > 1来突出CRC中上调和下调的基因。此外，为了研究TNIK的表观遗传调控，对小鼠CRC RRBS数据集（PRJNA589067）进行了探索性差异甲基化分析，该数据集模拟APC突变CRC类器官中的Wnt过度激活。数据通过Bismark v0.24.2进行比对，并使用Bioconductor包edgeR在CpG背景下进行DMR鉴定。因此，进行了结直肠癌的表观遗传分析，以使用阈值p < 0.05和|log2FC| > 1来识别差异甲基化区域。结果

DEG分析显示，TNIK在癌症样本中显著上调。从DMR分析中，TNIK在小鼠实验模型中观察到相对低甲基化，而人类CRC微阵列数据的表达分析将TNIK确定为上调基因，这种反向关系与已确立的表观遗传调控趋势一致。讨论

本工作的数据分析和解释为未来针对TNIK激酶活性和CRC中异常DNA甲基化的药理学研究提供了分子基础，对恢复正常Wnt通路调节的药物发现工作具有潜在意义。该研究将DNA甲基化模式的变化与基因表达联系起来，并提供了表观遗传修饰如何影响基因调控的重要机制定义。结论

TNIK过表达通过表观遗传调节在CRC中促进致癌和肿瘤进展的总体贡献，可作为未来研究中临床生物标志物或肿瘤抑制基因的候选。

title: Culture of infectious human norovirus isolated from live contaminated oysters.

abstract: Human noroviruses are a major cause of foodborne outbreaks worldwide. Filter-feeding shellfish, such as oysters, can bioaccumulate these viruses in their digestive tissue when grown in sewage-impacted coastal areas and are often implicated in norovirus foodborne outbreaks. Despite the high sensitivity of current molecular assays, these methods for norovirus detection in shellfish fail to distinguish between infectious and non-infectious particles. Assessing norovirus infectivity in shellfish remains a challenge due to the lack of suitable isolation methods that maintain capsid integrity. In this study, a protocol for isolating infectious norovirus from oyster tissues, based on chloroform-butanol elution and polyethylene glycol concentration (CB-PEG), was optimized for the recovery of human norovirus GI and GII. While CB-PEG method recovered various norovirus GI and GII genotypes, it was less efficient at the genomic level than a protocol based on proteinase K elution (adapted from ISO 15216) and showed genotype-dependent viral recovery rates. By optimizing the flocculation step, we improved the method's compatibility with human intestinal enteroid (HIE) cultures. Using this approach, we successfully quantified infectious norovirus GII.3 titers recovered from artificially-contaminated live oysters. Interestingly, infectious virus was better isolated following a freezing step of the digestive tissues, with titers ranging from 13 to 40 TCID50/mL for positive samples. In conclusion, this study established an optimized methodological approach for the relative quantification of infectious norovirus GII.3 in shellfish, paving the way for future research on viral persistence and inactivation strategies in this foodstuff.
abstractZh: 人诺如病毒是全球食源性暴发的主要原因。滤食性贝类，如牡蛎，在受污水影响的海岸地区生长时，可在其消化组织中生物富集这些病毒，并常与诺如病毒食源性暴发有关。尽管当前分子检测方法灵敏度高，但这些用于贝类中诺如病毒检测的方法无法区分具有传染性和非传染性的病毒颗粒。由于缺乏能保持衣壳完整性的合适分离方法，评估贝类中诺如病毒的传染性仍然是一个挑战。在本研究中，基于氯仿-丁醇洗脱和聚乙二醇浓缩（CB-PEG）的从牡蛎组织中分离具有传染性诺如病毒的方案，被优化用于回收人诺如病毒GI和GII。虽然CB-PEG方法能回收多种诺如病毒GI和GII基因型，但在基因组水平上，其效率低于基于蛋白酶K洗脱的方案（改编自ISO 15216），并且显示出基因型依赖的病毒回收率。通过优化絮凝步骤，我们提高了该方法与人肠道类器官（HIE）培养的兼容性。使用这种方法，我们成功定量了从人工污染的活牡蛎中回收的具有传染性诺如病毒GII.3的滴度。有趣的是，在消化组织经过冷冻步骤后，传染性病毒的分离效果更好，阳性样本的滴度范围为13至40 TCID50/mL。总之，本研究建立了一种优化的方法学途径，用于相对定量贝类中具有传染性的诺如病毒GII.3，为未来研究该食品中病毒持久性和灭活策略铺平了道路。

title: Bisphenol mixture impairs offspring social memory via an H4K8 Lactylation-Fyn-Microglial synaptic pruning axis.

abstract: Bisphenol A (BPA) and its structural analogs, i.e., bisphenol S (BPS) and bisphenol F (BPF), are commonly incorporated into consumer products, resulting in simultaneous human exposure to multiple bisphenols. Prospective cohort studies have linked prenatal exposure to individual bisphenols to disrupted neurodevelopment and cognitive dysfunction; however, the mechanisms by which bisphenol mixtures affect neural health remain underexplored. Here, we show that maternal exposure to an environmentally relevant bisphenol mixture during pregnancy and lactation elicits aberrant microglial activation in male offspring, mediated by estrogen receptor β-dependent metabolic reprogramming. This exposure enhances microglial glycolytic activity and histone H4K8 lactylation, thereby directly boosting Fyn transcription. Elevated Fyn expression accelerates microglia-mediated synaptic pruning, leading to decreased hippocampal synaptic density and subsequent deficits in social memory. Notably, genetic and pharmacological suppression of microglial activity, including microglial ablation and selective Fyn inhibition during the exposure period, substantially alleviates these synaptic deficits and behavioral impairments. Similar microglia-dependent synaptic abnormalities are further validated in cell-based and human brain organoid co-culture models. Together, these results reveal a previously unrecognized metabolic-epigenetic pathway by which chemical mixtures disrupt neurodevelopment, emphasizing the critical importance of examining the neurodevelopmental consequences of exposure to real-world chemical mixture during early development.
abstractZh: 双酚A（BPA）及其结构类似物，即双酚S（BPS）和双酚F（BPF），通常被掺入消费品中，导致人类同时暴露于多种双酚。前瞻性队列研究已将产前暴露于单一双酚与神经发育紊乱和认知功能障碍联系起来；然而，双酚混合物影响神经健康的机制仍未得到充分探索。在此，我们表明，在妊娠期和哺乳期，母体暴露于环境相关双酚混合物会引发雄性后代小胶质细胞的异常激活，这一过程由雌激素受体β依赖的代谢重编程介导。这种暴露增强了小胶质细胞的糖酵解活性和组蛋白H4K8乳酸化，从而直接促进Fyn转录。Fyn表达升高加速了小胶质细胞介导的突触修剪，导致海马突触密度降低，进而出现社交记忆缺陷。值得注意的是，在暴露期间，对小胶质细胞活性的遗传和药理学抑制，包括小胶质细胞消融和选择性Fyn抑制，显著减轻了这些突触缺陷和行为障碍。类似的依赖于小胶质细胞的突触异常在基于细胞和人类脑类器官共培养模型中也得到了进一步验证。总之，这些结果揭示了一条先前未被认识的代谢-表观遗传途径，通过该途径，化学混合物破坏神经发育，强调了在早期发育阶段检查暴露于现实世界化学混合物对神经发育后果的至关重要性。

abstract: The Italian Society of Pediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition (SIGENP) recognized the need to define research priorities and identify knowledge gaps to guide future investigations in pediatric digestive health. Following international examples, SIGENP aimed to provide a structured framework that aligns scientific innovation with clinical relevance and patient-centered outcomes. This narrative review represents the consensus output of SIGENP's thematic working groups (WGs) in key fields-inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), Gastrointestinal Endoscopy, Hepatology, Nutrition and Intestinal Failure, Functional and Motility Disorders, and Allergy and Immunity. Each WG conducted a focused review of recent literature, national activities, and registry data, identifying unmet needs and defining strategic objectives. Draft reports were refined through plenary discussions and finalized by consensus during dedicated SIGENP meetings. Across all areas, shared priorities emerged: advancing precision and personalized medicine, integrating multi-omics and digital tools, and promoting pediatric-specific evidence through multicenter collaboration and harmonized registries. Disease-specific gaps include early diagnosis and biomarker discovery in IBD and liver disease, standardization of pediatric endoscopy and motility diagnostics, optimization of nutritional interventions and intestinal failure management, and the exploration of organoid and immune models in celiac disease and food allergy. This review outlines a comprehensive research agenda in pediatric gastroenterology, hepatology, and nutrition developed through a structured SIGENP expert process. It provides a strategic framework to guide future research initiatives, foster collaboration, and ultimately improve outcomes for children with gastrointestinal and nutritional disorders.
abstractZh: 意大利儿科胃肠病学、肝病学与营养学会（SIGENP）认识到有必要确定研究优先事项并识别知识空白，以指导儿科消化健康领域的未来研究。借鉴国际经验，SIGENP旨在提供一个结构化框架，将科学创新与临床相关性和以患者为中心的结果相结合。本叙述性综述代表了SIGENP在关键领域专题工作组（WGs）的共识成果，这些领域包括炎症性肠病（IBD）、消化内镜、肝病学、营养与肠衰竭、功能性与动力障碍性疾病，以及过敏与免疫。每个工作组对近期文献、国内活动和注册数据进行了重点回顾，识别了未满足的需求并确定了战略目标。草案报告通过全体讨论进行完善，并在SIGENP专门会议期间通过共识最终确定。在所有领域中，共同的优先事项浮现：推进精准和个性化医疗，整合多组学和数字工具，以及通过多中心合作和协调统一的注册系统促进儿科特异性证据。疾病特异性空白包括IBD和肝病的早期诊断与生物标志物发现、儿科内镜和动力诊断的标准化、营养干预和肠衰竭管理的优化，以及乳糜泻和食物过敏中类器官和免疫模型的探索。本综述概述了一项全面的儿科胃肠病学、肝病学与营养学研究议程，该议程通过结构化的SIGENP专家流程制定。它提供了一个战略框架，以指导未来的研究举措、促进合作，并最终改善患有胃肠和营养疾病的儿童的治疗结果。

title: Microbial-associated acylated putrescines as immunomodulatory molecules in inflammatory bowel diseases
titleZh: 微生物相关的酰化腐胺作为炎症性肠病中的免疫调节分子
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Bae S, Avila-Pacheco J, Clay SL, Bang S, Scott MC, Andreeva N, Michaud M, Fonseca-Pereira D, Chun E, Cao YG, Zhang Y, Bhosle A, Perez RM, Pishchany G, Vlamakis H, El Tekle G, Morgan XC, Chen SP, Glickman JN, Xavier RJ, Graham DB, Clish CB, Clardy J, Franzosa EA, Huttenhower C, Garrett WS.
abstract:
The gut microbiota profoundly shapes intestinal immunity through the production of small-molecule metabolites; yet in inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), where the microbial metabolome is substantially altered, the identities and immunological functions of most disease-associated metabolites remain unknown. Here, we integrate untargeted fecal metabolomics from two independent IBD patient cohorts with gnotobiotic mouse metabolomic data to identify N-acyl putrescines as a class of microbiome-associated metabolites consistently enriched in both Crohn’s disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC). Among these, N-oleoylputrescine (NOP) induces potent and selective transcriptional responses in bone marrow-derived dendritic cells (BMDCs) and colonic organoids, establishing it as the primary immunomodulatory candidate in this metabolite class.  Enterocloster species harboring nonribosomal peptide synthetase (NRPS) biosynthetic gene clusters produce NOP via conjugation of oleic acid with putrescine, confirmed by isotope-tracing in vitro and germ-free mouse mono-colonization in vivo. NOP suppresses five core IBD-associated inflammatory pathways in mouse dendritic cells and human monocytes, reduces gene signatures of histologic inflammation and IBD therapy non-response, and ameliorates colitis in four murine models. NOP dampens NF-κB activation and iNOS expression in myeloid cells and suppresses type 1 immune responses through a T cell-intrinsic mechanism. The enrichment of NOP in IBD despite its anti-inflammatory activity supports a holobiont defense hypothesis: that the gut microbiota mounts a compensatory metabolic response to intestinal inflammation that may contribute to the restoration of organismal homeostasis.  In Brief

  Bae et al. identify N-acyl putrescines as gut microbiota-associated metabolites enriched in IBD and demonstrate that N-oleoylputrescine (NOP), produced by  Enterocloster species via NRPS biosynthetic machinery, broadly suppresses innate and adaptive inflammatory programs and ameliorates colitis in mice, supporting a holobiont defense hypothesis for microbiota-mediated immunomodulation.  Highlights

  N-acyl putrescines are microbiome-associated metabolites enriched in IBD feces across two independent human cohorts Enterocloster species harboring NRPS biosynthetic gene clusters produce NOP via oleic acid– putrescine conjugation  NOP suppresses NF-κB, iNOS, and IBD therapy non-response gene signatures in mouse and human myeloid cells NOP ameliorates colitis in four distinct murine models and suppresses type 1 immunity via a T cell-intrinsic mechanism
abstractZh:
肠道微生物群通过产生小分子代谢物深刻影响肠道免疫；然而，在炎症性肠病（IBD）中，微生物代谢组发生显著改变，大多数疾病相关代谢物的身份和免疫功能仍然未知。在此，我们整合了两个独立IBD患者队列的非靶向粪便代谢组学数据与无菌小鼠代谢组学数据，鉴定出N-酰基腐胺作为一类微生物相关代谢物，在克罗恩病（CD）和溃疡性结肠炎（UC）中均持续富集。其中，N-油酰腐胺（NOP）在骨髓来源树突状细胞（BMDCs）和结肠类器官中诱导强效且选择性的转录反应，确立其为此类代谢物中的主要免疫调节候选分子。携带非核糖体肽合成酶（NRPS）生物合成基因簇的肠梭菌属物种通过油酸与腐胺的结合产生NOP，这通过体外同位素示踪和体内无菌小鼠单菌定植得到证实。NOP在小鼠树突状细胞和人单核细胞中抑制五种核心IBD相关炎症通路，降低组织学炎症和IBD治疗无应答的基因特征，并在四种小鼠模型中改善结肠炎。NOP抑制髓系细胞中NF-κB活化和iNOS表达，并通过T细胞内在机制抑制1型免疫反应。尽管NOP具有抗炎活性，但它在IBD中富集支持全生物防御假说：肠道微生物群对肠道炎症产生代偿性代谢反应，这可能有助于恢复机体稳态。

  简报

  Bae等人将N-酰基腐胺鉴定为IBD中富集的肠道微生物相关代谢物，并证明由肠梭菌属物种通过NRPS生物合成机制产生的N-油酰腐胺（NOP）广泛抑制先天性和适应性炎症程序，并改善小鼠结肠炎，支持微生物介导免疫调节的全生物防御假说。

  亮点

  N-酰基腐胺是在两个独立人类队列中IBD粪便中富集的微生物相关代谢物 携带NRPS生物合成基因簇的肠梭菌属物种通过油酸-腐胺结合产生NOP NOP抑制小鼠和人髓系细胞中NF-κB、iNOS和IBD治疗无应答基因特征 NOP在四种不同小鼠模型中改善结肠炎，并通过T细胞内在机制抑制1型免疫

title: Modeling Risk Group 4 virus infection and antiviral treatment in microfluidic lung organ-on-chips in maximum containment laboratories
titleZh: 建模风险4组病毒感染及在最大防护实验室中微流体肺器官芯片上的抗病毒治疗
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Bhosle SM, Tran JP, Yu S, Geiger J, Das A, Anthony SM, Pahar B, Bernbaum-Cutler R, Rivera DFP, Crozier I, Wada J, Crane A, Palacios G, Kleinstreuer NC, Kuhn JH, Worwa G.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Development of candidate countermeasures against human pathogens frequently includes nonhuman animal experimentation. Preclinical animal pathogen exposure studies are conducted to model diseases and accumulate preliminary and hypothetically translatable data to inform and justify the design of clinical trial evaluation of countermeasure safety and efficacy. In addition to frequent ethical critiques, challenges associated with animal experimentation include considerable resources needed to achieve statistical power and robustness, replicability and reproducibility concerns, potentially compromised objectivity through lack of blinding, fundamental species-specific biological differences, and risk of unpredictable pathogen adaptation to the experimental animal. Recent U.S. and U.K. government initiatives aim to reduce animal experimentation by complementing or potentially replacing them with new approach methodologies (NAMs), i.e., increasingly sophisticated  in silico ,  in chemico , and  in vitro approaches. We piloted development of one type of NAM, organ-on-chips (OOCs), in the highly challenging environment of a maximum (biosafety level 4) containment laboratory. Using a Risk Group 4 virus, Nipah virus (NiV), and two types of lung OOCs seeded with human or porcine cells, we demonstrated the recapitulation of key features of NiV lung infection, including viral infection, replication, and translocation, that are associated with proinflammatory cytokine secretion, immune cell recruitment, and disruption of the air–liquid interface barrier. We reproduced the known anti-NiV activity of remdesivir and evaluated that of another potential antiviral, zotatifin. Our results pave the way for similar applications of advanced microphysiological systems for modeling infections caused by high-consequence viruses.
abstractZh:
摘要

  针对人类病原体的候选对策的开发通常包括非人类动物实验。临床前动物病原体暴露研究用于模拟疾病，并积累初步且假设可转化的数据，以告知并证明临床试验评估对策安全性和有效性的设计。除了经常受到伦理批评外，与动物实验相关的挑战还包括：实现统计功效和稳健性所需的大量资源、可重复性和再现性问题、因缺乏盲法而可能损害客观性、基本的物种特异性生物学差异，以及病原体对实验动物发生不可预测适应的风险。近期美国和英国政府倡议旨在通过补充或可能替代动物实验的新方法学（NAMs），即日益复杂的计算机模拟、化学和体外方法，来减少动物实验。我们在最高（生物安全4级）防护实验室这一极具挑战性的环境中，试点开发了一种NAMs——器官芯片（OOCs）。使用风险4组病毒——尼帕病毒（NiV）和两种用人或猪细胞接种的肺OOCs，我们证明了NiV肺部感染关键特征的再现，包括病毒感染、复制和转运，这些特征与促炎细胞因子分泌、免疫细胞募集以及气液界面屏障的破坏相关。我们重现了瑞德西韦已知的抗NiV活性，并评估了另一种潜在抗病毒药物zotatifin的活性。我们的结果为先进微生理系统在模拟高后果病毒引起感染方面的类似应用铺平了道路。

title: Decoding host-microbial dynamics in peri-implantitis: Ecosystem-specific experimental models.
titleZh: 解码种植体周围炎中的宿主-微生物动态：生态系统特异性实验模型。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Kotsakis GA, Araújo D, Wilensky A, Bastidas JG, Alimperti S, Pirih F.
affiliations: Department of Oral Biology and Clinical Research Center, Rutgers School of Dental Medicine, Newark, New Jersey, USA.
UCLA School of Dentistry, University of California, Los Angeles, California, USA.
Department of Periodontology, Hadassah Medical Center, Faculty of Dental Medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Jerusalem, Israel.
Department of Biochemistry and Molecular and Cellular Biology, Georgetown University, Washington, DC, USA.
abstract:
Background

Peri-implantitis is an inflammatory disease arising within a unique host-microbial-biomaterial ecosystem. Unlike periodontitis, peri-implant tissues lack a periodontal ligament and epithelial junction integrity and interface with metal oxides on titanium surfaces. The inflammatory changes in peri-implant disease not only affect the host but also extend to the implant surfaces, which undergo corrosion and particle release. These specific ecological features must be accurately captured in preclinical experimental models to provide mechanistic insight and enable translational success.Aim

This review evaluates preclinical and microengineered models of peri-implantitis, focusing on how well they recapitulate the peri-implant mucosal barrier, the biomaterial interface, and systemic modifiers. We propose minimum criteria for "true" peri-implantitis models and outline ecosystem-specific platforms for translational research.Materials and methods

A literature search for this narrative review was conducted in PubMed, prioritizing in vivo peri-implantitis models and their use in assessing systemic comorbidities (e.g., diabetes) and local risk factors on peri-implant disease. Furthermore, emerging implant-specific organ-on-a-chip systems for 3D peri-implant mucosa are reviewed.Results

Ligature- and infection-based rodent and large-animal models have elucidated key bacterial-driven inflammatory pathways around dental implants, but careful consideration is needed to ensure long-term chronicity and to account for titanium degradation as a costimulatory pathogenic factor. Comorbidity-integrated models demonstrate that diabetes, vascular disease, and antiresorptive therapy amplify peri-implant bone loss and can precipitate MRONJ-like lesions. Organ-on-a-chip peri-implant mucosa platforms now enable controlled bacterial and titanium exposure, biomechanical strain, and human-relevant barrier readouts, aligned with reduction principles and prioritizing Human-Centered models.Clinical relevance

Ecosystem-specific models that incorporate microrough titanium, inflammatory biomaterial corrosion, barrier biology, and systemic risk factors are essential to advance the study of peri-implantitis. Such models provide a strong foundation for implant-specific investigations that move peri-implantitis management beyond biofilm-centric debridement into the management of host-microbial-biomaterial equilibrium.
abstractZh:
背景

种植体周围炎是一种在独特的宿主-微生物-生物材料生态系统中发生的炎症性疾病。与牙周炎不同，种植体周围组织缺乏牙周膜和上皮结合部的完整性，并与钛表面的金属氧化物相互作用。种植体周围疾病的炎症变化不仅影响宿主，还延伸至种植体表面，导致腐蚀和颗粒释放。这些特定的生态特征必须在临床前实验模型中得到准确捕捉，以提供机制性见解并实现转化成功。目的

本综述评估了种植体周围炎的临床前和微工程模型，重点关注它们如何再现种植体周围黏膜屏障、生物材料界面和全身性调节因素。我们提出了“真正”种植体周围炎模型的最低标准，并概述了用于转化研究的生态系统特异性平台。材料与方法

本叙述性综述的文献检索在PubMed中进行，优先考虑体内种植体周围炎模型及其在评估全身性合并症（如糖尿病）和局部风险因素对种植体周围疾病影响中的应用。此外，还综述了新兴的种植体特异性器官芯片系统，用于3D种植体周围黏膜。结果

基于结扎和感染的啮齿动物及大型动物模型已阐明了牙种植体周围关键的细菌驱动炎症通路，但需要仔细考虑以确保长期慢性化，并考虑钛降解作为共刺激致病因素。合并症整合模型表明，糖尿病、血管疾病和抗吸收治疗会加剧种植体周围骨丢失，并可能诱发MRONJ样病变。器官芯片种植体周围黏膜平台现在能够实现受控的细菌和钛暴露、生物力学应变以及人类相关的屏障读数，符合减少（动物使用）原则，并优先考虑以人为中心的模型。临床相关性

纳入微粗糙钛、炎症性生物材料腐蚀、屏障生物学和全身性风险因素的生态系统特异性模型对于推进种植体周围炎研究至关重要。此类模型为种植体特异性研究提供了坚实基础，使种植体周围炎的管理超越以生物膜为中心的清创，进入宿主-微生物-生物材料平衡的管理。

title: Microbiome-mediated regulation of pathogen virulence: Molecular mechanisms and clinical implications.
titleZh: 微生物组介导的病原体毒力调控：分子机制与临床意义。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Alzahrani AJ.
affiliations: College of Medicine, Al-Imam Mohammed Ibn Saud Islamic University, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Laboratory Department, Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib Medical Group, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
abstract: The human microbiome profoundly influences pathogen virulence and disease susceptibility through diverse molecular mechanisms. This review, focused on literature from 2016 to 2026, synthesizes knowledge on microbiome-mediated regulation examining major pathogens including Vibrio cholerae, enterohemorrhagic Escherichia coli, Salmonella species, Clostridioides difficile, and Staphylococcus aureus. A triangular interaction model is presented, linking host immunity, resident microbiome, and invading pathogen to frame infection outcomes. Commensal bacteria regulate pathogen behavior through quorum sensing interference, metabolite-mediated regulation via short-chain fatty acids and bile acids, competitive exclusion, immune response modulation, and direct antimicrobial production. Key species-Lactobacillus spp. Bifidobacterium spp. Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron, and Faecalibacterium prausnitzii-employ distinct molecular strategies against these pathogens. Organ-on-chip platforms and multi-omics advances reveal context-dependent interactions. Clinical applications including rationally designed probiotics, fecal microbiota transplantation, and precision microbiome engineering show promise despite challenges of inter-individual microbiome variability, representing a paradigm shift toward ecosystem-based infectious disease management.
abstractZh: 人类微生物组通过多种分子机制深刻影响病原体毒力和疾病易感性。本综述聚焦2016年至2026年的文献，综合了关于微生物组介导调控的知识，考察了包括霍乱弧菌、肠出血性大肠杆菌、沙门氏菌属、艰难梭菌和金黄色葡萄球菌在内的主要病原体。提出了一个三角相互作用模型，将宿主免疫、常驻微生物组和入侵病原体联系起来，以构建感染结局的框架。共生细菌通过群体感应干扰、通过短链脂肪酸和胆汁酸介导的代谢物调控、竞争性排斥、免疫应答调节以及直接抗菌物质产生来调控病原体行为。关键物种——乳杆菌属、双歧杆菌属、多形拟杆菌和普拉梭菌——针对这些病原体采用独特的分子策略。器官芯片平台和多组学进展揭示了环境依赖的相互作用。临床应用，包括合理设计的益生菌、粪菌移植和精准微生物组工程，尽管面临个体间微生物组变异性的挑战，仍显示出前景，代表着向基于生态系统的传染病管理模式的范式转变。

title: Considerations for selecting immunodeficient mouse strains for cancer xenograft models.
titleZh: 选择用于癌症异种移植模型的免疫缺陷小鼠品系的考虑因素
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Lee J, Jung J.
affiliations: College of Pharmacy, Duksung Women's University, Seoul, Republic of Korea.
College of Pharmacy, Duksung Women's University, Seoul, Republic of Korea. joohee@duksung.ac.kr.
abstract: Preclinical (in vivo) experiments for efficacy and toxicity are predominantly conducted in mice. Nevertheless, human-derived cells, tissues, and organoids are generally rejected by the immune system of mice. Thus, immunodeficient mice are used as xenograft models to overcome immune rejection in cancer research. Xenograft mouse models are divided into ectopic, orthotopic, and metastatic models based on the transplant sites. Xenograft mouse models are established by transplanting cancer cells, tissues, or organoids derived from patients. These models show diverse success rates and production times depending on the transplant materials and recipient mice. In this review, mouse strains for the establishment of xenograft models in cancer research are introduced. Genetic engineering of immune cells, such as T cells, B cells, and natural killer cells, shows specific properties. To select an immunodeficient mouse strain, the differences in the characteristics of the models must be understood. Optimized mouse models can provide information to investigate cancer progression and evaluate anticancer drugs.
abstractZh: 临床前（体内）实验主要用于评估疗效和毒性，且大多在小鼠中进行。然而，人源细胞、组织和类器官通常会被小鼠的免疫系统排斥。因此，在癌症研究中，使用免疫缺陷小鼠作为异种移植模型以克服免疫排斥。异种移植小鼠模型根据移植部位分为异位、原位和转移模型。异种移植小鼠模型通过移植来自患者的癌细胞、组织或类器官建立。这些模型的成功率和生产时间因移植材料和受体小鼠的不同而各异。本综述介绍了用于建立癌症研究异种移植模型的小鼠品系。对免疫细胞（如T细胞、B细胞和自然杀伤细胞）的基因工程改造显示出特定特性。为选择免疫缺陷小鼠品系，必须了解模型间特性的差异。优化的小鼠模型可为研究癌症进展和评估抗癌药物提供信息。

abstract: Intrauterine adhesions (IUA), a leading cause of uterine infertility, are characterized by endometrial fibrosis and a loss of functional regeneration. The impairment of endometrial mesenchymal stem/stromal cells (eMSCs) is central to IUA pathogenesis; however, the absence of reliable markers correlating with disease severity and fibrosis has hindered the understanding of their pathological mechanisms and the development of targeted therapies. Here, ALDH1A1 and ALDH1A2 were identified as novel eMSC markers significantly downregulated in IUA patient samples and scar tissue. ALDHHigh eMSCs exhibited superior self-renewal capability, proliferative capacity, decidualization potential, and angiogenic capability, alongside reduced fibrotic characteristics compared to ALDHLow eMSCs. Transplantation of ALDHHigh eMSCs promoted endometrial regeneration in a murine IUA model. Mechanistically, ALDHHigh eMSCs secreted higher levels of ATRA (all-trans retinoic acid), and their pro-regenerative effect was mediated through the ALDH-RA-RAR (RA Receptor) axis. ATRA and E2 (Estradiol) acted synergistically to promote glandular organoid growth and reprogram ALDHLow eMSCs towards a regenerative phenotype. The RE-Exo@HA hydrogel, composed of ATRA and E2 encapsulated in exosomes embedded within a hyaluronic acid hydrogel, effectively facilitated scarless endometrial repair, demonstrated by restored endometrial architecture, increased gland number, reduced fibrosis, and significantly improved pregnancy outcomes in vivo. Our findings establish ALDH1A1/ALDH1A2 as key functional markers of a regenerative eMSC subpopulation depleted in IUA and highlight the ALDH-RA axis as a critical mechanism governing endometrial repair.
abstractZh: 宫腔粘连（IUA）是子宫性不孕的主要原因，其特征为子宫内膜纤维化和功能性再生丧失。子宫内膜间充质干细胞/基质细胞（eMSCs）的功能损伤是IUA发病的核心；然而，缺乏与疾病严重程度和纤维化相关的可靠标志物阻碍了对其病理机制的理解和靶向治疗的发展。在此，ALDH1A1和ALDH1A2被鉴定为新型eMSC标志物，在IUA患者样本和瘢痕组织中显著下调。与ALDHLow eMSCs相比，ALDHHigh eMSCs表现出更优的自我更新能力、增殖能力、蜕膜化潜力和血管生成能力，同时纤维化特征减少。在鼠IUA模型中，移植ALDHHigh eMSCs促进了子宫内膜再生。机制上，ALDHHigh eMSCs分泌更高水平的ATRA（全反式维甲酸），其促再生作用通过ALDH-RA-RAR（维甲酸受体）轴介导。ATRA和E2（雌二醇）协同作用促进腺体类器官生长，并将ALDHLow eMSCs重编程为再生表型。由ATRA和E2包封在嵌入透明质酸水凝胶的外泌体中组成的RE-Exo@HA水凝胶，有效促进无瘢痕子宫内膜修复，表现为子宫内膜结构恢复、腺体数量增加、纤维化减少，并在体内显著改善妊娠结局。我们的发现确立了ALDH1A1/ALDH1A2作为IUA中耗竭的再生eMSC亚群的关键功能标志物，并强调ALDH-RA轴是调控子宫内膜修复的关键机制。

abstract: Phytolacca acinosa Roxb. (PR) is a saponin-rich medicinal plant associated with gastrointestinal toxicity, but the mechanisms underlying PR-induced intestinal barrier injury remain unclear. In this study, raw PR extract was analytically characterized by UPLC-ZenoTOF-MS/MS, confirming triterpenoid saponins as the predominant constituents. C57BL/6 J mice were orally exposed to characterized PR extract (1.20 or 12.0 g/kg for 5 h), and Caco-2 cells and mouse intestinal organoids were used to assess epithelial toxicity and barrier disruption. Histopathology, ELISA, FITC-dextran permeability assays, immunofluorescence, CCK-8, LDH release, western blotting, DIA-based proteomics and untargeted metabolomics were integrated to define toxicological mechanisms. PR induced dose-dependent intestinal inflammation and barrier dysfunction, with the ileum as the most sensitive target. PR increased serum DAO and D-lactate and intestinal TNF-α and IL-1β, disrupted organoid morphology, enhanced epithelial permeability, and reduced ZO-1 expression. Proteomics revealed changes in inflammatory, lipid-metabolic, cytoskeletal and tight-junction pathways, including upregulation of MLCK3 and phospholipase-related proteins and downregulation of ZO-1 and ZO-2. Metabolomics identified histidine metabolism disturbance and histamine accumulation. Integrated multi-omics and pharmacological validation indicated that histamine activated the PLC/IP₃/Ca²⁺/CaM/MLCK cascade, promoting MLC phosphorylation, tight-junction disassembly and epithelial leakiness. MLCK inhibition partially restored ZO-1/ZO-2 expression and attenuated PR-induced epithelial injury. These findings identify the histamine-MLCK-tight junction axis as a key mechanism of PR-induced intestinal toxicity and support hazard identification of saponin-rich PR exposure.
abstractZh: 商陆（Phytolacca acinosa Roxb.，PR）是一种富含皂苷的药用植物，与胃肠道毒性相关，但PR诱导肠道屏障损伤的机制仍不清楚。本研究通过UPLC-ZenoTOF-MS/MS对生PR提取物进行分析表征，确认三萜皂苷为其主要成分。C57BL/6J小鼠口服暴露于表征的PR提取物（1.20或12.0 g/kg，持续5小时），并使用Caco-2细胞和小鼠肠道类器官评估上皮毒性和屏障破坏。整合组织病理学、ELISA、FITC-葡聚糖通透性测定、免疫荧光、CCK-8、LDH释放、蛋白质印迹、基于DIA的蛋白质组学和非靶向代谢组学来定义毒理学机制。PR诱导剂量依赖性的肠道炎症和屏障功能障碍，其中回肠是最敏感靶点。PR增加血清DAO和D-乳酸以及肠道TNF-α和IL-1β，破坏类器官形态，增强上皮通透性，并降低ZO-1表达。蛋白质组学揭示炎症、脂质代谢、细胞骨架和紧密连接通路的变化，包括MLCK3和磷脂酶相关蛋白的上调以及ZO-1和ZO-2的下调。代谢组学鉴定出组氨酸代谢紊乱和组胺积累。综合多组学和药理学验证表明，组胺激活PLC/IP₃/Ca²⁺/CaM/MLCK级联反应，促进MLC磷酸化、紧密连接解组装和上皮渗漏。MLCK抑制部分恢复ZO-1/ZO-2表达并减轻PR诱导的上皮损伤。这些发现确定组胺-MLCK-紧密连接轴是PR诱导肠道毒性的关键机制，并支持对富含皂苷的PR暴露进行危害识别。

title: In vitro cell-line models of Alzheimer's disease: A systematic review and mechanism-based evidence map of induction paradigms, targeted mechanisms, and validation requirements.
titleZh: 阿尔茨海默病的体外细胞系模型：诱导范式、靶向机制和验证要求的系统综述及基于机制的证据图谱。

abstract:
Background

In vitro cell-line models are essential for investigating the complex, interconnected mechanisms of Alzheimer's disease (AD). While offering high tractability for mechanism-focused screening, their translational utility depends on the precise alignment of the biological inquiry with the appropriate cellular system, induction strategy, and experimental readouts.Methods

This systematic review and mechanism-based evidence map searched PubMed (inception to 1 May 2026), capturing 93 original experimental studies across neuronal, glial, endothelial, and higher-fidelity multicellular systems. Extracted data were structured by cellular model, induction paradigm, targeted mechanism, and interpretive scope.Results

The synthesized evidence indicates that AD-relevant in vitro systems are not interchangeable whole-disease models, but mechanism-based tools. SH-SY5Y cells are primarily suited for Aβ-associated neuronal toxicity and general screening. Neuro-2a (N2a) systems are optimized for evaluating APP processing and amyloidogenesis. HT-22 cells specifically model oxidative glutamate toxicity and ferroptosis-related injury, while PC12 cells are strictly reserved for NGF-dependent neurite biology and neuroprotection.Conclusions

While classical cell lines remain essential for initial mechanistic screening, establishing disease-level relevance requires validation through orthogonal readouts and high-fidelity human models, such as multicellular organoids or blood-brain barrier systems.
abstractZh:
背景

体外细胞系模型对于研究阿尔茨海默病（AD）复杂且相互关联的机制至关重要。尽管这些模型为以机制为中心的筛选提供了高度的可操作性，但其转化效用取决于生物学探究与适当的细胞系统、诱导策略和实验读数的精确匹配。方法

本系统综述和基于机制的证据图谱检索了PubMed（从建库至2026年5月1日），涵盖了93项涉及神经元、胶质细胞、内皮细胞和更高保真度的多细胞系统的原始实验研究。提取的数据按细胞模型、诱导范式、靶向机制和解释范围进行结构化整理。结果

综合证据表明，AD相关的体外系统并非可互换的全疾病模型，而是基于机制的工具。SH-SY5Y细胞主要适用于Aβ相关的神经元毒性和一般筛选。Neuro-2a（N2a）系统则优化用于评估APP加工和淀粉样蛋白生成。HT-22细胞专门模拟氧化性谷氨酸毒性和铁死亡相关损伤，而PC12细胞严格保留用于NGF依赖性神经突生物学和神经保护研究。结论

虽然经典细胞系在初始机制筛选中仍然必不可少，但确立疾病水平的关联性需要通过正交读数和更高保真度的人类模型（如多细胞类器官或血脑屏障系统）进行验证。

title: Looping patchworks and imaginations in a concept: Building the patchwork of "organoid" in contemporary biotechnology.
titleZh: 概念中的循环拼合与想象：构建当代生物技术中“类器官”的拼合。
journal: Studies in history and philosophy of science
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Altinok OA.
affiliations: Prince Mohammad bin Fahd University, College of Sciences and Human Studies, Humanities & Social Sciences, Center for Futuristic Studies, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia; University of Johannesburg, The African Centre for Epistemology and Philosophy of Science, South Africa; University of Freiburg, Institute for Advanced Studies, Young Academy for Cultures and Societies Research, Freiburg, Germany. Electronic address: oaltinok@uj.ac.za.
abstract: Organoids have become a central but contested notion across developmental biology, stem cell research, tissue engineering and regenerative medicine. I argue that the term organoid functions not as a single, well-defined scientific kind but as a special kind of patchwork concept that I call looping patchwork concept: a coordination device whose stability depends on overlapping inferential patches distributed across material practices, ethical deliberations, and promissory imaginaries. Drawing on Hacking's looping kinds, Jasanoff's co-production framework, and recent philosophical work on patchwork concepts; I show how the same label anchors different research agendas while enabling interdisciplinary collaboration and governance. I illustrate this analysis with brief comparisons of the U.S. Multicellular Engineered Living Systems (MCELS) initiative and the Germany based REBIRTH (REgenerative BIology to Reconstructive Therapy) excellence cluster, showing how divergent emphases on engineering, therapy, and regulation produce different weightings of the concept's registers. Conceptualizing organoids as looping patchwork concepts with ethical and social relevance reframes definitional instability as an epistemic resource: conceptual flexibility facilitates coordination, legitimation, and the co-constitution of objects in the making. This way I propose the usage of a multilayer approach in concepts that are building entities of biotechnology.
abstractZh: 类器官已成为发育生物学、干细胞研究、组织工程和再生医学中一个核心但备受争议的概念。我认为，“类器官”这一术语并非作为一个单一、定义明确的科学种类，而是一种特殊的拼合概念，我称之为循环拼合概念：一种协调装置，其稳定性依赖于分布在物质实践、伦理考量和承诺性想象中的重叠推理拼合。借鉴哈金（Hacking）的循环种类、贾萨诺夫（Jasanoff）的共同生产框架以及近期关于拼合概念的哲学研究，我展示了同一标签如何锚定不同的研究议程，同时促进跨学科合作与治理。我通过简要比较美国多细胞工程生命系统（MCELS）倡议和德国REBIRTH（从再生生物学到重建治疗）卓越集群来说明这一分析，展示工程、治疗和监管方面的不同侧重如何产生该概念不同层面的权重。将类器官概念化为具有伦理和社会相关性的循环拼合概念，将定义上的不稳定性重新定义为一种认知资源：概念灵活性促进了协调、合法化以及正在形成中的对象的共同建构。通过这种方式，我提议在构建生物技术实体的概念中采用多层方法。

abstract: Immunoreceptors experience forces that modulate their activities; however, demonstrating this in vivo has been limited by technical challenges. As a first step toward meeting this challenge, we adapted a synthetic Notch (SynNotch) receptor system to report force transmission through immunoreceptors in vivo by replacing the native ligand-binding domain with a receptor-specific antibody and rewiring Notch signaling to drive enhanced green fluorescent protein or luciferase expression. We expressed SynNotch on Jurkat cells targeting CD40 or T cell receptor (TCR) and characterized their activation in coculture with B or T cells, defining the requirements, optimal conditions, and kinetics of activation. Using complementary mechanobiology approaches, we quantified the exogenous force required for reporter activation and verified that activation depends on forces generated by receptor-expressing sender cells rather than SynNotch-expressing receiver cells. By implanting sensors and targets into immunocompromised mice, we visualized mechanically activated reporter expression on CD40 and TCR-targeting SynNotch cells in vivo. Furthermore, CD40 and TCR signaling was amplified when the receptor bore force against mechanical support from immobilized ligand, indicating that force functions as a biologically relevant co-stimulus. Together, our results establish mechanically activated SynNotch reporters as a useful strategy for detecting receptor-associated mechanical signaling across two-dimensional coculture, three-dimensional organoid, and in vivo systems.
abstractZh: 免疫受体会承受调节其活性的力；然而，由于技术挑战，在体内证明这一点一直受到限制。作为应对这一挑战的第一步，我们改造了合成Notch（SynNotch）受体系统，通过用受体特异性抗体替换天然配体结合域，并重新连接Notch信号以驱动增强型绿色荧光蛋白或荧光素酶表达，从而在体内报告通过免疫受体的力传递。我们在靶向CD40或T细胞受体（TCR）的Jurkat细胞上表达SynNotch，并表征了它们与B或T细胞共培养时的激活，定义了激活的要求、最佳条件和动力学。利用互补的机械生物学方法，我们量化了报告基因激活所需的外力，并验证了激活依赖于表达受体的发送细胞产生的力，而非表达SynNotch的接收细胞。通过将传感器和靶标植入免疫缺陷小鼠，我们在体内可视化了CD40和TCR靶向SynNotch细胞上机械激活的报告基因表达。此外，当受体承受来自固定化配体的机械支持力时，CD40和TCR信号被放大，表明力作为生物学相关的共刺激发挥作用。总之，我们的结果确立了机械激活的SynNotch报告基因作为一种有用的策略，用于检测二维共培养、三维类器官和体内系统中受体相关的机械信号传导。

title: DLG4 Mutations Disrupt Human Cortical Development and Synaptic Programs in Patient- Derived Brain Organoids
titleZh: DLG4突变破坏患者来源脑类器官中的人类皮层发育和突触程序
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: V.C LB, Moreira NCS, Sanchez S, Dias ÂRM, Petroski LP, Turaca T, Gaudio LPM, Thiyagarajan NG, Almeida SS, Blanch R, Fischer JSdG, Tsu BL, Carvalho PC, Martins AM, Muotri AR.
abstract: Abstract    DLG4-related synaptopathy is a rare neurodevelopmental disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the Discs Large MAGUK Scaffold Protein 4  (DLG4)  gene, which encodes postsynaptic density protein 95 (PSD-95). Although  DLG4  variants have been associated with a broad spectrum of neurodevelopmental phenotypes, the molecular mechanisms by which distinct mutation classes disrupt human cortical development and their responsiveness to gene replacement therapy remain poorly understood. Here, we used patient-derived cortical organoids to define the mutation-specific effects of  DLG4  variants on human cortical development and evaluate the therapeutic potential of adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated gene replacement. Loss-of-function variants disrupted not only synaptic organization but also broader developmental programs governing neuronal differentiation and cortical identity, converging on transcriptional signatures associated with impaired excitatory neuronal maturation and increased interneuron developmental pathways. In contrast, a splice-site mutation produced a distinct gain-of-function molecular phenotype through constitutive inclusion of a proline-, glutamate-, serine-, and threonine-rich (PEST) domain-containing PSD-95 isoform predicted to alter protein turnover. AAV-mediated restoration of  DLG4  expression rescued PSD-95 abundance and downstream neuronal and synaptic molecular signatures in loss-of-function organoids. Together, these findings demonstrate that distinct classes of  DLG4  mutations drive divergent neurodevelopmental mechanisms and support AAV-mediated gene replacement as a promising therapeutic strategy for loss-of-function DLG4-related synaptopathy.
abstractZh: 摘要 DLG4相关突触病是一种罕见的神经发育障碍，由Discs Large MAGUK支架蛋白4（DLG4）基因的致病性变异引起，该基因编码突触后密度蛋白95（PSD-95）。尽管DLG4变异与广泛的神经发育表型相关，但不同突变类别破坏人类皮层发育的分子机制及其对基因替代疗法的反应仍知之甚少。在此，我们使用患者来源的皮层类器官来定义DLG4变异对人类皮层发育的突变特异性效应，并评估腺相关病毒（AAV）介导的基因替代的治疗潜力。功能丧失型变异不仅破坏了突触组织，还破坏了控制神经元分化和皮层身份的更广泛的发育程序，汇聚到与兴奋性神经元成熟受损和中间神经元发育通路增加相关的转录特征上。相比之下，一个剪接位点突变通过组成性包含一个富含脯氨酸、谷氨酸、丝氨酸和苏氨酸（PEST）结构域的PSD-95异构体，产生了独特的功能获得型分子表型，该异构体预计会改变蛋白质周转。AAV介导的DLG4表达恢复在功能丧失型类器官中挽救了PSD-95丰度以及下游神经元和突触分子特征。总之，这些发现表明不同类别的DLG4突变驱动不同的神经发育机制，并支持AAV介导的基因替代作为功能丧失型DLG4相关突触病的一种有前景的治疗策略。

abstract:
Background

Salivary gland fine-needle aspirates (FNAs) with low-grade oncocytic features are diagnostically challenging due to the substantial morphologic overlap between benign oncocytic tumors and their malignant mimickers. This study evaluates the diagnostic discriminators, performance, and risk of malignancy of these lesions using the Milan System for Reporting Salivary Gland Cytopathology (MSRSGC).Methods

We retrospectively reviewed salivary gland FNA cases (2021-2025) categorized as Milan IVa: Benign neoplasm with oncocytic features, including Warthin tumor and oncocytoma/nodular oncocytic hyperplasia (NOH), and Milan IVb: Salivary gland neoplasm of uncertain malignant potential (SUMP) with oncocytic features, with surgical follow-up. Cytomorphological analysis was performed on liquid-based cytology (LBC), direct smears, and cell blocks. Features including architectural patterns, cytological details, and background were correlated with histology.Results

Forty-nine cases were included. All 43 cases diagnosed as Milan IVa were confirmed as Warthin tumor or oncocytoma/nodular oncocytic hyperplasia. Warthin tumor shows cohesive, flat clusters of oncocytes along with a cystic debris-like background, while oncocytoma/NOH shows compact globoid clusters of oncocytes with a "bunch of grapes" pattern and clean background. In the six Milan IVb cases, follow-up histology included oncocytic mucoepidermoid carcinoma (OMEC, n = 2), oncocytoma/nodular oncocytic hyperplasia (n = 2), oncocytic lipoadenoma (n = 1), and spindle cell lipoma (n = 1). The OMEC cases form discohesive clusters and single cells. Cell block preparations revealed focal glandular structures and rare intracytoplasmic mucin.Conclusion

The MSRSGC effectively risk-stratifies low-grade oncocytic salivary gland lesions. While cohesive, organoid architecture supports a benign diagnosis, the presence of isolated cells and discohesive clusters is better classified as SUMP. Cell block preparation is useful for identifying mucin and glandular differentiation.
abstractZh:
背景

具有低级别嗜酸细胞特征的涎腺细针穿刺（FNA）在诊断上具有挑战性，因为良性嗜酸细胞肿瘤与其恶性模拟物之间存在显著的形态学重叠。本研究使用米兰涎腺细胞病理学报告系统（MSRSGC）评估这些病变的诊断鉴别指标、性能及恶性风险。方法

我们回顾性审查了2021年至2025年间分类为米兰IVa：良性肿瘤伴嗜酸细胞特征（包括Warthin瘤和嗜酸细胞瘤/结节性嗜酸细胞增生（NOH））以及米兰IVb：涎腺肿瘤恶性潜能不确定（SUMP）伴嗜酸细胞特征且有手术随访的涎腺FNA病例。对液基细胞学（LBC）、直接涂片和细胞块进行了细胞形态学分析。包括结构模式、细胞学细节和背景在内的特征与组织学结果进行了相关性分析。结果

共纳入49例。所有43例诊断为米兰IVa的病例均被确认为Warthin瘤或嗜酸细胞瘤/结节性嗜酸细胞增生。Warthin瘤显示嗜酸细胞呈黏附性、扁平簇状排列，伴有囊性碎屑样背景，而嗜酸细胞瘤/NOH显示嗜酸细胞呈致密球状簇，呈“葡萄串”模式，背景干净。在6例米兰IVb病例中，随访组织学包括嗜酸细胞性黏液表皮样癌（OMEC，n=2）、嗜酸细胞瘤/结节性嗜酸细胞增生（n=2）、嗜酸细胞性脂肪腺瘤（n=1）和梭形细胞脂肪瘤（n=1）。OMEC病例形成松散黏附的细胞簇和单个细胞。细胞块制备显示局灶性腺样结构和罕见的胞浆内黏液。结论

MSRSGC能有效对低级别嗜酸细胞性涎腺病变进行风险分层。虽然黏附性、器官样结构支持良性诊断，但存在孤立细胞和松散黏附的细胞簇时，应更好地归类为SUMP。细胞块制备有助于识别黏液和腺样分化。

abstract: Canine chronic enteropathy (CE) is characterized by persistent mucosal inflammation and impaired barrier function. Despite its high clinical prevalence, research has been hindered by a lack of host-specific intestinal models. Here, we present an optimized canine-derived colon organoid (cCO) culture platform designed for assessing drug toxicity and regenerative potential. Combining Wnt/EGF activation with TGF-β/p38 MAPK inhibition supported the long-term maintenance of stem cell-enriched organoids. Upon maturation, differentiated cCOs exhibited both absorptive and secretory cells, validated by lineage-specific marker expression and functional P-glycoprotein efflux activity. While pro-inflammatory cytokines exerted non-specific toxicity, diclofenac-induced injury was significantly more pronounced in differentiated organoids than in expanding counterparts. This indicates that our platform effectively recapitulates the cell type-specific sensitivity of the intestinal epithelium to pharmacological insults. Next, to determine whether the cCOs could model epithelial repair process, we examined the therapeutic effects of canine mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), a representative cell-based therapy for CE, on damaged organoids. Notably, treatment with MSC-conditioned media (MSC-CM) triggered a morphological transition into cystic spheroids with the upregulation of pro-regenerative stem cell markers, suggesting the induction of a fetal-like regenerative reprogramming. Indeed, MSC-CM treatment restored growth and proliferation while preserving barrier integrity in diclofenac-treated organoids. Collectively, these findings demonstrate the advantages of cCO system for modeling intestinal injury and repair, supporting the development of targeted therapeutic strategies for canine gastrointestinal disorders.
abstractZh: 犬慢性肠病（CE）以持续性黏膜炎症和屏障功能受损为特征。尽管其临床发病率高，但研究一直因缺乏宿主特异性肠道模型而受阻。在此，我们提出了一种优化的犬源性结肠类器官（cCO）培养平台，旨在评估药物毒性和再生潜力。结合Wnt/EGF激活与TGF-β/p38 MAPK抑制，支持了富含干细胞的类器官的长期维持。成熟后，分化的cCO表现出吸收细胞和分泌细胞，通过谱系特异性标志物表达和功能性P-糖蛋白外排活性得到验证。虽然促炎细胞因子产生非特异性毒性，但双氯芬酸诱导的损伤在分化类器官中显著比扩增类器官更明显。这表明我们的平台有效重现了肠道上皮对药理学损伤的细胞类型特异性敏感性。接下来，为了确定cCO是否能模拟上皮修复过程，我们检查了犬间充质干细胞（MSCs）——一种代表性的CE细胞疗法——对受损类器官的治疗效果。值得注意的是，用MSC条件培养基（MSC-CM）处理触发了向囊性球体的形态转变，并上调了促再生的干细胞标志物，提示诱导了胎儿样再生重编程。确实，MSC-CM处理恢复了生长和增殖，同时保持了双氯芬酸处理类器官的屏障完整性。总之，这些发现证明了cCO系统在模拟肠道损伤和修复方面的优势，支持了针对犬胃肠道疾病的靶向治疗策略的开发。

abstract:
Background

Cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are key components of the tumor microenvironment and can influence tumor progression and therapeutic response. However, whether functional heterogeneity of CAFs contributes to 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) resistance in gastric cancer remains unclear.Methods

Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) and matched CAFs were established from gastric cancer specimens and cocultured using a Transwell noncontact system. The effects of CAFs on PDO growth and chemotherapy response were evaluated. Candidate secreted factors were analyzed by qRT-PCR and ELISA. Gain- and loss-of-function experiments, together with transcriptomic and protein analyses, were performed to investigate the underlying mechanisms. A CAF-containing xenograft model was established to evaluate the therapeutic effects of VEGFA blockade combined with 5-FU treatment in vivo.Results

CAFs derived from different patients exhibited marked functional heterogeneity in regulating PDO growth and chemotherapy response. A VEGFA-associated functional CAF state significantly promoted PDO proliferation and enhanced resistance to 5-FU. Vascular endothelial growth factor A (VEGFA) was identified as a key secreted factor that was significantly upregulated in these growth-promoting CAFs. Exogenous VEGFA recapitulated the pro-growth and anti-apoptotic effects observed, whereas VEGFA blockade attenuated CAF-mediated chemoprotective effects and enhanced PDO sensitivity to 5-FU. In vivo, bevacizumab improved the response of CAF-containing tumors to 5-FU treatment, supporting the therapeutic relevance of targeting CAF-derived VEGFA. These effects were driven by the activation of the PI3K/AKT-mTOR survival pathway in PDOs.Conclusion

A VEGFA-associated functional CAF state promotes gastric cancer organoid growth and chemoresistance through paracrine signaling, highlighting the CAF-VEGFA axis as a potential therapeutic target.
abstractZh:
背景

癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）是肿瘤微环境的关键组成部分，可影响肿瘤进展和治疗反应。然而，CAFs的功能异质性是否导致胃癌中5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU）耐药仍不清楚。方法

从胃癌标本中建立患者来源的类器官（PDOs）和匹配的CAFs，并使用Transwell非接触系统共培养。评估CAFs对PDO生长和化疗反应的影响。通过qRT-PCR和ELISA分析候选分泌因子。进行功能获得和缺失实验，结合转录组和蛋白质分析，以研究潜在机制。建立含CAF的异种移植模型，以评估VEGFA阻断联合5-FU治疗在体内的治疗效果。结果

来自不同患者的CAFs在调节PDO生长和化疗反应方面表现出显著的功能异质性。一种与VEGFA相关的功能性CAF状态显著促进PDO增殖并增强对5-FU的耐药性。血管内皮生长因子A（VEGFA）被确定为在这些促进生长的CAFs中显著上调的关键分泌因子。外源性VEGFA重现了观察到的促生长和抗凋亡效应，而VEGFA阻断减弱了CAF介导的化学保护作用，并增强了PDO对5-FU的敏感性。在体内，贝伐珠单抗改善了含CAF肿瘤对5-FU治疗的反应，支持靶向CAF来源的VEGFA的治疗相关性。这些效应由PDO中PI3K/AKT-mTOR生存通路的激活驱动。结论

一种与VEGFA相关的功能性CAF状态通过旁分泌信号促进胃癌类器官生长和化疗耐药，突出CAF-VEGFA轴作为潜在的治疗靶点。
