abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) cell culture can leverage the precise arrangement of materials, known as patterning, to generate physiologically relevant tissue-like structures. Hydrogels are widely used in 3D cell culture due to their ability to mimic the properties of biological extracellular matrix networks. In this tutorial review, we discuss the use of microfluidic systems to control fluid movement and placement within fabricated microchannels to pattern hydrogel precursors in 3D through the use of capillary flow. Such systems offer unique advantages in their ability to create complex biomimetic structures, organs-on-a-chip, and microphysiological systems with high spatial resolution and relatively small volumes of hydrogel material. We first discuss the fundamental principles behind capillary pinning and aspiration-mediated patterning. We then review literature describing the development and applications of three different types of microfluidic systems - closed, semi-open, and open - and describe how different patterning techniques are applied to each system. We also discuss modular microfluidic systems, in which multiple classes of microfluidic systems are combined together for complex and biomimetic modeling of biological systems. In each section, we provide synthesis and critical analysis of established and novel techniques to draw connections across diverse papers in literature. Finally, we offer our perspectives on the advantages of microfluidic systems for hydrogel patterning and the future of the field. Taken together, microfluidic flow-based patterning is an exciting tool for microphysiological systems and other 3D cell culture models that are poised to transform our understanding of basic biological mechanisms and provide new opportunities for studying diverse phenomena in physiologically relevant tissue models.
abstractZh: 三维（3D）细胞培养可以利用材料的精确排列，即图案化，来生成具有生理相关性的组织样结构。水凝胶因其能够模拟生物细胞外基质网络的特性而被广泛应用于3D细胞培养。在本教程综述中，我们讨论了利用微流控系统控制制造微通道内流体的运动和位置，通过毛细流动在3D中图案化水凝胶前体。这类系统在创建复杂仿生结构、器官芯片和微生理系统方面具有独特优势，具有高空间分辨率和相对较小的水凝胶材料体积。我们首先讨论毛细管钉扎和抽吸介导图案化的基本原理。然后，我们回顾了描述三种不同类型的微流控系统——封闭式、半开放式和开放式——的发展和应用的文献，并描述了不同的图案化技术如何应用于每种系统。我们还讨论了模块化微流控系统，其中多种类别的微流控系统组合在一起，用于生物系统的复杂和仿生建模。在每个部分，我们提供对既有和新颖技术的综合和批判性分析，以在文献中的不同论文之间建立联系。最后，我们提出了关于微流控系统在水凝胶图案化中的优势以及该领域未来的观点。总之，基于微流控流动的图案化是微生理系统和其他3D细胞培养模型的一个令人兴奋的工具，这些模型有望改变我们对基本生物学机制的理解，并为在生理相关的组织模型中研究各种现象提供新的机会。

abstract: Organ-on-chip (OoC) platforms are increasingly used to replicate structural, functional and molecular features of native tissue within controlled microenvironments. While most current brain-on-chip (BoC) systems rely on 2D cultures or 3D stem cell-derived constructs, the integration of intact brain tissue slices-particularly organotypic explants of the central nervous system-offers distinct advantages by preserving native cytoarchitecture, synaptic connectivity, and regional specificity. This systematic review aimed to identify and critically assess OoC platforms that incorporate ex vivo brain tissue slices maintained under dynamic perfusion for extended periods (≥10 days in vitro). A structured PubMed search conducted in accordance with the preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses (PRISMA) guidelines identified 2796 records, of which 7 studies met the predefined inclusion criteria. All included studies employed organotypic brain slices derived from early postnatal rodents and integrated them into perfused microfluidic systems. Most platforms combined air-liquid interface culture with low-volume perfusion to support prolonged tissue viability and partial functional maintenance, including electrophysiological activity, preserved structural integrity, and molecular homeostasis. Notably, none of the identified studies reported the successful long-term cultivation of adult rodent or human brain tissue in a comparable perfused OoC configuration, underscoring a major limitation of current approaches. Moreover, assessment of tissue viability and function was heterogeneous and frequently relied on descriptive or insufficiently sensitive readouts, limiting cross-platform comparisons and translational relevance. Future development of BoC technologies should prioritize improved microenvironmental control, the integration of suitable biomaterials, and embedded monitoring strategies capable of assessing metabolic state and circuit-level function. Addressing these challenges will be essential for advancing OoC platforms towards physiologically meaningful and translationally relevant applications in neuroscience.
abstractZh: 器官芯片（OoC）平台越来越多地用于在受控微环境中复制天然组织的结构、功能和分子特征。虽然目前大多数脑芯片（BoC）系统依赖于二维培养或三维干细胞衍生物，但整合完整的脑组织切片——特别是中枢神经系统的器官型外植体——通过保留天然细胞结构、突触连接和区域特异性，提供了独特的优势。本系统评价旨在识别并批判性评估在动态灌注下维持离体脑组织切片长时间（≥10天体外）的OoC平台。根据系统评价和荟萃分析首选报告项目（PRISMA）指南进行的结构化PubMed检索识别出2796条记录，其中7项研究符合预定的纳入标准。所有纳入的研究均采用源自早期产后啮齿动物的器官型脑切片，并将其整合到灌注微流控系统中。大多数平台将气液界面培养与低容量灌注相结合，以支持延长的组织活力和部分功能维持，包括电生理活动、结构完整性保持和分子稳态。值得注意的是，所识别的任何研究均未报告在可比较的灌注OoC配置中成功长期培养成年啮齿动物或人脑组织，这凸显了当前方法的主要局限性。此外，组织活力和功能的评估是异质性的，且常常依赖于描述性或敏感性不足的读数，限制了跨平台比较和转化相关性。未来BoC技术的发展应优先考虑改进的微环境控制、合适生物材料的整合，以及能够评估代谢状态和回路水平功能的嵌入式监测策略。解决这些挑战对于推动OoC平台向神经科学中具有生理意义和转化相关性的应用发展至关重要。

abstract: Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS)-based organ-on-a-chip (OoC) platforms typically rely on cleanroom photolithography, custom masks, and master molds, which limit their accessibility and impede rapid prototyping efforts. Here, we present a simple, mask-free, cleanroom-free method to fabricate membrane-integrated PDMS microfluidic devices using a low-cost digital craft cutter and plasma-assisted adhesive bonding. The process achieves 150µm feature resolution, and forms PDMS-adhesive interfaces with high mechanical robustness (>370 kPa tensile strength) and hydrolytic stability, supporting flow rates up to 20 ml min-1without leakage. Using this method, we fabricated one-lane and two-lane OoC platforms incorporating commercial polycarbonate membranes and lab-made bacterial nanocellulose membranes without requiring membrane modification for bonding. These membrane-integrated devices enabled rapid formation of intestinal tissues within 72 h, significantly faster than conventional PDMS or transwell-based models, which typically require 1-3 weeks to achieve epithelial differentiation. Under physiological shear stress, epithelial tissues exhibited 2-3 fold increase in expression of differentiation markers (Mucin-2, Villin) and substantial reduction in stemness marker expression compared with static culture. In two-lane co-culture systems, epithelial-endothelial interfaces developed functional barrier properties within the same 72 h window and demonstrated membrane-dependent differences in maturation, with nanocellulose membranes promoting enhanced three-dimensional organization. This cleanroom-free platform reduces fabrication barriers for membrane-integrated PDMS OoC devices. Its ability to support rapid, robust intestinal tissue formation makes it a practical platform for accessible organ-mimetic systems in research settings and translational applications.
abstractZh: 基于聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）的器官芯片（OoC）平台通常依赖于洁净室光刻、定制掩模和母模，这限制了其可及性并阻碍了快速原型制作。在此，我们提出了一种简单、无掩模、无需洁净室的方法，使用低成本数字切割机和等离子辅助粘合键合来制造膜集成PDMS微流控器件。该工艺实现了150µm的特征分辨率，并形成了具有高机械强度（>370 kPa拉伸强度）和水解稳定性的PDMS-粘合剂界面，支持高达20 ml min-1的流速而无泄漏。使用该方法，我们制造了单通道和双通道OoC平台，整合了商用聚碳酸酯膜和实验室自制的细菌纳米纤维素膜，无需对膜进行改性即可键合。这些膜集成器件在72小时内实现了肠道组织的快速形成，显著快于传统PDMS或Transwell模型（通常需要1-3周才能实现上皮分化）。在生理剪切应力下，与静态培养相比，上皮组织表现出分化标志物（Mucin-2、Villin）表达增加2-3倍，且干性标志物表达显著降低。在双通道共培养系统中，上皮-内皮界面在相同的72小时窗口内形成了功能性屏障特性，并表现出膜依赖性的成熟差异，其中纳米纤维素膜促进了增强的三维组织化。这种无需洁净室的平台降低了膜集成PDMS OoC器件制造的障碍。其支持快速、稳健肠道组织形成的能力，使其成为研究环境和转化应用中可及性器官模拟系统的实用平台。

abstract: Cytotoxic chemotherapy remains indispensable for many epithelial malignancies, yet gemcitabine (GEM) and doxorubicin (DOX) are constrained by a narrow therapeutic index and clinically significant toxicity. Here, we developed an epithelial cell adhesion molecule (EpCAM)-targeted DNA aptamer (EP)-based construct for co-delivery of GEM and DOX and evaluated its antitumour activity together with renal injury-associated readouts in vitro. A GEM-integrating EP construct (EPG) was generated by substituting seven cytidines with GEM residues, followed by DOX loading through intercalation into GC-rich regions to form EPGD. Mass spectrometry confirmed the expected molecular species, and DOX association with EP/EPG was supported by fluorescence quenching. ELONA-based analyses further showed that EPG retained EpCAM binding with a modest increase in apparent Kd relative to EP, while competitive ELONA supported preserved, competitively inhibitable EpCAM engagement under the tested conditions. In an evaporation-driven microfluidic self-perfusion chip, EPGD induced greater tumour cytotoxicity and more pronounced γ-H2AX formation than free drugs or single-drug aptamer formulations at matched nominal drug concentrations. In patient-derived intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma organoids, EPGD reduced viability in a concentration-dependent manner. In a dual-compartment microfluidic chip operated under shared perfusion, HK-2 proximal tubular cells cultured on a kidney-derived decellularised extracellular matrix showed higher viability together with lower kidney injury molecule-1 (KIM-1) secretion and lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release after EPGD treatment than after free GEM and DOX. Together, these findings indicate that EPGD integrates CI-supported GEM/DOX synergism demonstrated in A549 cells with preferential activity in EpCAM-high tumour models and is associated with lower renal injury-associated readouts in this in vitro microfluidic platform.
abstractZh: 细胞毒性化疗对于许多上皮性恶性肿瘤仍然不可或缺，但吉西他滨（GEM）和多柔比星（DOX）受限于狭窄的治疗窗和临床显著毒性。在此，我们开发了一种基于上皮细胞黏附分子（EpCAM）靶向DNA适配体（EP）的构建体，用于共递送GEM和DOX，并在体外评估了其抗肿瘤活性及肾损伤相关读数。通过将七个胞苷替换为GEM残基生成了整合GEM的EP构建体（EPG），随后通过嵌入GC富集区加载DOX形成EPGD。质谱分析确认了预期的分子种类，荧光猝灭支持DOX与EP/EPG的结合。基于ELONA的分析进一步表明，EPG保留了EpCAM结合能力，表观Kd相对于EP略有增加，而竞争性ELONA支持在测试条件下保留可竞争性抑制的EpCAM结合。在蒸发驱动的微流控自灌注芯片中，在匹配的名义药物浓度下，EPGD比游离药物或单药适配体制剂诱导了更强的肿瘤细胞毒性和更明显的γ-H2AX形成。在患者来源的肝内胆管癌类器官中，EPGD以浓度依赖性方式降低活力。在共享灌注的双室微流控芯片中，培养在肾脏来源脱细胞细胞外基质上的HK-2近端肾小管细胞在EPGD处理后显示出比游离GEM和DOX更高的活力，同时肾损伤分子-1（KIM-1）分泌和乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）释放更低。总之，这些发现表明EPGD整合了在A549细胞中证明的CI支持的GEM/DOX协同作用，在EpCAM高表达肿瘤模型中具有优先活性，并且在此体外微流控平台中与较低的肾损伤相关读数相关。

abstract: Microfluidic devices remain difficult to translate into commercial products, particularly for three-dimensional (3D) applications. While soft lithography offers high-resolution features and biocompatibility, its workflows and planar geometries are limited. Conversely, industry-standard injection moulding enables scalability, but lacks flexibility and incurs high upfront costs. Here, we present an innovative hybrid microfabrication methodology combining stereolithographic 3D printed moulds with flexible wire templating and polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) casting to create monolithic 3D microfluidic devices. Leveraging injection moulding design principles, this enables the rapid and repeatable fabrication of microfluidic devices with embedded internal channels, variable-height membranes, and curved geometries. Our methodology is validated using a variety of devices, including flexible membranes, plug-based flow distributors for 96-well plates, and high-aspect-ratio bioreactors with integrated electrodes. The resulting devices were leak-proof, reusable, and compatible with standard cell culture systems. This scalable, low-cost methodology retains the advantages of PDMS while allowing for 3D design freedom for both internal channels and external features, making it ideal for emerging applications such as organ-on-chip, bioprinting, diagnostics, and soft robotics.
abstractZh: 微流控器件仍然难以转化为商业产品，尤其是在三维（3D）应用中。虽然软光刻提供了高分辨率的特征和生物相容性，但其工作流程和平面几何形状受到限制。相反，行业标准的注塑成型可实现可扩展性，但缺乏灵活性且前期成本高昂。在此，我们提出了一种创新的混合微制造方法，将立体光刻3D打印模具与柔性线模板和聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS）铸造相结合，以制造单片3D微流控器件。利用注塑成型设计原则，这能够快速、可重复地制造具有嵌入式内部通道、可变高度膜和弯曲几何形状的微流控器件。我们的方法通过多种器件进行了验证，包括柔性膜、用于96孔板的基于塞子的流动分配器，以及带有集成电极的高纵横比生物反应器。所得器件防漏、可重复使用，并与标准细胞培养系统兼容。这种可扩展、低成本的方法保留了PDMS的优势，同时允许内部通道和外部特征的3D设计自由度，使其成为器官芯片、生物打印、诊断和软体机器人等新兴应用的理想选择。

abstract: Microphysiological systems (MPS) have emerged as promising models to better recapitulatein vivomicroenvironments, but they often rely on manufacturing techniques that limit their scalability and constrain non-trivial three-dimensional architectures. Here, LCD 3D printing was used to fabricate an MPS capable of microfluidic flow, physiologically relevant cyclic strain, and resistance to rhodamine absorption. The device contains a thin, permeable (readily up to ∼70 kDa) extracellular matrix substrate (∼5 µm dehydrated) that can sustain NCI-H441 lung epithelial cells for a period of at least one week. This microfabrication strategy may be extended to different organ systems, enabling researchers to fabricate MPS with more complex designs.
abstractZh: 微生理系统（MPS）已成为更好地再现体内微环境的有前景的模型，但它们通常依赖于限制其可扩展性并约束非平凡三维结构的制造技术。在此，使用LCD 3D打印制造了一种能够进行微流体流动、生理相关循环应变和抵抗罗丹明吸收的MPS。该装置包含一个薄的、可渗透的（容易达到约70 kDa）细胞外基质基底（约5 µm脱水），能够维持NCI-H441肺上皮细胞至少一周。这种微加工策略可扩展到不同的器官系统，使研究人员能够制造具有更复杂设计的MPS。

title: Advanced biomaterial strategies for 3D in vitro biomimetic neuroblastoma cell culture.
titleZh: 用于三维体外仿生神经母细胞瘤细胞培养的先进生物材料策略。

abstract: Neuroblastoma is the most common extracranial solid tumor of infancy, and a lethal form of paediatric cancer. The treatment of this cancer remains challenging due to its heterogeneity. In some cases, the cancer regresses to become benign, while in others it becomes highly aggressive. In this latter case, the level of sensitivity to treatments such as retinoic acid cannot be predicted. An in vitro avatar of the patient's cancer would be of great value to identify the most effective treatment. In order to better understand the biology of this cancer and to find strategies for its treatment, the scientific community is devoted to developing 3D biomimetic approaches. The purpose of this review is to identify and explain the various techniques of 3D culture, to present their advantages and disadvantages, and their capacity to reproduce in vivo phenomena. It will also provide examples of their uses. While some models such as hydrogels and organoids/spheroids are already established, some upcoming techniques emerging from recent technological developments will allow the development of models that enable deeper control of architecture and functionalization parameters, thanks to the use of 3D printing, photo-polymerization, bioprinting, and fused deposition modeling.
abstractZh: 神经母细胞瘤是婴儿期最常见的颅外实体肿瘤，也是一种致命的儿科癌症。由于其异质性，这种癌症的治疗仍然具有挑战性。在某些情况下，癌症会消退并变为良性，而在其他情况下则变得高度侵袭性。在后一种情况下，对维甲酸等治疗的敏感性水平无法预测。患者癌症的体外替身对于确定最有效的治疗将具有重要价值。为了更好地了解这种癌症的生物学特性并寻找治疗策略，科学界致力于开发3D仿生方法。本综述的目的是识别和解释3D培养的各种技术，介绍其优缺点及其再现体内现象的能力。它还将提供其使用的示例。虽然水凝胶和类器官/球体等一些模型已经建立，但近期技术发展中出现的一些即将到来的技术将允许开发能够更深入控制架构和功能化参数的模型，这得益于3D打印、光聚合、生物打印和熔融沉积建模的使用。

abstract: Mechanical wrinkling of epithelial tissues encodes key features of tissue morphogenesis and mechanotransductive responses, yet its quantitative, multiscale characterization remains challenging in organoid-based in vitro models due to reliance on fluorescence labelling and sectioning. Here, we develop label-free ultraviolet photoacoustic microscopy (UV-PAM) for multiscale imaging and quantitative analysis of human organoid-derived epithelial wrinkle tissues. By exploiting intrinsic nucleic-acid absorption at 266 nm, UV-PAM visualizes wrinkle structures and nuclear morphology without labeling or sectioning. Using morphomechanically defined wrinkle tissues, we identify multiscale signatures, including wrinkle wavelength, wrinkle index, and strain-induced nuclear elongation and redistribution. UV-PAM further captures chemically induced epithelial stress, revealing degradation of wrinkle structure and nuclear morphology. In a proof-of-concept dataset comprising two untreated and two DTT-treated specimens, integration of these intrinsic signatures with deep learning enabled patch-level discrimination between untreated and chemically perturbed wrinkle tissues on held-out field of views (FOVs), with training and test FOVs obtained from the same specimens. These results establish UV-PAM as a label-free platform for multiscale imaging of epithelial morphogenesis and preliminary computational phenotyping.
abstractZh: 上皮组织的机械褶皱编码了组织形态发生和机械转导反应的关键特征，然而在基于类器官的体外模型中，由于其依赖荧光标记和切片，其定量、多尺度表征仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们开发了无标记紫外光声显微镜（UV-PAM），用于人类类器官来源的上皮褶皱组织的多尺度成像和定量分析。通过利用266 nm处内在的核酸吸收，UV-PAM无需标记或切片即可可视化褶皱结构和细胞核形态。利用形态力学定义的褶皱组织，我们识别了多尺度特征，包括褶皱波长、褶皱指数以及应变诱导的细胞核伸长和重新分布。UV-PAM进一步捕获了化学诱导的上皮应激，揭示了褶皱结构和细胞核形态的退化。在一个包含两个未处理和两个DTT处理样本的概念验证数据集中，将这些内在特征与深度学习相结合，能够在保留的视野（FOV）上实现未处理和化学扰动褶皱组织之间的斑块级区分，其中训练和测试FOV来自相同样本。这些结果确立了UV-PAM作为上皮形态发生多尺度成像和初步计算表型分析的无标记平台。

abstract: Tissue engineering and regenerative medicine are shifting from passive tissue replacement toward instructive platforms that regulate cellular behavior, immune responses, vascularization, and extracellular matrix remodeling. This review examines recent advances in natural, synthetic, composite, and stimuli-responsive biomaterials, biofabrication and 3D bioprinting, stem and progenitor cell therapies, extracellular vesicles and other cell-free products, immunomodulatory scaffolds, skin organoids and organ-on-a-chip systems, nanotechnology, and artificial intelligence-assisted design. Particular emphasis is placed on plastic, reconstructive, and aesthetic applications, including skin and wound repair, craniofacial bone and cartilage regeneration, peripheral nerve reconstruction, vascularization, and dental and periodontal repair. The review also considers biomodulators and skinboosters as emerging regenerative-aesthetic interventions that aim to improve dermal hydration, fibroblast activity, collagen remodeling, and skin quality rather than provide volume replacement alone. Importantly, these technologies differ substantially in translational maturity, ranging from in vitro and preclinical platforms to early clinical interventions, established clinical products, and commercially available treatments for which durable regenerative efficacy remains incompletely validated. Throughout this review, biological plausibility and preclinical efficacy are therefore distinguished from human clinical evidence, regulatory or established clinical use, and commercial availability. Progress will require standardized characterization, mechanism-linked potency assays, clinically relevant models, and outcome measures that capture functional integration, durability, safety, and aesthetic performance.
abstractZh: 组织工程和再生医学正从被动的组织替代转向指导性平台，这些平台调节细胞行为、免疫反应、血管化和细胞外基质重塑。本综述考察了天然、合成、复合和刺激响应性生物材料、生物制造和3D生物打印、干细胞和祖细胞疗法、细胞外囊泡和其他无细胞产品、免疫调节支架、皮肤类器官和器官芯片系统、纳米技术以及人工智能辅助设计的最新进展。特别强调了在整形、重建和美容应用中的使用，包括皮肤和伤口修复、颅面骨和软骨再生、周围神经重建、血管化以及牙科和牙周修复。本综述还考虑了生物调节剂和皮肤增强剂作为新兴的再生美容干预措施，旨在改善皮肤水合作用、成纤维细胞活性、胶原蛋白重塑和皮肤质量，而不仅仅是提供体积替代。重要的是，这些技术在转化成熟度上存在显著差异，从体外和临床前平台到早期临床干预、已建立的临床产品和商业可用的治疗，其持久的再生功效尚未得到完全验证。因此，在整个综述中，生物学合理性和临床前疗效与人类临床证据、监管或既定临床使用以及商业可用性区分开来。进展将需要标准化的表征、机制相关的效力测定、临床相关模型以及能够捕捉功能整合、耐久性、安全性和美学性能的结果指标。

title: Biomedical Materials and Fabrication Methods for Construction of In Vitro Neurovascular Unit Models.
titleZh: 用于构建体外神经血管单元模型的生物医学材料与制造方法。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: In vitro neurovascular unit (NVU) models are essential for reproducing blood-brain barrier (BBB) transport and neurovascular cell interactions. However, the literature remains fragmented: biomaterial chemistry, fabrication parameters and organ-on-a-chip architecture are commonly evaluated in isolation, while inconsistent reporting of matrix properties, processing history, cell source, flow and barrier readouts prevents head-to-head comparison and the extraction of transferable design rules. To address this gap, this review integrates biomaterials, manufacturing technologies and organ-on-a-chip engineering within a unified material-process-structure-function framework. We translate endothelial junctions, basement-membrane components and perivascular cells into experimentally actionable material requirements; compare natural, synthetic, semisynthetic and decellularized extracellular-matrix hydrogels; and examine crosslinking, peptide functionalization, stimuli responsiveness, composite-network formation and preparation methods. Findings from Transwell, microfluidic, tubular, self-assembled and 3D-bioprinted BBB systems are used to relate matrix stiffness, degradability, ligand density, permeability, device-body material and fabrication route to barrier maturation, analytical access and reproducibility. By defining matched controls and minimum reporting requirements for chemistry, mechanics, transport and processing, this review provides a practical basis for next-generation BBB models that can improve permeability and efficacy screening in drug discovery, reproduce disease- and patient-specific barrier dysfunction, and support individualized response testing with iPSC- or patient-derived cells.
abstractZh: 体外神经血管单元（NVU）模型对于再现血脑屏障（BBB）转运和神经血管细胞相互作用至关重要。然而，相关文献仍然零散：生物材料化学、制造参数和器官芯片架构通常被孤立评估，而基质特性、加工历史、细胞来源、流动和屏障读数的报告不一致，阻碍了头对头比较和可转移设计规则的提取。为弥补这一空白，本综述在统一材料-工艺-结构-功能框架内整合了生物材料、制造技术和器官芯片工程。我们将内皮连接、基底膜成分和血管周围细胞转化为实验上可操作的材料要求；比较了天然、合成、半合成和脱细胞细胞外基质水凝胶；并考察了交联、肽功能化、刺激响应性、复合网络形成和制备方法。来自Transwell、微流控、管状、自组装和3D生物打印BBB系统的发现被用于关联基质刚度、降解性、配体密度、渗透性、装置主体材料和制造路线与屏障成熟度、分析可及性和可重复性。通过定义匹配对照以及化学、力学、转运和加工的最低报告要求，本综述为下一代BBB模型提供了实用基础，这些模型可以改善药物发现中的渗透性和功效筛选，重现疾病和患者特异性屏障功能障碍，并支持使用iPSC或患者来源细胞进行个体化反应测试。

title: Colon-targeted oral delivery of melatonin for regulating macrophage activity and intestinal barrier in ulcerative colitis.
titleZh: 结肠靶向口服褪黑素递送用于调节溃疡性结肠炎中的巨噬细胞活性和肠道屏障。

abstract:
Background

Despite its promising therapeutic potential, inefficient site-specific targeting and complex fabrication processes hinder the clinical translation of oral melatonin therapy for ulcerative colitis (UC). Herein, we present Melatonin-Eudragit-Thioketal polymer-based Assembly (META), a dual pH/ROS-responsive oral microsphere for precise melatonin delivery to the inflamed colon and enhanced therapeutic outcomes.Methods

META was fabricated via a scalable emulsification process using Eudragit® FS 30 D and a thioketal polymer to enable dual pH- and ROS-responsive release. Its targeting delivery and therapeutic effects were then evaluated in simulated gastrointestinal (GI) fluids, 2D cell models, intestinal organoids, and a murine colitis model.Results

Using cell and animal models, we showed the important role of melatonin in GI health, supporting our strategy for UC treatment. META exhibited controlled melatonin release and better accumulation in the inflamed colon. The targeted delivery helped promote disease recovery by modulating macrophages and improving the intestinal barrier.Conclusion

META delivers melatonin precisely to the colon, which reprograms colonic macrophages and reinforces the epithelial barrier. This study offers a practical, clinically relevant approach for improving the use of endogenous therapeutic molecules in UC and other inflammatory GI diseases.
abstractZh:
背景

尽管具有广阔的治疗潜力，但低效的位点特异性靶向和复杂的制备过程阻碍了口服褪黑素治疗溃疡性结肠炎（UC）的临床转化。在此，我们提出了褪黑素-尤特奇-硫缩酮聚合物组装体（META），一种双pH/ROS响应性口服微球，用于将褪黑素精确递送至发炎结肠并增强治疗效果。方法

META通过使用Eudragit® FS 30 D和硫缩酮聚合物的可规模化乳化过程制备，以实现双pH和ROS响应性释放。随后在模拟胃肠（GI）液、二维细胞模型、肠道类器官和小鼠结肠炎模型中评估了其靶向递送和治疗效果。结果

利用细胞和动物模型，我们展示了褪黑素在胃肠健康中的重要作用，支持了我们的UC治疗策略。META表现出受控的褪黑素释放和在发炎结肠中更好的积累。靶向递送通过调节巨噬细胞和改善肠道屏障有助于促进疾病恢复。结论

META将褪黑素精确递送至结肠，重新编程结肠巨噬细胞并增强上皮屏障。这项研究为改善内源性治疗分子在UC和其他炎症性胃肠疾病中的应用提供了一种实用、临床相关的方法。

title: Beyond monolayers: a comparative analysis of 2D cell cultures and 3D in vitro models as new approach methodologies.
titleZh: 超越单层培养：2D细胞培养与3D体外模型作为新方法学的比较分析
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Calori IR, Guimaraes APP, Kammala AK, Richardson LS, Menon R.
affiliations: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Division of Basic Science and Translational Research, The University of Texas Medical Branch at Galveston, Galveston, TX, United States.
abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) cell cultures have been used as in vitro models in biomedical research as fundamental tools for investigating biological processes. However, their limited capacity to recapitulate the complexity of human tissues has driven the search for more physiologically relevant in vitro systems. In parallel, limitations in the predictive capacity, costs, and ethical concerns associated with animal models have reinforced the importance of the 3Rs principles (Replacement, Reduction, and Refinement), introduced in 1959, and more recently contributed to the emergence of New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). In this context, three-dimensional (3D) cell culture models, such as spheroids, organoids, and bioprinted models have been developed. This literature review focuses on studies that directly compare spheroids, organoids, and 3D-printed models with their 2D culture counterparts, highlighting their potential and limitations as human-relevant NAMs.
abstractZh: 二维（2D）细胞培养作为体外模型，一直是生物医学研究中探究生物学过程的基础工具。然而，其在重现人体组织复杂性方面的能力有限，推动了人们对更具生理相关性的体外系统的探索。与此同时，动物模型在预测能力、成本及伦理问题上的局限性，进一步强化了1959年提出的3R原则（替代、减少和优化）的重要性，并近期促进了新方法学（NAMs）的出现。在此背景下，三维（3D）细胞培养模型，如球体、类器官和生物打印模型等得以发展。本文献综述聚焦于直接比较球体、类器官和3D打印模型与其对应的2D培养模型的研究，突出它们作为与人体相关的新方法学的潜力与局限性。

title: Integrating brain organoids, meningeal immunity, and glymphatic dynamics: toward modeling neuroimmune clearance and crosstalk in disease.
titleZh: 整合脑类器官、脑膜免疫与类淋巴动力学：迈向疾病中神经免疫清除与串扰的建模。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Wu X, Du B, Chen Q, Hang R, Cui C, Li M.
affiliations: Department of Cancer Center, Army Medical Center of PLA (Daping Hospital), Army Medical University, Chongqing, China.
Department of Neurology and State Key Laboratory of Biotherapy, National Clinical Research Center for Geriatrics, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, China.
abstract: The central nervous system has long been considered an immune-privileged organ, but discoveries about meningeal lymphatics, meningeal immune cells, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF)-interstitial fluid (ISF) exchange, and aquaporin-4 (AQP4)-associated glymphatic-like transport are reshaping our understanding of waste clearance and immune surveillance in the brain. However, there are obvious breaks in the current model system. Animal models possess complete circulatory and meningeal structures, but are limited by species differences, imaging depth, operability, and high throughput. Traditional two-dimensional (2D) culture and transwell models lack 3D brain parenchymal structure, low-speed fluid dynamics, and the meningeal immune microenvironment. This paper proposes the concept of "brain parenchyma-lymphoid-meningeal immune assembly chip", which integrates brain organoids containing neurons, astrocytes and microglia, CSF-like fluid derived from choroid plexus organoids, microfluidic lymphatic channels, and meningeal immune modules containing meningeal lymphatic endothelium, meningeal fibroblasts, macrophages, and dendritic cells. Currently, the various component technologies required for this platform are still at different stages of experimental maturity and have not yet been integrated into a single system. This review discusses existing issues such as the cellular composition of the brain parenchyma module, the engineering simulation of glymphatic dynamics, the reconstruction of the meningeal lymphatic and immune interface, disease applications, and validation standards. It also outlines a phased development roadmap to build a platform capable of tracking the continuous process of "pathological product generation-fluid clearance-meningeal immune sensing-inflammatory feedback" under simulated human brain conditions, providing new tools for mechanism analysis and drug screening in neurodegenerative diseases, brain injury, and neuro-immunological diseases.
abstractZh: 中枢神经系统长期以来被视为免疫豁免器官，但关于脑膜淋巴管、脑膜免疫细胞、脑脊液（CSF）-组织间液（ISF）交换以及水通道蛋白-4（AQP4）相关的类淋巴转运的发现，正在重塑我们对大脑废物清除和免疫监视的理解。然而，当前模型系统存在明显的断裂。动物模型拥有完整的循环和脑膜结构，但受限于物种差异、成像深度、可操作性和高通量。传统的二维（2D）培养和Transwell模型缺乏3D脑实质结构、低速流体动力学和脑膜免疫微环境。本文提出了“脑实质-淋巴-脑膜免疫组装芯片”的概念，该芯片整合了包含神经元、星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞的脑类器官、源自脉络丛类器官的CSF样液体、微流控淋巴通道，以及包含脑膜淋巴内皮、脑膜成纤维细胞、巨噬细胞和树突状细胞的脑膜免疫模块。目前，该平台所需的各种组件技术仍处于不同的实验成熟阶段，尚未整合到单一系统中。本综述讨论了现有问题，如脑实质模块的细胞组成、类淋巴动力学的工程模拟、脑膜淋巴和免疫界面的重建、疾病应用和验证标准。它还概述了一个分阶段的发展路线图，以构建一个能够在模拟人类大脑条件下追踪“病理产物生成-液体清除-脑膜免疫感知-炎症反馈”连续过程的平台，为神经退行性疾病、脑损伤和神经免疫疾病的机制分析和药物筛选提供新工具。

title: The 3D landscape of infection: spatial organization and in vitro models.
titleZh: 感染的3D景观：空间组织与体外模型。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Goldmann O, Medina E.
affiliations: Infection Immunology Research Group, Helmholtz Centre for Infection Research, Braunschweig, Germany.
abstract: Microbial infections rarely consist of free-floating cells. Instead, pathogens and immune cells are typically organized into complex three-dimensional (3D) structures, including biofilms, abscesses, and granulomas, which can serve to constrain pathogen dissemination. At the same time, these architectures create protective microenvironments that promote microbial persistence, immune evasion, and increased resistance to antimicrobial therapies. A mechanistic understanding of how spatially organized tissue structures and local microenvironmental cues shape host-pathogen dynamics may open new avenues for therapeutic interventions, for example by improving targeted drug delivery, enhancing antibiotic penetration, or disrupting protective microbial niches. In this review, we summarize emerging insights into the 3D landscape of infections and highlight advances in experimental platforms that more faithfully recapitulate tissue architecture, including 3D cell culture systems, bioprinted tissue, organoids, and organ-on-chip technologies. Finally, we discuss how integrating spatial parameters into infection models reshapes our understanding of pathogenesis and opens new conceptual and therapeutic avenues for combating infections.
abstractZh: 微生物感染很少由自由漂浮的细胞组成。相反，病原体和免疫细胞通常组织成复杂的三维（3D）结构，包括生物膜、脓肿和肉芽肿，这些结构可以限制病原体的传播。同时，这些结构创造了保护性微环境，促进微生物持久存在、免疫逃逸，并增加对抗菌治疗的耐药性。对空间组织的组织结构和局部微环境线索如何塑造宿主-病原体动态的机制性理解，可能为治疗干预开辟新途径，例如通过改善靶向药物递送、增强抗生素渗透或破坏保护性微生物生态位。在这篇综述中，我们总结了关于感染3D景观的新兴见解，并强调了更真实地再现组织结构的实验平台进展，包括3D细胞培养系统、生物打印组织、类器官和器官芯片技术。最后，我们讨论了将空间参数整合到感染模型中如何重塑我们对发病机制的理解，并为对抗感染开辟新的概念和治疗途径。

title: Advances in organoids for personalized medicine: from technological development to clinical application.
titleZh: 类器官在个性化医学中的进展：从技术开发到临床应用。

dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

affiliations: Henan Key Laboratory of Children's Genetics and Developmental Diseases, Henan International Joint Laboratory of Children's Infectious Diseases, Henan Clinical Research Center of Childhood Diseases, Children's Hospital Affiliated to Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.

abstract: Organoids, three-dimensional cell culture models derived from patient tissues or stem cells, have emerged as a cutting-edge technology in personalized medicine, owing to their remarkable ability to closely recapitulate in vivo tissue architecture and function. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the technological evolution and construction methodologies of organoids, highlighting their significant applications in oncology, genetic disorders, infectious diseases, and drug screening. This review examines how organoids enable precision medicine by preserving genomic fidelity, predicting drug sensitivity, and creating disease models via gene editing. Despite these advances, organoid technology faces several technical challenges that impede its full clinical translation. Addressing these obstacles is critical for realizing the potential of organoids in individualized therapeutic strategies. This article aims to delineate current progress and future directions in organoid research, furnishing a theoretical foundation and guiding future investigations towards enhancing personalized treatment paradigms.
abstractZh: 类器官，源自患者组织或干细胞的三维细胞培养模型，因其能够密切重现体内组织结构和功能的显著能力，已成为个性化医学中的前沿技术。本综述全面概述了类器官的技术演进和构建方法，强调了其在肿瘤学、遗传性疾病、传染病和药物筛选中的重大应用。本综述探讨了类器官如何通过保持基因组保真度、预测药物敏感性和通过基因编辑创建疾病模型来实现精准医学。尽管取得了这些进展，类器官技术仍面临若干技术挑战，阻碍了其全面的临床转化。解决这些障碍对于实现类器官在个体化治疗策略中的潜力至关重要。本文旨在阐述类器官研究的当前进展和未来方向，为增强个性化治疗模式提供理论基础并指导未来研究。

title: Neurotoxic mechanisms of cadmium in neurodegenerative diseases.
titleZh: 镉在神经退行性疾病中的神经毒性机制。

dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: Cadmium (Cd) is a highly toxic, bioaccumulative heavy metal increasingly implicated in the pathogenesis of neurodegenerative disorders. This review systemically characterizes the molecular mechanisms underlying Cd-induced neurotoxicity, with particular emphasis on oxidative stress-mediated pathways that initiate interconnected processes including ferroptosis, mitochondrial impairment, disruption of calcium homeostasis, and chronic neuroinflammation. Evidence indicates that Cd exerts both convergent and disease-specific effects in neurodegenerative conditions. In Alzheimer's disease (AD), Cd exposure has been associated with enhanced amyloid-β (Aβ) deposition and increased tau hyperphosphorylation. In Parkinson's disease (PD), Cd disrupts metabolic homeostasis via the gut-liver-brain axis and promotes aberrant conformational changes and aggregation of α-synuclein (α-Syn). Within the amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD) spectrum, Cd contributes to TDP-43 proteinopathy and impairs nucleocytoplasmic transport mechanisms. Therapeutic strategies targeting Cd-induced neurotoxicity are also explored, including upstream approaches like metal chelation and downstream interventions aimed at restoring autophagic flux, modulating the neuroimmune microenvironment, and enhancing neuronal repair. Although emerging platforms such as brain organoids provide valuable mechanistic insights, translating findings from in vitro models to real-world chronic exposure scenarios remains a significant challenge. This review provides a comprehensive framework for the development of early-warning systems and precision-based interventions for Cd-related neurodegeneration.
abstractZh: 镉（Cd）是一种高毒性、具有生物累积性的重金属，日益被认为与神经退行性疾病的发病机制有关。本综述系统性地阐述了镉诱导神经毒性的分子机制，特别强调了氧化应激介导的通路，这些通路启动了一系列相互关联的过程，包括铁死亡、线粒体损伤、钙稳态失调和慢性神经炎症。证据表明，镉在神经退行性疾病中既表现出趋同效应，也表现出疾病特异性效应。在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中，镉暴露与β-淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）沉积增加和tau蛋白过度磷酸化增强有关。在帕金森病（PD）中，镉通过肠-肝-脑轴扰乱代谢稳态，并促进α-突触核蛋白（α-Syn）的异常构象改变和聚集。在肌萎缩侧索硬化-额颞叶痴呆（ALS-FTD）谱系中，镉导致TDP-43蛋白病并损害核质转运机制。本文还探讨了针对镉诱导神经毒性的治疗策略，包括金属螯合等上游方法和旨在恢复自噬流、调节神经免疫微环境及增强神经元修复的下游干预措施。尽管脑类器官等新兴平台提供了有价值的机制见解，但将体外模型的发现转化为现实世界慢性暴露场景仍是一个重大挑战。本综述为开发镉相关神经退行性疾病的早期预警系统和精准干预措施提供了一个全面的框架。

title: Modulation of the cytoskeleton for cancer therapy.
titleZh: 细胞骨架调节用于癌症治疗。
journal: Frontiers in cell and developmental biology
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Matov A.
affiliations: DataSet Analysis LLC, San Francisco, CA, United States.
abstract:
Introduction

All degenerative diseases are associated with impairment in intracellular trafficking. The highly dynamic organization and remodeling of the cellular cytoskeleton are dysfunctional in pathology and often lead to drug resistance. Successful analyses of the mechanisms of drug action require statistical analysis of large-scale readouts of molecular interactions at nanometer-scale resolution. The focus of our work is the automated extraction of unbiased information from time-lapse microscopy image series of the response of cytoskeletal meshworks, intracytoplasmic membranous networks, and vesicle trafficking to ex vivo drug treatment in cancer. We present the computer vision algorithms we have developed in this regard.Methods

We have performed cell biological profiling of cellular interactions and molecular mechanisms of pathogenesis and drug resistance. We are developing a platform for multifaceted analyses of intracellular and intercellular dynamics in patient-derived cultures. We aim to correlate our analyses with patterns of genetic and epigenetic variations in order to anticipate drug resistance and unfavorable treatment outcome. While we have established organoid cultures from solid tumor samples, we will perform preclinical and clinical analyses in a clinically-relevant model system in kidney organoids obtained from patient urine samples for which we will perform sequencing of long and small RNAs and will measure the expression levels of microtubule (MT) regulators and other cytoskeletal modulators. We label MT ends and will label other cellular components, such as actin, E-cadherin, cytoplasmic dynein, mitochondria, lysosomes, or exosomes, depending on the tumor type and disease stage. Our technology allows us to build a medical digital twin.Results

We report new function of the MT-stabilizing drug paclitaxel and the MT-destabilizing drug vinorelbine, which elucidate mechanisms beyond the canonical function of these tubulin inhibitors. We present new analysis results on patient stratification using non-invasive biomarkers, such as urinary small RNA. We identified dysregulated MT-regulating genes in colorectal cancer organoids that can be linked to spindle rotation during mitosis and resistance to MT-stabilizing drugs. The paper provides new results from our work with patient-derived cells cultured as organoids and the analysis of cancer vulnerabilities in the context of precision medicine. We report real-time computer vision analysis and lattice light-sheet live-cell organoid imaging before drug treatment and will extend this work after treatment with low drug doses of MT, GSK3β, or/and tropomyosin inhibitors, and small molecules that induce ferroptosis or inhibit Rho GTPase activity.Conclusion

Our biomedical computer vision approach allows us to elucidate mechanisms of drug action and uncover molecular interactions inaccessible by sequencing methods alone. After clinical validation, it may contribute to anticipating drug resistance and identifying sensitizing regimens that lead to complete response with minimal toxicity and the elimination of residual disease.
abstractZh:
引言

所有退行性疾病都与细胞内运输受损有关。细胞骨架的高度动态组织和重塑在病理状态下功能失调，常常导致耐药性。成功分析药物作用机制需要对纳米级分辨率的分子相互作用的大规模读数进行统计分析。我们工作的重点是自动提取无偏信息，从延时显微镜图像序列中提取细胞骨架网络、胞质膜网络和囊泡运输对离体药物处理在癌症中的反应。我们介绍了为此开发的计算机视觉算法。方法

我们进行了细胞生物学分析，研究细胞相互作用以及发病机制和耐药性的分子机制。我们正在开发一个平台，用于对患者来源培养物中的细胞内和细胞间动态进行多方面分析。我们的目标是将我们的分析与遗传和表观遗传变异模式相关联，以预测耐药性和不利的治疗结果。虽然我们已经从实体瘤样本中建立了类器官培养物，但我们将在临床相关的模型系统中进行临床前和临床分析，该系统使用从患者尿液样本中获得的肾脏类器官，我们将对其进行长链和短链RNA测序，并测量微管（MT）调节因子和其他细胞骨架调节因子的表达水平。我们标记MT末端，并将标记其他细胞成分，如肌动蛋白、E-钙黏蛋白、细胞质动力蛋白、线粒体、溶酶体或外泌体，具体取决于肿瘤类型和疾病阶段。我们的技术使我们能够构建医学数字孪生。结果

我们报告了MT稳定药物紫杉醇和MT去稳定药物长春瑞滨的新功能，这些功能揭示了这些微管蛋白抑制剂典型功能之外的机制。我们展示了使用非侵入性生物标志物（如尿液小RNA）进行患者分层的新分析结果。我们在结直肠癌类器官中鉴定了失调的MT调节基因，这些基因可能与有丝分裂期间纺锤体旋转和对MT稳定药物的耐药性有关。本文提供了我们使用患者来源细胞培养为类器官的工作的新结果，以及在精准医学背景下分析癌症脆弱性的结果。我们报告了药物治疗前的实时计算机视觉分析和晶格光片活细胞类器官成像，并将扩展这项工作，在低剂量MT、GSK3β或/和原肌球蛋白抑制剂，以及诱导铁死亡或抑制Rho GTP酶活性的小分子治疗后进行。结论

我们的生物医学计算机视觉方法使我们能够阐明药物作用机制，并揭示仅靠测序方法无法获得的分子相互作用。经过临床验证后，它可能有助于预测耐药性，并识别导致完全缓解、最小毒性和消除残留疾病的增敏方案。

title: Building bridges to immunotherapy: a knowledge-mapping analysis of cervical cancer organoid research.
titleZh: 搭建通往免疫治疗的桥梁：宫颈癌类器官研究的知识图谱分析
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Tian Y, Chang H, Liu J, Ding W, Jin J, Qin C, Zhao S, Zhao X.
affiliations: Department of Clinical Research and Translational Medicine, the Third Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.
Tianjian Laboratory of Advanced Biomedical Sciences, Institute of Advanced Biomedical Sciences, Zhengzhou University, Zhengzhou, Henan, China.
abstract: Cervical cancer, a human papillomavirus (HPV) -driven malignancy with inherent viral antigenicity, serves as a key model in immuno-oncology. Yet, the variable efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors highlights a critical gap: the lack of preclinical models that accurately mirror the patient-specific tumor microenvironment (TME). Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) offer a transformative solution, preserving autologous tumor and immune components for personalized therapeutic testing. This study provides the first bibliometric analysis of this evolving field, mapping its knowledge structure from model development to immuno-oncological application. By analyzing 130 publications (1992-2025) from Web of Science, PubMed, and Scopus using VOSviewer and CiteSpace, we delineate a clear, three-stage evolution: from foundational HPV virology and culture techniques, through pivotal organoid methodology establishment (e.g., Burk RD, 2017), to the current translational phase. This progression is marked by citation bursts in TME modeling (e.g., Lohmussaar K, 2021) and the emergence of keywords like "drug screening" and "immunotherapy". Research is dominated by the U.S., China, and European nations, published within an interdisciplinary core of oncology, immunology, and virology journals. Our analysis highlights the role of organoids as a crucial bridge linking basic virology to clinical immuno-oncology. However, standardization hurdles and suboptimal establishment rates for certain subtypes impede clinical translation. To realize the full potential of PDOs, future work must prioritize standardized immune-competent co-culture systems, integrate AI for high-content data analysis, and promote equitable global collaborations. Our analysis suggests the role of organoids as a crucial bridge linking basic virology to clinical immuno-oncology, highlighting that current advancements in tumor microenvironment modeling are establishing the necessary foundation for future immunotherapeutic applications.
abstractZh: 宫颈癌是一种由人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）驱动的恶性肿瘤，具有内在的病毒抗原性，是免疫肿瘤学中的关键模型。然而，免疫检查点抑制剂疗效的差异性凸显了一个关键缺口：缺乏能够准确反映患者特异性肿瘤微环境（TME）的临床前模型。患者来源类器官（PDOs）提供了一种变革性的解决方案，保留了自体肿瘤和免疫成分，可用于个性化治疗测试。本研究首次对该不断发展的领域进行了文献计量学分析，绘制了从模型开发到免疫肿瘤学应用的知识结构图谱。通过使用VOSviewer和CiteSpace分析来自Web of Science、PubMed和Scopus的130篇文献（1992-2025年），我们描绘了一个清晰的三阶段演变过程：从基础HPV病毒学与培养技术，到关键类器官方法学的建立（如Burk RD，2017年），再到当前的转化阶段。这一进展以肿瘤微环境建模中的引文爆发（如Lohmussaar K，2021年）以及“药物筛选”和“免疫治疗”等关键词的出现为标志。研究主要由美国、中国和欧洲国家主导，发表在以肿瘤学、免疫学和病毒学为核心的跨学科期刊中。我们的分析强调了类器官作为连接基础病毒学与临床免疫肿瘤学的关键桥梁的作用。然而，标准化障碍和某些亚型建立成功率不理想阻碍了临床转化。为充分发挥PDOs的潜力，未来的工作必须优先考虑标准化的免疫活性共培养系统，整合人工智能进行高内涵数据分析，并促进公平的全球合作。我们的分析表明，类器官作为连接基础病毒学与临床免疫肿瘤学的关键桥梁，当前肿瘤微环境建模的进展正在为未来的免疫治疗应用奠定必要的基础。

title: Mesenchymal Stem Cells Attenuate Acute Lung Injury Through the NF-κB/STAT3-Ntrk2 Axis to Promote Alveolar Epithelial Regeneration.
titleZh: 间充质干细胞通过NF-κB/STAT3-Ntrk2轴减轻急性肺损伤并促进肺泡上皮再生。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Xu H, Zheng J, Yang X, Jin L, Lan S, Yang L, Zhang Y.
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of Experimental Hematology, National Clinical Research Center for Blood Diseases, Haihe Laboratory of Cell Ecosystem, Institute of Hematology & Blood Diseases Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences & Peking Union Medical College, Tianjin 300020, China.
Tianjin Institutes of Health Science, Tianjin 301600, China.
Department of Obstetrics, Tianjin Medical University, Baodi Hospital, Tianjin 301800, China.
abstract:
Introduction

Mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) possess immunomodulatory and tissuereparative properties and have shown therapeutic potential in acute lung injury (ALI). However, the mechanisms underlying their protective effects remain unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of MSCs on bleomycin-induced ALI and to explore the underlying molecular mechanisms.Methods

A bleomycin-induced ALI mouse model was established, followed by human umbilical cord-derived MSC administration. Lung injury, pulmonary edema, neutrophil infiltration, and apoptosis of alveolar type II epithelial cells (AT2) were assessed. RNA-seq and molecular validation were performed using sorted AT2 cells to investigate the underlying mechanism. In vitro assays were carried out to examine the role of Ntrk2 in MSC-mediated epithelial repair.Results

MSC treatment alleviated lung injury, improved alveolar structure, reduced pulmonary edema, and decreased neutrophil infiltration and AT2 cell apoptosis. RNA-seq and molecular analyses indicated that MSCs regulated Ntrk2 expression by suppressing NF-κB signaling and enhancing STAT3 signaling, thereby promoting alveolar epithelial regeneration. In vitro, inhibition of Ntrk2 impaired the promotive effects of MSCs on A549 cell migration and alveolar organoid repair.Discussion

These findings suggest that MSCs protect against ALI by attenuating inflammatory injury and promoting alveolar epithelial repair, with the NF-κB/STAT3-Ntrk2 axis contributing to this process.Conclusion

MSC treatment ameliorated bleomycin-induced ALI and promoted alveolar epithelial regeneration, at least partly through the NF-κB/STAT3-Ntrk2 axis. These results provide further mechanistic support for MSC-based therapy in ALI.
abstractZh:
引言

间充质干细胞（MSCs）具有免疫调节和组织修复特性，在急性肺损伤（ALI）中显示出治疗潜力。然而，其保护作用的机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在评估MSCs对博来霉素诱导的ALI的影响，并探讨其潜在的分子机制。方法

建立博来霉素诱导的ALI小鼠模型，随后给予人脐带来源的MSCs。评估肺损伤、肺水肿、中性粒细胞浸润以及肺泡II型上皮细胞（AT2）的凋亡。使用分选的AT2细胞进行RNA-seq和分子验证以研究其潜在机制。进行体外实验以检查Ntrk2在MSC介导的上皮修复中的作用。结果

MSC治疗减轻了肺损伤，改善了肺泡结构，减少了肺水肿，并降低了中性粒细胞浸润和AT2细胞凋亡。RNA-seq和分子分析表明，MSCs通过抑制NF-κB信号和增强STAT3信号来调节Ntrk2表达，从而促进肺泡上皮再生。在体外，抑制Ntrk2削弱了MSCs对A549细胞迁移和肺泡类器官修复的促进作用。讨论

这些发现表明，MSCs通过减轻炎症损伤和促进肺泡上皮修复来保护免受ALI，其中NF-κB/STAT3-Ntrk2轴参与了这一过程。结论

MSC治疗改善了博来霉素诱导的ALI并促进了肺泡上皮再生，至少部分通过NF-κB/STAT3-Ntrk2轴实现。这些结果为MSC治疗ALI提供了进一步的机制支持。

title: Coupled transcriptomic divergence establishes a human-specific synaptic glial precursor state
titleZh: 耦合的转录组差异建立了人类特异性的突触胶质前体状态
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Sheu XD, Yamauchi YY, Amano R, Nakano Y, Yoshino J, Suzuki IK.
abstract: The mammalian cerebral cortex is built from a conserved developmental program, yet exhibits profound species-specific complexity. To decode the regulatory changes driving human brain evolution, we reconstructed and aligned continuous single-cell differentiation trajectories across the developing human, macaque, mouse, and ferret cortices. This comparative framework revealed a fundamental principle of transcriptomic evolution during mammalian cortical development: while stable expression is the mammalian default, genes that diverge strictly shift their allocation to cell differentiation trajectories and developmental timing in tandem. By isolating these coupled regulatory shifts to the human lineage, we revealed that a canonical synaptic gene network uniquely redeployed into early human oligodendrocyte precursor cells (OPCs). Human, chimpanzee, and gorilla cortical organoids confirmed that this neuron-like OPC state is an exclusively human innovation. Spatial transcriptome analysis found that these specialized OPCs engage adjacent neural progenitors (outer radial glia) via synaptic-adhesion signaling during neurogenetic period. These findings demonstrate that this coupled spatiotemporal rewiring establishes novel developmental microenvironments, providing a discrete molecular engine for human cortical evolution.
abstractZh: 哺乳动物大脑皮层由保守的发育程序构建，却展现出深刻的物种特异性复杂性。为了解码驱动人脑进化的调控变化，我们重建并比对了发育中的人类、猕猴、小鼠和雪貂皮层的连续单细胞分化轨迹。这一比较框架揭示了哺乳动物皮层发育过程中转录组进化的基本原理：虽然稳定表达是哺乳动物的默认状态，但发生分歧的基因严格地将其分配转移到细胞分化轨迹和发育时间上，并同步进行。通过将这些耦合的调控变化隔离到人类谱系，我们发现一个典型的突触基因网络被独特地重新部署到早期人类少突胶质前体细胞（OPCs）中。人类、黑猩猩和大猩猩的皮层类器官证实，这种神经元样OPC状态是纯粹的人类创新。空间转录组分析发现，这些特化的OPCs在神经发生期间通过突触粘附信号与邻近的神经祖细胞（外层放射状胶质细胞）相互作用。这些发现表明，这种耦合的时空重塑建立了新的发育微环境，为人类皮层进化提供了独特的分子引擎。

title: Evaluating EndoC βH5 pseudoislets as a model for human islet transplantation.
titleZh: 评估EndoC βH5假胰岛作为人胰岛移植模型的可行性。
journal: Diabetic medicine : a journal of the British Diabetic Association
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Daniels Gatward LF, Blackstone Whines WT, Hong TW, Sullivan R, Starikova J, Lonsane A, Arora R, Salem V, Zhao M, Jones PM, King AFJ, Persaud SJ.
affiliations: Department of Diabetes and Obesity, School of Cardiovascular and Metabolic Medicine and Sciences, King's College London, London, UK.
abstract:
Aims

The EndoC βH5 cell line represents a promising human β-cell model for preclinical diabetes research. Indeed, EndoC βH5 cells aggregate into islet-like organoids, secrete insulin in a glucose-dependent manner, and express a variety of β-cell functional markers. However, EndoC βH5 cell survival and functionality in vivo have not yet been investigated. Here, we have transplanted EndoC βH5 pseudoislets under the kidney capsule in SCID mice and analysed their capacity to regulate whole body blood glucose concentrations.Methods

EndoC βH5 pseudoislets were formed in agar microwells. Oxygen consumption rate and glucose-stimulated insulin secretion were quantified in vitro. After 31 days, groups of 1000 EndoC βH5 pseudoislets were transplanted under the kidney capsule in SCID mice. To selectively ablate endogenous β-cells, streptozotocin was administered 1 month after transplantation, and EndoC βH5 graft function was analysed through quantification of blood glucose and human plasma insulin.Results

EndoC βH5 pseudoislets exhibited glucose-induced insulin secretion at 15 days, which was maintained at 31 days of culture. Human insulin was detectable in mouse plasma at 1 week post-transplantation. Despite this, streptozotocin administration led to overt diabetes in transplant recipients.Conclusion

EndoC βH5 pseudoislets secrete insulin in a glucose-responsive manner in vitro, remain viable in vivo, and secrete insulin. Despite this, transplantation of 1000 pseudoislets is not sufficient to maintain glycaemia when endogenous β-cells are destroyed. Nonetheless, EndoC βH5 pseudoislets represent a useful tool for preclinical islet transplantation studies where graft control of systemic glycaemia is not a requirement.
abstractZh:
目的

EndoC βH5细胞系代表了临床前糖尿病研究中有前景的人β细胞模型。确实，EndoC βH5细胞聚集成胰岛样类器官，以葡萄糖依赖性方式分泌胰岛素，并表达多种β细胞功能标志物。然而，EndoC βH5细胞在体内的存活和功能尚未被研究。在此，我们将EndoC βH5假胰岛移植到SCID小鼠的肾包膜下，并分析其调节全身血糖浓度的能力。方法

在琼脂微孔中形成EndoC βH5假胰岛。在体外量化耗氧率和葡萄糖刺激的胰岛素分泌。31天后，将每组1000个EndoC βH5假胰岛移植到SCID小鼠的肾包膜下。为了选择性消融内源性β细胞，在移植后1个月施用链脲佐菌素，并通过量化血糖和人血浆胰岛素来分析EndoC βH5移植物的功能。结果

EndoC βH5假胰岛在15天时表现出葡萄糖诱导的胰岛素分泌，并在培养31天时维持。移植后1周，在小鼠血浆中可检测到人胰岛素。尽管如此，施用链脲佐菌素导致移植受体出现明显糖尿病。结论

EndoC βH5假胰岛在体外以葡萄糖反应性方式分泌胰岛素，在体内保持存活，并分泌胰岛素。尽管如此，当内源性β细胞被破坏时，移植1000个假胰岛不足以维持血糖。然而，EndoC βH5假胰岛代表了临床前胰岛移植研究的有用工具，其中移植物对全身血糖的控制不是必需条件。

title: Alisol A 23,24-diacetate improves LPS-induced acute lung injury through the IL-17A/NF-κB signaling pathway.
titleZh: 泽泻醇A 23,24-二乙酸酯通过IL-17A/NF-κB信号通路改善LPS诱导的急性肺损伤。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Zhang Y, Guo P, Zeng M, Zhu D, Zhang Z, Luo M, Chao Y, Chang F, Feng W, Zheng X.

abstract:
Objective

This study utilized the multi-model validation method to confirm that Alisol A 23,24-diacetate (AAD) can improve LPS-induced acute lung injury (ALI) through the IL-17A/NF-κB signaling pathway, providing experimental data support for preclinical research.Methods

Mice were given drugs by gavage continuously for 3 days, and then LPS was instilled into trachea to establish the model of acute lung injury. Subsequently, the lung pathological sections, lung function, the levels of oxidative stress and apoptosis, the metabolic levels in lung tissue and serum, and the levels of immune cells and inflammatory factors in each group of mice were detected. Then, the differentially expressed genes were screened based on the GEO database, and molecular docking combined with PCR technology was employed to investigate the potential pathogenesis of acute lung injury. Next, in vivo mouse models and in vitro lung organoid models were utilized, combined with Western blot and immunofluorescence techniques, to validate the proteins associated with the IL-17A/NF-κB signaling pathway. The binding of AAD to IL-17A protein was detected by cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). Finally, the Beas-2B cell model combined with IL-17 agonist (SR0987) and IL-17 antagonist (Brodalumab), as well as the zebrafish model coupled with the methods of IL-17A gene silencing and overexpression, were employed to validate the mechanism of action underlying the intervention of AAD in LPS-induced ALI.Results

AAD significantly ameliorated lung injury and lung function in a mouse model of LPS-induced ALI, modulated metabolic and immune disorders in ALI mice, and suppressed the release of inflammatory factors. The results from GEO database analysis, molecular docking, PCR, WB, immunofluorescence and CETSA, demonstrated that AAD ameliorates LPS-induced ALI via the IL-17A/NF-κB signaling pathway. In Beas-2B cells, AAD significantly suppressed the LPS-induced elevation of ROS and apoptosis levels, reduced the protein expression of IL-17A and p-NF-κB p65, and decreased the levels of inflammatory factors, exerting a comparable therapeutic effect to that of the IL-17 antagonist. However, the therapeutic efficacy of AAD was abrogated following the addition of an IL-17 agonist. In the experiment of zebrafish, AAD significantly enhanced the sports activity of zebrafish and inhibited the levels of IL-17A and inflammatory factor RNA. However, the therapeutic efficacy of AAD was abrogated following IL-17A gene overexpression.Conclusion

AAD improves LPS-induced ALI through the IL-17A/NF-κB signaling pathway.
abstractZh:
目的

本研究采用多模型验证方法，确认泽泻醇A 23,24-二乙酸酯（AAD）可通过IL-17A/NF-κB信号通路改善LPS诱导的急性肺损伤（ALI），为临床前研究提供实验数据支持。方法

小鼠连续灌胃给药3天，然后气管内滴注LPS建立急性肺损伤模型。随后，检测各组小鼠的肺病理切片、肺功能、氧化应激和凋亡水平、肺组织和血清中的代谢水平，以及免疫细胞和炎症因子水平。然后，基于GEO数据库筛选差异表达基因，并结合分子对接和PCR技术研究急性肺损伤的潜在发病机制。接下来，利用体内小鼠模型和体外肺类器官模型，结合Western blot和免疫荧光技术，验证与IL-17A/NF-κB信号通路相关的蛋白。通过细胞热位移分析（CETSA）检测AAD与IL-17A蛋白的结合。最后，采用Beas-2B细胞模型结合IL-17激动剂（SR0987）和IL-17拮抗剂（Brodalumab），以及斑马鱼模型结合IL-17A基因沉默和过表达方法，验证AAD干预LPS诱导ALI的作用机制。结果

AAD显著改善了LPS诱导的ALI小鼠模型的肺损伤和肺功能，调节了ALI小鼠的代谢和免疫紊乱，并抑制了炎症因子的释放。GEO数据库分析、分子对接、PCR、WB、免疫荧光和CETSA的结果表明，AAD通过IL-17A/NF-κB信号通路改善LPS诱导的ALI。在Beas-2B细胞中，AAD显著抑制了LPS诱导的ROS和凋亡水平升高，降低了IL-17A和p-NF-κB p65的蛋白表达，并降低了炎症因子水平，其治疗效果与IL-17拮抗剂相当。然而，加入IL-17激动剂后，AAD的治疗效果被消除。在斑马鱼实验中，AAD显著增强了斑马鱼的运动活性，并抑制了IL-17A和炎症因子RNA的水平。然而，IL-17A基因过表达后，AAD的治疗效果被消除。结论

AAD通过IL-17A/NF-κB信号通路改善LPS诱导的ALI。

title: DDIAS shields single-stranded DNA in mitosis and promotes vertebrate brain development.

abstract: DNA double-strand breaks and unresolved DNA replication intermediates are particularly dangerous during mitosis. Paradoxically, cells inactivate canonical DNA repair mechanisms during chromosome segregation in favor of alternative pathways that depend on TOPBP1 and CIP2A, but how these pathways function is still poorly defined. Here, we describe the identification of DDIAS as a mitosis-specific DNA damage response protein. We establish DDIAS as a phosphorylation-dependent component and effector of the TOPBP1-CIP2A complex, and we demonstrate that DDIAS protects single-stranded DNA from aberrant nucleolytic processing to safeguard chromosome integrity during mitosis, particularly in BRCA1-/BRCA2-deficient cells. We also identify biallelic inactivating mutations in DDIAS in patients with a severe neurodevelopmental disorder and, using human cerebral organoids and zebrafish, we show that DDIAS plays a critical and evolutionarily conserved role in limiting DNA damage specifically in neural progenitor cells. These findings demonstrate a physiological role for the DNA damage response in mitosis during vertebrate neurodevelopment.
abstractZh: DNA双链断裂和未解决的DNA复制中间体在分裂期尤其危险。矛盾的是，细胞在染色体分离过程中会失活经典的DNA修复机制，转而依赖依赖于TOPBP1和CIP2A的替代途径，但这些途径如何运作仍知之甚少。在此，我们描述了将DDIAS鉴定为一种分裂期特异性DNA损伤反应蛋白。我们确定DDIAS是TOPBP1-CIP2A复合物的磷酸化依赖性组分和效应器，并证明DDIAS保护单链DNA免受异常核酸水解加工，以维护分裂期染色体完整性，特别是在BRCA1-/BRCA2缺陷细胞中。我们还在患有严重神经发育障碍的患者中鉴定了DDIAS的双等位基因失活突变，并利用人类大脑类器官和斑马鱼，我们表明DDIAS在限制神经祖细胞中的DNA损伤方面发挥着关键且进化上保守的作用。这些发现证明了DNA损伤反应在脊椎动物神经发育过程中分裂期的生理作用。

abstract: Pancreatic cancer remains at a stagnant 5-year survival of <13%, attributed to the high heterogeneity and plasticity of these tumors. To circumvent this, we focus on the abundant nuclear protein high mobility group-box protein 2 (HMGB2). HMGB2 depletion is key for establishing replicative senescence in normal cells, but it is significantly overexpressed across multiple cancer types. Here, we combine single-cell and spatial genomics with patient-derived organoids and tumor samples to show how increased HMGB2 availability represents a transcriptional addiction that fuels cell-cycle progression and growth. We repurpose a small molecule inhibitor targeting HMGB2 to interfere with its binding to DNA, restrict chromatin accessibility at promoters, and constrain tumor growth both in vitro and in vivo. 3D chromatin interactions involving HMGB2-bound enhancers and promoters also collapse upon drug treatment. Thus, pharmacological HMGB2 targeting represents a universal strategy for managing cancer progression irrespective of its genetic or molecular characteristics.
abstractZh: 胰腺癌的5年生存率仍停滞在<13%，这归因于这些肿瘤的高度异质性和可塑性。为了规避这一点，我们聚焦于丰富的核蛋白高迁移率族蛋白盒2（HMGB2）。HMGB2的缺失是正常细胞建立复制性衰老的关键，但它在多种癌症类型中显著过表达。在此，我们结合单细胞和空间基因组学与患者来源的类器官和肿瘤样本，展示了HMGB2可用性增加如何代表一种转录成瘾，推动细胞周期进程和生长。我们重新利用一种靶向HMGB2的小分子抑制剂，干扰其与DNA的结合，限制启动子处的染色质可及性，并在体外和体内抑制肿瘤生长。涉及HMGB2结合的增强子和启动子的3D染色质相互作用在药物治疗后也会崩溃。因此，药理学靶向HMGB2代表了一种无论其遗传或分子特征如何，都能管理癌症进展的通用策略。

abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains a leading cause of cancer mortality, with limited therapeutic options and poor clinical outcomes. Tumor heterogeneity is a defining feature of HCC and a major barrier to effective treatment. To address this, we established a biobank of patient-derived HCC organoids generated from diagnostic biopsies, capturing the diversity of clinical features across disease stages. Using a high-throughput phenotypic screening platform, we tested more than 1,600 compounds and identified multiple agents with strong antitumor activity, including candidates suitable for drug repurposing. To further improve therapeutic responses, we systematically evaluated rationally designed doublet and triplet combinations anchored on regorafenib. Several combinations showed enhanced efficacy across HCCOs while maintaining selectivity over non-tumoral cells. In vivo validation of a selected triplet confirmed improved tumor control and tolerability. Together, these findings establish patient-derived organoids as a scalable platform for functional drug discovery and support combination strategies improving response across heterogeneous HCC.
abstractZh: 肝细胞癌（HCC）仍然是癌症死亡的主要原因，治疗选择有限，临床预后差。肿瘤异质性是HCC的一个定义性特征，也是有效治疗的主要障碍。为了解决这一问题，我们建立了一个由诊断性活检产生的患者来源的HCC类器官生物库，捕获了不同疾病阶段临床特征的多样性。利用高通量表型筛选平台，我们测试了超过1600种化合物，并鉴定了多种具有强抗肿瘤活性的药物，包括适合药物再利用的候选药物。为了进一步改善治疗反应，我们系统评估了以瑞戈非尼为基础的合理设计的双药和三药联合方案。几种联合方案在HCCOs中显示出增强的疗效，同时保持对非肿瘤细胞的选择性。选定三药联合方案的体内验证证实了改善的肿瘤控制和耐受性。总之，这些发现确立了患者来源的类器官作为功能性药物发现的可扩展平台，并支持改善异质性HCC反应的联合策略。

abstract:
Background & aims

Primary liver cancer is the third leading cause of cancer death worldwide, and about 70% of hepatocellular carcinomas (HCCs) do not respond to systemic immunotherapies. Transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) remains standard treatment for intermediate-stage HCC, but long-term survival is poor. We aimed to develop a polymeric TACE-like platform to sensitize liver cancer to checkpoint inhibitors by enabling sustained co-delivery of panobinostat and IL-12.Methods

Patient-derived liver cancer organoids were used to screen drugs and identify panobinostat as a cytotoxic agent. We then formulated sustained-release microparticles from anionic poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA) and cationic poly(beta-amino ester) (PBAE) for combined delivery of panobinostat and IL-12, and tested the system in three liver cancer models.Results

The microparticles achieved tumor-specific retention and sustained release for two weeks following a single intratumoral or intrahepatic arterial injection. This led to tumor inhibition and prolonged survival in orthotopic liver cancer models. Mechanistically, treatment promoted tertiary lymphoid structure formation, increased infiltration of immune cells, and elevated pro-inflammatory cytokines, triggering innate and adaptive antitumor immune responses.Conclusions

A PLGA/PBAE sustained-release microparticle platform was successfully developed for TACE-like co-delivery of panobinostat and IL-12. This combined chemoimmunotherapy strategy shows promise for overcoming immune suppression and improving liver cancer treatment.
abstractZh:
背景与目的

原发性肝癌是全球癌症死亡的第三大原因，约70%的肝细胞癌（HCC）对系统性免疫治疗无反应。经动脉化疗栓塞（TACE）仍是中期HCC的标准治疗，但长期生存率较差。我们旨在开发一种聚合物TACE样平台，通过持续共递送帕诺比诺他和IL-12，使肝癌对检查点抑制剂敏感。方法

使用患者来源的肝癌类器官筛选药物，并确定帕诺比诺他为细胞毒性药物。然后，我们由阴离子聚乳酸-羟基乙酸共聚物（PLGA）和阳离子聚β-氨基酯（PBAE）制备缓释微粒，用于联合递送帕诺比诺他和IL-12，并在三种肝癌模型中测试该系统。结果

该微粒在单次瘤内或肝动脉内注射后，实现了肿瘤特异性滞留和持续两周的释放。这导致原位肝癌模型中的肿瘤抑制和生存期延长。机制上，治疗促进了三级淋巴结构形成，增加了免疫细胞浸润，并升高了促炎细胞因子，触发先天性和适应性抗肿瘤免疫反应。结论

成功开发了PLGA/PBAE缓释微粒平台，用于TACE样共递送帕诺比诺他和IL-12。这种联合化学免疫治疗策略显示出克服免疫抑制和改善肝癌治疗的潜力。

abstract:
Background

Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a well-established high-risk contributor for the pathogenesis of colitis-associated colorectal cancer (CAC), with patients exhibiting a markedly increased risk of CAC compared with the general population. However, the underlying mechanisms driving this transformation are incompletely elucidated.Methods

The expression of key molecules in the cGAS-STING/NF-κB signaling pathway was detected via RT-qPCR and Western blot. Immunofluorescence staining was performed to assess the release of double-stranded DNA (dsDNA). Immunohistochemistry (IHC) was used to examine the expression of cGAS, STING, p-p65, Ki67, and Cleaved caspase-3. Colon crypt cells isolated from mice were utilized to establish an organoid model, through which organoid viability, morphology, inflammatory factor secretion, and p65 nuclear translocation were evaluated. Dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced UC mouse model and azoxymethane (AOM)/DSS combined CAC mouse model were constructed. Disease activity index (DAI), colon length, and tumor number were recorded to evaluate disease progression and verify the in vivo function of the cGAS-STING pathway. Plasmid transfection and pathway inhibitors were applied to explore the specific mechanisms underlying the cGAS-STING pathway.Results

Compared with the control group, the mRNA and protein levels of cGAS-STING/NF-κB pathway-related molecules were progressively elevated, while IκBα expression was reduced, accompanied by cytoplasmic dsDNA accumulation in colonic tissues of UC and CAC mice, indicating that this pathway was gradually activated during the progression from inflammation to tumorigenesis. In the colon organoid model, DSS treatment triggered activation of this pathway, resulting in structural destruction and enhanced secretion of inflammatory cytokines. The STING agonist SR-717 exacerbated these pathological changes and facilitated p65 nuclear translocation, whereas the STING inhibitor H-151 or cGAS knockdown alleviated tissue injury and suppressed p65 nuclear translocation. Mechanistic investigations revealed that the NF-κB inhibitor Bay11-7082 effectively abrogated the proinflammatory effects induced by SR-717. Consistent with in vitro findings, in vivo data from the CAC mouse model further demonstrated that SR-717 administration promoted tumor formation, as evidenced by upregulated expression of the proliferation marker Ki67 and downregulated expression of the apoptotic marker Cleaved caspase-3. Notably, co-treatment with Bay11-7082 reversed the tumor-promoting phenotypes driven by SR-717.Conclusion

This study suggests that the cGAS-STING signaling pathway plays an important promoting role in the malignant transformation from UC to CAC by activating NF-κB signaling, providing experimental evidence for elucidating the pathogenesis of CAC.
abstractZh:
背景

溃疡性结肠炎（UC）是结肠炎相关结直肠癌（CAC）发病机制中公认的高危因素，与普通人群相比，患者患CAC的风险显著增加。然而，驱动这一转变的潜在机制尚未完全阐明。方法

通过RT-qPCR和Western blot检测cGAS-STING/NF-κB信号通路中关键分子的表达。采用免疫荧光染色评估双链DNA（dsDNA）的释放。使用免疫组织化学（IHC）检测cGAS、STING、p-p65、Ki67和Cleaved caspase-3的表达。利用从小鼠中分离的结肠隐窝细胞建立类器官模型，通过该模型评估类器官活力、形态、炎症因子分泌和p65核转位。构建了葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的UC小鼠模型和氧化偶氮甲烷（AOM）/DSS联合CAC小鼠模型。记录疾病活动指数（DAI）、结肠长度和肿瘤数量，以评估疾病进展并验证cGAS-STING通路的体内功能。应用质粒转染和通路抑制剂来探索cGAS-STING通路的具体机制。结果

与对照组相比，UC和CAC小鼠结肠组织中cGAS-STING/NF-κB通路相关分子的mRNA和蛋白水平逐渐升高，而IκBα表达降低，同时伴有细胞质dsDNA积累，表明该通路在从炎症到肿瘤发生的过程中逐渐被激活。在结肠类器官模型中，DSS处理触发了该通路的激活，导致结构破坏和炎症细胞因子分泌增强。STING激动剂SR-717加剧了这些病理变化并促进了p65核转位，而STING抑制剂H-151或cGAS敲低减轻了组织损伤并抑制了p65核转位。机制研究表明，NF-κB抑制剂Bay11-7082有效消除了SR-717诱导的促炎效应。与体外研究结果一致，CAC小鼠模型的体内数据进一步表明，SR-717给药促进了肿瘤形成，表现为增殖标志物Ki67表达上调，凋亡标志物Cleaved caspase-3表达下调。值得注意的是，与Bay11-7082联合治疗逆转了SR-717驱动的促肿瘤表型。结论

本研究表明，cGAS-STING信号通路通过激活NF-κB信号在UC向CAC的恶性转化中发挥重要的促进作用，为阐明CAC的发病机制提供了实验证据。

abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma features a dense, desmoplastic tumor microenvironment (TME) dominated by cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs). While gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel (approximated as gemcitabine plus paclitaxel [GP]) and gemcitabine plus S-1 (GS) are standard regimens with distinct clinical indications, their specific effects on tumor suppression and CAF-associated stromal remodeling remain unclear. Using a humanized, three-dimensional (3D) S2-013 organoid xenograft model integrating human mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) and human endothelial cells, we investigated the histopathological and immunohistochemical alterations induced by GP and GS. We quantitatively evaluated tumor parenchymal growth using cytokeratin 19 (CK19) and CAF-associated marker profiles, including α-smooth muscle actin (αSMA), fibroblast activation protein (FAP), platelet-derived growth factor receptors (PDGFR), and interleukin-6 (IL-6). Both regimens clearly suppressed tumor growth, but only GP significantly reduced parenchymal tumor growth compared with untreated controls. Notably, the treatments selectively remodeled the peritumoral stroma in the humanized xenograft model: PDGFR-expressing CAF-like cells were significantly reduced in the GP group, whereas FAP-expressing CAF-like cells and IL-6-expressing stromal cells were significantly decreased in the GS group. αSMA expression showed a general decreasing trend in both therapeutic arms. In summary, GP and GS chemotherapies induced distinct, measurable humanized TME remodeling modalities beyond direct cytotoxicity. By successfully recapitulating drug-stroma interactions and suggesting the human MSC origin of the peritumoral CAFs, this study demonstrates the robustness of our organoid xenograft model as a powerful preclinical screening platform for evaluating and predicting the efficacy of novel stroma-targeted and immunomodulatory investigative compounds.
abstractZh: 胰腺导管腺癌具有致密的、以癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）为主的促结缔组织增生性肿瘤微环境（TME）。虽然吉西他滨联合白蛋白结合型紫杉醇（近似为吉西他滨联合紫杉醇[GP]）和吉西他滨联合替吉奥（GS）是具有不同临床适应症的标准治疗方案，但它们对肿瘤抑制和CAF相关基质重塑的具体影响仍不清楚。利用整合了人间充质干细胞（MSCs）和人内皮细胞的人源化三维（3D）S2-013类器官异种移植模型，我们研究了GP和GS诱导的组织病理学和免疫组织化学改变。我们使用细胞角蛋白19（CK19）和CAF相关标志物谱（包括α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（αSMA）、成纤维细胞活化蛋白（FAP）、血小板衍生生长因子受体（PDGFR）和白细胞介素-6（IL-6））定量评估了肿瘤实质生长。两种方案均明显抑制肿瘤生长，但只有GP与未治疗对照组相比显著减少了实质肿瘤生长。值得注意的是，在人源化异种移植模型中，治疗选择性地重塑了瘤周基质：GP组中表达PDGFR的CAF样细胞显著减少，而GS组中表达FAP的CAF样细胞和表达IL-6的基质细胞显著减少。两个治疗组的αSMA表达均呈普遍下降趋势。总之，GP和GS化疗诱导了不同的、可测量的人源化TME重塑模式，这超出了直接的细胞毒性作用。通过成功重现药物-基质相互作用并提示瘤周CAFs来源于人间充质干细胞，本研究证明了我们的类器官异种移植模型作为强大的临床前筛选平台的稳健性，可用于评估和预测新型基质靶向和免疫调节研究化合物的疗效。

title: Evolutionary co-option of endogenous retroviruses: syncytins as regulators of placental development and disease.
titleZh: 内源性逆转录病毒的进化共选：合胞素作为胎盘发育和疾病的调节因子。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: Syncytins are envelope proteins of retroviral origin that have been evolutionarily co-opted to play essential roles in placental biology. Primarily recognized for mediating the fusion of cytotrophoblasts into the syncytiotrophoblast, a multinucleated epithelium, critical for nutrient transport and maternal-fetal immune tolerance. Syncytins also contribute to broader aspects of placental development through diverse mechanistic pathways. This review focuses on the evolutionary origins and functional mechanisms of Syncytin-1 (encoded by HERV-W) and Syncytin-2 (encoded by HERV-FRD) in orchestrating placental morphogenesis and homeostasis. We further discuss the clinical significance of aberrant syncytin expression, which is associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes including preeclampsia, intrauterine growth restriction, gestational diabetes mellitus, and trophoblastic disease. Additionally, we examine how exogenous viral infections, such as cytomegalovirus and SARS-CoV-2, may disrupt syncytin transcriptional regulation and compromise placental integrity. Collectively, syncytins represent a paradigm of evolutionary viral domestication, wherein pathogenic genetic elements have been repurposed into indispensable mediators of human reproduction. Their precise spatiotemporal regulation is paramount for optimal placental function and maternal-fetal health. Future research leveraging advanced omics technologies and placental organoid systems will be instrumental in elucidating underlying molecular mechanisms and developing targeted therapeutic interventions for pregnancy-related disorders.
abstractZh: 合胞素是逆转录病毒来源的包膜蛋白，在进化上被共选，在胎盘生物学中发挥重要作用。它们主要被认为介导细胞滋养层融合成合体滋养层，这是一种多核上皮，对营养运输和母胎免疫耐受至关重要。合胞素还通过多种机制途径促进胎盘发育的更广泛方面。本综述聚焦于Syncytin-1（由HERV-W编码）和Syncytin-2（由HERV-FRD编码）在协调胎盘形态发生和稳态中的进化起源和功能机制。我们进一步讨论了合胞素异常表达的临床意义，这与不良妊娠结局相关，包括子痫前期、宫内生长受限、妊娠期糖尿病和滋养细胞疾病。此外，我们探讨了外源性病毒感染，如巨细胞病毒和SARS-CoV-2，如何可能破坏合胞素的转录调控并损害胎盘完整性。总的来说，合胞素代表了进化性病毒驯化的典范，其中致病性遗传元件被重新利用为人类生殖不可或缺的介质。它们的精确时空调控对于最佳胎盘功能和母胎健康至关重要。未来利用先进组学技术和胎盘类器官系统的研究将有助于阐明潜在分子机制，并为妊娠相关疾病开发靶向治疗干预措施。

title: Diverse Intestinal Injuries Drive Heterogeneous Transcriptional Responses and Limited Reactivation of Developmental Gene Programs in Human Enteroids
titleZh: 多种肠道损伤驱动人类肠类器官中的异质性转录反应和发育基因程序的有限再激活
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Villanueva JW, Tsai Y, Wu A, Caldwell C, Vallie A, Buerk M, Huang S, Spence JR.
abstract: The murine intestine reactivates developmental gene programs following various forms of damage  in vivo and  in vitro ; however, injury response mechanisms used by the human intestine remain unclear. Using adult human small intestinal epithelium-only organoids (‘enteroids’), we characterized the early response to eight injury conditions and injury-associated signaling pathways (P53, PGE2, YAP, TGFβ) to interrogate whether human developmental genes were activated. P53 activation and decreased proliferation were common features across treatments. Most (7/8) injuries did not activate human development genes. Butyrate is a notable exception given it inhibited P53 and promoted a human developmental transcriptional signature. We observe that P53 induces a human adult gene signature while TGFβ and YAP promote a developmental signature. Together our data characterizes various transcriptional responses to injury, supports injury-associated signaling pathways as regulators of human adult and developmental genes, and highlights how our data can be mined to predict injury-specific interventions for epithelial protection.
abstractZh: 小鼠肠道在体内和体外遭受各种形式的损伤后会重新激活发育基因程序；然而，人类肠道使用的损伤反应机制仍不清楚。使用成人人类小肠上皮-only类器官（‘肠类器官’），我们表征了八种损伤条件和损伤相关信号通路（P53、PGE2、YAP、TGFβ）的早期反应，以探究人类发育基因是否被激活。P53激活和增殖减少是各种处理中的共同特征。大多数（7/8）损伤并未激活人类发育基因。丁酸盐是一个显著例外，因为它抑制了P53并促进了人类发育转录特征。我们观察到P53诱导人类成人基因特征，而TGFβ和YAP促进发育特征。总之，我们的数据表征了对损伤的各种转录反应，支持损伤相关信号通路作为人类成人和发育基因的调节因子，并强调我们的数据如何被挖掘以预测针对上皮保护的损伤特异性干预措施。

title: Extracellular matrix context shapes morphogenesis and lactation-associated states in human milk-derived mammary organoids
titleZh: 细胞外基质环境塑造人乳来源乳腺类器官的形态发生和泌乳相关状态
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Hasenauer A, Pascetta V, McCabe MC, Saviola AJ, Ponta S, Yilmaz M, Bossung V, Coelius CL, Biesgen T, Hansen KC, Prekovic S, Ochsenbein-Koelble N, Zenobi-Wong M.
abstract: The mammary gland relies on reciprocal interactions between epithelial cells and their surrounding extracellular matrix (ECM) to form and maintain milk-producing tissue structures. Yet these processes remain difficult to study in human model systems. Mammary epithelial cells (MECs) can be isolated noninvasively from breast milk, but whether they generate three-dimensional organoids and respond to matrix cues has been unclear. Here, human milk-derived MECs (milk MECs) spontaneously form complex organoids, including polarized acinar and terminal duct lobular unit-like structures after isolation. To investigate how matrix composition shapes these organoids, milk MECs were cultured in decellularized mammary ECM (dECM), Matrigel, and collagen I. In dECM, milk MECs formed polarized branched networks with aligned actin organization along collagen fibrils, whereas in Matrigel they adopted a more lactation-associated state, marked by β-casein expression and milk fat globules. Together, these findings establish breast milk-derived MEC organoids as a human model to study how ECM context regulates mammary morphogenesis and lactation biology.
abstractZh: 乳腺依赖于上皮细胞与其周围细胞外基质（ECM）之间的相互作用来形成并维持产乳组织结构。然而，这些过程在人类模型系统中仍难以研究。乳腺上皮细胞（MECs）可以从母乳中无创分离，但它们是否能生成三维类器官并对基质信号作出反应尚不清楚。在此，人乳来源的MECs（乳汁MECs）在分离后自发形成复杂的类器官，包括极化的腺泡和终末导管小叶单位样结构。为了研究基质组成如何塑造这些类器官，将乳汁MECs培养在脱细胞乳腺ECM（dECM）、Matrigel和I型胶原中。在dECM中，乳汁MECs形成极化的分支网络，肌动蛋白沿胶原纤维排列整齐，而在Matrigel中，它们呈现出更接近泌乳相关的状态，以β-酪蛋白表达和乳脂小球为特征。总之，这些发现确立了母乳来源的MEC类器官作为研究ECM环境如何调节乳腺形态发生和泌乳生物学的人类模型。

title: A scalable human neuromuscular organoid platform enables lineage-specific analysis of drug responses in spinal muscular atrophy.
titleZh: 一个可扩展的人类神经肌肉类器官平台能够实现对脊髓性肌萎缩症药物反应的谱系特异性分析。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Lahmann I, García-Pérez A, El-Shimy IA, Martins IA, Nguyen LVN, Moysidou C, Findeisen N, Rudolph I, Bukas C, Cea D, Bassell GJ, Rossoll W, Piraud M, Diecke S, Gouti M.
abstract: Scalable human models that capture interactions between distinct tissues remain limited, constraining mechanistic insight and therapeutic prediction. Here, we established a scalable, automation-compatible human neuromuscular organoid (NMO) platform that enables integrated analysis of neuronal and muscle lineages in spinal muscular atrophy (SMA). Patient-derived NMOs reproducibly self-organise into spinal cord and skeletal muscle compartments and form functional neuromuscular circuits. SMA NMOs recapitulate early disease features, including reduced survival motor neuron (SMN) protein levels and impaired neuromuscular junction (NMJ) maturation. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing identifies lineage-specific transcriptional changes across neuronal and muscle compartments preceding functional deficits. Using this platform, we compared two clinically relevant SMN2 splicing modulators and observed distinct, cell-type-dependent responses. While both compounds increased SMN levels and NMJ number, only one enhanced myofiber growth and improved contractile function. These findings highlight muscle maturation, rather than NMJ number alone, as a key determinant of functional recovery and establish NMOs as a scalable system for studying cell-type-specific therapeutic responses.
abstractZh: 能够捕捉不同组织之间相互作用关系的可扩展人类模型仍然有限，这限制了对机制的理解和治疗预测。在此，我们建立了一个可扩展、自动化兼容的人类神经肌肉类器官（NMO）平台，能够对脊髓性肌萎缩症（SMA）中的神经元和肌肉谱系进行整合分析。患者来源的NMO可重复地自组织形成脊髓和骨骼肌区室，并形成功能性神经肌肉回路。SMA NMO重现了早期疾病特征，包括存活运动神经元（SMN）蛋白水平降低和神经肌肉接头（NMJ）成熟受损。单核RNA测序识别出在功能缺陷出现之前，神经元和肌肉区室中谱系特异性的转录变化。利用该平台，我们比较了两种临床相关的SMN2剪接调节剂，并观察到不同的、细胞类型依赖的反应。虽然两种化合物均增加了SMN水平和NMJ数量，但只有一种增强了肌纤维生长并改善了收缩功能。这些发现强调了肌肉成熟（而非仅NMJ数量）是功能恢复的关键决定因素，并确立了NMO作为研究细胞类型特异性治疗反应的可扩展系统。

title: Modeling sympathetic neuro-cardiac interactions in a hiPSC-based microphysiological system.
titleZh: 在基于hiPSC的微生理系统中模拟交感神经-心脏相互作用。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Reisqs JB, Sleiman Y, Boutjdir M.
affiliations: Cardiovascular Research Program, VA New York Harbor Healthcare System, Brooklyn, USA. mohamed.boutjdir@va.gov.
Department of Medicine, Cell Biology and Pharmacology, State University of New York Downstate Health Sciences University, New York, USA.
Division of Cardiology, Department of Medicine, NYU Grossmann School of Medicine, New York, New York, USA.
abstract: The cardiac autonomic nervous system is a key driver of various cardiac disorders and arrhythmias. However, investigating neuronal regulation of the human heart has proven difficult due to the limited availability of reliable experimental models. Here, we present a novel microphysiological system using a compartmentalized microfluidic device (MFD) to integrate co-cultured human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs) and sympathetic neurons (hiPSC-SNs). MFD is composed of two wide-open chambers separated by microfluidic microchannels. Patch-clamp electrophysiology, RT-qPCR, immunofluorescence, and video-motion recording were used to characterize the phenotype of hiPSC-SNs and their functional coupling with hiPSC-CMs in the MDF. Immunofluorescence and RT-qPCR demonstrated significantly increased expression of the sympathetic neuronal markers peripherin, tyrosine hydroxylase, βIII-tubulin, dopamine β-hydroxylase, and nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, confirming successful differentiation into a sympathetic neuronal phenotype. Patch-clamp electrophysiology further demonstrated functional maturation, with hiPSC-SNs exhibiting spontaneous action potentials and nicotine-triggered membrane depolarization in response to 1 μM nicotine. Co-culture of hiPSC-CMs and hiPSC-SNs within the MFD promoted axonal projection into the cardiomyocyte chamber, establishing a physical connection between the two cell types. After 10 days of co-culture, functional integration was confirmed by a significant increase in hiPSC-CMs action potential frequency and beating rate, as recorded by patch-clamp and video motion tracking, respectively. Furthermore, selective nicotine stimulation of the neuronal chamber increased both action potential frequency and beating rate in hiPSC-CMs, whereas β-adrenergic blockade with 5 μM propranolol significantly reduced the beating rate. Collectively, these data demonstrate the feasibility of differentiating hiPSCs into functional sympathetic neurons and establishing a robust neuro-cardiac interface. This microphysiological system represents a powerful platform for investigating disorders characterized by impaired neuro-cardiac interactions, offering a valuable tool for both disease modeling and pharmacological screening.
abstractZh: 心脏自主神经系统是多种心脏疾病和心律失常的关键驱动因素。然而，由于可靠实验模型的可用性有限，研究人类心脏的神经元调控一直很困难。在此，我们提出了一种新型微生理系统，使用分隔式微流控装置（MFD）整合共培养的人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）来源的心肌细胞（hiPSC-CMs）和交感神经元（hiPSC-SNs）。MFD由两个宽大的开放腔室组成，由微流控微通道分隔。使用膜片钳电生理学、RT-qPCR、免疫荧光和视频运动记录来表征hiPSC-SNs的表型及其在MFD中与hiPSC-CMs的功能偶联。免疫荧光和RT-qPCR显示交感神经元标志物外周蛋白、酪氨酸羟化酶、βIII-微管蛋白、多巴胺β-羟化酶和烟碱型乙酰胆碱受体的表达显著增加，证实成功分化为交感神经元表型。膜片钳电生理学进一步证明了功能成熟，hiPSC-SNs表现出自发动作电位和对1 μM尼古丁刺激的尼古丁触发膜去极化。在MFD内共培养hiPSC-CMs和hiPSC-SNs促进了轴突投射到心肌细胞腔室，建立了两种细胞类型之间的物理连接。共培养10天后，通过膜片钳和视频运动追踪分别记录到hiPSC-CMs动作电位频率和搏动率显著增加，证实了功能整合。此外，选择性刺激神经元腔室中的尼古丁增加了hiPSC-CMs的动作电位频率和搏动率，而5 μM普萘洛尔的β-肾上腺素能阻断显著降低了搏动率。总的来说，这些数据证明了将hiPSCs分化为功能性交感神经元并建立稳健的神经-心脏界面的可行性。该微生理系统代表了研究以神经-心脏相互作用受损为特征的疾病的强大平台，为疾病建模和药理学筛选提供了有价值的工具。

title: From Organoids to Organ-on-Chip: Advancing Human-Relevant Models for Viral Pathogenesis and Antiviral Drug Discovery.
titleZh: 从类器官到器官芯片：推进用于病毒发病机制和抗病毒药物发现的人源相关模型
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Tiwari V, Choe J, Vora A, Kataki I, Roujouleh SAL, Allenspach K, Swanson-Mungerson M, Volin MV, Sundaresan S.
affiliations: Department of Microbiology & Immunology, College of Graduate Studies, Midwestern University, Downers Grove, IL 60515, USA.
Department of Pharmacy, Midwestern University, Downers Grove, IL 60515, USA.
Carl Sandburg High School, Orland Park, IL 60462, USA.
