abstract:
Background and aims

LMNA-related dilated cardiomyopathy (LMNA-DCM) is a progressive genetic disorder characterized by conduction disease, malignant arrhythmias, myocardial fibrosis, and heart failure. Although LMNA mutations have traditionally been associated with cardiomyocyte-intrinsic defects, the mechanisms driving fibrotic remodelling remain incompletely understood.Methods

Spatial transcriptomics and integrated single-nuclei multiomics were performed on explanted human LMNA-DCM hearts to define endothelial transcriptional and epigenomic states associated with fibrosis. Patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cell-derived endothelial cells, engineered cardiac organoids, and the LMNAH222P/H222P mouse model were used to investigate RUNX1-mediated endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndoMT). Genetic and pharmacological RUNX1 inhibition strategies were evaluated in vitro and in vivo.Results

Endothelial populations exhibiting EndoMT-associated transcriptional and epigenomic signatures were identified in human LMNA-DCM hearts. LMNA induced pluripotent stem cell-derived endothelial cells demonstrated endothelial dysfunction, mesenchymal gene activation, and epigenetic activation of RUNX1 following loss of LMNA-mediated repression. Genetic RUNX1 deletion restored endothelial identity, reversed EndoMT-associated transcriptional programmes, and normalized chromatin accessibility at endothelial regulatory loci. In multicellular cardiac organoids, endothelial RUNX1 activation impaired endothelial-cardiomyocyte signalling and cardiomyocyte contractile function, whereas endothelial-specific RUNX1 deletion restored endothelial and myocardial function. Pharmacological RUNX1 inhibition with Ro24-7429 similarly improved endothelial and cardiomyocyte function in vitro and reduced myocardial fibrosis while preserving cardiac function in LMNAH222P/H222P mice, including after disease onset.Conclusions

RUNX1-driven EndoMT represents a central mechanism linking LMNA mutations to fibrotic remodelling in LMNA cardiomyopathy. These findings support endothelial transcriptional reprogramming and RUNX1 signalling as potential therapeutic targets in fibrotic cardiomyopathy.
abstractZh:
背景与目的

LMNA相关扩张型心肌病（LMNA-DCM）是一种进行性遗传性疾病，其特征为传导疾病、恶性心律失常、心肌纤维化和心力衰竭。尽管LMNA突变传统上与心肌细胞内在缺陷相关，但驱动纤维化重构的机制仍不完全清楚。方法

对离体人LMNA-DCM心脏进行空间转录组学和整合的单核多组学分析，以定义与纤维化相关的内皮转录和表观遗传状态。使用患者特异性诱导多能干细胞来源的内皮细胞、工程化心脏类器官和LMNAH222P/H222P小鼠模型研究RUNX1介导的内皮-间质转化（EndoMT）。在体外和体内评估了遗传和药理学RUNX1抑制策略。结果

在人LMNA-DCM心脏中鉴定出表现出EndoMT相关转录和表观遗传特征的内皮群体。LMNA诱导多能干细胞来源的内皮细胞在LMNA介导的抑制丧失后表现出内皮功能障碍、间充质基因激活和RUNX1的表观遗传激活。RUNX1基因缺失恢复了内皮身份，逆转了EndoMT相关的转录程序，并使内皮调控位点的染色质可及性正常化。在多细胞心脏类器官中，内皮RUNX1激活损害了内皮-心肌细胞信号传导和心肌细胞收缩功能，而内皮特异性RUNX1缺失恢复了内皮和心肌功能。药理学RUNX1抑制（Ro24-7429）在体外同样改善了内皮和心肌细胞功能，并在LMNAH222P/H222P小鼠中减少了心肌纤维化，同时保留了心脏功能，包括在疾病发作后。结论

RUNX1驱动的EndoMT是将LMNA突变与LMNA心肌病纤维化重构联系起来的核心机制。这些发现支持内皮转录重编程和RUNX1信号传导作为纤维化心肌病的潜在治疗靶点。

title: Drug Discovery's Blind Spot: Why Organoid-Artificial Intelligence Convergence Demands Integrated Governance.
titleZh: 药物发现的盲点：为何类器官与人工智能的融合需要综合治理。

abstract: Organoid-artificial intelligence (AI) platforms are increasingly central to drug discovery, yet they sit between two governance regimes. AI frameworks presume stable, well-characterized inputs, while organoid ethics focuses on donor consent, moral status, and tissue use, leaving downstream computational uses of organoid-derived data underregulated. This article argues that the convergence of living biological variability with algorithmic decision-making creates a governance vacuum in high-stakes preclinical contexts. The organoid-AI case is distinctive because two mature governance traditions, built on incompatible assumptions, intersect at a decision-critical point, and because organoid-derived biological states are transient and often irrecoverable. The article maps the structural causes of this gap, illustrates its practical consequences through three failure scenarios assessing likely probability and impact, and proposes an integrated two-pillar framework: graduated AI validation indexed to organoid functional complexity and tamper-resistant audit trails linking biological and algorithmic metadata. It concludes that proactive governance is morally preferable to delayed, crisis-driven regulation.
abstractZh: 类器官-人工智能（AI）平台在药物发现中日益核心，但它们处于两种治理制度之间。AI框架假定输入稳定且特征明确，而类器官伦理关注供者同意、道德地位和组织使用，导致类器官衍生数据的下游计算用途监管不足。本文认为，活体生物变异性与算法决策的融合在高度关键的临床前情境中造成了治理真空。类器官-AI案例之所以独特，是因为两个基于不相容假设的成熟治理传统在决策关键点交汇，且类器官衍生的生物状态是瞬态且往往不可恢复的。本文描绘了这一差距的结构性原因，通过三个评估可能概率和影响的失败场景说明其实际后果，并提出了一个综合的两支柱框架：与类器官功能复杂性挂钩的分级AI验证，以及连接生物和算法元数据的防篡改审计追踪。结论是，主动治理在道德上优于延迟的、危机驱动的监管。

abstract: Enteroaggregative Escherichia coli (EAEC) is a leading cause of diarrhea worldwide. Interestingly, EAEC disease outcomes vary dramatically among infected individuals, ranging from asymptomatic colonization to acute and chronic diarrhea. While previous research has focused on EAEC virulence factors, emerging evidence suggests that host genetic and cellular background may be equally important in determining disease susceptibility. To understand host-driven disease heterogeneity, we performed single-cell RNA sequencing on human colon organoids (HCOs) derived from three healthy adult donors following EAEC 042 infection. Surprisingly, despite comparable EAEC adherence across donors, we observed striking donor-specific responses to infection at multiple levels. A total of seven distinct colonic epithelial cell clusters were identified, with striking donor-specific baseline compositions. Following infection, the HCO donors exhibited three distinct response phenotypes evident in both cell type remodeling and gene regulation: hyperresponsive, intermediate, and non-responsive. We further observed extensive donor-specific cell-cell communication networks at baseline and after EAEC infection. This study suggests that the heterogeneity in host epithelial response to EAEC infection extends to the single-cell level. While the colonic regions from which the HCOs were derived represent a potential confounding factor, the magnitude of organoid-to-organoid variation exceeded previously reported regional differences, suggesting intrinsic host factors as a crucial part of response heterogeneity. These findings establish a paradigm for understanding infectious disease susceptibility through the human organoid model system.IMPORTANCEUnderstanding why similar pathogen exposures produce vastly different clinical outcomes is critical for combating infectious diseases. By conducting single-cell RNA sequencing on human colon organoids derived from three different donors, we show that each donor possesses unique intrinsic cellular compositions and distinct transcriptomic responses to enteroaggregative Escherichia coli (EAEC) infection. These findings challenge the traditional pathogen-focused paradigm and highlight the critical role of host factors in infectious disease outcomes. This study also validates human organoids as a powerful platform for studying host heterogeneity, which may help predict disease susceptibility and optimize treatment for diverse patient populations in the future.
abstractZh: 肠聚集性大肠杆菌（EAEC）是全球腹泻的主要原因。有趣的是，EAEC疾病的结局在感染者之间差异显著，从无症状定植到急性和慢性腹泻不等。虽然以往的研究集中在EAEC的毒力因子，但新出现的证据表明，宿主遗传和细胞背景在决定疾病易感性方面可能同样重要。为了理解宿主驱动的疾病异质性，我们对来自三名健康成人供体的结肠类器官（HCOs）在EAEC 042感染后进行了单细胞RNA测序。令人惊讶的是，尽管各供体间EAEC的粘附性相当，我们观察到感染反应在多个层面上存在显著的供体特异性。共鉴定出七个不同的结肠上皮细胞簇，其基线组成具有显著的供体特异性。感染后，HCO供体表现出三种不同的反应表型，在细胞类型重塑和基因调控方面均显而易见：高反应性、中间性和无反应性。我们进一步观察到在基线和EAEC感染后存在广泛的供体特异性细胞间通讯网络。这项研究表明，宿主上皮细胞对EAEC感染反应的异质性延伸到了单细胞水平。虽然HCOs来源的结肠区域是一个潜在的混杂因素，但类器官间变异的幅度超过了先前报道的区域差异，表明内在宿主因素是反应异质性的关键部分。这些发现通过人类类器官模型系统为理解感染性疾病易感性建立了一个范式。重要性：理解为什么相似的病原体暴露会产生截然不同的临床结果对于对抗感染性疾病至关重要。通过对来自三名不同供体的人类结肠类器官进行单细胞RNA测序，我们表明每个供体都具有独特的固有细胞组成和对肠聚集性大肠杆菌（EAEC）感染的独特转录组反应。这些发现挑战了传统的以病原体为中心的范式，并强调了宿主因素在感染性疾病结局中的关键作用。这项研究也验证了人类类器官作为研究宿主异质性的强大平台，这可能有助于预测疾病易感性并在未来为不同患者群体优化治疗。

abstract: In mammalian organisms, native tissue function depends on precise spatial organization down to the cellular level. Reconstituting tissue architectures in 2Din vitroplatforms can provide a means to study direct and indirect cell-cell interactions in a variety of tissue contexts while remaining compatible with high-throughput assays and high-resolution live imaging. We combine cost-effective stereolithography leveraging 3D printing with replica molding to stencil spatially defined, multicellular culture systems with sub-millimeter resolution onto planar substrates. The system is designed for ease of use, requires no complex fabrication setups and scales readily to 96-well plates. Sequential stencil application and removal under a biosafety cabinet enables controlled positioning of multiple cell types and supports the maturation of tissue assemblies. We demonstrate the utility of this stencil-based patterning strategy in three applications. First, we employ a combination of two circular stencils to recreate a structural feature characteristic of the tumor microenvironment of solid tumors: the encapsulation of colorectal cancer cells by cancer-associated fibroblast cells. Resulting cell patternings recapitulate key aspects of native tissue dynamics of the densely packed tumor tissues, in which cancer-associated fibroblast cells actively compress the cancer cells and confer targeted therapy resistance. Second, we probe an engineered synNotch-based signaling system in patterned cell patches that mimics morphogen gradient formation, where GFP-secreting sender cells generate a ligand-dependent gradient. Third, we recapitulate the characteristic crypt-villus architecture of the mammalian intestine by patterning intestinal organoids within a stencil-restricted crypt region and allowing differentiating cells to collectively migrate along a designed villus axis. The presented strategy allows for rebuilding multicellular tissue architecturesin vitrowith biologically relevant spatial precision for high-throughput drug screenings and dissection of tissue-specific cellular interactions.
abstractZh: 在哺乳动物生物体中，天然组织的功能依赖于精确的空间组织，直至细胞水平。在二维体外平台上重构组织架构可以提供一种研究多种组织环境中直接和间接细胞间相互作用的手段，同时保持与高通量测定和高分辨率活细胞成像的兼容性。我们将利用3D打印的经济高效的光刻技术与复制模塑相结合，以亚毫米分辨率在平面基底上模板化空间定义的多细胞培养系统。该系统设计为易于使用，无需复杂的制造设置，并可轻松扩展到96孔板。在生物安全柜中顺序应用和移除模板，能够实现多种细胞类型的受控定位，并支持组织组装的成熟。我们在三个应用中展示了这种基于模板的图案化策略的实用性。首先，我们结合使用两个圆形模板来重现实体瘤肿瘤微环境的结构特征：癌症相关成纤维细胞包裹结直肠癌细胞。所得的细胞图案重现了致密肿瘤组织中天然组织动力学的关键方面，其中癌症相关成纤维细胞主动压缩癌细胞并赋予靶向治疗耐药性。其次，我们在图案化的细胞斑块中探测了基于synNotch的工程信号系统，该系统模拟形态发生素梯度的形成，其中分泌GFP的发送细胞产生配体依赖性梯度。第三，我们通过在模板限制的隐窝区域内图案化肠道类器官，并允许分化细胞沿设计的绒毛轴集体迁移，重现了哺乳动物肠道的特征性隐窝-绒毛结构。所提出的策略允许以生物学相关的空间精度在体外重建多细胞组织架构，用于高通量药物筛选和组织特异性细胞相互作用的解析。

title: Bioinspired Hierarchical Cellulose/MXene Fibers for Integrated Capture and Ultrasensitive Detection of Microplastics in Complex Biological Matrices.

abstract: The long-standing disconnection between enrichment and identification processes fundamentally limits the reliable tracing of microplastics (MPs) in complex aqueous and biological environments. Inspired by the synergistic structure-function design of bee leg villi, we report a bioinspired hierarchical fiber composed of tunicate nanocellulose (TNC) and PDDA-modified positively charged MXene (P-MXene) that seamlessly integrates active capture with molecular identification. Through microfluidic spinning combined with interfacial electrostatic engineering, the hierarchical fiber is endowed with a biomimetic wrinkled topology and a rationally designed positively charged architecture, enabling spontaneous sequestration of negatively charged MPs with an ultrahigh adsorption capacity of 978.9 mg/g, a 9-fold enhancement over pristine fibers. Concurrently, the MXene-functionalized surface serves as an efficient surface-enhanced Raman scattering substrate, delivering an enhancement factor of 1.2 × 105 and enabling a 128-fold improvement in detection sensitivity. Benefiting from this integrated trap-and-sense mechanism, the platform effectively suppresses interference from complex biological matrices and enables trace-level detection of MPs accumulation in plant tissues, such as bean sprouts, revealing preferential retention in the root systems. This work establishes a versatile biomimetic hierarchical fiber-based material platform for detecting trace-level contaminants in realistic biological systems and beyond.
abstractZh: 富集与鉴定过程之间长期存在的脱节从根本上限制了在复杂水环境和生物环境中对微塑料（MPs）的可靠追踪。受蜜蜂腿绒毛协同结构-功能设计的启发，我们报道了一种由被囊纳米纤维素（TNC）和PDDA修饰的正电荷MXene（P-MXene）组成的仿生分级纤维，该纤维将主动捕获与分子识别无缝集成。通过微流控纺丝结合界面静电工程，分级纤维被赋予仿生褶皱拓扑结构和合理设计的正电荷架构，能够自发捕获带负电的微塑料，吸附容量高达978.9 mg/g，是原始纤维的9倍。同时，MXene功能化表面作为高效表面增强拉曼散射基底，增强因子达1.2 × 10^5，检测灵敏度提高128倍。得益于这种集成的捕获-传感机制，该平台有效抑制了复杂生物基质的干扰，并实现了植物组织（如豆芽）中微塑料积累的痕量检测，揭示了其在根系中的优先保留。这项工作建立了一个多功能仿生分级纤维基材料平台，用于在真实生物系统及其他领域中检测痕量污染物。

title: Spatial and single-nuclei transcriptomics reveals idiosyncratic and generic patterns in papillary and anaplastic thyroid cancers.

abstract: Sixty percent of papillary thyroid cancers (PTCs) are driven by BRAFV600E, a mutation associated with high inter- and intra-tumoral heterogeneity. PTCs may become highly aggressive anaplastic thyroid cancers (ATCs). While single-cell transcriptomics may resolve this heterogeneity, it is potentially confounded by technical effects whose correction may dampen inter-tumor variations. Here we profiled ATCs and BRAFV600E PTCs with single-nuclei RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics, and an experimental design disentangling biological and technical variations. It reveals that much transcriptional variation in cancer cells and several immune cell types is idiosyncratic, that is, tumor-specific, a phenomenon obscured by batch integration in a number of single-cell studies. Idiosyncrasies are associated in some cases with genomic aberrations and global tissue states like hypoxia. Beyond idiosyncrasies, differentiation markers SLC5A5 (NIS), TPO, TG, and TSHR are lost in a sequence mirrored by their gain during human thyroid organoids maturation, suggesting a new classification of cancer cell states. PTC cells retain TSHR expression and show features of partial epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) with a massive expression of FN1, which promotes proliferation via an autocrine loop. In contrast, ATCs undergo full-scale EMT, with expression of mesenchymal extracellular components and loss of TSHR. Finally, we show that the microenvironment of cancer cells is driven by inflammation. These findings may help future stratifications of BRAFV600E PTCs.
abstractZh: 60%的甲状腺乳头状癌（PTCs）由BRAFV600E驱动，这是一种与高度肿瘤间和肿瘤内异质性相关的突变。PTCs可能发展为高度侵袭性的间变性甲状腺癌（ATCs）。虽然单细胞转录组学可以解析这种异质性，但它可能受到技术效应的混淆，而对这些效应的校正可能会减弱肿瘤间的变异。在这里，我们使用单核RNA测序和空间转录组学对ATCs和BRAFV600E PTCs进行了分析，并通过实验设计区分了生物学和技术变异。研究揭示，癌细胞和几种免疫细胞类型中的许多转录变异是特异性的，即肿瘤特异性的，这一现象在多项单细胞研究中被批次整合所掩盖。在某些情况下，特异性与基因组畸变和整体组织状态（如缺氧）相关。除了特异性之外，分化标志物SLC5A5（NIS）、TPO、TG和TSHR的丢失顺序与人类甲状腺类器官成熟过程中这些标志物的获得顺序相对应，提示了一种新的癌细胞状态分类。PTC细胞保留TSHR表达，并表现出部分上皮-间质转化（EMT）的特征，伴有大量FN1表达，通过自分泌环促进增殖。相比之下，ATCs经历全面的EMT，表达间质细胞外基质成分并丢失TSHR。最后，我们表明癌细胞微环境由炎症驱动。这些发现可能有助于未来对BRAFV600E PTCs进行分层。

abstract:
Background

Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is the most aggressive subtype of breast cancer with limited treatment options. Although PARP inhibitor (PARPi) offers great promise in treating TNBC with deficiency in homologous recombination (HR), most TNBC patients are HR-proficient. Furthermore, acquired resistance to PARPi remains as a challenge. Thus, there is an unmet need to identify new therapeutic target for developing advanced TNBC treatment strategy.Methods

I-SceI reporter assay and alkaline comet assay were used to analyze the role of Smyca in HR repair. Ingenuity pathway analysis was used to identify upstream regulators of Smyca-regulated transcriptome. RNA immunoprecipitation and RNA pull down were used to examine Smyca-FOXM1 interaction. Chromatin immunoprecipitation followed by sequencing was performed to identify FOXM1 target genes that are regulated by Smyca. Chromatin isolation by RNA purification was used to determine Smyca loading onto the promoters of FOXM1 target genes. Patient-derived organoid and xenograft mouse models were performed to evaluate the effect of Smyca on chemoresistance. Nanoparticle-assisted gapmer antisense oligonucleotides delivery was used to target Smyca in vivo. Co-culture of CD3 + T cells with TNBC cells and syngeneic mouse model were used to examine the effect of Smyca-FOXM1 targeting on anti-tumor immunity.Results

The long non-coding RNA Smyca is highly expressed in TNBC. We show that Smyca is induced by genotoxic agents to enhance HR repair. Mechanistically, Smyca binds FOXM1 and promotes the recruitment of FOXM1 to the promoters of a set of HR and nucleotide metabolism genes, thereby promoting their expression. Smyca ablation induces BRCAness in HR-proficient TNBC, thereby sensitizing these tumors to platinum or PARPi. Furthermore, targeting Smyca-FOXM1 complex in combination with platinum or PARPi activates cGAS/STING pathway and tumor immunogenicity to enhance anti-tumor immune surveillance. Clinically, Smyca expression in breast cancer patients correlates positively with therapy resistance and negatively with HR deficiency, interferon signature, and infiltration of anti-tumor immune cells.Conclusions

Our study identifies an unprecedented role of Smyca in HR repair to promote TNBC survival and immune evasion in response to therapy and suggests Smyca as a potential target for sensitizing TNBC to chemotherapy, PARPi, or immunotherapy.
abstractZh:
背景

三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是最具侵袭性的乳腺癌亚型，治疗选择有限。尽管PARP抑制剂（PARPi）在治疗同源重组（HR）缺陷的TNBC方面显示出巨大潜力，但大多数TNBC患者是HR功能正常的。此外，对PARPi的获得性耐药仍然是一个挑战。因此，确定新的治疗靶点以制定先进的TNBC治疗策略的需求尚未得到满足。方法

使用I-SceI报告基因实验和碱性彗星实验分析Smyca在HR修复中的作用。使用 ingenuity 通路分析识别Smyca调控转录组的上游调控因子。使用RNA免疫沉淀和RNA pull-down检测Smyca-FOXM1相互作用。进行染色质免疫沉淀后测序，以鉴定受Smyca调控的FOXM1靶基因。使用RNA纯化染色质分离法确定Smyca在FOXM1靶基因启动子上的装载。使用患者来源的类器官和异种移植小鼠模型评估Smyca对化疗耐药的影响。使用纳米颗粒辅助的gapmer反义寡核苷酸递送在体内靶向Smyca。使用CD3+T细胞与TNBC细胞共培养和同基因小鼠模型检测靶向Smyca-FOXM1对抗肿瘤免疫的影响。结果

长链非编码RNA Smyca在TNBC中高表达。我们证明Smyca由基因毒性药物诱导以增强HR修复。机制上，Smyca结合FOXM1并促进FOXM1招募到一组HR和核苷酸代谢基因的启动子上，从而促进其表达。Smyca消融在HR功能正常的TNBC中诱导BRCAness表型，从而使这些肿瘤对铂类药物或PARPi敏感。此外，靶向Smyca-FOXM1复合物联合铂类药物或PARPi可激活cGAS/STING通路和肿瘤免疫原性，增强抗肿瘤免疫监视。临床上，乳腺癌患者中Smyca表达与治疗耐药呈正相关，与HR缺陷、干扰素特征和抗肿瘤免疫细胞浸润呈负相关。结论

我们的研究揭示了Smyca在HR修复中促进TNBC存活和治疗反应中免疫逃逸的前所未有的作用，并提示Smyca是使TNBC对化疗、PARPi或免疫治疗敏感的潜在靶点。

abstract:
Study question

Does the endometrium of oligo-ovulatory women with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS) exhibit menstrual cycle phase-specific transcriptomic alterations compared to women without PMOS?Summary answer

Compared to healthy controls, women with PMOS exhibit endometrial transcriptomic dysregulations which are menstrual cycle phase-specific and, most notably, related to mitochondrial function.What is known already

Infertility and gestational dysfunction in women with PMOS are increasingly attributed to endometrial abnormalities, yet the underlying mechanisms behind PMOS-related endometrial dysfunction remain unclear. Previous studies have focused on anovulatory phenotypes, resulting in a poor understanding of cycle phase-specific defects in the endometria of women with PMOS.Study design, size, duration

Endometrial biopsies were obtained from oligo-ovulatory women with PMOS and healthy controls at four distinct menstrual cycle phases (proliferative, early-, mid-, and late-secretory phases) and subjected to RNA sequencing. Parallel in vitro experiments were conducted using cultured endometrial stromal cells (ESCs) and epithelial organoids (EEOs) derived from an additional endometrial sample cohort.Participants/materials, setting, methods

RNA sequencing was performed on biopsies from 78 (oligo-)ovulatory women, age- and BMI-matched between PMOS (n = 39) and control (n = 39) groups. Phase-specific transcriptomic profiles and pathway enrichment analyses were performed. For functional assays, endometrial cells were isolated from four PMOS and four control donors per BMI group (lean: Main results and the role of chance

Endometrial transcriptomes clustered primarily by cycle phase; however, PMOS-specific dysregulation was observed related to extracellular matrix organization, estrogen receptor (ESR) signaling, ion transport, and mitochondrial respiratory function. Gene trajectory analyses revealed phase-specific alterations in progesterone-, insulin signaling-, and mitochondria-related gene expression during the early-secretory phase, and epithelial function during the mid-secretory phase. Functionally, decidualized ESCs from obese PMOS women displayed reduced mitochondrial respiration, whereas EEOs from lean PMOS patients exhibited increased mitochondrial activity.Large scale data

Sequencing data are available from the corresponding author upon request.Limitations, reasons for caution

Women with PMOS were oligo-ovulatory while controls exhibited regular cycles. The sample size for in vitro studies was modest, warranting validation in larger cohorts. Additionally, the use of bulk RNA sequencing may obscure cell-type-specific transcriptomic signatures, emphasizing the need for future single-cell approaches to dissect cellular heterogeneity in PMOS endometrium.Wider implications of the findings

This study uncovers dynamic, cycle phase-dependent molecular and bioenergetic alterations in the endometrium of oligo-ovulatory women with PMOS. Mitochondrial dysfunction, particularly during the implantation window, emerges as a key pathological feature. The observed BMI-dependent divergence in mitochondrial function suggests that personalized therapeutic strategies may be necessary to improve reproductive outcomes in women with PMOS.Funding

PRG1076, Swedish Research Council grant no. 2024-02530, Novo Nordisk Foundation grant no. NNF24OC0092384 and Horizon Europe grant NESTOR, grant no. 101120075 (A.S.).Disclosures

The authors declare no competing interests.
abstractZh:
研究问题

患有多内分泌代谢性卵巢综合征（PMOS）的稀发排卵女性的子宫内膜，与无PMOS的女性相比，是否表现出月经周期阶段特异性的转录组改变？

摘要答案

与健康对照组相比，PMOS女性的子宫内膜表现出转录组失调，这些失调具有月经周期阶段特异性，且最显著的是与线粒体功能相关。

已知信息

PMOS女性的不孕和妊娠功能障碍日益归因于子宫内膜异常，但PMOS相关子宫内膜功能障碍的潜在机制仍不清楚。以往的研究集中在无排卵表型上，导致对PMOS女性子宫内膜周期阶段特异性缺陷的了解不足。

研究设计、规模、持续时间

在四个不同的月经周期阶段（增殖期、早分泌期、中分泌期和晚分泌期）从PMOS稀发排卵女性和健康对照者中获取子宫内膜活检样本，并进行RNA测序。使用来自额外子宫内膜样本队列的培养子宫内膜基质细胞（ESCs）和上皮类器官（EEOs）进行了平行体外实验。

参与者/材料、设置、方法

对78名（稀发）排卵女性的活检样本进行了RNA测序，PMOS组（n=39）和对照组（n=39）在年龄和BMI上匹配。进行了阶段特异性转录组谱和通路富集分析。对于功能测定，从每个BMI组（瘦型：<25 kg/m²；肥胖：≥30 kg/m²）的四名PMOS和四名对照捐赠者中分离子宫内膜细胞。

主要结果和偶然性的作用

子宫内膜转录组主要按周期阶段聚类；然而，观察到PMOS特异性失调与细胞外基质组织、雌激素受体（ESR）信号传导、离子转运和线粒体呼吸功能相关。基因轨迹分析揭示了早分泌期孕激素、胰岛素信号传导和线粒体相关基因表达的阶段特异性改变，以及中分泌期上皮功能的改变。功能上，来自肥胖PMOS女性的蜕膜化ESCs表现出线粒体呼吸减少，而来自瘦型PMOS患者的EEOs表现出线粒体活性增加。

大规模数据

测序数据可应通讯作者要求提供。

局限性、注意事项

PMOS女性为稀发排卵，而对照组月经周期规律。体外研究的样本量适中，需要在更大队列中进行验证。此外，使用批量RNA测序可能掩盖细胞类型特异性的转录组特征，强调未来需要单细胞方法以解析PMOS子宫内膜中的细胞异质性。

研究结果的更广泛意义

本研究揭示了PMOS稀发排卵女性子宫内膜中动态的、周期阶段依赖的分子和生物能量改变。线粒体功能障碍，特别是在着床窗口期，成为关键病理特征。观察到的线粒体功能BMI依赖性差异表明，可能需要个体化治疗策略以改善PMOS女性的生殖结局。

资助

title: Tumor Necrosis Factor Receptor 1 Regulates Colonic Mesenchymal Cell Diversity and the Epithelial Stem Cell Niche.
titleZh: 肿瘤坏死因子受体1调控结肠间充质细胞多样性与上皮干细胞微环境
journal: Cellular and molecular gastroenterology and hepatology
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Gadeock S, Girish N, Liu CY, Huang Y, Das B, Grikscheit TC, Polk DB.

abstract:
Background & aims

Tumor necrosis factor receptor 1 regulates intestinal epithelial survival and repair, yet its role in the colonic mesenchyme remains unclear. We investigated how mesenchymal tumor necrosis factor receptor 1 signaling controls stromal cell identity, stem cell niche function, and epithelial homeostasis.Methods

Colonic mesenchymal populations from germline tumor necrosis factor receptor 1-deficient (TNFR1-/-) and mesenchymal-specific Pdgfra-Cre;TNFR1fl/fl mice were analyzed using immunostaining, Western blotting, bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing, and organoid-mesenchymal coculture systems. Functional studies included wound healing assays, recombinant R-spondin 3 rescue, and integrin A6 blockade.Results

Tumor necrosis factor receptor 1 deletion altered mesenchymal composition, reducing platelet derived growth factor receptor α expression while increasing α smooth muscle actin expression in vivo and in vitro. Single-cell RNA sequencing demonstrated loss of mesenchymal heterogeneity following tumor necrosis factor receptor 1 deletion, including depletion of a distinct tumor necrosis factor- and interferon-responsive mesenchymal subpopulation enriched for Mmp9, Cd200, Traf1, and Tnfrsf9. Transcriptomic profiling revealed downregulation of stem cell niche factors including Rspo3, Wnt2b, and Fgf2, alongside increased extracellular matrix and proliferative signaling pathways, particularly integrin A6, phosphoinositide 3-kinase, mitogen-activated protein kinase, and Ras-associated protein 1 signaling. Mesenchymal tumor necrosis factor receptor 1 deletion impaired epithelial proliferation and reduced Lgr5+ and Ephb3+ intestinal stem cell expression in vivo. In organoid coculture systems, tumor necrosis factor receptor 1-deficient mesenchymal cells suppressed epithelial stem cell marker expression and altered colonoid morphology, effects which were rescued by recombinant R-spondin 3. Integrin A6 blockade restored platelet derived growth factor receptor α and R-spondin 3 expression and normalized proliferative signaling and migration in tumor necrosis factor receptor 1-deficient myofibroblasts. Similarly, tumor necrosis factor receptor 1-dependent regulation of integrin A6, platelet derived growth factor receptor α, and R-spondin 3 was observed in human colonic myofibroblasts.Conclusions

Mesenchymal tumor necrosis factor receptor 1 preserves colonic mesenchymal diversity, sustains R-spondin 3-dependent stem cell niche signaling, and maintains intestinal stem cell homeostasis.
abstractZh:
背景与目的

肿瘤坏死因子受体1调控肠道上皮的存活与修复，但其在结肠间充质中的作用仍不清楚。我们研究了间充质肿瘤坏死因子受体1信号如何控制基质细胞身份、干细胞微环境功能以及上皮稳态。方法

对来自种系肿瘤坏死因子受体1缺陷（TNFR1-/-）和间充质特异性Pdgfra-Cre;TNFR1fl/fl小鼠的结肠间充质群体，采用免疫染色、Western blotting、批量及单细胞RNA测序以及类器官-间充质共培养系统进行分析。功能研究包括伤口愈合实验、重组R-spondin 3拯救以及整合素A6阻断。结果

肿瘤坏死因子受体1缺失改变了间充质组成，在体内和体外均降低了血小板衍生生长因子受体α的表达，同时增加了α平滑肌肌动蛋白的表达。单细胞RNA测序显示，肿瘤坏死因子受体1缺失后间充质异质性丧失，包括一个富含Mmp9、Cd200、Traf1和Tnfrsf9的独特肿瘤坏死因子和干扰素响应性间充质亚群的耗竭。转录组学分析显示，干细胞微环境因子（包括Rspo3、Wnt2b和Fgf2）下调，同时细胞外基质和增殖信号通路（特别是整合素A6、磷酸肌醇3-激酶、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶和Ras相关蛋白1信号）增强。间充质肿瘤坏死因子受体1缺失在体内损害了上皮增殖并降低了Lgr5+和Ephb3+肠道干细胞的表达。在类器官共培养系统中，肿瘤坏死因子受体1缺陷的间充质细胞抑制了上皮干细胞标志物的表达并改变了结肠类器官形态，这些效应可通过重组R-spondin 3得以拯救。整合素A6阻断恢复了肿瘤坏死因子受体1缺陷肌成纤维细胞中血小板衍生生长因子受体α和R-spondin 3的表达，并使增殖信号和迁移正常化。类似地，在人结肠肌成纤维细胞中也观察到肿瘤坏死因子受体1依赖性的整合素A6、血小板衍生生长因子受体α和R-spondin 3调控。结论

间充质肿瘤坏死因子受体1维持结肠间充质多样性，维持R-spondin 3依赖性干细胞微环境信号，并维持肠道干细胞稳态。

title: Convergent biology, divergent drivers: a cross-species comparison of human and canine invasive urothelial carcinoma
titleZh: 趋同生物学，不同驱动因素：人类与犬类浸润性尿路上皮癌的跨物种比较
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Cho H, Mochel JP, Corbett MP, Oliveira LJ, Allenspach K, Zdyrski C, Pawlak A, Johnson BA, Douglass EF.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Traditional animal models are often inbred and genetically uniform. This makes them powerful for controlled experiments, but it limits how well they represent the patient-to-patient variation seen in real-world disease. Comparative oncology seeks to address this gap by studying naturally occurring cancers in outbred companion animals, especially dogs. Canine medicine offers two important advantages: first, prospective trials can often be completed faster than in humans and second, dogs are already part of the translational pipeline through pharmacokinetic and toxicology studies. Here, we assessed the transcriptional fidelity of human and canine invasive urothelial carcinoma in primary tumors and patient-derived organoids. We then used single-cell and spatial data to resolve the underlying cellular organization. Despite strong species and platform differences, human and canine tumors preserved the same major luminal-basal structure and a similar tumor microenvironment. The two species reached this shared biology through different recurrent mutations. These included FGFR3 alterations in humans and BRAF alterations in dogs, which converged on overlapping pathways and a luminal phenotype. Human and canine organoids also underwent a similar shift in culture. Both became more proliferative and metabolic while losing inflammatory programs. Thus, organoids preserved important tumor biology while introducing predictable platform effects. Single-cell and spatial analyses showed that the luminal-basal axis reflects a gradient of cell states organized around the tumor-stroma boundary, rather than two discrete tumor types. This helps explain why bulk RNA-sequencing subtypes are reproducible but coarse. Together, these findings define where canine and human bladder cancer agree, where they differ, and how dogs can support parallel therapeutic and diagnostic development.
abstractZh:
摘要

  传统的动物模型通常是近交系且遗传背景单一。这使得它们在受控实验中非常强大，但限制了它们对真实世界疾病中患者间差异的代表性。比较肿瘤学旨在通过研究非近交系伴侣动物（尤其是狗）中自然发生的癌症来解决这一差距。犬类医学具有两个重要优势：首先，前瞻性试验通常可以比人类更快完成；其次，狗已经通过药代动力学和毒理学研究成为转化研究管线的一部分。在此，我们评估了原发肿瘤和患者来源类器官中人类与犬类浸润性尿路上皮癌的转录保真度。然后，我们利用单细胞和空间数据解析了潜在的细胞组织。尽管存在强烈的物种和平台差异，人类和犬类肿瘤保留了相同的腔面-基底主要结构以及相似的肿瘤微环境。这两个物种通过不同的反复突变达到了这种共同的生物学特性。这些突变包括人类中的FGFR3改变和犬类中的BRAF改变，它们汇聚于重叠的通路和腔面表型。人类和犬类类器官在培养中也经历了类似的转变。两者都变得更加增殖和代谢活跃，同时失去了炎症程序。因此，类器官保留了重要的肿瘤生物学特性，同时引入了可预测的平台效应。单细胞和空间分析表明，腔面-基底轴反映了围绕肿瘤-基质边界组织的细胞状态梯度，而非两种离散的肿瘤类型。这有助于解释为什么基于批量RNA测序的亚型是可重复的但较为粗糙。总之，这些发现定义了犬类和人类膀胱癌的一致之处、差异之处，以及狗如何支持平行的治疗和诊断开发。

title: Label-Free Quantification of Microtissue Growth Dynamics Using Optical Flow and Mitosis Detection
titleZh: 基于光流和有丝分裂检测的微组织生长动力学的无标记定量分析
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Fastabend KL, von Trotha T, Wolf K, Chatt R, Benn MC, Vogel V, Kollmannsberger P.
abstract:
While geometric constraints shape tissue development, quantifying the resulting growth dynamics remains a central challenge in tissue engineering. Conventional methods often struggle to capture multi-scale kinetics without complex labeling or difficult single-cell tracking. Here, we analyze geometrically controlled growth of microtissues derived from human dermal fibroblasts using time-resolved, label-free brightfield microscopy, combined with optical flow and semi-automated deep learning mitosis detection. By extracting multi-scale flow fields and integrating them with tissue segmentation, we quantify directional tissue dynamics, separating flow into parallel and normal components relative to the local tissue contour. Applying this framework, we contrast the quiescent tissue interior with the advancing growth front where localized dynamics and cell proliferation drive expansion. Our results demonstrate that, compared to the bulk, the growth front exhibits higher fluctuations parallel to the tissue contour, positive mean normal flow, and significantly increased mitotic activity. Furthermore, evaluating flow divergence around mitotic events reveals distinct spatial behaviors: with the onset of mitosis, a contraction and subsequent expansion occurs in the vicinity of the dividing cells. Beyond the immediate cellular neighborhood, the broader regional dynamics remain consistent before and after mitosis onset, with net tissue expansion in proximity to the growth front and contraction within the tissue interior. By extracting continuous kinetic data from easily accessible, label-free brightfield imaging, this approach serves as a non-invasive, complementary tool for evaluating in vitro tissue morphogenesis and growth dynamics. This analytical framework can be expanded to study locally resolved tissue morphogenesis and growth kinetics in other microsystems, ranging from embryos to organoids. Statement of Significance

  Understanding how localized cellular forces drive tissue growth is critical for mechanobiology. However, mapping these dynamics traditionally requires complex, invasive fluorescent labeling. We present an accessible, label-free computational framework combining optical flow and deep learning-based mitosis detection to quantify continuous tissue kinematics directly from standard brightfield microscopy. Applying this to 3D microtissues, we reveal a distinct spatial coupling between cell division, local mechanical fluctuations, and directed tissue expansion at the active growth front. This non-invasive approach bridges the gap between singlecell mechanics and macroscopic morphogenesis, offering a versatile tool to monitor complex in vitro model systems–like organoids and bioengineered tissues–without disrupting their native state.
abstractZh:
尽管几何约束塑造了组织发育，但量化由此产生的生长动力学仍然是组织工程中的一个核心挑战。传统方法通常难以在不进行复杂标记或困难的单细胞追踪的情况下捕捉多尺度动力学。在此，我们利用时间分辨、无标记的明场显微镜，结合光流和半自动深度学习有丝分裂检测，分析了源自人真皮成纤维细胞的微组织在几何控制下的生长。通过提取多尺度流场并将其与组织分割相结合，我们量化了定向组织动力学，将流动分解为相对于局部组织轮廓的平行和法向分量。应用这一框架，我们将静止的组织内部与活跃的生长前沿进行对比，后者表现出局部动力学和细胞增殖驱动扩张。我们的结果表明，与组织主体相比，生长前沿在平行于组织轮廓的方向上表现出更高的波动，具有正的平均法向流动，并且有丝分裂活性显著增加。此外，评估有丝分裂事件周围的流动散度揭示了不同的空间行为：随着有丝分裂的开始，分裂细胞附近发生收缩和随后的扩张。在直接细胞邻域之外，更广泛的区域动力学在有丝分裂开始前后保持一致，在生长前沿附近表现为净组织扩张，而在组织内部表现为收缩。通过从易于获取、无标记的明场成像中提取连续的动力学数据，该方法可作为评估体外组织形态发生和生长动力学的非侵入性、互补性工具。该分析框架可扩展用于研究其他微系统中的局部解析组织形态发生和生长动力学，范围从胚胎到类器官。意义声明

理解局部细胞力如何驱动组织生长对于力学生物学至关重要。然而，传统上绘制这些动力学需要复杂、侵入性的荧光标记。我们提出了一种易于使用、无标记的计算框架，结合光流和基于深度学习的有丝分裂检测，直接从标准明场显微镜中量化连续的组织运动学。将其应用于3D微组织，我们揭示了细胞分裂、局部机械波动和活跃生长前沿处定向组织扩张之间的独特空间耦合。这种非侵入性方法弥合了单细胞力学与宏观形态发生之间的差距，为监测复杂的体外模型系统（如类器官和生物工程组织）提供了一种多功能工具，且不会干扰其天然状态。

title: TR-107, a novel mitochondrial ClpP agonist, induces robust antitumor activity against preclinical models of adrenocortical carcinoma
titleZh: TR-107，一种新型线粒体ClpP激动剂，在肾上腺皮质癌临床前模型中诱导强效抗肿瘤活性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Karadimov GI, Kim YS, Fu H, Narula S, Elloumi F, Dhall A, Echtenkamp F, Li L, Iwanowicz EJ, Graves LM, Chan K, Andresson T, Robey RW, Greer Y, Lipkowitz S, Hoang CD, Hernandez JM, Pommier Y, Aladjem MI, Weyemi U, Boufraqech M, Kumar SM, del Rivero J.
abstract:
Abstract 

  Adrenocortical carcinoma (ACC) is a rare and highly aggressive endocrine malignancy originating from the adrenal cortex with limited effective treatment options. The underlying pathophysiology of ACC is uniquely characterized by abnormal steroid production and increased metabolic activity, highlighting the critical role of mitochondria in adrenal steroid hormone biosynthesis and tumor metabolism. In this study, we investigated the therapeutic potential of TR-107, a novel and highly selective small-molecule agonist targeting the mitochondrial protease ClpP. Pharmacologic hyperactivation of ClpP disrupts mitochondrial proteostasis and bioenergetics and has shown promising antitumor activity in various preclinical models. Our results demonstrated that TR-107 induces potent dose-dependent cytotoxic effects at nanomolar concentrations in ACC cell lines NCI-H295R and mACC3 as well as short-term ACC patient-derived organoid (PDO) models, markedly reducing cell viability and confluency  in vitro . Metabolic analyses revealed that TR-107 significantly impaired oxygen consumption, indicating a disruption of oxidative phosphorylation and substantial attenuation of basal cellular respiration. Mechanistic studies showed dose-dependent increases in reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels and upregulation of proteins involved in mediating the ferroptotic rheostat. Pharmacokinetic assessment uncovered that TR-107 was not a substrate of the ABCB1 (MDR1/P-glycoprotein) efflux transporter, suggesting potential to overcome common multidrug resistance mechanisms. Given the importance of IGF-2 signaling in ACC, we further explored the combinatorial effects of TR-107 with IGF-1 receptor (IGF-1R) inhibitors and discovered that co-treatment produced synergistic reductions in cell viability across NCI-H295R, mACC3, and ACC PDOs. Collectively, these findings support the potential of mitochondrial ClpP hyperactivation as a promising therapeutic strategy for ACC and demonstrate that TR-107 exhibits significant antitumor activity as a monotherapy or in combination with IGF-1R inhibitors. These findings provide a strong rationale for advancing ClpP agonists into clinical development for the management of ACC.
abstractZh:
摘要

肾上腺皮质癌（ACC）是一种罕见且高度侵袭性的内分泌恶性肿瘤，起源于肾上腺皮质，有效治疗选择有限。ACC的潜在病理生理学独特地表现为类固醇生成异常和代谢活性增加，突显了线粒体在肾上腺类固醇激素生物合成和肿瘤代谢中的关键作用。在本研究中，我们探讨了TR-107的治疗潜力，这是一种靶向线粒体蛋白酶ClpP的新型高选择性小分子激动剂。ClpP的药理学过度激活会破坏线粒体蛋白质稳态和生物能量学，并在多种临床前模型中显示出有前景的抗肿瘤活性。我们的结果表明，TR-107在ACC细胞系NCI-H295R和mACC3以及短期ACC患者来源类器官（PDO）模型中，以纳摩尔浓度诱导强效的剂量依赖性细胞毒性效应，显著降低体外细胞活力和融合度。代谢分析显示，TR-107显著损害氧消耗，表明氧化磷酸化被破坏，基础细胞呼吸显著减弱。机制研究表明，活性氧（ROS）水平呈剂量依赖性增加，并上调参与介导铁死亡调节的蛋白质。药代动力学评估发现，TR-107不是ABCB1（MDR1/P-糖蛋白）外排转运蛋白的底物，提示其具有克服常见多药耐药机制的潜力。鉴于IGF-2信号在ACC中的重要性，我们进一步探讨了TR-107与IGF-1受体（IGF-1R）抑制剂的联合效应，发现联合治疗在NCI-H295R、mACC3和ACC PDO中产生协同降低细胞活力的作用。总的来说，这些发现支持线粒体ClpP过度激活作为ACC有前景的治疗策略的潜力，并证明TR-107作为单药或与IGF-1R抑制剂联合使用时表现出显著的抗肿瘤活性。这些发现为推进ClpP激动剂进入ACC管理的临床开发提供了强有力的依据。

title: ‘An  NF2-  wildtype malignant meningioma cell line for basic and translational science’
titleZh: “一种用于基础与转化科学的NF2野生型恶性脑膜瘤细胞系”
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Chien P, Kohrn BF, Nguyen M, Martins TJ, Emerson S, Kennedy SR, Monnat RJ.
abstract:
Background

  Meningiomas are the most common primary nervous system neoplasm in adults. There are few good cellular models, especially of high grade/malignant meningiomas, to use to identify new therapeutic agents and treatment regimens. The widely available, partially characterized,  NF2- wildtype (  NF2 wt) Grade 3 malignant meningioma cell line IOMM-Lee can help meet this need.  Methods

  We generated new data to better characterize IOMM-Lee genomic and mtDNA variants, proliferation rate and colony-forming efficiency and sensitivity to ionizing radiation as a function of ATM kinase activity. A screen of 349 anti-cancer drugs identified multiple, mechanistically distinct clinical use drugs with nanomolar IC  50 values and high drug sensitivity prediction scores.  Results

  Exome sequencing confirmed that IOMM-Lee is  NF2wt , and contains a pathogenic  TERT -promoter (c.-124C>T) variant. Population doubling times (PDT) were short (19-21 hrs), and colony forming efficiency (CFE) high, of up to 87%. IOMM-Lee is comparatively radiosensitive with a D  10 of ∼3.9 Gy, and could be radiosensitized by AZD-1390-mediated ATM kinase inhibition. Thirty-four anti-cancer compounds spanning several mechanistic classes were identified that potently suppressed cell proliferation at sub-micromolar IC  50 values with high Breeze 2.0 Drug Sensitivity Scores.  Importance of the Study

  We provide new data to better characterize IOMM-Lee, the most widely used cell line model of human Grade 3 malignant meningioma. These data identify and characterize IOMM-Lee genomic alterations and mtDNA variants; quantify growth kinetics and ionizing radiation sensitivity; and identify multiple mechanistically distinct, clinical use drugs with nanomolar IC  50 values, high drug sensitivity prediction scores and potential as meningioma systemic therapies. Our data more clearly locate IOMM-Lee in the landscape of genomically-defined meningiomas, and will aid better use of this experimentally tractable cell line model to understand meningioma biology and identify more effective malignant meningioma therapies and treatment regimens.  Key points

  IOMM-Lee lacks  NF2 mutations, though is clearly related to but distinct from many other meningiomas and meningioma cell lines.  IOMM-Lee grows rapidly, is comparatively radio-sensitive, and can be suppressed by several mechanistic classes of anti-cancer agents at clinically achievable, sub-micromolar IC  50 values with high Drug Sensitivity Scores.  The experimental tractability, simplicity and versatility of IOMM-Lee can facilitate analyses of many aspects of meningioma biology and therapeutic development across a wide range of  in vitro , high throughput and  in vivo xenograft/organoid protocols.
abstractZh:
背景

脑膜瘤是成人最常见的原发性神经系统肿瘤。目前缺乏良好的细胞模型，尤其是高级别/恶性脑膜瘤模型，用于识别新的治疗药物和治疗方案。广泛可用且部分表征的NF2野生型（NF2 wt）3级恶性脑膜瘤细胞系IOMM-Lee可帮助满足这一需求。

方法

我们生成了新数据，以更好地表征IOMM-Lee的基因组和线粒体DNA变异、增殖速率、集落形成效率以及对电离辐射的敏感性（作为ATM激酶活性的函数）。对349种抗癌药物的筛选识别出多种机制不同的临床使用药物，其IC50值达到纳摩尔级别，且药物敏感性预测评分较高。

结果

外显子组测序证实IOMM-Lee为NF2wt，并含有致病性TERT启动子（c.-124C>T）变异。群体倍增时间（PDT）较短（19-21小时），集落形成效率（CFE）高达87%。IOMM-Lee相对放射敏感，D10约为3.9 Gy，并可通过AZD-1390介导的ATM激酶抑制而增敏。共鉴定出34种涵盖多种机制类别的抗癌化合物，在亚微摩尔IC50值下能有效抑制细胞增殖，且Breeze 2.0药物敏感性评分较高。

研究重要性

我们提供了新数据以更好地表征IOMM-Lee，这是最广泛使用的人类3级恶性脑膜瘤细胞系模型。这些数据识别并表征了IOMM-Lee的基因组改变和线粒体DNA变异；量化了生长动力学和电离辐射敏感性；并识别出多种机制不同、具有纳摩尔IC50值、高药物敏感性预测评分且有望作为脑膜瘤全身治疗药物的临床使用药物。我们的数据更清晰地定位了IOMM-Lee在基因组定义的脑膜瘤图谱中的位置，并将有助于更好地利用这一实验易处理的细胞系模型来理解脑膜瘤生物学，并识别更有效的恶性脑膜瘤疗法和治疗方案。

关键点

IOMM-Lee缺乏NF2突变，但与其他许多脑膜瘤和脑膜瘤细胞系明显相关但又有区别。
IOMM-Lee生长迅速，相对放射敏感，并可通过多种机制类别的抗癌药物在临床可达到的亚微摩尔IC50值和高药物敏感性评分下被抑制。
IOMM-Lee的实验易处理性、简单性和多功能性可促进对脑膜瘤生物学多个方面的分析，并支持在广泛的体外、高通量和体内异种移植/类器官方案中进行治疗开发。

title: Epigenetic evolution of colorectal cancer and its microenvironment reveals new vulnerabilities
titleZh: 结直肠癌及其微环境的表观遗传演化揭示新的脆弱性
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Livanova A, Azzolin L, Cambuli F, Chemi F, James C, Ferrazzano A, Rusconi F, D'Agosto S, Mulas I, Randon G, Prisciandaro M, Raimondi A, Ghelardi F, Ambrosini M, Manca P, Palermo F, Niger M, Sottotetti E, Martinetti A, Maspero M, Sposito C, Ferrari P, Lamparelli L, Bautista D, Ricciardelli E, Simeoni F, Rotta L, Peano C, Mazzaferro V, Graham T, Pietrantonio F, Sottoriva A.
abstract: Epigenetics is central to tumorigenesis, but the co-evolution of the cancer epigenome and its microenvironment is severely understudied. Here, we measure chromatin accessibility and transcriptome, at single cell resolution, of a set of normal colon, primary colorectal cancers and metastases, and identify recurrent epigenetic alterations in tumour cells. We also found that the normal epithelium adjacent to the cancer had recurrent epigenetic alterations associated with inflammatory programs that were partially shared with tumour cells. Distinct tumour-intrinsic transcription factor binding programs were associated with differential abundance of malignant stroma cell identities. We then leveraged matched patient-derived organoids, to assess the functional impact of the most recurrent epigenetic alterations on cancer cell viability, using CRISPR interference. We found a set of epigenetic-driven cancer dependencies, related to developmental reprogramming and cellular stress resilience, representing new potential therapeutic targets.
abstractZh: 表观遗传学是肿瘤发生的核心，但癌症表观基因组与其微环境的共同演化研究严重不足。在此，我们在单细胞分辨率下测量了一组正常结肠、原发性结直肠癌和转移灶的染色质可及性和转录组，并识别了肿瘤细胞中复发性表观遗传改变。我们还发现，与癌症相邻的正常上皮具有与炎症程序相关的复发性表观遗传改变，这些改变部分与肿瘤细胞共享。不同的肿瘤内在转录因子结合程序与恶性基质细胞身份的差异丰度相关。随后，我们利用匹配的患者来源类器官，通过CRISPR干扰评估了最复发性表观遗传改变对癌细胞活力的功能影响。我们发现了一组由表观遗传驱动的癌症依赖性，涉及发育重编程和细胞应激韧性，代表了新的潜在治疗靶点。

title: Adrenomedullary Organoids Derived from Neural Crest and Schwann Cell Precursors
titleZh: 源自神经嵴和施万细胞前体的肾上腺髓质类器官
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Wu H, McAlpine J, James C, Saini T, Padhi P, Baxley SD, Stewart CL, Seo DE, Huang M, Ulrichs H, Art J, Santori FR, Kanthasamy AG, Lee D, Ivanova NB, Avraham O, Zeltner N.
abstract: Abstract    The adrenal gland, essential for survival, contains the medulla and cortex. Chromaffin cells (ChrCs) in the adrenal medulla control the fight-or-flight response by releasing catecholamines like epinephrine and norepinephrine. Recent findings reveal that ChrCs originate from two progenitors: 20% from developmentally early, neural crest-derived sympathoadrenal progenitors (SAPs) and 80% from the later Schwann cell precursors (SCPs). We generated functional adrenomedullary organoids from human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs) via both pathways and in mixed (20% SAP, 80% SCP-derived) cultures. When implanted into chicken embryos, the organoids migrated and integrated into the adrenal gland anlagen.  In vitro  , they released norepinephrine and epinephrine in response to stimulation. Single-cell transcriptomics confirmed developmental trajectories matching human fetal data and allowed the identification of a novel ChrC subtype specifically derived from the SAP that may be responsible for mediating the severe stress reaction via EPI. Assessing developmental knowledge in this human system, we found that SAPs differentiated into ChrCs, but not sympathetic neurons or Schwann cells, showing limited plasticity. Meanwhile, SCPs could produce various cell types but not sympathetic neurons. Furthermore, our work reveals that under stress conditions, SAP-derived ChrCs mainly release epinephrine, while SCP-derived ChrCs release norepinephrine, highlighting distinct functions based on developmental origin. These organoids provide valuable models for studying ChrC development, interactions, and adrenal pathologies.
abstractZh: 摘要    肾上腺对生存至关重要，包含髓质和皮质。肾上腺髓质中的嗜铬细胞（ChrCs）通过释放儿茶酚胺（如肾上腺素和去甲肾上腺素）来控制“战斗或逃跑”反应。最新研究发现，ChrCs起源于两种祖细胞：20%来自发育早期、神经嵴来源的交感肾上腺祖细胞（SAPs），80%来自较晚期的施万细胞前体（SCPs）。我们通过这两种途径以及混合培养（20% SAP来源，80% SCP来源）从人多能干细胞（hPSCs）生成了功能性肾上腺髓质类器官。当植入鸡胚时，这些类器官迁移并整合到肾上腺原基中。在体外，它们响应刺激释放去甲肾上腺素和肾上腺素。单细胞转录组学证实了与人胎儿数据匹配的发育轨迹，并鉴定出一种新的、特异性来源于SAP的ChrC亚型，该亚型可能通过肾上腺素介导严重应激反应。在此人类系统中评估发育知识时，我们发现SAPs分化为ChrCs，但不分化为交感神经元或施万细胞，显示出有限的可塑性。同时，SCPs可以产生多种细胞类型，但不能产生交感神经元。此外，我们的工作揭示，在应激条件下，SAP来源的ChrCs主要释放肾上腺素，而SCP来源的ChrCs释放去甲肾上腺素，突出了基于发育起源的不同功能。这些类器官为研究ChrC发育、相互作用和肾上腺病理提供了有价值的模型。

title: A novel multisystem approach uncovers conserved mitochondrial complex I disease phenotypes and suppressors
titleZh: 一种新型多系统方法揭示了保守的线粒体复合物I疾病表型和抑制因子
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ventura N, Jentsch L, Maglioni S, Jerred C, O'Hara T, Mytilinaiou E, Ruiz J, Schaumkessel Y, Schroeter L, Jung J, Yotov N, Hoffmann J, Kremers K, Rossi A, Reichert A, Watts J, Palikaras K, Haroon S, Prigione A.
abstract: Abstract    Mitochondriopathies are a large group of pathological conditions characterized by dysfunction of tissues and organs with high energy needs such as the brain, heart, and skeletal muscles, which highly rely on functional mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS). The vast majority of these disorders are ascribed to mutations in nuclear or mitochondrial encoded subunits of complex I (CI), the largest OXPHOS complex. In this study, we develop a multisystemic pipeline for CI-associated disease based on new approach methods (NAMs), which includes non-mammalian models, namely  C. elegans  and zebrafish, and mammalian cell-based models, such as neuroblastoma cells and induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived neural progenitor cells (NPCs) and brain organoids. Systematic characterization of biochemical and neurobehavioral features in these models reveals obvious mitochondrial alterations with no major signs of redox imbalance possibly due compensatory or tissue-specific effects. Conversely, we identify specific pathogenetic features that are consistent across species and are rescued by lutein or vitamin B12, likely acting through non-cell-autonomous mechanisms converging on neurometabolic rewiring. Overall, our findings support the advantage of leveraging different  in vitro  and  in vivo  NAM systems with their unique and complementary disease endpoints to uncover critical pathological and quantifiable phenotypes exploitable to identify disease modifiers and suppressors.
abstractZh:
摘要
线粒体病是一大类以高能量需求组织和器官（如大脑、心脏和骨骼肌）功能障碍为特征的病理状况，这些组织和器官高度依赖功能性线粒体氧化磷酸化（OXPHOS）。绝大多数这类疾病归因于核基因或线粒体基因编码的复合物I（CI）亚基突变，CI是最大的OXPHOS复合物。在本研究中，我们基于新方法（NAMs）开发了一种针对CI相关疾病的多系统流程，包括非哺乳动物模型，即秀丽隐杆线虫和斑马鱼，以及基于哺乳动物细胞的模型，如神经母细胞瘤细胞和诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源的神经祖细胞（NPCs）和脑类器官。对这些模型进行系统的生化和神经行为特征表征，揭示了明显的线粒体改变，但没有明显的氧化还原失衡迹象，这可能是由于代偿或组织特异性效应。相反，我们识别出跨物种一致的特异性致病特征，这些特征可被叶黄素或维生素B12挽救，可能通过作用于神经代谢重连的非细胞自主机制发挥作用。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持利用不同的体外和体内NAM系统及其独特且互补的疾病终点来揭示关键病理和可量化表型的优势，这些表型可用于识别疾病修饰因子和抑制因子。

title: Transcriptomic Rewiring of Glioblastoma Organoids Reveals an NPC2-associated Neuronal Mimicry Program
titleZh: 胶质母细胞瘤类器官的转录组重编程揭示NPC2相关的神经元拟态程序
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Chen L.
abstract: Abstract    Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) model glioblastoma (GBM), but how isolation from the native microenvironment reshapes malignant cell states remains poorly understood. After re-analyzing public single-cell RNA sequencing datasets of paired primary GBM tissue and derived organoids, we found that  in vitro  microenvironmental deprivation drives a convergent mesenchymal phenotypic collapse, triggered by loss of stromal paracrine signaling. Using consensus non-negative matrix factorization (cNMF), we identified a compensatory "neuronal mimicry" response: isolated GBM cells broadly upregulate neurogenesis program. Functional co-culture experiments showed that peripheral immune cells fail to rescue the native transcriptomic state, but direct physical contact with neurons triggers targeted synaptic rewiring. This contact-dependent neuronal mimicry is concentrated in the neural progenitor-like 2 (NPC2) subtype and involves a structural-to-functional receptor switch. Clinical validation in the TCGA-GBM cohort confirmed that the neuronal mimicry network is conserved and co-regulated  in vivo  , and that the neurogenesis program carries significant adverse prognostic impact. These findings identify NPC2-driven, contact-dependent neuronal mimicry as a survival strategy in GBM and indicate that organoid models in the future should incorporate microenvironmental reconstitution.
abstractZh: 摘要    患者来源的类器官（PDOs）模拟胶质母细胞瘤（GBM），但脱离天然微环境如何重塑恶性细胞状态仍知之甚少。在重新分析配对的原发性GBM组织和衍生类器官的公共单细胞RNA测序数据集后，我们发现体外微环境剥夺驱动了趋同的间充质表型崩溃，这是由基质旁分泌信号丢失触发的。使用共识非负矩阵分解（cNMF），我们识别出一种补偿性的“神经元拟态”反应：分离的GBM细胞广泛上调神经发生程序。功能性共培养实验表明，外周免疫细胞无法挽救天然转录组状态，但与神经元的直接物理接触会触发靶向突触重连。这种接触依赖的神经元拟态集中在神经祖细胞样2（NPC2）亚型中，并涉及从结构到功能的受体转换。TCGA-GBM队列的临床验证证实，神经元拟态网络在体内是保守且共调控的，并且神经发生程序具有显著的不良预后影响。这些发现将NPC2驱动的接触依赖性神经元拟态确定为GBM的一种生存策略，并表明未来的类器官模型应纳入微环境重建。

title: A biomimetic microphysiological system predicts the impact of sepsis therapeutics on neutrophil-endothelial dynamics.
titleZh: 一种仿生微生理系统预测脓毒症治疗药物对中性粒细胞-内皮细胞动力学的影响。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Liu D, Esmalian Afyouni N, Yang Q, Kallogjerovic S, Gligorijevic B, Kunapuli S, Kilpatrick LE, Kiani MF.
affiliations: Department of Bioengineering, Temple University, Philadelphia, PA 19122, USA. mohammad.kiani@temple.edu.
Department of Mechanical Engineering, Temple University, Philadelphia, PA 19122, USA.
Sol Sherry Thrombosis Research Center, Lewis Katz School of Medicine, Temple University, Philadelphia, PA 19140, USA.
Center for Inflammation and Lung Research, Department of Microbiology, Immunology and Inflammation, Lewis Katz School of Medicine, Temple University, Philadelphia, PA 19140, USA.
abstract: Current preclinical models fail to capture human neutrophil-endothelial interactions central to sepsis, contributing to repeated failure of candidate therapeutics in clinical trials. Here, we present a biomimetic microphysiological system (bMPS) integrating primary human endothelial cells, human neutrophils and controlled chemoattractant gradients under physiological flow in a microvascular network. This platform enables real-time visualization of neutrophil adhesion and transmigration, along with quantitative analysis of endothelial barrier integrity. We demonstrate chemoattractant-dependent differential neutrophil recruitment to host-derived IL-8 and bacterial-derived fMLP and differential responses to two different therapeutics: the PAF receptor antagonist BN-52021 reduces recruitment in response to IL-8 but not to fMLP, whereas the PKC-δ inhibitor suppresses adhesion, transmigration, and NET formation to both IL-8 and fMLP. Confocal imaging and quantitative analysis demonstrate that Cytomix-induced endothelial barrier disruption in primary human lung microvascular endothelial cells (HLMVECs) is significantly ameliorated by BN-52021 and the PKC-δ inhibitor-restoring VE-cadherin integrity and reducing intercellular gaps. This bMPS provides a predictive, human-relevant platform for function-focused sepsis drug screening.
abstractZh: 当前的临床前模型无法捕捉脓毒症核心的人中性粒细胞-内皮细胞相互作用，导致候选治疗药物在临床试验中反复失败。在此，我们提出了一种仿生微生理系统（bMPS），该系统在微血管网络中整合了原代人内皮细胞、人中性粒细胞和受控的趋化因子梯度，并在生理流动条件下运行。该平台能够实时可视化中性粒细胞的黏附和跨内皮迁移，并对内皮屏障完整性进行定量分析。我们证明了趋化因子依赖性的差异中性粒细胞募集，即宿主来源的IL-8和细菌来源的fMLP，以及两种不同治疗药物的差异反应：PAF受体拮抗剂BN-52021可减少对IL-8的募集，但对fMLP无此作用，而PKC-δ抑制剂则抑制对IL-8和fMLP两者的黏附、跨内皮迁移和NET形成。共聚焦成像和定量分析表明，在原代人肺微血管内皮细胞（HLMVECs）中，Cytomix诱导的内皮屏障破坏可被BN-52021和PKC-δ抑制剂显著改善，恢复VE-钙黏蛋白完整性并减少细胞间隙。该bMPS为功能导向的脓毒症药物筛选提供了一个预测性、人相关的平台。

title: Artificial intelligence-augmented organ- and organoid-on-a-chip for drug screening.
titleZh: 人工智能增强的器官及类器官芯片在药物筛选中的应用。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Song C, Li T, Guan H, Zhang T, Zhu J, Lei J, Dong F, Liu C, Song Z, Huang L.

abstract: Organ- and organoid-on-a-chip technologies provide critical human-relevant models for drug screening. Despite their promise, translating their complex biological outputs into reproducible, quantifiable, and pharmacologically interpretable readouts remains a significant challenge. To address this, artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly employed to process the high-content imaging, sensor, and molecular data derived from these platforms. Crucially, this integration elevates AI from a conventional post-experimental analytical tool into a comprehensive framework that actively drives quality control, response quantification, model integration, and critical screening decisions. This review examines AI-augmented microphysiological systems across the entire drug screening pipeline by connecting biological readouts with specific computational strategies and pharmacological endpoints. We evaluate representative platforms, analytical methodologies, and specific applications where computational frameworks enable model standardization, robust phenotype interpretation, mechanism-informed evaluation, and compound prioritization. Furthermore, we outline primary barriers to clinical translation, including inherent biological and engineering variability, model generalizability, the need for external validation, and clinical dose relevance. Ultimately, these insights establish a comprehensive framework for evaluating the reproducibility, pharmacological applicability, interpretability, and translational potential of AI-driven microphysiological screening.
abstractZh: 器官及类器官芯片技术为药物筛选提供了关键的人体相关模型。尽管前景广阔，但将其复杂的生物输出转化为可重复、可量化且药理学上可解释的读数仍是一项重大挑战。为此，人工智能（AI）越来越多地被用于处理从这些平台获得的高内涵成像、传感器和分子数据。至关重要的是，这种整合将AI从传统的实验后分析工具提升为一个综合框架，该框架积极驱动质量控制、响应量化、模型整合和关键筛选决策。本综述通过将生物读数与特定的计算策略和药理学终点联系起来，审视了AI增强的微生理系统在整个药物筛选流程中的应用。我们评估了代表性平台、分析方法以及计算框架实现模型标准化、稳健表型解释、机制知情评估和化合物优先排序的具体应用。此外，我们概述了临床转化的主要障碍，包括固有的生物和工程变异性、模型泛化性、外部验证的需求以及临床剂量相关性。最终，这些见解为评估AI驱动的微生理筛选的可重复性、药理学适用性、可解释性和转化潜力建立了一个综合框架。

abstract: Industrialization and clinical translation applications based on organoids are often limited by low automation, high matrix consumption, and poor reproducibility. Here we present the VitroOrganoSphere (VOS) system, an automated droplet-engineered organoid sorting platform, which integrates droplet generation, photoelectric detection, fluorescence-based content evaluation, sorting, and automated dispensing into 96-well plates. Monodisperse droplets (CV <3%) are deposited as single droplets per well with Matrigel consumption as low as ∼0.3 μL. Real-time quality control enables rejection of empty or overloaded droplets and selective collection of droplets with appropriate encapsulation of viable organoids. Under the rigorous screening of two droplet selection criteria (size and sample content), the VOS system ultimately achieved a recovery rate of over 90% and accuracy of over 95%. Encapsulated organoids maintain viability and exhibit enhanced growth compared with manual methods. Drug sensitivity testing using patient-derived tumor organoids reliably distinguishes drug-sensitive and drug-resistant samples and reveals interpatient heterogeneity across multiple therapeutic agents. The VOS system establishes a standardized workflow for automated organoid-based drug screening and supports applications in precision medicine.
abstractZh: 基于类器官的工业化和临床转化应用常常受到自动化程度低、基质消耗高和可重复性差的限制。在此，我们介绍了VitroOrganoSphere (VOS)系统，这是一个自动化液滴工程化类器官分选平台，集成了液滴生成、光电检测、基于荧光的含量评估、分选以及自动分配到96孔板等功能。单分散液滴（CV <3%）以每孔单液滴的形式沉积，Matrigel消耗低至约0.3 μL。实时质量控制能够拒绝空液滴或过载液滴，并选择性收集含有适当封装活类器官的液滴。在严格的两种液滴选择标准（大小和样品含量）筛选下，VOS系统最终实现了超过90%的回收率和超过95%的准确率。封装后的类器官保持活力，并且与手动方法相比表现出增强的生长。使用患者来源的肿瘤类器官进行药物敏感性测试，能够可靠地区分药物敏感和耐药样本，并揭示多种治疗药物之间的患者间异质性。VOS系统为基于类器官的自动化药物筛选建立了标准化工作流程，并支持精准医学中的应用。

abstract: The lymphatic system is essential for fluid homeostasis and immune surveillance, yet its role in skeletal regeneration remains poorly defined. Here, we introduce a biomimetic organ-on-a-chip (OoC) model that recapitulates lymphatic endothelial cell (LEC) behavior under precisely controlled flow-mediated environments and elucidates their regulatory contribution in alveolar bone repair. Under flow-mediated shear stress, LECs exhibited enhanced sprouting, forming lumenized lymphatic structures in vitro. Furthermore, conditioned medium from perfused LECs significantly promoted the proliferation and osteogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs). Mass spectrometry identified WISP1 as a key mechanoresponsive secreted factor with high levels in LECs that activated canonical Wnt signaling in BMSCs, thus contributing to enhanced osteogenic marker expression and mineralization. In vivo validation using a murine molar extraction model with controlled occlusal loading revealed that occlusal loading promoted lymphangiogenesis and accelerated alveolar bone regeneration, accompanied by elevated WISP1 expression within alveolar sockets. Conversely, pharmacological suppression of lymphatic expansion through MAZ51 administration impaired bone formation while reducing WISP1 levels, thereby confirming the functional contribution of lymphatic vessels in alveolar bone regeneration. Together, these findings demonstrate that LECs function as mechanoresponsive regulators that transduce shear-related cues into osteoinductive signals through WISP1-mediated paracrine communication. Our study uncovers a previously unrecognized lymphatic-osteogenic signaling axis and establishes a physiologically relevant OoC platform for systematic investigation of lymphatic mechanotransduction in bone regeneration.
abstractZh: 淋巴系统对于体液稳态和免疫监视至关重要，但其在骨骼再生中的作用仍不明确。在此，我们引入了一种仿生器官芯片（OoC）模型，该模型在精确控制的流动介导环境中重现淋巴内皮细胞（LEC）的行为，并阐明了它们在牙槽骨修复中的调节作用。在流动介导的剪切应力下，LECs表现出增强的出芽，形成体外管腔化淋巴结构。此外，来自灌注LECs的条件培养基显著促进了骨髓间充质干细胞（BMSCs）的增殖和成骨分化。质谱分析鉴定出WISP1是LECs中高表达的关键机械响应性分泌因子，它激活了BMSCs中的经典Wnt信号通路，从而促进了成骨标志物表达和矿化的增强。使用受控咬合负荷的小鼠磨牙拔牙模型进行的体内验证表明，咬合负荷促进了淋巴管生成并加速了牙槽骨再生，同时伴随着牙槽窝内WISP1表达升高。相反，通过MAZ51给药进行药理学抑制淋巴管扩张则损害了骨形成，同时降低了WISP1水平，从而证实了淋巴管在牙槽骨再生中的功能贡献。总之，这些发现表明LECs作为机械响应性调节因子，通过WISP1介导的旁分泌通讯将剪切相关信号转导为成骨诱导信号。我们的研究揭示了一个先前未被认识的淋巴-成骨信号轴，并建立了一个生理相关的OoC平台，用于系统研究骨再生中的淋巴机械转导。

abstract: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) affects more than 4.6 million people annually in the United States, with the true numbers of mild TBI (mTBI) likely much higher due to insufficient detection and diagnosis methods. Some of the current challenges for successfully detecting mTBIs include the lack of patient symptoms and the lack of robust biomarkers for its diagnosis. While the quest for mTBI biomarkers remains an active area of research, the inherent low concentrations and our lack of understanding of the temporal evolution of its parenchymal release pose a significant hurdle to the adoption of blood- or saliva-borne biomarkers for injury diagnosis. Three-dimensional neuroglia and organoid cell culture models offer an opportunity to model TBI and screen for injury biomarker expression profiles. Yet there remains a shortage of lab-on-a-chip platforms capable of monitoring the evolution of injury biomarker onset using both imaging- and extraction-based detection approaches in the same culture platform. In this study, we developed a novel lab-on-a-chip, three-layer microfluidic device capable of reproducibly injuring cortical spheroids to model TBI in vitro. The device can be operated stand-alone with a single pump or straightforwardly integrated with common laboratory microscopes to facilitate real-time imaging access. To demonstrate its applicability for TBI research, compression of cortical spheroids was performed at a strain of 25% and a fixed strain rate of 3.125 s-1 as it is comparable to rates of mild TBI. Assessment of cell viability after 24 hours revealed that the impacted samples, on average, exhibited up to 8% cell death. Additionally, by leveraging a simple push-pull perfusion method, non-impacted samples could be exposed to culture medium from injured organoids on the same chip, which also resulted in increased cell death 24 hours later. These findings demonstrated the capability of this device as a viable in vitro platform of TBI, which should lend itself to investigations of TBI and other diseases.
abstractZh: 创伤性脑损伤（TBI）在美国每年影响超过460万人，而轻度创伤性脑损伤（mTBI）的真实数量可能因检测和诊断方法不足而更高。当前成功检测mTBI面临的一些挑战包括患者缺乏症状以及缺乏可靠的生物标志物用于诊断。虽然寻找mTBI生物标志物仍是一个活跃的研究领域，但其固有的低浓度以及我们对其实质释放的时间演变缺乏理解，对采用血液或唾液来源的生物标志物进行损伤诊断构成了重大障碍。三维神经胶质细胞和类器官细胞培养模型为模拟TBI和筛选损伤生物标志物表达谱提供了机会。然而，仍然缺乏能够在同一培养平台上同时使用基于成像和基于提取的检测方法来监测损伤生物标志物出现演变的芯片实验室平台。在本研究中，我们开发了一种新型的芯片实验室三层微流控装置，能够可重复地损伤皮层球体以在体外模拟TBI。该装置可以独立使用单个泵操作，或直接与常见的实验室显微镜集成，以方便实时成像访问。为了证明其在TBI研究中的适用性，我们在25%的应变和3.125 s-1的固定应变率下对皮层球体进行了压缩，该应变率与轻度TBI的速率相当。24小时后评估细胞活力显示，受冲击的样本平均表现出高达8%的细胞死亡。此外，通过利用简单的推拉灌注方法，未受冲击的样本可以暴露于同一芯片上受损类器官的培养液中，这也导致24小时后细胞死亡增加。这些发现证明了该装置作为TBI可行的体外平台的潜力，应有助于TBI及其他疾病的研究。

abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD), one of the major global public health burdens, continues to exhibit a rising prevalence worldwide. The growing population of patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD) has led to an increasing demand for renal replacement therapy (RRT). Although dialysis effectively prolongs survival, it fails to fully replicate kidney function. In addition, the persistent shortage of donor kidneys results in prolonged waiting periods for kidney transplantation. Emerging renal replacement strategies, such as kidney organoids, have demonstrated considerable potential. However, multiple technical limitations continue to hinder their near-term clinical translation. Bioartificial kidneys (BAKs), which integrate engineering and biological technologies, generally consist of artificial filtration membranes and living-cell bioreactors designed to mimic native kidney function. Advances in nanotechnology, biomaterials, and tissue engineering have accelerated the development of implantable bioartificial kidneys (iBAKs), making them an important research direction in renal replacement therapy. These innovations have improved membrane performance, biocompatibility, and cellular integration; however, substantial challenges remain regarding long-term stability, immune compatibility, and clinical validation before translation into human applications. Specifically, limited cell sources and uncertain long-term biocompatibility remain major barriers to iBAK development. In the future, biosensors and artificial intelligence (AI) technologies may be incorporated into bioartificial kidneys to enable personalized precision therapy. This review focuses on the developmental and major challenges of bioartificial kidneys, with detailed discussion of recent progress in implantable artificial kidneys.
abstractZh: 慢性肾脏病（CKD）作为全球主要的公共卫生负担之一，其患病率在全球范围内持续上升。终末期肾病（ESRD）患者群体的不断增长导致对肾脏替代治疗（RRT）的需求日益增加。尽管透析能有效延长生存期，但无法完全复制肾脏功能。此外，供体肾脏的持续短缺导致肾移植等待时间延长。新兴的肾脏替代策略，如肾脏类器官，已显示出相当大的潜力。然而，多项技术限制仍阻碍其近期临床转化。生物人工肾（BAKs）整合了工程和生物技术，通常由人工过滤膜和活细胞生物反应器组成，旨在模拟天然肾脏功能。纳米技术、生物材料和组织工程的进展加速了可植入生物人工肾（iBAKs）的发展，使其成为肾脏替代治疗的重要研究方向。这些创新改善了膜性能、生物相容性和细胞整合；然而，在转化为人体应用之前，长期稳定性、免疫相容性和临床验证方面仍存在重大挑战。具体而言，有限的细胞来源和不确定的长期生物相容性仍是iBAK发展的主要障碍。未来，生物传感器和人工智能（AI）技术可能被整合到生物人工肾中，以实现个性化精准治疗。本综述聚焦于生物人工肾的发展及主要挑战，并详细讨论了可植入人工肾的最新进展。

abstract: Predicting individual responses to radiotherapy remains a major challenge in esophageal cancer. This study evaluated an cancer organoid-based diagnosis and reactivity prediction (CODRP) approach to estimate pathological response and recurrence risk after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (NCRT) in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Organoids were established from endoscopic biopsy specimens and irradiated with doses of 2, 4, or 8 Gy. Growth inhibition-based area under the curve (GI-AUC) and cell growth rates were quantified and integrated with the clinical cancer stage to generate the CODRP index. Compared with single-parameter models, the CODRP showed improved apparent predictive performance for pathological response prediction in this feasibility cohort (sensitivity, 87.5%; specificity, 100%). Recurrence-free survival was significantly higher in the CODRP-classified radiation-sensitive group (71.43%) than in the radiation-resistant group (10%) (p = 0.0103). These findings support the feasibility of applying CODRP to radiotherapy response and recurrence risk prediction in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
abstractZh: 预测个体对放疗的反应仍是食管癌的一大挑战。本研究评估了一种基于癌症类器官的诊断和反应性预测（CODRP）方法，用于估计食管鳞状细胞癌新辅助放化疗（NCRT）后的病理反应和复发风险。类器官从内镜活检标本中建立，并以2、4或8 Gy的剂量照射。量化基于生长抑制的曲线下面积（GI-AUC）和细胞生长速率，并与临床癌症分期整合以生成CODRP指数。与单参数模型相比，CODRP在此可行性队列中显示出改善的病理反应预测表观性能（敏感性，87.5%；特异性，100%）。CODRP分类的放射敏感组的无复发生存率（71.43%）显著高于放射抵抗组（10%）（p = 0.0103）。这些发现支持将CODRP应用于食管鳞状细胞癌放疗反应和复发风险预测的可行性。

abstract: Diet composition and nutrient availability play critical roles in intestinal stem and progenitor cell function and proliferation. Here, we show that stearoyl-CoA desaturases (SCDs) are regulated by nutrient abundance and link intracellular lipid metabolism to intestinal homeostasis. Pharmacological inhibition or genetic deletion of Scd1 and Scd2 in intestinal mouse organoids disrupted lipid desaturation, induced endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, and impaired stem and progenitor cell proliferation, effects largely mitigated by oleic acid supplementation. Intestine-specific deletion of Scd1 and Scd2 reduced the number of LGR5+ stem cells in vivo and was accompanied by metabolic rewiring and expansion of transient amplifying cells. Loss of Scd1 and Scd2 also reduced epithelial regeneration capacity following irradiation and exacerbated tissue damage and inflammation in a DSS-induced colitis model. Together, these findings reveal important SCD dependencies and metabolic adaptations in intestinal stem and progenitor cells that are necessary for epithelial regeneration and repair following injury.
abstractZh: 饮食组成和营养可用性在肠道干细胞和祖细胞的功能与增殖中发挥关键作用。在此，我们表明硬脂酰辅酶A去饱和酶（SCDs）受营养丰度调节，并将细胞内脂质代谢与肠道稳态联系起来。在小鼠肠道类器官中，药理学抑制或基因敲除Scd1和Scd2会破坏脂质去饱和，诱导内质网（ER）应激，并损害干细胞和祖细胞的增殖，这些效应在很大程度上可通过油酸补充得到缓解。肠道特异性敲除Scd1和Scd2在体内减少了LGR5+干细胞的数量，并伴随代谢重编程和瞬时扩增细胞的扩增。Scd1和Scd2的缺失还降低了照射后的上皮再生能力，并在DSS诱导的结肠炎模型中加剧了组织损伤和炎症。总之，这些发现揭示了肠道干细胞和祖细胞中重要的SCD依赖性及代谢适应，这些对于损伤后的上皮再生和修复是必需的。

abstract: Currently, preclinical research on colorectal cancer (CRC) lacks effective tumor models. In recent years, 3D bioprinted models have shown great potential in tumor model construction. This study used 3D bioprinting technology to establish a CRC extracellular matrix (ECM) model. Gradient concentrations of laminin/entactin complex combined with photocurable gelatin methacrylate (GelMA) hydrogel were used to prepare 3D bioprinting bioinks with biomimetic ECM properties. Biocompatibility was assessed by calcein-AM and propidium iodide staining. Proliferation was evaluated using the CellTiter-Glo® Luminescent Cell Viability Assay Kit in SW620 cells and primary CRC cells. A "sandwich structure" model with inner and outer layers of GelMA or GelMA + LE2 was constructed to observe cell invasion. Mechanical properties of GelMA + LE2 were characterized. Total RNA was extracted from cells in 3D bioprinted models constructed with GelMA and GelMA + LE2 for transcriptome sequencing. Finally, chemotherapeutic drug tests were performed on the 3D bioprinted models. A 3D bioprinted CRC organoid model based on GelMA + LE2 was successfully established. This model exhibited good biocompatibility and the ability to promote tumor cell proliferation and invasion. These characteristics were independent of the model's mechanical properties. Instead, they originated from LE2 activating the ErbB/Wnt signaling pathway and gap junction-mediated intercellular communication. Additionally, a significant correlation was observed between the clinical treatment outcomes of CRC patients and the drug test results of the 3D bioprinted models. The 3D bioprinted CRC organoid constructed in this study provides a biomimetic and high-throughput research platform for precision medicine.
abstractZh: 目前，结直肠癌（CRC）的临床前研究缺乏有效的肿瘤模型。近年来，三维生物打印模型在肿瘤模型构建中显示出巨大潜力。本研究利用三维生物打印技术建立了CRC细胞外基质（ECM）模型。将梯度浓度的层粘连蛋白/内联蛋白复合物与光固化明胶甲基丙烯酰（GelMA）水凝胶结合，制备具有仿生ECM特性的三维生物打印生物墨水。通过钙黄绿素-AM和碘化丙啶染色评估生物相容性。使用CellTiter-Glo®发光细胞活力检测试剂盒在SW620细胞和原代CRC细胞中评估增殖。构建了内外层为GelMA或GelMA+LE2的“三明治结构”模型以观察细胞侵袭。表征了GelMA+LE2的力学性能。从使用GelMA和GelMA+LE2构建的三维生物打印模型中提取细胞总RNA进行转录组测序。最后，对三维生物打印模型进行了化疗药物测试。成功建立了基于GelMA+LE2的三维生物打印CRC类器官模型。该模型表现出良好的生物相容性和促进肿瘤细胞增殖和侵袭的能力。这些特性与模型的力学性能无关，而是源于LE2激活ErbB/Wnt信号通路和间隙连接介导的细胞间通讯。此外，CRC患者的临床治疗结果与三维生物打印模型的药物测试结果之间观察到显著相关性。本研究构建的三维生物打印CRC类器官为精准医学提供了一个仿生和高通量的研究平台。

title: Vascularization of Human iPSC-Derived Kidney Organoids Using Perfusion Culture, Pre-Vascularized Collagen Scaffolds, and Decellularized Extracellular Matrix.

abstract: Human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived kidney organoids represent promising in vitro models for studying kidney development and drug-induced toxicity, yet their lack of vasculature limits maturation and translational use. Here, we present a proof-of-concept co-culture platform to promote vascularization of kidney organoids by integrating stromal vascular fraction cells, collagen sponge scaffolds, porcine kidney decellularized extracellular matrix (dECM), and dynamic culture in a perfusion-based U-CUP bioreactor. We systematically evaluated the effects of serum supplementation, scaffold pre-vascularization, dECM encapsulation, and flow conditions on organoid-vascular integration. Low-level serum supplementation (1.5% FBS) sustained vascular networks without compromising organoid morphology. Perfusion supported vascular expansion; however, while a low flow rate comparable to interstitial tissue flow (0.01 mL/min) preserved organoid morphology and glomerular-like structures, a higher flow rate optimized for vascularization (0.47 mL/min) disrupted overall organoid architecture. Encapsulation within dECM preserved glomerular morphology and supported vascular infiltration, whereas co-culture with stromal vascular fraction cells enabled putative podocyte-endothelial interactions. Finally, exposure to the calcineurin inhibitor tacrolimus revealed dose-dependent cytotoxicity and characteristic nephron and vascular injury, demonstrating the model's utility for nephrotoxicity screening. The established modular platform enables the engineering of vascularized kidney organoids, establishing foundations for physiologically relevant models for disease modeling and pre-clinical drug testing.
abstractZh: 人诱导多能干细胞来源的肾类器官代表了研究肾脏发育和药物诱导毒性的有前景的体外模型，然而其缺乏血管系统限制了成熟和转化应用。在此，我们提出一个概念验证共培养平台，通过整合基质血管组分细胞、胶原海绵支架、猪肾脱细胞细胞外基质（dECM）以及基于灌注的U-CUP生物反应器中的动态培养，促进肾类器官的血管化。我们系统评估了血清补充、支架预血管化、dECM封装和流动条件对类器官-血管整合的影响。低水平血清补充（1.5% FBS）维持了血管网络而不损害类器官形态。灌注支持血管扩张；然而，虽然与组织间隙流动相当的低流速（0.01 mL/min）保持了类器官形态和肾小球样结构，但为血管化优化的较高流速（0.47 mL/min）破坏了整体类器官结构。在dECM内封装保持了肾小球形态并支持血管浸润，而与基质血管组分细胞共培养则实现了可能的足细胞-内皮细胞相互作用。最后，暴露于钙调神经磷酸酶抑制剂他克莫司揭示了剂量依赖性细胞毒性和特征性肾单位及血管损伤，证明了该模型在肾毒性筛选中的实用性。所建立的模块化平台能够工程化血管化肾类器官，为疾病建模和临床前药物测试的生理相关模型奠定了基础。

abstract: Inner ear organoids (IEOs) derived from pluripotent stem cells (PSCs) provide a promising platform for modeling neurosensory disorders and hearing loss; however, conventional systems often exhibit substantial structural variability, incomplete maturation, and limited reproducibility due to insufficient control of early organoid morphogenesis. Here, we demonstrate that micro-topographical cues applied during initial IEO formation enhance the development and functional maturation of PSC-derived IEOs. This microengineering strategy introduces temporally defined microscale geometric confinement to regulate early cell-cell and cell-extracellular matrix (ECM) interactions, thereby promoting epithelial organization and developmental fidelity. Microengineered IEOs (M-IEOs) exhibit improved reproducibility and neurosensory maturation, including increased hair cell-like populations, stereocilia-like structures and kinocilium-like features exhibiting a characteristic (9 × 2) + 2 microtubule organization. Functionally, M-IEOs exhibit enhanced electrophysiological responsiveness, supported by complementary transcriptomic and in situ analyses indicating activation of inner ear lineage maturation pathways. Furthermore, we demonstrate the versatility of M-IEOs by integrating them with a microfluidic vascular system to model vascular-epithelial interactions and inflammatory responses, highlighting its potential for disease modeling and pharmacological screening. Together, these findings establish transient micro-topographical guidance as an instructive regulator of inner ear organoid development and provide a robust, vascular-compatible platform for neurosensory research, disease modeling, and translational screening applications.
abstractZh: 由多能干细胞（PSCs）衍生的内耳类器官（IEOs）为神经感觉障碍和听力损失的建模提供了一个有前景的平台；然而，由于对早期类器官形态发生的控制不足，传统系统通常表现出显著的结构变异性、不完全成熟和有限的可重复性。在此，我们证明了在初始IEO形成期间施加的微地形线索可增强PSC衍生的IEO的发育和功能成熟。这种微工程策略引入了时间定义的微尺度几何限制，以调节早期细胞-细胞和细胞-细胞外基质（ECM）相互作用，从而促进上皮组织和发育保真度。微工程IEO（M-IEO）表现出改善的可重复性和神经感觉成熟，包括增加的毛细胞样群体、静纤毛样结构和动纤毛样特征，这些特征表现出典型的（9×2）+2微管组织。在功能上，M-IEO表现出增强的电生理反应性，并得到互补的转录组学和原位分析的支持，表明内耳谱系成熟途径的激活。此外，我们通过将M-IEO与微流体血管系统集成来模拟血管-上皮相互作用和炎症反应，展示了M-IEO的多功能性，突出了其在疾病建模和药理学筛选中的潜力。总之，这些发现确立了瞬时微地形引导作为内耳类器官发育的指导性调节因子，并为神经感觉研究、疾病建模和转化筛选应用提供了一个稳健的、血管兼容的平台。

abstract: The endothelialization of organ-on-chip platforms and vascular implants is often limited by slow cell attachment and unstable monolayer formation. This work presents a scalable workflow that imprints micro- and nano-gratings into elastin-like recombinamer (ELR)-based hydrogels, enabling rapid endothelial cell capture and accelerating monolayer formation within 14 days. Three gelatin-ELR formulations are engineered, with 1H-NMR confirming incorporation of sequences designed to modulate bioactivity (ELR1: inert, ELR2: uPA-responsive, ELR3: RGD-adhesive). ELR incorporation generates fibrillar microstructures and enhances mechanical performance, yielding elastic-dominant networks suitable for high-fidelity pattern transfer. Using this library, the combined effects of ELR bioactivity and groove geometry on human iPSC-derived endothelial cells are evaluated. In a 15-min attachment assay, patterned ELR composites markedly improve cell retention compared to gelatin, with ELR2 on ∼350 and ∼4 µm grooves performing best, consistent with controlled, cell-mediated interfacial remodeling. This early advantage persists, as ELR2 and ELR3 hydrogels support rapid alignment and reach confluence by day 14, whereas gelatin remains subconfluent. By combining enhanced early capture with protease-regulated remodeling, ELR2 identifies a favorable design window. These results establish a materials design framework linking programmable ELR chemistry with surface topography to engineer endothelial interfaces, providing a versatile platform for vascular biomaterials and microphysiological systems.
abstractZh: 器官芯片平台和血管植入物的内皮化常常受到细胞附着缓慢和单层形成不稳定的限制。本研究提出了一种可扩展的工作流程，将微米和纳米沟槽压印到基于弹性蛋白样重组体（ELR）的水凝胶中，实现快速内皮细胞捕获，并在14天内加速单层形成。设计了三种明胶-ELR配方，通过1H-NMR确认了用于调节生物活性的序列的掺入（ELR1：惰性，ELR2：uPA响应性，ELR3：RGD粘附性）。ELR的掺入产生了纤维状微结构并增强了机械性能，形成了适合高保真图案转移的弹性主导网络。利用该库，评估了ELR生物活性和沟槽几何形状对人iPSC来源内皮细胞的联合影响。在15分钟的附着实验中，与明胶相比，图案化ELR复合材料显著提高了细胞保留率，其中ELR2在约350和约4微米沟槽上表现最佳，这与受控的、细胞介导的界面重塑一致。这一早期优势持续存在，因为ELR2和ELR3水凝胶支持快速排列并在第14天达到融合，而明胶仍处于亚融合状态。通过将增强的早期捕获与蛋白酶调节的重塑相结合，ELR2确定了一个有利的设计窗口。这些结果建立了一个材料设计框架，将可编程的ELR化学与表面拓扑联系起来，以工程化内皮界面，为血管生物材料和微生理系统提供了一个多功能平台。

title: Targeting the S100A2-RAGE Pathway Restores AT2 Cell Identity and Mitigates Lung Fibrosis.
titleZh: 靶向S100A2-RAGE通路恢复AT2细胞特性并减轻肺纤维化。
journal: American journal of respiratory cell and molecular biology

abstract: Lung fibrosis, including idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), represents a spectrum of progressive interstitial lung diseases characterized by disrupted epithelial repair, fibroblast activation, and excess extracellular matrix accumulation. A central feature of fibrotic progression is the loss of alveolar type 2 epithelial (AT2) cell identity and the emergence of aberrant transitional states that fail to support normal regeneration. Based on our re-analysis of multiple publicly available scRNA-seq datasets from the IPF Cell Atlas, S100A2 expression is tightly associated with basal-like reprogramming of AT2 cells and is a top upregulated gene at both mRNA and protein levels in IPF lungs. Furthermore, scRNA-seq data from human lung organoid models reveal that AT2 cells co-cultured with fibroblasts acquire a basal-like phenotype and express high levels of S100A2. Functionally, overexpression of S100A2 in human iPSC-derived lung alveolar epithelial type 2 (iAT2) cells leads to loss of AT2 cellular identity, increased generation of reactive oxygen species, and activation of RAGE signaling pathway. We demonstrate that pharmacologic inhibition of RAGE using Azeliragon preserves AT2 cell populations, associated with reduced oxidative stress in iAT2 cells, and significantly attenuates collagen deposition in bleomycin-induced lung fibrosis models. Collectively, our results indicate that S100A2 is a key driver of epithelial dysfunction in lung fibrosis, promoting loss of AT2 identity, aberrant basal fate acquisition, and persistent epithelial injury. Targeting the unrecognized S100A2-RAGE pathway may offer a new therapeutic strategy to restore epithelial homeostasis in lung fibrosis.
abstractZh: 肺纤维化，包括特发性肺纤维化（IPF），代表了一系列进行性间质性肺疾病，其特征是上皮修复受损、成纤维细胞活化和细胞外基质过度积累。纤维化进展的一个核心特征是肺泡2型上皮（AT2）细胞特性的丧失，以及无法支持正常再生的异常过渡状态的出现。基于我们对IPF细胞图谱中多个公开可用的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据集的重新分析，S100A2表达与AT2细胞的基底样重编程密切相关，并且是IPF肺中mRNA和蛋白质水平上上调最显著的基因之一。此外，来自人肺类器官模型的scRNA-seq数据显示，与成纤维细胞共培养的AT2细胞获得基底样表型并高表达S100A2。在功能上，人诱导多能干细胞来源的肺肺泡上皮2型（iAT2）细胞中S100A2的过表达导致AT2细胞特性丧失、活性氧生成增加以及RAGE信号通路激活。我们证明，使用Azeliragon对RAGE进行药理学抑制可保留AT2细胞群体，与iAT2细胞中氧化应激减少相关，并显著减轻博来霉素诱导的肺纤维化模型中的胶原沉积。总的来说，我们的结果表明S100A2是肺纤维化中上皮功能障碍的关键驱动因素，促进AT2特性丧失、异常基底命运获得和持续性上皮损伤。靶向未被认识的S100A2-RAGE通路可能为恢复肺纤维化中的上皮稳态提供一种新的治疗策略。

title: In Vitro New Approach Methodologies for Toxicity Assessment of Emerging Food Contaminants in Indonesia: A Proposed Strategy for BPOM Regulatory Integration.
titleZh: 印度尼西亚新兴食品污染物毒性评估的体外新方法学：BPOM监管整合的拟议策略。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Hardjo M, Sophian A.
affiliations: Department of Biochemistry, Faculty of Medicine, Hasanuddin University, Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia.
