abstract: An-Gong-Niu-Huang Wan (AGNHW) is a traditional Chinese medicine preparation containing cinnabar (HgS). However, its clinical use has been controversial due to concerns regarding mercury nephrotoxicity. To evaluate the renal toxicity, mice were administered AGNHW, cinnabar, methylmercury (MeHg), and mercuric chloride (HgCl₂) for 28 days. Blood biochemistry, histopathology, and the expression of nephrotoxicity-sensitive genes were assessed. To assess the health risks associated with AGNHW, we established an innovative Physiologically Based Extraction Test (IPBET) /small intestinal organ-on-a-chip model for the first time to simulate gastrointestinal digestion and absorption of mercury from AGNHW. This organ-on-a-chip model with HPLC-ICP-MS enabled the first determination of bioavailable mercury species in AGNHW. Urinary creatinine (UCr), total protein (TP), kidney injury molecule-1 (Kim-1), α1-microglobulin (a1-MG), N-cadherin levels, and histological findings in the MeHg and HgCl₂ groups showed significant differences compared to the control, cinnabar, and AGNHW groups. The expression of F4/80, CD11b, and MMP7 was markedly altered in the MeHg group. Our organ-on-a-chip model revealed that bioavailable MeHg in the MeHg group was 298-fold and 27-fold higher compared to the control and AGNHW groups. Our refined risk assessment indicated that, when adjusted by bioavailability and speciation, the health risks associated with mercury exposure from AGNHW consumption were acceptable. Collectively, considering bioavailability and mercury species, our IPBET/small intestinal organ-on-a-chip provides a novel approach for assessing cinnabar exposure risks in AGNHW. Our study provides a scientific basis that AGNHW and cinnabar are much less nephrotoxic than HgCl2 and MeHg, and does not pose a significant threat to human health clinically.
abstractZh: 安宫牛黄丸（AGNHW）是一种含有朱砂（HgS）的传统中药制剂。然而，由于对汞肾毒性的担忧，其临床应用一直存在争议。为评估肾毒性，给小鼠施用AGNHW、朱砂、甲基汞（MeHg）和氯化汞（HgCl₂）28天。评估了血液生化、组织病理学以及肾毒性敏感基因的表达。为评估与AGNHW相关的健康风险，我们首次建立了创新的基于生理的提取试验（IPBET）/小肠器官芯片模型，以模拟AGNHW中汞的胃肠消化和吸收。该器官芯片模型结合HPLC-ICP-MS首次测定了AGNHW中可生物利用的汞形态。与对照组、朱砂组和AGNHW组相比，MeHg和HgCl₂组的尿肌酐（UCr）、总蛋白（TP）、肾损伤分子-1（Kim-1）、α1-微球蛋白（a1-MG）、N-钙黏蛋白水平以及组织学结果均显示出显著差异。MeHg组中F4/80、CD11b和MMP7的表达显著改变。我们的器官芯片模型显示，MeHg组中可生物利用的MeHg分别比对照组和AGNHW组高298倍和27倍。我们精细化的风险评估表明，当根据生物利用度和形态进行调整时，通过食用AGNHW导致的汞暴露健康风险是可接受的。总之，考虑到生物利用度和汞形态，我们的IPBET/小肠器官芯片为评估AGNHW中朱砂暴露风险提供了一种新方法。我们的研究提供了科学依据，表明AGNHW和朱砂的肾毒性远低于HgCl₂和MeHg，且在临床上不会对人体健康构成显著威胁。

title: Tumor-specific Kinase Motif Enrichment Analysis Identifies Personalized Therapeutic Cancer Targets
titleZh: 肿瘤特异性激酶基序富集分析识别个性化癌症治疗靶点
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Pu T, Joughin BA, Desai PP, Forsythe SD, Holewinski R, Remmert K, Gasmi B, Coleman K, Leach T, Johansen AM, Russell N, Ma L, Rainey A, Sarvestani AL, Smith E, Sinha S, Mukherjee S, Luberice K, Xiao S, Larrain CM, Eade AV, Friedman LR, Ho J, Davis JL, Blakely AM, Kleiner DE, Sadowski SM, Andresson T, Rivero JD, Yaffe MB, Hernandez JM.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs) are an uncommon and poorly understood malignancy with low mutational burden, lacking well-defined oncogenic drivers. GEP-NET mortality frequently results from extensive hepatic metastases. Accordingly, we interrogated phosphoproteomic data from GEP-NET liver metastases and patient-matched uninvolved liver to identify tumor-specific signaling and targetable tumor vulnerabilities using Kinase Motif Enrichment Analysis (KMEA), a new tool leveraging the recent Kinase Library compendium of the substrate motif specificity for nearly the entire human kinome. KMEA identified patient tumor-specific upregulation of mTOR or casein kinase 2 (CK2) activity that would be undiscoverable by standard personalized genomic and transcriptomic approaches. Striking concordance was observed between KMEA predictions for specific tumors, and their sensitivity to inhibitors of mTOR or CK2 using patient tumor-derived organoids. These findings reveal potential clinically-actionable protein kinases hyperactivated in GEP-NETs, and more broadly indicate a general method for personalized cancer treatment using phosphoproteomics and KMEA-derived kinase activity signatures.
abstractZh:
摘要

胃肠胰神经内分泌肿瘤（GEP-NETs）是一种罕见且了解甚少的恶性肿瘤，突变负荷低，缺乏明确的致癌驱动因素。GEP-NET的死亡率常由广泛的肝转移导致。因此，我们分析了GEP-NET肝转移及其患者匹配的非受累肝脏的磷酸化蛋白质组数据，以使用激酶基序富集分析（KMEA）识别肿瘤特异性信号和可靶向的肿瘤脆弱性。KMEA是一种新工具，利用最近的激酶文库纲要，该纲要涵盖了几乎整个人类激酶组的底物基序特异性。KMEA识别出患者肿瘤特异性的mTOR或酪蛋白激酶2（CK2）活性上调，这些通过标准个性化基因组和转录组方法无法发现。KMEA对特定肿瘤的预测与使用患者肿瘤来源类器官对mTOR或CK2抑制剂的敏感性之间观察到显著的一致性。这些发现揭示了GEP-NETs中潜在临床可操作的过度激活蛋白激酶，并更广泛地表明了一种使用磷酸化蛋白质组学和KMEA衍生的激酶活性特征进行个性化癌症治疗的通用方法。

title: A functional comparison of readthrough agent ELX-02 across a wide range of nonsense CFTR variants
titleZh: 通读剂ELX-02在广泛无义CFTR变异中的功能比较
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Destoop M, Ramalho AS, Silva IAL, Vonk AM, Suen S, Bierlaagh MC, Boj SF, Vries RGJ, Beekman JM, De Boeck K, van der Ent CK, Amaral MD, Vermeulen F, Spelier S.
abstract:
Background

  Nonsense variants in  CFTR account for ~10% of cystic fibrosis (CF) variants and cannot be treated with approved CFTR modulators. Translational readthrough agents such as ELX-02 offer a potential therapeutic strategy, but clinical trials evaluated mainly in G542X CFTR nonsense variant and underlined limited efficacy. This study aimed to evaluate ELX-02-mediated CFTR rescue across a broad range of nonsense variants using patient-derived intestinal organoids (PDIOs) to define variant-specific determinants of readthrough efficacy and assess its potential across a genetically diverse CF population.  Method

  The ex vivo response to ELX-02 was assessed in 206 PDIOs carrying heterogeneous nonsense variants. CFTR function was quantified using forskolin-induced swelling (FIS) assay after 48-hour exposure to ELX-02. Responses were analysed by genotype and stop codon identity, with secondary validation performed in a selected subset of PDIOs (n = 60). Results

  ELX-02–mediated CFTR rescue varied markedly, ranging from responses approaching those observed with approved CFTR modulators (LUM/IVA) to responses at or below detection limit. Overall, maximal responses were modest and at the lower end of the functional range for CFTR modulators. Rescue was dose-dependent and higher in PDIOs carrying two nonsense variants when compared with PDIOs carrying a single nonsense variant combined with a residual or minimal function variant. Nonsense variants in nucleotide-binding domain 1, including G542X, S466X, G550X and R553X, showed relatively higher responsiveness. Conclusion

  ELX-02 induces limited and highly heterogeneous CFTR rescue across nonsense variants. PDIO-based functional screening provides a framework to guide patient selection and stratification for future readthrough therapy trials.
abstractZh:
背景

  CFTR中的无义变异约占囊性纤维化（CF）变异的10%，且无法用已批准的CFTR调节剂治疗。翻译通读剂如ELX-02提供了一种潜在的治疗策略，但临床试验主要针对G542X CFTR无义变异进行评估，并强调了其疗效有限。本研究旨在使用患者来源的肠道类器官（PDIOs）评估ELX-02在广泛无义变异中介导的CFTR拯救，以确定变异特异性的通读疗效决定因素，并评估其在遗传多样性CF人群中的潜力。方法

 在携带异质性无义变异的206个PDIOs中评估了ELX-02的离体反应。使用毛喉素诱导肿胀（FIS）试验，在ELX-02暴露48小时后量化CFTR功能。按基因型和终止密码子身份分析反应，并在选定的PDIOs子集（n = 60）中进行二次验证。结果

 ELX-02介导的CFTR拯救变化显著，从接近已批准CFTR调节剂（LUM/IVA）观察到的反应到处于或低于检测限的反应。总体而言，最大反应适中，且处于CFTR调节剂功能范围的低端。拯救呈剂量依赖性，且携带两个无义变异的PDIOs与携带单个无义变异合并残余或最小功能变异的PDIOs相比，反应更高。核苷酸结合域1中的无义变异，包括G542X、S466X、G550X和R553X，显示出相对较高的反应性。结论

 ELX-02在无义变异中诱导有限且高度异质的CFTR拯救。基于PDIO的功能筛选为未来通读治疗试验的患者选择和分层提供了框架。

title: Examination of DNA methylation patterns in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
titleZh: 胰腺导管腺癌DNA甲基化模式的研究
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Pinto JR, Jang GH, Zhang A, Flores-Figueroa E, Xu J, Shooshtari P, Notta F, Grant R, Tsang E, O’Kane G, Behjati FA, Pin C.
abstract: Abstract  Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a deadly cancer with a 5-year survival rate of ~ 13%. PDAC treatment options are limited and are often given based on patient fitness rather than molecular characteristics. Transcriptomics analysis characterizes PDAC into molecular subtypes which could help guide patient treatment based on tumour characteristics. The consensual classical and basal-like PDAC subtypes are characterized by the expression of pancreatic developmental genes or epithelial to mesenchymal transition genes, respectively. However, while basal-like tumors are more aggressive than classical tumors, these transcriptomic signatures may not translate to ex vivo analysis and also do not reflect the continuum of phenotypes observed in vivo. In this study, we focused on DNA methylation, a heritable and stable epigenetic mark that can be used to track cell of origin. DNA methylation patterns were assessed in 62 patient-derived organoids, originating from two clinical trial studies, using a targeted analysis involving methylation arrays. The analysis confirmed hypermethylation of basal-like PDAC compared to classical PDAC and identified four DNA methylation-based clusters independent of transcriptional subtypes. Methylation profiles aligned with biological processes linked to differentiated or poorly-differentiated subtypes and was able to further characterize PDAC heterogeneity. The identification of these DNA methylation signatures may uncover unique sensitivities for treatment and possible biological mechanisms that drive PDAC biology.
abstractZh: 摘要 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）是一种致命的癌症，5年生存率约为13%。PDAC的治疗选择有限，且通常基于患者体能状况而非分子特征来决定。转录组学分析将PDAC分为分子亚型，这可能有助于根据肿瘤特征指导患者治疗。共识的经典亚型和基底样亚型分别以胰腺发育基因或上皮-间质转化基因的表达为特征。然而，尽管基底样肿瘤比经典肿瘤更具侵袭性，这些转录组特征可能无法转化为体外分析，也不能反映体内观察到的表型连续体。在本研究中，我们关注DNA甲基化，这是一种可遗传且稳定的表观遗传标记，可用于追踪细胞起源。通过使用涉及甲基化阵列的靶向分析，评估了来自两项临床试验研究的62个患者来源类器官的DNA甲基化模式。分析证实基底样PDAC与经典PDAC相比存在高甲基化，并确定了四个独立于转录亚型的基于DNA甲基化的聚类。甲基化谱与分化或低分化亚型相关的生物学过程一致，并能进一步表征PDAC的异质性。这些DNA甲基化特征的识别可能揭示独特的治疗敏感性以及驱动PDAC生物学的潜在生物学机制。

title: An AI-Mechanistic Coagulation–Cardiovascular Framework for Reducing Arrhythmia Risk Under Vascular Stress
titleZh: 一种用于降低血管应激下心律失常风险的AI-机制性凝血-心血管框架
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Mohammadiaria M.
abstract: Abstract    This work presents a self-consistent mechanistic simulation and machine-learning (ML) surrogate demonstration, not a validated biological prediction: ion-channel priors are grounded in real human GEO expression data, but the governing kinetic rate constants are literature-plausible defaults rather than fitted or experimentally validated parameters (see Methods). Within this simulated system, we implement a unified mechanistic–AI framework — a lumped-parameter, single-cell model of a human ventricular cardiomyocyte-like phenotype — that links electroporation-mediated mRNA delivery of potassium-channel genes to increased macroscopic I  Kr  , I  K1  , and I  Ks  conductance, driven by channel density rather than single-channel conductance. This conductance increase shortens APD  90  by 15–30%, suppresses early afterdepolarizations (EADs), and supports pacemaker induction via transcription-factor-driven upregulation of HCN4 (TBX18/SHOX2). We explicitly distinguish this chronic, gene-delivery-driven mechanism — active on an hours-to-days timescale after membrane resealing — from the acute-phase (seconds-to-minutes) repolarization impairment reported experimentally following electroporation-induced membrane and oxidative injury; both regimes are discussed explicitly in the main text. To assess vascular safety, the electrophysiological model is coupled to thrombin–fibrin kinetics and shear-dependent clot formation, through which coagulation-associated changes in ROS, pH, and extracellular K  +  act unidirectionally upstream on cardiac excitability — the reverse pathway, arrhythmia promoting thrombosis, is not modeled, a scope limitation we note explicitly. An autophagy module, parameterized with literature-plausible rather than GEO-derived rate constants, stabilizes voltage-gated ion channel (VGIC) density, reduces EAD susceptibility, and attenuates thrombin amplification. Using 400 omics-informed synthetic trajectories (200 training, 100 independent testing, 100 stress/extrapolation testing) generated by a mechanistic ODE simulator whose ion-channel priors were drawn from human expression data in GEO (GSE5406, ischemic/idiopathic cardiomyopathy vs. non-failing donor myocardium; GSE41177, atrial fibrillation vs. sinus rhythm), we trained a long short-term memory (LSTM) classifier to predict overall protocol safety from a composite indicator combining early afterdepolarization probability, fibrin formation, and APD  90  shortening. The classifier achieved an AUC of 0.92 (accuracy 0.76, F1 0.81) on the independent test set (Set B) and 0.99 (accuracy 0.93) on internal validation; performance on the high-dose stress-test set (Set C) was similarly strong (AUC 1.00), though this set is heavily imbalanced toward unsafe protocols (98/100), a caveat we note explicitly. Together, these results demonstrate a self-consistent, GEO-informed simulation and surrogate-modeling pipeline that can flag pulse-protocol regimes as safe or unsafe within the model's own assumptions; whether these mechanistic trends and surrogate predictions hold in real cardiac tissue has not yet been tested. Validating the framework against direct electrophysiological and hemostatic recordings is a necessary next step before it could inform applications such as personalized electrophysiological therapy or organ-on-chip risk assessment, which we discuss as future directions rather than established outcomes.
abstractZh: 摘要    本工作展示了一个自洽的机制性模拟和机器学习（ML）替代模型演示，而非经过验证的生物学预测：离子通道先验基于真实的人类GEO表达数据，但控制动力学速率常数是文献中合理的默认值，而非拟合或实验验证的参数（见方法）。在此模拟系统内，我们实现了一个统一的机制性-人工智能框架——一个人类心室心肌细胞样表型的集总参数单细胞模型——将电穿孔介导的钾通道基因mRNA递送与宏观I Kr 、I K1 和I Ks 电导增加联系起来，该增加由通道密度而非单通道电导驱动。这种电导增加使APD 90 缩短15-30%，抑制早期后除极（EADs），并通过转录因子驱动的HCN4（TBX18/SHOX2）上调支持起搏诱导。我们明确区分这种慢性的、基因递送驱动的机制——在膜重新密封后数小时至数天的时间尺度上活跃——与电穿孔诱导的膜和氧化损伤后实验报道的急性期（秒至分钟）复极损伤；两种状态均在正文中明确讨论。为评估血管安全性，电生理模型与凝血酶-纤维蛋白动力学和剪切依赖性血栓形成耦合，通过该耦合，凝血相关的ROS、pH和细胞外K + 变化单向上游作用于心脏兴奋性——反向通路，即心律失常促进血栓形成，未被建模，这是我们明确指出的范围限制。一个自噬模块，使用文献合理而非GEO衍生的速率常数参数化，稳定电压门控离子通道（VGIC）密度，降低EAD易感性，并减弱凝血酶扩增。使用由机制性ODE模拟器生成的400个组学信息合成轨迹（200个训练，100个独立测试，100个压力/外推测试），其离子通道先验来自GEO中的人类表达数据（GSE5406，缺血性/特发性心肌病 vs. 非衰竭供体心肌；GSE41177，心房颤动 vs. 窦性心律），我们训练了一个长短期记忆（LSTM）分类器，根据结合早期后除极概率、纤维蛋白形成和APD 90 缩短的复合指标预测总体方案安全性。该分类器在独立测试集（Set B）上实现了AUC 0.92（准确率0.76，F1 0.81），在内部验证上实现了0.99（准确率0.93）；在高剂量压力测试集（Set C）上的表现同样强劲（AUC 1.00），尽管该集严重不平衡，偏向不安全方案（98/100），这是我们明确指出的一个注意事项。总之，这些结果展示了一个自洽的、GEO信息化的模拟和替代建模流程，可以在模型自身假设内将脉冲方案标记为安全或不安全；这些机制趋势和替代预测是否在真实心脏组织中成立尚未测试。在框架能够为个性化电生理治疗或器官芯片风险评估等应用提供信息之前，必须针对直接电生理和止血记录进行验证，我们将其讨论为未来方向而非既定结果。

title: Cell surface ADGRG1 and CD86 expression identifies antitumor CD4<sup>+</sup> T cells in human cancer.
titleZh: 细胞表面ADGRG1和CD86表达鉴定人类癌症中的抗肿瘤CD4<sup>+</sup> T细胞。

abstract: Adoptive cell transfer of tumor infiltrating CD4+ T cells or T cells genetically modified to express antitumor CD4+ T cell receptors (TCRs) has shown clinical efficacy in patients with advanced solid tumors. We previously defined unique transcriptomic states of antitumor, neoantigen-specific CD8+ and CD4+ tumor infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL) in human cancer. However, optimal cell surface protein markers that identify and would enable viable cell isolation and selective enrichment of antitumor CD4+ T cells have yet to be identified. Here, we define transcriptomic and corresponding cell surface protein profiles of antitumor CD4+ TIL within metastatic colorectal tumors using high dimensional single cell transcriptomic and proteomic analysis. Comprehensive analysis of 45 antitumor CD4+ TCR clonotypes demonstrated uniquely high cell surface protein expression of ADGRG1, CD86, and CD57. In all samples containing tumor neoantigen-reactive CD4+ TIL clonotypes, ADGRG1- and CD86-based cell surface enrichment of known reactive TCR clonotypes were 11-fold and 9-fold higher than bulk CD4+ TIL, respectively. ADGRG1- and CD86-based cell surface enrichment identified >60 validated antitumor CD4+ TCR-clonotypes including tumor organoid-reactive TCRs, as well as neoantigen-specific TCRs targeting private tumor mutations and cancer driver mutations. While both ADGRG1 and CD86 enriched CD4+ TIL displayed an exhausted neoantigen-specific gene expression signature, CD86 also enriched for cytotoxic CD4+ TIL phenotypes. CD4+ TIL isolated based on ADGRG1 expression and expanded in vitro also demonstrated neoantigen reactivity in two samples. Thus, ADGRG1 and CD86 appear to be effective protein markers for isolating human tumor-specific CD4+ TCR clonotypes and studying antitumor CD4+ TIL.
abstractZh: 过继性细胞转移肿瘤浸润性CD4+ T细胞或经基因修饰表达抗肿瘤CD4+ T细胞受体（TCR）的T细胞，在晚期实体瘤患者中已显示出临床疗效。我们先前定义了人类癌症中抗肿瘤、新抗原特异性CD8+和CD4+肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（TIL）的独特转录组状态。然而，能够鉴定抗肿瘤CD4+ T细胞并实现活细胞分离和选择性富集的最佳细胞表面蛋白标志物尚未确定。在此，我们利用高维单细胞转录组和蛋白质组分析，定义了转移性结直肠肿瘤内抗肿瘤CD4+ TIL的转录组及相应的细胞表面蛋白谱。对45种抗肿瘤CD4+ TCR克隆型的综合分析表明，ADGRG1、CD86和CD57的细胞表面蛋白表达 uniquely 高。在所有含有肿瘤新抗原反应性CD4+ TIL克隆型的样本中，基于ADGRG1和CD86的细胞表面富集，已知反应性TCR克隆型的富集程度分别比总CD4+ TIL高11倍和9倍。基于ADGRG1和CD86的细胞表面富集鉴定出超过60种经过验证的抗肿瘤CD4+ TCR克隆型，包括肿瘤类器官反应性TCR，以及靶向私有肿瘤突变和癌症驱动突变的新抗原特异性TCR。虽然ADGRG1和CD86富集的CD4+ TIL均表现出耗竭的新抗原特异性基因表达特征，但CD86还富集了细胞毒性CD4+ TIL表型。基于ADGRG1表达分离并在体外扩增的CD4+ TIL在两个样本中也表现出新抗原反应性。因此，ADGRG1和CD86似乎是分离人类肿瘤特异性CD4+ TCR克隆型和研究抗肿瘤CD4+ TIL的有效蛋白标志物。

abstract: Hydrogels are highly hydrated three-dimensional polymeric network materials that have attracted considerable attention in medical and biomedical fields owing to their favorable chemical modifiability, physical tunability, biocompatibility, and capacity to mimic key features of native extracellular matrices. With advances in polymer chemistry, crosslinking strategies, stimuli-responsive design, and emerging fabrication technologies, hydrogels have evolved from simple soft materials into multifunctional biomedical systems capable of integrating controlled delivery, tissue support, microenvironmental regulation, biosensing, and disease modeling. These properties make hydrogels particularly relevant for addressing a broad spectrum of human diseases in which conventional therapeutic strategies are often limited by insufficient targeting efficiency, limited therapeutic windows, pronounced systemic side effects, and inadequate restoration of damaged tissue structure and function. In this review, we systematically summarize the design principles and material engineering strategies of hydrogels, including structural construction approaches and functional regulation concepts. We then provide a comprehensive overview of their current biomedical applications, encompassing drug delivery systems, tissue engineering and regenerative medicine, biosensing and diagnostic platforms, as well as cell culture and organoid systems. Building on this foundation, we place particular emphasis on recent progress in hydrogel-based therapeutic strategies across diverse human disease contexts, including wound healing, musculoskeletal system repair, cancer, neurological diseases, cardiovascular diseases, autoimmune disorders, and reproductive system diseases. Finally, we discuss the developmental potential of hydrogels in biomedicine and present an integrated perspective on their clinical translation prospects, with the aim of offering references and insights for the further application of hydrogel materials in future human disease treatment.
abstractZh: 水凝胶是高度水合的三维聚合物网络材料，因其良好的化学可修饰性、物理可调性、生物相容性以及模拟天然细胞外基质关键特征的能力，在医学和生物医学领域引起了广泛关注。随着聚合物化学、交联策略、刺激响应设计以及新兴制造技术的进步，水凝胶已从简单的软材料演变为多功能生物医学系统，能够整合控制释放、组织支持、微环境调节、生物传感和疾病建模等功能。这些特性使水凝胶特别适用于解决广泛的人类疾病，在这些疾病中，传统治疗策略往往受限于靶向效率不足、治疗窗口有限、明显的全身副作用以及受损组织结构与功能恢复不足等问题。在本综述中，我们系统总结了水凝胶的设计原理和材料工程策略，包括结构构建方法和功能调控概念。随后，我们全面概述了其当前的生物医学应用，涵盖药物递送系统、组织工程与再生医学、生物传感与诊断平台，以及细胞培养与类器官系统。在此基础上，我们特别强调了水凝胶基于治疗策略在多种人类疾病背景下的最新进展，包括伤口愈合、肌肉骨骼系统修复、癌症、神经系统疾病、心血管疾病、自身免疫性疾病和生殖系统疾病。最后，我们讨论了水凝胶在生物医学中的发展潜力，并对其临床转化前景提出了综合视角，旨在为水凝胶材料在未来人类疾病治疗中的进一步应用提供参考和见解。

title: Neurons Die Not by One Hit, but by Signaling Convergence.
titleZh: 神经元并非因单一打击而死亡，而是由信号汇聚所致。

abstract: There is an emerging understanding of neurodegenerative diseases as complex diseases with a combination of multiple interrelated signaling pathways as opposed to one causative factor. This review examines the idea that neurons do not die in a single event, but through convergence of signals, which outlines the different pathological events such as oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, excitotoxicity, calcium imbalance, impaired proteostasis and neuroinflammation that interact to determine the fate of neurons. The processes are closely connected by molecular nodes like ROS, NF-κB, and MAPK signaling pathways, Nrf2/Keap1 antioxidant axis, and dysregulated autophagy and endoplasmic reticulum stress responses. The review also discusses the contribution of neuron glia interactions and the impact of microglial activation, astrocyte malfunction and cytokine networks in enhancing neuronal damage in a feedback mechanism. Mechanisms that have been mentioned as the oxidative stress inflammation cycle, mitochondrial damage, ROS feedback, and protein aggregation cellular stress loop are cited to be the major contributors to disease progression. Also, the review mentions new biomarkers, multi-omics methods, and sophisticated research instruments, such as artificial intelligence and organoid models, which can contribute to our knowledge of disease pathogenesis and help diagnose it earlier. On the whole, this review presents a complete paradigm on how to perceive neurodegeneration as a systems-level phenomenon. It combines molecular, cellular, and clinical perspectives and offers the rationale for the need to consider the therapeutic approach to neurodegenerative diseases in a holistic and multi-dimensional manner.
abstractZh: 目前，人们逐渐认识到神经退行性疾病是复杂疾病，由多种相互关联的信号通路组合而成，而非单一致病因素所致。本综述探讨了神经元并非在单一事件中死亡，而是通过信号汇聚而死亡的观点，概述了氧化应激、线粒体功能障碍、兴奋性毒性、钙失衡、蛋白质稳态受损和神经炎症等不同病理事件如何相互作用，共同决定神经元的命运。这些过程通过分子节点紧密相连，如ROS、NF-κB和MAPK信号通路，Nrf2/Keap1抗氧化轴，以及失调的自噬和内质网应激反应。本综述还讨论了神经元-胶质细胞相互作用的贡献，以及小胶质细胞活化、星形胶质细胞功能障碍和细胞因子网络在反馈机制中加剧神经元损伤的影响。氧化应激-炎症循环、线粒体损伤、ROS反馈和蛋白质聚集细胞应激环等机制被认为是疾病进展的主要驱动因素。此外，本综述提及了新的生物标志物、多组学方法和先进的研究工具，如人工智能和类器官模型，这些有助于我们理解疾病发病机制并实现更早诊断。总体而言，本综述提出了一个将神经退行性变视为系统级现象的完整范式，整合了分子、细胞和临床视角，并为以整体和多维方式考虑神经退行性疾病的治疗策略提供了理论依据。

abstract: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) is a prevalent and complex syndrome, with metabolic dysfunction playing a pivotal role in its progression. Disrupted endoplasmic reticulum (ER) homeostasis is recognized as a central mechanism in its pathogenesis. Although the homologous kinases Pak1 and Pak2 regulate the ER stress response, the role of Pak1 in HFpEF remains unclear. This study demonstrates that Pak1 is a critical regulator of cardiac adaptation to metabolic stress. Using a murine HFpEF model combining high‑fat diet and nitric oxide synthase inhibition, Pak1 knockdown accelerates diastolic dysfunction and maladaptive remodeling, accompanied by disrupted ER ultrastructure and impaired PERK‑ATF4 signaling, whereas Pak1 overexpression preserves cardiac function and ER homeostasis. Mechanistically, Pak1 activates the ERK1/2-MNK1-eIF4E signaling axis and promotes adaptive integrated stress response (ISR) signaling through the PERK-ATF4 pathway. Pharmacological inhibition of MNK1 attenuated Pak1-mediated PERK activation and ATF4 induction, identifying a mechanistic link between Pak1 signaling and adaptive stress responses. Furthermore, we developed a novel small-molecule Pak1 activator, JB2019, which reversed metabolic stress-induced cardiac dysfunction in both HFpEF mice and cardiac organoids. Collectively, these findings identify Pak1 as a novel regulator of adaptive ISR signaling and establish Pak1 activation as a promising therapeutic strategy for HFpEF.
abstractZh: 射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）是一种常见且复杂的综合征，代谢功能障碍在其进展中起关键作用。内质网（ER）稳态的破坏被认为是其发病机制中的核心机制。尽管同源激酶Pak1和Pak2调节内质网应激反应，但Pak1在HFpEF中的作用仍不清楚。本研究表明，Pak1是心脏适应代谢应激的关键调节因子。在使用高脂饮食和一氧化氮合酶抑制相结合的小鼠HFpEF模型中，Pak1敲低加速了舒张功能障碍和适应不良性重塑，并伴有内质网超微结构破坏和PERK-ATF4信号传导受损，而Pak1过表达则保留了心脏功能和内质网稳态。机制上，Pak1激活ERK1/2-MNK1-eIF4E信号轴，并通过PERK-ATF4通路促进适应性整合应激反应（ISR）信号传导。MNK1的药理学抑制减弱了Pak1介导的PERK激活和ATF4诱导，确定了Pak1信号传导与适应性应激反应之间的机制联系。此外，我们开发了一种新型小分子Pak1激活剂JB2019，它在HFpEF小鼠和心脏类器官中均逆转了代谢应激诱导的心脏功能障碍。总之，这些发现将Pak1确定为适应性ISR信号传导的新型调节因子，并将Pak1激活确立为HFpEF的一种有前景的治疗策略。

abstract: Despite remarkable advances in cancer drug treatment, including chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and immunotherapy, therapeutic resistance remains a formidable clinical barrier, limiting durable responses and long-term survival. Drug resistance can be broadly categorized as intrinsic, where tumors fail to respond to initial treatment, or acquired, which emerges during or after therapy due to adaptive or evolutionary processes. A comprehensive understanding of the multifactorial and dynamic nature of resistance is essential for improving treatment efficacy. In this review, we systematically examine the molecular and cellular determinants of drug response and resistance across 22 cancer types, highlighting key resistance mechanisms such as compensatory pathway activation, phenotypic plasticity, immune evasion, enhanced DNA damage repair, and the survival of drug-tolerant persister cells. These mechanisms are further contextualized across major therapeutic modalities, supported by clinical trials. We also present emerging strategies to overcome resistance, including rational drug combinations, novel agents, microbiome modulation, adaptive and intermittent therapies and advanced drug delivery systems, each illustrated with representative clinical studies. Moreover, we discuss cutting-edge tools that are revolutionizing resistance research, including single-cell and spatial multiomic profiling, patient-derived tumor organoid and xenograft (PDO/PDX) models, and artificial intelligence (AI)-powered predictive analytics. By integrating insights across molecular, cellular, and clinical dimensions, this review offers a strategic framework for understanding and tackling cancer drug resistance, with important translational implications for the future of precision oncology.
abstractZh: 尽管癌症药物治疗取得了显著进展，包括化疗、靶向治疗和免疫治疗，但治疗耐药性仍然是临床上的一个巨大障碍，限制了持久的反应和长期生存。耐药性大致可分为内在性耐药，即肿瘤对初始治疗无反应，或获得性耐药，即在治疗期间或之后由于适应性或进化过程而出现。全面理解耐药性的多因素和动态特性对于提高治疗效果至关重要。在这篇综述中，我们系统地考察了22种癌症类型中药物反应和耐药性的分子和细胞决定因素，强调了关键的耐药机制，如代偿性通路激活、表型可塑性、免疫逃逸、增强的DNA损伤修复以及耐药持久性细胞的存活。这些机制进一步在主要治疗模式中进行了情境化，并得到了临床试验的支持。我们还提出了克服耐药性的新兴策略，包括合理的药物组合、新型药物、微生物组调节、适应性和间歇性治疗以及先进的药物递送系统，每种策略都有代表性的临床研究加以说明。此外，我们讨论了正在彻底改变耐药性研究的尖端工具，包括单细胞和空间多组学分析、患者来源的肿瘤类器官和异种移植（PDO/PDX）模型，以及人工智能（AI）驱动的预测分析。通过整合分子、细胞和临床维度的见解，本综述为理解和应对癌症耐药性提供了一个战略框架，对精准肿瘤学的未来具有重要的转化意义。

abstract: Kidney organoids (KOs) are being actively developed and used as models for evaluating nephrotoxicity, which is an important process during drug development. To evaluate human pluripotent stem cell-derived KOs, various lineage markers have been used to confirm KO differentiation via quantitative real-time-PCR and western blotting. However, as these are qualitative evaluations, there are currently limitations in evaluating how similar differentiated KOs are to actual human kidneys. Thus, in this study, we utilized RNA-sequencing (21 organs; n = 7361) derived from the GTEx database to create a transcriptome-based kidney-specific gene expression panel (KiGEP) and developed a quantitative calculation algorithm (the KiGEP algorithm) to assess the similarity between human pluripotent stem cell-derived KOs and human kidneys. Thus, the KiGEP algorithm allows quantitative quality assessments of KOs, providing important information for the development of high-quality KOs for drug development and regenerative medicine applications.
abstractZh: 肾脏类器官（KOs）正在被积极开发并用作评估肾毒性的模型，这是药物开发过程中的一个重要环节。为了评估人多能干细胞来源的KOs，已使用各种谱系标志物通过定量实时PCR和蛋白质印迹法来确认KO分化。然而，由于这些是定性评估，目前在评估分化的KOs与实际人类肾脏的相似程度方面存在局限性。因此，在本研究中，我们利用来自GTEx数据库的RNA测序数据（21个器官；n = 7361）创建了基于转录组的肾脏特异性基因表达面板（KiGEP），并开发了一种定量计算算法（KiGEP算法）来评估人多能干细胞来源的KOs与人类肾脏之间的相似性。因此，KiGEP算法允许对KOs进行定量质量评估，为开发用于药物开发和再生医学应用的高质量KOs提供重要信息。

title: ComicGTN infers disease-associated rare cell states from single-cell multiomic data using DNA sequence-augmented graph transformer networks.

abstract: Single-cell multiomic technology makes it possible to profile both the transcriptome and epigenome within individual cells. The detection of rare cell states from such data is crucial for exploring novel disease biomarkers with clinical potential. However, existing methods typically focus on the gene and peak counts while ignoring the underlying genomic sequence at accessible sites. Here, we propose ComicGTN, an innovative computational framework that integrates single-cell multiomic data with DNA sequence information via enhanced graph transformer networks to accurately identify rare cell clusters. ComicGTN consistently outperforms nine state-of-the-art methods in identifying rare cells across multiple complex scenarios. In mouse breast cancer data, ComicGTN detects several functionally distinct immune subpopulations. In cerebral cortex of epilepsy patients, it uncovers oligodendrocytes undergoing particular differentiation states. For polycystic kidney disease patient-derived organoids, ComicGTN elaborates pathological pathways in a captured rare glomerular subgroup. Overall, ComicGTN accelerates the localization of disease-associated rare cell populations, facilitating the derivation of clinical insights in development and disease progression.
abstractZh: 单细胞多组学技术使得在单个细胞内同时分析转录组和表观基因组成为可能。从这类数据中检测稀有细胞状态对于探索具有临床潜力的新型疾病生物标志物至关重要。然而，现有方法通常侧重于基因和峰计数，而忽略了可及位点下的基因组序列。在此，我们提出了ComicGTN，一个创新的计算框架，通过增强的图变换器网络整合单细胞多组学数据与DNA序列信息，以准确识别稀有细胞簇。在多个复杂场景中，ComicGTN在识别稀有细胞方面始终优于九种最先进的方法。在小鼠乳腺癌数据中，ComicGTN检测到几个功能不同的免疫亚群。在癫痫患者的大脑皮层中，它揭示了正在经历特定分化状态的少突胶质细胞。对于多囊肾病患者来源的类器官，ComicGTN详细阐述了捕获的稀有肾小球亚群中的病理途径。总体而言，ComicGTN加速了与疾病相关的稀有细胞群体的定位，有助于在发育和疾病进展中获得临床见解。

title: Patient-Derived Organoids in Gastrointestinal Disease: Current Applications, Limitations, and Future Perspectives.

abstract: The development of patient-derived organoids (PDOs) has substantially advanced the study of gastrointestinal diseases by providing three-dimensional human models that faithfully recapitulate the structural, molecular, and functional characteristics of native tissues. Unlike conventional two-dimensional cultures and animal models, intestinal organoids preserve epithelial architecture, cellular heterogeneity, and patient-specific genetic features, enabling more physiologically relevant investigations of gastrointestinal physiology and disease. Recent technological advances, including co-culture systems, organoid-derived monolayers, and organ-on-chip platforms, have further expanded their ability to model epithelial interactions with immune cells, stromal components, and the gut microbiota. These developments have facilitated mechanistic studies of epithelial barrier function, host-microbiota communication, microbial metabolites, and endocrine signaling, while also supporting translational applications in inflammatory bowel disease, infectious disorders, inherited gastrointestinal diseases, and gastrointestinal cancers. Moreover, patient-derived organoids have emerged as promising platforms for drug screening, biomarker discovery, precision medicine, and regenerative therapies. Despite these advances, several challenges remain, including limited representation of the native tissue microenvironment, lack of standardized culture protocols, scalability, and regulatory issues that currently restrict routine clinical implementation. This review summarizes recent progress in gastrointestinal organoid technology, highlighting current applications, emerging experimental platforms, and future perspectives for integrating organoid-based models into translational research and personalized medicine.
abstractZh: 患者来源类器官（PDOs）的发展通过提供忠实再现天然组织结构、分子和功能特征的三维人体模型，极大地推进了胃肠道疾病的研究。与传统的二维培养和动物模型不同，肠道类器官保留了上皮结构、细胞异质性和患者特异性遗传特征，使得对胃肠道生理和疾病的生理相关性研究成为可能。近期的技术进步，包括共培养系统、类器官来源的单层和器官芯片平台，进一步扩展了它们模拟上皮与免疫细胞、基质成分和肠道微生物群相互作用的能力。这些发展促进了上皮屏障功能、宿主-微生物通讯、微生物代谢物和内分泌信号传导的机制研究，同时也支持了炎症性肠病、感染性疾病、遗传性胃肠道疾病和胃肠道癌症的转化应用。此外，患者来源类器官已成为药物筛选、生物标志物发现、精准医学和再生治疗的有前景平台。尽管取得了这些进展，仍存在若干挑战，包括对天然组织微环境代表性有限、缺乏标准化培养方案、可扩展性以及目前限制常规临床实施的监管问题。本综述总结了胃肠道类器官技术的最新进展，重点介绍了当前应用、新兴实验平台以及将基于类器官的模型整合到转化研究和个性化医学中的未来前景。

title: The solid tumor microenvironment changes the hierarchy of CD155 and CD112 receptors, shaping checkpoint blockade outcome
titleZh: 实体瘤微环境改变CD155和CD112受体的层级，塑造检查点阻断的结果
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Carannante V, Olofsson K, Zhang H, Sandström N, Fontana J, Toullec D, Turyasingura G, Hell B, Wagner AK, Sandoz PA, Ooijen HV, Lundqvist A, Wiklund M, Önfelt B.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Reproducing a physiologically relevant tumor microenvironment  in vitro is essential for developing effective immunotherapeutic treatments. By integrating the use of combinatorial receptor blockade and organoid models we provide a deep functional understanding of CD155 and CD112 receptors in solid tumors and their impact on cellular immunotherapy and infiltration. CD226 showed plasticity in response to the environment, being able to switch between CD155 and CD112 depending on the ligand availability. In addition, CD226 drove NK cell infiltration into tumor tissues via CD155 and CD112 ligation, with CD226-CD112 interaction specifically promoting migration from the periphery to the core. Downregulation of CD155 and TIGIT induced by the tumor microenvironment and previous drug exposure reduced the long-term efficacy of TIGIT blockade. Taken together, our findings point towards using CD112R blockade in primary tumors to simultaneously enhance NK cell killing activity and promote infiltration into the tumor core via CD226 and CD112 interaction.  ONE SENTENCE SUMMARY

  Tumors shape the hierarchy of CD155-CD112 receptors, reducing TIGIT blockade efficacy, while CD226 drives NK infiltration and shows binding plasticity
abstractZh:
摘要

  在体外重现生理相关的肿瘤微环境对于开发有效的免疫治疗至关重要。通过整合组合受体阻断和类器官模型的使用，我们提供了对实体瘤中CD155和CD112受体的深入功能理解，以及它们对细胞免疫治疗和浸润的影响。CD226表现出对环境响应的可塑性，能够根据配体的可用性在CD155和CD112之间切换。此外，CD226通过CD155和CD112的连接驱动NK细胞浸润到肿瘤组织中，其中CD226-CD112相互作用特别促进从外周到核心的迁移。肿瘤微环境和先前的药物暴露诱导的CD155和TIGIT的下调降低了TIGIT阻断的长期疗效。总的来说，我们的发现指向在原发性肿瘤中使用CD112R阻断，通过CD226和CD112相互作用同时增强NK细胞杀伤活性并促进向肿瘤核心的浸润。

abstract: Human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) can differentiate into various types of central nervous system organoids which are valuable for applications in tissue engineering and injury repair. The secreted extracellular vesicles (EVs) of organoids, in particular the small-sized EV subset referred as exosomes (30-200 nm), have emerged as novel therapeutics in regenerative medicine. This study investigated the encapsulation and controlled release of human spinal cord organoid (hSCO)-derived EVs in viscoelastic hyaluronic acid (HA) hydrogels and assessed their impact on organoid patterning. A series of pH-responsive hydrogels were fabricated, leading to sustained EV release regulated by viscoelastic properties. The pH of these hydrogels decreased from 9 to 7 during incubation, which altered hydrogel viscoelasticity, thereby modulating EV release kinetics. In addition, EV-loaded hydrogels regulated key hSCO patterning markers such as DBX1 and ISL1. Furthermore, these EVs in hydrogels can cross a modeled blood-spinal cord barrier and provide cross-barrier capability for delivery. Taken together, the organoid-secreted EVs in viscoelastic HA hydrogels can be released at a controlled rate and have potential to regulate spinal cord organoid patterning. This study advances our knowledge of regulating intercellular communication and developing EV-based therapies for treating neurological disorders such as spinal cord injury.
abstractZh: 人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）可分化为多种中枢神经系统类器官，这些类器官在组织工程和损伤修复中具有重要应用价值。类器官分泌的细胞外囊泡（EVs），特别是被称为外泌体的小尺寸EV亚群（30-200 nm），已成为再生医学中的新型治疗手段。本研究探讨了人脊髓类器官（hSCO）来源的EVs在粘弹性透明质酸（HA）水凝胶中的封装与控释，并评估了它们对类器官模式形成的影响。制备了一系列pH响应性水凝胶，通过粘弹性特性实现EV的持续释放。在孵育过程中，这些水凝胶的pH从9降至7，改变了水凝胶的粘弹性，从而调节了EV的释放动力学。此外，负载EV的水凝胶调节了关键的hSCO模式形成标志物，如DBX1和ISL1。进一步研究表明，水凝胶中的这些EVs能够穿越模拟的血脊髓屏障，具备跨屏障递送能力。综上所述，粘弹性HA水凝胶中的类器官分泌EVs可以以受控速率释放，并具有调节脊髓类器官模式形成的潜力。这项研究增进了我们对调控细胞间通讯以及开发基于EVs的疗法治疗脊髓损伤等神经系统疾病的理解。

title: Tomographic Printing in a Chip: A Versatile Platform for Biomimetic 3D Organ-on-Chip.

abstract: Organ-on-chip (OoC) platforms are increasingly adopted for predictive in vitro testing. However, most remain limited by soft-lithography-derived 2.5D microfluidic architectures and nonphysiological rigid materials, or bioprinting approaches that require complex and failure-prone post-fabrication assembly. Here, we present a versatile approach that integrates tomographic volumetric additive manufacturing (TVAM) directly within preassembled microfluidic chips, enabling rapid, contactless fabrication of freeform 3D OoCs. Leveraging our open-source optical simulation framework, Dr.TVAM, we perform TVAM in custom-designed chips, eliminating post-printing manual assembly steps that commonly lead to leakage, contamination, and poor reproducibility. This strategy, termed TVAM-in-a-chip, supports the generation of diverse 3D channel architectures in multiple biocompatible photoresins spanning a wide range of chemistries and mechanical properties, including cell-laden formulations. We demonstrate multi-channel designs, compatibility with confocal imaging, and dynamic culture of epithelial and endothelial models. Overall, TVAM-in-a-chip overcomes key limitations of current OoC technologies and paves the way for a new generation of scalable, biomimetic 3D platforms for advanced in vitro modeling.
abstractZh: 器官芯片（OoC）平台越来越多地被用于预测性体外测试。然而，大多数平台仍受限于基于软光刻的2.5维微流控架构和非生理性刚性材料，或需要复杂且易失败的后制造组装的生物打印方法。在此，我们提出了一种多功能方法，将断层体积增材制造（TVAM）直接集成到预组装的微流控芯片中，实现快速、非接触式制造自由形态的三维OoC。利用我们开源的Dr.TVAM光学模拟框架，我们在定制设计的芯片中进行TVAM，消除了打印后手动组装步骤，这些步骤通常会导致泄漏、污染和较差的重复性。这种策略被称为“芯片内TVAM”，支持在多种生物相容性光刻胶中生成多样化的三维通道架构，涵盖广泛的化学和机械性能，包括含细胞配方。我们展示了多通道设计、与共聚焦成像的兼容性，以及上皮和内皮模型的动态培养。总体而言，芯片内TVAM克服了当前OoC技术的关键限制，为新一代可扩展、仿生三维平台用于先进体外建模铺平了道路。

abstract: Inflammatory activation is involved in the pathogenesis of heart failure (HF). ATPase H+-Transporting Accessory Protein 2 (ATP6AP2) is an auxiliary subunit of the V-ATPase, and its role in HF is not fully understood. To assess the role and regulatory mechanisms and therapeutic potential of ATP6AP2 in HF, we used a cardiac-specific ATP6AP2 conditional knockout (CKO) mouse model and observed spontaneous cardiac dysfunction, myocardial fibrosis and cardiomyocyte apoptosis in mice. Further studies showed that ATP6AP2 promoted stimulator of interferon genes (STING) degradation through the lysosome-dependent pathway. ATP6AP2 knockdown significantly upregulated STING protein levels, activated the STING-TBK1-IRF3 signaling axis, and promoted pro-inflammatory factor expression and cardiomyocyte apoptosis. In mice with myocardial infarction (MI), myocardial overexpression of ATP6AP2 or treatment with H-151 inhibited the activation of the STING signaling pathway, ameliorated cardiomyocyte apoptosis and inflammatory responses, thereby improving cardiac function. In addition, in macrophages treated with conditioned medium from hypoxia-exposed cardiomyocytes, the levels of pyroptosis-related proteins were markedly increased, whereas ATP6AP2 overexpression or STING inhibition reduced pyroptosis. ATP6AP2 likewise attenuates inflammation and pyroptosis caused by hypoxia in cardiac organoids. In conclusion, activating ATP6AP2 could serve as a promising therapeutic option in HF.
abstractZh: 炎症激活参与心力衰竭（HF）的发病机制。ATPase H+转运辅助蛋白2（ATP6AP2）是V-ATPase的辅助亚基，其在HF中的作用尚未完全阐明。为了评估ATP6AP2在HF中的作用、调控机制及治疗潜力，我们使用了心脏特异性ATP6AP2条件敲除（CKO）小鼠模型，并观察到小鼠出现自发性心功能障碍、心肌纤维化和心肌细胞凋亡。进一步研究表明，ATP6AP2通过溶酶体依赖性途径促进干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）的降解。ATP6AP2敲低显著上调STING蛋白水平，激活STING-TBK1-IRF3信号轴，并促进促炎因子表达和心肌细胞凋亡。在心肌梗死（MI）小鼠中，心肌过表达ATP6AP2或使用H-151治疗可抑制STING信号通路的激活，改善心肌细胞凋亡和炎症反应，从而改善心功能。此外，在用缺氧心肌细胞条件培养基处理的巨噬细胞中，焦亡相关蛋白水平显著升高，而ATP6AP2过表达或STING抑制可减少焦亡。ATP6AP2同样减轻了心脏类器官中缺氧引起的炎症和焦亡。总之，激活ATP6AP2可能成为HF的一种有前景的治疗选择。

abstract: Bioengineered livers using decellularized extracellular matrix (ECM) scaffolds hold promise for transplantation therapies. However, conventional recellularization methods involving cell injection via blood vessels encounter challenges in recapitulating the complexity of hepatic tissues, including high cellularity, differentiation hierarchy, and cellular heterogeneity. Here, we developed a methodology termed "combined single-cell and organoid (CSO) injection." We injected human liver organoids (HLOs) and dispersed organoid cells via direct puncture and vascular injection into a decellularized porcine ECM scaffold, respectively. This process facilitated the construction of densely populated and self-organized liver-like tissues (CSO Livers) that formed cell-cell/cell-ECM interactions. The tissues displayed hepatic characteristics, including ALBUMIN secretion, robust expression of liver-associated genes, and cellular heterogeneity comprising hepatocytes, cholangiocytes, as well as stellate-like and endothelial cells. Furthermore, we demonstrated that CSO-Livers functioned as grafts in immunodeficient mice and in a microminipig model of liver fibrosis through transplantation via vascular anastomosis. These findings indicate the applicability of the combined single-cell and organoid (CSO) injection method for generating bioengineered liver grafts using HLOs.
abstractZh: 使用脱细胞细胞外基质（ECM）支架的生物工程肝脏有望用于移植治疗。然而，传统的再细胞化方法，如通过血管注射细胞，在重现肝组织的复杂性（包括高细胞密度、分化层次和细胞异质性）方面面临挑战。在此，我们开发了一种称为“单细胞与类器官联合（CSO）注射”的方法。我们通过直接穿刺和血管注射将人肝类器官（HLOs）和分散的类器官细胞分别注入脱细胞猪ECM支架中。这一过程促进了高密度、自组织的肝样组织（CSO肝脏）的构建，形成了细胞-细胞/细胞-ECM相互作用。这些组织表现出肝脏特征，包括白蛋白分泌、肝相关基因的强表达，以及包含肝细胞、胆管细胞以及星状样细胞和内皮细胞的细胞异质性。此外，我们证明了CSO肝脏通过血管吻合移植在免疫缺陷小鼠和肝纤维化微型猪模型中作为移植物发挥作用。这些发现表明，单细胞与类器官联合（CSO）注射方法适用于利用HLOs生成生物工程肝脏移植物。

title: Decoding age-stratified clinical and molecular heterogeneity in male breast cancer through multiomic profiling.
titleZh: 通过多组学分析解码男性乳腺癌中按年龄分层的临床和分子异质性。

abstract:
Objective

Age-associated molecular heterogeneity is well described in female breast cancer but remains insufficiently characterized in male breast cancer (MBC). We profiled age-stratified clinical and molecular differences between younger (≤55 years) male breast cancer (YMBC) and older (>55 years) male breast cancer (OMBC).Methods

We retrospectively analyzed 347 patients with MBC diagnosed at Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center by integrating clinicopathological data, RNA sequencing, and whole-exome sequencing (WES). Survival, differential expression, and mutational signature analyses were performed. Tumor microenvironment features were inferred using xCell and ESTIMATE, and weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) was conducted to identify age-associated co-expression modules. Candidate therapeutics were prioritized using the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer (GDSC) resource and evaluated using patient-derived organoids (PDOs).Results

Compared with OMBC, YMBC more frequently had human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)-positive status (14.91% vs. 4.02%) and triple-negative tumors (4.92% vs. 1.78%), and had worse 5-year recurrence-free survival (hazard ratio=2.19, P=0.018). Transcriptomic analyses indicated enrichment of neural-related programs and reduced immune-related signaling in YMBC, and xCell/ESTIMATE supported lower immune infiltration. Consistently, WGCNA identified age-associated modules linking neural-related programs with reduced immune infiltration. Immunohistochemistry supported increased perineural invasion and lower CD8+ T cell infiltration in YMBC. GDSC-guided prioritization with PDO testing nominated sepantronium bromide (YM155) as a candidate vulnerability in YMBC. WES showed a higher NBPF10 mutation frequency in YMBC (54.5% vs. 14.3%, PConclusions

Integrated multi-omics profiling revealed age-stratified clinical and molecular heterogeneity in MBC. YMBC patients demonstrated inferior recurrence-free survival, neural signaling enrichment, an immune-cold microenvironment, and enriched NBPF10 mutations. These findings support age as a meaningful stratification variable in MBC risk assessment and treatment planning, and highlight the need for caution when considering treatment de-escalation in younger patients, while nominating YM155 as a candidate agent for prospective evaluation.
abstractZh:
目的

年龄相关的分子异质性在女性乳腺癌中已有充分描述，但在男性乳腺癌（MBC）中仍未得到充分表征。我们分析了年轻（≤55岁）男性乳腺癌（YMBC）与年长（>55岁）男性乳腺癌（OMBC）之间按年龄分层的临床和分子差异。方法

我们回顾性分析了复旦大学附属肿瘤医院诊断的347例MBC患者，整合了临床病理数据、RNA测序和全外显子组测序（WES）。进行了生存分析、差异表达分析和突变特征分析。使用xCell和ESTIMATE推断肿瘤微环境特征，并进行加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）以识别与年龄相关的共表达模块。使用癌症药物敏感性基因组学（GDSC）资源优先排序候选治疗药物，并使用患者来源的类器官（PDOs）进行评估。结果

与OMBC相比，YMBC更频繁地具有人表皮生长因子受体2（HER2）阳性状态（14.91%对4.02%）和三阴性肿瘤（4.92%对1.78%），且5年无复发生存率更差（风险比=2.19，P=0.018）。转录组分析表明YMBC中神经相关程序的富集和免疫相关信号传导的减少，xCell/ESTIMATE支持较低的免疫浸润。一致地，WGCNA识别出将神经相关程序与免疫浸润减少联系起来的年龄相关模块。免疫组织化学支持YMBC中神经周围浸润增加和CD8+ T细胞浸润降低。GDSC指导的优先排序和PDO测试提名塞帕特罗尼溴化物（YM155）作为YMBC的候选脆弱性。WES显示YMBC中NBPF10突变频率更高（54.5%对14.3%，P结论

整合的多组学分析揭示了MBC中按年龄分层的临床和分子异质性。YMBC患者表现出较差的无复发生存期、神经信号富集、免疫冷微环境和富集的NBPF10突变。这些发现支持年龄作为MBC风险评估和治疗计划中有意义的分层变量，并强调在年轻患者中考虑降级治疗时需要谨慎，同时提名YM155作为前瞻性评估的候选药物。

title: Reduced mechanical shear is associated with early cortical differentiation and GDNF-GFRA1/RET signalling in human brain organoids.

abstract: Early cortical differentiation in human brain organoids is a critical step of corticogenesis, but remains poorly coordinated under conventional culture conditions. In a standard orbital shaker system, mechanical shear and variability in extracellular matrix support, can disrupt neuroepithelial organisation, leading to inconsistent early cortical differentiation. Here, we investigated how ClinoStar-associated low-shear culture conditions affect early corticogenic marker expression in brain organoids and examined GFRA1/RET-related signaling as a candidate pathway associated with these culture-related effects. Using a low-shear ClinoStar bioreactor, we observed improved neuroepithelial-like expansion, enhanced tissue organisation, and promoted early cortical differentiation during the neuroepithelial expansion stage. Compared with conventional conditions, low-mechanical shear in ClinoStar was associated with increased proliferation capacity and supported the number of TBR2+ intermediate progenitors and TBR1+ early cortical neurons. Transcriptomic analysis revealed enrichment of neuronal differentiation and neuroactive ligand-receptor interaction pathways, with increased upregulation of GDNF signalling components under reduced mechanical shear. Functional experiments showed that GDNF supplementation increased TBR2+ intermediate progenitor-associated and TBR1+ early neuronal marker-related populations in brain organoids, suggesting a positive effect on early corticogenic marker expression. Consistent with this, GFRA1/RET levels were elevated in organoids in the ClinoStar culture with low-mechanical shear stress, and manipulation of GFRA1 affected early cortical differentiation outcomes. These findings suggest that ClinoStar low-shear culture promoted early corticogenic marker expression, potentially associated with GDNF-GFRA1/RET signalling. Collectively, this study provides a refined culture framework for improving the reproducibility and structural organisation of human brain organoid models of early cortical differentiation.
abstractZh: 人类大脑类器官中的早期皮层分化是皮层形成的关键步骤，但在常规培养条件下协调性较差。在标准轨道摇床系统中，机械剪切力和细胞外基质支持的可变性会破坏神经上皮组织，导致早期皮层分化不一致。在此，我们研究了ClinoStar相关的低剪切培养条件如何影响大脑类器官中早期皮层生成标志物的表达，并检查了GFRA1/RET相关信号传导作为与这些培养相关效应相关的候选通路。使用低剪切ClinoStar生物反应器，我们观察到在神经上皮扩增阶段，神经上皮样扩增得到改善，组织组织结构增强，并促进了早期皮层分化。与常规条件相比，ClinoStar中的低机械剪切力与增殖能力增加相关，并支持了TBR2+中间祖细胞和TBR1+早期皮层神经元的数量。转录组分析揭示了神经元分化和神经活性配体-受体相互作用通路的富集，在减少机械剪切力下，GDNF信号传导成分的上调增加。功能实验表明，GDNF补充增加了大脑类器官中TBR2+中间祖细胞相关和TBR1+早期神经元标志物相关群体，表明对早期皮层生成标志物表达有积极影响。与此一致，在低机械剪切应力的ClinoStar培养中，类器官中的GFRA1/RET水平升高，并且GFRA1的操作影响了早期皮层分化结果。这些发现表明，ClinoStar低剪切培养促进了早期皮层生成标志物的表达，可能与GDNF-GFRA1/RET信号传导有关。总的来说，这项研究为改善早期皮层分化的人类大脑类器官模型的再现性和结构组织提供了一个精细的培养框架。

title: Stem cell-based therapeutics in epilepsy: current advances and future prospects.

abstract: Epilepsy represents as one of the most prevalent and serious neurological disorders, with approximately one-third of patients resistant to conventional treatments. Current pharmacologic therapies primarily suppress seizures without targeting the underlying epileptogenesis, resulting in unchanged long-term prognosis. At the same time, epilepsy surgery remains underutilized due to the requirement for extensive evaluations and specialized expertise. Stem cell-based therapy has emerged as a promising avenue, offering the potential to address both the neurological and neuropsychiatric aspects. This review summarizes recent preclinical and clinical studies on stem cell therapy in epilepsy, with a focus on their mechanisms of action, including direct engraftment, restoration of normal neurogenesis, and immunomodulation via bystander effect. Advances in genetic engineering, extracellular vesicle-based therapy, and patient-derived brain organoids offer more personalized treatment strategies. Although stem cell therapy holds significant promise as a treatment for epilepsy, further extensive research is required to establish its clinical safety and efficacy.
abstractZh: 癫痫是最常见且严重的神经系统疾病之一，约有三分之一的患者对常规治疗耐药。目前的药物治疗主要抑制癫痫发作，而不针对潜在的癫痫发生机制，导致长期预后无改善。同时，由于需要广泛的评估和专业知识，癫痫手术仍未得到充分利用。基于干细胞的治疗已成为一个有前景的途径，有望同时解决神经学和神经精神方面的问题。本综述总结了近年来干细胞治疗癫痫的临床前和临床研究，重点关注其作用机制，包括直接移植、恢复正常神经发生以及通过旁观者效应进行免疫调节。基因工程、细胞外囊泡治疗和患者来源的脑类器官的进展提供了更个性化的治疗策略。尽管干细胞治疗作为癫痫的一种治疗方法具有显著前景，但仍需进一步广泛研究以确定其临床安全性和有效性。

title: [Construction and application of organoid models in traditional Chinese medicine research].
titleZh: [中药研究中类器官模型的构建与应用]。

abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine(TCM) research has long faced technical bottlenecks, including the complexity of chemical composition, multi-target mechanisms of action, and the difficulty of deeply elucidating holistic effects. There is an urgent need to establish novel research models and platforms that more closely recapitulate in vivo physiological and pathological states. In recent years, organoids, as emerging three-dimensional culture systems, have been widely applied in drug screening, toxicity evaluation, and personalized medicine, offering new technical tools and perspectives for TCM research. However, the application of organoid models in TCM research is still in its early stage, and relevant case studies and systematic summaries remain insufficient. This article systematically reviews the construction characteristics of different types of organoid models and their application value in TCM research, with a focus on the applications of organoids in the studies of medicinal herbs, TCM formulas, and TCM toxicity and safety evaluation. These applications include elucidation of mechanisms of action, screening of active components, toxicity and safety assessment, exploration of formula compatibility patterns, and development of novel TCM drugs. In view of the current challenges and limitations of organoid technology in standardized construction, simulation of complex microenvironments, maintenance of functional stability, adaptation to the complexity of TCM systems, and particularly the development of disease-syndrome combination models, this paper proposes corresponding solutions. Furthermore, this paper envisions the application prospects of integrating organoids with cutting-edge technologies such as microfluidics, artificial intelligence, 3D bioprinting, and multi-omics analysis to address the complexities of TCM research, aiming to provide a systematic reference and a theoretical basis for advancing the modernization of TCM.
abstractZh: 中药研究长期以来面临技术瓶颈，包括化学成分复杂、作用机制多靶点以及整体效应难以深入阐明。迫切需要建立更接近体内生理和病理状态的新型研究模型和平台。近年来，类器官作为新兴的三维培养系统，已广泛应用于药物筛选、毒性评价和个体化医疗，为中药研究提供了新的技术工具和视角。然而，类器官模型在中药研究中的应用仍处于早期阶段，相关案例和系统总结仍不足。本文系统综述了不同类型类器官模型的构建特点及其在中药研究中的应用价值，重点介绍了类器官在药材、中药复方以及中药毒性和安全性评价研究中的应用。这些应用包括阐明作用机制、筛选活性成分、毒性和安全性评估、探索复方配伍规律以及开发中药新药。鉴于当前类器官技术在标准化构建、模拟复杂微环境、维持功能稳定性、适应中药系统的复杂性，特别是疾病-证候结合模型开发方面面临的挑战和局限性，本文提出了相应的解决方案。此外，本文展望了将类器官与微流控、人工智能、3D生物打印和多组学分析等前沿技术相结合以应对中药研究复杂性的应用前景，旨在为推进中药现代化提供系统参考和理论基础。

title: Reversible vs. Irreversible Neuronal Injury in Brain Ischemia: Role of the Mitochondrial-Synaptic Axis.
titleZh: 脑缺血中可逆与不可逆神经元损伤：线粒体-突触轴的作用。

abstract: Ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury triggers a rapid and self-amplifying cascade of mitochondrial dysfunction, synaptic instability, and neuroinflammation that ultimately determines neuronal survival and functional recovery. Early bioenergetic collapse-driven by mitochondrial depolarization, Reactive oxygen species (ROS) overproduction, and impaired mitophagy-initiates excitotoxic signaling and calpain-mediated structural degradation at vulnerable synapses. These events converge with microglial and astrocytic activation to exacerbate cytokine release, blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption, and delayed neuronal injury. Therapeutic strategies targeting this axis show considerable promise. Mitochondria-directed interventions-including mitophagy modulation, Dynamin-related protein 1 (Drp1) inhibition, antioxidant nanocarriers, and emerging mitochondrial transplantation-restore Adenosine triphosphate (ATP) production, stabilize membrane potential, and prevent downstream excitotoxic injury. Synaptic protection via N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA)/postsynaptic density protein-95 (PSD-95) uncoupling, α-amino-3-hydroxy-5-methyl-4-isoxazolepropionic acid (AMPA) receptor stabilization, and calpain inhibition preserves dendritic architecture and neurotransmission. Modulation of inflammatory pathways, particularly Interleukin-1β (IL-1β), Tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), and Interleukin-6 (IL-6) signaling, as well as cell-specific microglial and astrocytic reprogramming, further attenuates secondary degeneration. Gene- and RNA-based therapies, nanoparticles engineered for BBB penetration, and extracellular vesicle-mediated delivery systems represent additional advanced platforms moving toward clinical translation. Despite substantial progress, challenges remain, including timing constraints, region-specific vulnerability (e.g., CA1 vs. CA3), limited BBB permeability, and species differences in mitochondrial dynamics and glial responses. Integrative multimodal strategies-combining mitochondrial repair, synaptic stabilization, and immunomodulation-along with advanced imaging, spatial transcriptomics, and patient-derived organoids, may accelerate the development of precision therapies for I/R injury. This review synthesizes mechanistic and translational evidence demonstrating that the mitochondria-synapse-inflammation axis forms a unified pathological framework across experimental and clinical I/R settings, including transient focal ischemia, global ischemia following cardiac arrest (CA), and reperfusion after thrombolysis or thrombectomy.
abstractZh: 缺血再灌注（I/R）损伤触发线粒体功能障碍、突触不稳定和神经炎症的快速且自我放大的级联反应，最终决定神经元存活和功能恢复。早期生物能量崩溃——由线粒体去极化、活性氧（ROS）过度产生和线粒体自噬受损驱动——在脆弱突触处引发兴奋毒性信号传导和钙蛋白酶介导的结构降解。这些事件与小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞激活汇聚，加剧细胞因子释放、血脑屏障（BBB）破坏和延迟性神经元损伤。针对这一轴的治疗策略显示出相当大的前景。线粒体导向干预——包括线粒体自噬调节、动力相关蛋白1（Drp1）抑制、抗氧化纳米载体和新兴的线粒体移植——恢复三磷酸腺苷（ATP）产生，稳定膜电位，并防止下游兴奋毒性损伤。通过N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸（NMDA）/突触后密度蛋白-95（PSD-95）解偶联、α-氨基-3-羟基-5-甲基-4-异恶唑丙酸（AMPA）受体稳定和钙蛋白酶抑制进行的突触保护，保留了树突结构和神经传递。炎症通路的调节，特别是白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）和白细胞介素-6（IL-6）信号传导，以及细胞特异性小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞重编程，进一步减轻继发性变性。基因和RNA-based疗法、为穿透BBB设计的纳米颗粒以及细胞外囊泡介导的递送系统代表了向临床转化推进的额外先进平台。尽管取得了实质性进展，但挑战仍然存在，包括时间限制、区域特异性脆弱性（例如，CA1与CA3）、有限的BBB通透性以及线粒体动力学和胶质细胞反应的物种差异。整合多模式策略——结合线粒体修复、突触稳定和免疫调节——以及先进成像、空间转录组学和患者来源的类器官，可能加速I/R损伤精准疗法的发展。本综述综合了机制和转化证据，证明线粒体-突触-炎症轴在实验和临床I/R环境中形成了一个统一的病理框架，包括短暂性局灶性缺血、心脏骤停（CA）后的全脑缺血以及溶栓或血栓切除后的再灌注。

abstract: Myeloproliferative neoplasms are a group of clonal proliferative diseases originating from hematopoietic stem cells, with a risk of transformation to acute myeloid leukemia. Primary myelofibrosis (PMF) is a subtype of myeloproliferative neoplasms. Mutations in Janus kinase 2 (JAK2), calreticulin (CALR), and thrombopoietin receptor (MPL) genes are the main pathogenic factors in PMF patients. Current therapeutic strategies, including JAK2 inhibitors, are only effective in a subset of PMF patients, highlighting an urgent need for the development of novel interventions. Experimental models of PMF, including cellular models, animal models, and in vitro organoid models, play crucial roles in exploring pathogenesis and screening potential therapeutic agents. This review comprehensively summarizes these experimental model systems, compares the advantages and disadvantages of different models, and discusses the limitations of current research and prospects for future directions, in order to provide assistance for the development of therapeutic strategies for PMF.
abstractZh: 骨髓增殖性肿瘤是一组起源于造血干细胞的克隆性增殖性疾病，有转化为急性髓系白血病的风险。原发性骨髓纤维化（PMF）是骨髓增殖性肿瘤的一种亚型。Janus激酶2（JAK2）、钙网蛋白（CALR）和血小板生成素受体（MPL）基因的突变是PMF患者的主要致病因素。目前的治疗策略，包括JAK2抑制剂，仅对部分PMF患者有效，这凸显了开发新型干预措施的迫切需求。PMF的实验模型，包括细胞模型、动物模型和体外类器官模型，在探索发病机制和筛选潜在治疗药物方面发挥着至关重要的作用。本综述全面总结了这些实验模型系统，比较了不同模型的优缺点，并讨论了当前研究的局限性和未来方向的前景，以期为PMF治疗策略的开发提供帮助。

abstract:
Background

Radiation therapy is a standard-of-care oncological treatment for central nervous system (CNS) malignancies. However, as survival outcomes improve, radiation-induced injury to normal brain tissue has increased in clinical significance. CNS radiation injury is a delayed, multifactorial process characterized by impaired neurogenesis, reactive gliosis, and persistent functional deficits. Mechanistic exploration and development of effective radiation mitigators have been limited by the lack of scalable, human-relevant models.Methods

Mature human iPSC-derived cortical organoids were exposed to single-dose or clinically relevant fractionated radiation (5 × 2 Gy). DNA damage, apoptosis, and growth dynamics were assessed longitudinally. Structural organization, synaptic integrity, and neuroinflammatory responses were evaluated by immunofluorescence and real-time PCR. Transcriptomic profiling was performed at 72 hours and 2 weeks after fractionated radiation to capture acute and delayed effects. Two candidate radiation mitigators, NSPP and amisulpride, were tested for their therapeutic effects within the organoid system.Results

Cortical organoids exhibited partial recovery following single doses up to 4 Gy or fractioned irradiation. Transcriptomic analyses revealed that radiation not only reduced overall cell viability but also reshaped lineage trajectories, characterized by depletion of neural stem/progenitor populations, loss of neuronal identity, enhanced gliogenesis, increased inflammatory cytokines, and disrupted cortical layering and synaptic integrity. Treatment with NSPP or amisulpride attenuated injury-associated transcriptional and structural alterations.Conclusion

Human cortical organoids recapitulate key features of radiation-induced neural injury, recovery, and therapeutic modulation, providing a robust, scalable, and human-relevant platform for studying CNS radiation biology and preclinical screening of candidate radiation mitigators.
abstractZh:
背景

放射治疗是中枢神经系统恶性肿瘤的标准治疗方案。然而，随着生存结局的改善，放射治疗对正常脑组织造成的损伤在临床上的重要性日益增加。中枢神经系统放射性损伤是一个延迟性的、多因素过程，其特征是神经发生受损、反应性胶质增生和持续性功能缺陷。由于缺乏可扩展的、与人类相关的模型，辐射缓解剂的机制探索和开发受到限制。方法

将成熟的人诱导多能干细胞来源的皮层类器官暴露于单次剂量或临床相关的分次辐射（5 × 2 Gy）。纵向评估DNA损伤、细胞凋亡和生长动态。通过免疫荧光和实时PCR评估结构组织、突触完整性和神经炎症反应。在分次辐射后72小时和2周进行转录组分析，以捕捉急性和延迟效应。测试了两种候选辐射缓解剂NSPP和氨磺必利在类器官系统中的治疗效果。结果

皮层类器官在单次剂量高达4 Gy或分次照射后表现出部分恢复。转录组分析显示，辐射不仅降低了整体细胞活力，还重塑了谱系轨迹，其特征是神经干/祖细胞群体耗竭、神经元特性丧失、胶质生成增强、炎症细胞因子增加，以及皮层分层和突触完整性破坏。NSPP或氨磺必利治疗减轻了损伤相关的转录和结构改变。结论

人皮层类器官再现了辐射诱导神经损伤、恢复和治疗调节的关键特征，为研究中枢神经系统辐射生物学和候选辐射缓解剂的临床前筛选提供了一个稳健、可扩展且与人类相关的平台。

abstract: Cell-cycle progression is a major source of variability in live-cell phenotyping, yet imaging workflows still lack a general way to account for it alongside structural and functional readouts. Here we show CALIPERS (Cell-cycle-Aware Live-cell Imaging for Phenotyping Experiments and Regeneration Studies), an integrated framework that pairs a spectrally redesigned FUCCI reporter with continuous cell-cycle inference and flexible delivery strategies in human cells and stem-cell models. In epithelial cells, CALIPERS simultaneously images actin, tubulin, or calcium dynamics, phase-locks migration and proliferation, triggers mitosis-aware smart microscopy, and recovers fast calcium signals. In induced pluripotent stem-cell workflows, lentiviral and safe-harbor versions span pluripotent, lineage-restricted, and cardiac models. In cardiac organoids, CALIPERS tracks cell-cycle exit, tissue compaction, and calcium onset, and distinguishes productive proliferation from multinucleation and endoreplication. By making cell-cycle state an explicit, measurable variable, CALIPERS helps triage candidate regenerative interventions across diverse live-imaging assays.
abstractZh: 细胞周期进程是活细胞表型分析中变异性的主要来源，然而成像工作流程仍然缺乏一种通用的方法来在考虑结构和功能读数时同时考虑它。在这里，我们展示了CALIPERS（用于表型实验和再生研究的细胞周期感知活细胞成像），这是一个集成框架，将光谱重新设计的FUCCI报告器与连续细胞周期推断和灵活递送策略相结合，应用于人类细胞和干细胞模型。在上皮细胞中，CALIPERS同时成像肌动蛋白、微管蛋白或钙动力学，相位锁定迁移和增殖，触发有丝分裂感知的智能显微镜，并恢复快速钙信号。在诱导多能干细胞工作流程中，慢病毒和安全港版本涵盖多能性、谱系限制和心脏模型。在心脏类器官中，CALIPERS追踪细胞周期退出、组织压实和钙起始，并区分生产性增殖与多核化和内复制。通过使细胞周期状态成为明确、可测量的变量，CALIPERS有助于在各种活体成像分析中筛选候选再生干预措施。

abstract: Decellularized extracellular matrix can well preserve the biomimetic ultrastructure of native tissue, providing a suitable three-dimensional biomimetic microenvironment for the in vitro culture of cells and organoids. The aim of this study is to prepare a porcine testicular decellularized extracellular matrix (PT-dECM) scaffold that fully preserves the natural ultrastructure and bioactive components, thereby providing a highly biomimetic three-dimensional microenvironment for the adhesion and proliferation of primary testicular cells and the in vitro construction of testicular organoids. In this study, we optimized a combined physicochemical decellularization protocol and, after screening, obtained a PT-dECM scaffold that could effectively remove immunogenic substances and fully preserve the natural ultrastructure and bioactive components. This scaffold not only supported uniform cell adhesion and directed proliferation but also provided primary testicular cells with a three-dimensional biomimetic environment that maintained structural and functional integrity. Testicular organoids constructed on this scaffold exhibited the typical physiological structure of native testes, and the four core functional cell types-Sertoli cells, Leydig cells, germ cells, and peritubular myoid cells-were reliably detected, with their spatial distribution being highly consistent with that of native tissue. The PT-dECM scaffold optimized in this study mimicked the natural testicular microenvironment, overcoming the limitations of existing models. It provides a new tool for advancing research into the functions of the testicular microenvironment and has significant application potential in the field of reproductive tissue engineering.
abstractZh: 脱细胞细胞外基质能够很好地保留天然组织的仿生超微结构，为细胞和类器官的体外培养提供合适的三维仿生微环境。本研究旨在制备一种充分保留天然超微结构和生物活性成分的猪睾丸脱细胞细胞外基质（PT-dECM）支架，从而为原代睾丸细胞的粘附、增殖以及睾丸类器官的体外构建提供高度仿生的三维微环境。在本研究中，我们优化了一种物理化学联合脱细胞方案，经过筛选，获得了一种能够有效去除免疫原性物质并充分保留天然超微结构和生物活性成分的PT-dECM支架。该支架不仅支持均匀的细胞粘附和定向增殖，还为原代睾丸细胞提供了维持结构和功能完整性的三维仿生环境。在该支架上构建的睾丸类器官表现出天然睾丸的典型生理结构，四种核心功能细胞类型——支持细胞、间质细胞、生殖细胞和管周肌样细胞——均被可靠检测到，其空间分布与天然组织高度一致。本研究优化的PT-dECM支架模拟了天然睾丸微环境，克服了现有模型的局限性，为推进睾丸微环境功能研究提供了新工具，并在生殖组织工程领域具有显著的应用潜力。

abstract:
Motivation

Spatial computational models such as agent-based models (ABMs) offer powerful in silico tools to study tumor dynamics, yet imaging data are still rarely used to inform these models directly.Results

We present an ABM optimization framework that leverages convolutional encoders to compare spatial patterns between experimental imaging data and ABM-generated outputs within a shared latent space. This quantitative comparison was used to estimate ABM parameters across three datasets, ranging from synthetic data to 3D tumoroid-T cell co-culture microscopy and histopathology images from The Cancer Genome Atlas skin cutaneous melanoma samples. Estimated parameters were evaluated using data-derived features and experimental knowledge, including experimental conditions and gene expressions. Simulations using optimized parameters reproduced key spatial features of the training images, such as tumor boundary complexity and tumor-tumor neighborhood structure. Together, these results demonstrate a flexible framework for ABM parameter optimization using spatial data across modalities, enabling systematic investigation of how spatial architecture influences tumor progression and immune interactions.Availability and implementation

Source code is available at https://github.com/SysBioOncology/ AutoencoderABM under the GPL-3.0 license, with corresponding data sets at https://zenodo.org/records/19022344.
abstractZh:
动机

空间计算模型，如基于智能体的模型（ABMs），为研究肿瘤动力学提供了强大的计算机模拟工具，然而影像数据仍很少被直接用于指导这些模型。结果

我们提出了一种ABM优化框架，利用卷积编码器在共享潜在空间内比较实验影像数据与ABM生成输出之间的空间模式。这种定量比较被用于跨三个数据集估计ABM参数，范围从合成数据到三维肿瘤球-T细胞共培养显微镜图像以及来自癌症基因组图谱皮肤皮肤黑色素瘤样本的组织病理学图像。估计的参数通过数据衍生的特征和实验知识（包括实验条件和基因表达）进行评估。使用优化参数的模拟重现了训练图像的关键空间特征，如肿瘤边界复杂性和肿瘤-肿瘤邻域结构。总之，这些结果展示了一个灵活的框架，用于使用跨模态的空间数据进行ABM参数优化，从而能够系统研究空间结构如何影响肿瘤进展和免疫相互作用。可用性和实现

abstract:
Introduction

SORL1 encodes the sorting receptor SORLA, a major genetic contributor to Alzheimer's disease (AD). Although SORL1 loss disrupts endosomal trafficking and promotes amyloidogenic amyloid precursor protein (APP) processing, the functional consequences of specific missense variants in human neurons remain unclear.Methods

We used isogenic induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived NGN2 neurons and 3D cerebral organoids carrying wild-type, SORL1 p.Y1816C knock-in, or SORL1 knockout alleles. We analyzed SORLA maturation and shedding, APP localization, amyloid-β (Aβ) secretion, endosomal morphology, axonal transport of Rab5+ endosomes and APP, and network activity.Results

The p.Y1816C variant impaired SORLA maturation and shedding and, together with knockout, caused enlarged early endosomes, APP retention, elevated Aβ secretion, amyloid deposition in organoids, axonal swellings, disrupted axonal transport, and neuronal hyperexcitability.Conclusions

The SORL1 p.Y1816C variant is pathogenic in human neurons, and we reveal novel roles for SORLA in axonal transport and neuronal excitability. These findings highlight endosomal trafficking disruption as a central mechanism in AD pathogenesis.
abstractZh:
引言

SORL1编码分选受体SORLA，是阿尔茨海默病（AD）的主要遗传贡献因素。尽管SORL1缺失会破坏内体运输并促进淀粉样蛋白前体蛋白（APP）的淀粉样生成加工，但特定错义变异在人类神经元中的功能后果仍不清楚。方法

我们使用了携带野生型、SORL1 p.Y1816C敲入或SORL1敲除等位基因的同基因诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源的NGN2神经元和3D大脑类器官。我们分析了SORLA的成熟和脱落、APP定位、淀粉样蛋白-β（Aβ）分泌、内体形态、Rab5+内体和APP的轴突运输以及网络活动。结果

p.Y1816C变异损害了SORLA的成熟和脱落，并与敲除一起导致早期内体增大、APP滞留、Aβ分泌升高、类器官中淀粉样蛋白沉积、轴突肿胀、轴突运输中断和神经元过度兴奋。结论

SORL1 p.Y1816C变异在人类神经元中具有致病性，我们揭示了SORLA在轴突运输和神经元兴奋性中的新作用。这些发现强调内体运输中断是AD发病机制中的核心机制。

abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer mortality globally, with therapeutic efficacy hindered by tumor heterogeneity and drug resistance. While organoid technology offers unprecedented opportunities to model tumor complexity, systematic platforms for chemo-targeted combination screening and molecular mechanisms underlying chemoresistance remain underexplored in Chinese populations. Here, we established a biobank of 17 patient-derived CRC organoids (85% success rate) from treatment-naïve surgical specimens, preserving histopathological fidelity and molecular diversity of parental tumors. High-throughput drug screening across eight clinical regimens revealed different responses. To dissect chemoresistance mechanisms, six organoids representing extreme phenotypes (three sensitive and three resistant, based on IC50 difference for irinotecan + raltitrexed) were selected from this cohort for single-cell transcriptomic analysis. Single-cell transcriptomics of irinotecan + raltitrexed-treated organoids identified chemoresistance-associated clonal expansion of epithelial subpopulations (cluster_0), characterized by overexpression of REG4/TFF1/TFF3 and epithelial keratins (KRT19/KRT8/KRT18). Intercellular network analysis revealed intra-epithelial communication as a resistance hub, mediated by 32 ligand-receptor pairs. Integration with TCGA-COAD cohort (n = 378) demonstrated intratumoral heterogeneity (ITH) score as an independent prognostic determinant, outperforming stemness/angiogenesis metrics. Machine learning consensus identified CEACAM6 and KRT19 as dual regulators of mortality and ITH through epithelial plasticity networks. Our multi-omics framework establishes organoid-guided chemoresistance mechanisms while proposing ITH quantification targeting as precision strategies. This study bridges critical gaps in CRC therapeutic personalization, offering clinically actionable insights for overcoming treatment failure.
abstractZh: 结直肠癌（CRC）仍然是全球癌症死亡的主要原因，肿瘤异质性和耐药性阻碍了治疗效果。虽然类器官技术为模拟肿瘤复杂性提供了前所未有的机会，但在中国人群中，用于化疗靶向联合筛选的系统性平台及化疗耐药背后的分子机制仍未得到充分探索。在此，我们建立了一个包含17例患者来源的CRC类器官（成功率85%）的生物样本库，这些类器官来自未经治疗的手术标本，保留了亲本肿瘤的组织病理学保真度和分子多样性。对八种临床方案的高通量药物筛选揭示了不同的反应。为了剖析化疗耐药机制，从该队列中选择了六个代表极端表型的类器官（基于伊立替康+雷替曲塞的IC50差异，三个敏感和三个耐药）进行单细胞转录组分析。对伊立替康+雷替曲塞处理的类器官进行单细胞转录组学分析，确定了与化疗耐药相关的上皮亚群（cluster_0）的克隆扩增，其特征是REG4/TFF1/TFF3和上皮角蛋白（KRT19/KRT8/KRT18）的过表达。细胞间网络分析揭示了上皮内通讯作为耐药枢纽，由32个配体-受体对介导。与TCGA-COAD队列（n=378）的整合表明，肿瘤内异质性（ITH）评分是独立的预后决定因素，优于干性/血管生成指标。机器学习共识确定CEACAM6和KRT19是通过上皮可塑性网络调节死亡率和ITH的双重调节因子。我们的多组学框架建立了类器官引导的化疗耐药机制，同时提出将ITH量化靶向作为精准策略。这项研究弥合了CRC治疗个体化的关键差距，为克服治疗失败提供了临床可操作的见解。

abstract: Physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling has emerged as a critical tool for predicting fetal drug exposure during pregnancy, accounting for the complex interplay of maternal physiological changes and placental transfer mechanisms. This review summarizes the current state of PBPK modeling in maternal-fetal pharmacology, discussing various modeling approaches, including compartmental structures and mathematical formulations for placental transfer, as well as approaches to parameterize placental drug transfer in humans. Furthermore, a regulatory perspective on the use of maternal-fetal PBPK models in submissions to the MHRA is provided. Despite advancements, significant gaps remain in understanding the variability of placental drug transfer across gestational stages and the implications of transporter activity. Future research should focus on generating robust clinical data and integrating innovative technologies, such as organ-on-a-chip systems, to enhance model accuracy. Additionally, regulatory acceptance of PBPK models will depend on the establishment of comprehensive validation frameworks. By fostering collaboration between researchers, clinicians, and regulatory bodies, PBPK modeling can advance toward safer therapeutic options for pregnant women and their developing fetuses, ultimately improving maternal-fetal health outcomes.
abstractZh: 基于生理的药代动力学（PBPK）建模已成为预测妊娠期胎儿药物暴露的关键工具，它考虑了母体生理变化与胎盘转运机制之间复杂的相互作用。本综述总结了母胎药理学中PBPK建模的现状，讨论了各种建模方法，包括房室结构和胎盘转运的数学公式，以及在人类中参数化胎盘药物转运的方法。此外，还提供了关于在向MHRA提交的申报中使用母胎PBPK模型的监管视角。尽管取得了进展，但在理解胎盘药物转运在妊娠各阶段的变异性以及转运体活性的影响方面仍存在显著差距。未来的研究应侧重于生成可靠的临床数据，并整合器官芯片系统等创新技术，以提高模型准确性。此外，PBPK模型的监管接受将取决于建立全面的验证框架。通过促进研究人员、临床医生和监管机构之间的合作，PBPK建模可以朝着为孕妇及其发育中的胎儿提供更安全的治疗选择迈进，最终改善母胎健康结局。

abstract: The spinal cord exhibits a complex cytoarchitecture and neuronal circuitry organization that challenges in vitro replication of its functional integrity. Here we employed a previously published protocol to generate spinal cord organoids (SCOs) from human-induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs). We characterized phenotypic changes in functional neuronal properties in SCO neurons at early developmental stages (15-32 days in culture) using a quantitative electrophysiological approach. Using the whole-cell patch-clamp technique to evaluate electrophysiological properties, we found that SCO neurons exhibited progressive maturation, as evidenced by hyperpolarized resting membrane potentials, increased inward current amplitude, refined action potential kinetics, and the early emergence of mature-type firing patterns. In particular, we show that the spike frequency adaptation phenomenon, which prevails in motor neurons, appears at early stages of SCO neuron development. Immunohistochemical assessment confirmed the expression of key transcription factors in motor neurons (ISLET1 and HB9) and immature spinal interneurons (LHX1/5 and PAX2). Collectively, our findings demonstrate that neurons in hiPSC-derived SCOs exhibit physiological differentiation, which is important for using SCOs to investigate human spinal cord development and advance translational research in CNS disorders and cell replacement therapies.
abstractZh: 脊髓表现出复杂的细胞结构和神经元回路组织，这对体外复制其功能完整性提出了挑战。在此，我们采用先前发表的方案，从人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）中生成脊髓类器官（SCOs）。我们使用定量电生理方法，表征了早期发育阶段（培养15-32天）SCO神经元功能特性的表型变化。通过使用全细胞膜片钳技术评估电生理特性，我们发现SCO神经元表现出逐渐成熟，表现为静息膜电位超极化、内向电流幅度增加、动作电位动力学精细化以及成熟型放电模式的早期出现。特别是，我们表明在运动神经元中占主导地位的 spike 频率适应现象在SCO神经元发育早期即出现。免疫组织化学评估证实了运动神经元关键转录因子（ISLET1和HB9）以及未成熟脊髓中间神经元（LHX1/5和PAX2）的表达。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，hiPSC来源的SCO中的神经元表现出生理性分化，这对于使用SCO研究人类脊髓发育以及推进中枢神经系统疾病和细胞替代疗法的转化研究具有重要意义。

abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the most prevalent malignancies globally. Recent breakthrough of synthetic biology stimulates the utilization of engineered bacteria for cancer diagnosis and treatment. We perform a comprehensive fecal metabolomic analysis in CRC mouse models and patients and identify ornithine as a specific metabolic biomarker for tumor development. We subsequently engineer an E. coli Nissle 1917 (EcN)-based bioluminescent reporter via ornithine-responsive tumor detection. For therapeutic intervention, we construct a probiotic system that locally releases Dickkopf 3 (DKK3), a potent Wnt signaling antagonist to retard tumor growth. Oral administration of the bacteria demonstrates reduced tumor burden and improved survival outcomes in multiple preclinical models, and the anticancer efficacy is further confirmed in CRC patient-derived organoids and patient-derived xenograft (PDX) model. Taken together, we develop a novel probiotic platform combing non-invasive diagnostic capability with targeted therapeutic delivery for CRC management, underscoring the strong potential for clinical translation and eventual application in preventive oncology.
abstractZh: 结直肠癌（CRC）是全球最常见的恶性肿瘤之一。合成生物学的最新突破促进了工程菌在癌症诊断和治疗中的应用。我们在CRC小鼠模型和患者中进行了全面的粪便代谢组学分析，并鉴定出鸟氨酸作为肿瘤发展的特异性代谢生物标志物。随后，我们通过鸟氨酸响应性肿瘤检测，构建了一种基于大肠杆菌Nissle 1917（EcN）的生物发光报告系统。对于治疗干预，我们构建了一种益生菌系统，该系统局部释放Dickkopf 3（DKK3），一种有效的Wnt信号拮抗剂，以延缓肿瘤生长。口服该细菌在多个临床前模型中显示出减少肿瘤负担和改善生存结果的效果，其抗癌功效在CRC患者来源的类器官和患者来源的异种移植（PDX）模型中进一步得到证实。总之，我们开发了一种新型益生菌平台，将非侵入性诊断能力与靶向治疗递送相结合，用于CRC管理，强调了其在临床转化和最终应用于预防性肿瘤学方面的巨大潜力。

abstract: The aim of this study is to investigate active targeting of residual melanoma cells. Melanoma is the most aggressive form of skin cancer for which the conventional therapies often fail to target post-surgical residual cells owing to challenges like chemoresistance, early metastasis, and recurrence. To mitigate the following issues, we repurposed Dasatinib (DAS), an antineoplastic drug approved for chronic myeloid leukaemia, and evaluated its potential in melanoma treatment through a safe, biomacromolecule-based topical delivery system. DAS-loaded human serum albumin nanoparticles (DNPs) were optimised via Box-Behnken design and incorporated into a hydrogel for localised delivery. The DNPs had a particle size of 125.6 ± 1.58 nm with a polydispersity index of 0.242 ± 0.008 and a zeta potential of -14.28 ± 0.22 mV. ATR-FTIR, PXRD, and DSC analyses demonstrated amorphisation of the drug in DNPs devoid of any chemical interactions. The loading and entrapment efficiencies of DAS in DNPs were estimated to be 7.49 ± 0.28 and 89.80 ± 1.52%, respectively. In vitro assays such as the MTT assay, scratch assay, transwell-based invasive assays, cell cycle assay, and 3D tumoroid-based assays demonstrated superior cytotoxic, anti-invasion, and antimigration properties of DNPs. Mechanistic studies demonstrated that DNPs induced apoptosis via caspase-7 upregulation and downregulation of PI3K, p-mTOR, VEGFR, and EGFR. Dermatokinetic analysis of DNPs-entrapped hydrogel confirmed DNPs accumulation in the epidermal and dermal layers near residual melanoma cells, highlighting their therapeutic potential in the management of residual disease.
abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨对残余黑色素瘤细胞的主动靶向。黑色素瘤是最具侵袭性的皮肤癌类型，传统疗法常因化疗耐药、早期转移和复发等挑战而无法靶向术后残余细胞。为缓解上述问题，我们重新定位了达沙替尼（DAS），一种获批用于慢性髓性白血病的抗肿瘤药物，并通过一种安全的、基于生物大分子的局部递送系统评估其在黑色素瘤治疗中的潜力。通过Box-Behnken设计优化了载DAS的人血清白蛋白纳米颗粒（DNPs），并将其掺入水凝胶中以实现局部递送。DNPs的粒径为125.6 ± 1.58 nm，多分散指数为0.242 ± 0.008，zeta电位为-14.28 ± 0.22 mV。ATR-FTIR、PXRD和DSC分析表明，药物在DNPs中呈无定形状态，且无任何化学相互作用。DAS在DNPs中的载药量和包封率分别估计为7.49 ± 0.28%和89.80 ± 1.52%。体外实验如MTT实验、划痕实验、基于Transwell的侵袭实验、细胞周期实验和3D肿瘤球实验表明，DNPs具有优越的细胞毒性、抗侵袭和抗迁移特性。机制研究表明，DNPs通过上调caspase-7并下调PI3K、p-mTOR、VEGFR和EGFR来诱导细胞凋亡。DNPs包埋水凝胶的皮肤动力学分析证实，DNPs在表皮层和真皮层中靠近残余黑色素瘤细胞处积累，突显了其在残余疾病管理中的治疗潜力。

abstract: Objective: To establish an in vitro fibrotic endometrial organoid model and investigate the early intervention effects of placenta-derived mesenchymal stem cell extracellular vesicles (Pd-MSC-EV) on fibrotic injury in endometrial organoids. Methods: Cell clusters were isolated from the endometrial tissues of healthy female mice and used to establish a three-dimensional endometrial organoid culture system. The structure and cellular composition of the organoids were characterized by histological staining and immunofluorescence staining. To construct an in vitro fibrosis model, the organoids were treated with different concentrations of transforming growth factor-β1 (TGF-β1), and model establishment was evaluated based on organoid morphological changes and the mRNA expression of fibrosis-related genes, including collagen type Ⅰ alpha 1 chain (COL1A1), α-smooth muscle actin (α-SMA), and fibronectin (FN). Pd-MSC-EVs were isolated and characterized by transmission electron microscopy, nanoparticle tracking analysis, and western blotting. The effects of Pd-MSC-EVs on TGF-β1-induced fibrotic changes in endometrial organoids were then assessed by morphological observation, real-time quantitative PCR (RT-qPCR) analysis of COL1A1, α-SMA, and FN mRNA expression, and immunofluorescence detection of COL1A1 and α-SMA protein expression. All experiments were repeated three times. Results: Mouse endometrial organoids with lumen-like structures were successfully established and expressed the epithelial markers E-cadherin and CK8 as well as the stromal marker Vimentin. Compared with the control group, TGF-β1 treatment disrupted organoid architecture and increased the mRNA expression levels of fibrosis-related genes, including COL1A1, α-SMA and FN, in a dose-dependent manner (all PPPConclusion: Pd-MSC-EV attenuate TGF-β1-induced fibrotic changes in endometrial organoids in vitro and reduce organoid structural injury, providing experimental evidence for mechanistic studies and potential intervention strategies for endometrial fibrosis-related diseases such as intrauterine adhesions.
