abstract: BackgroundGastric cancer is a deadly disease with poor prognosis and unfavorable therapeutic outcomes. It is known that a major cause of treatment failure for gastric cancer is related to tumor heterogeneity. However, it is difficult to assess heterogeneity, as the composition of tumors is dynamic and cancer treatments reshape cell diversity and gene/protein expression profiles.ObjectiveWe utilized gastric cancer patient-derived tumor organoids to monitor tumor heterogeneity and the impacts of chemotherapy (FLOT and FOLFOX) on cancer stem cells (LGR5 and CD133) and cancer immune checkpoint molecules (MHC-I and PD-L1).MethodsSix tumor organoids were established from different patients or different regions of the same tumor. The tumor organoids were used to investigate the real-time profiles of cancer stem cell marker expression and cancer immune checkpoint molecule expression after chemotherapy treatment. Tumor suppression was monitored by the propidium iodide assay and measurements of tumor organoid diameter. Expression levels of cancer stem cell markers and immune checkpoint molecules were analyzed by flow cytometry.ResultsGrowth of all tumor organoids could be suppressed by chemotherapy. However, diverse impacts of FLOT and FOLFOX were observed in terms of the expression profiles of cancer stem cell markers and cancer immune checkpoint molecules. In particular, tumor organoids from different patients exhibited distinct expression profiles for cancer stem cell markers and immune checkpoint molecules after treatment with the same chemotherapeutic regimen. Similar observations were made with tumor organoids derived the same patient but different tumor regions.ConclusionOur findings demonstrated that spatial and temporal tumoral heterogeneity can be observed after treatment with chemotherapy, suggesting that repeated monitoring of tumor characteristics may be essential for clinical decision making. In addition, sampling of multiple sites at multiple time-points might be important when evaluating the impacts of chemotherapy on cancer stem cells markers and immune checkpoint molecules.
abstractZh: 背景胃癌是一种预后不良、治疗结果不佳的致命疾病。已知胃癌治疗失败的一个主要原因是与肿瘤异质性有关。然而，由于肿瘤的组成是动态的，且癌症治疗会重塑细胞多样性和基因/蛋白质表达谱，因此评估异质性很困难。目的我们利用胃癌患者来源的肿瘤类器官来监测肿瘤异质性以及化疗（FLOT和FOLFOX）对癌症干细胞（LGR5和CD133）和癌症免疫检查点分子（MHC-I和PD-L1）的影响。方法从不同患者或同一肿瘤的不同区域建立了六个肿瘤类器官。使用这些肿瘤类器官研究化疗治疗后癌症干细胞标志物表达和癌症免疫检查点分子表达的实时谱。通过碘化丙啶测定和肿瘤类器官直径测量来监测肿瘤抑制情况。通过流式细胞术分析癌症干细胞标志物和免疫检查点分子的表达水平。结果所有肿瘤类器官的生长均可被化疗抑制。然而，在癌症干细胞标志物和癌症免疫检查点分子的表达谱方面，观察到FLOT和FOLFOX的不同影响。特别是，来自不同患者的肿瘤类器官在相同化疗方案治疗后，其癌症干细胞标志物和免疫检查点分子的表达谱表现出明显差异。对于来自同一患者但不同肿瘤区域的肿瘤类器官，也观察到了类似的结果。结论我们的研究结果表明，化疗治疗后可以观察到空间和时间上的肿瘤异质性，提示反复监测肿瘤特征可能对临床决策至关重要。此外，在评估化疗对癌症干细胞标志物和免疫检查点分子的影响时，在多个时间点对多个部位进行采样可能很重要。

Moreover, calcitriol reduced the cytotoxicity of 5-FU and SN38 in normal organoids regardless of patient age, while in tumor organoids this protective effect was restricted to EO-CRC. abstractZh: 早发性结直肠癌（EO-CRC，<50岁）的发病率正在上升，而晚发性结直肠癌（LO-CRC，≥50岁）的发病率也在增加。维生素D缺乏与CRC风险增加和化疗结果不佳有关。然而，年龄和维生素D状态如何影响化疗反应仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用来自EO-CRC和LO-CRC患者的配对正常和肿瘤结直肠类器官，研究了骨化三醇（1,25-二羟基维生素D3）对5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU）和SN38（伊立替康的活性代谢物）反应的影响。我们发现，在正常类器官中，5-FU的细胞毒性在EO-CRC中高于LO-CRC，而在肿瘤类器官中，5-FU的细胞毒性在LO-CRC中高于EO-CRC，表明选择性肿瘤细胞毒性。相反，SN38的治疗窗口在LO-CRC类器官中得以保留，但在EO-CRC类器官中则不然，揭示了药物敏感性的年龄依赖性差异。此外，骨化三醇降低了正常类器官中5-FU和SN38的细胞毒性，无论患者年龄如何，而在肿瘤类器官中，这种保护作用仅限于EO-CRC。因此，骨化三醇治疗选择性地扩大了LO-CRC类器官中5-FU和SN38的治疗窗口。机制上，这些效应与骨化三醇诱导的抗增殖作用以及药物代谢相关通路的转录调控相关。总体而言，我们的研究结果确定了化疗反应中的年龄依赖性差异，并支持维持足够维生素D状态以减少化疗相关毒性的重要性。

abstract: Metabolic dysfunction associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is one of the most predominant liver disorders. MASLD is associated with dietary intake of fatty acids. Among them, oleic (OA) and palmitic (PA) acids are the most abundant. Furthermore, OA was reported to have an hepatoprotective effect against PA toxicity on primary hepatocytes and liver cell lines. In this work, to characterize the mechanisms related to fatty acids exposure, we analyzed the metabolomic signatures of HepG2/C3A using advanced organ-on-chip technology. The cells were exposed for 2 to 7 days to OA, PA and OA/PA mixture. The cell secretions were analyzed using GC-MS spectrometry to reveal their metabolomic signatures. We were able to identify a common HepG2/C3A response to OA, PA and OA/PA deciphering the FFAs global perturbations including the nitrogen metabolism, after 7 days of treatments. Then, we extracted the specificity of each treatment. We found that OA altered intracellular lipid secretion, while OA/PA shifted metabolism from the lipid production to their consumption. PA exposure induced changes consistent with a perturbation in oxidative stress, energy metabolism and a high oxalic acid production. Nicotinamide levels increased in all treatments, indicating a potential in vitro exposure biomarker of FFA, and a potential mechanistic candidate for further validation in preclinical and clinical settings as its protective effect against liver steatosis was reported in literature. These findings highlight the intricate metabolic responses to FFAs exposure in hepatocytes, suggesting potential biomarkers and pathways for liver-related disorders.
abstractZh: 代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）是最主要的肝脏疾病之一。MASLD与膳食脂肪酸摄入有关。其中，油酸（OA）和棕榈酸（PA）含量最为丰富。此外，据报道，OA对原代肝细胞和肝细胞系中PA的毒性具有肝脏保护作用。在本研究中，为了表征与脂肪酸暴露相关的机制，我们使用先进的器官芯片技术分析了HepG2/C3A的代谢组学特征。将细胞暴露于OA、PA及OA/PA混合物2至7天。使用GC-MS光谱分析细胞分泌物，以揭示其代谢组学特征。我们能够识别出HepG2/C3A对OA、PA和OA/PA的常见反应，从而在治疗7天后解读游离脂肪酸（FFAs）的全局扰动，包括氮代谢。然后，我们提取了每种治疗的特异性。我们发现OA改变了细胞内脂质分泌，而OA/PA将代谢从脂质产生转向脂质消耗。PA暴露引起的改变与氧化应激、能量代谢的扰动以及高草酸产量一致。所有治疗中烟酰胺水平均升高，表明其可能作为FFA暴露的体外生物标志物，并可能成为临床前和临床环境中进一步验证的机制候选物，因为文献报道了其对肝脏脂肪变性的保护作用。这些发现强调了肝细胞对FFA暴露的复杂代谢反应，提示了肝脏相关疾病的潜在生物标志物和通路。

abstract: Recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL) is a heterogeneous reproductive condition, and unexplained recurrent pregnancy loss (URPL) denotes repeated pregnancy losses for which no established cause is identified after standard evaluation. Recurrent miscarriage (RM) and recurrent spontaneous abortion (RSA) are overlapping terms used in the literature, whereas recurrent implantation failure (RIF) is a related but distinct infertility context. In this Mini Review, URPL is treated as an exclusion-based clinical category rather than a single disease entity. This review examines the hypothesis that a subset of URPL reflects abnormalities in specific cellular and molecular components of the maternal-fetal interface. We focus on maternal compartments, including endometrial epithelial lineage states, decidual stromal dysfunction, and stromal-immune interactions, as well as fetal/trophoblast compartments such as trophoblast lineage defects and broader maternal-fetal interactions, incorporating insights from recent advances in molecular and cellular technologies and human model systems. Particular attention is given to single-cell, spatial, organoid, assembloid, implantation model, trophoblast stem cell, and placental explant studies published from 2024 to 2026. Current data do not establish clinical subtypes for URPL or support treatment selection in routine practice. However, recent molecular and cellular technologies now make it possible to define interface phenotypes with higher resolution and to test whether patient-derived abnormalities are reproducible and perturbable in experimental systems. An interface-centered framework may therefore help move URPL research from broad exclusion-based labels toward experimentally testable subtype identification based on epithelial, decidual, trophoblast, immune, and embryo-endometrial phenotypes.
abstractZh: 复发性流产（RPL）是一种异质性生殖疾病，不明原因复发性流产（URPL）指经过标准评估后未发现明确病因的反复妊娠丢失。复发性流产（RM）和反复自然流产（RSA）是文献中使用的重叠术语，而反复种植失败（RIF）是一种相关但不同的不孕症背景。在本篇小型综述中，URPL被视为一种基于排除法的临床类别，而非单一疾病实体。本综述探讨了以下假说：部分URPL反映了母胎界面特定细胞和分子成分的异常。我们重点关注母体部分，包括子宫内膜上皮谱系状态、蜕膜基质功能障碍以及基质-免疫相互作用，同时涵盖胎儿/滋养层部分，如滋养层谱系缺陷和更广泛的母胎相互作用，并结合分子和细胞技术及人类模型系统的最新进展。特别关注2024年至2026年发表的单细胞、空间、类器官、组装体、着床模型、滋养层干细胞和胎盘外植体研究。目前的数据尚未确立URPL的临床亚型，也不支持在常规实践中指导治疗选择。然而，最新的分子和细胞技术现已能够以更高分辨率定义界面表型，并测试患者来源的异常在实验系统中是否可重复且可干预。因此，以界面为中心的框架可能有助于将URPL研究从广泛的基于排除法的标签转向基于上皮、蜕膜、滋养层、免疫和胚胎-子宫内膜表型的可实验验证的亚型识别。

title: Testicular organoid models in male reproductive toxicology: advances, applications, and future perspectives.
titleZh: 睾丸类器官模型在男性生殖毒理学中的应用：进展、应用与未来展望。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: Male reproductive health has declined markedly over the past decades, with environmental chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and lifestyle factors implicated in this trend. Conventional toxicological approaches-rodent bioassays and two-dimensional cell cultures-suffer from species-specific biases, limited physiological relevance, and inadequate throughput for screening the expanding universe of suspect compounds. Testicular organoid technology has emerged as a promising alternative, reconstituting three-dimensional cellular architecture, paracrine crosstalk, and partial spermatogenic progression in vitro. This narrative review was assembled from English-language studies retrieved from PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus (2010-2024) using combinations of the terms testicular organoid, organ-on-chip, spermatogenesis, and reproductive toxicology, prioritizing original research and methodological reports on three-dimensional testicular models and excluding abstract-only records. On this basis the review maps current construction strategies, spanning primary cell isolation, pluripotent stem cell differentiation, and spermatogonial stem cell expansion, alongside matrix choices and microfluidic culture platforms. It then examines how testicular organoids have been deployed to assess endocrine-disrupting chemicals, chemotherapeutics, and other pharmacological agents, where several studies report the detection of effects at concentrations appreciably below those required in monolayer systems, particularly under chronic low-dose exposure. Integration with single-cell multi-omics and machine learning has advanced mechanistic dissection and candidate biomarker discovery across oxidative, mitochondrial, and epigenetic axes, although these computational applications remain exploratory given the absence of standardized organoid protocols. Morphological, functional, molecular, and epigenetic indicators are consolidated into a unified evaluation framework, and persistent bottlenecks are addressed, including incomplete blood-testis barrier reconstitution, long-term culture instability, inter-donor variability, and inefficient elongated spermatozoa formation. Overall, testicular organoids offer clear mechanistic and human-relevance advantages, yet they are not yet sufficiently mature or validated to broadly replace in vivo models in regulatory assessment. Future priorities center on protocol standardization, automated high-throughput adaptation, multi-organ-on-chip integration, and formal regulatory validation to enable transformative applications in drug safety evaluation, environmental risk management, and male reproductive health protection.
abstractZh: 过去几十年来，男性生殖健康显著下降，环境化学物质、药物和生活方式因素与此趋势有关。传统的毒理学方法——啮齿动物生物测定和二维细胞培养——存在物种特异性偏差、生理相关性有限以及筛选日益增多的可疑化合物时通量不足的问题。睾丸类器官技术已成为一种有前景的替代方案，可在体外重建三维细胞结构、旁分泌串扰和部分精子发生进程。本叙述性综述基于从PubMed、Web of Science和Scopus（2010-2024年）检索的英文研究，使用睾丸类器官、器官芯片、精子发生和生殖毒理学等术语的组合，优先考虑关于三维睾丸模型的原创研究和 methodology 报告，并排除仅摘要的记录。在此基础上，综述梳理了当前的构建策略，涵盖原代细胞分离、多能干细胞分化和精原干细胞扩增，以及基质选择和微流控培养平台。随后，它考察了睾丸类器官如何被用于评估内分泌干扰化学物质、化疗药物和其他药理制剂，其中多项研究报告了在浓度明显低于单层系统所需浓度时检测到效应，尤其是在慢性低剂量暴露下。与单细胞多组学和机器学习的整合推进了机制解析和候选生物标志物的发现，涉及氧化、线粒体和表观遗传学轴，尽管由于缺乏标准化的类器官方案，这些计算应用仍处于探索阶段。形态学、功能性、分子和表观遗传学指标被整合到一个统一的评估框架中，并解决了持续存在的瓶颈，包括血睾屏障重建不完全、长期培养不稳定、供体间变异以及长形精子形成效率低下。总体而言，睾丸类器官提供了明确的机制和人类相关性优势，但尚未足够成熟或经过验证，无法在监管评估中广泛替代体内模型。未来的优先事项集中在方案标准化、自动化高通量适应、多器官芯片整合以及正式的监管验证，以实现其在药物安全性评价、环境风险管理和男性生殖健康保护中的变革性应用。

abstract:
Introduction

Radioresistance remains a major obstacle in the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Transcription factor AP-2α (TFAP2A) has been implicated in tumor progression, but its role in NSCLC radioresistance and translational therapeutic relevance remain unclear.Methods

Bioinformatics analyses of TCGA and GEO datasets were used to identify transcription factors associated with NSCLC radioresponse. TFAP2A expression was evaluated in NSCLC tissues by immunohistochemistry. The functional role of TFAP2A was investigated using gain- and loss-of-function experiments in NSCLC cells, xenograft models, and patient-derived NSCLC organoids. Mechanistic studies included RNA sequencing, DNA damage repair assays, dual-luciferase reporter assays, chromatin immunoprecipitation, BRCA1 rescue experiments, and extended DNA damage response pathway validation. Structure-based virtual screening, surface plasmon resonance analysis, clonogenic survival assays, and xenograft experiments were performed to assess TFAP2A-targeted radiosensitization.Results

TFAP2A was overexpressed in NSCLC tissues and was associated with poor prognosis and reduced radiotherapy response. TFAP2A knockdown enhanced radiosensitivity by reducing post-irradiation proliferative recovery, increasing apoptosis, inducing G2/M accumulation, and impairing DNA damage repair, whereas TFAP2A overexpression promoted radioresistance. TFAP2A directly bound to the BRCA1 promoter and transcriptionally activated BRCA1. BRCA1 restoration partially rescued the radiosensitizing effects and G2/M accumulation induced by TFAP2A knockdown. Extended validation of representative DNA damage response pathways and additional RNA-seq-derived repair candidates further supported BRCA1 as a principal downstream effector in this model. Patient-derived NSCLC organoids confirmed that TFAP2A knockdown enhanced radiosensitivity in a clinically derived ex vivo model. Pharmacological validation identified Dephospho-CoA as a candidate TFAP2A-binding compound that enhanced radiotherapy response in clonogenic assays and xenograft models.Conclusions

TFAP2A promotes NSCLC radioresistance by transcriptionally activating BRCA1 and enhancing DNA damage repair. The TFAP2A/BRCA1 axis may serve as a predictive biomarker and therapeutic target for overcoming radioresistance, and TFAP2A-targeted radiosensitization warrants further preclinical development.
abstractZh:
引言

放射抗性仍然是治疗非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的主要障碍。转录因子AP-2α（TFAP2A）已被认为与肿瘤进展有关，但其在NSCLC放射抗性中的作用及转化治疗相关性仍不清楚。方法

利用TCGA和GEO数据集的生物信息学分析来识别与NSCLC放射反应相关的转录因子。通过免疫组织化学评估NSCLC组织中TFAP2A的表达。在NSCLC细胞、异种移植模型和患者来源的NSCLC类器官中，通过功能获得和功能丧失实验研究TFAP2A的功能作用。机制研究包括RNA测序、DNA损伤修复检测、双荧光素酶报告基因检测、染色质免疫沉淀、BRCA1拯救实验以及扩展的DNA损伤反应通路验证。进行了基于结构的虚拟筛选、表面等离子体共振分析、克隆形成存活实验和异种移植实验，以评估靶向TFAP2A的放射增敏作用。结果

TFAP2A在NSCLC组织中过表达，并与不良预后和放疗反应降低相关。TFAP2A敲低通过减少照射后增殖恢复、增加凋亡、诱导G2/M期阻滞和损害DNA损伤修复来增强放射敏感性，而TFAP2A过表达则促进放射抗性。TFAP2A直接结合BRCA1启动子并转录激活BRCA1。BRCA1恢复部分挽救了TFAP2A敲低诱导的放射增敏效应和G2/M期阻滞。对代表性DNA损伤反应通路和额外的RNA-seq衍生修复候选基因的扩展验证进一步支持BRCA1作为该模型中的主要下游效应因子。患者来源的NSCLC类器官证实，在临床衍生的离体模型中，TFAP2A敲低增强了放射敏感性。药理学验证确定Dephospho-CoA为候选TFAP2A结合化合物，在克隆形成实验和异种移植模型中增强了放疗反应。结论

TFAP2A通过转录激活BRCA1和增强DNA损伤修复来促进NSCLC放射抗性。TFAP2A/BRCA1轴可能作为克服放射抗性的预测性生物标志物和治疗靶点，靶向TFAP2A的放射增敏作用值得进一步的临床前开发。

abstract: The annual economic burden of obesity has reached 190 billion dollars in the US and around 62 billion Egyptian pounds in Egypt. It is linked to many harmful diseases, including diabetes mellitus, cardiovascular, liver, reproductive, bone diseases, and many others. Modeling of obesity and obesity-associated comorbidities represents a fruitful area of research. Animal models of obesity have many limitations regarding reliability, translatability, and extrapolation to human obesity. Microfluidic "organ on a chip" has emerged in recent decades as a potent in vitro tool for studying human diseases, offering advantages over traditional in vitro models, thereby facilitating the development of a human on a chip model. This review will briefly discuss obesity-associated metabolic disturbances and the recent publications that tried to use microfluidic devices to answer obesity-related questions. This review covers the role of in vitro modeling using microfluidic devices in obesity research. The different species of invertebrates utilized in obesity research have also been investigated, including nematodes, with a highlight on Caenorhabditis elegans. Research on anti-obesity drugs, which could potentially aid in managing obesity, has been increasing daily. Natural anti-obesity phytoconstituents have shown considerable therapeutic potential in obesity, with many plant extracts and single components with promising effects. In conclusion, integrating microfluidics, invertebrate models, and phytochemical screening is promising for obesity research, yet it requires further standardisation and clinical validation to enable personalised therapies.
abstractZh: 在美国，肥胖每年造成的经济负担已达1900亿美元，在埃及则约为620亿埃及镑。肥胖与许多有害疾病相关，包括糖尿病、心血管疾病、肝脏疾病、生殖系统疾病、骨骼疾病等。肥胖及其相关合并症的建模是一个富有成果的研究领域。肥胖动物模型在可靠性、可转化性以及外推到人类肥胖方面存在许多局限性。近几十年来，微流控“器官芯片”作为一种强大的体外工具应运而生，用于研究人类疾病，相比传统体外模型具有优势，从而促进了“人体芯片”模型的发展。本综述将简要讨论肥胖相关的代谢紊乱以及近期尝试使用微流控设备回答肥胖相关问题的出版物。本综述涵盖了使用微流控设备进行体外建模在肥胖研究中的作用。还研究了用于肥胖研究的各种无脊椎动物物种，包括线虫，并重点介绍了秀丽隐杆线虫。关于抗肥胖药物的研究日益增多，这些药物可能有助于管理肥胖。天然抗肥胖植物成分在肥胖治疗中显示出相当大的潜力，许多植物提取物和单一成分具有令人期待的效果。总之，将微流控技术、无脊椎动物模型和植物化学筛选相结合，对肥胖研究具有广阔前景，但仍需进一步标准化和临床验证，以实现个性化治疗。

abstract: Autoimmune diseases-including systemic sclerosis (SSc), systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), and rheumatoid arthritis (RA)-are increasingly understood as programmable microenvironmental states, wherein evolving changes in matrix mechanics, barrier integrity, interferon and cytokine networks, immune-complex deposition, and stromal-immune reciprocity progressively reshape tissue behavior. These shifting axes generate nonlinear trajectories of fibrosis, vascular injury, and joint destruction that static or reductionist in vitro systems fail to recapitulate. Organoid and organ-on-a-chip platforms now allow controlled reconstruction of these dynamic microenvironments in human-derived systems. By integrating iPSC-derived epithelial, endothelial, stromal, and immune lineages with tunable extracellular matrix (ECM) stiffness and viscoelasticity, perfusable microvasculature, and modular innate and adaptive immune components, these systems reproduce key autoimmune phenomena. These include stiffness-driven fibroblast activation and endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EndoMT), interferon-conditioned barrier collapse, immune-complex-mediated injury, and cytokine-dependent stromal invasion. Patient-specific induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC), CRISPR-based editing of risk alleles, and controlled exposure to sera or autoantibody repertoires provide genetic and immunologic personalization, while multi-omic profiling, spatial imaging, and machine-learning analytics enable quantitative alignment between organoid states and patient tissues. By translating pathogenic microenvironmental logic into controllable 3D systems, these platforms establish autoimmune organoids as programmable, human-relevant tools for mechanistic discovery, therapeutic interrogation, and precision modeling-laying the groundwork for next-generation, potentially animal-free pipelines and advancing personalized immunology across SSc, SLE, and RA.
abstractZh: 自身免疫性疾病——包括系统性硬化症（SSc）、系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）和类风湿关节炎（RA）——日益被理解为可编程的微环境状态，其中基质力学、屏障完整性、干扰素和细胞因子网络、免疫复合物沉积以及基质-免疫相互作用的不断变化逐渐重塑组织行为。这些变化的轴产生非线性轨迹的纤维化、血管损伤和关节破坏，而静态或还原论的体外系统无法重现这些过程。类器官和器官芯片平台现在允许在人类来源的系统中可控地重建这些动态微环境。通过将iPSC衍生的上皮、内皮、基质和免疫谱系与可调的细胞外基质（ECM）刚度和粘弹性、可灌注的微血管系统以及模块化的先天性和适应性免疫组分相结合，这些系统重现了关键的自身免疫现象。这些现象包括刚度驱动的成纤维细胞活化和内皮-间质转化（EndoMT）、干扰素调节的屏障崩溃、免疫复合物介导的损伤以及细胞因子依赖的基质侵袭。患者特异性诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）、基于CRISPR的风险等位基因编辑以及对照暴露于血清或自身抗体库提供了遗传和免疫学个性化，而多组学分析、空间成像和机器学习分析能够实现类器官状态与患者组织之间的定量对齐。通过将致病性微环境逻辑转化为可控的3D系统，这些平台将自身免疫类器官确立为可编程的、与人类相关的工具，用于机制发现、治疗探究和精准建模——为下一代、可能无动物的管线奠定基础，并推进SSc、SLE和RA的个性化免疫学。

abstract: Diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma (DIPG) is a highly lethal and therapeutically refractory pediatric brain tumor, and the effects of distinct disease backgrounds on treatment response and residual cell-state plasticity remain poorly understood. We evaluated abemaciclib, an FDA-approved CDK4/6 inhibitor, combined with temozolomide (TMZ) and radiation (XRT) in two patient-derived orthotopic xenograft (PDOX) models established from a treatment-naïve biopsy (IBs-9119DIPG) and a previously treated autopsy tumor (IBs-A0317DIPG). Treatment activity was assessed in PDOX-derived 3D tumor organoids and in randomized DIPG PDOX studies, followed by survival analysis, immunohistochemistry, and endpoint single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq). The triple therapy generated synergistic antitumor effects in PDOX-derived organoids and significantly prolonged survival in both PDOX models (P < 0.05) despite their distinct baseline molecular and cell-state differences. Endpoint scRNA-seq revealed reduced oligodendrocyte-progenitor-like (OPC-like) cells in both models and decreased astrocyte-like cells in the IBs-A0317DIPG model as cell-state changes associated with treatment response. In contrast, neural progenitor-like (NPC-like) cells expanded in IBs-A0317DIPG, whereas mesenchymal-like and Mitotic populations persisted in IBs-9119DIPG as candidate therapy-tolerant states. Pseudotime trajectory analysis uncovered a resistance-associated trajectory characterized by an exit from stemness toward differentiation in OPC-like cells in treatment-naïve IBs-9119DIPG, in contrast to the enrichment of stem-like OPC-like and NPC-like cells in therapy-resistant IBs-A0317DIPG. A transcriptionally defined radiation-resistance-associated subpopulation with candidate radiosensitization target genes (NPAS3, TBC1D15, and INPP4B) was also identified. Overall, the triple therapy improved survival in clinically distinct DIPG PDOX models and revealed therapy-associated residual cell-state changes that may inform future strategies to improve durable DIPG tumor control.
abstractZh: 弥漫性内生性脑桥胶质瘤（DIPG）是一种高度致命且治疗难治的儿童脑肿瘤，不同疾病背景对治疗反应和残留细胞状态可塑性的影响仍知之甚少。我们在两个患者来源的异位移植瘤（PDOX）模型中评估了abemaciclib（一种FDA批准的CDK4/6抑制剂）与替莫唑胺（TMZ）和放疗（XRT）的联合治疗，这两个模型分别来自治疗初治活检（IBs-9119DIPG）和既往治疗的尸检肿瘤（IBs-A0317DIPG）。在PDOX来源的3D肿瘤类器官和随机DIPG PDOX研究中评估了治疗活性，随后进行生存分析、免疫组织化学和终点单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）。三联疗法在PDOX来源的类器官中产生协同抗肿瘤效应，并在两个PDOX模型中显著延长生存期（P < 0.05），尽管它们具有不同的基线分子和细胞状态差异。终点scRNA-seq显示，两个模型中少突胶质前体样（OPC样）细胞减少，IBs-A0317DIPG模型中星形胶质细胞样细胞减少，这些是与治疗反应相关的细胞状态变化。相反，在IBs-A0317DIPG中，神经前体样（NPC样）细胞扩增，而在IBs-9119DIPG中，间充质样和有丝分裂群体持续存在，作为候选的治疗耐受状态。伪时间轨迹分析揭示了一条与耐药相关的轨迹，其特征是在治疗初治的IBs-9119DIPG中，OPC样细胞从干性退出向分化转变，而在治疗耐药的IBs-A0317DIPG中，则富集了干性OPC样和NPC样细胞。还鉴定了一个转录定义的放射抵抗相关亚群，具有候选放射增敏靶基因（NPAS3、TBC1D15和INPP4B）。总体而言，三联疗法在临床不同的DIPG PDOX模型中改善了生存期，并揭示了与治疗相关的残留细胞状态变化，这可能为未来改善DIPG持久肿瘤控制的策略提供信息。

abstract: Cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) is a leading cause of vascular cognitive impairment and stroke, yet its pathophysiology remains incompletely understood and effective treatments are lacking. This narrative review focuses on animal models that recapitulate the ischemic phenotypes of CSVD, including white matter lesions, lacunar infarcts, and chronic cerebral hypoperfusion; hemorrhagic CSVD subtypes are not discussed. We systematically survey the principal model categories for CSVD, encompassing chronic hypoperfusion models (such as bilateral common carotid artery stenosis [BCAS]), hypertensive models (such as spontaneously hypertensive rats [SHR]), genetically engineered models (such as CADASIL and CARASIL models), and chemically induced models (such as local injection of L-NIO). The article elaborates on the principles underlying the establishment of each model type, the pathological phenotypes simulated (vascular injury, white matter lesions, microinfarcts, microhemorrhages, neurological deficits), and their respective advantages and disadvantages. Building on this foundation, we have focused on analyzing the common challenges and controversies faced by existing models, including clinical relevance (species differences), pathological complexity (multifactorial integration), and the simulation of chronic processes. Finally, this review summarizes universal criteria for model evaluation and outlines future directions, emphasizing the integration of multifactorial composite models and the use of novel technologies such as large animals and organoids. These insights provide systematic guidance for bridging the gap between basic science and translational medicine in CSVD.
abstractZh: 脑小血管病（CSVD）是血管性认知障碍和卒中的主要原因，但其病理生理学仍未被完全理解，且缺乏有效的治疗方法。本叙述性综述聚焦于能够重现CSVD缺血性表型的动物模型，包括白质病变、腔隙性梗死和慢性脑低灌注；出血性CSVD亚型不在讨论范围内。我们系统性地梳理了CSVD的主要模型类别，涵盖慢性低灌注模型（如双侧颈总动脉狭窄[BCAS]）、高血压模型（如自发性高血压大鼠[SHR]）、基因工程模型（如CADASIL和CARASIL模型）以及化学诱导模型（如局部注射L-NIO）。本文详细阐述了每类模型建立所依据的原理、所模拟的病理表型（血管损伤、白质病变、微梗死、微出血、神经功能缺损）及其各自的优缺点。在此基础上，我们重点分析了现有模型面临的常见挑战和争议，包括临床相关性（物种差异）、病理复杂性（多因素整合）以及慢性过程的模拟。最后，本综述总结了模型评估的通用标准，并展望了未来方向，强调多因素复合模型的整合以及大动物和类器官等新技术的应用。这些见解为弥合CSVD基础科学与转化医学之间的鸿沟提供了系统性指导。

abstract:
Background

Oropouche virus (OROV) is an emerging arbovirus currently spreading across South America, with increasing reports of neurological manifestations, severe systemic disease, and congenital abnormalities. Although traditionally associated with mild febrile illness, the recent geographic expansion and surge in OROV outbreaks have prompted attention to its neurotropic potential.Methods

We investigated the effects of Oropouche virus (OROV) infection on neural stem cells (NSCs) and brain organoids derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells, using both an emergent reassortant isolate and a prototypical strain.Findings

OROV infected NSCs, leading to cell death, depletion of proliferative progenitors, and disruption of neuroepithelial organisation. Transcriptomic profiling revealed reduction of antiviral response genes and enrichment of signalling pathways related to viral replication, apoptosis, and inhibition of stem cell maintenance and neuronal differentiation. These molecular signatures aligned with phenotypic collapse of progenitor pools and cortical structure observed in organoids, in which OROV infected progenitors, neurons and astrocytes. Proteomic analysis of brain organoids infected with OROV showed regulation of neurodevelopment pathways, which have been previously associated with ZIKV infection, suggesting convergent pathway disruption associated with reduced growth of organoids infected by ZIKV and OROV and highlighting their potential to impair brain development.Interpretation

These results reveal evidence consistent with a previously unrecognised neurodevelopmental pathogenic potential of OROV strains and provide mechanistic insight into their contribution to microcephaly-like outcomes.Funding

abstractZh:
背景

奥罗普切病毒（OROV）是一种新兴的虫媒病毒，目前正在南美洲传播，越来越多的报告显示其与神经系统表现、严重全身性疾病和先天性异常相关。尽管传统上与轻度发热性疾病相关，但近期OROV疫情的地理扩张和激增已引起对其嗜神经潜力的关注。方法

我们使用一种新出现的重配分离株和一种原型株，研究了奥罗普切病毒（OROV）感染对人诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干细胞（NSCs）和脑类器官的影响。结果

OROV感染NSCs，导致细胞死亡、增殖性祖细胞耗竭以及神经上皮组织破坏。转录组分析显示，抗病毒反应基因减少，而与病毒复制、凋亡以及抑制干细胞维持和神经元分化相关的信号通路富集。这些分子特征与类器官中观察到的祖细胞池和皮层结构的表型崩溃一致，其中OROV感染了祖细胞、神经元和星形胶质细胞。对感染OROV的脑类器官进行的蛋白质组分析显示，神经发育通路受到调控，这些通路此前与ZIKV感染相关，提示存在汇聚的通路破坏，与ZIKV和OROV感染的类器官生长减少相关，并突显其损害大脑发育的潜力。解释

这些结果揭示了与先前未识别的OROV株神经发育致病潜力一致的证据，并为其导致小头畸形样结局的机制提供了见解。资助

abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Neuromesodermal progenitors (NMPs) drive vertebrate posterior axis elongation, but the lineage hierarchy of human NMP derivatives remains poorly defined. Here, we integrated a CRISPR/Cas9-based single-cell lineage tracing system with paired multiomics profiling—including scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq—in human pluripotent stem cell-derived neuromesodermal organoids (NMOs) to reconstruct high-resolution lineage relationships spanning 50 days of differentiation. Our data analysis reveal that intermediate mesoderm (IM) and paraxial mesoderm (PM) originate from a shared presomitic mesoderm (PSM) progenitor downstream of NMPs, whereas lateral plate mesoderm (LPM) segregates early from committed mesodermal progenitors. Notably, TBX6 ablation disrupts both IM and somite development, demonstrating that TBX6 functions as an upstream regulator of these two lineages. Mechanistically, TBX6 loss arrests PSM at the progenitor stage and abolishes activation of development programs required for IM maturation. We further delineate neural crest differentiation pathways from NMPs, identifying pre-bifurcation molecular signatures that predict neural crest fate. This work provides a clonal-resolution lineage map of human NMP differentiation and advances our understanding of human posterior trunk development and the etiology of TBX6-associated congenital disorders affecting both the spine and the kidney.
abstractZh:
摘要

  神经中胚层祖细胞（NMPs）驱动脊椎动物后部轴突的延伸，但人类NMP衍生物的谱系层级仍不清楚。在此，我们将基于CRISPR/Cas9的单细胞谱系追踪系统与配对的多组学分析（包括scRNA-seq和scATAC-seq）整合到人类多能干细胞来源的神经中胚层类器官（NMOs）中，以重建跨越50天分化的高分辨率谱系关系。我们的数据分析显示，中间中胚层（IM）和轴旁中胚层（PM）起源于NMP下游的一个共同的体节前中胚层（PSM）祖细胞，而侧板中胚层（LPM）则从已定型的中胚层祖细胞中早期分离。值得注意的是，TBX6的敲除破坏了IM和体节的发育，表明TBX6是这两个谱系的上游调节因子。机制上，TBX6缺失使PSM停滞在祖细胞阶段，并取消了IM成熟所需发育程序的激活。我们进一步描绘了从NMPs到神经嵴的分化路径，识别出预测神经嵴命运的预分叉分子特征。这项工作提供了人类NMP分化的克隆分辨率谱系图谱，并增进了我们对人类后躯干发育以及影响脊柱和肾脏的TBX6相关先天性疾病的病因学的理解。

title: Encapsulated cell technology delivers ciliary neurotrophic factor to promote JAK/STAT-dependent photoreceptor survival in retinal degeneration
titleZh: 封装细胞技术递送睫状神经营养因子以促进视网膜变性中JAK/STAT依赖的光感受器存活
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Iwama Y, Laughlin L, Harkins-Perry S, Giles S, Maeyama A, Traxler K, van Daelen M, Bonelli R, Nishida K, Friedlander M, Gantner ML, Eade KT.
abstract: Sustained trophic factor delivery via Encapsulated Cell Technology (ECT) is a powerful new class of therapeutics with broad potential for targeted treatment. Intravitreal delivery of ciliary neurotrophic factor (CNTF) via the ECT, NT-501, is a first-in-class therapy that slows the progression of macular telangiectasia type 2 (MacTel). Despite its clinical efficacy, key questions remain regarding its mechanism of action, including whether other implant-derived factors contribute to therapeutic benefit and how optimal dosing should be determined. Resolving these issues is critical for optimizing NT-501 in MacTel and guiding the development of ECT-based therapies for other diseases. We evaluated the biological activity of implant-derived cytokines on retinal tissue, using long-term NT-501 intravitreal implants in rabbits alongside human retinal organoid (hRO) models treated with NT-501–conditioned medium (NT-501–CM). Then, using a MacTel-specific photoreceptor degeneration model in hROs, we showed NT-501–CM significantly reduced photoreceptor cell death, and this protective effect was abolished by either CNTF-neutralizing antibodies or JAK inhibitor. We also established a therapeutic dose-response relationship linking NT-501–derived CNTF levels to JAK/STAT3 activation and photoreceptor protection. These findings directly connect ECT-derived CNTF exposure with JAK/STAT3-mediated photoreceptor protection in human retinal tissue and suggest an optimal concentration range for efficacy.
abstractZh: 通过封装细胞技术（ECT）持续递送营养因子是一类强大的新型治疗方法，在靶向治疗方面具有广泛潜力。通过ECT（NT-501）玻璃体内递送睫状神经营养因子（CNTF）是一种首创疗法，可减缓2型黄斑毛细血管扩张症（MacTel）的进展。尽管其临床有效性已得到证实，但其作用机制仍存在关键问题，包括其他植入物来源因子是否有助于治疗效果，以及如何确定最佳剂量。解决这些问题对于优化MacTel中的NT-501以及指导基于ECT的疗法在其他疾病中的开发至关重要。我们评估了植入物来源细胞因子对视网膜组织的生物活性，使用兔长期NT-501玻璃体内植入物以及用NT-501条件培养基（NT-501–CM）处理的人视网膜类器官（hRO）模型。然后，利用hRO中MacTel特异性光感受器变性模型，我们显示NT-501–CM显著减少了光感受器细胞死亡，而这种保护作用被CNTF中和抗体或JAK抑制剂所消除。我们还建立了治疗剂量-反应关系，将NT-501来源的CNTF水平与JAK/STAT3激活和光感受器保护联系起来。这些发现直接将ECT来源的CNTF暴露与人视网膜组织中JAK/STAT3介导的光感受器保护联系起来，并提示了有效性的最佳浓度范围。

title: Epilepsy-associated SCN2A-L1342P mutation drives network hyperexcitability and widespread transcriptomic changes in human cortical organoids.

abstract:
Objective

SCN2A pathogenic mutations, such as the recurrent heterozygous Nav1.2-L1342P, are monogenic causes of epilepsy. In this human-induced pluripotent stem cell-derived model system, we aim to investigate the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying SCN2A-L1342P-associated pathology.Methods

Using a human male induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) reference line (KOLF) carrying the Nav1.2-L1342P mutation, we generated three-dimensional (3D) cortical organoids for functional studies. Patch-clamp, multi-electrode array (MEA) recordings, immunocytochemistry, and RNA sequencing were used to characterize the disease phenotypes.Results

Nav1.2-L1342P organoid neurons displayed increased intrinsic excitability and amplified excitatory post-synaptic currents, which are consistent with an increase in excitatory synapse formation revealed by SYN1/PSD95 immunostaining. Moreover, elevated network firing activity, as demonstrated by MEA, indicates a pronounced network hyperexcitability. Transcriptomic profiling of organoids carrying the Nav1.2-L1342P mutation further revealed significant alterations in synaptic, glutamatergic, developmental, and senescence/apoptotic pathways.Significance

Our findings demonstrate that the Nav1.2-L1342P mutation drives a multifaceted disease phenotype, including network hyperexcitability and disruption of pathways related to neuronal and synaptic functions. These results advance our understanding of SCN2A-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE), laying a foundation for personalized interventions.
abstractZh:
目的

SCN2A致病性突变，如复发性杂合Nav1.2-L1342P，是癫痫的单基因病因。在此人诱导多能干细胞衍生模型系统中，我们旨在研究SCN2A-L1342P相关病理的分子和细胞机制。方法

使用携带Nav1.2-L1342P突变的人男性诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）参考系（KOLF），我们生成了三维（3D）皮层类器官用于功能研究。使用膜片钳、多电极阵列（MEA）记录、免疫细胞化学和RNA测序来表征疾病表型。结果

Nav1.2-L1342P类器官神经元表现出增加的内在兴奋性和放大的兴奋性突触后电流，这与SYN1/PSD95免疫染色显示的兴奋性突触形成增加一致。此外，MEA显示的网络放电活动升高表明明显的网络过度兴奋。携带Nav1.2-L1342P突变的类器官的转录组分析进一步揭示了突触、谷氨酸能、发育和衰老/凋亡通路的显著改变。意义

我们的发现表明，Nav1.2-L1342P突变驱动多方面的疾病表型，包括网络过度兴奋和与神经元及突触功能相关通路的破坏。这些结果推进了我们对SCN2A相关发育性和癫痫性脑病（DEE）的理解，为个性化干预奠定了基础。

title: Uncovering smooth structures in single-cell data with neighbor embeddings guided by predictability-computability-stability.
titleZh: 通过可预测性-可计算性-稳定性引导的邻居嵌入揭示单细胞数据中的平滑结构。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ma R, Li X, Hu J, Yu B.
affiliations: Department of Biostatistics, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, Boston, MA, USA.
Department of Data Science, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Boston, MA, USA.

abstract: Single-cell sequencing enables detailed study of cell-state transitions, but extracting smooth, low-dimensional structures from noisy, high-dimensional data remains challenging. Neighbor embedding (NE) algorithms, such as t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) and uniform manifold approximation and projection (UMAP), are widely used to embed high-dimensional single-cell data into low dimensions, but they often introduce distortions that can lead to misleading interpretations. To address these challenges, we build on the predictability-computability-stability (PCS) framework for reliable and reproducible data-driven discoveries. First, we systematically evaluate popular NE algorithms through empirical and theoretical analyses, revealing their key limitations such as algorithmic artifacts and instability. We then introduce NESS, a principled and interpretable machine learning approach that improves NE representations by leveraging algorithmic stability, enabling more robust inference of smooth biological structures from single-cell data. Finally, we apply NESS to multiple datasets, including studies of pluripotent stem cell differentiation, organoid development, and diverse tissue-specific lineages. Across these settings, NESS consistently yields biologically meaningful insights.
abstractZh: 单细胞测序能够详细研究细胞状态转变，但从噪声高维数据中提取平滑的低维结构仍然具有挑战性。邻居嵌入（NE）算法，如t分布随机邻居嵌入（t-SNE）和均匀流形逼近与投影（UMAP），被广泛用于将高维单细胞数据嵌入到低维空间，但它们常常引入扭曲，可能导致误导性解释。为了解决这些挑战，我们基于可预测性-可计算性-稳定性（PCS）框架，实现可靠且可重复的数据驱动发现。首先，我们通过实证和理论分析系统评估了流行的NE算法，揭示了它们的关键局限性，如算法伪影和不稳定性。然后，我们引入了NESS，一种有原则且可解释的机器学习方法，通过利用算法稳定性改进NE表示，从而能够从单细胞数据中更稳健地推断平滑的生物结构。最后，我们将NESS应用于多个数据集，包括多能干细胞分化、类器官发育和多种组织特异性谱系的研究。在这些场景中，NESS始终产生具有生物学意义的见解。

title: Systems toxicology integration uncovers trophoblast apoptosis as a pivotal mechanism underlying PFAS-related recurrent miscarriage.
titleZh: 系统毒理学整合揭示滋养层细胞凋亡是PFAS相关复发性流产的关键机制。
journal: Frontiers in cell and developmental biology
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Wu S, Dai W, Lin J, Hong X.
affiliations: Intensive Care Unit, Women and Children's Hospital of Ningbo University, Ningbo, China.
abstract: The present investigation seeks to clarify the molecular underpinnings through which perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) and perfluorooctanesulfonic acid (PFOS) precipitate recurrent miscarriage (RM). Initially, prospective targets of PFOA (6050 in total) and PFOS (8896 in total) were systematically compiled from three repositories-CTD, ChEMBL, and Super-PRED-while 1822 pathogenic targets linked to RM were cataloged through the amalgamation of GeneCards, OMIM, and NCBI resources. Venn diagrammatic assessment disclosed 699 overlapping targets shared between PFOA and RM, alongside 832 shared between PFOS and RM. Thereafter, PPI networks were assembled utilizing the STRING platform. By applying median filtering coupled with CytoHubba-based evaluation, central targets were distilled-362 for the PFOA-RM axis and 502 for the PFOS-RM axis-together with their respective top 10 hub genes. Functional enrichment conducted via DAVID pointed toward platelet coagulation elements as potentially critical mediators in PFOA- and PFOS-triggered RM. Moreover, the distinctive enrichment of transcriptional co-regulatory complexes observed specifically for PFOS, coupled with divergent pathway involvements including adipocytokine signaling, TNF cascades, and fluid shear stress transduction between the two agents, implies compound-specific pathogenic modalities. Overlapping target scrutiny pinpointed TP53 as the exclusive pathogenic gene candidate. SMART-based verification affirmed its essential structural domains, with documented subcellular residence in cytoplasmic, nuclear, and mitochondrial compartments. TP53 engages functionally with MDM2 and MDM4 among other interactors, exhibiting pronounced expression within female reproductive tissues such as the cervix and ovary. Notably, its expression proved markedly elevated in healthy villous tissues (encompassing cytotrophoblast and chorionic cavity cells) relative to decidual counterparts. Single-cell interrogation further substantiated prominent TP53 expression within migratory extravillous trophoblasts, extravillous trophoblast populations, and endometrial vascular endothelial cells. Ex vivo investigations demonstrated that PFOA and PFOS exposure markedly suppressed HTR8/Svneo cell proliferation while promoting programmed cell death, concomitantly attenuating TP53 protein abundance. Computational molecular docking corroborated favorable binding energetics between both perfluorinated compounds and the TP53 protein. Collectively, these observations furnish novel mechanistic perspectives on PFAS-driven RM pathogenesis, highlighting TP53 as a promising molecular marker for environmentally triggered RM. Also, this study is limited by its in vitro nature, the use of a single SV40-immortalized trophoblast cell line, and the absence of primary human trophoblast or organoid validation.
abstractZh: 本研究旨在阐明全氟辛酸（PFOA）和全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）诱发复发性流产（RM）的分子基础。首先，从CTD、ChEMBL和Super-PRED三个数据库中系统整理了PFOA（共6050个）和PFOS（共8896个）的预测靶点，同时通过整合GeneCards、OMIM和NCBI资源，整理了与RM相关的1822个致病靶点。维恩图评估显示，PFOA与RM之间有699个重叠靶点，PFOS与RM之间有832个重叠靶点。随后，利用STRING平台构建了PPI网络。通过应用中位数过滤结合CytoHubba评估，筛选出核心靶点——PFOA-RM轴362个，PFOS-RM轴502个——以及它们各自的前10个Hub基因。通过DAVID进行的功能富集分析表明，血小板凝血因子可能是PFOA和PFOS触发RM的关键介质。此外，PFOS特有的转录共调控复合物的独特富集，以及两种化合物之间包括脂肪细胞因子信号传导、TNF级联和流体剪切应力转导在内的不同通路参与，暗示了化合物特异性的致病模式。重叠靶点分析确定TP53为唯一的致病基因候选。基于SMART的验证确认了其必需的结构域，并记录了其在细胞质、细胞核和线粒体区室中的亚细胞定位。TP53与MDM2和MDM4等功能性相互作用，并在女性生殖组织（如宫颈和卵巢）中表现出显著表达。值得注意的是，其在健康绒毛组织（包括细胞滋养层和绒毛膜腔细胞）中的表达显著高于蜕膜组织。单细胞研究进一步证实了TP53在迁移性绒毛外滋养层细胞、绒毛外滋养层细胞群和子宫内膜血管内皮细胞中的显著表达。离体研究表明，PFOA和PFOS暴露显著抑制HTR8/Svneo细胞增殖并促进程序性细胞死亡，同时降低TP53蛋白丰度。计算分子对接证实了两种全氟化合物与TP53蛋白之间具有良好的结合能。总的来说，这些观察结果为PFAS驱动的RM发病机制提供了新的机制视角，强调TP53是环境触发RM的有前景的分子标志物。此外，本研究受限于其体外性质、使用单一SV40永生化滋养层细胞系，以及缺乏原代人滋养层细胞或类器官验证。

title: Modeling and targeting the hostile physicochemical niche in bone metastasis: from experimental platforms to niche-directed therapy.
titleZh: 建模与靶向骨转移中的恶劣理化微环境：从实验平台到微环境导向治疗。
journal: Frontiers in cell and developmental biology
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Bakir M, Alkhatib AR, Helal B, Al Masri MK, Dabaliz A, Mohammad KS.
affiliations: Department of Medicine, College of Medicine, Alfaisal University, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Department of Clinical Skills, College of Medicine, Alfaisal University, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Department of Anatomy, College of Medicine, Alfaisal University, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
abstract: Cancer metastasis to bone is shaped not only by tumor-stromal crosstalk but also by a hostile physicochemical niche that promotes disease persistence and therapeutic failure. Hypoxia, acidosis, mineralized matrix architecture, altered mechanics, interstitial pressure, impaired perfusion, and limited drug transport influence metastatic seeding, dormancy, reactivation, remodeling, pain, and treatment response. Conventional two-dimensional cultures and many simplified three-dimensional systems reproduce only selected features of this environment, often overestimating therapeutic efficacy. This review examines experimental platforms designed to model bone metastasis with greater biological and biophysical fidelity, including mineralized scaffolds, multicellular co-cultures, ex vivo bone explants, organoids, bone-on-chip and microphysiological systems (MPS), animal models, and computational or hybrid approaches. Rather than ranking models by complexity, we propose a fit-for-purpose framework in which platform selection is guided by the biological question, the lesion feature being tested, and the required balance between control, scalability, and physiological fidelity. We further discuss how modeling oxygen tension, extracellular pH, pressure, mechanics, vascular transport, immune context, and neural interactions can inform niche-directed therapeutic strategies. The central challenge is to build models that reproduce clinically relevant bone lesion states and thereby improve therapeutic prediction, patient stratification, and treatment design.
abstractZh: 癌症骨转移不仅受肿瘤-基质串扰影响，还受恶劣的理化微环境影响，这种微环境促进疾病持续和治疗失败。缺氧、酸中毒、矿化基质结构、力学改变、间质压力、灌注受损和药物转运受限影响转移定植、休眠、再激活、重塑、疼痛和治疗反应。传统的二维培养和许多简化的三维系统仅能重现该环境的某些特征，往往高估治疗效果。本综述探讨了旨在以更高生物学和生物物理保真度模拟骨转移的实验平台，包括矿化支架、多细胞共培养、离体骨外植体、类器官、骨芯片和微生理系统（MPS）、动物模型以及计算或混合方法。我们并非按复杂性对模型进行排序，而是提出一种“按需适用”框架，其中平台选择由生物学问题、所测试的病变特征以及控制性、可扩展性和生理保真度之间的所需平衡来指导。我们进一步讨论了如何模拟氧张力、细胞外pH、压力、力学、血管转运、免疫环境和神经相互作用，为微环境导向的治疗策略提供信息。核心挑战在于构建能够重现临床相关骨病变状态的模型，从而改善治疗预测、患者分层和治疗设计。

title: Ambient aromatic hydrocarbons and prostate cancer: mechanistic evidence linking benzene and PAH exposure to tumor progression.
titleZh: 环境芳香烃与前列腺癌：苯和多环芳烃暴露促进肿瘤进展的机制证据。
journal: Frontiers in cell and developmental biology
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Wu H, Cao H, Ye Z, Li Z, Chang M, Zhang W, Xu T, Wang L, Yang T, Deng X, Hu E, Gao B.
affiliations: Department of Urology, First Hospital of Jilin University, Changchun, Jilin, China.
abstract: Prostate cancer (PCa) remains one of the most common malignancies in men worldwide, yet modifiable environmental contributors remain incompletely defined. Aromatic hydrocarbons (AHs), particularly benzene and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), are widespread pollutants in ambient air, occupational settings, tobacco smoke, and high-temperature cooking emissions. In this review, we synthesize evidence from population-based and occupational epidemiology, dietary exposure proxies, animal carcinogenesis models, organoid systems, and cell-based mechanistic studies to assess the biological plausibility of AH-related prostate carcinogenesis. Human studies support modest but recurrent associations between long-term exposure to traffic-related mixtures, benzene-containing emissions, PAH-generating cooking practices, and increased PCa risk, with stronger duration-response signals in occupational settings. Experimental evidence further indicates that benzo[a]pyrene and related PAHs can induce prostatic mutagenesis, oxidative and genotoxic stress, endocrine perturbation, epigenetic remodeling, and immunosuppressive changes in the tumor microenvironment. The most coherent mechanisms involve AhR-AR crosstalk, CYP1A1/1B1-mediated bioactivation, ROS generation, DNA-adduct formation, DNMT1/HDAC6-associated epigenetic regulation, JAK2/STAT3-linked survival signaling, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, and IDO/TDO-kynurenine-AhR-mediated immune suppression. Collectively, current evidence supports a biologically plausible framework in which AH exposure may contribute to PCa initiation and progression and may intersect with pathways implicated in therapy resistance, although causal inference remains constrained by exposure misclassification, mixture complexity, and limited longitudinal biomarker data. Future studies should integrate precise exposure assessment with prostate-specific molecular studies, organoid systems, animal models, and prospective human cohorts.
abstractZh: 前列腺癌（PCa）仍然是全球男性最常见的恶性肿瘤之一，然而可改变的环境因素尚未完全明确。芳香烃（AHs），特别是苯和多环芳烃（PAHs），是环境空气、职业环境、烟草烟雾和高温烹饪排放中广泛存在的污染物。在本综述中，我们综合了基于人群和职业流行病学、饮食暴露替代指标、动物致癌模型、类器官系统和细胞机制研究的证据，以评估芳香烃相关前列腺癌发生的生物学合理性。人类研究支持长期暴露于交通相关混合物、含苯排放物、产生多环芳烃的烹饪方式与前列腺癌风险增加之间存在适度但反复出现的关联，且在职业环境中观察到更强的持续时间-反应信号。实验证据进一步表明，苯并[a]芘及相关多环芳烃可诱导前列腺突变、氧化和基因毒性应激、内分泌紊乱、表观遗传重塑以及肿瘤微环境中的免疫抑制性变化。最一致的机制涉及AhR-AR串扰、CYP1A1/1B1介导的生物活化、ROS生成、DNA加合物形成、DNMT1/HDAC6相关的表观遗传调控、JAK2/STAT3相关的生存信号传导、上皮-间质转化以及IDO/TDO-犬尿氨酸-AhR介导的免疫抑制。总的来说，当前证据支持一个生物学上合理的框架，即芳香烃暴露可能促进前列腺癌的发生和进展，并可能与治疗耐药相关的通路交叉，尽管因果推断仍受暴露错分、混合物复杂性和纵向生物标志物数据有限的限制。未来的研究应将精确的暴露评估与前列腺特异性分子研究、类器官系统、动物模型和前瞻性人类队列相结合。

title: A modern reinterpretation of the "kidney governs bone" theory: systemic regulation of the neuro-endocrine-immune network via the brain-bone axis and traditional chinese medicine intervention strategies.
titleZh: “肾主骨”理论的现代诠释：通过脑-骨轴对神经-内分泌-免疫网络的系统调控及中医药干预策略
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Dong J, Peng Z, Chen T.
affiliations: The First Clinical Medical College, Yunnan University of Chinese Medicine, Kunming, China.
Yunnan Provincial Hospital of Chinese Medicine, Kunming, China.
abstract: The traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) theory of "Kidney Governs Bone' has been progressively validated in modern medical research. However, a purely endocrinological perspective cannot fully explain its regulatory implications under complex conditions such as stress, inflammation, and nerve injury. As bone metabolism research shifts toward a systemic regulatory paradigm, the "brain-bone axis' provides a new framework for reinterpreting "Kidney Governs Bone.' Based on current evidence, the core scientific proposition of this article is that we propose the hypothesis that the therapeutic effects of TCM's "Kidney Governs Bone' theory can be partially explained by systemic regulation of the neuro-endocrine-immune network, and that the therapeutic efficacy of TCM interventions may be related to their ability for layered, multi-target regulation within this network. This proposition requires further validation in diverse pathological contexts. Based on this proposition, we propose three conceptual frameworks: ① extending "Kidney Governs Bone' from the traditional "kidney-bone' endocrine axis to a systemic regulatory framework centered on the "brain-bone axis'; ② constructing a three-level "central-peripheral-local' regulatory model that systematically integrates the hierarchical interactions within the neuro-endocrine-immune network; and ③ proposing a "stratified intervention' strategy for TCM, clarifying the target differences among different therapeutic principles across the three network levels. Using this framework, we systematically evaluate the mechanisms of TCM interventions: kidney-tonifying herbs regulate the hypothalamic-pituitary axis to maintain endocrine homeostasis; kidney-tonifying and blood-activating methods, as well as acupuncture and other external therapies, achieve "neuro-vascular-osteogenic' synergy by modulating sympathetic tone and upregulating neuropeptides such as CGRP; acupuncture and moxibustion remodel the bone immune microenvironment by activating the cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway, promoting M2 macrophage polarization, and inhibiting NLRP3 inflammasome activation. Current challenges include spatiotemporal heterogeneity, network complexity, and clinical translation gaps. Future studies should employ technologies such as optogenetics, multi-omics integration, and organoid-on-a-chip platforms. The modern scientific connotation of "Kidney Governs Bone' is deeply reflected in the systemic regulation of the neuro-endocrine-immune network, and this interdisciplinary direction provides a crucial theoretical breakthrough for transforming TCM orthopedics from empirical medicine toward systems medicine.
abstractZh: 中医“肾主骨”理论在现代医学研究中已逐步得到验证。然而，单纯的内分泌学视角无法完全解释其在应激、炎症和神经损伤等复杂条件下的调控意义。随着骨代谢研究向系统调控范式转变，“脑-骨轴”为重新诠释“肾主骨”提供了新框架。基于现有证据，本文的核心科学命题是：我们提出假设，即中医“肾主骨”理论的疗效可部分归因于对神经-内分泌-免疫网络的系统调控，且中医药干预的疗效可能与其在该网络中进行分层、多靶点调控的能力有关。该命题需在不同病理背景下进一步验证。基于此命题，我们提出三个概念框架：①将“肾主骨”从传统的“肾-骨”内分泌轴扩展至以“脑-骨轴”为中心的系统调控框架；②构建“中枢-外周-局部”三级调控模型，系统整合神经-内分泌-免疫网络内的层级交互；③提出中医药“分层干预”策略，明确不同治则在该网络三个层级中的靶点差异。利用该框架，我们系统评估了中医药干预机制：补肾中药通过调节下丘脑-垂体轴维持内分泌稳态；补肾活血法及针灸等外治疗法通过调节交感神经张力、上调CGRP等神经肽实现“神经-血管-成骨”协同；针灸通过激活胆碱能抗炎通路、促进M2巨噬细胞极化、抑制NLRP3炎症小体活化来重塑骨免疫微环境。当前挑战包括时空异质性、网络复杂性和临床转化缺口。未来研究应采用光遗传学、多组学整合和类器官芯片等技术。“肾主骨”的现代科学内涵深刻体现在对神经-内分泌-免疫网络的系统调控中，这一跨学科方向为中医骨伤科从经验医学向系统医学转化提供了重要理论突破。

title: Fibroblasts selectively modulate immune cell-derived cytokine effects on tumor cells in colorectal cancer.
titleZh: 成纤维细胞选择性调节免疫细胞来源的细胞因子对结直肠癌肿瘤细胞的作用。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Hajdó S, Komlósi ZI, Érsek B, Carmi I, Tölgyes T, Wiener Z.
affiliations: Institute of Genetics, Cell- and Immunobiology, Semmelweis University, Budapest, Hungary.
Department of General Surgery and Surgical Oncology, Uzsoki Hospital, Budapest, Hungary.
abstract:
Introduction

Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a heterogeneous malignancy and a major cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) accumulate in tumors and correlate with poor patient survival, suggesting a central role in immune regulation. Patient-derived organoids (PDO) maintain the intra-tumoral cellular heterogeneity of the original tissue, thus, they represent one of the best methods to study human cancers. The tumor microenvironment (TME) contains diverse immune cell populations, including innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), yet how stromal components influence cytokine-driven tumor-immune interactions remains unclear.Methods

PDOs from CRC patients were used to screen TME-derived cytokines affecting tumor growth. Organoid-forming efficiency and signaling pathway activation were analyzed following cytokine stimulation in the presence or absence of CAFs. Tumor-infiltrating ILC subsets were characterized in patient samples, and co-culture systems were employed to assess cytokine production and stromal-immune interactions.Results

IL-22 was identified as a cytokine that increased PDO-forming efficiency without activating fibroblasts. Although IL-22 typically signals through the JAK-STAT pathway, it unexpectedly activates MAPK signaling in PDO cells. Interestingly, interferon-γ (IFNγ) showed only partial cytotoxic effects on CRC cells. Tumor tissues contained both IFNγ-producing ILC1 and IL-22/IL-17A-producing ILC3 populations. Co-culture with PDOs selectively induced IL-22, but not IL-17A, production in ILC3 cells. Importantly, IL-22 enhanced organoid formation only in the absence of CAFs, whereas IFNγ activity was largely unaffected by stromal context.Discussion

These findings demonstrate that CAFs modulate local immunity by selectively masking ILC3-derived IL-22 signaling while preserving ILC1-mediated IFNγ responses. This study emphasizes the importance of stromal context in interpreting cytokine function in CRC and reveals a previously unrecognized mechanism of stromal-immune crosstalk within the TME.
abstractZh:
引言

结直肠癌（CRC）是一种异质性恶性肿瘤，是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）在肿瘤中积累，并与患者生存率低相关，提示其在免疫调节中发挥核心作用。患者来源的类器官（PDO）保留了原始组织的肿瘤内细胞异质性，因此，它们代表了研究人类癌症的最佳方法之一。肿瘤微环境（TME）包含多种免疫细胞群体，包括固有淋巴样细胞（ILCs），然而，基质成分如何影响细胞因子驱动的肿瘤-免疫相互作用仍不清楚。方法

使用来自CRC患者的PDO筛选影响肿瘤生长的TME来源细胞因子。在存在或不存在CAFs的情况下，分析细胞因子刺激后的类器官形成效率和信号通路激活。在患者样本中表征肿瘤浸润的ILC亚群，并采用共培养系统评估细胞因子产生和基质-免疫相互作用。结果

IL-22被鉴定为一种增加PDO形成效率而不激活成纤维细胞的细胞因子。尽管IL-22通常通过JAK-STAT通路发出信号，但它意外地激活了PDO细胞中的MAPK信号传导。有趣的是，干扰素-γ（IFNγ）对CRC细胞仅显示出部分细胞毒性作用。肿瘤组织包含产生IFNγ的ILC1和产生IL-22/IL-17A的ILC3群体。与PDO共培养选择性地诱导ILC3细胞产生IL-22，但不产生IL-17A。重要的是，IL-22仅在不存在CAFs时增强类器官形成，而IFNγ活性在很大程度上不受基质背景的影响。讨论

这些发现表明，CAFs通过选择性掩蔽ILC3来源的IL-22信号传导，同时保留ILC1介导的IFNγ反应来调节局部免疫。这项研究强调了在解释CRC中细胞因子功能时基质背景的重要性，并揭示了TME内基质-免疫串扰的一种先前未被认识的机制。

title: Therapeutic resistance in HPV-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma: molecular mechanisms, clinical challenges, and precision strategies.
titleZh: HPV阳性口咽鳞状细胞癌的治疗耐药：分子机制、临床挑战与精准策略。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Meng Y, Sun J, Ma Y, Kong C.
affiliations: Department of Central Laboratory, Liaoning Cancer Hospital & Institute, Cancer Hospital of Dalian University of Technology, Shenyang, Liaoning, China.
Department of Biobank, Liaoning Cancer Hospital & Institute, Cancer Hospital of Dalian University of Technology, Shenyang, Liaoning, China.
abstract: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC) exhibits exceptional sensitivity to chemoradiotherapy, with 5-year overall survival exceeding 80%, thereby providing a compelling rationale for treatment de-escalation. However, 15%-20% of patients develop therapeutic resistance and locoregional recurrence, resulting in markedly inferior outcomes. This Review systematically dissects the molecular architecture of treatment resistance in HPV-positive OPSCC, with particular emphasis on mechanisms conferring resistance to radiotherapy, platinum-based chemotherapy, and EGFR-targeted therapy (cetuximab). We delineate core drivers - aberrant DNA damage response (DDR) signaling, epigenetic reprogramming, cancer stem cell (CSC) plasticity, and non-coding RNA networks-and pinpoint actionable vulnerabilities. The contributions and limitations of patient-derived organoids, genetically engineered mouse models, and pivotal clinical trials (notably RTOG 1016) are critically appraised. We address persistent controversies, including the complex relationship between de-escalation and resistance, and highlight the lack of integrative resistance biomarkers. Finally, we propose a roadmap to bridge translational gaps and accelerate the development of precision strategies that circumvent resistance.
abstractZh: 人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）阳性的口咽鳞状细胞癌（OPSCC）对放化疗表现出卓越的敏感性，5年总生存率超过80%，这为治疗降级提供了有力的依据。然而，15%-20%的患者会出现治疗耐药和局部区域复发，导致预后显著较差。本综述系统剖析了HPV阳性OPSCC治疗耐药性的分子架构，特别强调了赋予放疗、铂类化疗和EGFR靶向治疗（西妥昔单抗）耐药性的机制。我们阐述了核心驱动因素——异常的DNA损伤反应（DDR）信号传导、表观遗传重编程、癌症干细胞（CSC）可塑性和非编码RNA网络——并指出了可行的攻击靶点。我们批判性地评估了患者来源的类器官、基因工程小鼠模型和关键临床试验（尤其是RTOG 1016）的贡献与局限性。我们探讨了持续存在的争议，包括降级治疗与耐药性之间的复杂关系，并强调了缺乏整合性耐药生物标志物的问题。最后，我们提出了一条路线图，以弥合转化差距并加速开发规避耐药的精准策略。

abstract:
Background

Docetaxel resistance represents a major therapeutic challenge in advanced prostate cancer. Despite extensive studies on drug efflux, apoptosis, and metabolic adaptation, the specific cellular states and molecular determinants that sustain resistance remain poorly understood.Methods

To delineate the cellular basis of chemoresistance, we integrated bulk RNA sequencing of docetaxel-resistant prostate cancer models with single-cell transcriptomic data from patient tumors. Resistance-associated gene signatures were projected onto a single-cell atlas to identify docetaxel-resistant associated cancer cells (DRACs). Candidate regulators were screened through cross-dataset analysis and validated using molecular, cellular, and organoid-based assays, with functional and signaling consequences evaluated across in vitro and in vivo systems.Results

Single-cell mapping revealed a distinct epithelial cluster characterized by enrichment of resistance-related transcriptional programs and extensive communication with stromal cells. Integrative analyses identified PRR7 as a consistently upregulated gene within DRACs and resistant cell lines. PRR7 amplification and co-alteration with PI3K-AKT and Wnt pathway components were observed in clinical datasets. Functional inhibition of PRR7 suppressed β-catenin signaling, reduced cell viability, and downregulated stemness markers in docetaxel-resistant cells and patient-derived organoids. These results support a functional association between PRR7 and Wnt/β-catenin-related maintenance of resistance.Conclusion

The study defines DRACs as a transcriptionally distinct subpopulation sustaining docetaxel tolerance and identifies PRR7 as a regulatory hub connecting genomic alterations, Wnt/β-catenin activation, and stem-like phenotypes. These findings provide a framework for understanding chemoresistance in prostate cancer and suggest PRR7-centered signaling as a potential target for therapeutic intervention.
abstractZh:
背景

多西他赛耐药是晚期前列腺癌治疗中的主要挑战。尽管在药物外排、凋亡和代谢适应方面已有广泛研究，但维持耐药性的特定细胞状态和分子决定因素仍知之甚少。方法

为了描绘化疗耐药的细胞基础，我们将多西他赛耐药前列腺癌模型的批量RNA测序与患者肿瘤的单细胞转录组数据相结合。将耐药相关基因特征投射到单细胞图谱上，以识别多西他赛耐药相关癌细胞（DRACs）。通过跨数据集分析筛选候选调控因子，并使用分子、细胞和类器官实验进行验证，同时在体外和体内系统中评估其功能和信号传导后果。结果

单细胞图谱揭示了一个独特的上皮细胞簇，其特征是耐药相关转录程序富集并与基质细胞广泛通讯。整合分析确定PRR7为DRACs和耐药细胞系中持续上调的基因。在临床数据集中观察到PRR7扩增及其与PI3K-AKT和Wnt通路组分的共改变。功能抑制PRR7可抑制β-catenin信号传导，降低细胞活力，并在多西他赛耐药细胞和患者来源类器官中下调干性标志物。这些结果支持PRR7与Wnt/β-catenin相关耐药维持之间的功能关联。结论

该研究将DRACs定义为维持多西他赛耐受的转录上独特的亚群，并确定PRR7为连接基因组改变、Wnt/β-catenin激活和干样表型的调控枢纽。这些发现为理解前列腺癌化疗耐药提供了框架，并提示以PRR7为中心的信号传导可作为治疗干预的潜在靶点。

title: Human blood vessel organoids reveal a critical role for IGFBP7 in Diabetic Microangiopathy
titleZh: 人类血管类器官揭示IGFBP7在糖尿病微血管病变中的关键作用

authors: Pooni A, Theofilatos K, Boas L, Pruktanakul T, Alhaque S, Romeo SG, Secco I, Schneider E, Oexner R, Schmitt R, Zoccarato A, Park S, Lynham S, Zeng L, Lee CN, Jackson TL, Modarai B, Margariti A, Giacca M, Shah AM, Zampetaki A.
affiliations: British Heart Foundation Centre, School of Cardiovascular & Metabolic Medicine and Sciences, ,

abstract: Microangiopathy is a key contributor to diabetic vascular complications. There is currently no effective treatment, and patients are at high risk of major adverse cardiovascular events. We have recently demonstrated that human blood vessel organoids (BVOs) capture key aspects of the microvasculature. Here, employing patient derived BVOs we find that diabetic media treated BVOs display features of diabetic clinical microvascular specimens. Proteomic profiling of diabetic BVOs and their secretome, revealed a robust upregulation of IGFBP7, a protein that was subsequently associated with microangiopathy in UK Biobank. Follow-up studies uncovered an instrumental role of IGFBP7 in the microvasculature and LGALS1 and LGALS3 as its downstream effectors. Underlying their importance in a clinical setting, in the UKB biobank, we observed a strong association of LGALS1, LGALS3 with diabetic nephropathy and retinopathy while in AoU cohort we identified genetic variants in the diabetic microangiopathy signature associated with diabetes diagnosis and cardiometabolic outcomes.
abstractZh: 微血管病变是糖尿病血管并发症的关键因素。目前尚无有效治疗方法，患者发生主要不良心血管事件的风险很高。我们最近证明，人类血管类器官（BVOs）能够捕捉微血管系统的关键方面。在此，我们利用患者来源的BVOs发现，经糖尿病培养基处理的BVOs表现出糖尿病临床微血管标本的特征。对糖尿病BVOs及其分泌组的蛋白质组学分析显示，IGFBP7显著上调，该蛋白随后在英国生物银行（UK Biobank）中被发现与微血管病变相关。后续研究揭示了IGFBP7在微血管系统中的重要作用，并确定LGALS1和LGALS3为其下游效应因子。在临床环境中，我们在UKB生物银行观察到LGALS1、LGALS3与糖尿病肾病和视网膜病变的强关联，而在AoU队列中，我们识别出与糖尿病诊断和心脏代谢结局相关的糖尿病微血管病变特征中的遗传变异。

abstract: The successful culture of human embryonic stem (hES) cells from inner cell mass cells of blastocyst stage 'spare' embryos in 1998, followed by induced pluripotent stem (iPS) cells in 2006, which allowed somatic cells to be reprogrammed to pluripotency using the Yamanaka factors, transformed regenerative biology and inspired extensive global efforts towards developing pluripotent stem cell-based applications. However, hES and iPS cells, as well as organoids generated from them, largely retain fetal-like characteristics, which limits their relevance for clinical translation. Concurrently, the prevailing assumption published in leading journals that adult tissues lack endogenous stem cells has led to the belief that mature cells dedifferentiate and reprogram during in vivo regeneration upon chronic injury, and that the appearance of embryonic/fetal markers in diabetes, heart failure, cancer, and many other chronic disease states reflects dedifferentiation of mature cells. We suggest that the prevailing concepts of dedifferentiation and reprogramming, both in vitro and in vivo, require careful re-evaluation. Adult somatic cells possibly do not truly dedifferentiate, neither in vitro nor in vivo. Instead, tissue-resident, pluripotent, very small embryonic-like stem cells (VSELs) in multiple organs account for the observed biology. In vitro "reprogramming" responses to Yamanaka factors likely reflect selective activation and expansion of VSELs/early progenitors rather than the dedifferentiation/ reprogramming of mature adult somatic cells. Likewise, the embryonic/fetal-like signatures reported in multiple disease states including cancer reflect expansion of immature tissue-specific progenitors that arise from VSELs but fail to differentiate normally due to a damaged microenvironment in vivo. Therapeutic strategies involving transplantation of MSCs, MUSE cells, or their secreted exosomes improve disease outcomes, possibly by restoring the damaged niche that supports functional tissue repair by VSELs. Although direct evidence to support this is lacking at present, recognising the central role of VSELs/progenitors and their niche in maintaining tissue homeostasis in vivo could resolve existing roadblocks and guide more effective endogenous regenerative therapies for diseased tissues and age-related dysfunctions.
abstractZh: 1998年，从囊胚期“多余”胚胎的内细胞团成功培养出人胚胎干细胞（hES），随后在2006年，山中因子使体细胞能够被重编程为多能性，产生了诱导多能干细胞（iPS），这改变了再生生物学，并激发了全球范围内开发基于多能干细胞应用的广泛努力。然而，hES和iPS细胞以及由它们生成的类器官在很大程度上保留了胎儿样特征，这限制了它们与临床转化的相关性。与此同时，发表在顶级期刊上的主流假设认为成体组织缺乏内源性干细胞，这导致人们相信成熟细胞在慢性损伤后的体内再生过程中会去分化并重编程，并且糖尿病、心力衰竭、癌症和许多其他慢性疾病状态中胚胎/胎儿标志物的出现反映了成熟细胞的去分化。我们认为，目前关于去分化和重编程的主流概念，无论是在体外还是体内，都需要仔细重新评估。成体体细胞可能既不会在体外也不会在体内真正去分化。相反，多个器官中组织驻留的多能性极小胚胎样干细胞（VSELs）解释了观察到的生物学现象。对山中因子的体外“重编程”反应可能反映了VSELs/早期祖细胞的选择性激活和扩增，而不是成熟成体体细胞的去分化/重编程。同样，包括癌症在内的多种疾病状态中报道的胚胎/胎儿样特征反映了未成熟组织特异性祖细胞的扩增，这些祖细胞来源于VSELs，但由于体内微环境受损而无法正常分化。涉及移植MSCs、MUSE细胞或其分泌的外泌体的治疗策略可改善疾病结局，可能是通过恢复受损的微环境，该微环境支持VSELs进行功能性组织修复。尽管目前缺乏直接证据支持这一点，但认识到VSELs/祖细胞及其微环境在维持体内组织稳态中的核心作用，可能解决现有的障碍，并为患病组织和年龄相关功能障碍指导更有效的内源性再生疗法。

abstract: Age-related changes in the immune system result in pronounced vulnerability to acute infections and cancers, and in dysregulated inflammation and wound healing that fuel many chronic diseases. Although we understand much about some of these changes, gaps in mechanistic knowledge remain, in part hindered by a lack of well-validated in vitro models of immune aging. We propose that multidisciplinary approaches, nucleated at the interface of immunology, gerontology and engineering, have the potential to both bring substantial new knowledge, and to usher a new era of precision diagnostics and therapeutics to reprogram and rejuvenate immunity, potentially improving the length and quality of life in older adults. We outline areas to be addressed by this multidisciplinary approach, focusing on the initiation of immune responses. We discuss the potential for new approaches in drug delivery, extracellular matrix and related biomaterials, and in microphysiological and organoid systems, to advance the science of immune aging.
abstractZh: 与年龄相关的免疫系统变化导致对急性感染和癌症的显著易感性，以及失调的炎症和伤口愈合，这些都会助长许多慢性疾病。尽管我们对其中一些变化了解很多，但机制知识方面仍存在空白，部分原因是缺乏经过充分验证的免疫衰老体外模型。我们提出，以免疫学、老年学和工程学交叉为核心的多学科方法，既有潜力带来大量新知识，也有望开启精准诊断和治疗的新时代，以重编程和恢复免疫活力，可能改善老年人的寿命和生活质量。我们概述了这种多学科方法需要解决的问题，重点关注免疫反应的启动。我们讨论了药物递送、细胞外基质及相关生物材料、微生理和类器官系统方面的新方法在推进免疫衰老科学方面的潜力。

abstract:
Background

Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide and is characterized by an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment (TME). While adaptive immunity contributes to tumor control, growing evidence underscores the role of innate lymphocytes, particularly natural killer (NK) cells, in early antitumor surveillance. However, tumor-infiltrating NK cells often exhibit defective maturation and impaired effector functions, whereas the signals regulating NK cell differentiation and activity in CRC remain poorly defined. Interleukin-27 (IL-27) has emerged as a regulator of antitumor immunity, yet its role in modulating NK cell responses in intestinal tumors is largely unexplored.Methods

We employed an orthotopic transplantation model of genetically engineered colorectal tumor organoids Apc-/-KrasG12D/+Trp53R172H/-Smad4-/- (AKPS) to investigate NK cell heterogeneity, maturation, and function during CRC progression. Tumor-infiltrating innate lymphocytes were analyzed using single-cell RNA sequencing, flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, and functional assays. In vitro co-culture systems and in vivo IL-27 blockade were used to assess the impact of tumor-derived IL-27 on NK cell transcriptional programs and effector activity.Results

Single-cell transcriptomic profiling revealed marked heterogeneity among tumor-infiltrating NK cells, identifying subsets with different maturation states and functional capacities. Among innate lymphocytes, AKPS tumors were dominated by NK cells displaying reduced activating receptors and diminished cytotoxic and cytokine-producing potential. Phenotypic and adoptive transfer analyses demonstrated that the TME favors persistence of immature CD27+ NK cell subsets while limiting differentiated NK cells. Mechanistically, tumor-derived IL-27 emerged as a critical regulator sustaining NK cell infiltration and activation; IL-27 blockade reduced NK cell accumulation, interferon-γ production, and immature subset frequency. The clinical relevance of these findings was supported by analysis of human CRC single-cell datasets, which revealed elevated IL-27 signaling in intratumoral NK cells, as well as by the ability of patient-derived organoids to enhance NK-cell cytotoxicity, which was reduced by IL-27 blockade.Conclusions

Our study identifies IL-27 as a critical modulator of NK cell differentiation and function in CRC, highlighting its role in sustaining NK cell-mediated immune surveillance within the tumor microenvironment. These findings provide mechanistic insight into NK cell dysfunction in CRC and suggest IL-27 signaling as a promising therapeutic target to restore innate antitumor immunity.
abstractZh:
背景

结直肠癌（CRC）是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因，其特征是免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境（TME）。虽然适应性免疫有助于肿瘤控制，但越来越多的证据强调了固有淋巴细胞，特别是自然杀伤（NK）细胞，在早期抗肿瘤监视中的作用。然而，肿瘤浸润的NK细胞通常表现出成熟缺陷和效应功能受损，而在CRC中调节NK细胞分化和活性的信号仍不清楚。白细胞介素-27（IL-27）已成为抗肿瘤免疫的调节因子，但其在肠道肿瘤中调节NK细胞反应的作用在很大程度上尚未被探索。方法

我们采用基因工程结直肠肿瘤类器官Apc-/-KrasG12D/+Trp53R172H/-Smad4-/-（AKPS）的原位移植模型来研究CRC进展过程中NK细胞的异质性、成熟和功能。使用单细胞RNA测序、流式细胞术、免疫荧光和功能测定分析肿瘤浸润的固有淋巴细胞。使用体外共培养系统和体内IL-27阻断来评估肿瘤来源的IL-27对NK细胞转录程序和效应活性的影响。结果

单细胞转录组分析揭示了肿瘤浸润NK细胞中显著的异质性，识别出具有不同成熟状态和功能能力的亚群。在固有淋巴细胞中，AKPS肿瘤以NK细胞为主，这些细胞表现出激活受体减少以及细胞毒性和细胞因子产生潜力降低。表型和过继转移分析表明，TME有利于未成熟CD27+ NK细胞亚群的持续存在，同时限制分化的NK细胞。机制上，肿瘤来源的IL-27成为维持NK细胞浸润和激活的关键调节因子；IL-27阻断减少了NK细胞积累、干扰素-γ产生和未成熟亚群频率。这些发现的临床相关性得到了人类CRC单细胞数据集分析的支持，该分析显示肿瘤内NK细胞中IL-27信号升高，以及患者来源的类器官增强NK细胞细胞毒性的能力，而这种能力被IL-27阻断所减弱。结论

我们的研究确定IL-27是CRC中NK细胞分化和功能的关键调节因子，强调其在肿瘤微环境中维持NK细胞介导的免疫监视中的作用。这些发现为CRC中NK细胞功能障碍提供了机制见解，并提示IL-27信号作为恢复固有抗肿瘤免疫的有前景的治疗靶点。

abstract: De novo variants in the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway are linked to autism spectrum disorder (ASD), yet their functional impact on neurodevelopment remains poorly understood. We investigated USP15, a deubiquitinating enzyme with rare damaging variants identified in individuals with ASD, using isogenic human iPSC-derived brain organoids and single-cell transcriptomics. USP15 mutant organoids showed genotype-dependent, progenitor-centered alterations during corticogenesis. Heterozygous organoids modeling haploinsufficiency displayed a shift toward later pseudotime states together with altered maturation and synaptic organization of deep-layer neurons. In contrast, homozygous organoids showed broader phenotypes, including mitotic suppression, aberrant HOX gene expression, and stress-response activation. Regulon analysis showed reduced activity of progenitor-associated regulons, including SOX2, NR2F1, and NR2F2, in heterozygous organoids, whereas homozygous organoids exhibited broader changes in transcriptional regulatory networks. Furthermore, USP15 mutant-associated gene expression patterns were significantly enriched for established ASD risk genes. Comparison with the mouse brain perturbation atlas showed that the transcriptional signature of the USP15 mutant showed notable overlap with those of Fezf2 and Foxp1 mutants, key regulators of deep-layer projection neuron identity. These findings characterize genotype-dependent neurodevelopmental phenotypes associated with reduced USP15 dosage and provide a human neural framework for investigating ASD-relevant developmental mechanisms in the context of a rare ubiquitin-pathway variant.
abstractZh: 泛素-蛋白酶体通路中的新生变异与自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）相关，但其对神经发育的功能影响仍知之甚少。我们利用同基因人类iPSC来源的脑类器官和单细胞转录组学，研究了USP15（一种去泛素化酶，在ASD个体中鉴定出罕见的破坏性变异）。USP15突变类器官在皮质发生过程中表现出基因型依赖的、以祖细胞为中心的改变。模拟单倍剂量不足的杂合类器官显示出向更晚拟时间状态的转变，同时深层神经元成熟和突触组织发生改变。相比之下，纯合类器官表现出更广泛的表型，包括有丝分裂抑制、异常HOX基因表达和应激反应激活。调控子分析显示，杂合类器官中与祖细胞相关的调控子（包括SOX2、NR2F1和NR2F2）活性降低，而纯合类器官在转录调控网络方面表现出更广泛的变化。此外，USP15突变相关的基因表达模式显著富集于已确立的ASD风险基因。与小鼠大脑扰动图谱的比较显示，USP15突变体的转录特征与Fezf2和Foxp1突变体（深层投射神经元身份的关键调控因子）有显著重叠。这些发现表征了与USP15剂量减少相关的基因型依赖的神经发育表型，并为在罕见泛素通路变异背景下研究ASD相关发育机制提供了人类神经框架。

abstract: Neurodegenerative diseases, such as Parkinson's disease (PD) and Alzheimer's disease (AD), globally pose a significant challenge with an aging population. Despite the presence of various therapeutic agents, AD and PD treatments with small molecules currently only address the symptoms; certain biologic agents for AD have been approved for their disease-modifying effects, but the risk of intracerebral hemorrhage severely limits their use. Moreover, the bioavailability of orally administered agents in the brain is challenged by the blood-brain barrier, complicating brain-targeted drug development. Extensive efforts are currently underway to develop intranasal platforms with nanoparticles for direct nose-to-brain drug delivery. Additionally, various in vitro designs involving brain organoids, and in vivo models, such as rodents and zebrafish, have been explored to improve the efficiency and accuracy of preclinical models. Efforts to develop sophisticated computational modeling of intranasal drug delivery, including computational fluid dynamics (CFD) deposition and physiologically based pharmacokinetics (PBPK) modeling, also continue to advance the intranasal drug delivery research and potentially improve the feasibility of developing clinically relevant intranasal platforms for neurodegenerative disease.
abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病，如帕金森病（PD）和阿尔茨海默病（AD），随着人口老龄化在全球范围内构成重大挑战。尽管存在多种治疗药物，目前针对AD和PD的小分子治疗仅能缓解症状；某些用于AD的生物制剂已被批准用于其疾病修饰作用，但脑出血的风险严重限制了其使用。此外，口服药物在脑内的生物利用度受到血脑屏障的挑战，使脑靶向药物开发复杂化。目前正在进行广泛努力，开发含有纳米颗粒的鼻内平台，用于直接的鼻-脑药物递送。此外，各种涉及脑类器官的体外设计，以及体内模型，如啮齿动物和斑马鱼，已被探索以提高临床前模型的效率和准确性。开发复杂的鼻内药物递送计算模型的努力，包括计算流体动力学（CFD）沉积和基于生理的药代动力学（PBPK）建模，也在不断推进鼻内药物递送研究，并可能提高开发临床相关鼻内平台用于神经退行性疾病的可行性。

abstract: Drug repurposing offers a faster and less costly route to therapeutic development, yet its translational success remains constrained by a critical scientific and evidentiary gap: the absence of human-relevant intermediate validation systems capable of converting computationally generated candidates into biologically grounded, clinically actionable evidence. In this opinion paper, we propose that human organoid platforms-particularly when integrated with artificial intelligence (AI)-driven candidate prioritisation upstream and multidimensional data analytics downstream-can function as context-specific, fit-for-purpose functional decision layers within repurposing pipelines-decision-grade within a defined context of use rather than possessing it as a generalisable property of the platform. We outline a hybrid framework coupling in silico discovery, organoid-based functional validation, and AI-enabled response interpretation, and we propose the disease categories in which this approach is most immediately applicable. We further discuss current operational challenges alongside their enabling solutions, and contextualise the framework within the evolving regulatory landscapes of the FDA and EMA as both agencies advance the integration of New Approach Methodologies (NAMs).
abstractZh: 药物再利用提供了一条更快、成本更低的治疗开发途径，然而其转化成功仍受到一个关键的科学和证据鸿沟的制约：缺乏与人类相关的中间验证系统，能够将计算生成的候选药物转化为具有生物学基础、临床可操作的证据。在这篇观点文章中，我们提出人类类器官平台——特别是与人工智能（AI）驱动的上游候选药物优先排序和下游多维数据分析相结合时——可以在再利用流程中充当情境特异性、适合特定用途的功能性决策层——在明确的使用情境中达到决策级水平，而非作为平台的普遍属性。我们概述了一个混合框架，将计算机模拟发现、类器官功能验证和AI驱动的反应解读相结合，并提出了该方法最直接适用的疾病类别。我们进一步讨论了当前的运营挑战及其相应的解决方案，并将该框架置于FDA和EMA不断演进的监管环境中，因为这两个机构都在推进新方法学（NAMs）的整合。

title: A xeno-free human iPSC-derived prostate organoid platform for multilineage differentiation and genetic manipulation.

abstract: Current prostate organoid models rely on tissue-derived material or animal components and lack epithelial and stromal complexity. We defined a xeno-free system to generate human prostate organoids from induced pluripotent stem cells with consistent multilineage differentiation. Organoids formed as free-floating 3D aggregates self-organized into the epithelial and stromal domains with basal, luminal, neuroendocrine, fibroblast, and smooth muscle markers. In an alternative modular co-culture system, engineered epithelial progenitors aggregated with wild-type mesenchymal progenitors, enabling compartment-specific manipulation. Androgen receptor (AR)-overexpressing organoids showed increased epithelial AR and prostate-specific antigen (PSA) expression and proliferation. Single-cell transcriptomics, together with qPCR and immunostaining, confirmed prostate lineage specification and tissue organization. This xeno-free platform provides a reproducible, scalable, and genetically tractable model to study in vitro prostate lineage programs, epithelial and stromal interactions, and disease biology.
abstractZh: 当前的前列腺类器官模型依赖于组织来源的材料或动物成分，并且缺乏上皮和基质的复杂性。我们定义了一种无异源成分的系统，从诱导多能干细胞生成人前列腺类器官，具有一致的多谱系分化。类器官以自由漂浮的3D聚集体形式形成，自组织成上皮和基质区域，具有基底细胞、腔上皮细胞、神经内分泌细胞、成纤维细胞和平滑肌标志物。在另一种模块化共培养系统中，工程化的上皮祖细胞与野生型间充质祖细胞聚集，实现了区室特异性操作。雄激素受体（AR）过表达的类器官显示出上皮AR和前列腺特异性抗原（PSA）表达增加以及增殖增加。单细胞转录组学，连同qPCR和免疫染色，证实了前列腺谱系特化和组织组织。这种无异源成分的平台提供了一种可重复、可扩展且遗传可操作的模型，用于研究体外前列腺谱系程序、上皮和基质相互作用以及疾病生物学。

title: Integrated Radioproteomic Modeling for Early Recurrence Prediction and Metabolic Characterization in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
titleZh: 整合放射蛋白质组学模型用于肝细胞癌早期复发预测及代谢特征分析。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Zhuang Q, Xu T, Xing X, Hu E, Zhou Y, Zheng X, Bai L, Huang Y, Liu X, Chen Y.
affiliations: The United Innovation of Mengchao Hepatobiliary Technology Key Laboratory of Fujian Province, Mengchao Hepatobiliary Hospital of Fujian Medical University, Fuzhou, China.

abstract:
Purpose

Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, with high recurrence rates after surgical resection posing a significant challenge. While deep learning (DL) approaches show promise in predicting HCC recurrence, their clinical translation is limited by poor interpretability and unclear mechanisms. Our study aimed to develop an interpretable DL framework that predicts recurrence while elucidating underlying biology through integration of radiologic imaging and multiomics profiling.Materials and methods

We developed a DL framework to predict early postoperative HCC recurrence using preoperative multiphase computed tomography imaging and generate an imaging-based early recurrence risk score (ERRS) for risk stratification. To decipher the biological basis of ERRS, we integrated DL features with proteomic data to identify key metabolic alterations, which were validated by metabolomics, immunohistochemistry, and enzymatic assays. Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) were used to assess the therapeutic potential of targeting these alterations.Results

The Multi-model_NC&ART&PV DL model showed improved performance compared with conventional single-phase models in predicting early postoperative recurrence, with high-ERRS patients exhibiting worse survival and more aggressive features. Mechanistically, radioproteomic analyses linked model predictions to dysregulated pyruvate metabolism, characterized by reduced pyruvate dehydrogenase complex expression/activity and elevated lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) activity. PDOs from patients with HCC were sensitive to LDH inhibitor stiripentol, with high-ERRS tumors showing greater therapeutic vulnerability than low-ERRS tumors.Conclusion

This study bridges artificial intelligence-driven imaging and mechanism-guided therapy by developing a biologically interpretable DL model for HCC recurrence prediction. Radioproteomic integration identified dysregulated pyruvate metabolism as a hallmark of high-risk HCC, enabling the repurposing of stiripentol as a potential therapy. This framework suggests a potential strategy linking noninvasive risk stratification with pathway-guided treatment although further validation and prospective studies are needed to establish its clinical utility.
abstractZh:
目的

肝细胞癌（HCC）是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，手术切除后高复发率构成重大挑战。虽然深度学习（DL）方法在预测HCC复发方面显示出潜力，但其临床转化受限于可解释性差和机制不明确。本研究旨在开发一个可解释的DL框架，通过整合放射影像和多组学分析，在预测复发的同时阐明潜在生物学机制。

材料与方法

我们开发了一个DL框架，利用术前多期计算机断层扫描成像预测HCC术后早期复发，并生成基于影像的早期复发风险评分（ERRS）用于风险分层。为解析ERRS的生物学基础，我们将DL特征与蛋白质组学数据整合，以识别关键代谢改变，并通过代谢组学、免疫组织化学和酶学测定进行验证。使用患者来源类器官（PDOs）评估靶向这些改变的潜在治疗价值。

结果

Multi-model_NC&ART&PV DL模型在预测术后早期复发方面较传统单期模型表现出更优性能，高ERRS患者表现出更差的生存和更具侵袭性的特征。机制上，放射蛋白质组学分析将模型预测与丙酮酸代谢失调联系起来，其特征为丙酮酸脱氢酶复合物表达/活性降低和乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）活性升高。来自HCC患者的PDOs对LDH抑制剂司替戊醇敏感，高ERRS肿瘤比低ERRS肿瘤表现出更大的治疗脆弱性。

结论

本研究通过开发一个生物学可解释的DL模型用于HCC复发预测，弥合了人工智能驱动的影像学与机制引导治疗之间的鸿沟。放射蛋白质组学整合将丙酮酸代谢失调确定为高风险HCC的标志，使得司替戊醇作为潜在治疗药物得以再利用。该框架提出了一种将无创风险分层与通路引导治疗联系起来的潜在策略，尽管仍需进一步验证和前瞻性研究以确立其临床实用性。

title: CD36 is a receptor for human sapovirus.
titleZh: CD36是人类札幌病毒的受体。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Haga K, Arai M, Takai-Todaka R, Fukuda Y, Ishiyama R, Katayama K.

abstract: Human sapovirus (HuSaV) is a major cause of gastroenteritis but has long lacked a defined receptor. Here, we identify the scavenger receptor CD36 as essential for infection. Comparative transcriptomics identified CD36 as the key susceptibility factor. CRISPR knockout abolished replication, while ectopic expression restored permissiveness across diverse cells. Binding assays showed nanomolar affinity between CD36 and HuSaV particles. Infection also required the bile acid glycocholic acid, which promoted CD36 internalization and viral entry. In human intestinal organoids, CD36 knockout abrogated infection, confirming physiological relevance. Our findings establish CD36 as the long-sought HuSaV receptor, uncover a bile acid-assisted entry mechanism that confines infection to the intestine and point to opportunities for antiviral and vaccine development.
abstractZh: 人类札幌病毒（HuSaV）是胃肠炎的主要原因，但长期以来缺乏明确的受体。在此，我们确定清道夫受体CD36对感染至关重要。比较转录组学将CD36确定为关键易感因素。CRISPR敲除 abolished 复制，而异位表达在不同细胞中恢复了允许性。结合实验显示CD36与HuSaV颗粒之间具有纳摩尔级亲和力。感染还需要胆汁酸甘氨胆酸，它促进了CD36的内化和病毒进入。在人类肠道类器官中，CD36敲除消除了感染，证实了其生理相关性。我们的发现确立了CD36作为长期寻找的HuSaV受体，揭示了一种胆汁酸辅助的进入机制，该机制将感染限制在肠道内，并为抗病毒和疫苗开发提供了机会。

title: Targeting Tex10 Overcomes Oxaliplatin Resistance by Competitively Disrupting the Non-Canonical BAF Complex in Colorectal Cancer.
titleZh: 靶向Tex10通过竞争性破坏结直肠癌中的非经典BAF复合物克服奥沙利铂耐药性
