abstract:
Background & aims

Intestinal barriers limiting gut-to-liver translocation of bacteria/l products are disrupted in cirrhosis. Cirrhosis is characterised by sustained β-adrenergic overactivity, which may contribute to barrier dysfunction but, its impact on the gut-liver-axis remains unclear. We investigated whether β-adrenergic signalling drives barrier disruption in experimental cirrhosis being amenable for treatment by non-selective beta blockers such as propranolol.Methods

Cirrhosis was induced in rats (CCl4, BDL) and mice (BDL), followed by propranolol or vehicle treatment. Chronic β-adrenergic stimulation was modelled by isoproterenol in mice, and VE-cadherin gain-of-function mice were used for mechanistic experiments. Barrier integrity and bacterial translocation were assessed by gut-to-liver FITC-dextran translocation, FITC-albumin endomicroscopy, hepatic 16S rDNA, faecal albumin, junctional immunofluorescence. Ileal transcriptomics, microbiota profiling, primary intestinal endothelial cells and human ileal organoids were used.Results

Propranolol reduced hepatic 16S rDNA load and gut-to-liver translocation of FITC-dextran but not viable bacteria in both cirrhosis models. It restored muco-epithelial integrity, increasing mucus thickness, goblet cell number and epithelial tight junction proteins. Propranolol improved gut-vascular barrier dysfunction, reducing PV1 expression and normalising pathological FITC-albumin extravasation in BDL mice, with model-dependent modulation of VE-cadherin and claudin-5. Without liver injury, isoproterenol recapitulated intestinal barrier disruption and gut-to-liver translocation in absence of microbiota changes but being attenuated by propranolol. VE-cadherin GOF mice were protected from β-adrenergic-induced barrier disruption and showed reduced gut-to-liver translocation after BDL. Ileal transcriptomic alterations were partially reversed in pathways related to barrier function, inflammation and adrenergic signalling.Conclusions

Sustained β-adrenergic hyperstimulation disrupts the multi-layer intestinal barrier, promoting pathological bacterial translocation in cirrhosis. Propranolol restores barrier integrity through mechanisms involving endothelial VE-cadherin stabilisation, at least partly independent of microbiota changes and haemodynamic effects.
abstractZh:
背景与目的

限制细菌/产物从肠道向肝脏易位的肠道屏障在肝硬化中被破坏。肝硬化以持续的β-肾上腺素能过度活跃为特征，这可能促进屏障功能障碍，但其对肠-肝轴的影响仍不清楚。我们研究了β-肾上腺素能信号是否在实验性肝硬化中驱动屏障破坏，并可通过非选择性β受体阻滞剂如普萘洛尔进行治疗。方法

在大鼠（CCl4、BDL）和小鼠（BDL）中诱导肝硬化，随后给予普萘洛尔或赋形剂治疗。通过小鼠中的异丙肾上腺素模拟慢性β-肾上腺素能刺激，并使用VE-钙黏蛋白功能获得性小鼠进行机制实验。通过肠道到肝脏的FITC-葡聚糖易位、FITC-白蛋白内镜显微镜、肝脏16S rDNA、粪便白蛋白、连接蛋白免疫荧光评估屏障完整性和细菌易位。使用回肠转录组学、微生物群分析、原代肠道内皮细胞和人回肠类器官。结果

在两种肝硬化模型中，普萘洛尔减少了肝脏16S rDNA载量和FITC-葡聚糖的肠道到肝脏易位，但不减少活细菌。它恢复了黏膜上皮完整性，增加了黏液厚度、杯状细胞数量和上皮紧密连接蛋白。普萘洛尔改善了肠道血管屏障功能障碍，在BDL小鼠中降低了PV1表达并使病理性FITC-白蛋白外渗正常化，且VE-钙黏蛋白和claudin-5的调节具有模型依赖性。在没有肝损伤的情况下，异丙肾上腺素在无微生物群变化的情况下重现了肠道屏障破坏和肠道到肝脏易位，但被普萘洛尔减弱。VE-钙黏蛋白功能获得性小鼠免受β-肾上腺素能诱导的屏障破坏，并在BDL后表现出减少的肠道到肝脏易位。回肠转录组改变在与屏障功能、炎症和肾上腺素能信号相关的通路中部分逆转。结论

持续的β-肾上腺素能过度刺激破坏多层肠道屏障，促进肝硬化中的病理性细菌易位。普萘洛尔通过涉及内皮VE-钙黏蛋白稳定的机制恢复屏障完整性，至少部分独立于微生物群变化和血流动力学效应。

title: Cardiopedia-Ligand: A ligand-receptor perturbation atlas of human cardiac organoid function and transcriptional state.
titleZh: Cardiopedia-Ligand：人类心脏类器官功能与转录状态的配体-受体扰动图谱。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Reid JD, Foster SR, Lor M, Hauser AS, Griffen B, Fitzsimmons RL, Hudson JE.
affiliations: QIMR Berghofer, Brisbane, QLD, Australia; School of Biomedical Sciences, The University of Queensland, St Lucia, Brisbane, QLD, Australia.

QIMR Berghofer, Brisbane, QLD, Australia; School of Biomedical Sciences, The University of Queensland, St Lucia, Brisbane, QLD, Australia; Department of Pharmacology, Monash University, Melbourne, VIC, Australia.
QIMR Berghofer, Brisbane, QLD, Australia.
Department of Drug Design and Pharmacology, Center for Pharmaceutical Data Science Education, University of Copenhagen, Copenhagen, Denmark.
Dynomics Pty Ltd, Brisbane, QLD, Australia.
QIMR Berghofer, Brisbane, QLD, Australia; School of Biomedical Sciences, The University of Queensland, St Lucia, Brisbane, QLD, Australia. Electronic address: james.hudson@qimrb.edu.au.
abstract: Large-scale perturbation atlases have transformed systems biology, yet no equivalent resource exists for the human heart, where contractile function and transcriptomic state must be measured together. Here, we establish Cardiopedia-Ligand, a comprehensive perturbation-function-transcriptome atlas generated by stimulating human cardiac organoids (hCOs) with 87 ligands targeting 98 cell-membrane receptors expressed in the human heart. We developed an automated high-throughput pipeline enabling individualized contractility measurements and single-organoid mRNA sequencing. We use this pipeline to define both recognized and previously unrecognized functional and transcriptional clusters, including inotropes, endothelin peptides, extracellular matrix regulators, and multiple inflammatory clusters. Clustering analysis, machine learning, and the "fingerprinting" of human heart failure biopsies revealed previously underappreciated similarities between ligands and an interferon-γ signaling signature driving heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). Together, this comprehensive Cardiopedia-Ligand dataset provides a valuable and accessible resource for interrogating cardiac biology and human disease.
abstractZh: 大规模扰动图谱已改变了系统生物学，但人类心脏尚无同等资源，而心脏的收缩功能与转录组状态必须同时测量。在此，我们建立了Cardiopedia-Ligand，这是一个全面的扰动-功能-转录组图谱，通过用87种靶向人类心脏中表达的98种细胞膜受体的配体刺激人类心脏类器官（hCOs）而生成。我们开发了一种自动化高通量流程，能够实现个体化收缩力测量和单类器官mRNA测序。我们利用该流程定义了已知和先前未识别的功能与转录聚类，包括正性肌力药物、内皮素肽、细胞外基质调节因子以及多个炎症聚类。聚类分析、机器学习以及对人类心力衰竭活检组织的“指纹识别”揭示了配体之间先前未被充分认识的相似性，以及一种驱动射血分数保留型心力衰竭（HFpEF）的干扰素-γ信号特征。总之，这一全面的Cardiopedia-Ligand数据集为探究心脏生物学和人类疾病提供了宝贵且可访问的资源。

title: Lung cancer stem cells in the tumor microenvironment: translational biomarkers and therapeutic strategies for immune evasion and treatment resistance.
titleZh: 肿瘤微环境中的肺癌干细胞：免疫逃逸和治疗抵抗的转化生物标志物与治疗策略。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Shao LL, Shao JJ, Zhao TY, Cai ED, Wang Y, Lu RJ, Chen SH.
affiliations: Department of Oncology, Affiliated Tumor Hospital of Nantong University & Nantong Tumor Hospital, Nantong, China.
Department of Oncology, Affiliated Tumor Hospital of Nantong University & Nantong Tumor Hospital, Nantong, China. Electronic address: 17805050201@163.com.
Department of Cardiothoracic Surgery, Nantong Third People's Hospital, Affiliated Nantong Hospital 3 of Nantong University, Nantong, China. Electronic address: lurujian168@sina.com.
Department of Oncology, Affiliated Tumor Hospital of Nantong University & Nantong Tumor Hospital, Nantong, China. Electronic address: jsshcjl@ntu.edu.cn.
abstract: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide. Although immune checkpoint inhibitors and targeted therapies have improved outcomes, durable benefit is restricted by primary resistance, acquired resistance, minimal residual disease, and relapse. Lung cancer stem cells (LCSCs) represent a plastic, therapy-resistant tumor subpopulation with self-renewal capacity, lineage adaptability, and marked interactions with the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME). In this review, we frame LCSCs and the TIME as a reciprocal regulatory network rather than as independent biological compartments. TIME components, including tumor-associated macrophages, myeloid-derived suppressor cells, regulatory T cells, cancer-associated fibroblasts, hypoxia, and extracellular matrix remodeling, sustain LCSC stemness through paracrine signaling, niche formation, metabolic adaptation, and epigenetic regulation. Conversely, LCSCs remodel the immune ecosystem through PD-L1, B7-H3, CD47, CXCL12/CXCR4, CCL2, IL-6/STAT3, TGF-β, extracellular vesicles, and impaired antigen presentation. This self-reinforcing network promotes immune evasion, suppressive immune-cell recruitment, treatment failure, and recurrence. We further classify LCSC-related markers according to translational use, including identification markers, prognostic markers, immunotherapy-response markers, monitoring biomarkers, and therapeutic targets, while indicating whether available evidence is mainly derived from non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), small cell lung cancer (SCLC), or both. Finally, we distinguish clinically established immunotherapeutic strategies from investigational LCSC-directed approaches and discuss how single-cell sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, organoids, patient-derived xenografts, and liquid biopsy may support biomarker validation and rational combination therapy.
abstractZh: 肺癌仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。尽管免疫检查点抑制剂和靶向治疗改善了预后，但原发性耐药、获得性耐药、微小残留病灶和复发限制了持久获益。肺癌干细胞（LCSCs）代表了一种可塑的、治疗抵抗的肿瘤亚群，具有自我更新能力、谱系适应性和与肿瘤免疫微环境（TIME）的显著相互作用。在本综述中，我们将LCSCs和TIME视为一个相互调节的网络，而非独立的生物学隔室。TIME组分，包括肿瘤相关巨噬细胞、髓源性抑制细胞、调节性T细胞、癌症相关成纤维细胞、缺氧和细胞外基质重塑，通过旁分泌信号、生态位形成、代谢适应和表观遗传调控维持LCSC干性。相反，LCSCs通过PD-L1、B7-H3、CD47、CXCL12/CXCR4、CCL2、IL-6/STAT3、TGF-β、细胞外囊泡和抗原呈递受损来重塑免疫生态系统。这种自我强化的网络促进免疫逃逸、抑制性免疫细胞募集、治疗失败和复发。我们进一步根据转化用途对LCSC相关标志物进行分类，包括鉴定标志物、预后标志物、免疫治疗反应标志物、监测生物标志物和治疗靶点，同时指明现有证据主要来源于非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）、小细胞肺癌（SCLC）或两者兼有。最后，我们区分了临床已确立的免疫治疗策略与实验性的LCSC定向方法，并讨论了单细胞测序、空间转录组学、类器官、患者来源异种移植和液体活检如何支持生物标志物验证和合理的联合治疗。

title: Doxycycline Modulates Uveal-Melanoma-Associated Marker Expression in BAP1-Repressed Human Ocular Organoids
titleZh: 多西环素调节BAP1抑制的人眼类器官中葡萄膜黑色素瘤相关标志物的表达
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Chiu EA, Blenkinsop TA.
abstract: Uveal Melanoma (UM) is the most common eye cancer, with a metastatic mortality rate of 80%. Only 1-3% of patients have detectable UM at metastasis, and UM exhibits punctuated early growth. Doxycycline has recently been shown to inhibit metabolic processes exploited by cancer cells and reduce cancer cell growth in models of liver cancer. We hypothesized doxycycline may also be effective in UM and therefore tested doxycycline treatment in an eye organoid model of uveal melanoma. Using a stem cell line whereby BAP1 can be knocked down with a tetracycline-inducible system, we differentiated this line into a whole eye organoid model termed self-formed ectodermal autonomous multi-zone of ocular cells (SEAM). We found an enhanced proliferation in neural crest cells within the SEAM colonies. To identify the neural crest cells, we conducted single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis utilizing the Seurat R toolkit to pinpoint genes within neural crest clusters. To confirm the results of the  in silico scRNA-seq analysis, genes with notable functions and differential expression in the neural crest cluster in relation to UM proliferation, angiogenesis, and oxidative phosphorylation were analyzed through immunofluorescence and RT-qPCR. Based on the scRNA-seq analysis, immunofluorescence, and RT-qPCR, the novel BAP1 KD (UM phenotype) model was found to replicate UM-relevant gene and protein expressions effectively, so the BAP1 KD (UM phenotype) was then treated with doxycycline to evaluate its effect on UM metastasis. Subsequent analysis found that doxycycline significantly inhibited UM growth, angiogenesis, and oxidative phosphorylation in the BAP1 KD (UM phenotype) model more than that of the control model, perhaps due to doxycycline targeting higher regions with more mitochondrial activity, indicating doxycycline’s therapeutic potential in treating UM.
abstractZh: 葡萄膜黑色素瘤（UM）是最常见的眼癌，转移死亡率达80%。仅1-3%的患者在转移时可检测到UM，且UM表现出早期爆发性生长。最近研究表明，多西环素可抑制癌细胞利用的代谢过程，并在肝癌模型中减少癌细胞生长。我们假设多西环素可能对UM也有效，因此在葡萄膜黑色素瘤的眼类器官模型中测试了多西环素治疗。使用一种可通过四环素诱导系统敲低BAP1的干细胞系，我们将该细胞系分化为全眼类器官模型，称为自形成外胚层自主多区眼细胞（SEAM）。我们发现SEAM集落内神经嵴细胞的增殖增强。为识别神经嵴细胞，我们利用Seurat R工具包进行了单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）分析，以定位神经嵴簇内的基因。为确认计算机模拟scRNA-seq分析的结果，通过免疫荧光和RT-qPCR分析了神经嵴簇中与UM增殖、血管生成和氧化磷酸化相关的具有显著功能和差异表达的基因。基于scRNA-seq分析、免疫荧光和RT-qPCR，新型BAP1敲低（UM表型）模型被发现能有效复制UM相关的基因和蛋白质表达，因此随后用多西环素处理BAP1敲低（UM表型）模型以评估其对UM转移的影响。后续分析发现，多西环素在BAP1敲低（UM表型）模型中显著抑制UM生长、血管生成和氧化磷酸化，效果优于对照模型，这可能是因为多西环素靶向线粒体活性更高的区域，表明多西环素在治疗UM方面的治疗潜力。

title: Co-optation of the regenerative role of type 2 alveolar cells in distal lung repair in mice by terminal airway epithelial cells in humans
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Torres JA, Schönweiler E, Thimraj TA, Liu H, Springer AD, Murray JW, Saqi A, Snoeck H.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  The lung is endowed with extensive regenerative capacity. The principal cell of the lung is the type 1 alveolar epithelial (AT1) cell, which mediates gas exchange. Mouse models implicated surfactant-producing type 2 alveolar epithelial (AT2) cells as facultative stem cells that regenerate AT1 cells after injury through a transitional KRT8  + intermediate. Larger mammals, however, possess terminal and respiratory bronchioles that are lined by alveoli and by epithelial cells that are absent in mice. Here we show, using human pluripotent stem cell-derived lung organoids and comparative computational analysis, a prime role for terminal and respiratory bronchiole cells in AT1 regeneration without AT2 intermediate. Furthermore, cells similar to aberrant basaloid cells, profibrotic elements that accumulate in pulmonary fibrosis, are physiological intermediates in a more rapidly committing trajectory from terminal and respiratory bronchioles to AT1 cells marked by expression of KRT17, are regulated by Hippo and TGFβ signaling, and are transcriptionally distinct from mouse AT2-derived KRT8  + transitional cells. Our findings indicate that terminal and respiratory bronchioles in humans have to a large extent co-opted the regenerative and pathogenic functions of AT2 cells in mice. Efforts to enhance or correct human lung regeneration should therefore focus on facultative airway-derived alveolar progenitors using human models.

title: scINTILLA: Single-Cell Integrated Inference, Labelling, and Landscape Analysis for Cell-Type Annotation Quality Assessment
titleZh: scINTILLA：用于细胞类型注释质量评估的单细胞整合推断、标记和景观分析
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Kanannejad S, Bongiorni N, Nordera E, Redaelli S, Rusconi I, Zanin R, Giustacchini A, Chatterjee S.
abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing has enabled the construction of comprehensive cell atlases, yet the quality and coherence of the cell-type annotations within these atlases remain largely unexamined. When a label is applied to a transcriptionally heterogeneous population, the downstream analyses that depend on it, and automated label transfer in particular, become unreliable. We present scINTILLA (Single-Cell Integrated Inference, Labelling, and Landscape Analysis), a computational framework that combines supervised and unsupervised machine learning to score the learnability and internal consistency of cell-type labels in single-cell datasets. The unsupervised arm benchmarks a broad panel of clustering algorithms and derives a neighbourhood confusion score for every cell, whilst the supervised arm trains up to twelve classifiers and extracts prediction agreement, entropy, and confidence. These signals are normalised and aggregated into a single composite score per cell type, where a low score flags label ambiguity or concealed heterogeneity. As a by-product, scIN-TILLA also reports which clustering and classification algorithms perform best on a given dataset, offering practical guidance for downstream label transfer. We applied it to five Human Cell Atlas datasets spanning the adult brain, lung, eye, and two organoid atlases, and recovered clear differences in the learnability and internal consistency of annotations across atlases that were not driven by the number of annotated cell types. Focused re-analysis of lowscoring populations in the lung and endoderm-organoid atlases resolved biologically coherent sub-populations, in some cases with context-specific enrichment, much of it recovered from cells that had been assigned broad or catch-all labels. scINTILLA is advisory rather than prescriptive, guiding principled, data-driven re-annotation at atlas scale.
abstractZh: 单细胞RNA测序已能够构建全面的细胞图谱，然而这些图谱中细胞类型注释的质量和一致性在很大程度上仍未得到检验。当标签被应用于转录异质性群体时，依赖该标签的下游分析，尤其是自动化标签转移，将变得不可靠。我们提出了scINTILLA（单细胞整合推断、标记和景观分析），这是一个结合监督和无监督机器学习的计算框架，用于对单细胞数据集中细胞类型标签的可学习性和内部一致性进行评分。无监督部分对广泛的聚类算法进行基准测试，并为每个细胞推导出邻域混淆分数，而有监督部分则训练多达十二个分类器，并提取预测一致性、熵和置信度。这些信号被归一化并聚合为每个细胞类型的单一复合分数，其中低分数表示标签模糊或隐藏的异质性。作为副产品，scINTILLA还报告了在给定数据集上表现最佳的聚类和分类算法，为下游标签转移提供实用指导。我们将其应用于五个人类细胞图谱数据集，涵盖成人大脑、肺、眼睛以及两个类器官图谱，并发现了不同图谱间注释的可学习性和内部一致性的明显差异，这些差异并非由注释细胞类型的数量驱动。对肺和内皮层类器官图谱中低分数群体的重点重新分析解析出了生物学上连贯的亚群，在某些情况下具有上下文特异性富集，其中大部分是从被分配了宽泛或包罗万象标签的细胞中恢复的。scINTILLA是建议性的而非规定性的，指导在图谱规模上进行有原则的、数据驱动的重新注释。

title: Comparative primate transcriptomics identifies a ZNF90–OVOL2 regulatory axis shaping human neural progenitor cell dynamics
titleZh: 比较灵长类转录组学鉴定出调控人类神经祖细胞动态的ZNF90–OVOL2调控轴
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Bastidas-Betancourt CM, Negretti-Ingravallo MI, Göloğlu İB, Begenova D, Puig-Segui MS, Costa AM, Reshetar M, Heide S, Ivanov MN, Veleva LV, Kachovski TE, Kovachev EG, Tonchev AB, Heide M.
abstract:
Summary

  Understanding the behavior of human neural progenitor cells (NPCs) requires comparative characterization of their transcriptomic landscape, particularly through comparisons with closely related primate species. The rhesus macaque represents a key non-hominoid outgroup for such analyses, and several representative transcriptomic datasets are now available. Here, we compare genes enriched in human NPCs with those enriched in rhesus macaque NPCs and found that human NPC-enriched genes are associated with gene programs supporting radial glial identity and proliferative capacity, as well as functions related to sister chromatid segregation. This analysis identified two zinc-finger transcription factors for functional investigation: the ape-specific ZNF90 and the highly conserved OVOL2. By analysing their genome-wide binding, transcriptional output, and cellular effects in cerebral organoids, we uncovered a previously uncharacterized regulatory axis with divergent but partially overlapping effects that converge on apical progenitor (AP) maintenance. Together, our findings support a model in which lineage-specific / evolutionarily young transcription factor become integrated into a conserved developmental gene regulatory network, generating novel NPC dynamics during primate corticogenesis.
abstractZh:
摘要

  理解人类神经祖细胞（NPCs）的行为需要对其转录组景观进行比较性表征，特别是通过与近缘灵长类物种的比较。恒河猴是此类分析中一个关键的非人猿类外群，目前已有多个代表性的转录组数据集可用。在此，我们比较了人类NPC中富集的基因与恒河猴NPC中富集的基因，发现人类NPC富集基因与支持放射状胶质细胞身份和增殖能力的基因程序以及姐妹染色单体分离相关功能有关。该分析确定了两个锌指转录因子用于功能研究：猿类特异性的ZNF90和高度保守的OVOL2。通过分析它们在脑类器官中的全基因组结合、转录输出和细胞效应，我们揭示了一个先前未表征的调控轴，其效应具有分歧但部分重叠，并汇聚于顶端祖细胞（AP）的维持。总之，我们的发现支持一个模型，即谱系特异性/进化上年轻的转录因子被整合到保守的发育基因调控网络中，在灵长类皮层生成过程中产生新的NPC动态。

title: Live single-molecule imaging reveals global shifts in mRNA mobility during human stem cell differentiation
titleZh: 活细胞单分子成像揭示人类干细胞分化过程中mRNA流动性的全局变化
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Bamford A, Gut G, Buchholz T, Okamoto R, Seimiya M, Santel M, Treutlein B, Voigt F.
abstract: Spatiotemporal regulation of mRNA localisation is fundamental to cell identity specification and function, yet tracking transcript dynamics in living differentiating cells remains technically challenging. Here, we establish a robust pipeline for MS2 tagging of endogenous transcripts in human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), coupled with single-particle tracking and Hidden Markov Modelling to map mRNA mobility landscapes during differentiation and cell state transitions. Applying this approach to different cytoskeleton-encoding transcripts in diverse contexts — neural organoids, directly programmed neurons, and vascular organoids — we reveal a conserved principle: Both,  β -actin and  β 2b-tubulin particle dynamics progressively shift towards constrained, compartmentalised patterns as cells acquire cell type identity. Perturbation experiments demonstrate that microtubule-dependent tethering is a common, conserved mechanism controlling  β -actin mRNA localisation in all cell types studied, whereas translation-dependent anchoring and actin filaments contribute in a context-dependent manner. Analysis of particle dynamics in migrating blood vessel progenitors further showed that  β -actin mRNAs accumulating at cell edges are highly diffusive, while those in perinuclear regions show constrained movement. Together, our integrated framework provides a scalable foundation for mechanistic dissection of mRNA targeting in human developmental and disease models.
abstractZh: mRNA定位的时空调控对于细胞身份特化和功能至关重要，然而在活体分化细胞中追踪转录本动态仍具有技术挑战性。在此，我们建立了一个稳健的流程，用于在人类诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）中对内源转录本进行MS2标记，并结合单粒子追踪和隐马尔可夫模型，绘制分化及细胞状态转变过程中的mRNA流动性图谱。将该方法应用于不同情境下的多种细胞骨架编码转录本——神经类器官、直接编程的神经元和血管类器官——我们揭示了一个保守的原则：随着细胞获得细胞类型身份，β-肌动蛋白和β2b-微管蛋白的粒子动力学逐渐转向受限的、区室化的模式。扰动实验表明，微管依赖性锚定是所研究的所有细胞类型中控制β-肌动蛋白mRNA定位的常见且保守的机制，而翻译依赖性锚定和肌动蛋白丝则以情境依赖的方式发挥作用。对迁移血管祖细胞中粒子动力学的分析进一步表明，积累在细胞边缘的β-肌动蛋白mRNA具有高度扩散性，而核周区域的mRNA则表现出受限运动。总之，我们的整合框架为在人类发育和疾病模型中机制性解析mRNA靶向提供了可扩展的基础。

abstract: Resistance to endocrine therapy (ET) is common in estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. Multiple studies have demonstrated that upregulation of MAPK signaling pathways contributes to ET resistance. Herein we show that vandetanib treatment suppresses MAPK signaling and enhances sensitivity to ET across ET-sensitive and ET-resistant ER+ cell lines and patient derived organoids. Vandetanib treatment reprograms transcription toward a less proliferative, more estrogen responsive, Luminal-A like state by enriching ERα chromatin binding at canonical estrogen response elements. Multiplexed kinase inhibitor beads-mass spectrometry (MIB/MS) revealed kinase network reprogramming, including upregulation of PI3K and HER2 activity, as shared adaptive resistance mechanisms to vandetanib treatment. Co-treatment with the HER2 inhibitor lapatinib, further enhanced sensitivity to vandetanib. Using an operating room-to-laboratory short-term ex-vivo assay coupled to single-cell RNA sequencing, we demonstrate conserved gene expression changes in primary tumor cells, including increased HER2 activity signatures, following vandetanib treatment. Vandetanib sensitivity signatures were generated from cell line and primary human tumor cells which correlate with vandetanib sensitivity in ER+ patient-derived organoid and xenograft models. Future studies should evaluate if signatures predict responses in patients with ER+ breast tumors, and determine the role of co-targeting HER2 signaling with vandetanib therapy.
abstractZh: 内分泌治疗（ET）耐药在雌激素受体阳性（ER+）乳腺癌中很常见。多项研究表明，MAPK信号通路的上调导致ET耐药。在此，我们显示凡德他尼治疗抑制MAPK信号传导，并在ET敏感和ET耐药的ER+细胞系及患者来源的类器官中增强对ET的敏感性。凡德他尼治疗通过富集ERα在经典雌激素反应元件上的染色质结合，将转录重编程为增殖性较低、雌激素反应性更强、Luminal-A样状态。多重激酶抑制剂珠子-质谱（MIB/MS）揭示了激酶网络重编程，包括PI3K和HER2活性的上调，作为对凡德他尼治疗的共同适应性耐药机制。与HER2抑制剂拉帕替尼联合治疗进一步增强了凡德他尼的敏感性。使用手术室到实验室的短期离体检测结合单细胞RNA测序，我们证明了原发肿瘤细胞中保守的基因表达变化，包括凡德他尼治疗后HER2活性特征的增加。从细胞系和原发人类肿瘤细胞生成了凡德他尼敏感性特征，这些特征与ER+患者来源的类器官和异种移植模型中的凡德他尼敏感性相关。未来的研究应评估这些特征是否能预测ER+乳腺肿瘤患者的反应，并确定在凡德他尼治疗中共同靶向HER2信号传导的作用。

abstract: Microfluidic systems incorporating or contained within hydrogels are important in creating microphysiological systems (MPSs). Often naturally-derived hydrogels are used, as their inherent bioactivity supports dynamic cellular behaviors. Hydrogel biomaterials that are partly or fully synthetic are desirable in engineering systems with specific, designed properties, though they typically lack bioactive features of natural materials without additional molecular design. In particular, engineering synthetic biomaterials to support physiologically relevant, dynamic cellular behaviors is an important design goal. Granular hydrogels inherently permit dynamic cellular activity, owning to porosity between particles and dynamic material properties in the absence of interparticle crosslinking. However, using dynamic granular hydrogels in MPSs requires stable channels to perfuse fluid in these dynamic systems. Here, we establish channels within granular hydrogels to enable perfusion through spatially controlled interparticle crosslinking. Selective crosslinking allowed for the formation of stable channels while allowing hydrogel microparticles between two channels to remain uncrosslinked. This allowed spatiotemporal control of signals within an environment established from microparticles without interparticle crosslinking. Fluorescently tagged molecules allowed for the visualization of controlled soluble gradients between two channels within the device. Additionally, embedded 3D printing processes can be used to specify material composition within the system, demonstrating integrated technology for engineering well-defined hydrogel systems. Integrated microfluidic-based control over soluble signals in a system that is compatible with 3D printing processes will establish a basis for building MPSs for broad applications, and the ability to maintain granular systems in culture without interparticle crosslinking will enable design of synthetic hydrogels that access unique dynamic properties within these systems.
abstractZh: 包含或容纳在水凝胶中的微流控系统在创建微生理系统（MPSs）中非常重要。通常使用天然来源的水凝胶，因为它们固有的生物活性支持动态细胞行为。部分或完全合成的 hydrogel 生物材料在工程化具有特定设计性能的系统中是可取的，尽管它们通常缺乏天然材料的生物活性特征，除非进行额外的分子设计。特别是，工程化合成生物材料以支持生理相关的动态细胞行为是一个重要的设计目标。颗粒水凝胶天然允许动态细胞活动，这归因于颗粒之间的孔隙率以及在缺乏颗粒间交联的情况下的动态材料特性。然而，在MPSs中使用动态颗粒水凝胶需要稳定的通道来在这些动态系统中灌注流体。在这里，我们在颗粒水凝胶内建立通道，通过空间控制的颗粒间交联实现灌注。选择性交联允许形成稳定的通道，同时使两个通道之间的水凝胶微粒保持未交联状态。这允许在由微粒建立的环境中实现信号的时间空间控制，而无需颗粒间交联。荧光标记分子允许可视化设备内两个通道之间的受控可溶性梯度。此外，嵌入式3D打印过程可用于指定系统内的材料组成，展示了用于工程化明确水凝胶系统的集成技术。在与3D打印过程兼容的系统中，基于微流控的可溶性信号集成控制将为构建广泛应用的MPSs奠定基础，并且在培养中维持颗粒系统而无需颗粒间交联的能力将使得设计合成水凝胶成为可能，这些水凝胶能够利用这些系统内的独特动态特性。

abstract: Cholangiocarcinoma (CCA) is a highly aggressive biliary malignancy characterized by a dismal prognosis. Tumor progression relies heavily on the hypoxic tumor microenvironment (TME), a key factor that promotes drug resistance and reduces therapeutic efficacy. A major barrier to clinical translation is that standard in vitro cultures fail to maintain this stable low-oxygen state. Addressing this limitation, we designed a microfluidic platform incorporating patient-derived CCA organoids (CCOs) to act as a high-fidelity tumor model. Moreover, we synthesized a hypoxia-activatable nanodrug, BM-MN@PDA (BMMNP). This agent consists of a metronidazole (MN)-loaded bismuth-TCPP framework shielded by a biocompatible polydopamine (PDA) coating. In a hypoxic environment, the drug generates cytotoxic radicals. Validation studies confirmed that our microfluidic platform successfully established a highly biomimetic hypoxic TME (O2 <2.5%), evidenced by the robust upregulation of HIF-1α and HIF-2α. Furthermore, BMMNP NPs demonstrated superior cellular uptake and potent cytotoxicity within the hypoxic CCOs. Notably, these nanoparticles effectively reversed hypoxia-induced resistance to gemcitabine, acting as a powerful chemosensitizer. Collectively, this platform not only establishes a physiologically relevant "hypoxia-on-a-chip" model for preclinical drug evaluation but also accelerates the optimization of nanoparticle-based strategies for hypoxia-targeted therapy.
abstractZh: 胆管癌（CCA）是一种高度侵袭性的胆道恶性肿瘤，预后极差。肿瘤进展严重依赖低氧肿瘤微环境（TME），这是促进耐药性并降低治疗效果的关键因素。临床转化的主要障碍是标准体外培养无法维持这种稳定的低氧状态。针对这一局限性，我们设计了一个微流控平台，整合患者来源的CCA类器官（CCOs），作为高保真肿瘤模型。此外，我们合成了一种低氧激活的纳米药物BM-MN@PDA（BMMNP）。该制剂由载有甲硝唑（MN）的铋-TCPP框架组成，并包被生物相容性聚多巴胺（PDA）涂层。在低氧环境中，该药物产生细胞毒性自由基。验证研究证实，我们的微流控平台成功建立了高度仿生的低氧TME（O2 <2.5%），表现为HIF-1α和HIF-2α的强烈上调。此外，BMMNP纳米颗粒在低氧CCOs中表现出优异的细胞摄取和强效细胞毒性。值得注意的是，这些纳米颗粒有效逆转了低氧诱导的吉西他滨耐药性，充当了强大的化学增敏剂。总之，该平台不仅为临床前药物评价建立了生理相关的“芯片上低氧”模型，而且加速了基于纳米颗粒的低氧靶向治疗策略的优化。

abstract: Goose astrovirus (GAstV) is a newly identified avian pathogen that causes fatal gout in goslings, characterized by kidney damage and high mortality. Unlike non-pathogenic human gout, GAstV-induced gout lacks reference models due to the absence of goose-derived cell lines and standard experimental animals, limiting mechanistic studies. Here, primary goose kidney organoids (GKOs) were isolated from 28-day-old goose embryos. GKOs retained physiological structures and functions comparable to in vivo kidneys. GAstV infection in GKOs was evaluated across renal cell lineages and compared with in vivo outcomes. Viral replication and effects on uric acid metabolism were assessed at different multiplicities of infection. GAstV readily infected GKOs, targeting progenitor, pluripotent stem, collecting duct, and renal tubular cells, consistent with in vivo findings. At a multiplicity of infection of 10.0, GAstV rapidly induced a significant elevation of uric acid, whereas lower doses had weaker effects, paralleling disease severity in goslings. In contrast, GAstV replication was minimal in 2D cells, and other avian viruses failed to induce uric acid elevation in GKOs. Post-infection, transcriptomic and metabolomic analysis showed GAstV remodeled global gene expression and metabolism, mainly disrupting purine metabolism pathways. GAstV infection significantly increased mRNA levels of SLC22A23, SLC17A5, and SLC13A3, which were correlated positively with uric acid. GKOs provide a physiologically relevant model for elucidating GAstV pathogenesis, offering new insights into virus-induced gout and a platform for studying goose viral diseases.
abstractZh: 鹅星状病毒（GAstV）是一种新发现的禽类病原体，可导致雏鹅发生致命性痛风，其特征为肾脏损伤和高死亡率。与非致病性的人类痛风不同，GAstV诱导的痛风由于缺乏鹅源细胞系和标准实验动物而缺少参考模型，限制了机制研究。本研究从28日龄鹅胚中分离出原代鹅肾类器官（GKOs）。GKOs保留了与体内肾脏相当的生理结构和功能。在GKOs中评估了GAstV感染对各肾细胞谱系的影响，并与体内结果进行了比较。在不同感染复数下评估了病毒复制及其对尿酸代谢的影响。GAstV易于感染GKOs，靶向祖细胞、多能干细胞、集合管和肾小管细胞，与体内发现一致。在感染复数为10.0时，GAstV迅速诱导尿酸显著升高，而较低剂量则效果较弱，与雏鹅的疾病严重程度相符。相比之下，GAstV在2D细胞中复制极少，其他禽类病毒未能诱导GKOs中尿酸升高。感染后，转录组学和代谢组学分析显示，GAstV重塑了全局基因表达和代谢，主要干扰嘌呤代谢通路。GAstV感染显著增加了SLC22A23、SLC17A5和SLC13A3的mRNA水平，这些水平与尿酸呈正相关。GKOs为阐明GAstV发病机制提供了生理相关模型，为病毒诱导的痛风提供了新见解，并为研究鹅病毒性疾病提供了平台。

abstract: Beam engineering effectively overcomes the resolution-depth of focus trade-off in high-NA optical coherence microscopy (OCM). Conventional OCM is limited by this constraint, hindering stable volumetric acquisition. To overcome this, we present an intrinsically registered imaging platform based on Bessel beam-enabled extended-depth-of-focus OCM for quantitative, label-free volumetric phenotyping of three-dimensional cell models. Annular illumination extends the focal range to 193 µm, enabling stable scattering contrast in dense spheroids. By exploiting structural scattering signatures associated with cellular disintegration, we demonstrate volumetric viability mapping with 94.57 ± 2.69% aggregate viability concordance relative to fluorescence references. The platform differentiates drug-specific responses and captures pathological transitions in spheroids and organoids, establishing a quantitative paradigm for volumetric biological phenotyping.
abstractZh: 光束工程有效克服了高数值孔径光学相干显微镜（OCM）中分辨率与焦深之间的权衡。传统OCM受此限制，阻碍了稳定的体积采集。为克服这一问题，我们提出了一种基于贝塞尔光束实现的扩展焦深OCM的固有配准成像平台，用于三维细胞模型的定量、无标记体积表型分析。环形照明将焦深范围扩展至193微米，使得在致密球体中能够获得稳定的散射对比度。通过利用与细胞崩解相关的结构散射特征，我们展示了体积活力映射，其总体活力一致性与荧光参考相比为94.57±2.69%。该平台能够区分药物特异性反应，并捕捉球体和类器官中的病理转变，为体积生物表型分析建立了定量范式。

abstract: Drug-induced liver injury (DILI) remains a major cause of acute liver failure and drug withdrawal from the market. Recently developed three-dimensional (3D) hepatic in vitro systems exhibit improved functionality and drug sensitivity compared with conventional two-dimensional cultures. These 3D models range from simple physiologic-like culture systems to advanced bioreactors with dynamic flow to provide sufficient nutrients and consistent drug exposure. However, whether dynamic perfusion improves sensitivity and reproducibility of hepatotoxicity testing remains unclear. Here, we developed a tailor-made perfusion platform to support volumetric bioprinted hepatic constructs for hepatotoxicity testing. The constructs consist of intrahepatic cholangiocyte organoids (ICOs) differentiated towards hepatocyte lineage and embedded in a gelatin methacryloyl bioresin. For toxicity evaluation, the hepatocyte-like ICO constructs were exposed to prolonged subtoxic acetaminophen treatment (10 mM, 7 days). The perfusion system effectively maintained and enhanced hepatocyte differentiation, evidenced by upregulated hepatic markers under perfused conditions compared to static controls. Testing of acetaminophen hepatotoxicity revealed that the perfused constructs displayed elevated cellular injury, with markedly higher liver injury markers relative to controls. Collectively, this study demonstrates the successful application of perfusion-based 3D model culture and highlights its potential as a more physiological platform for hepatotoxicity risk assessment in drug discovery and regenerative medicine.
abstractZh: 药物性肝损伤（DILI）仍然是急性肝衰竭和药物撤市的主要原因。最近开发的三维（3D）肝脏体外系统相比传统的二维培养表现出改善的功能和药物敏感性。这些3D模型范围从简单的生理样培养系统到具有动态流动的先进生物反应器，以提供足够的营养和一致的药物暴露。然而，动态灌注是否提高肝毒性测试的敏感性和可重复性仍不清楚。在此，我们开发了一个定制的灌注平台，以支持体积生物打印的肝脏构建体用于肝毒性测试。这些构建体由向肝细胞谱系分化的肝内胆管细胞类器官（ICOs）组成，并嵌入明胶甲基丙烯酰基生物树脂中。对于毒性评估，将肝细胞样ICO构建体暴露于长期亚毒性对乙酰氨基酚处理（10 mM，7天）。灌注系统有效维持并增强了肝细胞分化，表现为灌注条件下肝标志物上调，与静态对照相比。对乙酰氨基酚肝毒性测试显示，灌注构建体表现出更高的细胞损伤，肝损伤标志物显著高于对照。总的来说，本研究证明了基于灌注的3D模型培养的成功应用，并强调了其作为药物发现和再生医学中肝毒性风险评估的更生理平台的潜力。

abstract: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive and fatal interstitial lung disease with limited treatment options. Depression and anxiety are common comorbidities in patients with IPF, and emerging evidence suggests that neuroactive pathways may also influence fibrotic remodeling. On this basis, we investigated desipramine, a tricyclic antidepressant, as a potential modulator of fibroblast state in lung fibrosis. Desipramine was identified in an FDA-approved compound screen as a pro-lipogenic hit in TGF-β-stimulated fibroblasts and was subsequently evaluated across a stepwise validation pipeline of increasing biological complexity. In WI-38 fibroblasts, desipramine was well tolerated at 10 μM and reduced myofibroblast-associated features while increasing lipid-associated staining. In a fibroblast-supported alveolosphere assay, desipramine altered qualitative organoid clustering and changed the transcript levels of specific mesenchymal markers under profibrotic stimulation, whereas direct treatment of MLE-12 epithelial cells did not elicit a consistent response. While desipramine demonstrated pro-lipogenic and anti-myofibroblastic phenotypic shifts in reductionist 2D cultures, these effects failed to translate robustly into complex 3D human lung tissue slices or in vivo disease models. Ultimately, our findings highlight the critical necessity of utilizing complex translational pipelines to rigorously validate early screening hits before therapeutic efficacy is assumed.
abstractZh: 特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种进行性且致命的间质性肺疾病，治疗选择有限。抑郁和焦虑是IPF患者常见的合并症，新出现的证据表明神经活性通路也可能影响纤维化重塑。基于此，我们研究了地昔帕明，一种三环类抗抑郁药，作为肺纤维化中成纤维细胞状态的潜在调节剂。地昔帕明在一项FDA批准的化合物筛选中被鉴定为TGF-β刺激的成纤维细胞中的促脂生成命中物，随后在逐步增加生物学复杂性的验证流程中进行了评估。在WI-38成纤维细胞中，地昔帕明在10 μM浓度下耐受性良好，并减少了肌成纤维细胞相关特征，同时增加了脂质相关染色。在成纤维细胞支持的肺泡球实验中，地昔帕明在促纤维化刺激下改变了定性类器官聚集，并改变了特定间充质标志物的转录水平，而直接处理MLE-12上皮细胞未引发一致的反应。尽管地昔帕明在简化的2D培养中表现出促脂生成和抗肌成纤维细胞的表型转变，但这些效应未能稳健地转化为复杂的3D人肺组织切片或体内疾病模型。最终，我们的研究结果强调了利用复杂转化流程严格验证早期筛选命中物在假设治疗效果之前的必要性。

title: Structure-function dissection of huntingtin exon 1 identifies a PRD-driven modifier of neuronal toxicity in Huntington’s disease
titleZh: 亨廷顿蛋白外显子1的结构-功能解析鉴定出PRD驱动的亨廷顿病神经元毒性调节因子

authors: Iennaco R, Maffezzini C, Maestri S, Scolz A, Cattaneo A, Murgia A, Trovesi C, Cammarota E, Vezzoli E, Falqui A, Felsenfeld DP, Vogt TF, Bachi A, Zuccato C, Cattaneo E.
abstract: The  Huntingtin gene (  HTT ) contains a conserved, yet expandable CAG repeat within exon 1. While the pathogenic expansion in Huntington’s Disease (HD) is well studied, the role of surrounding domains remains unclear. Using genome-edited mini-organoids and neurons, we dissected  HTT exon 1 and found species-specific toxicity: the human variant caused more severe deficits than the mouse. Swapping the proline-rich domain (PRD) - the most divergent region - revealed its key role: the mouse PRD mitigated, while the human PRD worsened neuronal phenotypes. Omics profiling showed that pathogenic human exon 1 induced broad protein dysregulation, largely reversed by mouse PRD replacement. Bioinformatics implicated the actin cytoskeleton and transcriptional coactivator MKL2/MRTFB. We validated MKL2/MRTFB dysregulation in HD models and showed that restoring its expression rescued neuronal abnormalities. These findings highlight the PRD’s contribution to HD toxicity and point to MKL2/MRTFB and the cytoskeleton as candidate mediators.
abstractZh: 亨廷顿基因（HTT）在外显子1内包含一个保守但可扩展的CAG重复序列。虽然亨廷顿病（HD）中的致病性扩增已被充分研究，但周围结构域的作用仍不清楚。利用基因组编辑的微型类器官和神经元，我们解析了HTT外显子1，并发现了物种特异性毒性：人类变体比小鼠变体引起更严重的缺陷。交换脯氨酸丰富结构域（PRD）——差异最大的区域——揭示了其关键作用：小鼠PRD减轻了神经元表型，而人类PRD则使其恶化。组学分析显示，致病性人类外显子1诱导了广泛的蛋白质失调，而小鼠PRD的替换在很大程度上逆转了这种失调。生物信息学分析提示肌动蛋白细胞骨架和转录共激活因子MKL2/MRTFB参与其中。我们在HD模型中验证了MKL2/MRTFB的失调，并表明恢复其表达可挽救神经元异常。这些发现强调了PRD对HD毒性的贡献，并指出MKL2/MRTFB和细胞骨架是候选介导因子。

title: Cortical organoids from congenital DM1 PSCs reveal MBNL-dependent corticogenesis defects and enable preclinical testing of therapeutic compounds
titleZh: 来自先天性DM1 PSCs的皮层类器官揭示MBNL依赖性皮层生成缺陷，并实现治疗化合物的临床前测试
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Abatan A, Polentes J, Bouquier M, Beuriot A, Chose O, Mahiou H, El Kassar L, Giraud-Triboult K, Chatrousse L, Benchoua A, Tomé S, Gourdon G, Gomes-Pereira M, Baghdoyan S, Martinat C.
abstract:
ABSTRACT

  Myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1) is caused by an expansion of a CTG repeat in the 3′ untranslated region of the  DMPK gene, leading to accumulation of toxic CUG-repeat RNAs, sequestration of MBNL proteins and widespread splicing dysregulation. Congenital DM1 (CDM), the most severe form of the disease, is associated with profound muscular and neurodevelopmental defects, yet the mechanisms underlying early human brain involvement remain poorly understood. Here, we generated cortical organoids from patient-derived pluripotent stem cells carrying >1000 CTG repeats, an expansion typically associated with CDM, to model early human neurodevelopment. DM1 molecular and cellular hallmarks were detected at early developmental stages, including nuclear  DMPK RNA foci in neural progenitor cells and reduced proliferative capacity. As organoids matured, CDM cultures displayed altered cortical composition, with reduced CTIP2⁺ and SATB2⁺ neuronal populations and increased NFIA⁺/GFAP⁺ glial cells. In parallel, 120-day-old organoids recapitulated splicing abnormalities previously identified in DM1 patient brain tissue. To assess the contribution of MBNL dysfunction, we analyzed cortical organoids derived from  MBNL2 and  MBNL1/2/3 knockout induced pluripotent stem cells, which reproduced key neurodevelopmental phenotypes observed in CDM organoids, supporting a central role for MBNL loss of function in impaired corticogenesis. Finally, we evaluated the translational relevance of this model using tideglusib and erythromycin, two compounds currently under clinical evaluation in DM1 patients. Both treatments reduced  DMPK RNA foci and restored proliferation defects in SOX2⁺ neural progenitors. Together, these findings establish cortical organoids as a robust human model of CDM-associated neurodevelopmental defects, uncover MBNL-dependent mechanisms underlying early corticogenesis impairment and demonstrate the utility of this platform for translational therapeutic discovery in DM1.
abstractZh:
摘要

  1型肌强直性营养不良（DM1）由DMPK基因3'非翻译区中CTG重复序列的扩增引起，导致毒性CUG重复RNA的积累、MBNL蛋白的隔离和广泛的剪接失调。先天性DM1（CDM）是该病最严重的形式，与严重的肌肉和神经发育缺陷相关，但早期人脑受累的机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们从携带>1000个CTG重复序列（通常与CDM相关的扩增）的患者来源多能干细胞生成了皮层类器官，以模拟早期人类神经发育。在早期发育阶段检测到DM1分子和细胞标志，包括神经祖细胞中的核DMPK RNA灶和增殖能力降低。随着类器官成熟，CDM培养物表现出改变的皮层组成，CTIP2⁺和SATB2⁺神经元群体减少，NFIA⁺/GFAP⁺胶质细胞增加。同时，120天龄的类器官重现了先前在DM1患者脑组织中鉴定的剪接异常。为了评估MBNL功能障碍的贡献，我们分析了源自MBNL2和MBNL1/2/3敲除诱导多能干细胞衍生的皮层类器官，这些类器官重现了CDM类器官中观察到的关键神经发育表型，支持MBNL功能丧失在皮层生成受损中的核心作用。最后，我们使用tideglusib和红霉素（两种目前正在DM1患者中进行临床评估的化合物）评估了该模型的转化相关性。两种治疗均减少了SOX2⁺神经祖细胞中的DMPK RNA灶并恢复了增殖缺陷。总之，这些发现将皮层类器官确立为CDM相关神经发育缺陷的稳健人类模型，揭示了MBNL依赖性机制在早期皮层生成损伤中的作用，并证明了该平台在DM1转化治疗发现中的实用性。

abstract:
Background

Metastatic disease remains the leading cause of cancer-related death, yet most precision oncology strategies still emphasize profiling primary tumors and tracking cell-free tumor DNA (ctDNA). Although ctDNA has transformed genomic profiling, molecular residual disease monitoring, and early cancer detection, it cannot directly capture viable tumor cell states, phenotypic plasticity, or functional adaptations that drive metastatic spread. We propose that the next phase of precision oncology should integrate the cellular dimension of metastasis through systematic circulating tumor cell (CTC) profiling.Methods

The SCRUM-MONSTAR platform, one of the largest pan-cancer molecular profiling initiatives in Japan, offers an exceptional foundation for this transition through its nationwide infrastructure for multi-omics analysis, longitudinal biospecimen collection, and artificial intelligence-enabled clinical interpretation. By combining matched tissue profiling, serial ctDNA analysis, single-cell CTC transcriptomics, metabolomics, and organoid- and mouse-based functional modeling, SCRUM-MONSTAR-CTC could evolve into a translational ecosystem for anti-metastatic drug discovery. Within this framework, we highlight adherent-to-suspension transition (AST) as one representative, experimentally tractable plasticity program that enables tumor cells to survive in circulation and subsequently colonize distant organs.Discussion

We envision that identifying and therapeutically targeting AST-related and other metastatic plasticity programs across tumor types will provide a path toward clinically actionable anti-metastatic therapies. More broadly, this framework could enable the identification of metastatic vulnerabilities, the development of biomarker-guided anti-metastatic trials, and the reverse translation of patient-derived discoveries into early-phase clinical testing. Precision oncology must move beyond cataloging tumor genomes and begin targeting metastasis as a dynamic biological process.Trial registration

UMIN000056873, approved by the Institutional Review Board of the National Cancer Center Hospital East.
abstractZh:
背景

转移性疾病仍是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，然而大多数精准肿瘤学策略仍强调对原发肿瘤进行分型并追踪循环游离肿瘤DNA（ctDNA）。尽管ctDNA已改变了基因组分析、分子残留病监测和早期癌症检测，但它无法直接捕获驱动转移扩散的可行肿瘤细胞状态、表型可塑性或功能适应性。我们提出，精准肿瘤学的下一阶段应通过系统性循环肿瘤细胞（CTC）分析整合转移的细胞维度。方法

SCRUM-MONSTAR平台是日本最大的泛癌种分子分析计划之一，通过其全国性的多组学分析、纵向生物样本采集和人工智能驱动的临床解读基础设施，为这一转变提供了卓越的基础。通过结合匹配的组织分析、系列ctDNA分析、单细胞CTC转录组学、代谢组学以及类器官和小鼠功能建模，SCRUM-MONSTAR-CTC可发展为一个抗转移药物发现的转化生态系统。在此框架内，我们强调贴壁-悬浮转变（AST）作为一种代表性的、实验上可处理的塑性程序，使肿瘤细胞能够在循环中存活并随后定植于远处器官。讨论

我们设想，识别并治疗性靶向AST相关及其他跨肿瘤类型的转移塑性程序，将为临床可操作的抗转移疗法提供路径。更广泛地说，该框架可促进转移脆弱性的识别、生物标志物指导的抗转移试验的开发，以及将患者来源的发现反向转化为早期临床测试。精准肿瘤学必须超越对肿瘤基因组的编目，开始将转移视为一个动态生物学过程进行靶向。试验注册

abstract: Epigenetic dysregulation is a hallmark of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet the mechanisms linking chromatin modifiers to tumor stemness remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify the histone methyltransferase KMT5C as master regulator of HCC stemness and progression through integrative analyses of patient-derived organoids, murine models, and clinical cohorts. Mechanistically, KMT5C interacts with HDAC1 to promote H4K20me3-dependent chromatin compaction and histone deacetylation, cooperatively silencing tumor suppressor genes. Dual pharmacological inhibition of KMT5C and HDAC1 potently suppresses tumor growth, eliminates cancer stem cells, and sensitizes HCC to lenvatinib. Among their co-targets, we uncover SERPINA4 as a tumor suppressor that disrupts an oncogenic c-JUN/PRKCA/MAPK/c-FOS positive feedback loop. Notably, PRKCA is identified as a key and specific downstream effector of SERPINA4 in HCC. Clinically, KMT5C overexpression correlates with elevated PRKCA expression, reduced SERPINA4 levels, and poor patient survival. Our work establishes the KMT5C-HDAC1 axis as a central epigenetic switch that governs HCC stemness and progression, revealing a co-targeting strategy for the treatment of aggressive HCC.
abstractZh: 表观遗传失调是肝细胞癌（HCC）的一个标志，但将染色质修饰因子与肿瘤干性联系起来的机制仍不完全清楚。在此，我们通过整合分析患者来源的类器官、小鼠模型和临床队列，确定组蛋白甲基转移酶KMT5C是HCC干性和进展的主要调控因子。机制上，KMT5C与HDAC1相互作用，促进H4K20me3依赖的染色质压缩和组蛋白去乙酰化，协同沉默肿瘤抑制基因。KMT5C和HDAC1的双重药理学抑制可强效抑制肿瘤生长、消除癌症干细胞，并使HCC对仑伐替尼敏感。在其共同靶点中，我们发现SERPINA4是一种肿瘤抑制因子，可破坏致癌的c-JUN/PRKCA/MAPK/c-FOS正反馈环路。值得注意的是，PRKCA被确定为SERPINA4在HCC中的关键且特异性下游效应因子。临床上，KMT5C过表达与PRKCA表达升高、SERPINA4水平降低以及患者生存率差相关。我们的工作确立了KMT5C-HDAC1轴作为控制HCC干性和进展的核心表观遗传开关，揭示了一种针对侵袭性HCC治疗的联合靶向策略。

abstract: Estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer is the most common subtype of breast cancer and is an age-related disease. How systemic and tumor microenvironment hormone signaling intersects with chronic inflammation and how this shapes aging-associated tumor biology remain incompletely understood. Here, using an aged rat model of ER+ tumors, we identify age-associated differences in tumor development and immune features. In parallel, analysis of samples from patients with ER+/HER2- breast cancer and age-matched controls demonstrated estrone-predominant systemic estrogen patterns and increased tumor HSD17B7 expression in older patients, consistent with enhanced local estrone-to-estradiol conversion. In patient-derived organoids from older women, pharmacologic inhibition of HSD17B7 reduced estrogen conversion and proliferation-associated transcriptional programs. Tumors from older patients also exhibited chemokine enrichment, including CCL2, associated with immunosuppressive macrophage features. Targeting both estrogen signaling and chemokine pathways attenuated macrophage polarization ex vivo. These findings support a model linking age-associated hormonal and inflammatory changes to features of a tumor-permissive microenvironment in ER+ breast cancer.
abstractZh: 雌激素受体阳性（ER+）乳腺癌是乳腺癌中最常见的亚型，且是一种与年龄相关的疾病。全身性和肿瘤微环境激素信号如何与慢性炎症相互作用，以及这如何塑造与衰老相关的肿瘤生物学，仍不完全清楚。在此，我们使用ER+肿瘤的老年大鼠模型，识别了肿瘤发展和免疫特征中与年龄相关的差异。同时，对ER+/HER2-乳腺癌患者及年龄匹配对照样本的分析显示，老年患者呈现以雌酮为主的全身性雌激素模式，且肿瘤中HSD17B7表达增加，这与局部雌酮向雌二醇转化的增强一致。在来自老年女性的患者来源类器官中，药理学抑制HSD17B7减少了雌激素转化和增殖相关的转录程序。老年患者的肿瘤还表现出趋化因子富集，包括CCL2，这与免疫抑制性巨噬细胞特征相关。同时靶向雌激素信号和趋化因子通路在体外减弱了巨噬细胞极化。这些发现支持一个模型，将年龄相关的激素和炎症变化与ER+乳腺癌中肿瘤允许性微环境的特征联系起来。

title: Synergistic neurotoxicity of mono-butyl phthalate and bisphenol A at environmentally relevant concentrations: Multi-Omics evidence for ferroptosis via glutathione metabolism disruption in neural stem cells and brain organoids.

abstract: Evaluating endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) risk such as mono-butyl phthalate (MBP) and bisphenol A (BPA) raises a pressing question: can doses deemed safe for each individual exposure become hazardous in combination? This study aimed to determine whether environmentally relevant concentrations of MBP and BPA exert synergistic neurotoxicity and to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms using an integrated multi-omics approach. Exposure concentrations (20 nM each) were derived from epidemiological biomonitoring data. Primary neural stem cells (NSCs) were used to detect CCK-8, reactive oxygen species (ROS), and apoptosis Synergy was evaluated using the Bliss independence model and two-way ANOVA. Transcriptomic (RNA-seq) and untargeted metabolomic (LC-MS) profiling were performed, followed by integrative pathway analysis. Three-dimensional (3D) brain organoids were used to validate the main findings. Co-exposure to MBP and BPA at equimolar concentrations synergistically reduced cell proliferation (BlissΔ >0, E_Observed = 0.371 vs. E_Bliss = 0.163) and synergistically elevated intracellular ROS (interaction index = 2.21, p = 0.0066; two-way ANOVA interaction p = 0.033). Transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses converged on glutathione metabolism as the most significantly dysregulated pathway in the co-exposure group. Integrated multi-omics analysis revealed ferroptosis may serve as the primary mode of synergistic cell death. Three-dimensional brain organoids confirmed the ferroptosis signature, with significantly decreased GPX4 and SLC7A11 protein expression and concomitantly increased ACSL4 in the co-exposure group. In summary, MBP and BPA co-exposure at human-relevant doses synergistically induces neurotoxicity in NSCs through glutathione metabolism disruption and subsequent ferroptosis. These findings underscore the importance of evaluating chemical mixtures rather than individual compounds in neurodevelopmental risk assessment.
abstractZh: 评估内分泌干扰化学物（EDCs）如单丁基邻苯二甲酸酯（MBP）和双酚A（BPA）的风险提出了一个紧迫的问题：对每种单独暴露被认为是安全的剂量，在组合时是否会变得危险？本研究旨在确定环境相关浓度的MBP和BPA是否会产生协同神经毒性，并利用整合的多组学方法阐明其潜在分子机制。暴露浓度（各20 nM）来源于流行病学生物监测数据。使用原代神经干细胞（NSCs）检测CCK-8、活性氧（ROS）和细胞凋亡。使用Bliss独立模型和双因素方差分析评估协同作用。进行了转录组学（RNA-seq）和非靶向代谢组学（LC-MS）分析，随后进行整合通路分析。使用三维（3D）脑类器官验证主要发现。MBP和BPA以等摩尔浓度共同暴露协同降低了细胞增殖（BlissΔ >0，E_观察值=0.371 vs. E_Bliss=0.163），并协同升高了细胞内ROS（交互指数=2.21，p=0.0066；双因素方差分析交互p=0.033）。转录组学和代谢组学分析一致指向谷胱甘肽代谢是共同暴露组中失调最显著的通路。整合多组学分析揭示铁死亡可能是协同细胞死亡的主要模式。三维脑类器官证实了铁死亡特征，共同暴露组中GPX4和SLC7A11蛋白表达显著降低，同时ACSL4表达增加。总之，在人类相关剂量下，MBP和BPA共同暴露通过谷胱甘肽代谢紊乱和随后的铁死亡协同诱导NSCs的神经毒性。这些发现强调了在神经发育风险评估中评估化学混合物而非单一化合物的重要性。

abstract: Conventional cancer therapy has largely been organized around maximal cytotoxic elimination, yet intense tumor killing can impose evolutionary selection pressures that promote resistance, clonal escape, and relapse. Here, we propose therapeutic super-competitor cells (TSCs) as a programmable, evolution-aware extension of educative cancer care rather than as an established clinical platform. In this framework, TSCs are engineered cells designed to home to or be locally positioned within tumor-associated niches, sense malignant ecological cues, transiently acquire bounded competitive fitness, restrict malignant access to space, metabolites, and stromal support, and then undergo monitored clearance or benign differentiation. TSCs are therefore not defined by direct target-cell cytolysis, although competitive pressure, metabolic restriction, or immune remodeling may secondarily reduce tumor viability. This Review integrates concepts from cancer ecology, tumor microenvironment biology, developmental cell competition, immunotherapy, and synthetic biology while distinguishing established principles from speculative engineering applications, evaluating feasible early disease contexts, and outlining measurable endpoints for ecological replacement, including spatial occupancy, clonal displacement, resource gradients, persistence kinetics, and responsiveness to safety triggers. We further discuss organoid and tumor-on-chip competition assays, spatial and lineage tracking, response biomarkers, therapeutic-window definition, layered containment, and ethical/regulatory safeguards. By reframing engineered cell therapy as a controllable ecological intervention rather than simply a vehicle for maximal killing, the TSC framework provides a testable but still hypothetical direction for educative cancer care and evolution-aware oncology.
abstractZh: 传统癌症治疗主要围绕最大程度的细胞毒性消除来组织，然而强烈的肿瘤杀伤可能施加进化选择压力，促进耐药性、克隆逃逸和复发。在此，我们提出治疗性超级竞争细胞（TSCs）作为一种可编程的、具有进化意识的癌症教育性护理的延伸，而非已建立的临床平台。在该框架中，TSCs是经过工程化设计的细胞，旨在归巢至或局部定位于肿瘤相关微环境中，感知恶性生态线索，短暂获得有界的竞争适应性，限制恶性细胞对空间、代谢物和基质支持的可及性，然后经历监测下的清除或良性分化。因此，TSCs并非通过直接靶细胞裂解来定义，尽管竞争压力、代谢限制或免疫重塑可能继发性地降低肿瘤活力。本综述整合了癌症生态学、肿瘤微环境生物学、发育细胞竞争、免疫疗法和合成生物学的概念，同时区分已确立的原理与推测性的工程应用，评估可行的早期疾病背景，并概述生态替代的可测量终点，包括空间占用、克隆位移、资源梯度、持久性动力学以及对安全触发器的响应性。我们进一步讨论了类器官和肿瘤芯片竞争实验、空间和谱系追踪、反应生物标志物、治疗窗口定义、分层遏制以及伦理/监管保障。通过将工程化细胞疗法重新定义为一种可控的生态干预，而非仅仅是最大程度杀伤的载体，TSC框架为教育性癌症护理和具有进化意识的肿瘤学提供了一个可测试但仍属假设性的方向。

abstract: Organ-on-Chip (OoC) systems hold extraordinary promise for predictive drug development and disease modeling. Yet, their translational impact is constrained by several challenges, one of which is the inability to monitor cellular microenvironments and tissue behavior in real time, without destructive sampling. In the absence of real-time sensing capabilities, OoC characterization often relies on intermittent or endpoint measurements, where inputs and endpoints are known, but transient cellular mechanisms driving biological responses remain elusive. This ambiguity limits mechanistic insights and complicates model validation essential for pre-clinical decision-making. Integrating sensing capabilities into OoCs resolves this gap by enabling continuous, non-invasive monitoring of multi-parametric cellular and microenvironmental dynamics. This review presents an overview of the current state of real-time OoC sensing, examining how electrochemical, optical, affinity-based, and mechanical sensing modalities capture real-time data related to barrier integrity, metabolic shifts, ion dynamics, biomarker secretion, and contractile force. It discusses data from representative organ systems (brain, gut, liver, kidney, etc.), commercially available platforms, and disease-modeling applications, highlighting enhanced predictive potential relative to the conventional pre-clinical models. Innovations in multi-modal sensors and AI/ML-based data analysis are advancing OoCs toward high-throughput drug safety and efficacy assessments. However, persistent challenges such as sensor miniaturization, lack of standardized calibration protocols, batch-to-batch reproducibility, signal interference in complex media, economic barriers, and lack of binding international regulatory guidelines impede scalable translation. Addressing these gaps through co-ordinated standardization, regulatory harmonization, and infrastructure development is essential to unlock OoCs as routine pre-clinical tools capable of reducing animal use, accelerating therapeutic translation, and improving patient outcomes.
abstractZh: 器官芯片（OoC）系统在预测性药物开发和疾病建模方面具有非凡的前景。然而，其转化影响受到若干挑战的制约，其中之一是缺乏在不进行破坏性采样的情况下实时监测细胞微环境和组织行为的能力。在缺乏实时传感能力的情况下，OoC表征通常依赖于间歇性或终点测量，其中输入和终点已知，但驱动生物反应的瞬时细胞机制仍然难以捉摸。这种模糊性限制了机制洞察，并使对于临床前决策至关重要的模型验证复杂化。将传感能力整合到OoC中解决了这一差距，能够实现多参数细胞和微环境动态的连续、非侵入性监测。本综述概述了实时OoC传感的当前状态，探讨了电化学、光学、基于亲和力的和机械传感模式如何捕获与屏障完整性、代谢转变、离子动态、生物标志物分泌和收缩力相关的实时数据。它讨论了代表性器官系统（脑、肠、肝、肾等）的数据、商业可用平台和疾病建模应用，强调了相对于传统临床前模型增强的预测潜力。多模态传感器和基于AI/ML的数据分析创新正在推动OoC向高通量药物安全性和有效性评估发展。然而，持续的挑战，如传感器小型化、缺乏标准化校准协议、批次间重现性、复杂介质中的信号干扰、经济障碍以及缺乏具有约束力的国际监管指南，阻碍了可扩展的转化。通过协调标准化、监管协调和基础设施发展来解决这些差距，对于释放OoC作为常规临床前工具的潜力至关重要，这些工具能够减少动物使用、加速治疗转化并改善患者预后。

abstract: Microcystin LR (MC LR) and cylindrospermopsin (CYN) are cyanobacterial toxins commonly detected during harmful algal blooms in freshwater systems. Their increasing occurrence raises concerns about water quality and potential risks to human health. Although the liver is their target organ, these cyanotoxins can also affect the nervous system. The potential neurotoxicity of MC-LR and CYN is still scarcely investigated, particularly for CYN. In this study, the effects of both cyanotoxins on neural progenitor cells were evaluated. MC-LR did not significantly affect cell viability at concentrations up to 60 µM, whereas CYN induced evident cytotoxicity starting at 1 µM after 24-48 h. Additionally, CYN was also tested in BrainSpheres (also called brain microphysiological system, bMPS) for the first time. Statistically significant cytotoxicity was observed from 1 µM onward after 1 week exposure. Downstream analysis revealed that subcytotoxic concentrations of CYN altered the gene expression of different nervous (TUBB3, NEFH, SYP, OLIG1, and GFAP), inflammatory (IL-1β, TNF-α and Nf-κβ) and oxidative stress (SOD1, HMOX and GSTT) markers analysed by RT-qPCR. Overall, the results obtained showed that BrainSpheres is an effective new approach methodology for evaluating the neurotoxic potential of cyanotoxins and points out the importance of including neurotoxicity in the risk assessment of cyanotoxins to human health.
abstractZh: 微囊藻毒素LR（MC LR）和柱孢藻毒素（CYN）是在淡水系统有害藻华期间常检测到的蓝藻毒素。它们的日益增多引发了对水质和人类健康潜在风险的担忧。尽管肝脏是它们的主要靶器官，这些蓝藻毒素也能影响神经系统。MC-LR和CYN的潜在神经毒性研究仍然很少，尤其是对CYN。在本研究中，评估了这两种蓝藻毒素对神经祖细胞的影响。MC-LR在浓度高达60 µM时未显著影响细胞活力，而CYN在24-48小时后从1 µM开始诱导明显的细胞毒性。此外，CYN也首次在BrainSpheres（也称为脑微生理系统，bMPS）中进行了测试。暴露1周后，从1 µM起观察到统计学上显著的细胞毒性。下游分析显示，亚细胞毒性浓度的CYN改变了通过RT-qPCR分析的不同神经（TUBB3、NEFH、SYP、OLIG1和GFAP）、炎症（IL-1β、TNF-α和Nf-κβ）和氧化应激（SOD1、HMOX和GSTT）标志物的基因表达。总体而言，获得的结果表明BrainSpheres是评估蓝藻毒素神经毒性潜力的有效新方法，并指出了将神经毒性纳入蓝藻毒素对人类健康风险评估的重要性。

abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a multifactorial disease with mixed pathologies. Consequentially, drugs targeting multiple pathological processes may offer synergistic benefits. While histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitors have demonstrated efficacy in alleviating AD-related pathologies in animal models, the neuroprotective Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway remains compromised in AD brain. CI-994 is a class I HDAC inhibitor containing N-(2-aminophenyl)-benzamide. Our recent studies indicate that CI-994 is also an activator of Wnt/β-catenin signaling by stabilizing Wnt co-receptor LRP6. We herein use CI-994 as a scaffold to develop novel potent dual modulators of class I HDACs and Wnt/β-catenin signaling for AD therapy. Our lead compound, W2A-28, selectively inhibits class I HDAC1, 2 and 3 with IC50 values of 0.51 μM, 0.68 μM and 0.22 μM, respectively, and shows no inhibitory activities on other HDACs. Furthermore, W2A-28 potently activates Wnt reporter activity with an EC50 value of 1.61 μM in Wnt-3A-expressing HEK293 cells. As expected, activation of Wnt/β-catenin signaling by W2A-28 is associated with elevated LRP6 protein level. Importantly, W2A-28 displays excellent microsomal stability in both mouse and human liver microsomal stability assays, alongside high permeability and a lack of active efflux in MDR1-MDCKII models. Critically, W2A-28 treatment significantly enhances histone acetylation, activates Wnt/β-catenin signaling, suppresses tau phosphorylation, and reduces Aβ levels in AD patient-specific cerebral organoids carrying APOE ε4/ε4 or APOE ε3/ε4 with PSEN1 M146V mutation. Our findings position W2A-28 as a promising multi-target drug candidate for AD therapy.
abstractZh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种具有混合病理特征的多因素疾病。因此，针对多种病理过程的药物可能提供协同效益。虽然组蛋白去乙酰化酶（HDAC）抑制剂在动物模型中已显示出缓解AD相关病理的功效，但AD大脑中的神经保护性Wnt/β-catenin信号通路仍然受损。CI-994是一种含有N-(2-氨基苯基)-苯甲酰胺的I类HDAC抑制剂。我们最近的研究表明，CI-994还通过稳定Wnt共受体LRP6来激活Wnt/β-catenin信号通路。我们在此以CI-994为骨架，开发新型强效的I类HDAC和Wnt/β-catenin信号通路双重调节剂用于AD治疗。我们的先导化合物W2A-28选择性抑制I类HDAC1、2和3，IC50值分别为0.51 μM、0.68 μM和0.22 μM，对其他HDAC无抑制活性。此外，W2A-28在表达Wnt-3A的HEK293细胞中强效激活Wnt报告基因活性，EC50值为1.61 μM。如预期，W2A-28激活Wnt/β-catenin信号通路与LRP6蛋白水平升高相关。重要的是，W2A-28在小鼠和人肝微粒体稳定性测定中表现出优异的微粒体稳定性，同时在MDR1-MDCKII模型中具有高渗透性和无主动外排。关键的是，在携带APOE ε4/ε4或APOE ε3/ε4且伴有PSEN1 M146V突变的AD患者特异性大脑类器官中，W2A-28处理显著增强组蛋白乙酰化，激活Wnt/β-catenin信号通路，抑制tau磷酸化，并降低Aβ水平。我们的发现将W2A-28定位为AD治疗的有前景的多靶点药物候选物。

title: Interpretable gene networks from single-cell foundation models reveal conserved neurogenic dysfunction in Parkinson’s disease
titleZh: 来自单细胞基础模型的可解释基因网络揭示帕金森病中保守的神经发生功能障碍
