abstract: Interpreting large-scale single-cell transcriptomic data remains a major challenge for understanding disease mechanisms. Recent single-cell foundation models learn rich representations of gene relationships across millions of cells, yet methods for translating these embeddings into biologically interpretable gene networks remain limited. Here we present scGENet, a computational framework that constructs context-specific gene interaction networks from foundation model–derived gene embeddings. By fine-tuning pretrained models on transcriptomic data from human midbrain organoids, scGENet generates transcriptome-scale gene modules that capture biologically meaningful cellular programs. Benchmarking across multiple foundation models demonstrates that networks derived from a fine-tuned scGPT brain model show the highest concordance with curated neuronal pathways, Parkinson’s disease (PD) genetic risk loci, and independent patient-derived transcriptional signatures. Applying this framework to human iPSC-derived PD midbrain organoids reveals transcriptional modules associated with neuronal differentiation, synaptic signaling, and cell-cycle regulation. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing further links these programs to altered cellular composition, including reduced dopaminergic neurons, expansion of radial glia–like progenitors, and a dopaminergic neuron subtype expressing SNCA and VGLUT2. Integration with independent human substantia nigra datasets identifies a conserved neurogenic program disrupted across genetic and idiopathic PD. Together, these results establish a generalizable strategy for extracting interpretable gene networks from single-cell foundation models, enabling systematic discovery of disease-relevant molecular programs across diverse tissues and datasets.
abstractZh: 解读大规模单细胞转录组数据仍然是理解疾病机制的主要挑战。近期的单细胞基础模型在数百万个细胞中学习了丰富的基因关系表征，但将这些嵌入转化为生物学上可解释的基因网络的方法仍然有限。在此，我们提出了scGENet，一个从基础模型衍生的基因嵌入构建情境特异性基因相互作用网络的计算框架。通过在人中脑类器官的转录组数据上微调预训练模型，scGENet生成了转录组规模的基因模块，这些模块捕获了具有生物学意义的细胞程序。跨多个基础模型的基准测试表明，从微调的scGPT脑模型衍生的网络与精选的神经元通路、帕金森病（PD）遗传风险位点以及独立的患者来源的转录特征具有最高的一致性。将该框架应用于人iPSC衍生的PD中脑类器官，揭示了与神经元分化、突触信号传导和细胞周期调控相关的转录模块。单核RNA测序进一步将这些程序与改变的细胞组成联系起来，包括多巴胺能神经元减少、放射状胶质样祖细胞扩增，以及一个表达SNCA和VGLUT2的多巴胺能神经元亚型。与独立的人黑质数据集的整合识别出一个在遗传性和特发性PD中均被破坏的保守神经发生程序。总之，这些结果建立了一种从单细胞基础模型中提取可解释基因网络的通用策略，使得在不同组织和数据集中系统性地发现疾病相关的分子程序成为可能。

title: Computationally guided design of a metastasis-on-a-chip platform for quantitative evaluation of chemotactic cues in developmental cancers
titleZh: 计算引导的转移瘤芯片平台设计用于定量评估发育性癌症中的趋化线索
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Murphy C, Jarc L, Cadavere A, Cioffi E, Badiola-Mateos M, Fernandez D, Gomez-Jimenez N, Mora J, Samitier J, Villasante A.
abstract:
Metastatic dissemination is initiated by tumor cells interpreting spatially organized biochemical and biophysical cues that remain difficult to reproduce using conventional migration assays. Here, we developed a computationally guided metastasis-on-a-chip (MET-on-a-chip) platform based on the concept of the Minimally Functional Unit (MFU), in which only the biological components required to answer a defined experimental question are incorporated. The platform consists of two independent culture chambers connected through an array of confined microchannels that permits diffusion of soluble factors while constraining tumor cell migration. Rather than relying on empirical optimization, finite-element COMSOL simulations were first used to predict molecular transport, define growth factor loading conditions, identify biologically relevant exposure regions, and guide the rational design of the microfluidic assay. Computational predictions were experimentally validated using 70-kDa FITC-dextran diffusion and VEGF release studies, confirming the formation of stable spatial concentration gradients across the microfluidic platform. The simulations further demonstrated that both growth factor loading and cell positioning relative to the predicted gradients critically influenced assay performance, leading to the optimization of the platform through spatial reconfiguration of the tumor compartment. Using the optimized configuration, we compared the migratory responses of neuroblastoma, Ewing sarcoma, and osteosarcoma cells to vascular (VEGF-A165) and lymphatic (VEGF-C) chemotactic cues. VEGF-C significantly increased migration through the microchannel array in Ewing sarcoma and osteosarcoma cells, whereas VEGF-A165 produced no significant effect. In contrast, neuroblastoma cells exhibited minimal migration under either condition, revealing tumor-specific differences in responsiveness to VEGF signaling. Together, these findings establish a computationally guided workflow for the rational design of metastasis-on-a-chip assays, in which predictive modeling informs experimental design before biological validation. By substantially reducing empirical trial-and-error while enabling quantitative control over growth factor exposure, this strategy provides a robust framework for developing minimally functional microphysiological systems capable of dissecting individual steps of the metastatic cascade under experimentally defined conditions. Translational Impact Statement

  Metastatic dissemination remains one of the greatest clinical challenges in pediatric oncology, yet experimental models capable of quantitatively evaluating early migratory events remain limited. The computationally guided MET-on-a-Chip workflow presented here provides a human-relevant platform in which soluble microenvironmental cues can be systematically investigated under controlled and predictive conditions. Although demonstrated here using VEGF-A165 and VEGF-C, the platform can be readily adapted to study virtually any chemotactic factor, cytokine, extracellular vesicle population, or therapeutic candidate involved in metastatic dissemination. The modular MFU design allows biological complexity to be incorporated progressively as dictated by the scientific question, providing a flexible framework for future applications. In the longer term, this workflow could be combined with patient-derived tumor cells, organoids, or biopsy material to investigate patient-specific metastatic behavior and evaluate anti-metastatic therapeutic strategies in a personalized setting. Beyond identifying pro-migratory signaling pathways, the platform may serve as a preclinical tool to prioritize compounds capable of preventing tumor cell dissemination before evaluation in more complex animal models or clinical studies.
abstractZh:
转移性扩散是由肿瘤细胞解读空间组织的生化和生物物理线索启动的，这些线索使用传统的迁移实验难以重现。在此，我们开发了一个基于最小功能单元（MFU）概念的计算引导的转移瘤芯片（MET-on-a-chip）平台，其中仅纳入回答特定实验问题所需的生物组分。该平台由两个独立的培养室组成，通过一系列受限微通道连接，允许可溶性因子扩散，同时限制肿瘤细胞迁移。我们并非依赖经验优化，而是首先使用有限元COMSOL模拟来预测分子传输、定义生长因子加载条件、识别生物学相关暴露区域，并指导微流体实验的合理设计。计算预测通过70-kDa FITC-葡聚糖扩散和VEGF释放研究进行了实验验证，确认了跨微流体平台稳定空间浓度梯度的形成。模拟进一步表明，生长因子加载和细胞相对于预测梯度的定位都关键影响实验性能，导致通过肿瘤隔室的空间重构来优化平台。使用优化配置，我们比较了神经母细胞瘤、尤文肉瘤和骨肉瘤细胞对血管（VEGF-A165）和淋巴（VEGF-C）趋化线索的迁移反应。VEGF-C显著增加了尤文肉瘤和骨肉瘤细胞通过微通道阵列的迁移，而VEGF-A165没有产生显著效果。相比之下，神经母细胞瘤细胞在任一条件下表现出最小迁移，揭示了肿瘤特异性对VEGF信号传导反应的差异。总之，这些发现建立了一个计算引导的工作流程，用于合理设计转移瘤芯片实验，其中预测建模在生物学验证之前指导实验设计。通过大幅减少经验性试错，同时实现对生长因子暴露的定量控制，该策略为开发能够在实验定义条件下解析转移级联各个步骤的最小功能微生理系统提供了稳健框架。转化影响声明

  转移性扩散仍然是儿科肿瘤学中最大的临床挑战之一，然而能够定量评估早期迁移事件的实验模型仍然有限。此处介绍的计算引导的MET-on-a-Chip工作流程提供了一个与人类相关的平台，其中可溶性微环境线索可以在受控和预测条件下系统研究。虽然此处使用VEGF-A165和VEGF-C进行演示，但该平台可以轻松适应研究涉及转移性扩散的任何趋化因子、细胞因子、细胞外囊泡群体或治疗候选物。模块化MFU设计允许根据科学问题逐步纳入生物复杂性，为未来应用提供了灵活框架。从长远来看，该工作流程可以与患者来源的肿瘤细胞、类器官或活检材料结合，以研究患者特定的转移行为并在个性化环境中评估抗转移治疗策略。除了识别促迁移信号通路外，该平台还可以作为临床前工具，在更复杂的动物模型或临床研究评估之前，优先考虑能够阻止肿瘤细胞扩散的化合物。

title: Proteomic analysis reveals WNT3a, TGFβ, and cAMP-dependent cell type differentiation in gastric antral mucosoids
titleZh: 蛋白质组学分析揭示WNT3a、TGFβ和cAMP依赖性细胞类型分化在胃窦黏膜类器官中
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Ehsani M, Quevedo-Olmos A, Moustafa A, Moritz M, Siebels B, Brauer A, Wang S, Zhang X, Riedel L, Mackelenbergh MTMv, Ordemann J, Wiegand S, Hahn J, Hedemann N, Holthaus D, Meyer TF.
abstract: Abstract    Two-dimensional gastric organoid-derived mucosoids provide a physiologically relevant model for studying epithelial differentiation and function. We demonstrated that withdrawal of WNT3a (WNT) and TGFβ inhibitor promotes differentiation and compartmentalization in human gastric mucosoids without impairing functionality. This results in a phenotype resembling the  in vivo  antral glands. Compared with WNT/TGFβi  +  conditions, WNT/TGFβi  -  cultures exhibited increased cell height, enhanced barrier function, and reduced cell density, accompanied by reduced stemness markers and increased tight junction and secreted factors. Phenotypically, WNT/TGFβi⁻ cultures resembled the antral gland tip, showing increased MUC5AC expression, whereas WNT/TGFβi⁺ condition maintained gland base–like features with higher nuclear density. We applied the adenylyl cyclase activator Forskolin (FSK), which enhanced expression of mucus and hormone-related marker without additional WNT supplementation. Differential proteomic confirmed that withdrawal of WNT and TGFβ inhibitor shift cells from stemness toward differentiated epithelial states with enhanced tight junctions and secretory features. FSK promoted a more parietal cell-like state, dependent on the absence of WNT and TGFβ inhibition. Proteomic analysis revealed that the mucus layer has a protein composition distinct from matched cellular lysates, enriched in extracellular matrix, immune, antimicrobial, coagulation, and GPCR-related proteins. This mucus signature was conserved across organoid lines despite marked donor-to-donor variability. WNT, TGFβ, and cAMP signalling further shaped the composition of the mucus proteome while preserving patient-specific protein signatures. We show that the withdrawal of WNT and TGFβ inhibition alone is sufficient to drive broad epithelial differentiation of cells and the enrichment of multiple differentiated subpopulations, without the need for supplementation of additional growth factors. At the same time, standard culture protocols can be used to preserve the proliferative zone, enabling study of both compartments of the gland. Together, these findings establish gastric mucosoids as a versatile model to investigate epithelial differentiation, functional compartmentalization, and secretion with enhanced  in vitro  differentiation.
abstractZh: 摘要  二维胃类器官来源的黏膜类器官为研究上皮分化和功能提供了生理相关模型。我们证明，撤除WNT3a（WNT）和TGFβ抑制剂可促进人胃黏膜类器官的分化和区室化，且不损害功能。这导致表型类似于体内胃窦腺体。与WNT/TGFβi+条件相比，WNT/TGFβi-培养物表现出细胞高度增加、屏障功能增强和细胞密度降低，同时伴随干性标志物减少以及紧密连接和分泌因子增加。表型上，WNT/TGFβi⁻培养物类似于胃窦腺体顶部，MUC5AC表达增加，而WNT/TGFβi⁺条件维持了腺体基部样特征，核密度更高。我们应用了腺苷酸环化酶激活剂毛喉素（FSK），在不额外补充WNT的情况下，增强了黏液和激素相关标志物的表达。差异蛋白质组学证实，撤除WNT和TGFβ抑制剂使细胞从干性状态转向分化上皮状态，并增强紧密连接和分泌特征。FSK促进了更类似壁细胞的状态，这依赖于WNT和TGFβ抑制的缺失。蛋白质组学分析显示，黏液层的蛋白质组成与匹配的细胞裂解物不同，富含细胞外基质、免疫、抗菌、凝血和GPCR相关蛋白。尽管供体间存在显著差异，这种黏液特征在类器官系中保守。WNT、TGFβ和cAMP信号进一步塑造了黏液蛋白质组的组成，同时保留了患者特异性蛋白质特征。我们表明，仅撤除WNT和TGFβ抑制就足以驱动细胞的广泛上皮分化以及多种分化亚群的富集，无需补充额外生长因子。同时，标准培养方案可用于保留增殖区，从而能够研究腺体的两个区室。总之，这些发现将胃黏膜类器官确立为一种多功能模型，用于研究上皮分化、功能性区室化和分泌，并增强体外分化。

title: Organoid research in diabetes and cardiovascular diseases: bibliometric mapping of knowledge evolution and emerging frontiers in organ-on-a-chip systems, bioprinting, artificial intelligence, and multi-omics
titleZh: 类器官在糖尿病和心血管疾病中的研究：知识演化与器官芯片系统、生物打印、人工智能和多组学新兴前沿的文献计量图谱
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Fu C, Li C, Li Y, Gao X, Han B, Zhang H, Liu S, Wang F, Zeng Q.
abstract: Abstract  Background  Diabetes mellitus and cardiovascular diseases exhibit strong comorbidity, while organoid- and organ-on-a-chip-based three-dimensional (3D) in vitro systems have emerged as promising platforms for disease modeling and drug discovery. However, a comprehensive bibliometric overview of this rapidly evolving interdisciplinary field remains limited. Objective  This study aimed to systematically map the global research landscape, knowledge evolution, collaboration networks, and emerging frontiers of organoid and organ-on-a-chip research in diabetes and cardiovascular diseases. Methods  A total of 802 publications were retrieved from the Web of Science Core Collection (2016–2025). Bibliometric analyses were performed using CiteSpace, VOSviewer, and the bibliometrix R package, focusing on publication trends, country/institutional collaboration networks, author productivity, journal distribution, and keyword co-occurrence and burst detection. Results  The number of publications demonstrated a sustained upward trend with an annual growth rate of 19.83%, reaching a peak in 2025 (n = 163). The United States (n = 310) and China (n = 204) were the leading contributors. The research focus has evolved from early-stage 3D culture system establishment toward high-fidelity disease modeling and multi-technology integration. Emerging hotspots include bioprinting, single-cell sequencing, and machine learning. Co-citation analysis highlighted human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived cardiac organoids and pancreatic islet organoids as central research themes. Conclusion  The field is undergoing a paradigm shift from organoid construction toward high-fidelity disease modeling and integrative functional analysis. A platform-based interdisciplinary framework integrating biomanufacturing, single-cell omics, and artificial intelligence is rapidly emerging, providing new opportunities for mechanistic studies and translational research in cardiometabolic diseases.
abstractZh:
摘要

背景
糖尿病和心血管疾病表现出强烈的共病性，而基于类器官和器官芯片的三维（3D）体外系统已成为疾病建模和药物发现的有前景平台。然而，对这一快速发展的跨学科领域进行全面文献计量概述仍然有限。

目的
本研究旨在系统描绘类器官和器官芯片在糖尿病和心血管疾病研究中的全球研究格局、知识演化、合作网络和新兴前沿。

方法
从Web of Science核心合集（2016-2025年）检索到共802篇出版物。使用CiteSpace、VOSviewer和bibliometrix R包进行文献计量分析，重点关注出版趋势、国家/机构合作网络、作者生产力、期刊分布以及关键词共现和突现检测。

结果
出版物数量呈现持续上升趋势，年增长率为19.83%，在2025年达到峰值（n=163）。美国（n=310）和中国（n=204）是主要贡献者。研究焦点已从早期3D培养系统的建立转向高保真疾病建模和多技术整合。新兴热点包括生物打印、单细胞测序和机器学习。共被引分析强调人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）来源的心脏类器官和胰岛类器官是核心研究主题。

结论
该领域正在经历从类器官构建向高保真疾病建模和整合功能分析的范式转变。一个整合生物制造、单细胞组学和人工智能的基于平台的跨学科框架正在迅速出现，为心脏代谢疾病的机制研究和转化研究提供了新机遇。

title: An organ-on-chip model of vulvovaginal candidiasis to study the interplay between fungal pathogenicity and inflammation
titleZh: 一种用于研究真菌致病性与炎症相互作用的阴道念珠菌病器官芯片模型
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Cheng KO, Gross VE, Cseresnyés Z, Kolchanova M, Pullin Ö, Gürel E, Figge L, Zelante T, Dietschmann A, Zimmermann A, Valentine M, Mosig AS, Montaño DE, Alonso-Roman R, Figge MT, Gresnigt MS.
abstract: Abstract    Vulvovaginal candidiasis (VVC) is a mucosal yeast infection that affects most women at least once in their lifetime, and exhibits severe recurrence (RVVC) in a subset of patients. The onset of (R)VVC is linked to a complex interplay between fungal pathogenicity and excessive innate immune responses driving neutrophilic inflammation that mediates disease progression. The current state of knowledge of VVC pathogenesis is established based on patient studies, animal models, and  in vitro  cell culture models. Conventional monolayer epithelial infection models cannot simulate recruitment of inflammatory neutrophils, a hallmark of VVC pathogenesis, whereas murine animal models exhibit some interspecies differences in the immune system. Recent advances in microfluidic organ-on-chip systems enabled us to establish a vulvovaginal-candidiasis (VVC)-on-chip model that simulates infection of vaginal mucosa by  Candida albicans  and can be used to study innate immune responses driving neutrophil-mediated inflammation.  C. albicans  infection elicits proinflammatory responses that induce neutrophil recruitment to the vaginal epithelium in the chip. Neutrophils were found to swarm towards sites of  C. albicans-  infected epithelium, which was visualized and quantified  via  3D object-based segmentation analysis. While recruited neutrophils fail to fully clear the infection, they exacerbate proinflammatory cytokine responses, consistent with clinical observations. Overall, this VVC-on-chip model represents a novel tool to dissect mechanisms driving the immunopathology of VVC. Moreover, it also provides a platform for studying host-pathogen interactions at the vaginal epithelial interface as well as evaluation of both pathogen- and host-directed therapies.
abstractZh: 摘要 外阴阴道念珠菌病（VVC）是一种黏膜酵母菌感染，大多数女性一生中至少感染一次，并且在部分患者中表现出严重复发（RVVC）。(R)VVC的发病与真菌致病性和过度先天免疫反应之间的复杂相互作用有关，这些反应驱动中性粒细胞炎症，从而介导疾病进展。目前关于VVC发病机制的知识是基于患者研究、动物模型和体外细胞培养模型建立的。传统的单层上皮感染模型无法模拟炎症性中性粒细胞的募集，而这是VVC发病机制的一个标志，而小鼠动物模型在免疫系统方面存在一些种间差异。微流控器官芯片系统的最新进展使我们能够建立一种外阴阴道念珠菌病（VVC）芯片模型，该模型模拟白色念珠菌对阴道黏膜的感染，并可用于研究驱动中性粒细胞介导炎症的先天免疫反应。白色念珠菌感染引发促炎反应，诱导中性粒细胞募集到芯片中的阴道上皮。通过3D基于对象的分割分析，可视化并量化了中性粒细胞向白色念珠菌感染上皮部位的聚集。虽然募集的中性粒细胞未能完全清除感染，但它们加剧了促炎细胞因子反应，这与临床观察结果一致。总体而言，这种VVC芯片模型代表了一种剖析VVC免疫病理学驱动机制的新工具。此外，它还为研究阴道上皮界面的宿主-病原体相互作用以及评估针对病原体和宿主的疗法提供了一个平台。

title: MASH Background Confers Enhanced Disease Susceptibility and Acetaminophen Toxicity in iPSC-Derived Liver Organoids.
titleZh: MASH背景赋予iPSC来源肝脏类器官增强的疾病易感性和对乙酰氨基酚毒性。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Minocha E, Gupta AK, Schmidt N, Green RM, Purdy JG, Wertheim JA.
affiliations: Department of Surgery, College of Medicine, University of Arizona, Tucson, Arizona, USA.
Bio5 Institute, University of Arizona, Tucson, Arizona, USA.
Surgery Service, Southern Arizona VA Health Care System, Tucson, Arizona, USA.
Department of Immunobiology, University of Arizona College of Medicine, Tucson, Arizona, USA.
Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine, Chicago, Illinois, USA.
Department of Biomedical Engineering, University of Arizona, Tucson, Arizona, USA.
abstract: Organoids derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) serve as advanced multicellular models for studying human organ development and disease. Recent liver organoid platforms focus on achieving multicellular organization while minimizing reliance on xenogeneic extracellular matrices to support future clinical translation. Building on these advances, this study establishes a xenogeneic-free strategy that develops the hepatic cellular repertoire with interdigitating vasculature using an air-liquid interface approach, generating highly vascularized, multicellular, and functional liver organoids from de-identified control and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) donor-derived iPSCs. Phenotypic and functional characterization confirms the presence of hepatocytes, cholangiocytes, stellate cells, sinusoidal endothelial cells, and Kupffer-like cells. These organoids demonstrate the capacity to model steatohepatitis following free-fatty acid exposure and predict acetaminophen-induced drug toxicity. Organoids derived from MASH-donors exhibit increased susceptibility to steatosis, inflammation, fibrosis, and acetaminophen-induced toxicity. Lipidomic profiling reveals that MASH phenotype in organoids induces global lipidomic shifts that closely resemble those observed in MASH liver biopsies. Further post-transplantation into mice, the organoids retain hepatic cell repertoire, establish functional anastomoses with host vasculature, display intraluminal erythrocytes, and secrete human-specific albumin, validating their translational potential. This approach provides a robust, xenogeneic-free platform for disease modeling, evaluating drug responses, and exploring regenerative therapies.
abstractZh: 源自人类诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）的类器官作为研究人类器官发育和疾病的高级多细胞模型。最近的肝脏类器官平台侧重于实现多细胞组织，同时尽量减少对异种细胞外基质的依赖，以支持未来的临床转化。在这些进展的基础上，本研究建立了一种无异种策略，通过气液界面方法发展具有交错血管的肝细胞谱系，从去标识化的对照和代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）供体来源的iPSCs生成高度血管化、多细胞且功能性的肝脏类器官。表型和功能表征确认了肝细胞、胆管细胞、星状细胞、肝窦内皮细胞和库普弗样细胞的存在。这些类器官展示了在游离脂肪酸暴露后模拟脂肪性肝炎的能力，并预测对乙酰氨基酚诱导的药物毒性。源自MASH供体的类器官表现出对脂肪变性、炎症、纤维化和对乙酰氨基酚诱导毒性的易感性增加。脂质组学分析揭示，类器官中的MASH表型诱导了与MASH肝活检中观察到的密切相似的全局脂质组学变化。进一步移植到小鼠体内后，类器官保留了肝细胞谱系，与宿主血管建立功能性吻合，显示腔内红细胞，并分泌人特异性白蛋白，验证了其转化潜力。该方法为疾病建模、评估药物反应和探索再生疗法提供了一个 robust、无异种的平台。

title: Porcine Airway Organoids Reveal Strain-Associated Replication and Epithelial Host Response Signatures of a Reassortant H1N1 Virus.
titleZh: 猪气道类器官揭示重配H1N1病毒的株相关复制和上皮宿主反应特征。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Lee H, Shin Y, Heo JY, Yu A, Park JH, Cho K, Park HS, Chae DH, Kim J, Jee S, Kim C, Oh MK, Song D, Yu KR.
affiliations: Department of Agricultural Biotechnology and Research Institute of Agriculture and Life Sciences, Seoul National University, Seoul 08826, Korea.
Department of Virology, College of Veterinary Medicine and Research Institute for Veterinary Science, Seoul National University, Seoul, 08826, Republic of Korea.
abstract: Pigs serve as mixing vessels for influenza A viruses, facilitating reassortment and the emergence of variants with zoonotic potential. Since the 2009 pandemic, human-origin influenza gene segments have been repeatedly detected in swine populations, contributing to the generation of genetically diverse reassortant viruses. However, assessing the infection phenotypes and epithelial host responses of newly emerging reassortant swine influenza viruses remains challenging using conventional in vitro and in vivo approaches. Here, we established long-term expanding three-dimensional porcine airway organoids (pAOs) as a platform for the phenotypic and transcriptomic characterization of reassortant influenza viruses. We compared the infection phenotypes of a recently identified reassortant H1N1 virus, SNU01/H1N1/2023, with those of a classical swine-lineage H1N1 strain, GC0503/H1N1/2005, and the 2009 pandemic strain, CA04/H1N1/2009. All viruses productively infected pAOs, while SNU01 yielded higher levels of infectious progeny than the comparator strains. Bulk transcriptomic profiling at 24 h post-infection revealed that SNU01 infection was associated with an epithelial host-response profile more similar to CA04 than to GC0503, characterized by stronger epithelial antiviral and inflammatory transcriptional activation. Notably, SNU01 infection was associated with distinct cytoskeleton-associated transcriptional programs that were not prominent in the comparator infections. These findings demonstrate that porcine airway organoids can distinguish strain-associated differences in viral replication and epithelial host responses, providing a tractable platform for the comparative characterization of reassortant influenza viruses.
abstractZh: 猪作为甲型流感病毒的混合容器，促进基因重配和具有人畜共患潜力的变异株的出现。自2009年大流行以来，人源流感基因片段在猪群中反复被检测到，促进了遗传多样性重配病毒的产生。然而，使用传统的体外和体内方法评估新出现的重配猪流感病毒的感染表型和上皮宿主反应仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们建立了长期扩增的三维猪气道类器官（pAOs）作为重配流感病毒表型和转录组学特征描述的平台。我们比较了最近鉴定的重配H1N1病毒SNU01/H1N1/2023与经典猪谱系H1N1株GC0503/H1N1/2005以及2009年大流行株CA04/H1N1/2009的感染表型。所有病毒均能有效感染pAOs，而SNU01产生的感染性子代病毒高于对照株。感染后24小时的批量转录组学分析显示，SNU01感染相关的上皮宿主反应谱更接近CA04而非GC0503，其特征是更强的上皮抗病毒和炎症转录激活。值得注意的是，SNU01感染与独特的细胞骨架相关转录程序相关，这些程序在对照感染中不显著。这些发现表明，猪气道类器官可以区分病毒复制和上皮宿主反应中株相关的差异，为比较表征重配流感病毒提供了一个易处理的平台。

title: Beyond H5N1: influenza A virus infection in bovine udder organoids.
titleZh: 超越H5N1：牛乳腺类器官中的甲型流感病毒感染
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Fritsch H, Arora P, Yan M, Grotha I, Pfarrer C, Becher P.
affiliations: Institute of Virology, University of Veterinary Medicine Hannover, Hannover, Germany.
Institute for Anatomy, University of Veterinary Medicine Hannover, Hannover, Germany.
abstract: Influenza A viruses (IAVs) have recently expanded their host range to bovine species, raising critical questions about tissue tropism, viral replication capacity, and impacts on dairy production and zoonotic risk. Extensive shedding of highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAIV) H5N1 in milk from naturally infected cattle in the USA highlights the bovine mammary gland as a relevant site of viral replication. To investigate these dynamics, we established and characterized bovine mammary gland organoids (MGOs) derived from primary epithelial cells and maintained in chemically defined media. This efficient, scalable model reconstructs structural and functional hallmarks of the bovine udder, including luminal-basal polarity, lineage-specific cytokeratin patterns, and lactation-associated differentiation. We then used this system to study low and highly pathogenic avian, as well as swine and human IAVs. Viruses from diverse host species productively infected MGOs, largely independent of culturing conditions. Mammalian origin H1N1 strains matched bovine H5N1 in efficiency, but low pathogenic avian H9N2 showed restricted replication, indicating subtype-specific differences in mammary tropism. This suitability study develops a MGO platform that provides a tractable basis for detailed molecular investigation of mammary infection biology and influenza pathogenesis in cattle, to inform strategies that protect both animal and public health.
abstractZh: 甲型流感病毒（IAVs）最近将其宿主范围扩展至牛科动物，引发了关于组织嗜性、病毒复制能力以及对乳制品生产和人畜共患病风险的关键问题。美国自然感染牛只的乳汁中大量排出高致病性禽流感病毒（HPAIV）H5N1，凸显了牛乳腺作为病毒复制相关部位的重要性。为研究这些动态，我们建立并表征了源自原代上皮细胞并在化学成分明确培养基中维持的牛乳腺类器官（MGOs）。这一高效、可扩展的模型重建了牛乳房的结构和功能特征，包括腔-基底极性、谱系特异性细胞角蛋白模式以及泌乳相关分化。随后，我们利用该系统研究了低致病性和高致病性禽流感病毒，以及猪源和人源IAVs。来自不同宿主物种的病毒均能有效感染MGOs，且在很大程度上不依赖于培养条件。哺乳动物来源的H1N1毒株在感染效率上与牛源H5N1相当，但低致病性禽H9N2表现出受限的复制，表明乳腺嗜性存在亚型特异性差异。这项适用性研究开发了一个MGO平台，为详细研究牛乳腺感染生物学和流感发病机制的分子机制提供了易处理的实验基础，以助力制定保护动物和公众健康的策略。

title: Nanomaterials for the Prevention, Detection, and Treatment of Pharyngeal Human Papillomavirus Infection: A Translational Roadmap.
titleZh: 纳米材料用于咽部人乳头瘤病毒感染的预防、检测和治疗：转化路线图。

authors: Paun LA, Dumitru M, Iacob DG, Patrascu OM, Vrinceanu D, Oanca R, Dragomir-Serboiu AD, Marinescu A, Cirstoiu MM.
affiliations: ENT Department, Carol Davila University of Medicine and Pharmacy, 020021 Bucharest, Romania.
Epidemiology and Infectious Diseases Department, Carol Davila University of Medicine and Pharmacy, 020021 Bucharest, Romania.

abstract: Pharyngeal infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV), particularly HPV16, is biologically distinct from cervical infection because it occurs within the specialized lymphoepithelial environment of Waldeyer's ring. This review evaluates nanoparticle materials for the prevention, detection, and treatment of pharyngeal HPV, with an emphasis on structure-property-function relationships, mucosal performance, and translational feasibility. Lipid nanoparticle platforms, polymeric nanoparticle platforms, inorganic systems, and hybrid platforms are compared with respect to composition, particle size distribution, surface charge, colloidal stability, biodegradability, payload compatibility, release behavior, and manufacturing complexity. Evidence suggests that lipid and polymeric systems are the most credible near-future candidates for mucosal vaccination and localized nucleic acid delivery because they offer the best balance between controllable fabrication, analytical tractability, and biologically plausible performance in mucus-exposed tissue. By contrast, the development of inorganic theranostics and CRISPR-enabled platforms remains at an earlier stage because repeated mucosal dosing, retention in lymphoid tissue, and combined product regulation impose substantial burdens. A translational roadmap is proposed in which material selection is guided by clinically relevant quality attributes, standardized saliva- and mucus-relevant assays, human tonsil organoid testing, and early attention to manufacturability, safety, and regulatory strategy. The field is promising, but direct pharyngeal HPV data remain limited; accordingly, there is an urgent need for comparative studies that connect nanoparticle architecture to measurable outcomes such as tonsillar deposition, epithelial uptake, immune activation, and local tolerability.
abstractZh: 咽部感染高危型人乳头瘤病毒（HPV），特别是HPV16，在生物学上与宫颈感染不同，因为它发生在咽淋巴环（Waldeyer环）的特殊淋巴上皮环境中。本综述评估了用于咽部HPV预防、检测和治疗的纳米颗粒材料，重点强调了结构-性能-功能关系、黏膜表现和转化可行性。脂质纳米颗粒平台、聚合物纳米颗粒平台、无机系统和混合平台在组成、粒径分布、表面电荷、胶体稳定性、生物降解性、载荷兼容性、释放行为和生产复杂性方面进行了比较。证据表明，脂质和聚合物系统是黏膜疫苗和局部核酸递送最可信的近期候选者，因为它们在可控制造、分析可处理性和在黏液暴露组织中的生物学合理表现之间提供了最佳平衡。相比之下，无机治疗诊断学和CRISPR使能平台的发展仍处于早期阶段，因为重复黏膜给药、在淋巴组织中的滞留以及联合产品监管带来了巨大负担。提出了一条转化路线图，其中材料选择以临床相关的质量属性、标准化的唾液和黏液相关检测、人扁桃体类器官测试以及早期对可制造性、安全性和监管策略的关注为指导。该领域前景广阔，但直接的咽部HPV数据仍然有限；因此，迫切需要将纳米颗粒结构与可测量结果（如扁桃体沉积、上皮摄取、免疫激活和局部耐受性）联系起来的比较研究。

title: Novel ALG13 Variants and an Expanded Neurodevelopmental Spectrum: Genotype-Phenotype Correlations.
titleZh: 新型ALG13变异与扩展的神经发育谱系：基因型-表型关联。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Su S, Hu W, Ren Y, Zhang T, Yu C, Zhang H.
affiliations: Neurology Department, Children's Hospital Affiliated to Shandong University, Jinan, Shandong, China.
Neurology Department, Jinan Children's Hospital, Jinan, Shandong, China.
abstract:
Background

The ALG13 gene is implicated in congenital disorders of glycosylation (CDG) and developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE), yet genotype-phenotype correlations remain incompletely understood.Methods

Whole-exome sequencing (WES) was performed in unrelated families, and we systematically reviewed existing patient data on ALG13 variants and investigated the expression patterns of ALG13 using organoid models.Results

This study reports five patients with ALG13 variants, including two novel variants. Four patients presented with epilepsy accompanied by neurodevelopmental impairment, including infantile epileptic spasms syndrome (IESS) and drug-resistant epilepsy, whereas one patient showed developmental delay without seizures. Further analysis revealed that variants identified in patients with isolated developmental delay were primarily located outside the key glycosylation functional domain. Statistical analysis of patients with epileptic encephalopathy showed that infantile-onset seizures were the predominant feature, with most cases being refractory to treatment. Additionally, in organoids, the highest ALG13 expression was observed at 1 month in ectodermal-derived neurons (EN). At 5 months, peak expression shifted to deep-layer cortical neurons (EN-CTX-Deep).Conclusions

ALG13 variants are associated with a broad phenotypic spectrum ranging from DEE to neurodevelopmental impairment without seizures. Our findings support a possible domain-related genotype-phenotype association and provide additional developmental context for the role of ALG13 in neurodevelopmental disorders. Further functional studies are required to clarify the pathogenic mechanisms of different ALG13 variants.
abstractZh:
背景

ALG13基因与先天性糖基化障碍（CDG）和发育性及癫痫性脑病（DEE）有关，但基因型-表型关联仍不完全清楚。方法

对无亲缘关系的家系进行全外显子组测序（WES），并系统回顾了现有ALG13变异患者数据，利用类器官模型研究了ALG13的表达模式。结果

本研究报道了5例携带ALG13变异的患者，包括两个新变异。其中4例患者表现为癫痫伴神经发育障碍，包括婴儿癫痫性痉挛综合征（IESS）和药物难治性癫痫，而1例患者仅表现为发育迟缓而无癫痫发作。进一步分析显示，在孤立性发育迟缓患者中发现的变异主要位于关键糖基化功能域之外。对癫痫性脑病患者的统计分析显示，婴儿期起病的癫痫是主要特征，且大多数病例对治疗无效。此外，在类器官中，ALG13表达在1个月时在外胚层来源神经元（EN）中最高。在5个月时，表达峰值转移至深层皮质神经元（EN-CTX-Deep）。结论

ALG13变异与从DEE到无癫痫发作的神经发育障碍的广泛表型谱相关。我们的发现支持可能存在与结构域相关的基因型-表型关联，并为ALG13在神经发育障碍中的作用提供了额外的发育背景。需要进一步的功能研究来阐明不同ALG13变异的致病机制。

title: IL-13 Induces a Tuft Cell-Intrinsic CD45 Checkpoint to Limit Intestinal Type 2 Immunity
titleZh: IL-13诱导簇细胞内在CD45检查点以限制肠道2型免疫
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Sochen C, Lebon S, Habshush-Menachem A, Sarusi-Portuguez A, Holiar V, Rudenko V, Toval B, Liu J, Levin Y, Vaaknin E, Rosenthal N, Tiferet N, Orr I, Ben-Dor S, Haffner-Krausz R, Grencis RK, Munitz A, Karo-Atar D, Shulman Z, Biton M.
abstract: Tuft cells initiate intestinal type 2 immunity, yet the mechanisms that restrain excessive tuft cell activation remain poorly understood. Here, we identify the receptor tyrosine phosphatase CD45 (  Ptprc ), previously considered a hematopoietic marker, as a regulator of intestinal tuft cell function. CD45 expression is restricted to a subset of tuft cells and is induced by helminth infection and IL-13. Epithelial-specific deletion of  Ptprc activated a tuft cell inflammatory program, promoted an epithelial inflammatory state, and increased eosinophil accumulation at homeostasis. During  Heligmosomoides polygyrus bakeri infection, CD45 deficiency enhanced ILC2 and Th2 responses and reduced parasite burden, demonstrating that epithelial CD45 limits type 2 immunity  in vivo . Accordingly, in intestinal organoids, CD45 was dispensable for IL-13-driven tuft cell differentiation but restrained IL-13-responsive transcriptional programs. Mechanistically, CD45-deficient tuft cells exhibited altered protein abundance of STAT5 and IL17RB, implicated in tuft cell immune regulation. Together, these findings identify CD45 as a tuft cell-intrinsic regulatory checkpoint that restrains intestinal type 2 immunity through an IL-13-induced negative-feedback circuit.
abstractZh: 簇细胞启动肠道2型免疫，但限制簇细胞过度活化的机制仍知之甚少。在此，我们鉴定受体酪氨酸磷酸酶CD45（Ptprc），先前被认为是造血标志物，作为肠道簇细胞功能的调节因子。CD45表达限于簇细胞亚群，并由蠕虫感染和IL-13诱导。上皮特异性缺失Ptprc激活簇细胞炎症程序，促进上皮炎症状态，并在稳态下增加嗜酸性粒细胞积累。在巴西日圆线虫感染期间，CD45缺陷增强ILC2和Th2反应并减少寄生虫负担，证明上皮CD45在体内限制2型免疫。相应地，在肠道类器官中，CD45对于IL-13驱动的簇细胞分化是可有可无的，但限制IL-13反应性转录程序。机制上，CD45缺陷簇细胞表现出STAT5和IL17RB蛋白丰度改变，这些蛋白与簇细胞免疫调节有关。总之，这些发现将CD45确定为簇细胞内在调节检查点，通过IL-13诱导的负反馈回路限制肠道2型免疫。

title: A high throughput system reveals distinct segmentation clock phase responses in hiPSC-derived organoids
titleZh: 一种高通量系统揭示hiPSC衍生类器官中不同的分节钟相位响应
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Gallagher RL, Meijer HA, Hetherington A, Kalamara M, Davidson L, Langlands A, Dale JK, Murray PJ.
abstract:
During somitogenesis, the vertebrate body axis segments into transient periodic structures known as somites. Somite formation is regulated by a multicellular molecular oscillator known as the segmentation clock. Recent advances in human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) culture have shown that hiPSC-derived somitogenesis organoids (somitoids) exhibit segmentation clock oscillations and can be produced at scale, making them an excellent model system for high throughput investigation of the mechanisms underpinning the segmentation clock. However, somitoids interact both biochemically and mechanically, and accurate high-throughput sampling of segmentation clock phases is required to exploit this system effectively. Here we address these challenges using an image-based, high-content screening workflow. Individual hiPSC-derived somitoids carrying a segmentation clock reporter are cultured in 384-well plates, and a programmable feeding schedule is used to initiate oscillations that are monitored using fluorescence microscopy. We develop an automated pipeline for image segmentation and data analysis, represent oscillations using a compact set of parameters, and construct predictive mathematical models to interpret data. We find that: (i) a staggered feeding schedule that sequentially initiates oscillations yields large numbers of somitoids at defined stages of the segmentation clock cycle; (ii) media exchange in established oscillations induces a Type 0-like phase response, resetting the segmentation clock to a state characterised by low NOTCH pathway transcription; and (iii) control wells in media exchange experiments exhibit a Type 1 phase response in which the segmentation clock is delayed non-uniformly across the cycle. Using a mathematical model of segmentation clock dynamics along the anterior-posterior axis, we show that periodic activation of a Type 1 phase response could segment a continuous phase gradient — an insight with potential implications for the determination of somite boundaries  in vivo . abstractZh:
在体节形成过程中，脊椎动物体轴被分割成称为体节的周期性瞬时结构。体节的形成受一种称为分节钟的多细胞分子振荡器调控。近年来，人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）培养的进展表明，hiPSC衍生的体节发生类器官（somitoids）表现出分节钟振荡，并且可以大规模生产，使其成为高通量研究分节钟机制的优秀模型系统。然而，somitoids之间既存在生化相互作用也存在机械相互作用，并且需要准确的高通量采样分节钟相位才能有效利用该系统。在这里，我们使用基于图像的高内涵筛选工作流程来解决这些挑战。携带分节钟报告基因的单个hiPSC衍生somitoids在384孔板中培养，并使用可编程的加样计划启动振荡，通过荧光显微镜监测。我们开发了用于图像分割和数据分析的自动化流程，用一组紧凑的参数表示振荡，并构建预测性数学模型来解释数据。我们发现：（i）交错加样计划依次启动振荡，产生大量处于分节钟周期特定阶段的somitoids；（ii）在已建立的振荡中更换培养基会诱导0型样相位响应，将分节钟重置为以NOTCH通路转录低为特征的状态；（iii）培养基更换实验中的对照孔表现出1型相位响应，其中分节钟在周期内非均匀延迟。使用沿前后轴的分节钟动力学数学模型，我们表明周期性激活1型相位响应可以分割连续的相位梯度——这一见解对体内体节边界的确定具有潜在意义。

title: From patient to tumor organoid: Culture protocol choice controls glioblastoma tumor architecture and identity.

abstract: Patient-derived tumor organoids are widely used in cancer research, yet the biological impact of tissue processing during model generation remains unclear. Fragment-based and dissociation-based (DIS) approaches are commonly assumed to trade fidelity for uniformity, but their molecular consequences remain incompletely defined. To address this gap, we performed a proteome-wide comparison of fragment-based (cut-and-culture [CUT]) and DIS glioblastoma organoid protocols using quantitative mass spectrometry. Organoids from multiple patient tumors were cultured under growth factor-free or growth factor-supplemented conditions and compared with matched primary tissue. Results show that both protocols produced technically robust glioblastoma organoids when maintained in their native media. However, CUT organoids matched the reproducibility of DIS cultures while preserving a broader extracellular matrix (ECM) repertoire and networks linked to collagen assembly, vascular support, and cell-matrix signaling. DIS cultures were biased toward exogenous basement membrane components and proliferative, growth factor-responsive states. Across tumors, CUT organoids consistently showed greater proteomic similarity to matched primary tissue, retaining neural, glial, stromal, and extracellular features largely absent from DIS models. Taken together, fragment-based glioblastoma organoids can be both reproducible and biologically faithful. Tissue dissociation acts as a major perturbation that reshapes ECM organization, cellular states, and tumor identity, making protocol choice a critical determinant of model fidelity and translational relevance.
abstractZh: 患者来源的肿瘤类器官在癌症研究中被广泛使用，然而模型生成过程中组织处理对生物学的影响仍不清楚。基于片段和基于解离（DIS）的方法通常被认为在保真度和均一性之间进行权衡，但其分子后果尚未完全明确。为填补这一空白，我们使用定量质谱法对基于片段（切割培养[CUT]）和DIS胶质母细胞瘤类器官方案进行了蛋白质组范围的比较。来自多名患者肿瘤的类器官在无生长因子或补充生长因子的条件下培养，并与匹配的原发组织进行比较。结果表明，两种方案在各自的原培养基中维持时，均能产生技术上稳健的胶质母细胞瘤类器官。然而，CUT类器官在匹配DIS培养的可重复性的同时，保留了更广泛的细胞外基质（ECM）组成以及与胶原组装、血管支持和细胞-基质信号传导相关的网络。DIS培养则偏向于外源性基底膜成分以及增殖性、生长因子反应性状态。在不同肿瘤中，CUT类器官始终显示出与匹配原发组织更高的蛋白质组相似性，保留了在DIS模型中大多缺失的神经、胶质、基质和细胞外特征。综上所述，基于片段的胶质母细胞瘤类器官既能具有可重复性，又能保持生物学保真度。组织解离作为一种主要扰动，重塑了ECM组织、细胞状态和肿瘤特性，使方案选择成为模型保真度和转化相关性的关键决定因素。

abstract: Drug-induced liver injury (DILI) remains a major challenge for drug development, contributing to adverse events in patients and regulatory setbacks. Traditional nonclinical approaches frequently fail to predict DILI due to interspecies differences and complex DILI mechanisms. Microphysiological systems (MPS) offer a promising alternative by recreating dynamic drug exposure, human-relevant metabolism, and organotypic features central to DILI pathogenesis. However, broader industry and regulatory adoption is limited by lack of confidence, platform variability, and lack of benchmarks. This manuscript describes the process of designing a cross-platform evaluation of eight commercially available liver MPS, conducted through a public-private partnership between the 3Rs Collaborative and FDA's Center for Drug Evaluation and Research. It ultimately focused on using liver MPS for defined Context of Use: retrospective assessment of elevated liver signals in early clinical trials. The team created a harmonized experimental strategy with blinded compounds, common endpoints, and independent data analysis to define category-level performance expectations rather than rank individual systems. This effort represents the first design of a systematic, category-level comparison of liver MPS for a regulatory application. It provides a blueprint for advancing New Approach Methodologies for regulatory use, strengthening confidence in human-relevant models for drug safety assessment.
abstractZh: 药物性肝损伤（DILI）仍然是药物开发的主要挑战，导致患者不良事件和监管挫折。传统的非临床方法由于种间差异和复杂的DILI机制，常常无法预测DILI。微生理系统（MPS）通过重现动态药物暴露、人类相关代谢和与DILI发病机制相关的器官型特征，提供了一种有前景的替代方案。然而，由于缺乏信心、平台变异性和缺乏基准，更广泛的行业和监管采用受到限制。本手稿描述了设计八种市售肝脏MPS跨平台评估的过程，该评估通过3Rs协作组织与美国食品药品监督管理局药物评价与研究中心的公私合作伙伴关系进行。最终重点在于使用肝脏MPS进行明确的预期用途：早期临床试验中肝脏信号升高的回顾性评估。团队创建了统一的实验策略，包括盲法化合物、共同终点和独立数据分析，以定义类别级性能预期，而非对个别系统进行排名。这项工作代表了首次为监管应用设计系统性、类别级肝脏MPS比较。它为推进新方法学用于监管用途提供了蓝图，增强了人类相关模型在药物安全性评估中的信心。

title: Clinical features and imaging diagnostic challenges of fetus-in-fetu associated with abdominal cryptorchidism: a case report.
titleZh: 胎儿内胎儿合并腹腔隐睾的临床特征与影像诊断挑战：一例病例报告。

abstract:
Background

Fetus-in-fetu (FIF) is a rare congenital anomaly in which a malformed monozygotic twin is incorporated within its host twin. FIF is usually retroperitoneal, whereas association with an intra-abdominal undescended testis is exceptionally uncommon. Because imaging may show a heterogeneous mass containing soft tissue, fat and calcified elements, FIF can be difficult to distinguish preoperatively from mature teratoma, especially when cryptorchidism is also present.Case presentation

A 3-day-old male neonate was admitted because of jaundice and a palpable right abdominal mass. Physical examination revealed an underdeveloped right hemiscrotum without a palpable right testis; the left testis was palpable and a left hydrocele was suspected. Prenatal ultrasound demonstrated a mixed echogenic mass in the right lower abdomen and raised the possibility of FIF. Fetal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and postnatal contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) showed a well-circumscribed cystic-solid abdominal mass with fat-like signal/density and multiple calcified stripe-like components, leading to diagnostic uncertainty between FIF and teratoma. Serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) showed no abnormal elevation after interpretation according to neonatal age. Exploratory laparotomy revealed a 5.0 cm x 4.0 cm x 4.0 cm encapsulated cystic-solid mass arising from the right intra-abdominal undescended testis, without identifiable viable right testicular parenchyma. The mass and the atrophic right testicular/epididymal tissue were excised. Gross and histopathological examination demonstrated an organized axial skeleton/spinal structure and multiple differentiated tissues, including brain, intestine, liver, bone, skeletal muscle, skin, and epididymal duct tissue, fulfilling the Willis criterion for FIF.Conclusions

This case highlights a very rare presentation of FIF associated with abdominal cryptorchidism. Recognition of calcified axial skeletal elements, fat components, organoid structures and the relationship to the spermatic cord/testicular structures may help pediatric surgeons and radiologists anticipate FIF rather than misdiagnosing the lesion as a testicular or abdominal teratoma. Complete surgical excision and long-term follow-up with ultrasonography and tumor markers are recommended.
abstractZh:
背景

胎儿内胎儿（FIF）是一种罕见的先天性异常，其中发育不良的单卵双胞胎被纳入其宿主双胞胎体内。FIF通常位于腹膜后，而与腹腔内未降睾丸的关联极为罕见。由于影像学可能显示含有软组织、脂肪和钙化成分的异质性肿块，FIF在术前难以与成熟畸胎瘤区分，尤其是当同时存在隐睾时。病例报告

一名3天大的男性新生儿因黄疸和可触及的右侧腹部肿块入院。体格检查显示右侧阴囊发育不良，未触及右侧睾丸；左侧睾丸可触及，并怀疑左侧鞘膜积液。产前超声显示右下腹部混合回声肿块，提示FIF的可能性。胎儿磁共振成像（MRI）和产后增强计算机断层扫描（CT）显示一个边界清晰的囊实性腹部肿块，具有脂肪样信号/密度和多个钙化条状成分，导致FIF与畸胎瘤之间的诊断不确定性。血清甲胎蛋白（AFP）和人绒毛膜促性腺激素（HCG）按新生儿年龄解读后未见异常升高。剖腹探查发现一个5.0厘米×4.0厘米×4.0厘米的包膜完整的囊实性肿块，起源于右侧腹腔内未降睾丸，未见可识别的存活右侧睾丸实质。肿块和萎缩的右侧睾丸/附睾组织被切除。大体和组织病理学检查显示有组织的轴向骨骼/脊柱结构和多种分化组织，包括脑、肠、肝、骨、骨骼肌、皮肤和附睾管组织，符合FIF的Willis标准。结论

本病例强调了FIF与腹腔隐睾相关的非常罕见表现。识别钙化的轴向骨骼成分、脂肪成分、类器官结构以及与精索/睾丸结构的关系，可能有助于儿科外科医生和放射科医生预判FIF，而不是将病变误诊为睾丸或腹部畸胎瘤。建议完全手术切除并进行长期随访，包括超声检查和肿瘤标志物监测。

title: Preclinical Pharmacological Evaluation of Sacituzumab Govitecan (IMMU-132) in TROP2-Positive Colorectal Liver Metastasis Models.
titleZh: Sacituzumab Govitecan (IMMU-132) 在TROP2阳性结直肠癌肝转移模型中的临床前药理学评价。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Zhang W, Wang R, Situ Y, Wang W, Peng J, Lu Z.
affiliations: Department of Colorectal Surgery, State Key Laboratory of Oncology in South China, Collaborative Innovation Center for Cancer Medicine, Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, 651 Dongfeng Road East, Guangzhou 510060, China.
abstract: Background/Objectives: Sacituzumab govitecan (SG, IMMU-132) is a TROP2-directed antibody-drug conjugate carrying SN-38. Patients with colorectal liver metastasis (CRLM) still have limited treatment options after first-line systemic therapy, and the preclinical pharmacological value of TROP2-directed SN-38 delivery in CRLM remains insufficiently defined. Methods: Public single-cell RNA-sequencing data were reanalyzed to explore the distribution of TACSTD2/TROP2-positive epithelial-associated cells in adjacent normal tissues, primary colorectal cancer, and CRLM. The prognostic relevance of TACSTD2 was evaluated using the Kaplan-Meier Plotter database. TROP2-knockdown and TROP2-overexpressing colorectal cancer models were used to assess IMMU-132 response in vitro and in vivo. Pharmacological antitumor activity was further evaluated using subcutaneous xenografts, syngeneic intrasplenic liver metastasis models, and CRLM patient-derived organoids (PDOs). Transcriptomic profiling and γ-H2AX immunofluorescence were used to explore treatment-associated molecular changes. Results: At the patient/sample level, TACSTD2/TROP2-positive epithelial-associated cells showed numerically higher proportions in primary colorectal tumors and liver metastases than in adjacent normal tissues, and high TACSTD2 expression was associated with inferior overall survival in a public survival database. TROP2 knockdown attenuated IMMU-132-induced growth inhibition, apoptosis, and suppression of colony formation. In vivo, IMMU-132 suppressed colorectal tumor growth and reduced liver metastatic burden, with more evident activity in human TROP2-overexpressing models. In a limited exploratory CRLM PDO cohort established after first-line therapy, liver metastasis-derived PDOs showed lower normalized AUC values than primary tumor-derived PDOs. Transcriptomic analysis and representative γ-H2AX immunofluorescence suggested that IMMU-132 treatment was associated with changes in adhesion/cytoskeletal-related pathways, Wnt/cancer-associated transcriptional programs, and DNA damage-associated signals. Conclusions: These in vitro, in vivo, and PDO-based findings support further preclinical pharmacological evaluation of TROP2-directed SN-38 delivery by IMMU-132 in biomarker-annotated CRLM models, particularly in the post-first-line systemic therapy setting.
abstractZh: 背景/目的：Sacituzumab govitecan (SG, IMMU-132) 是一种靶向TROP2的抗体药物偶联物，携带SN-38。结直肠癌肝转移（CRLM）患者在一线全身治疗后的治疗选择仍然有限，而靶向TROP2的SN-38递送在CRLM中的临床前药理学价值仍未得到充分定义。方法：重新分析了公开的单细胞RNA测序数据，以探索TACSTD2/TROP2阳性上皮相关细胞在癌旁正常组织、原发结直肠癌和CRLM中的分布。使用Kaplan-Meier Plotter数据库评估了TACSTD2的预后相关性。使用TROP2敲低和TROP2过表达的结直肠癌模型来评估IMMU-132在体外和体内的反应。使用皮下异种移植模型、同基因脾内肝转移模型和CRLM患者来源类器官（PDO）进一步评估了药理学抗肿瘤活性。使用转录组分析和γ-H2AX免疫荧光来探索治疗相关的分子变化。结果：在患者/样本水平上，TACSTD2/TROP2阳性上皮相关细胞在原发结直肠肿瘤和肝转移中的比例在数值上高于癌旁正常组织，并且在公共生存数据库中，高TACSTD2表达与较差的总生存期相关。TROP2敲低减弱了IMMU-132诱导的生长抑制、凋亡和集落形成抑制。在体内，IMMU-132抑制了结直肠肿瘤的生长并减少了肝转移负担，在人类TROP2过表达模型中活性更为明显。在一线治疗后建立的有限探索性CRLM PDO队列中，肝转移来源的PDO显示出比原发肿瘤来源的PDO更低的归一化AUC值。转录组分析和代表性的γ-H2AX免疫荧光表明，IMMU-132治疗与粘附/细胞骨架相关通路、Wnt/癌症相关转录程序以及DNA损伤相关信号的变化有关。结论：这些基于体外、体内和PDO的研究结果支持在生物标志物注释的CRLM模型中，特别是在一线全身治疗后的情况下，进一步对IMMU-132靶向TROP2的SN-38递送进行临床前药理学评价。

abstract: The intestinal epithelium forms a tight barrier against the harsh luminal environment. Absorptive enterocytes have a polygonal, columnar morphology, while mucus-producing goblet cells exhibit a rounded apical shape and a voluminous cell body, raising the question of how epithelial integrity is preserved in tissues with such morphological heterogeneity. Here, we show that, under homeostatic conditions in vivo, goblet cells mechanically induce tight-junction fractures between neighboring enterocytes. This effect is exacerbated by goblet cell hypertrophy and is associated with increased gut permeability. Using in vivo and organoid models, combined with pharmacological, genetic and mechanical perturbations and theoretical modeling, we demonstrate that these fractures arise from a force imbalance at cell interfaces: goblet cells exert pressure on adjacent enterocytes, whose junctional rupture depends on tissue rheology controlled by myosin II. Our findings uncover a mechanical role for goblet cells in epithelial cohesion and barrier regulation, revealing how cellular heterogeneity shapes tissue integrity.
abstractZh: 肠上皮形成一道紧密的屏障，抵御严酷的管腔环境。吸收性肠上皮细胞呈多边形、柱状形态，而分泌黏液的杯状细胞则呈现圆形的顶端形态和庞大的细胞体，这引出了一个问题：在具有这种形态异质性的组织中，上皮完整性是如何维持的。在这里，我们展示了在体内稳态条件下，杯状细胞机械性地诱导相邻肠上皮细胞之间的紧密连接断裂。这种效应因杯状细胞肥大而加剧，并与肠道通透性增加相关。结合体内和类器官模型，以及药理学、遗传学和机械扰动及理论建模，我们证明这些断裂源于细胞界面上的力失衡：杯状细胞对相邻肠上皮细胞施加压力，其连接破裂取决于由肌球蛋白II控制的组织流变性。我们的发现揭示了杯状细胞在上皮粘附和屏障调节中的机械作用，揭示了细胞异质性如何塑造组织完整性。

abstract:
Background

Gastric cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with limited sensitivity to 5-fluorouracil (5-FU) representing a major obstacle to effective chemotherapy. Licochalcones, bioactive chalcones derived from licorice, have demonstrated broad-spectrum anticancer activities, yet the role of Licochalcone C in enhancing 5-FU sensitivity in gastric cancer remains unexplored.Purpose

This study aimed to investigate the antitumor effects of Licochalcone C on gastric cancer and evaluate its potential to enhance 5-FU chemosensitivity, along with elucidating the underlying molecular mechanisms.Study design

The antitumor and chemosensitizing effects of Licochalcone C were systematically evaluated using human gastric cancer cell lines, patient-derived organoids, clinical specimens, and a mouse xenograft model.Methods

Cell proliferation, colony formation, migration, invasion, and cell cycle distribution were assessed by standard assays. Biotin-labeled Licochalcone C pull-down with mass spectrometry, molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay, and co-immunoprecipitation were employed for target identification. Western blot and transcriptomic analyses defined the signaling mechanisms.Results

Licochalcone C inhibited gastric cancer cell proliferation, migration, and invasion while inducing G1 arrest, and markedly enhanced 5-FU sensitivity in cell lines, organoids, and xenograft models. Mechanistically, Licochalcone C directly bound RAC3, suppressing the RAC3-mediated PI3K-AKT-mTOR pathway and downregulating P-glycoprotein. Clinically, RAC3 overexpression correlated with advanced stage, poor survival, and unfavorable chemotherapy response.Conclusion

Licochalcone C functions as a RAC3-targeting chemosensitizer that enhances 5-FU efficacy by inhibiting PI3K-AKT-mTOR signaling and P-glycoprotein expression, supporting its development as a therapeutic adjuvant for gastric cancer.
abstractZh:
背景

胃癌仍然是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一，对5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU）的敏感性有限是有效化疗的主要障碍。甘草查尔酮是从甘草中提取的生物活性查尔酮，已显示出广谱的抗癌活性，但甘草查尔酮C在增强胃癌5-FU敏感性中的作用尚未被探索。目的

本研究旨在探讨甘草查尔酮C对胃癌的抗肿瘤作用，并评估其增强5-FU化疗敏感性的潜力，同时阐明其潜在的分子机制。研究设计

使用人胃癌细胞系、患者来源的类器官、临床标本和小鼠异种移植模型，系统评估了甘草查尔酮C的抗肿瘤和化疗增敏作用。方法

通过标准实验评估细胞增殖、集落形成、迁移、侵袭和细胞周期分布。采用生物素标记的甘草查尔酮C下拉结合质谱、分子对接、细胞热位移实验和免疫共沉淀进行靶点鉴定。通过蛋白质印迹和转录组分析确定信号机制。结果

甘草查尔酮C抑制胃癌细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，同时诱导G1期阻滞，并在细胞系、类器官和异种移植模型中显著增强5-FU敏感性。机制上，甘草查尔酮C直接结合RAC3，抑制RAC3介导的PI3K-AKT-mTOR通路并下调P-糖蛋白。临床上，RAC3过表达与晚期、不良生存和不利的化疗反应相关。结论

甘草查尔酮C作为靶向RAC3的化疗增敏剂，通过抑制PI3K-AKT-mTOR信号和P-糖蛋白表达增强5-FU疗效，支持其作为胃癌治疗辅助药物的开发。

title: Deletion of Ferritin Heavy Chain Limits Tumor Growth and Promotes Iron-Dependent Stress in Medulloblastoma
titleZh: 铁蛋白重链缺失限制髓母细胞瘤肿瘤生长并促进铁依赖性应激
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Segui F, Durivault J, Pagnuzzi M, Vial V, Bernini A, Filipponi D, Harayama T, Perné P, Debayle D, Muller K, Pasquier E, Le Grand M, SK P, Cormerais Y, Pouyssegur J, Vucetic M, Picco V.
abstract: Iron is essential for tumor proliferation and metabolic adaptation but becomes cytotoxic when unbuffered, creating a potential metabolic vulnerability. Ferritin, a conserved iron-storage complex, limits labile iron and establishes the upper threshold of iron tolerance in cancer cells. Here, we report the first ferritin heavy chain (FTH) knockout in a brain tumor model system. Although FTH loss was tolerated under basal conditions through adaptive remodeling of iron metabolism, it exposed profound vulnerabilities under iron stress. FTH deficiency lowered the threshold for iron toxicity, sensitizing medulloblastoma (MB) cells to both canonical ferroptosis and a mechanistically distinct iron-dependent cell death pathway. Oxidative iron stress impaired tumor growth and prolonged survival in orthotopic xenografts, whereas vitamin C–induced iron reduction triggered a selective, iron-dependent, but non-ferroptotic elimination of MB-like cells in tumor organoids. Notably, sensitivity to iron toxicity correlated strongly with cellular phenotype, with mesenchymal-like cells displaying greater susceptibility than epithelial-like counterparts. Collectively, these findings identify ferritin as a central regulator of iron tolerance in MB and establish iron toxicity, not via iron deprivation, as a therapeutically exploitable vulnerability. More broadly, this work provides a mechanistic framework for targeting iron metabolism through modulation of ferritin-dependent iron buffering and iron redox homeostasis in cancers. abstractZh: 铁对于肿瘤增殖和代谢适应至关重要，但当未缓冲时会具有细胞毒性，从而形成潜在的代谢脆弱性。铁蛋白是一种保守的铁储存复合物，可限制不稳定铁池并设定癌细胞铁耐受性的上限。在此，我们报告了脑肿瘤模型系统中首次铁蛋白重链（FTH）敲除。尽管在基础条件下，通过铁代谢的适应性重塑，FTH缺失得以耐受，但在铁应激条件下，它暴露了深刻的脆弱性。FTH缺乏降低了铁毒性的阈值，使髓母细胞瘤（MB）细胞对经典铁死亡和一种机制上不同的铁依赖性细胞死亡途径均敏感。氧化性铁应激损害了原位异种移植模型中的肿瘤生长并延长了生存期，而维生素C诱导的铁还原在肿瘤类器官中触发了MB样细胞的选择性、铁依赖性但非铁死亡的消除。值得注意的是，对铁毒性的敏感性与细胞表型密切相关，间充质样细胞比上皮样细胞表现出更大的易感性。总的来说，这些发现确定铁蛋白是MB中铁耐受性的核心调节因子，并确立了铁毒性（而非铁剥夺）作为一种可利用的治疗脆弱性。更广泛地说，这项工作为通过调节铁蛋白依赖性铁缓冲和铁氧化还原稳态来靶向癌症中的铁代谢提供了机制框架。图形摘要

abstract: Cervical squamous cell carcinoma (CESC) is frequently complicated by cisplatin (CDDP) resistance, which is a primary cause of treatment failure and poor prognosis. Here, we identified a CLCF1-ZIC5-CNTFR feedback loop that contributes to CDDP resistance in CESC. We found that ZIC5 was significantly upregulated in CDDP-resistant CESC and correlated with worse overall survival. Functionally, ZIC5 promoted CDDP resistance, in part by enhancing properties associated with cancer stem cells (CSCs) through the transcriptional activation of CNTFR. CLCF1, the ligand for CNTFR, was found to induce ZIC5 expression via STAT3 signaling, thereby forming a CLCF1-ZIC5-CNTFR positive feedback loop. Targeting CNTFR with a neutralizing antibody disrupted this regulatory circuit, leading to a reversal of CDDP resistance and suppression of CSC-associated phenotypes in vitro. Furthermore, combining an anti-CNTFR antibody with CDDP resulted in enhanced antitumor effects in patient-derived xenograft (PDX) and organoid (PDO) models. In summary, our findings suggest that the CLCF1-ZIC5-CNTFR positive feedback loop promotes CDDP resistance in CESC, potentially by sustaining CSC properties. Targeting this pathway, particularly CNTFR, may represent a potential therapeutic strategy for patients with CDDP-resistant CESC.
abstractZh: 宫颈鳞状细胞癌（CESC）常并发顺铂（CDDP）耐药，这是治疗失败和预后不良的主要原因。在此，我们确定了一个CLCF1-ZIC5-CNTFR反馈环路，该环路有助于CESC中的CDDP耐药。我们发现ZIC5在CDDP耐药的CESC中显著上调，并与较差的总生存期相关。在功能上，ZIC5通过转录激活CNTFR，部分通过增强与癌症干细胞（CSCs）相关的特性来促进CDDP耐药。发现CNTFR的配体CLCF1通过STAT3信号传导诱导ZIC5表达，从而形成CLCF1-ZIC5-CNTFR正反馈环路。用中和抗体靶向CNTFR可破坏这一调节回路，导致CDDP耐药的逆转和体外CSC相关表型的抑制。此外，将抗CNTFR抗体与CDDP联合使用，在患者来源的异种移植（PDX）和类器官（PDO）模型中产生了增强的抗肿瘤效果。总之，我们的研究结果表明，CLCF1-ZIC5-CNTFR正反馈环路通过可能维持CSC特性来促进CESC中的CDDP耐药。靶向这一通路，特别是CNTFR，可能为CDDP耐药的CESC患者提供一种潜在的治疗策略。

abstract: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is characterized by progressive alveolar destruction and defective regeneration, yet the matrix-derived factors contributing to this process remain poorly defined. We investigated the role of elastin-derived peptides (EDPs), bioactive fragments generated during cigarette smoke (CS)-induced elastin degradation, in alveolar epithelial dysfunction. In lung tissues from patients with COPD and in CS-exposed mice, elevated levels of EDPs were associated with elastic fiber disruption and impaired alveolar type 2 (AT2)-to-alveolar type 1 (AT1) differentiation. These observations were supported by histological analyses, single-cell transcriptomic profiling, and organoid-based functional assays. In mouse and human alveolar organoids, CS extract and EDPs each suppressed organoid growth and impaired AT2-to-AT1 differentiation. Mechanistically, EDPs exposure was associated with activation of TLR4/NF-κB signaling, and reduced β-catenin activity, whereas pharmacological inhibition of TLR4 partially restored alveolar epithelial differentiation. Notably, the EDPs-neutralizing agent TB partially rescued AT2-to-AT1 differentiation in organoids and alleviated emphysematous injury in vivo. Together, these findings identify EDPs as an important matrix-derived mediator of alveolar regenerative failure in COPD and support further evaluation of EDP-targeted intervention as a potential strategy for promoting alveolar repair.
abstractZh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的特征是进行性肺泡破坏和再生缺陷，然而导致这一过程的基质衍生因素仍知之甚少。我们研究了弹性蛋白衍生肽（EDPs）在肺泡上皮功能障碍中的作用，这些生物活性片段是在香烟烟雾（CS）诱导的弹性蛋白降解过程中产生的。在COPD患者的肺组织和CS暴露的小鼠中，EDPs水平升高与弹性纤维破坏及肺泡2型（AT2）向肺泡1型（AT1）分化受损相关。这些观察得到了组织学分析、单细胞转录组谱分析和基于类器官的功能测定的支持。在小鼠和人肺泡类器官中，CS提取物和EDPs均抑制类器官生长并损害AT2向AT1的分化。机制上，EDPs暴露与TLR4/NF-κB信号激活及β-连环蛋白活性降低相关，而药理学抑制TLR4可部分恢复肺泡上皮分化。值得注意的是，EDPs中和剂TB在类器官中部分恢复了AT2向AT1的分化，并在体内减轻了肺气肿损伤。总之，这些发现将EDPs确定为COPD中肺泡再生失败的重要基质衍生介质，并支持进一步评估靶向EDPs的干预作为促进肺泡修复的潜在策略。

abstract: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) remains a leading cause of irreversible blindness worldwide, characterized by the progressive breakdown of the outer blood-retinal barrier, accumulation of protein and lipid deposits in the subretinal space, and the consequential degeneration of macular photoreceptors. Geographic atrophy (GA) is one of the blinding end points of AMD. While current pharmaceutical interventions can slow lesion expansion or counter choroidal neovascularization, they fail to address the most significant clinical unmet need: regeneration of damaged retinal tissue to restore vision. Regenerative medicine via stem cell transplantation offers a definitive curative approach by replacing the structural and immune framework of the outer retina. This review synthesizes current advancements in human embryonic and pluripotent stem cells platforms engineered for outer retinal reconstruction. We evaluate the differentiation, culturing, and quality validation required to generate clinical-grade, polarized RPE monolayers and homeostatic microglia-like cells. Structurally, single-cell suspensions are contrasted against bioengineered patches, scaffold-free cell sheets, and advanced cell strips, analyzing how graft configuration dictates post-transplantation integration and visual recovery while balancing procedural adverse events like cell reflux and epiretinal membrane formation. Furthermore, this review addresses the microenvironmental challenges of transplanting allogeneic constructs into an inflamed, senescent host niche. We examine CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing paradigms, including cytosine base and prime editing, designed to rectify cell-intrinsic genetic vulnerabilities such as the complement factor H (CFH) risk variant. We highlight translational applications, such as knocking out the Class II transactivator to eliminate major histocompatibility complex class II (MHC-II) expression, which successfully circumvents host T-cell immune surveillance and prevents graft rejection in non-human primates. Additionally, we analyze how engineering an inhibitor-resistant colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor (CSF1R) point mutation enables exogenously administered microglia to robustly outcompete and replace maladaptive, pro-inflammatory host microglia under selective small-molecule pressure. Finally, we discuss future directions, emphasizing multi-lineage bilayered co-transplantation models that combine genome-edited RPE patches with homeostatic microglia or retinal organoids to achieve durable synaptic repair, alongside automated artificial intelligence manufacturing pipelines. Together, these combined structural, molecular, and immune-modulating strategies represent the next clinical frontier in restoring clear central vision and achieving permanent neurovascular rescue in advanced macular degeneration.
abstractZh: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）仍然是全球范围内不可逆性失明的主要原因，其特征是外层血-视网膜屏障的进行性破坏、视网膜下间隙蛋白质和脂质沉积物的积累，以及由此导致的黄斑光感受器变性。地图样萎缩（GA）是AMD致盲的终点之一。虽然目前的药物干预可以减缓病灶扩张或对抗脉络膜新生血管，但它们未能解决最重要的临床未满足需求：再生受损的视网膜组织以恢复视力。通过干细胞移植的再生医学提供了一种明确的治愈性方法，通过替换外视网膜的结构和免疫框架来实现。本综述综合了目前用于外视网膜重建的人胚胎干细胞和多能干细胞平台的最新进展。我们评估了生成临床级、极化的RPE单层和稳态微胶质样细胞所需的分化、培养和质量验证。在结构上，将单细胞悬浮液与生物工程补片、无支架细胞片和先进细胞条进行对比，分析移植物构型如何决定移植后的整合和视力恢复，同时平衡诸如细胞反流和视网膜前膜形成等程序性不良事件。此外，本综述探讨了将同种异体构建体移植到发炎、衰老的宿主微环境中所面临的微环境挑战。我们检查了CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑范式，包括胞嘧啶碱基编辑和先导编辑，旨在纠正细胞内在的遗传易感性，如补体因子H（CFH）风险变异。我们强调了转化应用，例如敲除II类反式激活因子以消除主要组织相容性复合体II类（MHC-II）表达，这成功规避了宿主T细胞免疫监视，并防止了非人灵长类动物中的移植物排斥。此外，我们分析了如何通过工程化一种抑制剂抗性的集落刺激因子1受体（CSF1R）点突变，使外源性给予的微胶质细胞在选择性小分子压力下能够强劲地竞争并取代适应不良的、促炎性宿主微胶质细胞。最后，我们讨论了未来方向，强调结合基因组编辑的RPE补片与稳态微胶质细胞或视网膜类器官的多谱系双层共移植模型，以实现持久的突触修复，以及自动化人工智能制造流程。总之，这些结合的结构、分子和免疫调节策略代表了在晚期黄斑变性中恢复清晰中心视力和实现永久性神经血管救援的下一个临床前沿。

abstract: Nanoplastics (NPs) can cross the human biological barriers, enter the bloodstream, and accumulate in vital organs due to their unique physical and chemical properties. This review provides a detailed explanation of the mechanisms by which NPs cross the air-blood, intestinal, and blood-brain barriers. It provides more insight into how NPs interact with blood components after entering circulation, assesses the cardiovascular toxicity that results, and visually represents how NPs are distributed in human tissues. Traditional static models have significant limitations in simulating the complex physiological microenvironments of the human body. Organ-on-a-chip (OoC) technology is emerging as a novel toxicology tool due to its unique advantages in dynamically reconstructing the vascular microenvironment and biological barriers. This technology allows for a precise characterization of the hemodynamic behavior of NPs and their mechanisms of cross-barrier toxicity. In general, this work offers crucial theoretical and methodological insights to address existing technical issues in assessing the toxicity of emerging environmental contaminants.
abstractZh: 纳米塑料（NPs）因其独特的物理和化学性质，能够穿越人体生物屏障，进入血液，并在重要器官中积累。本综述详细解释了NPs穿越气血屏障、肠道屏障和血脑屏障的机制。它进一步揭示了NPs进入循环后如何与血液成分相互作用，评估由此产生的心血管毒性，并直观展示了NPs在人体组织中的分布。传统的静态模型在模拟人体复杂生理微环境方面存在显著局限性。器官芯片（OoC）技术因其在动态重建血管微环境和生物屏障方面的独特优势，正成为一种新型毒理学工具。该技术能够精确表征NPs的血液动力学行为及其跨屏障毒性机制。总的来说，这项工作为解决评估新兴环境污染物毒性中存在的现有技术问题提供了关键的理论和方法学见解。

abstract: Tissue-engineered skin substitutes (TESS) represent a key therapeutic option for extensive cutaneous injuries when autologous grafting is limited; however, current constructs lack skin appendages, particularly hair follicles, resulting in incomplete functional and aesthetic restoration. A central barrier to engineering follicular structures within TESS is the rapid loss of hair-inductive features in cultured human dermal papilla (DP) fibroblasts and the difficulty of recreating epithelial-mesenchymal interactions required for early folliculogenesis. Here, we report a bioengineering platform that integrates self-organizing composite spheroids composed of human epidermal keratinocytes (KCs) and DP fibroblasts with laser-micropatterned collagen scaffolds to generate spatially defined hair peg-like structures within human TESS. Under optimized three-dimensional culture conditions, mixed KC-DP spheroids reproducibly undergo polarization, budding, and elongation to form hair peg-like structures that exhibit compartmentalized organization and expression of key follicle-associated markers. Transcriptomic analysis reveals activation of follicle-associated transcriptional programs in KCs, while DP fibroblasts retain DP-associated features under these conditions. When implanted into predefined microwells within collagen-based dermal scaffolds, these spheroids continue coordinated morphogenesis alongside epidermal stratification and dermal matrix formation, yielding engineered skin constructs containing spatially integrated hair peg-like structures. Although maturation into fully developed hair follicles remains to be achieved, this study establishes a scalable, clinically relevant platform for integrating early-stage follicular units into TESS. Collectively, these findings provide a foundation for future efforts toward appendage-inclusive skin regeneration using human cells. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: Engineering human hair follicles in skin substitutes remains challenging because dermal papilla cells rapidly lose hair-inductive function during laboratory expansion, and existing organoid models are difficult to scale or integrate into engineered skin. Here, we present a laser-micropatterned collagen scaffold that spatially incorporates early-stage follicular units formed from human keratinocytes and dermal papilla cells. Through systematic optimization of cell state, spheroid configuration, culture conditions, and scaffold integration, mixed keratinocyte-dermal papilla cell spheroids reproducibly undergo polarization, budding, and elongation in three-dimensional culture and retain hair peg-like organization after incorporation into micropatterned dermal scaffolds. This work advances hair follicle engineering toward clinically relevant skin constructs for studying human hair biology and regenerative skin therapies.
abstractZh: 组织工程皮肤替代物（TESS）在自体移植受限时是广泛皮肤损伤的关键治疗选择；然而，目前的构建物缺乏皮肤附属器，特别是毛囊，导致功能和美学恢复不完整。在TESS内工程化毛囊结构的一个核心障碍是培养的人真皮乳头（DP）成纤维细胞快速丧失毛囊诱导特性，以及难以重建早期毛囊发生所需的上皮-间充质相互作用。在此，我们报告了一个生物工程平台，该平台将自组织的复合球体（由人表皮角质形成细胞（KCs）和DP成纤维细胞组成）与激光微图案胶原支架整合，以在人体TESS内生成空间定义的毛钉样结构。在优化的三维培养条件下，混合KC-DP球体可重复地经历极化、出芽和伸长，形成毛钉样结构，这些结构表现出区室化组织以及关键毛囊相关标志物的表达。转录组分析揭示了KCs中毛囊相关转录程序的激活，而DP成纤维细胞在这些条件下保留了DP相关特征。当植入到基于胶原的真皮支架内的预定微孔中时，这些球体继续协调的形态发生，同时伴随表皮分层和真皮基质形成，产生包含空间整合的毛钉样结构的工程化皮肤构建物。尽管完全发育的毛囊的成熟仍有待实现，本研究建立了一个可扩展的、临床相关的平台，用于将早期毛囊单位整合到TESS中。总的来说，这些发现为未来使用人类细胞进行包含附属器的皮肤再生的努力奠定了基础。意义声明：在皮肤替代物中工程化人毛囊仍然具有挑战性，因为真皮乳头细胞在实验室扩增过程中迅速丧失毛囊诱导功能，而现有的类器官模型难以扩展或整合到工程化皮肤中。在此，我们提出了一种激光微图案胶原支架，其空间整合了由人角质形成细胞和真皮乳头细胞形成的早期毛囊单位。通过系统优化细胞状态、球体构型、培养条件和支架整合，混合角质形成细胞-真皮乳头细胞球体在三维培养中可重复地经历极化、出芽和伸长，并在整合到微图案真皮支架后保留毛钉样组织。这项工作将毛囊工程推进到临床相关的皮肤构建物，用于研究人类毛发生物学和再生皮肤疗法。

abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDA) is among the deadliest malignancies, driven by metastatic progression and profound cellular heterogeneity. We previously identified glutathione S-transferase theta 1 (GSTT1) as a regulator of a slow-cycling, highly metastatic tumor cell population, suggesting that GSTT1High cells may possess stem-like properties. Here, we define the functional and molecular features of this subpopulation in metastatic PDA. Using a mCherry-tagged Gstt1 reporter system in metastatic murine PDAC cells, we enriched for Gstt1High cells and observed increased tumor sphere formation, accompanied by upregulation of stemness-associated genes including PROM1 (CD133) and activation of Wnt and FGF signaling pathways. In human PDA models, CD133HighGSTT1High cells exhibited enhanced tumor sphere initiation and expansion compared to other populations, defining a maximal stem-like state. Notably, sensitivity to FGFR inhibitors was observed only under tumor sphere conditions, highlighting a context-dependent therapeutic vulnerability. Mechanistically, FGFR3 expression correlated with GSTT1 and CD133 levels, and FGF signaling was required to sustain this state. GSTT1 knockdown reduced CD133 protein levels, impaired tumor sphere formation, and altered sensitivity to FGFR inhibition. These findings were largely recapitulated in patient-derived PDA organoids, where GSTT1 and PROM1 co-expression predicted increased tumor sphere formation and enhanced response to the multi-kinase inhibitor Nintedanib. Together, these results identify a GSTT1HighCD133High stem-like subpopulation in metastatic PDA and identify an FGFR-dependent signaling axis that sustains this state, representing a potential therapeutic vulnerability.
abstractZh: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDA）是最致命的恶性肿瘤之一，其特点是转移性进展和显著的细胞异质性。我们之前发现谷胱甘肽S-转移酶theta 1（GSTT1）是慢周期、高转移性肿瘤细胞群体的调节因子，提示GSTT1高表达细胞可能具有干细胞样特性。在此，我们定义了转移性PDA中这一亚群的功能和分子特征。使用转移性小鼠PDAC细胞中mCherry标记的Gstt1报告系统，我们富集了Gstt1高表达细胞，并观察到肿瘤球形成增加，同时伴有干性相关基因（包括PROM1（CD133））的上调以及Wnt和FGF信号通路的激活。在人类PDA模型中，CD133高表达GSTT1高表达细胞与其他群体相比表现出增强的肿瘤球起始和扩增能力，定义了最大干细胞样状态。值得注意的是，FGFR抑制剂的敏感性仅在肿瘤球条件下观察到，突出了情境依赖的治疗脆弱性。机制上，FGFR3表达与GSTT1和CD133水平相关，且FGF信号是维持该状态所必需的。GSTT1敲低降低了CD133蛋白水平，损害了肿瘤球形成，并改变了对FGFR抑制的敏感性。这些发现在患者来源的PDA类器官中基本得到重现，其中GSTT1和PROM1共表达预测了增加的肿瘤球形成和对多激酶抑制剂尼达尼布的增强反应。总之，这些结果确定了转移性PDA中GSTT1高表达CD133高表达的干细胞样亚群，并识别了维持该状态的FGFR依赖性信号轴，代表了潜在的治疗脆弱性。

title: Histone acetyltransferase HAT1 regulates intestinal stem cell proliferation and differentiation.

abstract: Stem cells are critical for the development and maintenance of tissue integrity. An important example is intestinal stem cells (ISCs) that generate all epithelial cell types necessary for formation of the intestinal lining. HAT1 is a histone acetyltransferase that acetylates newly synthesized histone H4 molecules on lysine residues 5 and 12 during replication-coupled chromatin assembly. Within the intestine, HAT1 is specifically expressed in intestinal stem and progenitor cells. We generated an inducible deletion of the Hat1 gene in intestinal epithelial cells. Following loss of Hat1, intestinal crypts became elongated, with an increase in stem and progenitor cell proliferation and an increase in the population of OLFM+ cells. Loss of Hat1 also resulted in alterations in ISC differentiation, including an increase in the number of Goblet cells and the mislocalization of Paneth cells into villi. HAT1 is specifically responsible for the acetylation of histone H4 lysine 5 (H4K5ac) in ISCs. Genome-wide characterization of HAT1-dependent H4K5ac in intestinal crypt cells indicates that the most significant loss of H4K5ac occurs regions of the genome that correspond to in lamina-associated domains, as defined in mouse embryonic fibroblasts. Loss of H4K5ac is accompanied by an increase in histone H3 K9 tri-methylation, indicating that HAT1 regulates genome-wide histone modification patterns in intestinal crypt cells. A direct role for HAT1 in ISC function was demonstrated using organoids in culture. HAT1 is required for differentiation in organoids and for the maintenance of Lgr5+ stem cells. These results indicate that HAT1 is required for the proper regulation of ISC renewal and differentiation.
abstractZh: 干细胞对于组织的发育和维持完整性至关重要。一个重要的例子是肠道干细胞（ISCs），它们产生形成肠道内壁所需的所有上皮细胞类型。HAT1是一种组蛋白乙酰转移酶，在复制偶联的染色质组装过程中，乙酰化新合成的组蛋白H4分子上的赖氨酸残基5和12。在肠道内，HAT1特异性地表达于肠道干细胞和祖细胞中。我们在肠道上皮细胞中生成了Hat1基因的诱导性敲除。在Hat1缺失后，肠道隐窝变长，干细胞和祖细胞增殖增加，OLFM+细胞群体增加。Hat1的缺失也导致ISC分化的改变，包括杯状细胞数量的增加以及潘氏细胞错误定位到绒毛中。HAT1特异性地负责ISC中组蛋白H4赖氨酸5的乙酰化（H4K5ac）。肠道隐窝细胞中HAT1依赖性H4K5ac的全基因组特征分析表明，H4K5ac最显著的丢失发生在对应于层粘连相关结构域的基因组区域，这些区域在小鼠胚胎成纤维细胞中已定义。H4K5ac的丢失伴随着组蛋白H3 K9三甲基化的增加，表明HAT1调控肠道隐窝细胞中全基因组的组蛋白修饰模式。使用培养的类器官证明了HAT1在ISC功能中的直接作用。HAT1是类器官分化以及Lgr5+干细胞维持所必需的。这些结果表明，HAT1是正确调控ISC更新和分化所必需的。

title: Single-cell viral capture identifies injury-remodeling programs and host-response candidates in RSV-infected airway organoids
titleZh: 单细胞病毒捕获识别RSV感染气道类器官中的损伤重塑程序及宿主反应候选基因
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Liu R, Liu Z, Wang P, Zhang Y, Hou S, Zhang C, Guan W, Wang S, Sun X, Zhao C, Huang J, Zhang W, Li Q, Zhang Y, Wu H, Ma R, Wu X, Sun X.
abstract: Abstract  Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) causes substantial pediatric lower respiratory tract disease, but the host programs that separate directly infected airway cells from exposed bystander cells are still not fully resolved. We reanalyzed public single-cell RNA sequencing data from RSV-infected human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived respiratory organoids and used viral transcript capture to distinguish mock cells, RSV RNA-negative bystander cells and RSV RNA-positive cells. RSV-positive cells made up 12.61% of the atlas and showed viral-load-linked stress, epithelial injury-repair, paracrine remodeling, CD73/adenosine and metabolic programs, not merely stronger interferon responses. Bystander cells, by contrast, were enriched for interferon-stimulated and antiviral sensing states. Curated ligand-receptor analysis, exploratory virtual perturbation, multi-layer host-target ranking and drug-signature reversal highlighted IL11, PSAT1, GREM1, PTGS2, SERPINE1, NT5E/CD73 and TNFRSF12A/Fn14 as candidate host nodes. External organoid bulk RNA-seq (GSE263272), antibody-treated organoid scRNA-seq used as a treatment-endpoint reference (GSE263271), primary airway epithelial data (GSE32139) and an in-house RSV time-course qPCR screen supported the injury-remodeling model, while showing that individual candidates vary by context. In silico perturbation placed NT5E/CD73 among network-relevant secondary-tier nodes and ranked the SYK inhibitor Fostamatinib/R406 highly in drug-signature reversal. These findings set priorities for experimental follow-up but do not establish functional rescue or therapeutic efficacy. Together, the study defines a focused set of RSV organoid host-response candidates for functional screening.
abstractZh: 摘要  呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）引起大量儿科下呼吸道疾病，但将直接感染的 airway 细胞与暴露的旁观者细胞区分开来的宿主程序仍未完全阐明。我们重新分析了来自 RSV 感染的人诱导多能干细胞来源的呼吸类器官的公共单细胞 RNA 测序数据，并利用病毒转录本捕获来区分模拟细胞、RSV RNA 阴性旁观者细胞和 RSV RNA 阳性细胞。RSV 阳性细胞占图谱的 12.61%，并表现出与病毒载量相关的应激、上皮损伤修复、旁分泌重塑、CD73/腺苷和代谢程序，而不仅仅是更强的干扰素反应。相比之下，旁观者细胞富集于干扰素刺激和抗病毒感知状态。经过筛选的配体-受体分析、探索性虚拟扰动、多层宿主靶点排序和药物特征逆转，突出了 IL11、PSAT1、GREM1、PTGS2、SERPINE1、NT5E/CD73 和 TNFRSF12A/Fn14 作为候选宿主节点。外部类器官 bulk RNA-seq（GSE263272）、作为治疗终点参考的抗体处理类器官 scRNA-seq（GSE263271）、原代气道上皮数据（GSE32139）以及内部 RSV 时间过程 qPCR 筛选支持了损伤重塑模型，同时表明各个候选基因因环境而异。计算机模拟扰动将 NT5E/CD73 置于网络相关的次级节点中，并在药物特征逆转中将 SYK 抑制剂 Fostamatinib/R406 排名很高。这些发现为实验随访设定了优先级，但并未建立功能性拯救或治疗效果。总之，该研究为功能筛选定义了一组聚焦的 RSV 类器官宿主反应候选基因。

title: Limited Detectability of Network Functional Alterations in a Tauopathy Model Using Mouse Primary Cortical Cultures.

abstract: Background: Tauopathies are neurodegenerative disorders characterized by the abnormal hyperphosphorylation and aggregation of the microtubule-associated protein tau, leading to disrupted neuronal connectivity and progressive brain dysfunction. Despite their clinical relevance, most in vitro models have focused primarily on molecular and cellular aspects, with limited emphasis on alterations in network dynamics and functional connectivity. Methods: We developed an in vitro tauopathy model based on mouse primary neuronal cultures, enabling the investigation of network-level alterations under controlled conditions. We compared three experimental groups: untreated control cultures, cultures exposed to extracellular wild-type tau, and cultures treated with pathological tau (pTau) isolated from the sarkosyl-insoluble fraction of P301S (+/-) transgenic mice. To increase susceptibility to tau-induced pathology, all conditions were additionally transduced with adeno-associated viral vectors encoding human P301L tau. To quantify for damage, spontaneous neuronal activity was monitored throughout network maturation-from day in vitro (DIV) 7 to 16-using fluorescence calcium imaging, and multiple metrics describing network dynamics and functional organization were compared at DIV 12. Results: We observed that exposure to pTau did not induce overt cytotoxicity or major disruptions in global network dynamics, although a mild increase in network bursting activity was observed. Longitudinal analysis of network maturation further revealed largely similar developmental trajectories across experimental groups, with only subtle and persistent differences in bursting-related activity in pTau-treated cultures. Conclusions: We propose that the early developmental stage of the cultures, together with the intrinsic bursting and ongoing synaptic plasticity of primary neuronal networks, masks subtle pathological effects. This may limit the sensitivity of two-dimensional in vitro systems to detect network-level dysfunction, suggesting that more mature or structurally complex models, such as brain organoids, may be required to reveal robust functional deficits.
abstractZh: 背景：Tau蛋白病是以微管相关蛋白tau的异常过度磷酸化和聚集为特征的神经退行性疾病，导致神经元连接中断和进行性脑功能障碍。尽管具有临床相关性，大多数体外模型主要关注分子和细胞层面，对网络动力学和功能连接改变的关注有限。方法：我们开发了一种基于小鼠原代神经元培养的体外tau蛋白病模型，能够在受控条件下研究网络层面的改变。我们比较了三个实验组：未处理的对照培养物、暴露于细胞外野生型tau的培养物，以及用从P301S (+/-)转基因小鼠的sarkosyl不溶性组分中分离的病理性tau (pTau)处理的培养物。为了增加对tau诱导病理的易感性，所有条件额外转导了编码人P301L tau的腺相关病毒载体。为了量化损伤，在体外培养日(DIV) 7至16的整个网络成熟过程中，使用荧光钙成像监测自发神经元活动，并在DIV 12比较描述网络动力学和功能组织的多个指标。结果：我们观察到暴露于pTau并未引起明显的细胞毒性或全局网络动力学的重大破坏，尽管观察到网络爆发活动的轻度增加。网络成熟的纵向分析进一步显示，各实验组的发育轨迹大体相似，仅在pTau处理的培养物中观察到与爆发相关活动的细微且持续的差异。结论：我们认为培养物的早期发育阶段，加上原代神经元网络固有的爆发和持续的突触可塑性，掩盖了细微的病理效应。这可能限制二维体外系统检测网络层面功能障碍的敏感性，提示可能需要更成熟或结构更复杂的模型，如脑类器官，来揭示稳健的功能缺陷。

title: The airway epithelial-immune axis: mechanisms and therapeutic implications.
titleZh: 气道上皮-免疫轴：机制与治疗意义。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Zhu Z, Li Q, Hua B.
affiliations: Department of Hematology, Central Hospital of Haining, Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China.
Department of Respiratory Medicine, Jiaxing Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, Jiaxing, Zhejiang, China.
abstract: The airway epithelium is increasingly recognized not merely as a physical barrier, but as a central, active regulator of mucosal immunity. This review comprehensively summarizes the structural and functional basis of the airway epithelial-immune axis and its critical role in chronic respiratory diseases. Exposure to environmental allergens, pollutants, and respiratory pathogens disrupts epithelial tight junctions and triggers the rapid release of key alarmins, including TSLP, IL-33, and IL-25. These epithelial-derived cytokines participate in reciprocal epithelial-immune circuits, driving extensive crosstalk with both innate (ILC2s) and adaptive (Th2 cells) immune networks to establish self-perpetuating inflammatory loops. Such epithelial dysfunction can act as an important driver and amplifier in the pathogenesis of asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), and upper airway inflammatory disorders. Consequently, targeting this axis has emerged as a promising therapeutic strategy, shifting the focus toward alarmin-neutralizing biologics, upstream receptor inhibition, and barrier restoration. Furthermore, we highlight how emerging technologies-such as single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, organoid models, and multi-omics integration-are decoding cellular heterogeneity and spatial niches, ultimately paving the way for precision medicine and long-term disease-modifying therapies in respiratory medicine.
abstractZh: 气道上皮日益被认识到不仅是物理屏障，更是黏膜免疫的中枢活跃调节者。本综述全面总结了气道上皮-免疫轴的结构和功能基础及其在慢性呼吸系统疾病中的关键作用。接触环境过敏原、污染物和呼吸道病原体会破坏上皮紧密连接，并触发关键警报素（包括TSLP、IL-33和IL-25）的快速释放。这些上皮来源的细胞因子参与上皮-免疫的相互回路，驱动与先天（ILC2s）和适应性（Th2细胞）免疫网络的广泛串扰，从而建立自我延续的炎症循环。这种上皮功能障碍可作为哮喘、慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）和上气道炎症性疾病发病机制中的重要驱动因素和放大器。因此，靶向该轴已成为一种有前景的治疗策略，将焦点转向中和警报素的生物制剂、上游受体抑制和屏障修复。此外，我们强调了新兴技术——如单细胞RNA测序、空间转录组学、类器官模型和多组学整合——如何解码细胞异质性和空间生态位，最终为呼吸医学中的精准医学和长期疾病修饰疗法铺平道路。

title: Dynamic tumor microenvironment remodeling in cancer therapy resistance: molecular mechanisms and translational opportunities.
titleZh: 癌症治疗耐药中动态肿瘤微环境重塑：分子机制与转化机遇。

dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

affiliations: Health and Management Center, General Practice Medical Center, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, Chengdu, China.
