abstract:
Aims

Mutations in the LMNA gene, which encodes lamin A/C, cause a variety of diseases known as laminopathies. Some mutations are particularly associated with the occurrence of dilated cardiomyopathy and heart failure, but the genotype-phenotype relationship and underlying mechanisms are unclear.Methods and results

Induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) from a patient carrying a LMNA point mutation (c.665A>C, p.His222Pro) and a CRISPR/Cas9 corrected isogenic control hiPSCs clones were differentiated into cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs), with no difference in the differentiation yield and in sarcomere organisation between the two cell lines. However, 3D cardiac organoids generated with LMNA p.H222P hiPSC-CMs showed an impaired contractility compared to control organoids. Calcium transient recordings in LMNA p.H222P mutant cardiomyocytes showed a significantly higher calcium transient amplitude with a significantly slower calcium re-uptake. Transcriptomic analyses suggested a global mitochondrial dysfunction and in particular an impaired mitochondrial calcium uptake with a significantly decreased expression of the mitochondrial calcium uniporter (MCU). This decrease in MCU expression was confirmed by western blot and was accompanied by an increased MICU1:MCU ratio, as well as an increased PDH Ser232 and PDH Ser300 phosphorylation, indicating an altered mitochondrial calcium uptake in the LMNA mutant hiPSC-CMs. Consistently, lower mitochondrial respiration and ATP levels were found in LMNA p.H222P hiPSC-CMs as compared to isogenic controls. Strikingly, treatment with the MCU activator amorolfine restored mitochondrial calcium uptake and improved contractility in LMNA mutant hiPSC-CMs.Conclusions

Our results establish a direct mechanistic link between nuclear envelope dysfunction and impaired mitochondrial function, and highlight the MCU complex as a potential therapeutic target in LMNA-related cardiomyopathy. More broadly, this work provides a paradigm for connecting gene-specific nuclear defects to mitochondrial dysfunction in inherited cardiomyopathies.
abstractZh:
目的

LMNA基因编码核纤层蛋白A/C，其突变导致多种疾病，统称为核纤层蛋白病。某些突变与扩张型心肌病和心力衰竭的发生特别相关，但基因型-表型关系及其潜在机制尚不清楚。方法与结果

从携带LMNA点突变（c.665A>C, p.His222Pro）的患者和CRISPR/Cas9校正的同基因对照iPSC克隆中诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs），并分化为心肌细胞（hiPSC-CMs），两种细胞系在分化效率和肌节组织方面没有差异。然而，用LMNA p.H222P hiPSC-CMs生成的三维心脏类器官与对照类器官相比，收缩性受损。LMNA p.H222P突变心肌细胞中的钙瞬变记录显示，钙瞬变幅度显著升高，钙再摄取速度显著减慢。转录组分析提示整体线粒体功能障碍，特别是线粒体钙摄取受损，线粒体钙单向转运体（MCU）表达显著降低。Western blot证实了MCU表达的降低，并伴有MICU1:MCU比值升高，以及PDH Ser232和PDH Ser300磷酸化增加，表明LMNA突变hiPSC-CMs中线粒体钙摄取改变。一致地，与同基因对照相比，LMNA p.H222P hiPSC-CMs中的线粒体呼吸和ATP水平较低。引人注目的是，用MCU激活剂阿莫罗芬治疗恢复了LMNA突变hiPSC-CMs中的线粒体钙摄取并改善了收缩性。结论

我们的结果建立了核膜功能障碍与线粒体功能受损之间的直接机制联系，并强调MCU复合物是LMNA相关心肌病的潜在治疗靶点。更广泛地说，这项工作为将基因特异性核缺陷与遗传性心肌病中的线粒体功能障碍联系起来提供了范例。

abstract: Alveolar epithelial cells (AECs) are covered apically by the alveolar lining layer (ALL). The alveolar epithelial glycocalyx (AEGCX), which is part of the ALL, consists of a mixture of glycoproteins, proteoglycans, and glycosaminoglycans. In comparison with the endothelial glycocalyx (GCX), much less is known about the composition and structure of the AEGCX, although it is presumed to be involved in many cellular processes. The challenges of in vivo visualization of the AEGCX, coupled with the distorting effects of aldehyde fixation, make it difficult to accurately determine its structural organization and molecular composition. In this study, we aimed to improve the preservation of the ultrastructure of the AEGCX by using high-pressure freezing combined with freeze substitution (HPF/FS) for transmission electron microscopy (TEM) analysis. HPF is a type of cryopreservation that uses both liquid nitrogen and high pressure. By using HPF/FS to preserve commercially available human primary AECs, human alveolar-like organoids, monolayers of human organoid-derived alveolar-like epithelial cells, and ex vivo tissue from both mice and human lungs, we observed two distinct regions on the apical surface via TEM: an inner GCX-like layer along the cell membrane followed by a loosely arranged outer layer. Our data show a bilayered structure on the surface of AECs. To minimize freeze-induced damage during HPF, a protein-rich cryoprotectant was introduced to stabilize the sample. By processing control samples of protein-rich cryoprotectants lacking cells, we found that HPF/FS preserves components of the cryoprotectant, as confirmed by TEM analysis. This implies that HPF/FS preserves not only cellular-derived constituents but also components found in the cryoprotectant, which may interfere with interpretation of the outer surface layer.NEW & NOTEWORTHY The structure of the AEGCX is not fully understood. To avoid formaldehyde-induced disruption of the AEGCX, we preserved samples by HPF/FS for TEM analysis. We uncovered two morphologically distinct regions on the apical surface of AECs. An inner GCX-like layer along the membrane followed by an associated outer layer. We found that cryoprotectants used during HPF to avoid freezing induced damage interfere with the outer layer, potentially misleading interpretations of its structure.
abstractZh: 肺泡上皮细胞（AECs）在顶端被肺泡衬液层（ALL）覆盖。肺泡上皮糖萼（AEGCX）是ALL的一部分，由糖蛋白、蛋白聚糖和糖胺聚糖的混合物组成。与内皮糖萼（GCX）相比，尽管AEGCX被认为参与许多细胞过程，但对其组成和结构的了解要少得多。AEGCX体内可视化的挑战，加上醛固定引起的变形效应，使得准确确定其结构组织和分子组成变得困难。在本研究中，我们旨在通过使用高压冷冻结合冷冻替代（HPF/FS）进行透射电子显微镜（TEM）分析，改善AEGCX超微结构的保存。HPF是一种利用液氮和高压的冷冻保存方法。通过使用HPF/FS保存市售的人原代AECs、人肺泡样类器官、人类器官来源的肺泡样上皮细胞单层以及来自小鼠和人肺的离体组织，我们通过TEM观察到顶端表面有两个不同的区域：沿细胞膜的内层GCX样层，随后是松散排列的外层。我们的数据显示AECs表面存在双层结构。为了减少HPF过程中冷冻诱导的损伤，引入了富含蛋白质的冷冻保护剂来稳定样品。通过处理不含细胞的富含蛋白质冷冻保护剂的对照样品，我们发现HPF/FS保存了冷冻保护剂的成分，TEM分析证实了这一点。这意味着HPF/FS不仅保存了细胞来源的成分，还保存了冷冻保护剂中发现的成分，这可能干扰对外表面层的解释。新意与重要性 AEGCX的结构尚未完全了解。为了避免甲醛诱导的AEGCX破坏，我们通过HPF/FS保存样品进行TEM分析。我们发现了AECs顶端表面两个形态学上不同的区域。沿膜的内层GCX样层，随后是相关的外层。我们发现，在HPF过程中使用的冷冻保护剂以避免冷冻诱导的损伤，会干扰外层，可能误导对其结构的解释。

abstract:
Objectives

Exclusive enteral nutrition (EEN) is the first-line treatment for pediatric Crohn's disease, but its mechanisms of action remain poorly understood. Our aim was to identify the mechanisms that could explain the anti-inflammatory effects of EEN, studying the nutritional composition and transforming growth factor-β (TGF-β) effects, in a mouse model of colitis.Methods

Mice were treated with dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) to induce colitis. After DSS treatment, we compared two enteral nutrition formulas, and we evaluated the effect of TGF-β itself on clinical and microscopic inflammation, and intestinal permeability, by TGF-β-supplementation, -inhibition, or -deletion. Colonic crypts from DSS and EEN mice were cultured and their cellular properties were analyzed.Results

Both EEN formulas improved weight recovery and disease activity index. In contrast, EEN mice treated with TGF-β formula presented faster weight recovery and decreased inflammatory parameters, with a normalized intestinal permeability, suggesting gut restitution and functionality. These functional improvements were not found in the absence of TGF-β in the formulas. Finally, organoids from colonic crypts treated with Modulen IBD® containing TGF-β showed enhanced survival and re-epithelialization capacity.Conclusions

Both EEN formulas have anti-inflammatory properties based on their nutritional composition. However, TGF-β plays a significant role in intestinal functional restitution.
abstractZh:
目的

全肠内营养（EEN）是儿童克罗恩病的一线治疗方法，但其作用机制仍知之甚少。我们的目的是在结肠炎小鼠模型中，通过研究营养成分和转化生长因子-β（TGF-β）的作用，确定可能解释EEN抗炎效应的机制。方法

用葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）处理小鼠以诱导结肠炎。DSS处理后，我们比较了两种肠内营养配方，并通过TGF-β补充、抑制或缺失，评估了TGF-β本身对临床和微观炎症以及肠道通透性的影响。培养来自DSS和EEN小鼠的结肠隐窝，并分析其细胞特性。结果

两种EEN配方均改善了体重恢复和疾病活动指数。相比之下，使用含TGF-β配方治疗的EEN小鼠表现出更快的体重恢复和炎症参数降低，且肠道通透性正常化，提示肠道修复和功能恢复。在配方中缺乏TGF-β的情况下，未观察到这些功能改善。最后，用含TGF-β的Modulen IBD®处理的结肠隐窝类器官显示出增强的存活率和再上皮化能力。结论

两种EEN配方均具有基于其营养成分的抗炎特性。然而，TGF-β在肠道功能恢复中发挥重要作用。

title: Loss of INPP5E affects photoreceptor outer segment membrane biogenesis in iPSC-derived human retinal organoids.

abstract: Mutations in the ciliary gene INPP5E, encoding inositol polyphosphate-5-phosphatase E (INPP5E), can cause retinal degeneration as part of the ciliopathy Joubert syndrome or non-syndromic retinitis pigmentosa (RP). INPP5E regulates the membrane makeup of the primary cilium; however, its function in the specialized sensory photoreceptor cells of the human retina remain unclear. Here, we utilize control and CRISPR/Cas9-generated INPP5E knockout (INPP5ED477N/D477N) human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) to generate retinal organoids (ROs). Through proteomic and immunofluorescence analysis, we show that INPP5E plays an important role in early retinal development and photoreceptor progenitor cell differentiation. In mature ROs, INPP5E localizes to the connecting cilium of photoreceptors, and the loss of INPP5E leads to altered localization of ARL13B and rhodopsin in mature photoreceptors. Furthermore, photoreceptor outer segment structure is affected, leading to elongated outer segment membranes in both cone and rod photoreceptors, suggesting an important role for INPP5E in photoreceptor outer segment membrane biogenesis. Together, these data underline the importance of INPP5E in retina development and photoreceptor structure and highlight the usability of ROs to study protein function in a human context.
abstractZh: 睫状体基因INPP5E（编码肌醇多磷酸-5-磷酸酶E）的突变可导致视网膜变性，作为纤毛病Joubert综合征或非综合征性视网膜色素变性（RP）的一部分。INPP5E调节初级纤毛的膜组成；然而，其在人类视网膜特化感觉感光细胞中的功能仍不清楚。在此，我们利用对照和CRISPR/Cas9生成的INPP5E敲除（INPP5ED477N/D477N）人诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）来生成视网膜类器官（ROs）。通过蛋白质组学和免疫荧光分析，我们表明INPP5E在早期视网膜发育和感光祖细胞分化中发挥重要作用。在成熟的ROs中，INPP5E定位于感光细胞的连接纤毛，而INPP5E的缺失导致成熟感光细胞中ARL13B和视紫红质的定位改变。此外，感光细胞外节结构受到影响，导致视锥和视杆感光细胞的外节膜延长，提示INPP5E在感光细胞外节膜生物发生中发挥重要作用。总之，这些数据强调了INPP5E在视网膜发育和感光细胞结构中的重要性，并突出了ROs在人类背景下研究蛋白质功能的可用性。

title: The EH-binding protein EHBP1 operates in a ciliary functional module affected by INPP5E dysfunction.
titleZh: EH结合蛋白EHBP1在受INPP5E功能障碍影响的纤毛功能模块中发挥作用。

abstract: Inositol polyphosphate-5-phosphatase E (INPP5E) encodes the ciliary protein INPP5E, which plays an important role in regulating the phospholipid membrane makeup of the primary cilium. Here, we utilize proximity labeled proteomics of INPP5E to broaden the number of known functional modules that work in close proximity to the protein. In doing so, we identified the EH-binding protein EHBP1 as a ciliary protein that localizes to the basal body and ciliary compartment of the primary cilium in human-derived fibroblasts and RPE cells. Additionally, we show that EHBP1 localizes to the rudimentary outer segment membrane of developing photoreceptors in retinal organoids. Dysfunction of INPP5E - either due to pathogenic variants in human fibroblasts or CRISPR/Cas9-generated loss-of-function variants in human retinal organoids - causes the localization of EHBP1 to be altered. Our data suggest that EHBP1 functions at the primary cilium and photoreceptors, where it is regulated by INPP5E. This provides further insights into the disease pathogenesis of retinal ciliopathies caused by pathogenic variants in INPP5E, and suggests that EHBP1 might be a candidate gene for retinal ciliopathies.
abstractZh: 肌醇多磷酸-5-磷酸酶E（INPP5E）编码纤毛蛋白INPP5E，该蛋白在调节初级纤毛的磷脂膜组成中发挥重要作用。在此，我们利用INPP5E的邻近标记蛋白质组学来扩大已知的在该蛋白附近发挥功能的功能模块数量。通过这种方式，我们鉴定出EH结合蛋白EHBP1是一种纤毛蛋白，在人源成纤维细胞和RPE细胞中定位于初级纤毛的基体和纤毛区室。此外，我们显示EHBP1在视网膜类器官中发育中的感光细胞的未成熟外节膜上定位。INPP5E的功能障碍——无论是由于人成纤维细胞中的致病性变异还是人视网膜类器官中CRISPR/Cas9产生的功能缺失变异——都会导致EHBP1的定位发生改变。我们的数据表明，EHBP1在初级纤毛和感光细胞中发挥作用，并受INPP5E调控。这为INPP5E致病性变异引起的视网膜纤毛病的发病机制提供了进一步的见解，并提示EHBP1可能是视网膜纤毛病的候选基因。

abstract:
Background and aims

Intestinal tuft cells are rare chemosensory epithelial cells critical for mucosal immunity. However, the molecular features of human intestinal tuft cells remain incompletely defined due to limited access to human tissue and known species-specific differences from murine models. We sought to establish a human tuft cell-enriched intestinal organoid system derived from pluripotent stem cells.Methods

Human pluripotent stem cell-derived intestinal organoids containing epithelial, stromal, and neural components were subjected to Notch pathway inhibition and T helper 2 cytokine stimulation to promote tuft cell differentiation. Induced tuft cells were analyzed by immunofluorescence, quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR), and single-cell RNA sequencing, followed by integrated transcriptomic comparison with primary human small intestinal tuft cells.Results

Tuft cell-enriched organoids were reproducibly generated from 3 independent human pluripotent stem cell lines. Integrated single-cell transcriptomic analyses demonstrated strong concordance between in vitro-derived and primary human tuft cells. The organoid-derived tuft cells exhibited distinct molecular features, including low and non-enriched interleukin-25 expression and predominant DCLK2 expression, distinguishing them from murine tuft cells. Under defined experimental conditions, murine-reported regulatory mechanisms, including bone morphogenetic protein-dependent negative feedback and goblet cell-mediated lateral inhibition, were not recapitulated.Conclusion

We establish a human pluripotent stem cell-derived intestinal organoid model that enables enrichment and molecular characterization of human tuft cells. This platform provides a human-specific system for elucidating molecular programs governing tuft cell differentiation and epithelial-immune signaling.
abstractZh:
背景与目的

肠道簇细胞是罕见的化学感觉上皮细胞，对黏膜免疫至关重要。然而，由于人类组织获取受限以及已知与小鼠模型的物种特异性差异，人类肠道簇细胞的分子特征仍未完全明确。我们试图建立一种由多能干细胞来源的富含人类簇细胞的肠道类器官系统。方法

将含上皮、基质和神经成分的人多能干细胞来源的肠道类器官进行Notch通路抑制和T辅助2型细胞因子刺激，以促进簇细胞分化。通过免疫荧光、定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）和单细胞RNA测序分析诱导的簇细胞，并与原代人小肠簇细胞进行整合转录组比较。结果

从3个独立的人多能干细胞系可重复生成富含簇细胞的类器官。整合单细胞转录组分析表明，体外来源的簇细胞与原代人簇细胞高度一致。类器官来源的簇细胞表现出独特的分子特征，包括白细胞介素-25表达低且不富集，以及DCLK2表达占主导，这使其与小鼠簇细胞区分开来。在明确的实验条件下，小鼠中报道的调控机制，包括骨形态发生蛋白依赖性负反馈和杯状细胞介导的侧向抑制，未被重现。结论

我们建立了一种人多能干细胞来源的肠道类器官模型，能够富集和表征人类簇细胞的分子特征。该平台提供了一个人类特异性系统，用于阐明调控簇细胞分化和上皮-免疫信号传导的分子程序。

title: From patient-derived tumor organoids to personalized cancer therapy: advancing treatment for advanced solid tumors.
titleZh: 从患者来源的肿瘤类器官到个性化癌症治疗：推进晚期实体瘤的治疗。

abstract:
Background

Cancer remains a major global public health burden, with high morbidity and mortality. Despite advances in treatment strategies, many patients with advanced solid tumors face treatment resistance and limited therapeutic options. Patient-derived tumor organoids (PDTOs) have emerged as promising preclinical models for personalized medicine, but their clinical translational potential in guiding individualized treatment for advanced solid tumors requires further validation.Methods

The sample data of 164 solid tumors used for establishing organoids were retrospectively analyzed, and a clinical cohort involving 23 patients with advanced solid tumors was used to validate the feasibility of PDTOs in predicting the treatment response. The concordance between PDTO drug responses and clinical outcomes was evaluated using Cohen's Kappa test.Results

The overall establishment success rate of organoids reached 91.5%, with the rates ranging from 90.6% to 92.6% across different cancer types. Histopathological analysis confirmed that PDTOs partially recapitulated the histopathological features and proliferative activity of matched original tumors. PDTO-based drug sensitivity testing showed good concordance with clinical treatment outcomes of patients with advanced solid tumors, yielding an overall accuracy of 85.0%, a sensitivity of 86.7%, a specificity of 80.0%. Clinical case studies further highlighted the unique value of PDTOs in overcoming multidrug resistance in advanced solid tumors.Conclusions

This study demonstrates that PDTOs exhibit favorable potential for predicting treatment responses in patients with advanced solid tumors, and may serve as a promising auxiliary companion diagnostic tool to inform personalized cancer therapy and assist in evaluating multidrug resistance for advanced solid tumors. Future large-scale, multicenter studies with stratified subgroup validations are warranted to further verify the clinical translational value of PDTOs in individualized tumor treatment.
abstractZh:
背景

癌症仍然是全球主要的公共卫生负担，发病率和死亡率都很高。尽管治疗策略有所进步，但许多晚期实体瘤患者仍面临治疗耐药和有限的治疗选择。患者来源的肿瘤类器官（PDTOs）已成为个性化医疗的有前景的临床前模型，但它们在指导晚期实体瘤个体化治疗方面的临床转化潜力需要进一步验证。方法

回顾性分析了用于建立类器官的164例实体瘤样本数据，并利用一个包含23例晚期实体瘤患者的临床队列来验证PDTOs在预测治疗反应方面的可行性。使用Cohen's Kappa检验评估PDTO药物反应与临床结果之间的一致性。结果

类器官的总体建立成功率达到91.5%，不同癌症类型的成功率在90.6%至92.6%之间。组织病理学分析证实，PDTOs部分重现了匹配的原发肿瘤的组织病理学特征和增殖活性。基于PDTO的药物敏感性测试与晚期实体瘤患者的临床治疗结果显示出良好的一致性，总体准确率为85.0%，敏感性为86.7%，特异性为80.0%。临床病例研究进一步强调了PDTOs在克服晚期实体瘤多药耐药方面的独特价值。结论

本研究表明，PDTOs在预测晚期实体瘤患者治疗反应方面表现出良好的潜力，并可能作为一种有前景的辅助伴随诊断工具，为个性化癌症治疗提供信息，并协助评估晚期实体瘤的多药耐药性。未来需要进行大规模、多中心、分层亚组验证的研究，以进一步验证PDTOs在个体化肿瘤治疗中的临床转化价值。

abstract:
Background and purpose

Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is the most prevalent subtype of lung cancer and a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Current targeted therapies are limited by acquired resistance, highlighting the urgent need for novel therapeutic agents and targets. The aim of this study is to investigate the anti-tumor efficacy of oxypeucedanin (OPD) against LUAD and elucidate its underlying molecular mechanism.Experimental approach

In vitro functional assays, bioinformatics prediction, molecular docking, and binding validation experiments were employed to identify the direct target of OPD. Ubiquitination assays, co-immunoprecipitation coupled with mass spectrometry, and proteomic analysis were used to delineate the downstream pathway. Genetic knockdown/ overexpression rescue experiments were performed, and in vivo efficacy was evaluated using patient-derived organoids and mouse xenograft models.Results

OPD potently suppressed LUAD cell proliferation and induced apoptosis both in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, OPD directly bound to the motor protein KIF11 and promoted its ubiquitin-proteasomal degradation via the E3 ligase TRIM21. KIF11 degradation led to destabilization of its interacting partner, MCM2, consequently downregulating the CDK1/ Cyclin B1 complex and ultimately triggering G2/M phase cell cycle arrest.Conclusion and implications

OPD functions as a novel molecular degrader of KIF11, exerting its anti-LUAD effects by promoting KIF11 ubiquitination and subsequent proteasomal degradation. These results highlight OPD as a promising therapeutic strategy for LUAD.
abstractZh:
背景与目的

肺腺癌（LUAD）是肺癌最常见的亚型，也是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。当前靶向治疗受限于获得性耐药，凸显了对新型治疗药物和靶点的迫切需求。本研究旨在探讨氧前胡素（OPD）对LUAD的抗肿瘤疗效，并阐明其潜在分子机制。实验方法

采用体外功能实验、生物信息学预测、分子对接和结合验证实验来鉴定OPD的直接靶点。利用泛素化实验、免疫共沉淀结合质谱分析以及蛋白质组学分析来描绘下游通路。进行了基因敲低/过表达拯救实验，并使用患者来源类器官和小鼠异种移植模型评估体内疗效。结果

OPD在体外和体内均有效抑制LUAD细胞增殖并诱导凋亡。机制上，OPD直接结合运动蛋白KIF11，并通过E3连接酶TRIM21促进其泛素-蛋白酶体降解。KIF11降解导致其相互作用伙伴MCM2不稳定，进而下调CDK1/Cyclin B1复合物，最终触发G2/M期细胞周期阻滞。结论与意义

OPD作为KIF11的新型分子降解剂，通过促进KIF11泛素化及随后的蛋白酶体降解发挥抗LUAD作用。这些结果凸显了OPD作为LUAD有前景的治疗策略。

abstract: Organoids are three-dimensional structures derived from a single stem cell. They self-organize in vitro and mature to recreate microarchitecture and characteristics of their tissues of origin. Since the first culture of mouse intestinal epithelial organoids and the translation to human, this technology has shown vast potential. Applications include developmental biology, disease modelling, drug testing and regenerative medicine making it increasingly relevant to clinical practice. Organoids can now be generated from tissues such as lung, intestine, kidney and brain using adult and fetal stem cells, pluripotent stem cells and cancer samples. Whether to study fetal development, disease physiopathology, regenerative medicine or to develop new therapies in a faster, more ethical and cost-effective way than animal models, organoids represent a powerful new tool. First described in 1999, personalised medicine aims to fine-tune diagnostic, prognosis and treatment to each patient. Nowadays, personalised medicine is spreading to most areas of clinical management, becoming the gold standard for the adoption of new interventions. More recently, these concepts have been applied to fetal medicine for prevention and therapy with initial reports appearing in literature in 2020. By recapitulating patient-specific disease mechanisms, prenatal organoids represent a unique bridge between in vitro-based approaches and personalised fetal medicine. This review presents fetal diseases for which organoids were explored, focusing on the implications of their derivation from prenatal sources such as the amniotic fluid, and discusses their advantages, challenges, and perspectives for prenatal counselling, prognosis or diagnosis, regenerative therapy, in utero surgery, disease modelling and prenatal drug testing.
abstractZh: 类器官是由单个干细胞衍生的三维结构。它们在体外自我组织并成熟，以重现其来源组织的微结构和特征。自首次培养小鼠肠道上皮类器官并转化至人类以来，这项技术已显示出巨大的潜力。其应用包括发育生物学、疾病建模、药物测试和再生医学，使其与临床实践越来越相关。现在，可以使用成体和胎儿干细胞、多能干细胞以及癌症样本，从肺、肠、肾和脑等组织生成类器官。无论是为了研究胎儿发育、疾病病理生理学、再生医学，还是为了以比动物模型更快、更道德且更具成本效益的方式开发新疗法，类器官都代表了一种强大的新工具。个性化医疗于1999年首次被描述，旨在为每位患者微调诊断、预后和治疗。如今，个性化医疗正扩展到临床管理的大多数领域，成为采用新干预措施的金标准。最近，这些概念已被应用于胎儿医学的预防和治疗，2020年文献中出现了初步报告。通过重现患者特异性疾病机制，产前类器官代表了基于体外的方法与个性化胎儿医学之间的独特桥梁。本综述介绍了已探索类器官的胎儿疾病，重点关注其从产前来源（如羊水）衍生的意义，并讨论了其在产前咨询、预后或诊断、再生治疗、宫内手术、疾病建模和产前药物测试方面的优势、挑战和前景。

title: Histological Processing of Organoids for Immunostaining.

abstract: Organoids are three-dimensional cell structures derived from stem cells that recapitulate the architecture and function of native tissues. Histological analysis of organoids is essential for assessing their structure, cellular composition, and responses to experimental conditions. However, their small size and fragility make standard paraffin embedding workflows difficult. Here, we describe a robust and reproducible protocol for the fixation, paraffin embedding, and sectioning of human organoids, enabling high-quality histological and immunostaining analysis. The method involves direct fixation within the culture matrix and inclusion in HistoGel to prevent organoid loss during processing. The protocol is compatible with hematoxylin-eosin (H&E) staining and multiplex immunofluorescence. Critical steps, troubleshooting, and adaptations for intestinal and cardiac organoids are discussed. This cost-effective and accessible method supports long-term preservation and detailed structural analysis of organoid models. Key features • Enables reliable fixation, embedding, and sectioning of fragile human organoids for histological and immunofluorescence analysis. • Uses HistoGel inclusion to prevent organoid loss during paraffin embedding and processing. • Compatible with multiple organoid types (intestinal, cardiac, etc.) and staining methods (H&E, immunofluorescence). • Produces high-quality paraffin blocks and sections suitable for long-term storage.
abstractZh: 类器官是由干细胞衍生的三维细胞结构，能够重现天然组织的结构和功能。类器官的组织学分析对于评估其结构、细胞组成以及对实验条件的反应至关重要。然而，它们体积小且脆弱，使得标准的石蜡包埋流程难以进行。在此，我们描述了一种稳健且可重复的方案，用于人类类器官的固定、石蜡包埋和切片，从而实现高质量的组织学和免疫染色分析。该方法涉及在培养基质内直接固定，并包埋于HistoGel中，以防止处理过程中类器官的丢失。该方案与苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色和多重免疫荧光兼容。讨论了关键步骤、故障排除以及针对肠道和心脏类器官的适应性调整。这种经济高效且易于操作的方法支持类器官模型的长期保存和详细结构分析。关键特征 • 能够对脆弱的人类类器官进行可靠的固定、包埋和切片，用于组织学和免疫荧光分析。 • 使用HistoGel包埋以防止石蜡包埋和处理过程中类器官的丢失。 • 兼容多种类器官类型（肠道、心脏等）和染色方法（H&E、免疫荧光）。 • 产生适合长期储存的高质量石蜡块和切片。

title: Protocol for Measuring Drug-Target Engagement in Mouse Colorectal Cancer Organoids Using NanoBRET Assay.
titleZh: 使用NanoBRET实验测量小鼠结直肠癌类器官中药物-靶点结合的方法。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Badmos HA, Steele C, Cagan R.
affiliations: School of Cancer Sciences, Wolfson Wohl Cancer Research Centre, University of Glasgow, Glasgow, UK.
abstract: Organoids as a drug discovery platform represent an emerging field that continues to refine its tools. NanoBRET (bioluminescence resonance energy transfer) has emerged as a proximity-based and highly sensitive assay to measure protein-protein and protein-ligand interactions. NanoBRET assays were developed and are currently used for 2D cell line experiments. Here, we present the development of the first organoid-compatible Nanoluciferase (Nluc) for 3D model systems. We utilise the Nluc for NanoBRET assays to test drug-target engagement. We describe steps for seeding, transfecting, and replating of mouse colorectal cancer organoids. In addition, we provide detailed procedures for the NanoBRET assay. Various lines of evidence have shown significant difference in drug response between 2D human cell lines and 3D model systems, including patient-derived organoids. Our protocol provides a template for measuring this difference in the context of drug-target engagement. Key features • Development of organoid-compatible Nluc vector. • Lentiviral delivery and antibiotic selection of MEK1-Nluc organoids. • NanoBRET assay for the real-time measurement of drug-target engagement in organoids. • Quantitative measurement of competitive drug binding in living 3D organoids. • Impact of drug combinations on drug-target engagement in organoids.
abstractZh: 类器官作为药物发现平台是一个新兴领域，其工具仍在不断完善中。NanoBRET（生物发光共振能量转移）已成为一种基于邻近效应且高度灵敏的检测方法，用于测量蛋白质-蛋白质和蛋白质-配体相互作用。NanoBRET实验已被开发并目前用于二维细胞系实验。在此，我们介绍了首个适用于三维模型系统的类器官兼容型Nano荧光素酶（Nluc）的开发。我们利用Nluc进行NanoBRET实验以测试药物-靶点结合。我们描述了小鼠结直肠癌类器官的接种、转染和重新铺板的步骤。此外，我们提供了NanoBRET实验的详细操作流程。多种证据表明，二维人类细胞系与三维模型系统（包括患者来源的类器官）在药物反应上存在显著差异。我们的方案为在药物-靶点结合背景下测量这种差异提供了模板。关键特点 • 开发类器官兼容的Nluc载体。 • 慢病毒递送和抗生素筛选MEK1-Nluc类器官。 • NanoBRET实验用于实时测量类器官中的药物-靶点结合。 • 定量测量活体三维类器官中的竞争性药物结合。 • 药物组合对类器官中药物-靶点结合的影响。

title: Preclinical Models of Bladder Cancer: Barrier, Metabolic, and Translational Susceptibility.
titleZh: 膀胱癌临床前模型：屏障、代谢与转化易感性。

abstract: Preclinical bladder cancer models are often judged by tumor take, tumor growth or treatment inhibition, yet these endpoints do not reveal which bladder-specific constraints a given model preserves or bypasses. The bladder is shaped by a specialized urothelial barrier, urine exposure, cyclic filling and emptying, inflammatory injury, metabolic stress and intravesical treatment pressure. In this review, we use susceptibility engineering as an organizing framework for model selection and validation. We define susceptibility engineering as the deliberate definition, perturbation and reporting of model states that alter tumor initiation, adhesion, colonization, survival or therapeutic exposure. This framework groups cell lines, patient-derived organoids, cell-line-derived xenograft (CDX) and patient-derived xenograft (PDX) models, orthotopic transplantation, N-butyl-N-(4-hydroxybutyl) nitrosamine (BBN)-induced tumors, genetically engineered mouse models and large-animal platforms according to the biological constraints they test. We focus on three linked dimensions: urothelial barrier integrity and uroplakin-related tools; local colonization thresholds under bladder-specific selection; metabolic susceptibility involving peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARG)-associated differentiation programs and candidate solute carrier family 25 (SLC25)-linked mitochondrial stress nodes. We further distinguish large-animal systems as platforms for local delivery, imaging, device testing and procedural scale rather than universal substitutes for mouse models. A susceptibility-based validation framework could improve model selection, explain divergent responses across systems and support tiered platforms that connect patient-derived biology, mechanistic mouse studies and clinically realistic intravesical evaluation.
abstractZh: 临床前膀胱癌模型通常通过肿瘤生长率、肿瘤生长或治疗抑制来评判，但这些终点并不能揭示特定模型保留或绕过了哪些膀胱特异性限制。膀胱受特化的尿路上皮屏障、尿液暴露、周期性充盈和排空、炎症损伤、代谢应激和膀胱内治疗压力的影响。在本综述中，我们使用易感性工程作为模型选择和验证的组织框架。我们将易感性工程定义为对改变肿瘤起始、粘附、定植、存活或治疗暴露的模型状态进行有意的定义、扰动和报告。该框架根据所测试的生物学限制，将细胞系、患者来源的类器官、细胞系来源的异种移植（CDX）和患者来源的异种移植（PDX）模型、原位移植、N-丁基-N-(4-羟基丁基)亚硝胺（BBN）诱导的肿瘤、基因工程小鼠模型和大动物平台进行分组。我们关注三个相互关联的维度：尿路上皮屏障完整性和与尿斑蛋白相关的工具；膀胱特异性选择下的局部定植阈值；涉及过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARG）相关分化程序和候选溶质载体家族25（SLC25）相关线粒体应激节点的代谢易感性。我们进一步将大动物系统区分为局部给药、成像、设备测试和操作规模扩展的平台，而非小鼠模型的普遍替代品。基于易感性的验证框架可以改进模型选择，解释不同系统间的差异反应，并支持连接患者来源生物学、机制性小鼠研究和临床现实膀胱内评估的分层平台。

title: A Colon Cancer Organoid-on-a-Chip Model for In Vitro Therapy Assessment.
titleZh: 用于体外治疗评估的结肠癌类器官芯片模型。

abstract: Colon cancer is one of the leading causes of death, requiring advanced therapies that need models for developing new drugs. Conventional cell culture models do not accurately and precisely reproduce the complexity of the tumor microenvironment, limiting their usefulness in research and therapy development. To address this weakness, patient-derived organoids have emerged as promising in vitro models. The implementation of these organoid-based models into more physiologically relevant systems is expected to improve their clinical relevance. Thus, integrating these organoids into microfluidic chips acting as bioreactors will likely improve the predictive response of therapies in personalized medicine. In this article, we report the development of a new colon cancer organoid-on-a-chip model that enables the in vitro culture of patient-derived colon cancer organoids under continuous culture media flow. We demonstrate how the developed organoids were derived from tumor biopsies of patients with colorectal cancer, expanded in standard three-dimensional (3D) culture, and cultured inside the microfluidic chips. The microfluidic chip chambers are designed to house organoids in a controlled environment, allowing the injection of therapies and monitoring by optical microscopy in real time. The in vitro therapies tested were a combination of drugs based on 5-fluorouracil and oxaliplatin at different concentrations. As a result, we demonstrate for the first time that this model proves the capability of this technology for in vitro testing colon cancer therapies.
abstractZh: 结肠癌是导致死亡的主要原因之一，需要先进的疗法，而这些疗法的开发需要模型。传统的细胞培养模型不能准确且精确地再现肿瘤微环境的复杂性，限制了其在研究和疗法开发中的实用性。为了解决这一弱点，患者来源的类器官已成为有前景的体外模型。将这些基于类器官的模型整合到更具生理相关性的系统中，有望提高其临床相关性。因此，将这些类器官整合到作为生物反应器的微流控芯片中，可能会提高个性化医疗中疗法的预测性反应。在本文中，我们报告了一种新的结肠癌类器官芯片模型的开发，该模型能够在持续培养基流下进行患者来源的结肠癌类器官的体外培养。我们展示了所开发的类器官如何来源于结直肠癌患者的肿瘤活检组织，在标准三维（3D）培养中扩增，并在微流控芯片内培养。微流控芯片腔室设计用于在受控环境中容纳类器官，允许注射疗法并通过光学显微镜实时监测。所测试的体外疗法是基于5-氟尿嘧啶和奥沙利铂的不同浓度药物组合。因此，我们首次证明该模型证明了该技术在体外测试结肠癌疗法方面的能力。

title: JAK and TYK2 inhibitors differentially modulate interferon/TNF-driven inflammation, stemness and proliferation in the colonic epithelium of ulcerative colitis
titleZh: JAK和TYK2抑制剂差异调节溃疡性结肠炎结肠上皮中干扰素/TNF驱动的炎症、干性和增殖
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Sridhar A, Walaas GAE, Sæterstad S, Myrmehl JPD, Cermakova R, Myrseth MG, Grundel L, Hansen MD, Otterstad M, Høivik ML, Østvik AE, Bakke I, Bruland T.
abstract:
Background

  Janus kinase (JAK)-Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription (STAT) pathway is a key regulator of inflammatory signaling in ulcerative colitis (UC). While most studies have focused on JAK/tyrosine kinase 2 (TYK2) inhibitors effects on immune cell-mediated responses, their direct epithelial impact remains less known. We investigated epithelial-specific transcriptional responses to JAK/TYK2 inhibitors using patient-derived intestinal epithelial organoids (IEOs) under UC-relevant conditions. Methods

  Colonic IEOs from UC patients were pretreated with various concentrations of tofacitinib, upadacitinib, filgotinib, brepocitinib, and deucravacitinib for 1 hour prior to stimulation with IFNβ, IFNγ, or IFNλ1 for Western blot analysis of STAT1/3 and TYK2 phosphorylation. For transcriptomic profiling, IEOs were pretreated with upadacitinib or deucravacitinib for 16 hours, followed by 8-hour stimulation with IFNγ, IFNλ1, TNF, or IFNγ + TNF. Bulk RNA sequencing assessed differential gene expression, and multiplex assays quantified chemokine secretion. Ki67 immunohistochemistry on colonic biopsies from healthy controls, and UC patients with and without JAK inhibitors-treatment were assessed for epithelial proliferation. Results

  IFNs induced distinct STAT1/3 and TYK2 activation, with IFNβ/γ eliciting stronger phosphorylation than IFNλ1. All JAK/TYK2 inhibitors regulated pSTAT1/3 and pTYK2, with upadacitinib most strongly inhibiting pSTAT1/3 and deucravacitinib selectively targeting pTYK2. Transcriptomic analysis revealed extensive cytokine-driven gene regulation, with IFNγ + TNF eliciting the strongest response. Enrichment analysis highlighted upregulation of IFN signaling, antigen presentation, and innate immune pathways, alongside downregulation of cell-cycle processes. Drug-response profiling showed minimal transcriptional changes with upadacitinib and deucravacitinib alone. Upadacitinib broadly modulated IFNs and IFNγ + TNF-regulated genes, attenuating JAK-STAT, NFκB, antiviral, and cell death pathways, while restoring genes linked to mucosal healing. Upadacitinib also reduced IFNs and IFNγ + TNF-driven chemokine genes and protein secretion. In contrast, deucravacitinib showed selective, potent inhibition of inflammatory genes under IFNλ1-stimulation. Both inhibitors minimally impacted TNF-driven pathways. Ki67 immunohistochemistry confirmed enhanced epithelial proliferation in JAK inhibitor-treated UC patients regardless of mucosal inflammation status. Conclusions

  Our findings provide novel evidence that JAK/TYK2 inhibitors influence epithelial transcriptional programs associated with inflammation and mucosal healing. Upadacitinib demonstrated broader modulation of cytokine-driven gene networks compared to TYK2-selective inhibition. These findings provide insight into epithelial-specific drug actions and support precision approaches for UC therapy.
abstractZh:
背景

Janus激酶（JAK）-信号转导与转录激活因子（STAT）通路是溃疡性结肠炎（UC）炎症信号的关键调节因子。虽然大多数研究关注JAK/酪氨酸激酶2（TYK2）抑制剂对免疫细胞介导反应的影响，但其对上皮细胞的直接影响仍知之甚少。我们使用患者来源的肠道上皮类器官（IEOs）在UC相关条件下研究了JAK/TYK2抑制剂的上皮特异性转录反应。方法

从UC患者获取的结肠IEOs用不同浓度的托法替尼、乌帕替尼、非戈替尼、布雷泊替尼和德卡伐替尼预处理1小时，然后用IFNβ、IFNγ或IFNλ1刺激，通过Western blot分析STAT1/3和TYK2的磷酸化。对于转录组分析，IEOs用乌帕替尼或德卡伐替尼预处理16小时，随后用IFNγ、IFNλ1、TNF或IFNγ+TNF刺激8小时。通过批量RNA测序评估差异基因表达，并通过多重检测定量趋化因子分泌。对健康对照、未接受JAK抑制剂治疗的UC患者以及接受JAK抑制剂治疗的UC患者的结肠活检组织进行Ki67免疫组化染色，评估上皮增殖情况。结果

干扰素诱导了不同的STAT1/3和TYK2激活，其中IFNβ/γ比IFNλ1诱导更强的磷酸化。所有JAK/TYK2抑制剂均调节pSTAT1/3和pTYK2，其中乌帕替尼对pSTAT1/3的抑制作用最强，而德卡伐替尼选择性靶向pTYK2。转录组分析揭示了广泛的细胞因子驱动的基因调控，其中IFNγ+TNF诱导的反应最强。富集分析强调了干扰素信号、抗原呈递和先天免疫通路的上调，以及细胞周期过程的下调。药物反应分析显示，单独使用乌帕替尼和德卡伐替尼时转录变化最小。乌帕替尼广泛调节IFNs和IFNγ+TNF调控的基因，减弱JAK-STAT、NFκB、抗病毒和细胞死亡通路，同时恢复与黏膜愈合相关的基因。乌帕替尼还减少了IFNs和IFNγ+TNF驱动的趋化因子基因和蛋白分泌。相比之下，德卡伐替尼在IFNλ1刺激下显示出对炎症基因的选择性、强效抑制。两种抑制剂对TNF驱动的通路影响最小。Ki67免疫组化证实，接受JAK抑制剂治疗的UC患者上皮增殖增强，无论黏膜炎症状态如何。结论

我们的研究提供了新的证据，表明JAK/TYK2抑制剂影响与炎症和黏膜愈合相关的上皮转录程序。与TYK2选择性抑制相比，乌帕替尼显示出对细胞因子驱动的基因网络更广泛的调节。这些发现为上皮特异性药物作用提供了见解，并支持UC治疗的精准方法。

abstract:
Background

Acute liver injury (ALI) can rapidly progress to life-threatening acute liver failure. Liver transplantation remains the only definitive treatment, despite critical donor shortages. Macrophage-based therapies have shown promise in ALI but face challenges related to subset imprecision and limited humanized validation. VSIG4 is generally considered a marker of Kupffer cells; however, it is also expressed in monocyte-derived macrophages (MoMFs), and its role remains unclear during ALI.Methods

By integrating single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data from human and mouse liver tissues with clinical ALI tissue samples, we elucidated the dynamic changes in VSIG4+ macrophages (VSIG4+ Mφ) within the liver. We developed a reversible immunomagnetic nanoparticle system for the non-destructive isolation of viable VSIG4+ Mφ. The therapeutic efficacy and potential mechanisms of VSIG4+ Mφ were evaluated through tissue and molecular-level analyses in an acetaminophen (APAP)-induced ALI mouse model, as well as in a newly established vascularized human liver organoid ALI and monocyte chemotaxis model.Results

scRNA-seq revealed a previously underrecognized subpopulation of VSIG4+ MoMFs, which increases following ALI, while the number of resident VSIG4+ Kupffer cells decreases significantly. Clinical ALI tissue samples also confirmed the presence of CCR2+VSIG4+ cells in the livers of patients with ALI. In the APAP-induced ALI animal model, adoptive transfer of isolated VSIG4+ MoMFs dramatically decreased serum alanine transaminase, hepatic necrosis, and apoptosis while increasing anti-inflammatory cytokines. In contrast, adoptive transfer of unselected BMDM failed to improve liver injury and instead exacerbated certain pro-inflammatory responses, including elevated TNF-α and reduced CD206 expression. Mechanistically, VSIG4+ MoMFs prevented inflammatory amplification by suppressing NF-κB-dependent CCL2 transcription, thereby disrupting the CCL2-CCR2 chemotactic axis and reducing pro-inflammatory CCR2+ monocyte and macrophage recruitment. We further developed vascularized human liver organoids and APAP-induced hepatocyte injury and monocyte chemotaxis, finding that the chemotaxis-interrupting mechanism was fully recapitulated in the human liver organoid ALI model.Discussion

This study identifies VSIG4+ MoMFs as a therapeutically viable subset for ALI, with clear superiority over unselected BMDM. By blocking the CCL2-CCR2 inflammatory amplification loop, these cells attenuate liver injury in both mouse and humanized models. These consistent findings provide robust preclinical evidence to support the advancement of VSIG4+ Mφ-based immunotherapies into clinical practice.
abstractZh:
背景

急性肝损伤（ALI）可迅速进展为危及生命的急性肝衰竭。尽管存在严重的供体短缺，肝移植仍是唯一的根治性治疗方法。基于巨噬细胞的疗法在ALI中显示出前景，但面临亚群不精确和人源化验证有限等挑战。VSIG4通常被认为是库普弗细胞的标志物；然而，它也表达于单核细胞来源的巨噬细胞（MoMFs），其在ALI期间的作用尚不清楚。方法

通过整合人和小鼠肝脏组织的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据以及临床ALI组织样本，我们阐明了肝脏内VSIG4+巨噬细胞（VSIG4+ Mφ）的动态变化。我们开发了一种可逆的免疫磁珠纳米颗粒系统，用于非破坏性分离存活的VSIG4+ Mφ。通过对乙酰氨基酚（APAP）诱导的ALI小鼠模型以及新建立的人肝脏类器官ALI和单核细胞趋化模型，在组织和分子水平上评估了VSIG4+ Mφ的治疗效果和潜在机制。结果

scRNA-seq揭示了一个先前未被充分认识的VSIG4+ MoMFs亚群，该亚群在ALI后增加，而常驻的VSIG4+库普弗细胞数量显著减少。临床ALI组织样本也证实了ALI患者肝脏中存在CCR2+VSIG4+细胞。在APAP诱导的ALI动物模型中，过继转移分离的VSIG4+ MoMFs显著降低了血清丙氨酸转氨酶、肝坏死和凋亡，同时增加了抗炎细胞因子。相比之下，过继转移未选择的BMDM未能改善肝损伤，反而加剧了某些促炎反应，包括TNF-α升高和CD206表达降低。机制上，VSIG4+ MoMFs通过抑制NF-κB依赖的CCL2转录来阻止炎症放大，从而破坏CCL2-CCR2趋化轴并减少促炎性CCR2+单核细胞和巨噬细胞的募集。我们进一步开发了血管化的人肝脏类器官以及APAP诱导的肝细胞损伤和单核细胞趋化模型，发现趋化中断机制在人肝脏类器官ALI模型中完全重现。讨论

本研究确定VSIG4+ MoMFs是ALI的一个治疗可行亚群，明显优于未选择的BMDM。通过阻断CCL2-CCR2炎症放大环路，这些细胞在小鼠和人源化模型中均减轻了肝损伤。这些一致的结果为支持VSIG4+ Mφ免疫疗法进入临床实践提供了强有力的临床前证据。

abstract: Vascular dementia (VaD), whose leading cause is chronic cerebral hypoperfusion (CCH), currently has no approved effective disease-modifying therapies. The lung-brain axis mediates crosstalk between the lung and the nervous system, yet the specific mediators underlying its role in VaD remain unclear. This study demonstrated that subcutaneous transplantation of lung organoids (LO) ameliorated cognitive dysfunction in a mouse model of bilateral common carotid artery stenosis (BCAS). We showed that BCAS-induced CCH downregulated pulmonary expression of insulin-like growth factor-binding protein 7 (IGFBP7), a key mediator of the lung-brain axis. LO transplantation restored​circulating IGFBP7, which translocated to the brain and acted directly on microglia by binding to Argonaute2 (Ago2), thereby inhibiting pro-inflammatory signaling pathways, reducing neurovascular damage and neuroinflammation, and alleviating​peripheral lung injury caused by CCH. Notably, LO transplantation concurrently restores cerebral function and pulmonary homeostasis, with concurrent recovery of endogenous pulmonary IGFBP7 expression in BCAS mice, indicating concurrent improvement of both brain and lung pathology through lung-brain axis crosstalk. This study confirmed that LO transplantation represented an effective biotherapy for VaD and identified the IGFBP7-Ago2 axis as a core regulatory pathway of the lung-brain axis. These findings provide mechanistic insights into the pathogenesis of VaD and highlight that IGFBP7 is a potential therapeutic target for restoring inter-organ crosstalk in dementia.
abstractZh: 血管性痴呆（VaD）的主要病因是慢性脑低灌注（CCH），目前尚无获批的有效疾病修饰疗法。肺-脑轴介导肺与神经系统之间的串扰，但其在VaD中发挥作用的具体介质仍不清楚。本研究表明，在双侧颈总动脉狭窄（BCAS）小鼠模型中，皮下移植肺类器官（LO）可改善认知功能障碍。我们发现，BCAS诱导的CCH下调了肺中胰岛素样生长因子结合蛋白7（IGFBP7）的表达，而IGFBP7是肺-脑轴的关键介质。LO移植恢复了循环中的IGFBP7，其易位至大脑并直接作用于小胶质细胞，通过与Argonaute2（Ago2）结合，抑制促炎信号通路，减少神经血管损伤和神经炎症，并减轻CCH引起的外周肺损伤。值得注意的是，LO移植同时恢复脑功能和肺稳态，BCAS小鼠内源性肺IGFBP7表达同步恢复，表明通过肺-脑轴串扰同时改善脑和肺病理。本研究证实LO移植是VaD的有效生物疗法，并确定IGFBP7-Ago2轴是肺-脑轴的核心调控通路。这些发现为VaD的发病机制提供了机制性见解，并强调IGFBP7是恢复痴呆中器官间串扰的潜在治疗靶点。

abstract: Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) can recapitulate selected features of original tumors and provide a useful system for studying epithelial ovarian cancer (EOC) in three-dimensional culture. Nonetheless, the protocol to generate EOC-PDOs has not yet been standardized. We therefore empirically refined the culture conditions and medium composition, considering the protocol effective when EOC PDOs were successfully established in five consecutive attempts. Tissue and ascites samples (from 29 and 8 patients, respectively) were used and the Syringe-extruded Organoid Basement membrane extract Assembly (SOBA) fragment culture method applied. Selected similarities in cell morphology, marker expression, and detectable alterations between organoids and patient-matched tumor tissue were assessed using pairwise comparisons. The refined workflow used a culture medium containing recombinant human R-Spondin 1 protein (250 ng/mL), Noggin, and NRG1, factors implicated in organoid maintenance and expansion. Ultimately, 31 EOC organoid lines successfully generated from 82.8% (24/29) of tissue and 87.5% (7/8) of ascites samples. The SOBA technique increased the 10 day PDO yield by 2.75-fold relative to the surface-attached dome method (p < 0.0001). This empirically refined workflow can be adjusted for specific experimental applications; however, further validation across larger and clinically diverse EOC cohorts is required.
abstractZh: 患者来源类器官（PDOs）能够重现原发肿瘤的特定特征，并为在三维培养中研究上皮性卵巢癌（EOC）提供有用系统。然而，生成EOC-PDOs的方案尚未标准化。因此，我们经验性地优化了培养条件和培养基组成，当EOC PDOs在连续五次尝试中成功建立时，认为该方案有效。使用了组织样本（来自29名患者）和腹水样本（来自8名患者），并采用了注射器挤出类器官基底膜提取物组装（SOBA）片段培养方法。通过配对比较，评估了类器官与患者匹配肿瘤组织在细胞形态、标志物表达和可检测变异方面的选定相似性。优化后的流程使用了含有重组人R-Spondin 1蛋白（250 ng/mL）、Noggin和NRG1的培养基，这些因子与类器官的维持和扩增有关。最终，从82.8%（24/29）的组织样本和87.5%（7/8）的腹水样本中成功生成了31个EOC类器官系。SOBA技术使10天PDO产量相对于表面附着圆顶法提高了2.75倍（p < 0.0001）。这种经验优化的流程可根据特定实验应用进行调整；然而，需要在更大且临床多样化的EOC队列中进行进一步验证。

abstract: Neuromodulation is widely employed to enhance neural activity and restore impaired circuitry, yet current methods suffer from invasiveness, limited depth, or poor spatial resolution. Temporal interference stimulation (TIS) has emerged as a non-invasive approach to modulate deep brain regions via interference of high-frequency electric fields, achieving spatial selectivity. Despite its potential, the physiological effects remain unexplored. Here, we present a customized liquid metal-based neural interface to record electrophysiological responses to TIS across diverse neural tissues, from brain organoids to mouse brains. The softness of the interface minimizes invasiveness while ensuring stable access to deep neural regions. Electrophysiological analyses reveal TIS-induced dynamics in neurodevelopment and functional connectivity. Furthermore, we investigated latent neural dynamics, presenting population-level neural activity, to compare responses across models of differing complexity and maturity. By combining soft neural interfaces with multi-scale analyses, this study uncovers how neuromodulation shapes neural dynamics and supports the development of future therapeutic strategies.
abstractZh: 神经调控被广泛用于增强神经活动并修复受损的神经回路，然而当前的方法存在侵入性、深度有限或空间分辨率差等问题。时间干涉刺激（TIS）作为一种非侵入性方法，通过高频电场干涉来调节深部脑区，实现了空间选择性。尽管其具有潜力，但生理效应仍未得到探索。在此，我们提出了一种定制的基于液态金属的神经界面，用于记录从脑类器官到小鼠大脑等多种神经组织对TIS的电生理反应。该界面的柔软性最大限度地减少了侵入性，同时确保了对深部神经区域的稳定访问。电生理分析揭示了TIS诱导的神经发育和功能连接性动力学变化。此外，我们研究了潜在的神经动力学，呈现群体水平的神经活动，以比较不同复杂性和成熟度模型之间的反应。通过将软神经界面与多尺度分析相结合，本研究揭示了神经调控如何塑造神经动力学，并为未来治疗策略的发展提供支持。

abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative disorder characterised by progressive dementia, brain atrophy, and ultimately death. Using cerebral organoids derived from human-induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) carrying the familial PSEN1 A246E variant, we investigated the temporal relationship between amyloid-β (Aβ) dysregulation and spontaneous neuronal activity. Multielectrode array recordings from the differentiation day 60 (DD60) to at least DD130 revealed that AD organoids exhibited transient hyperexcitability and hypersynchrony compared with wild-type (WT) controls, followed by a gradual decline in activity. During the enhanced excitability stage, both elevated Aβ42/40 and Aβ aggregate size showed positive correlations with the percentage of active electrodes and the global synchrony index (GSI) in AD organoids. These findings indicate that Aβ dysregulation might contribute to transient network hyperexcitability in early AD. The results also suggest that patient-derived cerebral organoids may serve as a translational model to examine early network dysfunction and inform future investigations of potential Aβ-induced changes in excitability during the preclinical stages of AD.
abstractZh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种神经退行性疾病，其特征为进行性痴呆、脑萎缩，最终导致死亡。利用携带家族性PSEN1 A246E变异的人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）来源的脑类器官，我们研究了淀粉样蛋白-β（Aβ）失调与自发神经元活动之间的时间关系。从分化第60天（DD60）到至少DD130的多电极阵列记录显示，与野生型（WT）对照相比，AD类器官表现出短暂的高兴奋性和高同步性，随后活动逐渐下降。在兴奋性增强阶段，升高的Aβ42/40和Aβ聚集体大小均与AD类器官中活性电极的百分比和全局同步指数（GSI）呈正相关。这些发现表明，Aβ失调可能有助于早期AD中短暂的网络高兴奋性。结果还表明，患者来源的脑类器官可作为研究早期网络功能障碍的转化模型，并为未来调查AD临床前阶段中潜在的Aβ诱导的兴奋性变化提供信息。

abstract: Triclosan (TCS) and triclocarban (TCC), which are widely used as antimicrobial agents, come into direct contact with humans due to their increasing environmental release. Because of concerns regarding the environmental impact and potential hepatotoxicity of TCS, it is being phased out in many countries and substituted with TCC. However, the biological and molecular mechanisms underlying TCC's toxicity, particularly in relation to liver damage, remain largely unexplored. In this study, we demonstrated that although TCC exhibited reduced hepatotoxicity relative to TCS, it exerted a more significant impact on cholangiocytes compared to TCS. Using an intrahepatic cholangiocyte organoid model, we identified ferroptosis as a predominant pathological feature of TCC-induced cytotoxicity and dysfunction in cholangiocytes, characterized by iron overload, ROS generation, lipid peroxidation, and aberrant activation of the ferroptosis pathway. Mechanistically, TCC not only elevated Fe2+ levels in organoids by disrupting iron metabolism pathway but also impaired the antioxidant system by targeting the SLC7A11/GSH/GPX4 antioxidant axis, indicating that TCC induced ferroptosis through both canonical and noncanonical pathways. Notably, targeting ferroptosis with the ferroptosis inhibitor Fer-1 effectively rescued the cytotoxicity and attenuated the enhanced secretory function of organoids induced by TCC. Our study elucidates the critical cellular events occurring in cholangiocytes exposed to TCC and provides valuable insights into the mechanisms by which TCC exerts its toxic effects within the hepatobiliary system.
abstractZh: 三氯生（TCS）和三氯卡班（TCC）作为广泛使用的抗菌剂，由于其环境释放量的增加，与人类直接接触。由于对TCS的环境影响和潜在肝毒性的担忧，许多国家正在逐步淘汰TCS，并代之以TCC。然而，TCC毒性背后的生物学和分子机制，特别是在肝损伤方面，在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在本研究中，我们证明，尽管TCC相对于TCS表现出较低的肝毒性，但TCC对胆管细胞的影响比TCS更为显著。利用肝内胆管细胞类器官模型，我们确定铁死亡是TCC诱导的胆管细胞细胞毒性和功能障碍的主要病理特征，其特征为铁过载、活性氧生成、脂质过氧化以及铁死亡通路的异常激活。在机制上，TCC不仅通过破坏铁代谢途径提高类器官中的Fe2+水平，还通过靶向SLC7A11/GSH/GPX4抗氧化轴损害抗氧化系统，表明TCC通过经典和非经典途径诱导铁死亡。值得注意的是，使用铁死亡抑制剂Fer-1靶向铁死亡，可有效挽救TCC诱导的细胞毒性，并减轻类器官分泌功能的增强。我们的研究阐明了暴露于TCC的胆管细胞中发生的关键细胞事件，并为TCC在肝胆系统中发挥毒性作用的机制提供了有价值的见解。

abstract: Integrating pulmonary drug delivery and nanotechnology presents a promising strategy to enhance the efficacy and safety profile of lung cancer chemotherapy. This study aimed to (1) develop an in vitro air-liquid interface (ALI) lung cancer organoid (LCO) culture model for biorelevant antitumor efficacy screening of inhalable chemotherapy formulations and (2) evaluate the therapeutic potential of paclitaxel nanoagglomerate powder (PTX-NADP)-enabled inhaled PTX nanoparticle delivery in lung cancer. Aerosolized PTX-NADP exhibited dose-dependent efficacy and outperformed raw PTX powder in in vitro ALI FA34-O LCO cultures. Intratracheal (IT) instillation of PTX nanosuspensions reconstituted from PTX-NADP resulted in enhanced pulmonary PTX concentrations and reduced off-target tissue distribution compared to intravenous (IV) injection in vivo. In an orthotopic lung adenocarcinoma mouse model, administration of reconstituted PTX nanosuspensions via IT instillation was well tolerated and achieved numerically similar tumor growth suppression (∼67%) relative to IV injection at lower cumulative doses. Notably, a higher proportion of mice receiving combined IT and IV treatment exhibited reduced tumor burden, suggesting that combining inhaled with systemic chemotherapy could facilitate therapeutic intensification. These findings support the therapeutic potential of PTX-NADP-enabled inhaled PTX nanoparticle delivery for lung cancer treatment and offer new insights into the development of inhaled nanoparticle-based chemotherapy as a convenient treatment option to improve lung cancer outcomes. Furthermore, the results demonstrate the promise of the in vitro ALI LCO culture model, which recapitulates key features of lung tumors in vivo, as a novel new approach methodology (NAM) platform for biorelevant screening of inhalable chemotherapy formulations.
abstractZh: 将肺部药物递送与纳米技术相结合，为增强肺癌化疗的疗效和安全性提供了一种有前景的策略。本研究旨在（1）开发一种体外气-液界面（ALI）肺癌类器官（LCO）培养模型，用于吸入性化疗制剂的生物相关抗肿瘤疗效筛选；（2）评估紫杉醇纳米团聚体粉末（PTX-NADP）介导的吸入性PTX纳米颗粒递送在肺癌中的治疗潜力。雾化PTX-NADP在体外ALI FA34-O LCO培养中表现出剂量依赖性疗效，并优于原料PTX粉末。与静脉注射（IV）相比，通过气管内（IT）滴注给予由PTX-NADP重构的PTX纳米混悬液，在体内增强了肺部PTX浓度并减少了脱靶组织分布。在原位肺腺癌小鼠模型中，通过IT滴注给予重构的PTX纳米混悬液耐受性良好，并在较低累积剂量下实现了与IV注射数值相似的肿瘤生长抑制（约67%）。值得注意的是，接受IT和IV联合治疗的小鼠中，肿瘤负荷减轻的比例更高，表明吸入性化疗与全身性化疗相结合可能有助于强化治疗。这些发现支持PTX-NADP介导的吸入性PTX纳米颗粒递送在肺癌治疗中的治疗潜力，并为开发基于吸入性纳米颗粒的化疗作为改善肺癌预后的便捷治疗选择提供了新见解。此外，结果证明了体外ALI LCO培养模型作为新型方法学（NAM）平台在吸入性化疗制剂生物相关筛选中的前景，该模型重现了体内肺肿瘤的关键特征。

title: Patient-Derived Inner Ear Organoids as a Disease Modeling and Therapy Validation Platform For Hereditary Inner Ear Disorders
titleZh: 患者来源的内耳类器官作为遗传性内耳疾病疾病建模和治疗验证平台
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Fousert E, van den Boogaard WM, Lucassen AW, Udayappan SD, Oostrik J, van Benthem PPG, Kremer H, van Wijk E, van der Valk WH, de Vrieze E, Locher H.
abstract:
Background

  Hereditary inner ear disorders comprise a highly heterogenous group of disorders and are a major cause of hearing and vestibular dysfunction. Despite advances in genetic diagnosis, the development of precision therapies has been limited by the lack of relevant and scalable human model systems that can accommodate the wide spectrum of disease-causing variants and support the evaluation of therapeutic interventions. We established patient-derived inner ear organoids (IEOs) as a platform to assess antisense oligonucleotide (ASO)-based therapeutic strategies for hereditary hearing loss. Methods

  Two representative genetic models were selected: recessive syndromic Usher syndrome type IIa (  USH2A ) and dominant non-syndromic DFNA9 (  COCH ). Human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) were generated from a patient carrying a homozygous pathogenic  USH2A variant and a patient carrying a frequently occurring pathogenic  COCH variant. In parallel, isogenic iPSC lines were created by introducing the same disease-causing variants into a healthy donor background. Following differentiation into IEOs, disease-associated transcript expression was evaluated. Splice-switching and RNase H1-mediated gapmer ASOs were assessed for target engagement. ASO biodistribution and cellular uptake was also examined in both IEOs and adult human vestibular tissue.  Results

  Patient-derived and isogenic iPSCs were successfully differentiated into IEOs that recapitulated disease-associated transcript expression. ASOs showed efficient uptake into disease-relevant cell populations in both IEOs and adult human vestibular tissue. In  USH2A -variant IEOs, splice-switching ASO treatment corrected aberrant splicing. In  COCH -variant IEOs, gapmer ASO treatment reduced total  COCH transcript levels, achieving up to 75% knockdown in patient-derived IEOs.  Conclusions

  Patient-derived and isogenic variant IEOs provide a versatile and scalable human platform for evaluating ASO therapies for hereditary hearing loss. Their adaptability to diverse genetic variants, inheritance patterns, and ASO modalities makes them well suited to address the genetic heterogeneity of hereditary inner ear diseases and establishes IEOs as a broadly applicable preclinical model for rare hereditary inner ear diseases.
abstractZh:
背景

  遗传性内耳疾病包含一组高度异质性的疾病，是听力和前庭功能障碍的主要原因。尽管基因诊断取得了进展，但由于缺乏相关且可扩展的人类模型系统来容纳广泛的致病性变异并支持治疗干预措施的评估，精准疗法的发展受到限制。我们建立了患者来源的内耳类器官（IEOs）作为评估基于反义寡核苷酸（ASO）的遗传性听力损失治疗策略的平台。方法

  选择了两个代表性遗传模型：隐性综合征型Usher综合征IIa型（USH2A）和显性非综合征型DFNA9（COCH）。从携带纯合致病性USH2A变异的患者和携带常见致病性COCH变异的患者中生成人类诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）。同时，通过将相同的致病性变异引入健康供体背景，创建了同基因iPSC系。在分化为IEOs后，评估了疾病相关转录本表达。评估了剪接转换和RNase H1介导的gapmer ASO的靶标参与情况。还在IEOs和成人人类前庭组织中检查了ASO的生物分布和细胞摄取。结果

  患者来源和同基因iPSCs成功分化为IEOs，这些IEOs重现了疾病相关转录本表达。ASOs在IEOs和成人人类前庭组织中的疾病相关细胞群体中显示出高效摄取。在USH2A变异IEOs中，剪接转换ASO治疗纠正了异常剪接。在COCH变异IEOs中，gapmer ASO治疗降低了总COCH转录本水平，在患者来源的IEOs中实现了高达75%的敲低。结论

  患者来源和同基因变异IEOs为评估遗传性听力损失的ASO疗法提供了一个多功能且可扩展的人类平台。它们对多种遗传变异、遗传模式和ASO模式的适应性使其非常适合应对遗传性内耳疾病的遗传异质性，并确立了IEOs作为罕见遗传性内耳疾病的广泛适用的临床前模型。

abstract: Inter-tumor and intra-tumor heterogeneity present significant challenges to achieving precise treatment in breast cancer (BC). To address this, we established a living biobank comprising 68 patient-derived organoids (PDOs) from 50 patients across various regions, accurately maintaining the histological, genomic, and transcriptomic characteristics of the original tumors. Paired profiling demonstrated high concordance in mutation burden, copy number alterations, and molecular subtypes, capturing both inter- and intra-tumor heterogeneity. Drug screening with four clinically used agents revealed pronounced response variability, enabling the development of multi-gene expression signatures predictive of drug sensitivity. ACSL1 emerged as a key mediator of Doxorubicin resistance, enriched in malignant epithelial cells exhibiting focal adhesion/MAPK pathway activation and immune-evasive features. Functional and mechanistic analyses identified focal adhesion kinase (FAK) as an upstream regulator of ACSL1, mediating resistance via ERK and STAT3 signaling. Inhibiting FAK or ACSL1 through pharmacological methods increased the sensitivity of resistant PDOs to Doxorubicin. The combined treatment was effective in decreasing tumor growth and preventing metastasis in xenograft models. Clinically, elevated ACSL1 expression correlated with advanced disease and poor survival. Collectively, these findings define BC heterogeneity, establish prognostic biomarkers, as well as uncover a means of Doxorubicin resistance that supports rational combination therapy.
abstractZh: 肿瘤间和肿瘤内异质性对实现乳腺癌（BC）的精准治疗构成了重大挑战。为解决这一问题，我们建立了一个活体生物库，包含来自50名不同地区患者的68个患者来源类器官（PDOs），准确保持了原发肿瘤的组织学、基因组和转录组特征。配对分析显示突变负荷、拷贝数变异和分子亚型具有高度一致性，同时捕获了肿瘤间和肿瘤内的异质性。使用四种临床药物进行药物筛选，显示出显著的反应变异性，从而能够开发预测药物敏感性的多基因表达特征。ACSL1被确定为阿霉素耐药的关键介质，在表现出局灶黏附/MAPK通路激活和免疫逃逸特征的恶性上皮细胞中富集。功能和机制分析确定局灶黏附激酶（FAK）是ACSL1的上游调节因子，通过ERK和STAT3信号传导介导耐药性。通过药理学方法抑制FAK或ACSL1可增加耐药PDOs对阿霉素的敏感性。联合治疗在异种移植模型中有效减少肿瘤生长并防止转移。临床上，ACSL1表达升高与晚期疾病和不良生存相关。总之，这些发现定义了BC的异质性，建立了预后生物标志物，并揭示了支持合理联合治疗的阿霉素耐药机制。

abstract: Endometriosis is one of the most common causes of chronic pelvic or lower-abdominal pain, yet mechanisms, predictors, and patient-centered treatment pathways remain insufficiently defined. This article summarizes the situation in Germany and presents two complementary research consortia: StEPP-UPP and ENDO-PAIN.StEPP-UPP addresses the clinical heterogeneity of endometriosis pain via a prospective multicenter cohort, standardized patient-reported outcomes, quantitative sensory testing, and multi-omics from blood, stool, and lesions. Explainable artificial intelligence and machine-learning models aim to estimate risk and trajectories of persistent pain, define mechanism-informed subgroups, and support treatment decisions. Preclinical mouse models with non-evoked behavioral metrics plus multiparametric MRI and single-cell analyses provide mechanistic anchoring for clinical signatures.ENDO-PAIN focuses on neuroinflammation and fibrosis as drivers of pain and chronification. Using patient samples, cell cultures, and 3D organoids, it maps immune-stroma interactions, syndecan signaling, and hormone-inflammation axes (for example P4-TGFβ-NFκB-COX-2) to derive biomarker networks and therapeutic targets.Both consortia integrate patient advocacy structurally to ensure patient-relevant endpoints and accessible information. Together they point to three priorities: standardization of data collection and biobanking; stratification along bio-psycho-social profiles and molecular signatures; and interdisciplinary shared decision-making across research, clinics, and people with endometriosis, aiming for mechanistically grounded, data-driven, patient-centered pain medicine.
abstractZh: 子宫内膜异位症是慢性盆腔或下腹痛最常见的原因之一，但其机制、预测因素和以患者为中心的治疗路径仍定义不足。本文总结了德国的情况，并介绍了两个互补的研究联盟：StEPP-UPP和ENDO-PAIN。StEPP-UPP通过前瞻性多中心队列、标准化患者报告结局、定量感觉测试以及来自血液、粪便和病灶的多组学分析，探讨子宫内膜异位症疼痛的临床异质性。可解释的人工智能和机器学习模型旨在评估持续性疼痛的风险和轨迹，定义基于机制的亚组，并支持治疗决策。临床前小鼠模型采用非诱发行为指标，结合多参数MRI和单细胞分析，为临床特征提供机制锚定。ENDO-PAIN聚焦于神经炎症和纤维化作为疼痛和慢性化的驱动因素。利用患者样本、细胞培养和3D类器官，它绘制了免疫-基质相互作用、多配体蛋白聚糖信号传导和激素-炎症轴（例如P4-TGFβ-NFκB-COX-2）的图谱，以推导生物标志物网络和治疗靶点。两个联盟都在结构上整合了患者倡导，以确保患者相关的结局和可获取的信息。它们共同指出了三个优先事项：数据收集和生物样本库的标准化；根据生物-心理-社会概况和分子特征进行分层；以及跨研究、临床和子宫内膜异位症患者的跨学科共享决策，旨在实现基于机制、数据驱动、以患者为中心的疼痛医学。

abstract: Esophageal reconstruction is one of the most challenging procedures in gastrointestinal surgery. While conventional therapeutic approaches, such as gastric pull-up and intestinal interposition, can restore continuity, they often fail to replicate native physiology. This limitation frequently leads to long-term complications, including dysphagia, stricture, and reflux, which can significantly affect the patients' quality of life. Tissue engineering approaches offer promising alternatives aimed at developing esophageal constructs that restore both structure and function, addressing the shortcomings of current treatment methods. This review highlights recent progress in esophageal tissue engineering (ETE), focusing on the requirements for ideal ETE scaffolds and examining available biomaterials, including natural, synthetic, and hybrid. We discuss advances in fabrication techniques and various cell-based approaches, such as primary cells, stem cells, and organoids. Furthermore, we also review the steps necessary to transition ETE constructs from the laboratory to clinical settings (ongoing human trials), including preclinical studies conducted on rodent, rabbit, canine, and porcine models with the expected functional outcomes and regeneration capabilities. Early translational efforts in ETE are addressed, along with the regulatory and ethical considerations regarding good manufacturing practice (GMP) compliance, traceability, and long-term surveillance. While significant advancements in ETE have been made in preclinical models, the review also discusses the challenges of moving to clinical studies. Potential strategies to address these challenges, such as 4-dimensional printing, smart materials, artificial intelligence-driven scaffold optimization, and organoid-based models, are introduced to help bridge the gap from preclinical research to successful clinical trials. In summary, ETE is transitioning from an experimental advancement to a translational reality by integrating significant achievements in biomaterials, fabrication technologies, and cell biology while following health regulatory standards. These efforts aim to provide regenerative solutions that overcome the limitations of current therapeutic approaches in clinical settings, ultimately facilitating healing and improving the patients' quality of life.
abstractZh: 食管重建是胃肠外科最具挑战性的手术之一。虽然常规治疗方法，如胃上提术和肠段间置术，可以恢复连续性，但往往无法复制天然生理功能。这一局限性常导致长期并发症，包括吞咽困难、狭窄和反流，这些并发症可显著影响患者的生活质量。组织工程方法提供了有前景的替代方案，旨在开发能够同时恢复结构和功能的食管构建物，以解决当前治疗方法的不足。本综述重点介绍了食管组织工程（ETE）的最新进展，聚焦于理想ETE支架的要求，并审视了可用的生物材料，包括天然、合成和混合材料。我们讨论了制造技术的进展以及各种基于细胞的方法，如原代细胞、干细胞和类器官。此外，我们还综述了将ETE构建物从实验室过渡到临床环境（正在进行的人体试验）所需的步骤，包括在啮齿动物、兔、犬和猪模型上进行的临床前研究及其预期的功能结局和再生能力。本文还涉及ETE的早期转化努力，以及关于良好生产规范（GMP）合规性、可追溯性和长期监测的监管和伦理考量。尽管ETE在临床前模型中已取得显著进展，本综述也讨论了向临床研究推进所面临的挑战。为应对这些挑战，本文介绍了潜在策略，如四维打印、智能材料、人工智能驱动的支架优化和基于类器官的模型，以帮助弥合从临床前研究到成功临床试验之间的差距。总之，ETE正通过整合生物材料、制造技术和细胞生物学方面的重大成就，同时遵循健康监管标准，从实验性进展转变为转化现实。这些努力旨在提供再生解决方案，以克服当前治疗方法在临床环境中的局限性，最终促进愈合并改善患者的生活质量。

title: Wogonin Suppresses Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Growth in Association with Oxidative Stress, c-Myc/GPX4 Downregulation and Ferroptosis-Related Responses.

abstract: Reactive oxygen species (ROS)-regulated antioxidant defense is closely linked to non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) progression and therapy resistance. Wogonin (WGN), a flavonoid from Scutellaria baicalensis, has antitumor activity, but whether it is associated with ROS-dependent ferroptotic and mitochondrial stress in NSCLC remains incompletely defined. A549 and BEAS-2B cells, male BALB/c nude mouse A549 xenografts, patient-derived NSCLC organoids, and public transcriptomic cohorts were analyzed using viability, colony formation, migration/invasion, DCFH-DA ROS, JC-1, Annexin V/PI, Fe2+ and lipid ROS probes, RT-qPCR, Western blotting, immunofluorescence, inhibitor rescue, and c-Myc gain- and loss-of-function assays. WGN suppressed A549 growth and motility with weaker effects on BEAS-2B cells. WGN markedly increased intracellular ROS, Fe2+ accumulation and lipid peroxidation, decreased mitochondrial membrane potential, promoted Caspase-related apoptosis, reduced c-Myc/GPX4 and SLC7A11, and increased ACSL4. N-acetylcysteine, Z-VAD-FMK and Ferrostatin-1 partially rescued WGN-induced injury. c-Myc overexpression partially restored GPX4 and reduced lipid ROS/Fe2+ accumulation, whereas c-Myc knockdown decreased GPX4. Xenografts and organoids reproduced tumor inhibition and selected redox-associated molecular changes. Collectively, WGN suppresses A549-associated NSCLC phenotypes in association with ROS accumulation, ferroptosis-related lipid injury, mitochondrial dysfunction-associated apoptosis, and c-Myc/GPX4 downregulation.
abstractZh: 活性氧（ROS）调控的抗氧化防御与非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）的进展和治疗耐药密切相关。汉黄芩素（WGN）是黄芩中的一种黄酮类化合物，具有抗肿瘤活性，但其是否与NSCLC中ROS依赖的铁死亡和线粒体应激相关尚未完全明确。使用A549和BEAS-2B细胞、雄性BALB/c裸鼠A549异种移植瘤、患者来源的NSCLC类器官以及公共转录组队列，通过活力、集落形成、迁移/侵袭、DCFH-DA ROS、JC-1、Annexin V/PI、Fe2+和脂质ROS探针、RT-qPCR、Western blotting、免疫荧光、抑制剂拯救以及c-Myc功能获得和丧失实验进行分析。WGN抑制A549生长和运动能力，对BEAS-2B细胞作用较弱。WGN显著增加细胞内ROS、Fe2+积累和脂质过氧化，降低线粒体膜电位，促进Caspase相关凋亡，降低c-Myc/GPX4和SLC7A11，增加ACSL4。N-乙酰半胱氨酸、Z-VAD-FMK和Ferrostatin-1部分拯救了WGN诱导的损伤。c-Myc过表达部分恢复GPX4并减少脂质ROS/Fe2+积累，而c-Myc敲低降低GPX4。异种移植瘤和类器官重现了肿瘤抑制和选定的氧化还原相关分子变化。总之，WGN抑制A549相关的NSCLC表型，与ROS积累、铁死亡相关脂质损伤、线粒体功能障碍相关凋亡以及c-Myc/GPX4下调相关。

title: Modeling tonsil organoids for studying mucosal immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 vaccination.
titleZh: 建模扁桃体类器官用于研究SARS-CoV-2疫苗接种的黏膜免疫反应。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Gao Y, Wang W, Wang YY, Wang BF, Ye JY.
affiliations: Department of Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery, Beijing Tsinghua Changgung Hospital, School of Clinical Medicine, Tsinghua Medicine, Tsinghua University, Beijing, People's Republic of China.
abstract: A key bottleneck in preclinical vaccine research is the lack of a human in vitro system that faithfully models the germinal center (GC) reactions, a critical process for generating protective antibodies. This gap hinders the accurate assessment of vaccine candidates. The tonsil is a key component of the mucosal immune system in the oropharynx, acting as its first-line immune sentinel. We established a novel human tonsil organoid platform and stimulated it with the chimpanzee adenovirus serotype 68-19 spike protein (AdC68-19S) SARS-CoV-2 vaccine candidate. Cellular immune phenotypes were analyzed by flow cytometry, while spatial organization was assessed via immunofluorescence. Functional immune responses were quantified using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, enzyme-linked immunospot assay, and pseudovirus neutralization tests to measure antigen-specific antibodies production and their neutralizing capacity. AdC68‑19S immunization elicited coordinated GC reactions in tonsil organoids, characterized spatially by the formation of discrete GC compartments, specifically an AICDA+ dark zone and a PD‑1+ light zone. This reorganization was accompanied by a marked expansion of key effector populations, including GC B cells and plasma cells. Functionally, the platform generated antibody‑secreting cells as well as antigen‑specific IgG and IgA antibodies, these antibodies demonstrated neutralizing capacity against the SARS‑CoV‑2 pseudovirus. The human tonsil organoids platform represents a paradigm shift in vitro immunology, establishing a system that recapitulates key features of adaptive immune responses induced by AdC68-19S vaccine. This approach provides a robust, physiologically relevant, and ethically viable model to advance our understanding of human immunity, oral immune barrier and accelerate vaccine development.
abstractZh: 临床前疫苗研究的一个关键瓶颈是缺乏能够忠实模拟生发中心（GC）反应的人类体外系统，而这一过程对于产生保护性抗体至关重要。这一空白阻碍了对疫苗候选物的准确评估。扁桃体是口咽部黏膜免疫系统的关键组成部分，充当其第一道免疫哨兵。我们建立了一个新型人类扁桃体类器官平台，并用黑猩猩腺病毒血清型68-19刺突蛋白（AdC68-19S）SARS-CoV-2疫苗候选物进行刺激。通过流式细胞术分析细胞免疫表型，同时通过免疫荧光评估空间组织。使用酶联免疫吸附测定、酶联免疫斑点测定和假病毒中和试验量化功能性免疫反应，以测量抗原特异性抗体的产生及其中和能力。AdC68-19S免疫在扁桃体类器官中引发了协调的GC反应，其空间特征表现为形成离散的GC区室，特别是AICDA+暗区和PD-1+亮区。这种重组伴随着关键效应细胞群的显著扩增，包括GC B细胞和浆细胞。在功能上，该平台产生了抗体分泌细胞以及抗原特异性IgG和IgA抗体，这些抗体表现出对SARS-CoV-2假病毒的中和能力。人类扁桃体类器官平台代表了体外免疫学的范式转变，建立了一个能够重现AdC68-19S疫苗诱导的适应性免疫反应关键特征的系统。该方法提供了一个稳健、生理相关且伦理可行的模型，以增进我们对人类免疫、口腔免疫屏障的理解，并加速疫苗开发。

title: Emergent topological structure in spontaneous brain-organoid activity
titleZh: 自发脑类器官活动中的涌现拓扑结构
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Bodnia E, Basart M, Hai S, Ford L, Miolane N, Kosik KS, Bouwmeester D, Carr LD.
abstract: Neural activity is widely held to organize on low-dimensional structure embedded in a high-dimensional state space. Persistent homology reads such structure directly from the pattern of pairwise correlations, without assuming in advance which variables are relevant. We apply persistent homology to microelectrode-array (MEA) recordings of spontaneous activity from human (Lancaster) and mouse (Paşca) cortical organoids, spanning 26–234 simultaneously sorted units, and ask whether topological data analysis resolves structure at the node counts that neural recordings actually deliver. Building weighted networks in correlation space and characterizing them by Vietoris–Rips filtration, we find that the first homology (  H 1 , loops) rises significantly above a rate- and population-preserving null in 14 of 18 datasets. This loop structure occupies a non-redundant core: it is robust to random removal of units yet disrupted by targeted removal of the units that carry it. Topological richness grows with network size, and second homology (  H 2 ) emerges significantly above the null only in the larger networks. These results show that persistent homology resolves structured topology in neural recordings at the scale experiments actually deliver.
abstractZh: 神经活动被广泛认为组织在嵌入高维状态空间的低维结构上。持续同调直接从成对相关性的模式中读取这种结构，无需预先假设哪些变量是相关的。我们将持续同调应用于人类（Lancaster）和小鼠（Paşca）皮层类器官自发活动的微电极阵列（MEA）记录，涵盖26–234个同时分选的单元，并探究拓扑数据分析是否能在神经记录实际提供的节点数量上解析出结构。在相关性空间中构建加权网络，并通过Vietoris–Rips过滤对其进行表征，我们发现18个数据集中有14个的第一同调（H1，环）显著高于保持放电率和种群数量的零模型。这种环结构占据一个非冗余核心：它对随机移除单元具有鲁棒性，但会被针对性地移除携带该结构的单元所破坏。拓扑丰富度随网络规模增长，而第二同调（H2）仅在较大的网络中显著高于零模型。这些结果表明，持续同调能在实验实际提供的尺度上解析神经记录中的结构化拓扑。

title: Rasgrp1-Mediated Dampening of EGFR Signals Supports Coordinated Mammary Gland Development.
titleZh: Rasgrp1介导的EGFR信号减弱支持乳腺协调发育。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Samocha A, Shechtman L, Tapia EB, Doh HM, Gbenedio O, Sitarama V, Nguyen QH, Rudolph JD, Eckalbar WL, Barczak AJ, Miao Y, Depeille P, Garcia KC, Lawson DA, Kessenbrock K, Roose JP.

abstract: Mammary gland development during puberty requires tightly coordinated epithelial proliferation, lineage specification, and branching morphogenesis, processes critically regulated by growth factor signaling. While epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) signaling is essential for ductal development, how its activity is quantitatively controlled within mammary epithelial cells (MECs) remains incompletely understood. Here, we identify Rasgrp1, a Ras guanine nucleotide exchange factor, as a key modulator of EGFR signaling in the mammary epithelium. Using Rasgrp1-deficient mice, primary MEC assays, and organoid models, we demonstrate that loss of Rasgrp1 leads to elevated EGFR-Ras-PI3K-AKT and mTORC1-S6 signaling, resulting in enhanced proliferative capacity and aberrant EGF-driven branching. Transcriptomic analysis of organoids reveals that EGF signaling suppresses Wnt/R-spondin-dependent stem-cell gene programs, suggesting that excessive EGFR activity disrupts stem cell maintenance. In vivo, Rasgrp1 deficiency causes impaired ductal elongation, persistent terminal end buds, and increased epithelial proliferation, indicating a breakdown in the spatial and temporal coordination of mammary morphogenesis. Together, our findings establish Rasgrp1 as a signaling rheostat that dampens EGFR pathway activity to support coordinated mammary gland development. These results highlight the importance of precise signaling calibration in epithelial development and suggest broader implications for Ras pathway regulation in tissue homeostasis and disease.
abstractZh: 青春期乳腺发育需要紧密协调的上皮增殖、谱系特化和分支形态发生，这些过程受生长因子信号的关键调控。虽然表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）信号对于导管发育至关重要，但其活性在乳腺上皮细胞（MECs）中如何被定量控制仍不完全清楚。在此，我们确定Rasgrp1，一种Ras鸟嘌呤核苷酸交换因子，是乳腺上皮中EGFR信号的关键调节因子。利用Rasgrp1缺陷小鼠、原代MEC实验和类器官模型，我们证明Rasgrp1的缺失导致EGFR-Ras-PI3K-AKT和mTORC1-S6信号升高，从而增强增殖能力并引起异常的EGF驱动的分支。类器官的转录组分析显示，EGF信号抑制Wnt/R-spondin依赖的干细胞基因程序，提示过度的EGFR活性破坏干细胞维持。在体内，Rasgrp1缺陷导致导管伸长受损、末端终芽持续存在和上皮增殖增加，表明乳腺形态发生的空间和时间协调被破坏。总之，我们的发现确立了Rasgrp1作为信号变阻器，减弱EGFR通路活性以支持乳腺协调发育。这些结果强调了精确信号校准在上皮发育中的重要性，并提示Ras通路调节在组织稳态和疾病中的更广泛意义。

title: Use of microsensor platform to differentiate metabolic parameters associated with developmental timing and sex of individual bovine blastocysts.
titleZh: 使用微传感器平台区分与个体牛囊胚发育时间和性别相关的代谢参数。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Cheng MH, Fresa KJ, Gonzalez-Castro RA, Chicco AJ, Carnevale EM, Chen TW.

abstract: In assisted reproductive technologies (ARTs), embryo transfer success is dependent on the selection of a viable embryo which is predominantly based on morphological assessments and timing of development. Methods to further differentiate embryo viability in real time would be valuable for animal producers and have translational value in human fertility clinics. In the present study, the IMSIS (Instrumented Microphysiological System with Integrated Sensors) platform was used to perform label-free measurements of embryo's metabolic activities They include oxygen consumption rate (OCR) and extracellular acidification rate (ECAR), as an indicator of oxidative phosphorylation and an index of extracellular acidification, respectively, and hydrogen peroxide production rate (HPR) as an indicator of reactive oxygen species (ROS) production. In this study, bovine oocytes were fertilized using sex-sorted sperms. Metabolic assays were collected on individual blastocysts developing on day 7 (Normal) or day 8-9 (Delayed). Measurements of OCR, ECAR, and HPR did not differ (P > 0.05) between male and female blastocysts. However, OCR was lower (P = 0.01), and ECAR and HPR were also lower (P = 0.09 and 0.06, respectively), in Normal compared with Delayed blastocysts, despite similar morphology and expansion stage. Principal component analysis (PCA) was used to establish associations among metabolic variables, with increased variability in Delayed versus Normal. Potentially compromised embryos (Delayed) had greater metabolic activity than Normal. These findings suggest that blastocysts with delayed development exhibit increased metabolic activity and variability, consistent with compensatory or dysregulated metabolism rather than superior quality. The IMSIS platform was able to successfully differentiate Normal from Delayed embryos of similar morphology, highlighting the potential utility of integrated metabolic assessments as an adjunct tool for embryo evaluation in bovine ART.
abstractZh: 在辅助生殖技术（ARTs）中，胚胎移植的成功取决于对可存活胚胎的选择，这主要基于形态学评估和发育时间。实时进一步区分胚胎活力的方法将对动物生产者有价值，并在人类生育诊所中具有转化价值。在本研究中，使用IMSIS（集成传感器的仪器化微生理系统）平台对胚胎的代谢活动进行无标记测量，包括耗氧率（OCR）和细胞外酸化率（ECAR），分别作为氧化磷酸化的指标和细胞外酸化的指数，以及过氧化氢产生率（HPR）作为活性氧（ROS）产生的指标。在本研究中，使用性别分选精子对牛卵母细胞进行受精。对第7天（正常）或第8-9天（延迟）发育的单个囊胚进行代谢测定。OCR、ECAR和HPR的测量值在雄性和雌性囊胚之间没有差异（P > 0.05）。然而，与延迟囊胚相比，正常囊胚的OCR较低（P = 0.01），ECAR和HPR也较低（P分别为0.09和0.06），尽管形态和扩张阶段相似。使用主成分分析（PCA）建立代谢变量之间的关联，延迟囊胚的变异性高于正常囊胚。潜在受损的胚胎（延迟）比正常胚胎具有更高的代谢活性。这些发现表明，发育延迟的囊胚表现出增加的代谢活性和变异性，这与代偿性或失调的代谢一致，而非更高质量。IMSIS平台能够成功区分形态相似的正常和延迟胚胎，突出了整合代谢评估作为牛ART中胚胎评估辅助工具的潜在效用。

title: The closer, the better: intratumoral delivery of a thermoresponsive gemcitabine-loaded hydrogel in preclinical PDAC models.
titleZh: 越近越好：温敏吉西他滨水凝胶在临床前PDAC模型中的瘤内递送。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: Current treatments for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) patients are typically restricted to (neo)adjuvant chemotherapy, surgery or palliative care. Mainly due to a late diagnosis and highly desmoplastic environment, these treatments have limited efficacy and patient prognosis is very poor. Intratumoral delivery of chemotherapeutic agents using hydrogel technology might boost treatment efficacy and reduce side effects. Here, we aimed to investigate the preclinical efficacy and tolerability of a novel thermosensitive hydrogel, ChemoGell, loaded with the chemotherapeutic agent gemcitabine. We explored this in vitro, using patient-derived organoids and surgically obtained tumor explants, and in vivo, using a human patient-derived xenograft (PDX) and syngeneic KPC3 mouse models. Upon intratumoral injections of gemcitabine-loaded ChemoGell, respective survival, peripheral blood and end-stage tumor histological analyses were performed. Intratumoral injection of gemcitabine-loaded ChemoGell in in vitro and in vivo models showed decreased tumor growth and increased cytotoxicity compared to blank ChemoGell and saline control intratumoral injections. In contrast, systemic administration of gemcitabine did not show therapeutic benefits. Intratumoral ChemoGell injections induced interesting lymphocyte and monocyte dynamics overtime, showing an intratumoral influx of NK cells and monocytes and an in-depot infiltration of activated fibroblasts, macrophages and activated CD8 + T cells. Our findings establish a foundation for integrating localized treatment modalities, addressing critical challenges in PDAC and improving patient prognosis through more effective, localized therapeutic strategies.
abstractZh: 目前针对胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）患者的治疗通常局限于（新）辅助化疗、手术或姑息治疗。主要由于诊断较晚和高度促结缔组织增生的微环境，这些治疗疗效有限，患者预后极差。利用水凝胶技术进行化疗药物的瘤内递送可能提高治疗疗效并减少副作用。在此，我们旨在研究一种新型温敏水凝胶ChemoGell负载化疗药物吉西他滨的临床前疗效和耐受性。我们在体外使用患者来源的类器官和手术获取的肿瘤外植体，以及在体内使用人源患者来源异种移植（PDX）和同基因KPC3小鼠模型进行了探索。在瘤内注射负载吉西他滨的ChemoGell后，分别进行了生存期、外周血和终末期肿瘤组织学分析。在体外和体内模型中，瘤内注射负载吉西他滨的ChemoGell与空白ChemoGell和生理盐水对照瘤内注射相比，显示出肿瘤生长减少和细胞毒性增加。相反，全身性给予吉西他滨未显示治疗获益。瘤内注射ChemoGell随时间诱导了有趣的淋巴细胞和单核细胞动态变化，显示瘤内NK细胞和单核细胞浸润，以及库内活化成纤维细胞、巨噬细胞和活化CD8+T细胞的浸润。我们的发现为整合局部治疗模式奠定了基础，解决了PDAC中的关键挑战，并通过更有效的局部治疗策略改善患者预后。

title: CRISPR guided gene knockout in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma molecular mechanisms and therapeutic strategies.
titleZh: CRISPR引导的基因敲除在胰腺导管腺癌中的分子机制与治疗策略。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）

abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains one of the most lethal malignancies worldwide, characterized by late-stage diagnosis, profound chemoresistance, and a five-year survival rate that barely exceeds 12%. The fibrotic stromal barrier surrounding the tumor actively suppresses immune infiltration and blocks drug delivery, rendering conventional treatment options largely ineffective. CRISPR-Cas9-mediated gene knockout represents a promising strategy to overcome this stromal barrier-associated therapeutic resistance by enabling precise disruption of genes that sustain desmoplastic signaling, stromal-immune crosstalk, and drug efflux pathways within the tumor microenvironment. In this context, CRISPR-Cas9-guided gene knockout has opened a new chapter in PDAC research by enabling precise, scalable analysis of the cancer genome. Functional screens using this technology have mapped critical oncogenic dependencies, identifying mutant KRAS, TP53, SMAD4, and CDKN2A as high-value targets, while simultaneously revealing synthetic lethal interactions that were previously inaccessible through pharmacological approaches. These discoveries are now being translated into therapeutic strategies aimed at silencing driver mutations, restoring chemosensitivity, and reprogramming the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. Delivery platforms, including lipid nanoparticles, viral vectors, and extracellular vesicles, are being refined to navigate the physical barriers unique to PDAC. Patient-derived organoids and xenograft models are providing the translational framework needed to evaluate these interventions under clinically relevant conditions. This review examines the molecular mechanisms of CRISPR-guided knockout, the genetic vulnerabilities it has uncovered in PDAC, the therapeutic strategies emerging from this work, and the delivery systems supporting clinical translation. The remaining barriers and the steps needed to bring this technology to patients are also discussed.
abstractZh: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）仍然是全球最致命的恶性肿瘤之一，其特征是诊断晚、深度化疗耐药以及五年生存率勉强超过12%。肿瘤周围的纤维化基质屏障主动抑制免疫浸润并阻断药物递送，使得常规治疗方案基本无效。CRISPR-Cas9介导的基因敲除通过精确破坏维持促结缔组织增生信号、基质-免疫串扰和肿瘤微环境内药物外排途径的基因，代表了一种克服这种基质屏障相关治疗耐药性的有前景的策略。在此背景下，CRISPR-Cas9引导的基因敲除通过实现对癌症基因组的精确、可扩展分析，开启了PDAC研究的新篇章。使用该技术的功能筛选已绘制出关键的致癌依赖性图谱，将突变型KRAS、TP53、SMAD4和CDKN2A确定为高价值靶点，同时揭示了以前通过药理学方法无法获得的合成致死相互作用。这些发现正被转化为旨在沉默驱动突变、恢复化疗敏感性和重编程免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境的治疗策略。包括脂质纳米颗粒、病毒载体和细胞外囊泡在内的递送平台正在被优化，以穿越PDAC特有的物理屏障。患者来源的类器官和异种移植模型正在提供在临床相关条件下评估这些干预措施所需的转化框架。本综述探讨了CRISPR引导敲除的分子机制、其在PDAC中揭示的遗传脆弱性、由此产生的治疗策略以及支持临床转化的递送系统。还讨论了剩余的障碍以及将该技术带给患者所需的步骤。

abstract:
Background

MUC1 is frequently overexpressed in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC), but MUC1-targeted CAR-NK cells remain unexplored in this malignancy.Methods

MUC1 expression was assessed by IHC in 90 ESCC specimens, 47 paired adjacent normal tissues, and normal human organs. MUC1-targeted CAR-NK cells were generated from an iPSC platform. Antitumor activity was evaluated against patient-specific ESCC organoids (PSOs), primary ESCC cells, KYSE150 and KYSE140 cells using live/dead staining, CCK-8, and xCELLigence assays. In vivo efficacy was assessed in a KYSE140 xenograft model.Results

MUC1 was expressed in 70% (63/90) of ESCC cases versus 14.9% (7/47) of adjacent normal tissues (P  50% and > 80% tumor cell positivity, respectively. iPSC-derived MUC1 CAR-NK cells exhibited > 95% CAR expression across iPSC, progenitor, and mature stages. Compared with controls, MUC1 CAR-NK cells elicited potent, antigen-specific cytotoxicity against MUC1-expressing ESCC PSOs, primary cells, KYSE150, and KYSE140 in vitro and significantly suppressed KYSE140 xenograft growth in vivo.Conclusion

iPSC-derived MUC1-targeted CAR-NK cells exert robust and specific antitumor efficacy against human ESCC, supporting clinical translation of this off-the-shelf cell therapy.
