abstract: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) is a multifaceted progressive neurodegenerative disease characterized by memory deficits and cognitive impairment. The disease is clinically diagnosed by the presence of β-amyloid (Aβ), hyperphosphorylated tau, and neurodegeneration. Animal models serve as an indispensable tool to understanding AD pathogenesis and evaluating potential therapeutic approaches. However, despite the development of more than 200 rodent models, species-specific differences limit the translational relevance. Brain organoids generated from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) have the potential to bridge the gap between transgenic mouse models and clinical trials in human patients. Herein, we describe a robust stimulus-based neuroimmune organoid model that demonstrates neuroinflammation, neurodegeneration, and lipid dysregulation with AD-relevant pathological markers. Using planar organoids containing neurons, astrocytes, microglia, and vascular cells, we performed in-depth characterization of the induced AD-like phenotype using supernatant proteomic analysis, immunofluorescence staining, NfL and GFAP release, scRNAseq, bulk RNAseq, and pathway analysis both acutely (24 h) and chronically (7 days). Furthermore, we show that the induced neuroinflammation, lipid dysregulation, and neurodegeneration can be ameliorated using small molecules. This defined inducible model system presents an opportunity for drug discovery and development using a complex multicellular brain microenvironment derived from human iPSCs.
abstractZh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种多方面的进行性神经退行性疾病，以记忆缺陷和认知障碍为特征。该疾病的临床诊断依据是β-淀粉样蛋白（Aβ）、过度磷酸化tau蛋白和神经变性的存在。动物模型是理解AD发病机制和评估潜在治疗方法不可或缺的工具。然而，尽管开发了200多种啮齿动物模型，物种特异性差异限制了其转化相关性。由诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）生成的脑类器官有潜力弥合转基因小鼠模型与人类患者临床试验之间的差距。在此，我们描述了一种稳健的基于刺激的神经免疫类器官模型，该模型展示了神经炎症、神经变性和脂质失调，并伴有AD相关的病理标志物。使用包含神经元、星形胶质细胞、小胶质细胞和血管细胞的平面类器官，我们通过上清液蛋白质组学分析、免疫荧光染色、NfL和GFAP释放、单细胞RNA测序（scRNAseq）、批量RNA测序（bulk RNAseq）以及通路分析，在急性（24小时）和慢性（7天）时间点对诱导的AD样表型进行了深入表征。此外，我们表明，诱导的神经炎症、脂质失调和神经变性可以通过小分子得到改善。这个明确的诱导模型系统为利用源自人类iPSCs的复杂多细胞脑微环境进行药物发现和开发提供了机会。

abstract:
Background

The muscle-brain axis is critical in neuropsychiatric disorders. However, its role in the antidepressant mechanism of Xiaoyaosan (XYS) remains unclear. This study explored whether XYS exerts antidepressant effects by modulating the muscle FNDC5/Irisin-mediated muscle-brain axis to restore hippocampal synaptic plasticity.Methods

LPS-induced mouse model was established for in vivo evaluation. In vitro, siRNA knockdown in C2C12-HT22 Transwell co-culture system was used to investigate the involvement of FNDC5/Irisin signaling in muscle-neuron communication. Neuromuscular organoids were established as a three-dimensional platform to model key features of muscle-neuron interactions. Untargeted metabolomics, immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, Western blotting, and ELISA were performed.Results

XYS dose-dependently ameliorated LPS-induced depressive-like behaviors, restored muscle fiber integrity, and reversed hippocampal neuronal loss and synaptic deficits. Metabolomics analysis showed that XYS was associated with normalized metabolite profiles associated with β-alanine and taurine metabolism in the hippocampus and PPAR signaling pathway in the muscle. XYS was also associated with activation of the muscle PPARγ/PGC-1α/FNDC5/Irisin signaling pathway, accompanied by increased circulating Irisin levels and upregulation of hippocampal BDNF, PSD95, and synaptophysin. siRNA knockdown of FNDC5 attenuated the effects of XYS on Irisin secretion and synaptic marker restoration in co-cultured neurons. In organoids, XYS protected both myotube and neuronal compartments from LPS-induced injury.Conclusion

XYS exerts antidepressant effects, at least in part, through the activation of the muscle PPARγ/PGC-1α/FNDC5/Irisin axis and the restoration of hippocampal BDNF-mediated synaptic plasticity. The present findings support a potential role for FNDC5/Irisin in peripheral-to-central signaling associated with the antidepressant effects of XYS. These findings further suggest that the muscle-brain axis may represent a promising therapeutic target for depression and warrants further investigation.
abstractZh:
背景

肌肉-大脑轴在神经精神疾病中至关重要。然而，其在逍遥散（XYS）抗抑郁机制中的作用仍不清楚。本研究探讨了XYS是否通过调节肌肉FNDC5/Irisin介导的肌肉-大脑轴来恢复海马突触可塑性，从而发挥抗抑郁作用。方法

建立LPS诱导的小鼠模型用于体内评估。在体外，使用C2C12-HT12 Transwell共培养系统中的siRNA敲低来研究FNDC5/Irisin信号在肌肉-神经元通讯中的参与。建立神经肌肉类器官作为三维平台，以模拟肌肉-神经元相互作用的关键特征。进行了非靶向代谢组学、免疫组织化学、免疫荧光、Western blotting和ELISA。结果

XYS剂量依赖性地改善了LPS诱导的抑郁样行为，恢复了肌纤维完整性，并逆转了海马神经元丢失和突触缺陷。代谢组学分析显示，XYS与海马中与β-丙氨酸和牛磺酸代谢相关的代谢物谱以及肌肉中PPAR信号通路的正常化相关。XYS还与肌肉PPARγ/PGC-1α/FNDC5/Irisin信号通路的激活相关，伴随着循环Irisin水平的增加以及海马BDNF、PSD95和突触素的上调。FNDC5的siRNA敲低减弱了XYS对共培养神经元中Irisin分泌和突触标记物恢复的影响。在类器官中，XYS保护了肌管和神经元区室免受LPS诱导的损伤。结论

XYS至少部分通过激活肌肉PPARγ/PGC-1α/FNDC5/Irisin轴和恢复海马BDNF介导的突触可塑性来发挥抗抑郁作用。本研究结果支持FNDC5/Irisin在与XYS抗抑郁作用相关的外周至中枢信号传导中的潜在作用。这些发现进一步表明，肌肉-大脑轴可能代表抑郁症的一个有前景的治疗靶点，值得进一步研究。

title: Dihydroartemisinin promotes ABCG5/G8-mediated cholesterol efflux to potentiate anti-PD-1 therapy through YAP1-TEAD1 complex disruption in hepatocellular carcinoma.

abstract:
Background

Cholesterol accumulation influences the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), highlighting a targetable metabolic vulnerability. Dihydroartemisinin (DHA) has shown antitumor activity in HCC; however, its role in regulating cholesterol accumulation remains unclear.Purpose

The purpose of this study is to explore whether DHA enhances anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in HCC by promoting cholesterol efflux and to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanism.Methods

A Hepa1-6 subcutaneous tumor-bearing mouse model was established to assess the combined effect of DHA and anti-PD-1 treatment. Multiplex immunohistochemistry was performed to evaluate cytotoxic T-cell infiltration and activation in the tumor microenvironment (TME). Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) were established to evaluate the antitumor activity of DHA. The regulatory mechanism of YAP1/TEAD1 on ABCG5/G8 transcription was explored using chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) qPCR, dual-luciferase reporter assays, and functional gain/loss experiments. DEN/TCPOBOP-induced primary liver tumor model with hepatocyte-specific Yap1 deletion was used to assess the effect of YAP1 deficiency on cholesterol efflux. The direct effect of DHA on the YAP1-TEAD1 interaction was assessed through co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) and immunofluorescence (IF) co-localization, and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis.Results

DHA significantly potentiates anti-PD-1 therapy in HCC-bearing mice, accompanied by reduced serum and intratumoral total cholesterol (TC) levels and increased CD8/granzyme B double-positive signals in tumor tissues, without significant body weight loss. In parallel, ABCG5/G8-mediated cholesterol efflux reduced cholesterol accumulation and suppressed tumor growth, while enhancing cytotoxic immune activity in the TME. Mechanistically, the YAP1-TEAD1 complex directly binds to the promoter regions of ABCG5 and ABCG8 and represses their transcription, thereby limiting cholesterol efflux and promoting intracellular cholesterol accumulation in HCC cells. DHA disrupted the YAP1-TEAD1 interaction, as further supported by SPR analysis, downregulated YAP1 and TEAD1, and restored ABCG5/G8-mediated cholesterol efflux. Notably, DHA-induced ABCG5/ABCG8 upregulation, cholesterol efflux, and antitumor effects were markedly attenuated by YAP1 inhibition, supporting a YAP1-dependent mechanism. In addition, DHA suppressed the growth and viability of organoids derived from patients with HCC.Conclusion

This study reveals that DHA disrupts the YAP1-TEAD1 interaction to relieve transcriptional repression of ABCG5/G8, thereby promoting cholesterol efflux, remodeling the tumor immune microenvironment toward enhanced cytotoxic T-cell activity, and enhancing anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in HCC. These findings provide a novel mechanism for DHA as an immunomodulatory agent and support its clinical translation in combination with ICIs for HCC treatment.
abstractZh:
背景

胆固醇积累影响肝细胞癌（HCC）中免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）的疗效，突显了一个可靶向的代谢脆弱性。双氢青蒿素（DHA）在HCC中显示出抗肿瘤活性；然而，其在调节胆固醇积累中的作用尚不清楚。目的

本研究旨在探讨DHA是否通过促进胆固醇外流增强HCC中的抗PD-1免疫疗法，并阐明其潜在的分子机制。方法

建立Hepa1-6皮下荷瘤小鼠模型，评估DHA与抗PD-1联合治疗的效果。采用多重免疫组化评估肿瘤微环境（TME）中细胞毒性T细胞的浸润和活化。建立患者来源的类器官（PDOs）以评估DHA的抗肿瘤活性。利用染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）qPCR、双荧光素酶报告基因实验和功能获得/缺失实验，探讨YAP1/TEAD1对ABCG5/G8转录的调控机制。使用肝细胞特异性Yap1缺失的DEN/TCPOBOP诱导的原发性肝肿瘤模型，评估YAP1缺失对胆固醇外流的影响。通过免疫共沉淀（Co-IP）和免疫荧光（IF）共定位以及表面等离子体共振（SPR）分析，评估DHA对YAP1-TEAD1相互作用的直接影响。结果

DHA显著增强荷瘤小鼠中抗PD-1疗法的效果，伴随血清和瘤内总胆固醇（TC）水平降低，肿瘤组织中CD8/颗粒酶B双阳性信号增加，且无明显体重减轻。同时，ABCG5/G8介导的胆固醇外流减少了胆固醇积累并抑制了肿瘤生长，同时增强了TME中的细胞毒性免疫活性。机制上，YAP1-TEAD1复合物直接结合ABCG5和ABCG8的启动子区域并抑制其转录，从而限制胆固醇外流并促进HCC细胞内胆固醇积累。DHA破坏了YAP1-TEAD1相互作用（SPR分析进一步支持），下调YAP1和TEAD1，并恢复ABCG5/G8介导的胆固醇外流。值得注意的是，DHA诱导的ABCG5/ABCG8上调、胆固醇外流和抗肿瘤效应在YAP1抑制下显著减弱，支持YAP1依赖性机制。此外，DHA抑制了来自HCC患者的类器官的生长和活力。结论

本研究揭示DHA破坏YAP1-TEAD1相互作用，解除对ABCG5/G8的转录抑制，从而促进胆固醇外流，重塑肿瘤免疫微环境以增强细胞毒性T细胞活性，并增强HCC中抗PD-1免疫疗法的效果。这些发现为DHA作为免疫调节剂提供了新机制，并支持其与ICIs联合用于HCC治疗的临床转化。

abstract: The periosteum is an essential yet often neglected regulator of bone regeneration, and its loss represents a major barrier to healing critical-sized bone defects. Existing periosteum-mimicking strategies rely primarily on static architectures or exogenous factor delivery and fail to reconstruct a living periosteal interface. Here, we introduce an organoid-based approach for engineering functional periosteum organoids capable of restoring periosteal identity and regulatory function. A bioprinted GelMA/SilMA interpenetrating composite hydrogel integrated with black phosphorus nanosheets is developed to create a mechanically stable and bioactive microenvironment that supports osteogenic-angiogenic self-organization. Under three-dimensional culture, the constructs exhibit the potential to form periosteum organoids, with coordinated osteogenic differentiation and pro-angiogenic niche formation. Following in vivo conditioning, the constructs develop into periosteum organoids that exhibit dense collagen-rich fibrous architecture, pronounced periostin expression, enrichment of osteogenic lineage cells, and stabilized microvasculature, closely recapitulating the structural and functional hallmarks of native periosteum. When applied to a critical-sized rat calvarial defect model, the periosteum organoids significantly enhance bone regeneration, improve trabecular microarchitecture, reconstruct a functional periosteal interface, and rebalance bone remodeling without detectable systemic toxicity. This work establishes periosteum organoids as a living regenerative interface for skeletal repair and provides a new organoid-based paradigm for functional periosteal reconstruction in large bone defects.
abstractZh: 骨膜是骨再生中一个至关重要但常被忽视的调节者，其缺失是愈合临界尺寸骨缺损的主要障碍。现有的骨膜模拟策略主要依赖于静态结构或外源性因子递送，未能重建活性的骨膜界面。在此，我们介绍一种基于类器官的方法，用于工程化功能性骨膜类器官，能够恢复骨膜特性和调节功能。我们开发了一种与黑磷纳米片整合的生物打印GelMA/SilMA互穿复合水凝胶，以创建机械稳定且具有生物活性的微环境，支持成骨-血管生成的自组织。在三维培养下，这些构建体表现出形成骨膜类器官的潜力，具有协调的成骨分化和促血管生成微环境形成。经过体内条件化处理后，这些构建体发育成骨膜类器官，表现出致密的富含胶原的纤维结构、显著的骨膜蛋白表达、成骨谱系细胞的富集以及稳定的微血管系统，紧密重现了天然骨膜的结构和功能特征。当应用于临界尺寸的大鼠颅骨缺损模型时，骨膜类器官显著增强骨再生，改善小梁微结构，重建功能性骨膜界面，并重新平衡骨重塑，且未检测到全身毒性。这项工作确立了骨膜类器官作为骨骼修复的活性再生界面，并为大骨缺损中的功能性骨膜重建提供了新的基于类器官的范式。

abstract:
Background

Endometrial organoids, with their three-dimensional structure and robust hormonal responsiveness, have emerged as valuable models for investigating uterine physiology and embryo implantation. However, conventional derivation from endometrial biopsies is invasive, carries surgical risks, and limits repeated sampling. This study introduces uterine lavage fluid as a non-invasive source for generating endometrial organoids.Methods

We established endometrial organoids from uterine lavage fluid (UF-EOs) and compared them with matched tissue-derived endometrial organoids (T-EOs) for morphology, proliferation, epithelial marker expression, transcriptomic profiles, and hormone responsiveness. Lavage fluid was collected from reproductive-age women with normal endometrium and from patients with intrauterine adhesions (IUA). Differential gene-expression analysis between IUA-derived and control organoids was performed to identify IUA-associated signatures. A microinjection platform was developed to deliver HTR8/SVneo trophoblast spheroids into the organoid lumen.Results

UF-EOs were successfully derived from 90% of control individuals (9/10) and 60% of IUA patients (6/10). UF-EOs and T-EOs were morphologically indistinguishable, with comparable proliferation rates (104.6 ± 6.21 versus 106.4 ± 5.16; P > 0.05) and equivalent expression of epithelial markers (EpCAM, Cytokeratin 7, E-cadherin). Transcriptomic analysis showed tight paired clustering of UF-EOs with matched T-EOs across three independent patients. Both organoid types demonstrated equivalent hormone responsiveness, with progesterone-induced secretory differentiation evidenced by glandular folding, subnuclear vacuolization, glycogen accumulation, and upregulation of SPP1, PAEP, and 17HSDβ2. IUA-derived UF-EOs displayed 190 differentially expressed genes, with enrichment of cell cycle, TGF-β, and Hippo signaling pathways. TGF-β2 and Smad2 were significantly upregulated and SOX9, PCNA, and Ki67 were downregulated, consistent with compromised regenerative capacity. HTR8/SVneo spheroids were successfully microinjected into organoid lumens, with luminal localization observed at 24 h.Conclusion

We have introduced uterine lavage fluid as a feasible source for generating endometrial organoids with equivalent fidelity to tissue-derived counterparts. UF-EOs provide a non-invasive alternative that enables organoid-based research in populations previously excluded from invasive sampling, including patients with intrauterine adhesions. Our findings demonstrate applications in disease mechanism investigation, endometrial receptivity assessment, and modeling of early embryo-epithelium interactions. Future studies employing larger cohorts and integrated multicellular systems will be essential to validate the clinical utility of this approach.
abstractZh:
背景

子宫内膜类器官凭借其三维结构和强大的激素反应性，已成为研究子宫生理和胚胎着床的重要模型。然而，传统的子宫内膜活检来源具有侵入性，存在手术风险，并限制了重复采样。本研究引入子宫灌洗液作为生成子宫内膜类器官的非侵入性来源。方法

我们从子宫灌洗液（UF-EOs）中建立了子宫内膜类器官，并将其与匹配的组织来源子宫内膜类器官（T-EOs）在形态、增殖、上皮标志物表达、转录组谱和激素反应性方面进行了比较。灌洗液采集自具有正常子宫内膜的育龄女性以及宫腔粘连（IUA）患者。对IUA来源和对照类器官进行了差异基因表达分析，以识别IUA相关特征。开发了一个显微注射平台，将HTR8/SVneo滋养层球体递送到类器官腔内。结果

UF-EOs成功从90%的对照个体（9/10）和60%的IUA患者（6/10）中衍生。UF-EOs和T-EOs在形态上无法区分，增殖率相当（104.6±6.21对106.4±5.16；P>0.05），上皮标志物（EpCAM、细胞角蛋白7、E-钙黏蛋白）表达相同。转录组分析显示，在三个独立患者中，UF-EOs与匹配的T-EOs紧密配对聚类。两种类器官类型均表现出相同的激素反应性，孕酮诱导的分泌分化表现为腺体折叠、核下空泡化、糖原积累以及SPP1、PAEP和17HSDβ2的上调。IUA来源的UF-EOs显示了190个差异表达基因，富集于细胞周期、TGF-β和Hippo信号通路。TGF-β2和Smad2显著上调，而SOX9、PCNA和Ki67下调，与再生能力受损一致。HTR8/SVneo球体成功显微注射到类器官腔内，24小时观察到腔内定位。结论

我们引入了子宫灌洗液作为生成子宫内膜类器官的可行来源，其保真度与组织来源的对应物相当。UF-EOs提供了一种非侵入性替代方案，使得此前被排除在侵入性采样之外的人群（包括宫腔粘连患者）能够进行基于类器官的研究。我们的研究结果展示了在疾病机制研究、子宫内膜容受性评估以及早期胚胎-上皮相互作用建模中的应用。未来采用更大队列和整合多细胞系统的研究对于验证该方法的临床实用性至关重要。

abstract: Dermal fibroblasts exhibit spatiotemporal heterogeneity, transitioning from coordinating immune signaling and depositing a provisional extracellular matrix during the early inflammatory phase to driving directional migration and mature matrix synthesis in the proliferative phase of wound healing. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying these fibroblast state transitions remain unclear. Here, by integrating single-cell RNA-sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and in vivo and in vitro analyses in both mouse and skin organoid models for functional validation, we identify a previously underappreciated Gli2-Serpinh1 regulatory axis that plays a key role in fibroblast state transitions during skin wound healing. Serpinh1⁺ fibroblast subsets drive wound closure through re-epithelialization, vascular regeneration, and actin-mediated filopodia formation. Gli2, as a key upstream regulator of Serpinh1, modulates fibroblast function in a level-dependent manner across different healing states. Leveraging organoid technology as a drug discovery platform, we further identify three traditional Chinese medicine candidates that enhance wound healing by activating the Gli2-Serpinh1 axis. Our study reveals the Gli2-Serpinih1 axis as a pivotal regulator of fibroblast state transitions, providing mechanistic insight into fibroblast heterogeneity during wound healing and opening new avenues for precision regenerative therapies.
abstractZh: 真皮成纤维细胞表现出时空异质性，在伤口愈合的早期炎症阶段从协调免疫信号和沉积临时细胞外基质，转变为在增殖阶段驱动定向迁移和成熟基质合成。然而，这些成纤维细胞状态转变的分子机制仍不清楚。在此，通过整合单细胞RNA测序、空间转录组学以及小鼠和皮肤类器官模型中的体内和体外分析进行功能验证，我们确定了一个先前未被充分认识的Gli2-Serpinh1调控轴，该轴在皮肤伤口愈合过程中成纤维细胞状态转变中发挥关键作用。Serpinh1⁺成纤维细胞亚群通过再上皮化、血管再生和肌动蛋白介导的丝状伪足形成驱动伤口闭合。Gli2作为Serpinh1的关键上游调控因子，以水平依赖的方式在不同愈合状态下调节成纤维细胞功能。利用类器官技术作为药物发现平台，我们进一步确定了三种通过激活Gli2-Serpinh1轴促进伤口愈合的传统中药候选药物。我们的研究揭示了Gli2-Serpinh1轴是成纤维细胞状态转变的关键调控因子，为伤口愈合过程中成纤维细胞异质性提供了机制见解，并为精准再生治疗开辟了新途径。

abstract: Humans will return to the Moon and travel to deep space on their journey to Mars. Space exploration presents significant hazards to human health, including exposure to ionizing radiation (IR) from galactic cosmic rays (GCR) and solar particle events (SPEs). Space radiation-induced carcinogenesis is considered a primary risk to astronaut health. However, cardiovascular disease (CVD) and central nervous system (CNS) dysfunction have emerged as significant health risks for astronauts. Small animal models, particularly rodents, have provided valuable information regarding IR effects on the cardiovascular and CNSs; however, these small animal models have limitations in mimicking human metabolism and physiology, highlighting the need for alternative models. Minipigs are highly translational cardiovascular and neurovascular models due to their close similarities to humans in anatomy, physiology, metabolism, and immune responses. Their use enables clinically relevant assessment of space radiation-induced cardiovascular and neurological effects. This review highlights the advantages and limitations of minipigs as radiation models, including their utility for investigating sex-specific responses and their integration with emerging microphysiological systems. Together, these approaches provide a translational platform for mechanistic discovery, biomarker identification, risk assessment, and the development of countermeasures to protect astronaut health during future deep-space missions.
abstractZh: 人类将重返月球，并在前往火星的旅程中深入太空。太空探索对人类健康构成重大危害，包括来自银河宇宙射线（GCR）和太阳粒子事件（SPE）的电离辐射（IR）暴露。太空辐射诱发的癌症被认为是宇航员健康的主要风险。然而，心血管疾病（CVD）和中枢神经系统（CNS）功能障碍已成为宇航员面临的重大健康风险。小动物模型，特别是啮齿动物，为电离辐射对心血管和中枢神经系统的影响提供了宝贵信息；然而，这些小动物模型在模拟人类代谢和生理方面存在局限性，凸显了对替代模型的需求。迷你猪由于在解剖学、生理学、代谢和免疫反应方面与人类高度相似，是高度可转化的心血管和神经血管模型。它们的使用使得对太空辐射诱发的心血管和神经效应进行临床相关评估成为可能。本综述强调了迷你猪作为辐射模型的优势和局限性，包括其在研究性别特异性反应方面的效用，以及其与新兴微生理系统的整合。总之，这些方法为机制发现、生物标志物识别、风险评估以及制定保护宇航员在未来深空任务中健康的对策提供了一个转化平台。

abstract:
Background & aims

Gastric cancer develops through a sequential carcinogenic process beginning with pyloric metaplasia, a key feature of which is the transdifferentiation of gastric chief cells into spasmolytic polypeptide-expressing metaplastic (SPEM) cells. We found that SRY-Box 9 (SOX9), a transcription factor, is highly expressed in SPEM cells in both human and murine metaplasia. We therefore investigated the impact of SOX9-mediated SPEM cell plasticity and function on metaplasia development and progression during gastric carcinogenesis.Methods

We used 2 Sox9 knockout mouse models, GIFrtTA/+;TetO-CreTg/+;Sox9flox/flox (GCS) and GIFrtTA/+;TetO-CreTg/+;LSL-KrasG12DTg/+;Sox9flox/flox (GCKS) to examine the effects of SOX9 loss on metaplasia development after mucosal injury and carcinogenesis by immunofluorescence and single-cell RNA sequencing. We also confirmed our findings in human patient tissue microarrays and used SPEM organoids to identify genes regulated by SOX9.Results

Sox9 knockout in chief cells resulted in the failure of metaplasia development in both acute and chronic injury because chief cells were unable to transdifferentiate into SPEM cells. The GCKS mouse failed to progress through carcinogenesis due to lack of a SPEM cell subpopulation responsible for metaplasia progression and fibroblast recruitment to gland bases. Instead, homeostatic gastric cell lineages were repopulated in the glands. We also identified a DNA topoisomerase II-α-expressing SPEM cell subpopulation that contributes to metaplasia progression, and putative SOX9 downstream genes associated with lineage plasticity.Conclusion

These results demonstrate that SOX9 is a master regulator of SPEM cell lineage evolution and metaplasia progression. Therefore, SOX9-mediated SPEM cell plasticity is a central mechanism in carcinogenesis.
abstractZh:
背景与目的

胃癌通过一个连续的致癌过程发展，始于幽门化生，其关键特征是胃主细胞转分化为痉挛性多肽表达化生（SPEM）细胞。我们发现转录因子SRY-Box 9（SOX9）在人类和小鼠化生中的SPEM细胞中高表达。因此，我们研究了SOX9介导的SPEM细胞可塑性和功能对胃致癌过程中化生发展和进展的影响。方法

我们使用了两种Sox9敲除小鼠模型，GIFrtTA/+;TetO-CreTg/+;Sox9flox/flox（GCS）和GIFrtTA/+;TetO-CreTg/+;LSL-KrasG12DTg/+;Sox9flox/flox（GCKS），通过免疫荧光和单细胞RNA测序检查SOX9缺失对黏膜损伤后化生发展和致癌作用的影响。我们还在人类患者组织微阵列中确认了我们的发现，并使用SPEM类器官来鉴定由SOX9调控的基因。结果

主细胞中Sox9敲除导致急性和慢性损伤后化生发展失败，因为主细胞无法转分化为SPEM细胞。GCKS小鼠未能通过致癌过程进展，原因是缺乏负责化生进展和成纤维细胞募集到腺体基部的SPEM细胞亚群。相反，稳态胃细胞谱系在腺体中重新填充。我们还鉴定了一个表达DNA拓扑异构酶II-α的SPEM细胞亚群，该亚群有助于化生进展，以及推测的与谱系可塑性相关的SOX9下游基因。结论

这些结果表明SOX9是SPEM细胞谱系进化和化生进展的主调控因子。因此，SOX9介导的SPEM细胞可塑性是致癌过程中的一个核心机制。

abstract:
Aims

This study aims to investigate the efficacy of drug repurposing using a corneal organoid model developed from patient-derived iPSCs and to elucidate the pathophysiology of Aniridia-Associated Keratopathy (AAK).Materials and methods

A 90-day stepwise differentiation protocol was used to generate corneal organoids from iPSC cell lines developed from aniridia patients and healthy control. The corneal organoids produced were characterized using histology, immunofluorescence, qPCR, western blot, and transcriptomics. Two known agents, Duloxetine and Ataluren, were tested for corneal organoids for the restoring PAX6 protein expression.Key findings

Histological analyses showed that the corneal organoids had a similar architecture to the native corneal tissue. Corneal epithelial, stromal, and endothelial cell biomarker staining showed positive expressions. AAK corneal organoids exhibited features that indicate the AAK disease phenotype, such as thickening of the epithelial cell layers and decrease in expressions of PAX6, ΔNP63, and keratocan genes. An increase in PAX6 protein was observed in organoids produced from AAK1 after duloxetine treatment and in organoids produced from AAK2 following ataluren treatment. AAK3 did not respond to either agent, indicating that there was no mutation-specific drug activity. Transcriptomic analyses showed clear corneal differentiation and absence of retina or lens profile in organoids.Significance

This study presents patient-specific organoid models for AAK using iPSCs and offers insight into mutation effects and PAX6 restoration following drug repurposing. The findings form the basis of personalized treatments for congenital aniridia.
abstractZh:
目的

本研究旨在利用患者来源的iPSCs开发的角膜类器官模型，探讨药物再利用的疗效，并阐明无虹膜相关角膜病变（AAK）的病理生理学。材料与方法

采用90天逐步分化方案，从无虹膜患者和健康对照者开发的iPSC细胞系生成角膜类器官。通过组织学、免疫荧光、qPCR、western blot和转录组学对所生成的角膜类器官进行表征。测试了两种已知药物度洛西汀和阿他卢仑对角膜类器官恢复PAX6蛋白表达的作用。主要发现

组织学分析显示，角膜类器官具有与天然角膜组织相似的架构。角膜上皮、基质和内皮细胞生物标志物染色显示阳性表达。AAK角膜类器官表现出指示AAK疾病表型的特征，如上皮细胞层增厚以及PAX6、ΔNP63和角膜蛋白基因表达降低。在度洛西汀处理后产生的AAK1类器官和阿他卢仑处理后产生的AAK2类器官中观察到PAX6蛋白增加。AAK3对两种药物均无反应，表明没有突变特异性药物活性。转录组学分析显示类器官具有明确的角膜分化，且无视网膜或晶状体特征。意义

本研究利用iPSCs为AAK提供了患者特异性类器官模型，并提供了突变效应和药物再利用后PAX6恢复的见解。这些发现为先天性无虹膜的个性化治疗奠定了基础。

abstract: Adoptive T-cell therapy is a promising strategy for cancer immunotherapy; however, its efficacy is often limited by the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. γδ T cells, particularly the Vγ9Vδ2 subset, exhibit innate-like cytotoxicity and are emerging candidates for adoptive immunotherapy. Pemetrexed, an antifolate chemotherapeutic agent, has documented immunomodulatory effects in αβ T-cell settings; however, its impact on γδ T-cell antitumor responses remains insufficiently defined. Here, Vγ9Vδ2 T cells were isolated and expanded from healthy-donor peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PMBCs) and co-cultured with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) cells with or without pemetrexed pretreatment. Pemetrexed significantly enhanced γδ T cell-mediated cytotoxicity compared with either treatment alone. Mechanistically, pemetrexed increased the expression of NKG2D ligands, including MHC class I chain-related proteins A/B (MICA/B) and UL16-binding proteins (ULBPs), through the ataxia-telangiectasia mutated (ATM)-stimulator of interferon genes (STING)-nuclear factor-κB (NF-κB) signaling axis. ATM activation triggered cyclic GMP-AMP synthase-independent STING signaling and preferentially activated NF-κB rather than interferon regulatory factor 3 (IRF3), thereby promoting transcriptional upregulation of NKG2D ligands and improving tumor recognition by γδ T cells. Consistent with the cell-line findings, pemetrexed increased MICA/B and ULBP2/5/6 expression in NSCLC patient-derived organoids. Furthermore, in an in vivo NSCLC animal model, combined pemetrexed and adoptive γδ T-cell therapy suppressed tumor growth more effectively than either treatment alone and was accompanied by increased NKG2D ligand expression. Collectively, these findings reveal a tumor-sensitizing mechanism by which pemetrexed potentiates γδ T-cell antitumor function and support combining pemetrexed with γδ T cell-based immunotherapy for NSCLC.
abstractZh: 过继性T细胞治疗是癌症免疫治疗的一种有前景的策略；然而，其疗效常受免疫抑制性肿瘤微环境的限制。γδ T细胞，特别是Vγ9Vδ2亚群，表现出固有样细胞毒性，正成为过继性免疫治疗的候选细胞。培美曲塞，一种抗叶酸化疗药物，在αβ T细胞环境中已有免疫调节作用的记录；然而，其对γδ T细胞抗肿瘤反应的影响仍不明确。本研究从健康供体外周血单个核细胞（PBMCs）中分离并扩增Vγ9Vδ2 T细胞，并与非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）细胞共培养，无论是否经过培美曲塞预处理。与单独治疗相比，培美曲塞显著增强了γδ T细胞介导的细胞毒性。机制上，培美曲塞通过共济失调-毛细血管扩张突变（ATM）-干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）-核因子-κB（NF-κB）信号轴，增加了NKG2D配体（包括MHC I类链相关蛋白A/B（MICA/B）和UL16结合蛋白（ULBPs））的表达。ATM激活触发了环状GMP-AMP合酶非依赖的STING信号，并优先激活NF-κB而非干扰素调节因子3（IRF3），从而促进NKG2D配体的转录上调，提高γδ T细胞对肿瘤的识别。与细胞系发现一致，培美曲塞增加了NSCLC患者来源类器官中MICA/B和ULBP2/5/6的表达。此外，在体内NSCLC动物模型中，培美曲塞联合过继性γδ T细胞治疗比单独治疗更有效地抑制了肿瘤生长，并伴有NKG2D配体表达的增加。总的来说，这些发现揭示了培美曲塞增强γδ T细胞抗肿瘤功能的肿瘤敏化机制，并支持将培美曲塞与基于γδ T细胞的免疫治疗联合用于NSCLC。

abstract: Understanding the complexity of cells - their components, processes, and dynamics - requires imaging techniques capable of capturing biological organization in situ and across scales. Advances in cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET), enabled by focused ion beam (FIB) milling, have positioned this technique as a powerful tool for visualizing cells at molecular resolution. Extending cryo-ET to multicellular specimens such as organoids or tissues, however, requires sample preparation strategies that can access areas deep within complex specimens. Cryo-lift-out has emerged as a key sample preparation technique to address this challenge. Here, we review recent advances in cryo-lift-out to image cellular processes, discuss the remaining technical challenges, and outline our perspectives on how continued methodological development may enable more holistic in situ studies in the future.
abstractZh: 理解细胞的复杂性——其组成、过程和动态——需要能够在原位和跨尺度捕捉生物组织的成像技术。冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET）的进展，得益于聚焦离子束（FIB）铣削，使该技术成为以分子分辨率可视化细胞的强大工具。然而，将冷冻电子断层扫描扩展到多细胞标本（如类器官或组织）需要能够进入复杂标本深处区域的样品制备策略。冷冻提升取出已成为应对这一挑战的关键样品制备技术。在此，我们回顾了冷冻提升取出在成像细胞过程中的最新进展，讨论了剩余的技术挑战，并概述了我们对持续方法学发展如何可能在未来实现更全面的原位研究的观点。

abstract: Chronic stroke poses enduring neurological deficits, while experimental strategies based on human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cortical organoids (COs) remain limited by the lack of tools for longitudinal in vivo graft monitoring. Here, we introduce the Multimodal Imaging Platform for Organoid Tracking (MIPOT), integrating MRI, bioluminescence imaging, surgical microscopy, and intravital two-photon fluorescence microscopy to monitor CO transplantation in chronic stroke lesions in mice. MIPOT enabled confirmation of initial graft placement within cleaned infarct cavities, longitudinal assessment of viability-associated bioluminescence signals, and high-resolution visualization of graft-derived cells and short-term cellular dynamics. Bioluminescence imaging revealed a progressive decline in graft-associated signals that stabilized at approximately 25% by two weeks, while endpoint histology confirmed limited persistence of human graft-derived cells at later time points. Together, MIPOT provides a multimodal framework for monitoring organoid transplantation in the injured brain and supports future optimization of graft survival, maturation, and host-graft integration.
abstractZh: 慢性卒中造成持续的神经功能缺损，而基于人诱导多能干细胞来源的皮层类器官（COs）的实验策略因缺乏纵向体内移植物监测工具而受到限制。在此，我们介绍了用于类器官追踪的多模态成像平台（MIPOT），该平台整合了MRI、生物发光成像、手术显微镜和活体双光子荧光显微镜，以监测小鼠慢性卒中病变中的CO移植。MIPOT能够确认初始移植物在清理后的梗死腔内的放置，纵向评估与活力相关的生物发光信号，并高分辨率可视化移植物来源的细胞及短期细胞动态。生物发光成像显示，移植物相关信号逐渐下降，并在两周时稳定在约25%，而终点组织学证实，在后期时间点人移植物来源细胞的持续存在有限。总之，MIPOT为监测受损大脑中的类器官移植提供了一个多模态框架，并支持未来优化移植物存活、成熟及宿主-移植物整合。

abstract: Nucleus-specific brain organoids enable precise human brain research, yet refined hindbrain models are rare. Here, we present a guided differentiation protocol for generating human medullary spinal trigeminal nucleus-like organoids (hmSpVOs). We describe steps for constructing spinal trigeminal nucleus (SpV)-thalamus assembloids. Moreover, we outline the assays to characterize functional connections within these assembloids. For complete details on the use and execution of this protocol, please refer to Pang et al.1.
abstractZh: 核特异性脑类器官能够实现精确的人类大脑研究，但精细的后脑模型仍然罕见。在此，我们提出一种引导分化方案，用于生成人类延髓三叉神经脊束核样类器官（hmSpVOs）。我们描述了构建三叉神经脊束核（SpV）-丘脑组装体的步骤。此外，我们概述了用于表征这些组装体内功能连接的检测方法。有关此方案使用和执行的完整细节，请参阅Pang等人的文献1。

abstract: Spatially controlling morphogenesis is a challenge for many organoid systems that manifests as a limited understanding of self-organization of differentiating cells and leads to a high degree of heterogeneity in organoid morphometrics. Current methods to grow organoids rely on temporal presentation of soluble cues that are not controllably delivered, and little is known about the role of the extracellular microenvironment in this process. Here, we present a material-based strategy to spatiotemporally control morphogenesis of human intestinal organoids (HIOs) with predictable crypt morphometrics and cell composition that match their in vivo tissue counterparts. We first optimize culture conditions to generate more reproducible HIOs with predictable growth in phototunable poly (ethylene glycol)-based hydrogels, and then systematically investigate the role of light-mediated matrix softening in guiding crypt formation. The light dose delivered to crypt-sized regions adjacent to growing organoids is a key factor in maintaining organoid cell viability, as well as crypt budding and elongation. With optimized light doses, predictable epithelial shape changes result in programmable crypt formation, confirmed by the presence of proliferative (Ki67+) and niche-defining Paneth (Lyz+) cells. This methodology could be readily adopted for other budding and branching organoids to facilitate controllable changes in morphogenesis or cell migration. Sequential patterning approaches and more complex pattern designs could further open the parameter space to facilitate modeling of a wide array of engineered tissues for applications ranging from fundamental biology to disease modeling and translational medicine.
abstractZh: 空间控制形态发生对许多类器官系统来说是一个挑战，这表现为对分化细胞自组织的理解有限，并导致类器官形态测量学的高度异质性。目前培养类器官的方法依赖于可溶性信号的时序呈现，而这些信号无法可控地递送，并且关于细胞外微环境在此过程中的作用知之甚少。在此，我们提出了一种基于材料的策略，以时空可控的方式控制人肠道类器官（HIOs）的形态发生，其隐窝形态测量学和细胞组成可预测，且与体内组织对应物相匹配。我们首先优化培养条件，在可光调谐的聚乙二醇基水凝胶中生成更具可重复性且生长可预测的HIOs，然后系统研究光介导的基质软化在引导隐窝形成中的作用。递送至生长中类器官邻近隐窝大小区域的光剂量是维持类器官细胞活力以及隐窝出芽和伸长的关键因素。在优化的光剂量下，可预测的上皮形状变化导致可编程的隐窝形成，这通过增殖性（Ki67+）和生态位定义的潘氏细胞（Lyz+）的存在得到证实。该方法可轻松应用于其他出芽和分支类器官，以促进形态发生或细胞迁移的可控变化。顺序图案化方法和更复杂的图案设计可进一步拓展参数空间，以促进对多种工程组织的建模，应用范围从基础生物学到疾病建模和转化医学。

title: Oncogenic snoRNA SNORD78 fuels colorectal cancer by protecting the m6A reader IMP2 to enhance phospholipid metabolism.

abstract: Small nucleolar RNAs (snoRNAs) play crucial regulatory roles in various cancers. However, the mechanisms by which snoRNAs regulate N6-methyladenosine (m6A) modifications in colorectal cancer (CRC) remain unclear. This study systematically deciphered the precise interaction mechanism between SNORD78 and the m6A reader IMP2 in CRC. We demonstrate that SNORD78 specifically stabilizes IMP2 to activate the PIK3CD-CHKA-Kennedy pathway in an m6A-dependent manner, promoting endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS) and phosphatidylcholine (PC) biosynthesis, thereby driving CRC. Conversely, the SNORD78-targeting antisense oligonucleotide (ASO), ASO-78, effectively suppresses ERS and PC levels, inhibiting CRC progression. Mechanistically, SNORD78, relying on the "UAAUGA" element in its C-D box region, specifically binds to the Lys221 ubiquitination site of IMP2, blocking TRIM25-mediated degradation of IMP2 and maintaining its stability. IMP2 enhanced the stability and translation of the target mRNAs PIK3CD and CHKA by recognizing their corresponding m6A positions, m6A-3208 and m6A-1619, respectively, to reshape the phosphatidylcholine metabolite profile in CRC cells. In terms of potential therapeutic strategies, the ASO-78 can significantly inhibit CRC cell proliferation, reduce ERS levels, and decrease phosphatidylcholine content. The combination of ASO-78 and IMP2 inhibitor IMP2-IN1, by dual blocking of the SNORD78-IMP2 axis, exhibits an excellent proliferation-inhibiting effect in CRC organoids. This study not only reveals a mechanism by which the SNORD78-IMP2 interaction regulates CRC occurrence and development but also provides theoretical basis for innovative therapeutic strategies for precise targeting of tumor snoRNA-m6A reader interactions.
abstractZh: 小核仁RNA（snoRNAs）在多种癌症中发挥关键的调控作用。然而，snoRNAs在结直肠癌（CRC）中调控N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）修饰的机制仍不清楚。本研究系统解析了SNORD78与m6A阅读器IMP2在CRC中的精确相互作用机制。我们证明，SNORD78特异性稳定IMP2，以m6A依赖性方式激活PIK3CD-CHKA-Kennedy通路，促进内质网应激（ERS）和磷脂酰胆碱（PC）生物合成，从而驱动CRC。相反，靶向SNORD78的反义寡核苷酸（ASO），即ASO-78，能有效抑制ERS和PC水平，抑制CRC进展。机制上，SNORD78依赖其C-D盒区域中的“UAAUGA”元件，特异性结合IMP2的Lys221泛素化位点，阻断TRIM25介导的IMP2降解，维持其稳定性。IMP2通过识别其相应的m6A位点，即m6A-3208和m6A-1619，增强靶mRNA PIK3CD和CHKA的稳定性及翻译，从而重塑CRC细胞中的磷脂酰胆碱代谢物谱。在潜在治疗策略方面，ASO-78能显著抑制CRC细胞增殖，降低ERS水平，并减少磷脂酰胆碱含量。ASO-78与IMP2抑制剂IMP2-IN1的联合使用，通过双重阻断SNORD78-IMP2轴，在CRC类器官中展现出优异的增殖抑制效果。本研究不仅揭示了SNORD78-IMP2相互作用调控CRC发生发展的机制，也为精准靶向肿瘤snoRNA-m6A阅读器相互作用的创新治疗策略提供了理论基础。

abstract: Optical tweezers (OT), a cornerstone of micromanipulation, are fundamentally constrained by substrate-induced adhesion and friction, limiting their application to mesoscale objects and fragile biological specimens where overcoming these resistive forces requires physiologically damaging laser powers. Here, we overcome this long-standing challenge by introducing dielectric levitation optical tweezers (DL-OT), a multiphysics platform that seamlessly integrates alternating-current dielectric levitation with optical traps. By using negative dielectrophoresis (n-DEP) to actively neutralize the normal force, DL-OT eliminates solid-solid contact and near-wall viscous drag. Crucially, we demonstrate the fundamental superiority of this active physical levitation over traditional passive antiadhesion coatings. This physical decoupling enables the smooth translation of large biological samples using low, biologically safe optical powers (~15 mW) rather than nonviable levels (>150 mW). The creation of this frictionless environment not only boosts the maximum manipulation speed of standard microtargets by 40% but also enables the stable optical transport of previously intractable mesoscale objects (100 to 260 μm), including microgears and shrimp eggs. By preventing photothermal damage and mechanical deformation, DL-OT demonstrates very good biocompatibility, significantly enhancing cell viability postmanipulation. Building upon these advantages, we demonstrate advanced on-chip biofabrication protocols through the targeted, high-precision assembly of multicellular spheroids and the safe transport of patient-derived organoids, followed by their success in situ culture. By transforming OT from a microscale tool into a mesoscale assembly platform, DL-OT paves the way for breakthroughs in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, and the bottom-up assembly of living systems.
abstractZh: 光镊（OT）是微操控的基石，但其从根本上受到基底诱导的粘附和摩擦的限制，这限制了其在中尺度物体和脆弱生物样本上的应用，因为克服这些阻力需要具有生理损伤性的激光功率。在此，我们通过引入介电悬浮光镊（DL-OT）克服了这一长期挑战，这是一种多物理场平台，将交流介电悬浮与光陷阱无缝集成。通过使用负介电泳（n-DEP）主动中和法向力，DL-OT消除了固-固接触和近壁粘性阻力。关键的是，我们证明了这种主动物理悬浮相对于传统被动防粘涂层的根本优势。这种物理解耦使得能够使用低、生物安全的激光功率（约15 mW）而非不可行的水平（>150 mW）来平滑平移大型生物样本。这种无摩擦环境的创建不仅将标准微靶标的最大操控速度提高了40%，而且还实现了先前难以处理的中尺度物体（100至260 μm）的稳定光学传输，包括微型齿轮和虾卵。通过防止光热损伤和机械变形，DL-OT表现出非常好的生物相容性，显著提高了操控后的细胞活力。基于这些优势，我们通过靶向、高精度组装多细胞球体和患者来源类器官的安全传输，展示了先进的片上生物制造方案，并随后成功进行了原位培养。通过将OT从微尺度工具转变为中尺度组装平台，DL-OT为组织工程、再生医学和生命系统的自下而上组装铺平了道路。

title: Vessel Organoids Reveal FOXF1 Variant-Specific Regulation of Mesoderm and Capillary Development
titleZh: 血管类器官揭示FOXF1变异特异性调控中胚层和毛细血管发育
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Pek NM, Thorner K, Guo M, Dennison H, Rajaguru T, Stan G, Kishimoto K, Rottier RJ, Kotton DN, Zorn AM, Gu M.
abstract:
SUMMARY

  How allelic variants in lineage-regulating transcription factors drive diverging human developmental outcomes remains poorly understood. This is partly due to the lack of human model systems. Here, we used vessel organoids from human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) to resolve variant-specific functions of Forkhead Box F1 (FOXF1), a critical regulator of mesoderm and vascular development. Using three patient-derived hiPSC lines harboring unique  FOXF1 variants, we show that heterozygous variants cause capillary maldevelopment of varying severity. Single-nucleus multiomic analysis revealed variant-specific mechanisms – a severe variant impairs differentiation of nascent mesoderm to lateral plate mesoderm and disrupts vascular progenitor specification, while moderate variants permit mesoderm differentiation but rewire vascular progenitor states and function. Restoration of wild-type  FOXF1 via lipid nanoparticle-mediated mRNA delivery rescued capillary formation in a variant- and developmental-stage-dependent manner. Together, these findings demonstrate that different variants disrupt stage-specific FOXF1 functions in human mesoderm-to-vascular development, underscoring the importance of variant-specific therapeutic strategies.  HIGHLIGHTS Human vessel organoids reveal variant-specific roles of  FOXF1 in mesoderm patterning and capillary development.  Severe  FOXF1 variant c.253T>A (p.F85I) impairs nascent mesoderm-to-lateral plate mesoderm differentiation and disrupts vascular progenitor specification.  ‘Moderate’  FOXF1 variants differentially rewire endothelial and mural progenitor cell states and function.  Lipid nanoparticle-mediated  FOXF1 mRNA delivery rescues capillary formation in a variant- and developmental-stage-dependent manner.
abstractZh:
摘要

  谱系调控转录因子中的等位基因变异如何驱动不同的人类发育结果，目前仍知之甚少。这部分是由于缺乏人类模型系统。在这里，我们使用来自人类诱导多能干细胞（hiPSCs）的血管类器官来解析叉头框F1（FOXF1）的变异特异性功能，FOXF1是中胚层和血管发育的关键调控因子。利用三个携带独特FOXF1变异的患者来源hiPSC系，我们表明杂合变异导致不同严重程度的毛细血管发育不良。单核多组学分析揭示了变异特异性机制——一种严重变异损害新生中胚层向侧板中胚层的分化，并破坏血管祖细胞特化，而中度变异允许中胚层分化，但重新连接血管祖细胞状态和功能。通过脂质纳米颗粒介导的mRNA递送恢复野生型FOXF1，以变异和发育阶段依赖的方式挽救了毛细血管形成。总之，这些发现表明，不同变异破坏了人类中胚层到血管发育中阶段特异性的FOXF1功能，强调了变异特异性治疗策略的重要性。

  亮点
  人类血管类器官揭示了FOXF1在中胚层 patterning 和毛细血管发育中的变异特异性作用。
  严重FOXF1变异c.253T>A（p.F85I）损害新生中胚层向侧板中胚层的分化，并破坏血管祖细胞特化。
  “中度”FOXF1变异差异性地重新连接内皮和壁细胞祖细胞状态和功能。
  脂质纳米颗粒介导的FOXF1 mRNA递送以变异和发育阶段依赖的方式挽救毛细血管形成。

title: Disruption of  Histone H4C  genes impairs skeletal development and cortical neurogenesis, modeling rare neurodevelopmental syndromes
titleZh: 组蛋白H4C基因的破坏损害骨骼发育和皮层神经发生，模拟罕见的神经发育综合征
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Nagasawa H, Nishimura K, Tojima S, Nomura T.
abstract: Histone proteins, which reside in the nuclei of eukaryotic cells, are involved in diverse cellular processes. The core histone H4 serves as a structural component of the nucleosome. Patients carrying mutations in H4Clustered histone (  H4C ) genes exhibit a broad spectrum of developmental abnormalities, including short stature, microcephaly, intellectual disability, growth retardation, and digital anomalies. However, the impact of H4 mutations on mammalian embryogenesis remains largely unclear. Here, we demonstrate that  histone H4C genes play crucial roles in skeletal development and cortical neurogenesis. We found that mRNAs of the  histone H4C gene family are specifically expressed in proliferating progenitor cells in the developing mouse neocortex and in human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cortical organoids. CRISPR-mediated disruption of  H4C3 in mice caused severe defects in skeletal formation and neocortical neurogenesis. Furthermore, overexpression of a mutant form of  H4C3 resulted in altered expression of genes associated with cellular migration and motility. Together, these findings suggest that histone H4 plays a critical role in regulating the balance between proliferation and differentiation during mammalian embryonic development, thereby explaining the broad spectrum of patient phenotypes.
abstractZh: 组蛋白位于真核细胞核中，参与多种细胞过程。核心组蛋白H4作为核小体的结构组成部分。携带H4簇集组蛋白（H4C）基因突变的患者表现出广泛的发育异常，包括身材矮小、小头畸形、智力障碍、生长迟缓和手指异常。然而，H4突变对哺乳动物胚胎发生的影响仍 largely 不清楚。在此，我们证明组蛋白H4C基因在骨骼发育和皮层神经发生中发挥关键作用。我们发现，组蛋白H4C基因家族的mRNA在发育中的小鼠新皮层和人类诱导多能干细胞来源的皮层类器官中的增殖祖细胞中特异性表达。CRISPR介导的小鼠H4C3破坏导致骨骼形成和新皮层神经发生的严重缺陷。此外，过表达突变形式的H4C3导致与细胞迁移和运动相关的基因表达改变。总之，这些发现表明组蛋白H4在调节哺乳动物胚胎发育过程中增殖与分化之间的平衡中发挥关键作用，从而解释了患者表型的广泛谱系。

abstract: Nanomaterials have gained huge importance in various fields, such as healthcare, electronics, and environmental management, due to their unique characteristics. However, the potent toxicity is a big concern regarding their utility. Toxicological assessment becomes an important step to ensure their safe applications. The significant hazards of nanomaterials have risen from their shape, size, charge, and makeup, which leads to genetic damage, cellular uptake, and internalization with oxidative stress (OS) and harm to specific organs. This review focuses on toxicity profiles and their possible interactions with cellular organelles leading to apoptosis (Apop) and long-term bioaccumulation.Size, surface area, and dissolving capability may affect the toxicity of nanomaterials. Different measures such as encapsulation methods, increasing surface area, and enhancing biodegradability are being considered to reduce toxicity from innovative nanomaterials. Knowledge gaps encompass uneven toxicity evaluations, inadequate chronic exposure data, and insufficient attention to individualized reactions. The integration of standardized models, computational predictions, mechanistic investigations, and regulatory compliance is crucial for the safer design of nanomaterials. The review highlights toxicological issues caused by nanomaterials such as nanoformulation, quantum dots, and nanoparticles. It also directs future strategies in nanotoxicology, highlighting increasing assessment models, strategies, and collaborative research efforts. Bringing together regulatory and research efforts in the context of nanomaterials is important for ensuring the safe application of nanomaterials across pharmacy and other industries. This review offers a comprehensive viewpoint connecting physicochemical factors, sophisticated in vitro models, and developing regulatory frameworks, emphasizing emerging trends including microphysiological systems and animal-free risk assessment methodologies.
abstractZh: 纳米材料因其独特的特性，在医疗保健、电子和环境管理等多个领域具有极其重要的意义。然而，其潜在的毒性是其应用中的一个重大问题。毒理学评估成为确保其安全应用的重要步骤。纳米材料的显著危害源于其形状、尺寸、电荷和组成，这些因素会导致遗传损伤、细胞摄取、内化伴随氧化应激（OS）以及对特定器官的损害。本综述重点关注毒性特征及其与细胞器可能的相互作用，导致细胞凋亡（Apop）和长期生物蓄积。尺寸、表面积和溶解能力可能影响纳米材料的毒性。正在考虑采取不同的措施，如封装方法、增加表面积和增强生物降解性，以降低创新纳米材料的毒性。知识空白包括毒性评估不均衡、慢性暴露数据不足以及对个体化反应关注不够。标准化模型、计算预测、机制研究和监管合规的整合对于纳米材料的安全设计至关重要。本综述强调了纳米材料（如纳米制剂、量子点和纳米颗粒）引起的毒理学问题。它还指导了纳米毒理学未来的策略，强调了改进的评估模型、策略和合作研究工作。在纳米材料的背景下，将监管和研究工作结合起来对于确保纳米材料在制药及其他行业的安全应用非常重要。本综述提供了一个全面的视角，将理化因素、先进的体外模型和不断发展的监管框架联系起来，强调了包括微生理系统和无动物风险评估方法在内的新兴趋势。

abstract: The development of functional human vasculature is essential for tissue engineering, disease modeling, and regenerative medicine. Conventional differentiation protocols of vascular lineages often exhibit lineage heterogeneity and limited control over cellular ratios. Here, we describe a protocol for generating vascular organoids (VOs) via orthogonal forward programming of hPSCs. By utilizing doxycycline-inducible activation of the transcription factors ETV2 and NKX3.1, hPSCs are rapidly directed toward endothelial and mural cell lineages, respectively. This strategy enables the assembly of VOs with precisely tunable cellular compositions within six days. When combined with fluorescent reporter lines (PECAM1-mRuby3 and ACTA2-EGFP), vascular networks can be visualized in real time without the need for tissue clearing or immunostaining. We detail procedures for stable cell line engineering, 3D organoid assembly, in vitro angiogenesis assays for drug screening, and in vivo transplantation under the mouse kidney capsule to form perfusable human vasculature. This platform provides a flexible, standardized, and scalable tool for investigating vascular biology, modeling inherited vasculopathies, and enhancing the vascularization of co-transplant tissues.
abstractZh: 功能性人类血管系统的发育对于组织工程、疾病建模和再生医学至关重要。传统的血管谱系分化方案通常表现出谱系异质性，并且对细胞比例的控制有限。在此，我们描述了一种通过hPSCs的正向前向编程生成血管类器官（VOs）的方案。通过利用多西环素诱导的转录因子ETV2和NKX3.1的激活，hPSCs分别被快速导向内皮细胞和平滑肌细胞谱系。该策略使得在六天内组装具有精确可调细胞组成的VOs成为可能。当与荧光报告细胞系（PECAM1-mRuby3和ACTA2-EGFP）结合时，无需组织透明化或免疫染色即可实时可视化血管网络。我们详细介绍了稳定细胞系工程、3D类器官组装、用于药物筛选的体外血管生成测定，以及在小鼠肾囊下进行体内移植以形成可灌注的人类血管系统的程序。该平台为研究血管生物学、模拟遗传性血管病变以及增强共移植组织的血管化提供了灵活、标准化且可扩展的工具。

abstract:
Background

Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), Barrett's esophagus (BE), and esophageal adenocarcinoma (EAC) form a recognized pathological continuum, but the causal immune and inflammatory processes driving progression remain incompletely defined.Methods

Summary-level genome-wide association study (GWAS) data were analyzed for 91 circulating inflammatory proteins (n = 14,824), 731 immune cell phenotypes (n = 3,757), and three esophageal diseases (GERD, BE, and EAC). Bidirectional and two-step Mendelian randomization (MR) were used to infer causal effects and mediation, with Cochran's Q, MR-Egger, and MR-PRESSO applied to assess heterogeneity and pleiotropy. Causal interaction networks were reconstructed to map immune- and inflammation-dominant regulatory patterns across disease stages, and MR-prioritized signals were experimentally validated in esophagogastric junction (EGJ) organoids and mouse models.Results

MR supported a causal GERD-BE-EAC sequence, with BE mediating 31.95% of the total GERD-to-EAC effect. In total, 139 immune cell traits and 29 inflammatory proteins showed causal links to disease risk. Mediation analyses highlighted M-CSF1 and HLA-DR+CD4 + T cells as central hubs. Guided by the MR-prioritized FGF19-HLA-DR + T-cell axis, experimental studies demonstrated that FGF19 promotes EGJ glandular conversion and increases infiltration of HLA-DR+ CD4+/CD8 + T cells, validated in EGJ organoids and mouse models.Conclusions

This integrated genetic and experimental framework delineates a bidirectional immune-inflammation regulatory network underlying progression from GERD to BE and EAC. FGF19 emerges as a candidate cytokine driving EGJ glandular remodeling through HLA-DR+ CD4+/CD8 + T-cell associated immune activation, providing candidate molecular targets for early prevention and intervention.
abstractZh:
背景

胃食管反流病（GERD）、巴雷特食管（BE）和食管腺癌（EAC）构成公认的病理连续体，但驱动其进展的因果免疫和炎症过程仍未完全明确。方法

分析了91种循环炎症蛋白（n=14,824）、731种免疫细胞表型（n=3,757）和三种食管疾病（GERD、BE和EAC）的汇总级全基因组关联研究（GWAS）数据。使用双向和两步孟德尔随机化（MR）推断因果效应和中介作用，并应用Cochran's Q、MR-Egger和MR-PRESSO评估异质性和多效性。重建因果相互作用网络以映射跨疾病阶段的免疫和炎症主导调控模式，并在食管胃交界处（EGJ）类器官和小鼠模型中对MR优先信号进行实验验证。结果

MR支持GERD-BE-EAC的因果序列，其中BE介导了GERD到EAC总效应的31.95%。共有139个免疫细胞特征和29种炎症蛋白与疾病风险存在因果关联。中介分析强调M-CSF1和HLA-DR+CD4+ T细胞是核心枢纽。在MR优先的FGF19-HLA-DR+ T细胞轴指导下，实验研究表明FGF19促进EGJ腺体转化并增加HLA-DR+ CD4+/CD8+ T细胞的浸润，这在EGJ类器官和小鼠模型中得到验证。结论

这一整合的遗传和实验框架描绘了从GERD到BE和EAC进展背后的双向免疫炎症调控网络。FGF19作为候选细胞因子，通过HLA-DR+ CD4+/CD8+ T细胞相关的免疫激活驱动EGJ腺体重塑，为早期预防和干预提供了候选分子靶点。

abstract: Multiple organ dysfunction syndrome presents a significant challenge in clinical critical care, characterized by the progressive or simultaneous failure of two or more organ systems following severe insults such as infection, trauma, acute pancreatitis, shock, burns, or other major events. Recent advancements in research have deepened the understanding of organ dysfunction, with a shift toward investigating organ injury and organ-specific diseases. The pathogenesis of MODS is intricate and driven by dynamic interactions across multiple levels, including inflammatory responses, microcirculatory disruptions, coagulation abnormalities, cell death, DNA damage and the production of reactive oxygen species. Recent innovations in single-cell technologies, spatial omics and organoid models have opened new avenues for exploring intercellular signaling, targeting damaged tissues and advancing drug development. Current therapeutic approaches for MODS involve comprehensive strategies, such as aggressive management of underlying causes, organ support, modulation of immune and inflammatory responses, nutritional intervention and stabilization of the internal environment. Despite these efforts, mortality rates remain high, and therapeutic advancements have yet to yield optimal results. This highlights the urgent need for continued research to translate scientific discoveries into clinical breakthroughs. Further exploration of the disease's pathogenesis, identification of early diagnostic biomarkers and development of novel, effective treatments are crucial to improving treatment outcomes and reducing mortality in critically ill patients.
abstractZh: 多器官功能障碍综合征是临床重症监护中的重大挑战，其特征是在感染、创伤、急性胰腺炎、休克、烧伤或其他重大事件等严重打击后，两个或以上器官系统进行性或同时性功能衰竭。近期研究进展加深了对器官功能障碍的理解，研究重点转向器官损伤和器官特异性疾病的探讨。MODS的发病机制复杂，由多个层面的动态相互作用驱动，包括炎症反应、微循环障碍、凝血异常、细胞死亡、DNA损伤及活性氧的产生。单细胞技术、空间组学和类器官模型的最新创新为探索细胞间信号传导、靶向损伤组织及推进药物开发开辟了新途径。目前MODS的治疗方法涉及综合策略，如积极处理根本原因、器官支持、免疫和炎症反应调节、营养干预及内环境稳定。尽管付出了这些努力，死亡率仍然很高，治疗进展尚未达到最佳效果。这凸显了持续研究以将科学发现转化为临床突破的迫切需求。进一步探索疾病发病机制、识别早期诊断生物标志物以及开发新型有效治疗方法，对于改善危重患者的治疗结局和降低死亡率至关重要。

abstract: Multidrug resistance severely limits the therapeutic efficacy of cancer treatment, and carbon-based material-mediated photothermal therapy (PTT) provides a promising strategy for overcoming tumor drug resistance. This review focuses on graphene oxide, carbon nanotubes, carbon dots, and other carbon-based platforms, and summarizes their material features, biosafety profiles, synergistic therapeutic applications, and theranostic potential in drug-resistant tumors. Current evidence indicates that carbon-based PTT platforms can enhance drug delivery, promote light-responsive release, improve cellular uptake, weaken drug efflux, and regulate ROS-, ATP-, and heat stress-related resistance processes, thereby improving the efficacy of chemo-photothermal and photothermal-photodynamic synergistic therapy. In addition, imaging localization, therapeutic monitoring, and feedback regulation further expand their potential in theranostic applications. However, long-term safety, in vivo clearance, batch-to-batch reproducibility, scalable manufacturing, precision targeting, and regulatory evaluation remain major barriers to clinical translation. Future studies should balance therapeutic efficacy with standardized safety evaluation, biodegradable material design, and translational feasibility, while incorporating AI-assisted efficacy prediction and organoid-based preclinical evaluation to improve the predictability of carbon-based PTT before clinical application.
abstractZh: 多药耐药严重限制了癌症治疗的治疗效果，而碳基材料介导的光热治疗（PTT）为克服肿瘤耐药性提供了一种有前景的策略。本综述聚焦于氧化石墨烯、碳纳米管、碳点及其他碳基平台，总结了它们在耐药肿瘤中的材料特性、生物安全性概况、协同治疗应用及诊疗一体化潜力。当前证据表明，碳基PTT平台可以增强药物递送、促进光响应释放、改善细胞摄取、削弱药物外排，并调节与ROS、ATP和热应激相关的耐药过程，从而提高化学-光热和光热-光动力协同治疗的疗效。此外，成像定位、治疗监测和反馈调节进一步扩展了它们在诊疗一体化应用中的潜力。然而，长期安全性、体内清除、批次间重现性、可规模化制造、精准靶向和监管评估仍是临床转化的主要障碍。未来的研究应在疗效与标准化安全性评估、可生物降解材料设计和转化可行性之间取得平衡，同时结合人工智能辅助的疗效预测和基于类器官的临床前评估，以提高碳基PTT在临床应用前的可预测性。

title: Learning-aided design of micropost arrays for optimizing interface stability and mass transport in organs-on-chips.

abstract: Micropost-based organ-on-a-chip (OOC) platforms are widely used to spatially confine cell-laden hydrogels and create three-dimensional (3D) co-culture microenvironments while maintaining adjacent channels for mass transport, drug delivery, and molecular sampling. During hydrogel injection, surface tension across the micropost array keeps the hydrogel interface stable and creates a semi-closed configuration that allows diffusion-based compound exchange. Despite their widespread use, rational design of micropost geometries that simultaneously ensure interface stability without leakage and efficient mass transport remains largely empirical and lacks systematic quantitative guidelines. Here, we present a learning-aided computational framework for micropost design by performing high-throughput simulations of 160 distinct micropost geometries and integrating the results into a multi-objective Bayesian optimization scheme. Two-phase flow simulations were used to evaluate interface stability during injection, while diffusion simulations quantified transport efficiency across stably formed interfaces. By modeling the coupled relationships between geometric parameters and performance metrics, we identified optimal micropost designs that satisfy predefined stability and transport criteria. This framework provides a robust and extensible approach for rational micropost design and is readily applicable under varying flow conditions, material properties, or device dimensions, offering generalizable design guidance for micropost-based OOC systems.
abstractZh: 基于微柱的器官芯片（OOC）平台被广泛用于空间限制细胞负载水凝胶，并创建三维（3D）共培养微环境，同时保持相邻通道用于质量传输、药物递送和分子采样。在水凝胶注射过程中，微柱阵列上的表面张力保持水凝胶界面稳定，并形成半封闭配置，允许基于扩散的化合物交换。尽管它们被广泛使用，但微柱几何形状的合理设计同时确保无泄漏的界面稳定性和高效的质量传输，在很大程度上仍然是经验性的，缺乏系统的定量指导。在这里，我们提出了一种学习辅助的微柱设计计算框架，通过执行160种不同微柱几何形状的高通量模拟，并将结果整合到多目标贝叶斯优化方案中。使用两相流模拟评估注射过程中的界面稳定性，而扩散模拟量化了稳定形成界面上的传输效率。通过建模几何参数和性能指标之间的耦合关系，我们确定了满足预定义稳定性和传输标准的最佳微柱设计。该框架为合理的微柱设计提供了一种稳健且可扩展的方法，并且易于在不同流动条件、材料特性或设备尺寸下应用，为基于微柱的OOC系统提供了可推广的设计指导。

title: Emerging trends in bone marrow organoid research: From hematopoietic microenvironment reconstruction to translational and regenerative theranostic applications.
titleZh: 骨髓类器官研究的新兴趋势：从造血微环境重建到转化与再生治疗应用。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Park H, Jeong J.
affiliations: Department of Biohealth Convergence, College of Science and Convergence Technology, Seoul Women's University, Seoul, 01797, Republic of Korea.
abstract: Bone marrow organ is characterized as a dynamic tissue with a complex microenvironment wherein hematopoietic stem cell (HSC) homeostasis is maintained, and the generation of various hematopoietic cell subsets is regulated. Organoids technology has been applied as an alternative tool for modeling complex tissue microenvironments in a laboratory setting through the self-organization of cells. Recent studies have established a platform capable of studying complex cellular interactions by generating bone marrow organoids (BMOs) from iPSCs. Moreover, BMOs can emulate the architecture observed of the bone marrow, including the various cell types, containing vascular-like networks, HSCs, mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs), and mature hematopoietic cells. This review aimed to summarize how BMOs can provide foundational data essential for understanding similarities in the microenvironment and the pathological mechanisms underlying bone marrow diseases, as well as for developing new treatments. Furthermore, BMO systems represent a cutting-edge platform for studying hematopoiesis, disease mechanisms, and therapeutic screening, highlighting the recent trend toward physiologically relevant organoid-based models in regenerative and hematopoietic research.
abstractZh: 骨髓器官被描述为一种具有复杂微环境的动态组织，其中造血干细胞（HSC）稳态得以维持，并调控各种造血细胞亚群的生成。类器官技术已被用作一种替代工具，通过在实验室环境中细胞的自我组织来模拟复杂的组织微环境。近期研究已建立了一个平台，通过从iPSCs生成骨髓类器官（BMOs）来研究复杂的细胞相互作用。此外，BMOs可以模拟骨髓中观察到的结构，包括各种细胞类型，包含血管样网络、造血干细胞（HSCs）、间充质基质细胞（MSCs）和成熟造血细胞。本综述旨在总结BMOs如何提供基础数据，这些数据对于理解骨髓疾病微环境的相似性和病理机制以及开发新治疗方法至关重要。此外，BMO系统代表了研究造血、疾病机制和治疗筛选的前沿平台，突显了再生和造血研究中向生理相关类器官模型发展的最新趋势。

abstract: The eukaryotic cell-based biomedicine landscape is undergoing a paradigm shift, driven by the transition from static culture to highly controlled microbioreactor environments. This mini-review assembles high-value applications, including autologous cell therapies, recombinant protein production, induced pluripotent stem cell expansion, and organoid engineering. Technologically, we highlight how the integration of microfluidics into Chimeric antigen receptor T-cell manufacturing achieves numerical optimization of cell count and phenotypic distribution through automated, closed-loop workflows. Regarding bioproduction, perfusion-based microbioreactors demonstrate a six-fold increase in productivity over traditional T-flasks, utilizing at-line monitoring and advanced cell-retention configurations to minimize shear-induced damage. Beyond production, these systems are active regulators of oxygenation and tissue morphogenesis in the context of human induced pluripotent stem cells while enabling controlled 3D tissue organization. In this connection, microfluidic platforms influence extracellular matrix remodeling and developmental signaling by modulating convective flow and mechanotransduction pathways. Furthermore, automation enhances reproducibility in feeding schedules and differentiation timing. Critical to this endeavor, the ability to generate precise spatiotemporal morphogen gradients enables reproducible lineage commitment and the maturation of complex tissues through synchronized mechanical and electrical stimuli for hosting organoid growth. The microbioreactor's superior mass transfer and low shear stress produced organoids 140% larger than static controls. While automation significantly reduces reagent consumption and inter-batch variability, challenges in scalability and material selection remain. Finally, parameters that push the microscale control boundaries are presented. Collectively, these advancements streamline therapeutic pipelines, support the replacement of animal-based testing, and align with Sustainable Development Goal 3 by accelerating the move toward personalized medicine and ethical drug screening.
abstractZh: 以真核细胞为基础的生物医学领域正在经历一场范式转变，这得益于从静态培养向高度受控的微生物反应器环境的过渡。这篇小型综述汇集了高价值应用，包括自体细胞疗法、重组蛋白生产、诱导多能干细胞扩增和类器官工程。在技术方面，我们强调了将微流控技术整合到嵌合抗原受体T细胞制造中，如何通过自动化、闭环工作流程实现细胞数量和表型分布的数值优化。在生物生产方面，基于灌注的微生物反应器相比传统T型瓶，生产率提高了六倍，利用在线监测和先进的细胞截留配置来最小化剪切诱导的损伤。在生产之外，这些系统在人类诱导多能干细胞背景下是氧合和组织形态发生的主动调节器，同时实现受控的3D组织组织。在这方面，微流控平台通过调节对流和机械转导途径影响细胞外基质重塑和发育信号传导。此外，自动化提高了喂食时间表和分化时间安排的可重复性。对这一努力至关重要的一点是，生成精确时空形态发生素梯度的能力，通过同步的机械和电刺激实现可重复的谱系定向和复杂组织的成熟，以支持类器官生长。微生物反应器优越的传质和低剪切应力产生的类器官比静态对照大140%。虽然自动化显著减少了试剂消耗和批次间变异性，但在可扩展性和材料选择方面仍存在挑战。最后，提出了推动微尺度控制边界的参数。总的来说，这些进展简化了治疗流程，支持替代动物实验，并与可持续发展目标3保持一致，加速向个性化医疗和伦理药物筛选迈进。

abstract: Cartilage repair in osteoarthritis is limited not only by structural defects in articular cartilage but also by the chronic redox and immune dysregulation in the microenvironment. Acellular cartilage matrix (ACM) replicates tissue-specific extracellular matrix (ECM) characteristics, but lacks the capacity to counteract oxidative stress and secondary inflammation in the tissue microenvironment. In this research, we incorporated tannic acid (TA) into methacrylated ACM (ACMMA) to develop a dynamic dual-crosslinked network bioink for cartilage organoid constructs. TA remodeled precursor assembly behavior, altered the interfacial charge, and promoted the formation of a denser hydrogel microstructure. ACMMA-TA exhibited enhanced chondrogenic differentiation of bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) equivalent to ACMMA. However, under oxidative stress, it significantly reduced intracellular and mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels, preserved mitochondrial membrane potential, suppressed the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines, and promoted anti-inflammatory macrophage polarization. Transcriptomic analysis of ACMMA-TA based organoid constructs revealed enhanced ECM preservation and glutathione metabolism, along with the inhibition of IL-17 and NF-κB signaling. In a rat articular cartilage defect model, the ACMMA and ACMMA-TA groups showed comparable moderate improvement, while TA functionalized cell-laden organoid constructs achieved the highest ICRS scores with hyaline-like cartilage formation. These results indicate that TA functions as a conditional microenvironment stabilizer, suggesting that biomaterial design for cartilage repair may prioritize maintaining cell function under pathological stress over structural optimization or robust chondrogenic capacity alone.
abstractZh: 骨关节炎中的软骨修复不仅受限于关节软骨的结构缺损，还受限于微环境中的慢性氧化还原和免疫失调。脱细胞软骨基质（ACM）复制了组织特异性的细胞外基质（ECM）特征，但缺乏对抗组织微环境中氧化应激和继发性炎症的能力。在本研究中，我们将单宁酸（TA）掺入甲基丙烯酰化ACM（ACMMA）中，开发了一种用于软骨类器官构建体的动态双交联网络生物墨水。TA重塑了前体组装行为，改变了界面电荷，并促进了更致密的水凝胶微结构的形成。ACMMA-TA表现出与ACMMA相当的增强骨髓间充质干细胞（BMSCs）软骨形成分化的能力。然而，在氧化应激下，它显著降低了细胞内和线粒体活性氧（ROS）水平，保持了线粒体膜电位，抑制了促炎细胞因子的表达，并促进了抗炎巨噬细胞极化。基于ACMMA-TA类器官构建体的转录组学分析揭示了ECM保存和谷胱甘肽代谢的增强，以及IL-17和NF-κB信号传导的抑制。在大鼠关节软骨缺损模型中，ACMMA和ACMMA-TA组显示出相当的适度改善，而TA功能化的细胞负载类器官构建体获得了最高的ICRS评分，并形成了透明样软骨。这些结果表明，TA作为一种条件性微环境稳定剂，提示用于软骨修复的生物材料设计可能优先考虑在病理应激下维持细胞功能，而非仅依赖结构优化或强大的软骨形成能力。

abstract: The fallopian tube (FT) is increasingly recognized as the origin of high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC), yet its immune landscape remains poorly understood. Here, we employ single-cell RNA sequencing and paired T-cell receptor sequencing to profile tissue-resident memory-like T cells (TRML) from patient-derived matched non-cancerous FT, metastatic tumors, and peripheral blood. We identify substantial clonal and functional overlap (18.4%) between FT-derived and tumor-infiltrating TRMLs, exceeding that of circulating T cells. Shared clonotypes are preferentially enriched in exhausted CD8+ subsets, including a previously uncharacterized SIK3-high subset linked to epigenetic plasticity and metabolic adaptation. Functionally, FT-derived TRMLs recognize autologous tumor antigens, showing strong interferon-γ (IFN-γ) responses and CD137 upregulation in organoid coculture assays, supporting a role in early immune surveillance. Notably, FT TRMLs exhibit lower exhaustion than tumor counterparts, suggesting therapeutic potential. These findings reveal a precursor immune surveillance network in the FT and support leveraging FT-resident T cells for cancer immunotherapy and prevention.
abstractZh: 输卵管（FT）日益被认为是高级别浆液性卵巢癌（HGSOC）的起源，但其免疫微环境仍知之甚少。在此，我们采用单细胞RNA测序和配对T细胞受体测序，对来自患者匹配的非癌性输卵管、转移性肿瘤和外周血的组织驻留记忆样T细胞（TRML）进行谱系分析。我们鉴定了输卵管来源和肿瘤浸润TRML之间显著的克隆和功能重叠（18.4%），超过了循环T细胞的重叠。共享的克隆型优先富集于耗竭的CD8+亚群中，包括一个先前未表征的SIK3高表达亚群，该亚群与表观遗传可塑性和代谢适应相关。在功能上，输卵管来源的TRML识别自体肿瘤抗原，在类器官共培养实验中显示出强烈的干扰素-γ（IFN-γ）反应和CD137上调，支持其在早期免疫监视中的作用。值得注意的是，输卵管TRML的耗竭程度低于肿瘤对应物，提示其具有治疗潜力。这些发现揭示了输卵管中的前体免疫监视网络，并支持利用输卵管驻留T细胞进行癌症免疫治疗和预防。

abstract: Vascular aging contributes to systemic dysfunction and underlies many age-related diseases, driven by structural and functional changes across various cell types, including endothelial cells, vascular smooth muscle cells, pericytes, and cardiomyocytes. This review highlights experimental models that facilitate mechanistic insights and the development of novel therapeutic approaches for vascular aging, emphasizing both in vitro and in vivo methodologies. This review discusses in vitro models utilizing primary and induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived cultures across two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) systems, such as spheroids, organoids, and vessel-on-chip platforms, which allow for a more physiological investigation of aging-associated processes. Moreover, currently used in vivo models, including genetically engineered mice, and disease models mimicking human vascular aging, as well as state-of-the-art readouts, including flow-mediated dilation (FMD) and pulse wave velocity (PWV), are also reviewed. Lastly, an overview of the most prominent hurdles and shortcomings associated with modeling vascular aging is provided, underscoring the need for continued refinement to drive therapeutic innovation.
abstractZh: 血管衰老导致全身功能障碍，并构成许多年龄相关疾病的基础，其由包括内皮细胞、血管平滑肌细胞、周细胞和心肌细胞在内的多种细胞类型的结构和功能变化所驱动。本综述重点介绍了有助于机制洞察和开发血管衰老新型治疗方法的实验模型，强调了体外和体内方法。本综述讨论了利用原代和诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源的培养物在二维（2D）和三维（3D）系统中的体外模型，如球体、类器官和血管芯片平台，这些模型允许对衰老相关过程进行更生理性的研究。此外，还综述了目前使用的体内模型，包括基因工程小鼠和模拟人类血管衰老的疾病模型，以及最先进的读数，如血流介导的扩张（FMD）和脉搏波速度（PWV）。最后，概述了与血管衰老建模相关的最突出障碍和缺陷，强调了持续改进以推动治疗创新的必要性。

title: NRXN1 haploinsufficiency converges on RNA processing during cortical development, with partial transcriptomic concordance in adult autism cortex.
titleZh: NRXN1单倍剂量不足在皮层发育过程中汇聚于RNA加工，与成人自闭症皮层存在部分转录组一致性。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Lai X, Wen J.
affiliations: Department of Child Health Care, Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center, Guangzhou Medical University, Guangdong Provincial Clinical Research Center for Child Health, Guangzhou 510623, China

abstract:
Background

NRXN1 deletions are recurrent genetic risk factors for autism spectrum disorder (ASD), yet most functional work has focused on synaptic mechanisms. We asked whether NRXN1 haploinsufficiency is also associated with earlier gene-regulatory programs during cortical development, and whether related signals are detectable in adult ASD cortex.Methods

We reanalyzed two public single-cell datasets: matched control and NRXN1-heterozygous cortical organoid samples (GSE228315; 215,442 cells, 26 samples) and post-mortem adult ASD cortex (Velmeshev et al., 2019; 104,559 nuclei, 31 donors). All comparisons were performed at the sample or donor level.Results

In adult ASD cortex, donor-level analyses revealed no significant cell-type composition or CellRank-based fate-commitment differences. In organoids, paired pseudobulk comparisons identified 282 genes consistently downregulated across three or more neural cell types in NRXN1-heterozygous samples (10.6-fold enrichment, permutation p -10). In the same adult cohort, 8 of 16 cell types showed directional concordance under unmatched tests, but none exceeded an expression-matched permutation null after correction (0/16).Conclusions

NRXN1 haploinsufficiency is associated with coordinated downregulation of RNA-processing genes in cortical organoids. Cross-dataset concordance with adult ASD cortex is directional but not specific to NRXN1, and the convergence on mRNA nuclear export and RNA-processing genes should be interpreted cautiously and verified by direct experimental perturbation.
abstractZh:
背景

NRXN1缺失是自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的复发性遗传风险因素，然而大多数功能研究聚焦于突触机制。我们探究NRXN1单倍剂量不足是否也与皮层发育早期的基因调控程序相关，以及相关信号是否在成人ASD皮层中可检测。方法

我们重新分析了两个公共单细胞数据集：匹配的对照组和NRXN1杂合皮层类器官样本（GSE228315；215,442个细胞，26个样本）以及死后成人ASD皮层（Velmeshev等，2019；104,559个细胞核，31个供体）。所有比较均在样本或供体水平进行。结果

在成人ASD皮层中，供体水平分析未发现显著的细胞类型组成或基于CellRank的命运决定差异。在类器官中，配对伪批量比较识别出282个基因在NRXN1杂合样本的三种或更多神经细胞类型中一致下调（10.6倍富集，置换检验p < 10^-10）。在同一成人队列中，16种细胞类型中有8种在非匹配检验下显示方向一致性，但经校正后均未超过表达匹配的置换零假设（0/16）。结论

NRXN1单倍剂量不足与皮层类器官中RNA加工基因的协调下调相关。与成人ASD皮层的跨数据集一致性是方向性的，但并非NRXN1特异性，且对mRNA核输出和RNA加工基因的汇聚应谨慎解读，并通过直接实验扰动加以验证。

title: Adenine nucleotide translocase 2 (ANT2) deficiency reprograms ferroptosis in alveolar progenitor cells to promote emphysema
titleZh: 腺嘌呤核苷酸转位酶2（ANT2）缺乏重编程肺泡祖细胞的铁死亡以促进肺气肿
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Mbaekwe U, Shi J, Ting N, Hu Q, Gingras S, Koenigshoff M, Kliment CR.
abstract: Stem cell dysfunction and loss of renewal capacity are primary characteristics of tissue aging and decremental regeneration in response to injury. Alveolar type 2 cells (AT2) are key progenitor cells responsible for lung repair and are thought to be dysfunctional in diseases such as chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). AT2 cells are highly metabolic and rely on mitochondria, but how mitochondrial mechanisms influence their maintenance and cell fate is unclear. This gap is critical as no current therapies target lung repair or mitochondrial function in COPD. Here, we report that adenine nucleotide translocase 2 (ANT2), a key ATP/ADP transporter, is reduced in AT2 cells from COPD lungs, and that ANT2 loss impairs bioenergetics (ATP). We also identify, for the first time, ferroptotic susceptibility as a consequence of ANT2 loss in AT2 cells, leading to impaired self-renewal and progenitor capacity in alveolar organoids. Together, loss of ANT2 and the associated cellular dysfunction resulted in worsened lung damage or emphysema due to cigarette smoke in mice. Therapeutic restoration of ANT2 expression resulted in renewed AT2 stem cell function and prevention of emphysema by reducing oxidative stress and ferroptosis. These findings highlight the importance of ANT2 in metabolic regulation, plasticity, and cell resiliency of AT2 cells in the lung and that ANT2 is a potential target for lung repair.
abstractZh: 干细胞功能障碍和更新能力丧失是组织老化和损伤后再生能力下降的主要特征。肺泡2型细胞（AT2）是负责肺修复的关键祖细胞，被认为在慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）等疾病中功能失调。AT2细胞代谢活跃，依赖线粒体，但线粒体机制如何影响其维持和细胞命运尚不清楚。这一空白至关重要，因为目前没有针对肺修复或COPD中线粒体功能的疗法。在此，我们报告腺嘌呤核苷酸转位酶2（ANT2），一种关键的ATP/ADP转运体，在COPD肺的AT2细胞中减少，且ANT2缺失损害生物能量学（ATP）。我们还首次发现，ANT2缺失导致AT2细胞对铁死亡的易感性增加，进而损害肺泡类器官中的自我更新和祖细胞能力。总之，ANT2缺失及相关细胞功能障碍导致小鼠因香烟烟雾引起的肺损伤或肺气肿加重。治疗性恢复ANT2表达可通过减少氧化应激和铁死亡来恢复AT2干细胞功能并预防肺气肿。这些发现强调了ANT2在肺AT2细胞代谢调节、可塑性和细胞弹性中的重要性，并表明ANT2是肺修复的潜在靶点。

title: Plaque-associated oligodendrocyte proteostatic failure underlies myelin loss in Alzheimer’s disease
titleZh: 阿尔茨海默病中斑块相关少突胶质细胞蛋白质稳态失衡导致髓鞘丢失
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Shin J, Joshi N, Miller B, Vellarikkal S, Huang J, Wu F, Cui Y, Murali A, Chason J, Campbell CS, Chu K, Roozafzoon R, Dostalík M, Soukup J, Savastano G, Shen X, Ganz J, He S, Peterson V, Kennedy M, Khalil I, Ximerakis M, Tamburino AM, Mathew R, Cakir B.
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) features amyloid-β plaques and tau pathology, yet the mechanism underlying early and clinically significant myelin loss remains unresolved. Here, we report human iPSC-derived forebrain organoids with doxycycline-inducible expression of SOX10, OLIG2, and NKX6-2 (SON), which generate robust, mature oligodendrocytes and compact myelin in vitro and in vivo. Introducing amyloid precursor protein (APP) pathogenic mutations produces extracellular amyloid-β plaques and phosphorylated tau, accompanied by reduced myelin basic protein (MBP) expression and disrupted myelin ultrastructure. Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics combined with amyloid plaque imaging reveal that oligodendrocytes in plaque-dense regions show pathological changes in calcium signaling, immune activation, lipid remodeling, and protein catabolic pathways. Notably, MBP protein is reduced despite elevated myelin-related transcription, suggesting plaque-induced degradation of myelin proteins. Consistent with this, proteasomal inhibition restores MBP protein levels and improves compact myelin ultrastructure in AD organoids. In human AD brain tissue, protein catabolic pathways are similarly upregulated with increasing plaque density. Together, these findings identify plaque-associated oligodendrocyte proteostatic failure as a candidate mechanism of myelin loss and a potential therapeutic pathway in AD.
abstractZh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）以淀粉样-β斑块和tau病理为特征，但早期且有临床意义的髓鞘丢失的机制仍未明确。在此，我们报道了人诱导多能干细胞来源的前脑类器官，其具有多西环素诱导的SOX10、OLIG2和NKX6-2（SON）表达，可在体外和体内生成成熟、致密的少突胶质细胞和致密髓鞘。引入淀粉样前体蛋白（APP）致病性突变可产生细胞外淀粉样-β斑块和磷酸化tau，同时伴有髓鞘碱性蛋白（MBP）表达减少和髓鞘超微结构破坏。单细胞和空间转录组学结合淀粉样斑块成像显示，斑块密集区域的少突胶质细胞在钙信号、免疫激活、脂质重塑和蛋白质分解代谢途径中表现出病理变化。值得注意的是，尽管髓鞘相关转录升高，MBP蛋白却减少，提示斑块诱导的髓鞘蛋白降解。与此一致，蛋白酶体抑制可恢复AD类器官中MBP蛋白水平并改善致密髓鞘超微结构。在人类AD脑组织中，蛋白质分解代谢途径同样随斑块密度增加而上调。总之，这些发现将斑块相关少突胶质细胞蛋白质稳态失衡确定为髓鞘丢失的候选机制，并作为AD的潜在治疗途径。

title: Generation of hypoimmunogenic gastric insulin-secreting organoids
titleZh: 生成低免疫原性胃胰岛素分泌类器官
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Dattoli AA, Brown ME, Pearson B, Feinstein Z, Lan Y, Polavarapu V, Zhou M, Nachman R, Kelemen Y, Rafii S, Creusot RJ, Brusko TM, Zhou Q, Huang X.
abstract:
Summary

  Gastric insulin-secreting organoids (GINS) represent a promising source of β-like cells for type 1 diabetes (T1D) therapy. In same-donor comparisons with induced pluripotent stem cell-derived islets (iPSC-islets), GINS displayed robust glucose responsiveness and reduced expression of key T1D autoantigens. Importantly, GINS exhibited decreased susceptibility to cytotoxicity mediated by engineered HLA-matched preproinsulin-specific effector T cells (Avatar Teffs) and a distinct transcriptional profile enriched for immune-modulatory and stress-adaptive gene programs. To enhance immune evasion, we engineered gastric stem cells to overexpress Programmed Death Ligand 1 (PD-L1) in an inducible manner. PD-L1  + GINS maintained normal functionality, while exhibiting improved survival under allogeneic Avatar Teff challenge in a MHC class I-independent fashion. We evaluated PD-L1-mediated protection against autologous Avatar Teff attack using an endothelialized microfluidic platform recapitulating physiologic immune interactions. T cells show reduced infiltration into PD-L1⁺ GINS, resulting in significantly higher organoid viability compared to control GINS. Together, these findings identify GINS as a functional and engineerable β-like cell platform with intrinsic hypoimmunogenic features, and support PD-L1 engineering as a strategy to enhance immune protection for both allogeneic and autologous transplantation in T1D.
abstractZh:
摘要

胃胰岛素分泌类器官（GINS）代表了1型糖尿病（T1D）治疗中一种有前景的β样细胞来源。在与同供体诱导多能干细胞来源胰岛（iPSC-胰岛）的比较中，GINS表现出稳健的葡萄糖反应性，并降低了关键T1D自身抗原的表达。重要的是，GINS对由HLA匹配的前胰岛素特异性效应T细胞（Avatar Teffs）介导的细胞毒性表现出较低的易感性，并具有富含免疫调节和应激适应基因程序的独特转录谱。为了增强免疫逃逸，我们改造了胃干细胞，使其以诱导方式过表达程序性死亡配体1（PD-L1）。PD-L1⁺ GINS保持了正常功能，同时在异体Avatar Teff攻击下以不依赖MHC I类的方式表现出改善的存活率。我们使用内皮化的微流控平台评估了PD-L1介导的针对自体Avatar Teff攻击的保护作用，该平台重现了生理性免疫相互作用。T细胞向PD-L1⁺ GINS的浸润减少，与对照GINS相比，类器官活力显著提高。总之，这些发现将GINS确定为一个功能性和可工程化的β样细胞平台，具有内在的低免疫原性特征，并支持将PD-L1工程化作为增强T1D中同种异体和自体移植免疫保护的策略。

abstract: In embryos, intrinsic and extrinsic signals cooperatively shape cellular decisions to form tissues and organs. Developmental engineering seeks to harness insights into the molecular mechanisms governing embryonic development and leverage pluripotent stem cells to enable the synthetic reconstitution of organ-like multicellular systems in vitro, including organoids. These cellular systems can partially emulate the complexity of in vivo organs in terms of structure and function, facilitating disease modeling and regenerative medicine applications. Nonetheless, the field faces challenges, such as ensuring reproducibility and achieving adult-level maturation. In this Review, we discuss liver development in the human embryo and current models that are routinely used for generating liver organoids in vitro as well as their limitations. Next, we discuss how synthetic biology and computational analyses can be integrated to enhance organoids, particularly liver organoids, by promoting vascularization, establishing zonation, refining fate specification and enabling responsiveness to external cues. Together, these approaches pave the way for next-generation multicellular human stem cell-derived systems.
abstractZh: 在胚胎中，内在和外在信号协同塑造细胞决策，以形成组织和器官。发育工程旨在利用对胚胎发育分子机制的深入了解，并利用多能干细胞，在体外实现类器官样多细胞系统的合成重建，包括类器官。这些细胞系统可以在结构和功能上部分模拟体内器官的复杂性，促进疾病建模和再生医学应用。尽管如此，该领域仍面临挑战，例如确保可重复性和实现成体水平的成熟。在本综述中，我们讨论了人类胚胎中的肝脏发育以及目前常规用于体外生成肝脏类器官的模型及其局限性。接下来，我们讨论了如何整合合成生物学和计算分析来增强类器官，特别是肝脏类器官，通过促进血管化、建立分区、细化命运特化并使其能够响应外部线索。总之，这些方法为下一代多细胞人类干细胞衍生系统铺平了道路。

title: A Label-Free Ultraviolet Photoacoustic Microscopy Enables Nuclear Imaging and Toxicity Assessment in an Intact Brain Organoid.
titleZh: 一种无标记紫外光声显微镜实现完整脑类器官的细胞核成像与毒性评估

abstract: Fetal alcohol spectrum disorders (FASDs) are caused by prenatal exposure to ethanol (EtOH), leading to developmental brain abnormalities. Cortical organoids derived from human-induced pluripotent stem cells provide physiologically relevant models to study such neurotoxic effects. However, accurate imaging of nuclear morphology, a key indicator of cytotoxicity and developmental impairment, remains difficult. Traditional fluorescence-based techniques rely on staining and sectioning, limiting throughput and potentially altering native structures. Herein, we present an ultraviolet photoacoustic microscopy system that targets endogenous nucleic acids at 266 nm excitation, resulting in a lateral resolution of 278 nm, which is sufficient to resolve individual nuclei in situ. The system integrates precise z-axis scanning for focal-plane alignment, enabling high-resolution depth-resolved imaging of subvolumes within 3D intact live organoids without physical sectioning. Using EtOH-treated cortical organoids as a model of FASD-associated neurotoxicity, we observed significant reductions in nuclear area, diameter, and circularity by 46.1%, 20.8%, and 6.0%, respectively, indicating structural damage consistent with apoptosis and impaired neurodevelopment. This method is the first to demonstrate label-free nuclear imaging in intact live brain organoids, providing a robust and preparation-free platform for probing disease-relevant phenotypes, accelerating drug screening, and enabling early toxicity assessments in neurodevelopmental disorder models.
abstractZh: 胎儿酒精谱系障碍（FASDs）由产前暴露于乙醇（EtOH）引起，导致发育性脑异常。源自人诱导多能干细胞的大脑皮层类器官为研究此类神经毒性效应提供了生理相关模型。然而，细胞核形态（细胞毒性和发育损伤的关键指标）的精确成像仍然困难。传统的基于荧光的技术依赖染色和切片，限制了通量并可能改变天然结构。在此，我们提出一种紫外光声显微镜系统，以266 nm激发波长靶向内源性核酸，横向分辨率为278 nm，足以在原位分辨单个细胞核。该系统集成了精确的z轴扫描以实现焦平面校准，从而无需物理切片即可对3D完整活体类器官内的亚体积进行高分辨率深度分辨成像。使用EtOH处理的皮层类器官作为FASD相关神经毒性的模型，我们观察到细胞核面积、直径和圆度分别显著减少46.1%、20.8%和6.0%，表明与细胞凋亡和神经发育受损一致的结构损伤。该方法首次在完整活体脑类器官中实现无标记细胞核成像，为探测疾病相关表型提供了稳健且免制备的平台，加速药物筛选，并能在神经发育障碍模型中实现早期毒性评估。

title: Recent advancements and limitations of intestinal organoids for clinical applications.
titleZh: 肠道类器官在临床应用中的最新进展与局限性。
