abstract: Lineage plasticity has emerged as a fundamental mechanism of adaptive therapy resistance in prostate and bladder cancers, enabling malignant cells to bypass lineage-restricted dependencies through non-genetic reprogramming. However, plasticity is often studied as a terminal phenotype rather than as a dynamic process that unfolds over time. The endpoint-centered view can obscure the early and potentially reversible events that initiate identity loss, as well as the intermediate states through which resistant phenotypes emerge. In this review, we propose a phse-based framework for modeling lineage plasticity in genitourinary cancers. We conceptualize plasticity as a temporally ordered trajectory comprising three phases: priming, transition, and stabilization. We examine how commonly used near-patient experimental and computational platforms, including patient-derived organoids (PDOs), patient-derived xenografts (PDXs), genetically engineered mouse models (GEMMs), and artificial intelligence-based approaches, tend to sample different portions of this trajectory. By mapping these model systems to the phases, they are best equipped to simulate, we demonstrate how a phase-aware approach can resolve long-standing discrepancies in the literature and clarify the gene-regulatory logic underlying tumor identity shifts. Ultimately, this framework provides a roadmap for integrating cross-platform insights to identify critical "windows of vulnerability," informing novel strategies for the early therapeutic interception of lineage-driven resistance before it reaches a terminal, irreversible state.
abstractZh: 谱系可塑性已成为前列腺癌和膀胱癌适应性治疗耐药的基本机制，使恶性细胞能够通过非遗传重编程绕过谱系限制性依赖。然而，可塑性通常被视为终末表型，而非随时间展开的动态过程。以终点为中心的观点可能掩盖启动身份丢失的早期且可能可逆的事件，以及耐药表型出现的中间状态。在本综述中，我们提出了一个基于阶段的框架，用于模拟泌尿生殖系统癌症中的谱系可塑性。我们将可塑性概念化为一个时间有序的轨迹，包括三个阶段：启动、转变和稳定。我们研究了常用的近患者实验和计算平台，包括患者来源的类器官（PDOs）、患者来源的异种移植瘤（PDXs）、基因工程小鼠模型（GEMMs）和基于人工智能的方法，如何倾向于采样该轨迹的不同部分。通过将这些模型系统映射到它们最适合模拟的阶段，我们展示了阶段感知方法如何解决文献中长期存在的差异，并阐明肿瘤身份转变背后的基因调控逻辑。最终，该框架为整合跨平台见解提供了路线图，以识别关键的“脆弱窗口”，为在谱系驱动的耐药达到终末、不可逆状态之前进行早期治疗拦截提供新策略。

title: Synthetic PEG-4MAL Hydrogels Support Patient-Derived Human Intestinal Enteroid Culture.
titleZh: 合成PEG-4MAL水凝胶支持患者来源的人肠道类器官培养。

abstract: Patient-derived intestinal enteroids are valuable models for studying gastrointestinal physiology and disease, but their dependence on Matrigel™ limits reproducibility and clinical translation. Here, we developed a fully synthetic poly(ethylene glycol)-4-maleimide (PEG-4MAL) hydrogel platform to support human intestinal enteroid culture. Guided by enteroid transcriptomics revealing high expression of α2β1 integrin and matrix metalloproteinases, we systematically evaluated collagen-mimetic GFOGER and fibronectin-derived RGD (Arg-Gly-Asp) peptides combined with four MMP-sensitive crosslinkers. GFOGER-functionalized hydrogels significantly outperformed RGD formulations across all metrics. The optimized PEG-4MAL-GFOGER formulation demonstrated enteroid formation efficiency and viability approaching Matrigel™ performance. Bulk RNA-sequencing across multiple patient-derived lines demonstrated transcriptomic similarity between synthetic and Matrigel™ hydrogels, with preservation of stem cell, differentiation, and regional identity markers. This rationally designed synthetic platform overcomes key limitations of biological matrices while supporting robust enteroid growth and functionality comparable to standard biological matrices.
abstractZh: 患者来源的肠道类器官是研究胃肠生理和疾病的重要模型，但它们对Matrigel™的依赖限制了可重复性和临床转化。在此，我们开发了一种全合成的聚乙二醇-4-马来酰亚胺（PEG-4MAL）水凝胶平台，以支持人肠道类器官的培养。通过类器官转录组学揭示α2β1整合素和基质金属蛋白酶的高表达，我们系统评估了胶原模拟肽GFOGER和纤连蛋白来源的RGD（精氨酸-甘氨酸-天冬氨酸）肽与四种MMP敏感交联剂的组合。GFOGER功能化水凝胶在所有指标上均显著优于RGD配方。优化的PEG-4MAL-GFOGER配方显示出接近Matrigel™性能的类器官形成效率和活力。跨多个患者来源细胞系的批量RNA测序表明，合成水凝胶与Matrigel™水凝胶之间具有转录组相似性，并保留了干细胞、分化和区域身份标志物。这种合理设计的合成平台克服了生物基质的关键局限性，同时支持与标准生物基质相当的稳健类器官生长和功能。

title: Molecular Diagnosis to Individualized Therapies in Rare Genetic Diseases: New Approach Methodologies, RNA Therapeutics, and the Case for a Human-First Filter.
titleZh: 罕见遗传病分子诊断到个体化治疗：新方法学、RNA疗法及人源优先过滤器的论证。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Anwar S, Yokota T.
affiliations: Department of Medical Genetics, Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry, University of Alberta, Edmonton, AB T6G 2H7, Canada.

abstract: Rare genetic diseases are heterogeneous across mechanisms, trajectories, and treatment responses. To date, approved therapies remain available for only a small proportion of rare genetic diseases. Oligonucleotide-based RNA therapeutics, particularly antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) and small interfering RNAs (siRNAs), offer a promising therapeutic avenue for rare genetic diseases with sequence-level precision. However, traditional preclinical paths may mis-predict human outcomes when disease biology diverges from animal models. New approach methodologies (NAMs), including patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs), organoid models, and clinical-trials-in-a-dish (CTiD), aim to bring human biology earlier into the translational pipeline. NAMs enable variant-to-function studies, efficacy screening, and safety triage at clinically relevant speed and scale. While critics argue that NAMs are unvalidated and cannot replace preclinical animal models, proponents report that they are increasingly able to recapitulate human phenotypes and predict clinical liabilities, although their predictive validity remains context-dependent. Here, a front-loaded human filter refers to the use of human-derived systems early in development to support mechanistic interpretation, candidate prioritization, and early liability assessment before broader nonclinical evaluation. Recent studies pairing NAMs with ASOs support rapid, patient-specific preclinical screening in selected settings, while also showing the need for broader evidence on delivery, pharmacology, safety, and clinical relevance. This review places these developments within the translational realities of oligonucleotide-based therapeutics, including model fidelity, ASO chemistry and optimization, delivery challenges, pharmacology, regulatory pathways for individualized ASOs, and accessibility. We also propose a pragmatic validation framework to assess the scientific and translational credibility of NAMs across rare genetic diseases.
abstractZh: 罕见遗传病在机制、病程和治疗反应上具有异质性。迄今为止，获批疗法仅覆盖少数罕见遗传病。基于寡核苷酸的RNA疗法，特别是反义寡核苷酸（ASOs）和小干扰RNA（siRNAs），为罕见遗传病提供了具有序列级精准度的有前景的治疗途径。然而，当疾病生物学与动物模型存在差异时，传统临床前路径可能错误预测人类结果。新方法学（NAMs），包括患者来源的诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）、类器官模型和“培养皿中的临床试验”（CTiD），旨在将人类生物学更早引入转化管道。NAMs能够在临床相关速度和规模下进行变异-功能研究、疗效筛选和安全性分诊。虽然批评者认为NAMs未经验证且不能替代临床前动物模型，但支持者报告称，它们越来越能够重现人类表型并预测临床风险，尽管其预测有效性仍依赖于具体情境。此处，“前置人源过滤器”指在开发早期使用人源系统，以支持机制解释、候选优先级排序和早期风险评估，然后再进行更广泛的非临床评估。近期将NAMs与ASOs配对的研究支持在选定情境下进行快速、患者特异性的临床前筛选，同时也表明需要更广泛的证据来支持递送、药理学、安全性和临床相关性。本综述将这些进展置于寡核苷酸疗法的转化现实背景下，包括模型保真度、ASO化学和优化、递送挑战、药理学、个体化ASOs的监管路径及可及性。我们还提出了一个务实的验证框架，以评估NAMs在罕见遗传病中的科学和转化可信度。

title: Ischemic preconditioning promotes hepatic differentiation in human liver organoids.
titleZh: 缺血预适应促进人肝类器官的肝细胞分化。

abstract:
Introduction

Liver regeneration is essential for successful outcomes after liver transplantation. However, ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI) remains a major determinant of graft dysfunction that can profoundly affect hepatic regenerative responses. Although ischemic stress has been implicated in both tissue damage and regenerative signaling, its direct impact on progenitor differentiation and hepatocyte maturation remains poorly understood, partly due to the lack of controllable human experimental models. In this study, we investigated how controlled ischemic stress influences hepatocyte differentiation and regenerative signaling using a human liver organoid (HLiO) model.Methods

Organoids were expanded as undifferentiated cultures and subjected to a stepwise differentiation protocol toward hepatocyte-like cells. An in vitro IRI model was generated by exposing organoids to 16 h of cold ischemia (O2 0%) followed by reperfusion under normoxic conditions (O2 20%). Molecular, imaging, and functional analyses were performed to evaluate progenitor status, hepatocyte differentiation, and the release of inflammatory mediators.Results

Differentiation of HLiOs induced a shift from progenitor-associated gene expression toward hepatocyte-specific programs, accompanied by increased albumin secretion and expression of mature markers. Controlled ischemia caused a transient reduction in viability and triggered the release of High Mobility Group Box 1 (HMGB1), Interleukin 1 Beta (IL-1β), Interleukin 8 (IL-8), and Oxidized Low Density Lipoprotein Receptor 1 (LOX-1), followed by recovery during reperfusion. Notably, ischemic preconditioning enhanced hepatocyte maturation, characterized by stronger downregulation of progenitor markers, increased expression of Cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4), Hepatocyte Nuclear Factor 4 Alpha (HNF4A), Alpha-1 Antitrypsin (A1AT), and albumin, and improved functional output compared with standard differentiation.Discussion

These findings suggest that sub-lethal ischemic stress may act as a regenerative stimulus, potentially mediated by a progenitor-associated HMGB1-LOX-1-IL-8 signaling axis. Despite the absence of non-parenchymal liver cells, this organoid platform provides a controllable system to study intrinsic regenerative responses to ischemia, and indicates that appropriately modulated ischemic cues might promote hepatocyte differentiation, and improve graft recovery after liver transplantation.
abstractZh:
引言

肝再生对于肝移植后的成功结局至关重要。然而，缺血再灌注损伤（IRI）仍然是移植物功能障碍的主要决定因素，可深刻影响肝脏的再生反应。尽管缺血应激与组织损伤和再生信号均有关联，但其对祖细胞分化和肝细胞成熟的直接影响仍知之甚少，部分原因是缺乏可控的人体实验模型。在本研究中，我们利用人肝类器官（HLiO）模型，探讨了可控缺血应激如何影响肝细胞分化和再生信号。方法

类器官以未分化状态扩增，并经过逐步分化方案诱导为肝细胞样细胞。通过将类器官暴露于16小时冷缺血（O2 0%）后，在常氧条件（O2 20%）下复灌，建立了体外IRI模型。采用分子、影像和功能分析来评估祖细胞状态、肝细胞分化以及炎症介质的释放。结果

HLiO的分化诱导了从祖细胞相关基因表达向肝细胞特异性程序的转变，伴随白蛋白分泌和成熟标志物表达的增加。可控缺血导致活力短暂降低，并触发高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1）、白细胞介素1β（IL-1β）、白细胞介素8（IL-8）和氧化型低密度脂蛋白受体1（LOX-1）的释放，随后在复灌期间恢复。值得注意的是，与标准分化相比，缺血预适应增强了肝细胞成熟，表现为祖细胞标志物更显著地下调，细胞色素P450 3A4（CYP3A4）、肝细胞核因子4α（HNF4A）、α-1抗胰蛋白酶（A1AT）和白蛋白表达增加，以及功能输出的改善。讨论

这些发现表明，亚致死性缺血应激可能作为再生刺激，可能由祖细胞相关的HMGB1-LOX-1-IL-8信号轴介导。尽管缺乏非实质肝细胞，该类器官平台提供了一个可控系统，用于研究对缺血的固有再生反应，并表明适当调节的缺血信号可能促进肝细胞分化，并改善肝移植后的移植物恢复。

title: Biomimetic gradient hydrogels for osteochondral regeneration: from multi-dimensional design to clinical translation.
titleZh: 用于骨软骨再生的仿生梯度水凝胶：从多维设计到临床转化。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Kim D, Park S, Lee SS.
affiliations: Department of Biomedical Engineering, Dongguk University, Seoul, Republic of Korea.
abstract: Osteochondral defects represent a significant clinical challenge due to the complex, graded architecture of the osteochondral unit and the limited regenerative capacity of articular cartilage. Gradient hydrogels have emerged as a promising class of biomimetic scaffolds that replicate the continuous transitions in structure, mechanics, composition, and biochemistry spanning from cartilage to subchondral bone. This review comprehensively examines recent advances in gradient hydrogel design for osteochondral regeneration. We discuss fundamental design principles encompassing structural porosity gradients, mechanical stiffness gradients (kPa-to-GPa transitions), compositional mineral gradients, and biochemical growth factor gradients, as well as their multi-dimensional integration. Fabrication strategies-including layer-by-layer assembly, 3D bioprinting, microfluidic generation, diffusion-based methods, and injectable in situ systems-are critically compared regarding scalability, precision, and translational potential. Material selection spanning natural polymers (collagen, gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA), hyaluronic acid, silk fibroin), synthetic polymers (polyethylene glycol, polycaprolactone), and polymer-ceramic composites is evaluated alongside crosslinking chemistries enabling spatial control. We examine biological mechanisms through which gradients direct cell fate, including mechanotransduction via Yes-associated protein/transcriptional co-activator with PDZ-binding motif signaling, spatiotemporal growth factor delivery, zone-specific cell migration, immunomodulation, and extracellular vesicle-mediated paracrine signaling. Preclinical evidence from small and large animal models is synthesized, demonstrating superior outcomes for gradient versus uniform scaffolds. Finally, we address current limitations in long-term durability, vascularization, and regulatory pathways, and highlight emerging technologies-4D printing, AI-aided design, organ-on-chip screening, and personalized medicine-that may accelerate clinical translation.
abstractZh: 骨软骨缺损由于骨软骨单元复杂的梯度结构和关节软骨有限的再生能力，构成了重大的临床挑战。梯度水凝胶已成为一类有前景的仿生支架，能够复制从软骨到软骨下骨的结构、力学、组成和生物化学的连续过渡。本综述全面审视了用于骨软骨再生的梯度水凝胶设计的最新进展。我们讨论了基本设计原则，包括结构孔隙率梯度、机械刚度梯度（kPa至GPa过渡）、组成矿物梯度和生化生长因子梯度，以及它们的多维整合。制造策略——包括逐层组装、3D生物打印、微流控生成、基于扩散的方法和可注射原位系统——在可扩展性、精度和转化潜力方面进行了批判性比较。材料选择涵盖天然聚合物（胶原蛋白、甲基丙烯酰化明胶（GelMA）、透明质酸、丝素蛋白）、合成聚合物（聚乙二醇、聚己内酯）以及聚合物-陶瓷复合材料，并与实现空间控制的交联化学一起评估。我们研究了梯度引导细胞命运的生物学机制，包括通过Yes相关蛋白/具有PDZ结合基序的转录共激活因子信号传导的机械转导、时空生长因子递送、区域特异性细胞迁移、免疫调节和细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号传导。综合了小动物和大动物模型的临床前证据，证明梯度支架优于均匀支架的结果。最后，我们讨论了长期耐久性、血管化和监管途径方面的当前局限性，并强调了可能加速临床转化的新兴技术——4D打印、AI辅助设计、器官芯片筛选和个性化医疗。

title: Probing the Ovarian Microenvironment: Methods for Isolation, 2D Culture, and Organoid Culture of Mouse Ovarian Somatic Cells.
titleZh: 探究卵巢微环境：小鼠卵巢体细胞分离、二维培养及类器官培养方法。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Dipali SS, Converse A, Gowett MQ, Zaniker-Gomez EJ, Perry MJ, Duncan FE.
affiliations: Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Feinberg School of Medicine, Northwestern University, Chicago.
Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Feinberg School of Medicine, Northwestern University, Chicago; f-duncan@northwestern.edu.
abstract: The ovary consists of heterogeneous populations of somatic cells, both within the follicle and the surrounding stroma, which are critical to support ovarian function and for the generation of high-quality gametes. We report methods for isolating somatic cells from mouse ovaries, including endothelial, epithelial, steroidogenic, stromal, and immune cells. When these primary ovarian somatic cells are plated and cultured in a traditional 2D culture system, the cellular heterogeneity, organization, as well as cell-cell and cell-matrix interactions typically found in the ovary are lost. Thus, we also describe how to generate mouse ovarian somatic organoids using a scaffold-free approach. These organoids self-assemble, maintain diverse cell populations, and produce extracellular matrix and secreted factors, including cytokines. Organoids can be utilized for co-culture experiments and can be maintained in culture for at least 3 weeks with high viability. Overall, these models enable interrogation of ovarian physiology and pathology from the somatic cell perspective.
abstractZh: 卵巢由异质性的体细胞群体组成，这些细胞既存在于卵泡内，也存在于周围基质中，对于支持卵巢功能和产生高质量配子至关重要。我们报告了从小鼠卵巢中分离体细胞的方法，包括内皮细胞、上皮细胞、类固醇生成细胞、基质细胞和免疫细胞。当这些原代卵巢体细胞在传统的二维培养系统中铺板并培养时，卵巢中典型的细胞异质性、组织结构以及细胞-细胞和细胞-基质相互作用会丧失。因此，我们还描述了如何使用无支架方法生成小鼠卵巢体细胞类器官。这些类器官能够自组装，维持多样化的细胞群体，并产生细胞外基质和分泌因子，包括细胞因子。类器官可用于共培养实验，并可在培养中维持至少3周且具有高活力。总体而言，这些模型使得从体细胞角度探究卵巢生理和病理成为可能。

title: How Physiology and Pharmacology Shape Liver Regeneration: From Molecules and Cells to Trials.
titleZh: 生理学与药理学如何塑造肝脏再生：从分子、细胞到临床试验。
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Lonardo A, Weiskirchen R.
affiliations: Independent Researcher, 41100 Modena, Italy.
Institute of Molecular Pathobiochemistry, Experimental Gene Therapy and Clinical Chemistry (IFMPEGKC), RWTH University Hospital Aachen, D-52074 Aachen, Germany.
abstract: Liver regeneration is a tightly orchestrated compensatory response in which the remaining liver regains mass and function after liver injury or surgical resection. However, it does not fully restore its original anatomy. This process involves sequential priming, proliferative, and termination phases that are controlled by inflammatory cytokines, growth factor signaling, metabolic regulation, and extracellular matrix remodeling. Clinically, regenerative capacity plays a crucial role in situations such as partial hepatectomy, acute liver failure, and chronic liver disease. Unfortunately, it can be compromised by conditions like cirrhosis, steatosis, diabetes, and other systemic or local disorders. Current strategies to improve regeneration, such as portal vein modulation, cell-based therapies, organoid technology, and bioartificial liver support, show promise. However, they are limited by challenges including impaired engraftment, functional immaturity, technical complexity, and scalability restrictions. Against this background, the present review explores the pathophysiological basis of liver regeneration and evaluates the clinical evidence on nutritional and pharmacological interventions aimed at enhancing the natural liver repair mechanisms.
abstractZh: 肝脏再生是一种紧密协调的代偿性反应，在肝损伤或手术切除后，剩余肝脏恢复其质量和功能。然而，它并不能完全恢复其原始解剖结构。这一过程涉及由炎症细胞因子、生长因子信号传导、代谢调节和细胞外基质重塑控制的序贯启动、增殖和终止阶段。临床上，再生能力在部分肝切除术、急性肝衰竭和慢性肝病等情况下起着至关重要的作用。不幸的是，它可能因肝硬化、脂肪变性、糖尿病及其他系统性或局部疾病而受损。目前改善再生的策略，如门静脉调节、细胞疗法、类器官技术和生物人工肝支持，显示出前景。然而，它们受到植入不良、功能不成熟、技术复杂性和可扩展性限制等挑战的制约。在此背景下，本综述探讨了肝脏再生的病理生理学基础，并评估了旨在增强自然肝脏修复机制的营养和药理学干预措施的临床证据。

title: Hemodynamic Disruption Triggers Glomerular Barrier Injury via Endothelial Glycocalyx Degradation in Nephrotic Syndrome
titleZh: 血流动力学紊乱通过内皮糖萼降解触发肾病综合征中的肾小球屏障损伤
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Feng Y, Wang S, Wang Y, Yang M, Miao C, Wang Q, Ding W, Tan H, Luo T, Xu F.
abstract: Abstract    Background  :Nephrotic syndrome (NS) is characterized by severe proteinuria, generalized edema and a hypercoagulable state. The clinical manifestations of NS are well recognized, yet the mechanistic link between renal microhemodynamic disturbance and glomerular filtration barrier (GFB) injury remains poorly defined. Endothelial glycocalyx (EG) serves as a critical vascular mechanosensor and barrier regulator, and its degradation contributes to microcirculatory dysfunction and increased vascular permeability in renal diseases.  Methods  :This study established an integrated platform consisting of an adriamycin (ADR)-induced NS rat model and microphysiological vascular-on-a-chip (VOAC) and glomerulus-on-a-chip (GOAC) systems. In vivo, hemorheological parameters, coagulation function, EG biomarker expression and urinary metabolites were detected, and the therapeutic efficacy of sulodexide was evaluated in NS rats. In vitro, controlled laminar shear stress was applied in VOAC and GOAC models to explore the independent effects of mechanical stimulation on endothelial integrity and GFB permeability.  Results  :ADR-induced NS rats presented prominent hemorheological abnormalities and hypercoagulability, accompanied by significant EG damage characterized by decreased expression of EG-related proteins and increased urinary excretion of glycocalyx metabolites. To further clarify the underlying mechanical mechanism, in vitro VOAC and GOAC models were utilized, and the results confirmed that low shear stress triggered EG shedding, cytoskeletal disorganization, elevated adhesion molecule expression, and eventually increased GFB permeability in a dose-dependent manner. Furthermore, in vivo intervention experiments demonstrated that sulodexide treatment could effectively protect EG structural integrity, ameliorate hemorheological disorders, and restore impaired microvascular barrier function in NS rats.  Conclusions  :EG degradation critically bridges hemodynamic alterations and GFB injury in NS. Organ-on-a-chip systems provide a robust platform for elucidating shear stress-mediated renal barrier dysfunction. This study reveals a plausible pathogenic mechanism of NS and indicates the potential of EG-targeted sulodexide therapy for NS treatment.
abstractZh: 摘要 背景：肾病综合征（NS）以严重蛋白尿、全身性水肿和高凝状态为特征。NS的临床表现已被充分认识，但肾微血流动力学紊乱与肾小球滤过屏障（GFB）损伤之间的机制联系仍不明确。内皮糖萼（EG）作为关键的血管机械感受器和屏障调节器，其降解有助于肾脏疾病中的微循环功能障碍和血管通透性增加。方法：本研究建立了一个综合平台，包括阿霉素（ADR）诱导的NS大鼠模型和微生理血管芯片（VOAC）和肾小球芯片（GOAC）系统。在体内，检测了血液流变学参数、凝血功能、EG生物标志物表达和尿液代谢物，并评估了舒洛地特在NS大鼠中的治疗效果。在体外，在VOAC和GOAC模型中施加受控层流剪切应力，以探索机械刺激对内皮完整性和GFB通透性的独立影响。结果：ADR诱导的NS大鼠表现出显著的血液流变学异常和高凝状态，伴有显著的EG损伤，其特征为EG相关蛋白表达降低和糖萼代谢物尿排泄增加。为进一步阐明潜在的机械机制，使用体外VOAC和GOAC模型，结果证实低剪切应力以剂量依赖性方式触发EG脱落、细胞骨架紊乱、粘附分子表达升高，并最终增加GFB通透性。此外，体内干预实验表明，舒洛地特治疗能有效保护EG结构完整性，改善血液流变学紊乱，并恢复NS大鼠受损的微血管屏障功能。结论：EG降解在NS中关键地桥接血流动力学改变和GFB损伤。器官芯片系统为阐明剪切应力介导的肾屏障功能障碍提供了强大的平台。本研究揭示了NS的一种可能的致病机制，并表明EG靶向的舒洛地特治疗在NS治疗中的潜力。

abstract:
Aim

Many patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) do not derive clinical benefit from immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), and a reliable method for identifying potential responders is lacking. This study aims to establish an optimized patient-derived organoids (PDOs) culture system and develop a novel organoid-peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) co-culture platform to evaluate response to ICIs.Methods

We optimized culture conditions for patient-derived NSCLC organoids by integrating conditional reprogramming techniques. ICIs response was assessed with an organoid-PBMC co-culture system. The accuracy of this ex vivo system was validated by comparing its results with efficacy of ICI therapy in both an in vivo humanized mouse xenograft model and the corresponding patient's clinical response. Moreover, the genomic stability of the organoids during serial passaging was monitored through gene sequencing.Results

An optimal indirect co-culture system was established, culturing organoids with 25% Matrigel. This system consisted of 40 Gy-irradiated Swiss 3T3-J2 fibroblasts in an upper chamber and primary NSCLC cells in a lower chamber, using F-medium (DMEM/F-12 (3:1, v/v) + 10 µM Y-27632) supplemented with 0.5 µM A83-01. This method achieved an 85.59% (95/111) success rate. Using this platform, we evaluated PD-1 antibody efficacy with the organoid-PBMC co-culture system in 70 cases. For in vivo validation, a direct patient-derived organoid xenograft (PDOX) models were established in humanized mice reconstituted with the corresponding patient's PBMCs. Notably, the ex vivo results demonstrated a strong correlation with both the in vivo validation data and patients' actual clinical responses to ICIs, yielding a sensitivity of 100% and a specificity of 62.20%.Conclusion

We developed a novel, simple, rapid and reliable organoid-PBMC co-culture system for screening the response of NSCLC patients to ICI therapy.
abstractZh:
目的

许多非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者未能从免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）中获得临床获益，且缺乏可靠的方法来识别潜在应答者。本研究旨在建立优化的患者来源类器官（PDOs）培养系统，并开发一种新型类器官-外周血单核细胞（PBMC）共培养平台，以评估对ICIs的反应。方法

我们通过整合条件重编程技术，优化了患者来源的NSCLC类器官的培养条件。使用类器官-PBMC共培养系统评估ICIs反应。通过将该体外系统的结果与体内人源化小鼠异种移植模型及相应患者的临床反应进行比较，验证了该体外系统的准确性。此外，通过基因测序监测了类器官在连续传代过程中的基因组稳定性。结果

建立了一种最佳的间接共培养系统，将类器官与25% Matrigel共培养。该系统包括上室中的40 Gy照射的Swiss 3T3-J2成纤维细胞和下室中的原代NSCLC细胞，使用F培养基（DMEM/F-12（3:1，v/v）+ 10 µM Y-27632）并补充0.5 µM A83-01。该方法成功率达到85.59%（95/111）。利用该平台，我们在70例病例中通过类器官-PBMC共培养系统评估了PD-1抗体的疗效。对于体内验证，在用人源化小鼠中重建了相应患者的PBMC，建立了直接的患者来源类器官异种移植（PDOX）模型。值得注意的是，体外结果与体内验证数据及患者对ICIs的实际临床反应显示出强相关性，敏感性为100%，特异性为62.20%。结论

我们开发了一种新型、简单、快速且可靠的类器官-PBMC共培养系统，用于筛选NSCLC患者对ICI治疗的反应。

abstract: Organoids are three-dimensional in vitro models that mimic the anatomical and functional complexity of biological tissues, evolving into a powerful platform for studying human development and disease. Organoid-derived extracellular vesicles have been revealed as important intercellular messengers within organoid systems. Participating in the transport of functional substances such as proteins, lipids, and nucleic acids, these lipid-coated nanometer-scale carriers play a role in regulating biological responses. Unlike extracellular vesicles derived from 2D culture, organoid-derived extracellular vesicles carry tissue-specific molecular information and offer unique advantages in terms of targeting precision and biocompatibility. Strategies for engineering organoid-derived extracellular vesicles-such as loading them with specific drugs, surface-modifying them with targeting ligands, or modulating the microenvironment governing vesicle secretion-are currently being extensively explored to enhance their therapeutic potential and targeting capabilities. At the same time, the specific genetic instructions carried by organoid-derived extracellular vesicles hold great promise for early disease diagnosis and prognosis assessment. However, urgent challenges remain, including the heterogeneity of organoids and their in vivo microenvironments, low efficiency in vesicle isolation and purification, and the lack of established standardized production and quality control systems. This paper focuses on two potential applications of organoid-derived extracellular vesicles: as novel therapeutic agents and as tools for improving disease models. It also explores their application prospects in targeted drug delivery, regenerative medicine, and biomarker identification, with the aim of providing insights and guidance for research on the use of organoid-derived extracellular vesicles as multifunctional platforms and carriers in precision medicine.
abstractZh: 类器官是模拟生物组织解剖和功能复杂性的三维体外模型，已发展成为研究人类发育和疾病的有力平台。类器官来源的细胞外囊泡已被揭示为类器官系统内重要的细胞间信使。这些脂质包被的纳米级载体参与蛋白质、脂质和核酸等功能性物质的运输，在调节生物反应中发挥作用。与二维培养来源的细胞外囊泡不同，类器官来源的细胞外囊泡携带组织特异性分子信息，并在靶向精度和生物相容性方面具有独特优势。工程化类器官来源的细胞外囊泡的策略——例如装载特定药物、用靶向配体进行表面修饰，或调节控制囊泡分泌的微环境——目前正在广泛探索，以增强其治疗潜力和靶向能力。同时，类器官来源的细胞外囊泡携带的特定遗传指令对早期疾病诊断和预后评估具有巨大前景。然而，仍然存在紧迫的挑战，包括类器官及其体内微环境的异质性、囊泡分离和纯化效率低，以及缺乏既定的标准化生产和质量控制体系。本文重点关注类器官来源的细胞外囊泡的两个潜在应用：作为新型治疗剂和作为改进疾病模型的工具。它还探讨了它们在靶向药物递送、再生医学和生物标志物鉴定中的应用前景，旨在为类器官来源的细胞外囊泡作为精准医学中的多功能平台和载体的研究提供见解和指导。

abstract: High content imaging is being applied to achieve quantitative fluorescence readouts in increasingly complex 3-dimensional (3D) cell culture models such as spheroids and organoids. Compared to conventional 2D assays, 3D assays better represent biological heterogeneity but require more complex sample preparation, 3D imaging and 3D image analysis that can affect the accuracy and precision of such assays. We used spheroids formed from the NRAS-activated melanoma cell line 19161 modified to express an ERK kinase translocation reporter (KTR) as an exemplar 3D phenotypic assay carried out in 96-well plates. The spheroids were treated with the ERK activator TPA and a range of concentrations of the MEK inhibitor Binimetinib. 3D live-cell imaging with sub-cellular spatial resolution was performed using a dual-view oblique plane microscope (dOPM) – a form of single-objective light-sheet microscope – and the experiment was performed separately at 4 different institutes. The results were analysed using an identical 3D analysis pipeline and parameters. We assessed the variation in assay readout using a linear mixed effects model. Random variance at the well level was negligible (SD = 0.0048 relative to range of KTR biosensor readout at reference site of 0.17), indicating low technical noise. Treatment effects were dose-dependent and highly statistically significant compared to DMSO control across all sites (Dunnett-corrected  p < 0.001). The range in KTR readout between the minimum (3.5 μM Binimetinib) and maximum (100 nM TPA) treatments varied between 59 to 96% relative to the reference site. Measured bias in KTR readout between sites was between 6 and 12% of the range of the reference site. This study quantifies the reproducibility of a 3D live spheroid-based assay employing a fluorescence biosensor requiring readout out at the per-cell level using the dOPM platform and discusses areas where experimental protocol could be improved in the future to further improve reproducibility.
abstractZh: 高内涵成像正被应用于在越来越复杂的三维（3D）细胞培养模型（如球体和类器官）中实现定量荧光读数。与传统的二维检测相比，三维检测能更好地代表生物异质性，但需要更复杂的样品制备、三维成像和三维图像分析，这些都可能影响此类检测的准确性和精密度。我们使用由NRAS激活的黑色素瘤细胞系19161（经修饰表达ERK激酶易位报告基因（KTR））形成的球体，作为在96孔板中进行的示例性三维表型检测。球体用ERK激活剂TPA和一系列浓度的MEK抑制剂Binimetinib处理。使用双视角斜平面显微镜（dOPM）——一种单物镜光片显微镜——进行具有亚细胞空间分辨率的三维活细胞成像，实验在4个不同的研究所分别进行。结果使用相同的三维分析流程和参数进行分析。我们使用线性混合效应模型评估检测读数的变异性。孔水平的随机方差可忽略不计（SD = 0.0048，相对于参考位点KTR生物传感器读数的范围0.17），表明技术噪声低。处理效应呈剂量依赖性，且在所有位点与DMSO对照相比具有高度统计学显著性（Dunnett校正p < 0.001）。KTR读数在最低（3.5 μM Binimetinib）和最高（100 nM TPA）处理之间的范围相对于参考位点变化为59%至96%。各站点间KTR读数的测量偏倚在参考位点范围的6%至12%之间。本研究量化了使用dOPM平台、需要单细胞水平读数的荧光生物传感器进行三维活体球体检测的可重复性，并讨论了未来可改进实验方案以进一步提高可重复性的领域。

abstract:
Background

Precision oncology aims to tailor treatment according to tumor-specific molecular alterations, but the success of aberration-guided therapies has been limited in clinical trials. Here, we develop an integrated whole-genome and transcriptome workflow to systematically distinguish functionally credible, predictive driver aberrations from non-functional alterations across all classes of genomic events.Methods

We applied the integrated omics workflow to 335 patients with ovarian high-grade serous carcinoma (HGSC) enrolled in the observational DECIDER study. Tumor samples were collected from multiple cancer sites as part of the standard cancer care. DNA and RNA were extracted together from snap-frozen tumor samples and sent to whole-genome and transcriptome sequencing. Sequencing data were processed with the Anduril 2 pipeline for detection and validation of short somatic changes and with the HMW toolkit and the nf-core/rnafusion pipeline for assessment of structural changes. Aberration-specific drug sensitivity was tested in patient-derived organoids with a drug screen combining targeted agents and chemotherapy.Results

Using an agnostic integrated omics analysis, we identified clinically relevant ESCAT Tier II-III alterations in more than 40% of the patients, even though 58% of all nominally pathogenic variants proved to be false positives. Credible aberrations were predominantly clonal, detected across anatomical sites, and preserved from diagnosis to relapse, indicating early establishment during tumor evolution. The most recurrent actionable event was NF1 deficiency, which was associated with a robust transcriptional footprint and marked sensitivity to KRAS- and MEK-inhibition in patient-derived organoids. Notably, integrated DNA-RNA analysis enabled discrimination of treatment-guiding aberrations from false-positive findings that would otherwise misinform treatment selection and confound clinical trial outcomes.Conclusions

Our findings provide a strategy for more reliable biomarker detection in precision oncology, inform biomarker-guided clinical trial design, and reveal unexploited therapeutic vulnerabilities in HGSC.
abstractZh:
背景

精准肿瘤学旨在根据肿瘤特异性分子改变来定制治疗，但在临床试验中，基于畸变的指导性疗法的成功有限。在此，我们开发了一个整合的全基因组和转录组工作流程，以系统地区分所有类型基因组事件中功能可信的、预测性的驱动畸变与非功能性改变。方法

我们将这一整合组学工作流程应用于观察性DECIDER研究中入组的335例卵巢高级别浆液性癌（HGSC）患者。作为标准癌症治疗的一部分，从多个癌症部位采集肿瘤样本。从速冻肿瘤样本中同时提取DNA和RNA，并送往全基因组和转录组测序。测序数据使用Anduril 2流程进行短体细胞改变的检测和验证，并使用HMW工具包和nf-core/rnafusion流程评估结构改变。在患者来源的类器官中，通过结合靶向药物和化疗的药物筛选，测试了畸变特异性药物敏感性。结果

使用无偏倚的整合组学分析，我们在超过40%的患者中识别出临床相关的ESCAT II-III级改变，尽管所有名义上致病的变异中有58%被证明是假阳性。可信的畸变主要是克隆性的，在解剖部位间可检测到，并从诊断到复发得以保留，表明其在肿瘤进化早期就已建立。最常复发的可操作事件是NF1缺陷，其与稳健的转录足迹以及患者来源类器官中对KRAS和MEK抑制的显著敏感性相关。值得注意的是，整合的DNA-RNA分析能够区分治疗指导性畸变与假阳性发现，否则这些假阳性发现会误导治疗选择并混淆临床试验结果。结论

我们的发现为精准肿瘤学中更可靠的生物标志物检测提供了策略，为生物标志物指导的临床试验设计提供了信息，并揭示了HGSC中未被利用的治疗脆弱性。

abstract:
Purpose

To develop and validate a cartilage organoid (CO)-laden digital light processing (DLP) bioprinting strategy for auricular reconstruction and to compare its performance with conventional chondrocyte-laden prints.Materials and methods

Rat bone-marrow stromal cells (BMSCs) were aggregated into spheroid and chondrogenically induced to form CO. Organoid construction and characterization included EdU proliferation assay, CD73/CD90 immunofluorescence (IF), and real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) of chondrogenic genes. O-nitrobenzyl functionalized gelatin (GelNB)/ methacrylated hyaluronic acid (HAMA) bioinks were screened by gross morphology, tensile/ compressive mechanics, enzymatic degradability (0.1% collagenase II), and swelling, identifying 10% (w/v) GelNB + 1% (w/v) HAMA as the working bioink. Full-scale ears were DLP-printed from acellular, chondrocyte-laden, or CO-laden inks. In vitro, whole-mount Live/Dead imaging was performed at 7/14/21 days and qPCR quantified COL2A1, aggrecan (ACAN), COL10A1. In vivo, constructs were implanted subcutaneously in nude mice and analyzed at 4/8 weeks by Hematoxylin-eosin (H&E), Safranin O/Fast Green, ACAN and COL II IHC staining, and compressive Young's modulus measurement on implants.Results

The 10% GelNB + 1% HAMA ink balanced print fidelity, mechanical robustness, and controlled degradability. Loading CO did not impair printability. During 21-day culture, viability remained high; at day 21, CO-laden ears showed higher COL2A1/ACAN and lower COL10A1 than chondrocyte-laden controls. After implantation, CO-laden explants exhibited more abundant lacuna-like cartilage morphology, stronger ACAN and COL II staining, increased EVG-positive elastic fiber-associated matrix, and a higher compressive Young's modulus at 8 weeks.Conclusions

CO-laden DLP bioprinting enhances chondrogenesis and mitigates hypertrophy versus chondrocyte-laden printing, offering an exploratory high-fidelity strategy for auricular cartilage-like tissue engineering rather than definitive mature elastic cartilage regeneration.
abstractZh:
目的

开发并验证一种用于耳廓重建的负载软骨类器官（CO）的数字光处理（DLP）生物打印策略，并将其性能与传统的负载软骨细胞的打印进行比较。材料与方法

将大鼠骨髓基质细胞（BMSCs）聚集成球体，并进行软骨诱导以形成CO。类器官构建与表征包括EdU增殖实验、CD73/CD90免疫荧光（IF）以及软骨形成基因的实时定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）。通过大体形态、拉伸/压缩力学性能、酶降解性（0.1% II型胶原酶）和溶胀性筛选邻硝基苄基功能化明胶（GelNB）/甲基丙烯酰化透明质酸（HAMA）生物墨水，确定10%（w/v）GelNB + 1%（w/v）HAMA为工作生物墨水。使用无细胞、负载软骨细胞或负载CO的墨水进行全尺寸耳朵的DLP打印。体外实验中，在第7/14/21天进行整体Live/Dead成像，并通过qPCR定量COL2A1、聚集蛋白聚糖（ACAN）、COL10A1。体内实验中，将构建体皮下植入裸鼠，并在第4/8周通过苏木精-伊红（H&E）、番红O/固绿、ACAN和COL II免疫组化染色以及植入物的压缩杨氏模量测量进行分析。结果

10% GelNB + 1% HAMA墨水在打印保真度、机械稳健性和可控降解性之间取得了平衡。负载CO不影响可打印性。在21天培养期间，细胞活力保持较高；在第21天，负载CO的耳朵显示出比负载软骨细胞的对照组更高的COL2A1/ACAN和更低的COL10A1。植入后，负载CO的移植物表现出更丰富的腔隙样软骨形态、更强的ACAN和COL II染色、增加的EVG阳性弹性纤维相关基质，以及在8周时更高的压缩杨氏模量。结论

与负载软骨细胞的打印相比，负载CO的DLP生物打印增强了软骨形成并减轻了肥大，为耳廓软骨样组织工程提供了一种探索性的高保真策略，而非确定性的成熟弹性软骨再生。

abstract:
Background

Schizophrenia, a highly heritable neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by core clinical symptoms such as hallucination, remains poorly understood its polygenic pathogenesis.Methods

We selected 11 key schizophrenia risk genes and generated single-gene-knockout-precise-dorsal/ventral-forebrain-organoids via CRISPR-Cas9 system to investigate the polygenic effects of these schizophrenia risk genes on forebrain development via bulk and scRNA-sequencing, multi-electrode array recording and knockout mouse model.Results

We found that knockout of 11 risk genes leads to different levels of deficits in human dorsal/ventral forebrain organoids. Notably, CALN1 knockout significantly impacted pathways involved in forebrain development and the set of prioritized schizophrenia risk genes. Importantly, Caln1-KO mice exhibited a broad spectrum of schizophrenia-like behaviors, encompassing deficits in spatial memory, social ability and pre-pulse inhibition, alongside spontaneous startle behavior, head-twitch response and hallucination-like perception. At the cellular level, Caln1-deficient mice exhibit abnormal spontaneous abrupt burst spiking in mature layer-5 pyramidal neurons of the prefrontal cortex, and snRNA-seq analysis of Caln1-/- mice revealed severe transcriptional and gene network dysregulation in layer-5 excitatory neurons.Conclusions

This study reveals that CALN1 as a pivotal role in schizophrenia risk genes robustly perturb human forebrain development and cause a broad spectrum of schizophrenia behaviors in mice.
abstractZh:
背景

精神分裂症是一种高度遗传性的神经发育障碍，以幻觉等核心临床症状为特征，但其多基因发病机制仍知之甚少。方法

我们选取了11个关键的精神分裂症风险基因，并通过CRISPR-Cas9系统生成了单基因敲除的精确背侧/腹侧前脑类器官，以通过批量及单细胞RNA测序、多电极阵列记录和基因敲除小鼠模型研究这些精神分裂症风险基因对前脑发育的多基因效应。结果

我们发现，敲除11个风险基因会导致人类背侧/腹侧前脑类器官出现不同程度的缺陷。值得注意的是，CALN1敲除显著影响了涉及前脑发育和优先精神分裂症风险基因集的通路。重要的是，Caln1-KO小鼠表现出广泛的精神分裂症样行为，包括空间记忆、社交能力和前脉冲抑制的缺陷，以及自发性惊吓行为、头部抽搐反应和幻觉样感知。在细胞水平上，Caln1缺陷小鼠在前额叶皮层的成熟第5层锥体神经元中表现出异常的自发突发性尖峰放电，而Caln1-/-小鼠的snRNA-seq分析揭示了第5层兴奋性神经元中严重的转录和基因网络失调。结论

这项研究表明，CALN1在精神分裂症风险基因中起着关键作用，强烈扰乱人类前脑发育，并在小鼠中引起广泛的精神分裂症行为。

abstract: The human brain has long served as a blueprint for computation, guiding evolution from early symbolic systems to modern deep learning models. Despite these advances, traditional computing systems remain fundamentally limited in mirroring the remarkable flexibility, parallel processing and energy efficiency of the human brain. To address these limitations, neuromorphic computing was developed, which mimics the architecture and signaling behavior of biological neurons. Building on this foundation, a new frontier is now emerging-organoid intelligence (OI). OI uses lab-grown brain cellular structures, such as living neural organoids with electrical activity, synapse formation and primitive learning, as a substrate for computation. Here we trace the evolution of brain-inspired computing from symbolic logic systems to artificial neural networks, neuromorphic processors and finally biohybrid computers that incorporate living neural structures. We explore the transformative potential of OI along with the substantial technical, biological and ethical challenges it presents.
abstractZh: 人类大脑长期以来一直是计算的蓝图，引导着从早期符号系统到现代深度学习模型的演变。尽管取得了这些进步，传统计算系统在模仿人类大脑非凡的灵活性、并行处理和能源效率方面仍然存在根本性限制。为了解决这些限制，人们开发了神经形态计算，它模仿生物神经元的架构和信号行为。在这一基础上，一个新的前沿领域正在兴起——类器官智能（OI）。OI利用实验室培养的脑细胞结构，如具有电活动、突触形成和原始学习的活体神经类器官，作为计算的基质。在这里，我们追溯了从符号逻辑系统到人工神经网络、神经形态处理器，最终到包含活体神经结构的生物混合计算机的脑启发计算的演变。我们探讨了OI的变革潜力及其带来的重大技术、生物和伦理挑战。

abstract: Human production activities and daily life are the main sources of environmental pollutants, and their potential health impacts have attracted growing attention. Currently, the assessment of environmental pollutant toxicity depends heavily on animal models and some cell culture models. However, these approaches have inherent limitations, such as their inability to recapitulate the in vivo microenvironment and the presence of interspecies differences. Organoids not only recapitulate cell types and tissue structures of human organs, but also exhibit key physiological functions, rendering them ideal alternative models for assessing the health risks of environmental pollutants. In this review, we briefly introduce the development history of organoids as models for environmental pollutant toxicity assessment. Additionally, organoids are categorized by cell sources, and current mainstream organoid culture techniques are systematically summarized. Next, we highlight the application value of typical organoids including lung, brain, cardiac, intestine, liver and kidney organoids in environmental pollutant toxicity assessment. Finally, we thoroughly analyze the strengths and limitations of organoid models for such toxicity testing. Therefore, this review aims to advance organoid technology, and provide new insights into the toxicity assessment of environmental pollutants and the exploration of relevant toxic mechanisms.
abstractZh: 人类生产活动和日常生活是环境污染物的主要来源，其潜在的健康影响日益受到关注。目前，环境污染物毒性评估在很大程度上依赖于动物模型和一些细胞培养模型。然而，这些方法存在固有的局限性，例如无法重现体内微环境以及存在种间差异。类器官不仅重现了人体器官的细胞类型和组织结构，还表现出关键的生理功能，使其成为评估环境污染物健康风险的理想替代模型。在这篇综述中，我们简要介绍了类器官作为环境污染物毒性评估模型的发展历史。此外，根据细胞来源对类器官进行分类，并系统总结了当前主流的类器官培养技术。接下来，我们重点介绍了典型的类器官，包括肺、脑、心脏、肠、肝和肾类器官在环境污染物毒性评估中的应用价值。最后，我们深入分析了类器官模型用于此类毒性测试的优势和局限性。因此，本综述旨在推进类器官技术，并为环境污染物的毒性评估及相关毒性机制的探索提供新的见解。

abstract: Metastasis, which occurs when cancer cells spread from their original site in the body to other organs - is the leading cause of death in cancer patients. Conventional two-dimensional (2D) cell cultures along with orthotopic animal models are widely used to study and develop therapeutics for metastatic cancers. However, 2D cell cultures do not accurately reflect the physiology of real tissues, and the results obtained from the orthotopic animal models cannot always be applied to humans due to the interspecies differences. The recent emergence of human organoid models provides unique opportunities to study the complex cellular interactions in a near-physiological 3D environment. In this study, we have engineered an in vitro melanoma metastasis model using patient-derived melanoma cells and human-induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs)-derived planar neural organoids (PNOs). We investigated metastatic cancer processes such as the growth of melanoma cells, and evaluated the effects of anti-cancer drug treatment on it. Our results demonstrated that the 3D PNO system served as a more effective in vitro model than conventional 2D cultures to study melanoma brain metastases, and this PNO system can also be used to model other types of poorly understood metastatic cancers under physiological environments.
abstractZh: 转移，即癌细胞从体内原发部位扩散到其他器官，是癌症患者死亡的主要原因。传统的二维（2D）细胞培养以及原位动物模型被广泛用于研究和开发转移性癌症的治疗方法。然而，2D细胞培养不能准确反映真实组织的生理学，且由于物种间差异，从原位动物模型获得的结果并不总能适用于人类。近年来人类类器官模型的出现，为在接近生理状态的3D环境中研究复杂的细胞相互作用提供了独特的机会。在本研究中，我们利用患者来源的黑色素瘤细胞和人诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）衍生的平面神经类器官（PNOs）构建了一个体外黑色素瘤转移模型。我们研究了转移性癌症过程，如黑色素瘤细胞的生长，并评估了抗癌药物治疗对其的影响。我们的结果表明，3D PNO系统比传统的2D培养更有效地作为研究黑色素瘤脑转移的体外模型，并且该PNO系统也可用于在生理环境下模拟其他类型了解甚少的转移性癌症。

abstract: Brain metastases (BrM) affect up to 30% of patients with solid tumors, yet durable intracranial control remains rare, and the biological drivers of this poor prognosis are incompletely understood. Patient-derived resources, such as clinical cohorts, biobanks, functional ex vivo models, and multi-omic platforms, are central to closing this gap, but their generation and integration face substantial logistical and technical hurdles. Drawing on the RISEbrain consortium's experience, this Perspective examines BrM-focused cohorts and biobanks, highlighting the underused potential of rapid autopsy programs to capture early metastatic seeding. We discuss patient-derived organotypic cultures and emerging organoid-based "avatar" systems as functional platforms for therapeutic profiling, alongside the complementary strengths of bulk and single-cell/-nucleus transcriptomics. We outline how spatial transcriptomics and proteomics are resolving the architecture of the BrM microenvironment, and assess liquid biopsy approaches, including emerging photonic biosensors, for non-invasive monitoring. Together, these resources form an interdependent toolkit whose coordinated deployment will advance early detection, prevention, and precision treatment of BrM.
abstractZh: 脑转移（BrM）影响高达30%的实体瘤患者，然而持久的颅内控制仍然罕见，且对这种不良预后的生物学驱动因素了解不完全。患者来源的资源，如临床队列、生物样本库、功能性离体模型和多组学平台，是弥合这一差距的核心，但其生成和整合面临巨大的后勤和技术障碍。借鉴RISEbrain联盟的经验，本视角审视了聚焦BrM的队列和生物样本库，强调了快速尸检计划在捕获早期转移播种方面未被充分利用的潜力。我们讨论了患者来源的器官型培养和新兴的基于类器官的“替身”系统作为治疗谱分析的功能平台，以及批量与单细胞/单核转录组学的互补优势。我们概述了空间转录组学和蛋白质组学如何解析BrM微环境的架构，并评估了液体活检方法，包括新兴的光子生物传感器，用于非侵入性监测。总之，这些资源形成了一个相互依存的工具包，其协调部署将推进BrM的早期检测、预防和精准治疗。

title: PD-1 signalling restrains pathogenic T peripheral helper and effector CD4⁺ T cell functions in rheumatoid arthritis.

abstract:
Objectives

Inhibitory receptor signalling represents a potential therapeutic strategy in rheumatoid arthritis (RA), but its effects across pathogenic CD4⁺ T cell subsets and T-B cell interactions remain incompletely defined. We aimed to delineate the expression and function of major inhibitory receptors, including PD-1, BTLA, and TIGIT, in RA synovial CD4⁺ T cells and to determine how receptor agonism modulates T cell effector functions and T-B cell interactions.Methods

CD4⁺ T cells were isolated from RA synovial fluid or from tonsils and blood of controls. Cells were cocultured with artificial antigen-presenting cells (murine fibroblast L cells) expressing PD-L2, HVEM, or CD155, and cytokine production was measured by ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay). Three-dimensional organoid cultures were employed to assess PD-L2-mediated regulation of age-associated B cell (ABC) induction by flow cytometry. Single-cell RNA sequencing profiled inhibitory receptor and ligand expression across T cell subsets.Results

PD-1, BTLA, and TIGIT were preferentially expressed on T peripheral helper (Tph) and T follicular helper (Tfh) cells in RA synovium. Engagement of PD-L2 broadly suppressed pathogenic cytokine production across multiple CD4⁺ T cell subsets, including IL(Interleukin)-21 and CXCL13 in Tph cells and TNF (Tumor Necrosis Factor), IFN-γ (Interferon-γ), and IL-2 in PD-1⁺CXCR5⁻ non-Tph cells, with effects abolished by CRISPR (Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats)-mediated PD-1 disruption. PD-L2 also inhibited cytokine production by tonsillar Tfh and non-Tfh cells. In 3-dimensional organoids, PD-L2 significantly reduced the induction of CD11c⁺CD21⁻T-bet⁺ ABCs.Conclusions

PD-1 activation suppresses multiple T cell populations from diverse sites, including Tph cells in RA synovium. These results support the broad potential of PD-1 agonism to suppress pathologic T cell responses in RA.
abstractZh:
目的

抑制性受体信号传导代表了类风湿关节炎（RA）的一种潜在治疗策略，但其对致病性CD4⁺ T细胞亚群和T-B细胞相互作用的影响尚未完全明确。我们旨在描绘RA滑膜CD4⁺ T细胞中主要抑制性受体（包括PD-1、BTLA和TIGIT）的表达和功能，并确定受体激动如何调节T细胞效应功能和T-B细胞相互作用。方法

从RA滑液或对照的扁桃体和血液中分离CD4⁺ T细胞。将细胞与表达PD-L2、HVEM或CD155的人工抗原呈递细胞（小鼠成纤维细胞L细胞）共培养，并通过ELISA（酶联免疫吸附测定）测量细胞因子产生。采用三维类器官培养，通过流式细胞术评估PD-L2介导的年龄相关B细胞（ABC）诱导的调节。单细胞RNA测序分析了T细胞亚群中抑制性受体和配体的表达。结果

PD-1、BTLA和TIGIT在RA滑膜的T外周辅助（Tph）和T滤泡辅助（Tfh）细胞上优先表达。PD-L2的参与广泛抑制了多种CD4⁺ T细胞亚群的致病性细胞因子产生，包括Tph细胞中的IL（白细胞介素）-21和CXCL13，以及PD-1⁺CXCR5⁻非Tph细胞中的TNF（肿瘤坏死因子）、IFN-γ（干扰素-γ）和IL-2，这些效应在CRISPR（成簇规律间隔短回文重复序列）介导的PD-1破坏后被消除。PD-L2还抑制了扁桃体Tfh和非Tfh细胞的细胞因子产生。在三维类器官中，PD-L2显著减少了CD11c⁺CD21⁻T-bet⁺ ABC的诱导。结论

PD-1激活抑制了来自不同部位的多种T细胞群体，包括RA滑膜中的Tph细胞。这些结果支持PD-1激动在抑制RA中病理性T细胞反应方面的广泛潜力。

abstract: The glandular stomach is an important digestive organ, and its proper epithelial development is essential for its normal structure and function. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying its epithelial development remain largely unclear. Here, we employ mouse genetics to reveal that Hippo signaling regulates stomach epithelial development by balancing epithelial proliferation and differentiation. Deletion of Yap reduces epithelial growth in the developing glandular stomach, whereas overexpression of constitutively active Yap promotes its expansion. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and histological analyses further show that Yap enhances gastric epithelial proliferation while suppressing differentiation. Using 3D organoids, we find that Yap directly governs gastric epithelial proliferation and differentiation. Further genetic studies reveal that Mst1/2 deficiency regulates glandular stomach development partially through Yap. Finally, we demonstrate that Yap controls gastric epithelial proliferation and differentiation by modulating cell cycle activity. Overall, our studies demonstrate that Hippo signaling plays an important role in fine-tuning stomach development.
abstractZh: 腺胃是重要的消化器官，其上皮的正常发育对其结构和功能至关重要。然而，其上皮发育的分子机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。在此，我们利用小鼠遗传学揭示Hippo信号通路通过平衡上皮增殖和分化来调节胃上皮发育。Yap的缺失减少了发育中腺胃的上皮生长，而过表达组成性激活的Yap则促进其扩张。单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）和组织学分析进一步表明，Yap增强胃上皮增殖同时抑制分化。利用3D类器官，我们发现Yap直接控制胃上皮的增殖和分化。进一步的遗传学研究表明，Mst1/2缺陷部分通过Yap调节腺胃发育。最后，我们证明Yap通过调节细胞周期活性来控制胃上皮的增殖和分化。总体而言，我们的研究表明Hippo信号通路在微调胃发育中发挥重要作用。

abstract: Mutations in  MYO7A result in the most severe subtype of Usher syndrome, the leading genetic cause of deafblindness. The large size of  MYO7A requires dual adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors for gene transfer or alternative methods to treat retinal defects. Here, we evaluated two treatment approaches: i) Supplementation of the human  MYO7A gene via dual mRNA trans-splicing AAVs, and ii) CRISPR/Cas-mediated activation of the related murine  Myo7b gene. Upon  MYO7A supplementation, the transgenic MYO7A transcript and protein were expressed and correctly localized in retinal pigment epithelial (RPE) and photoreceptors of mice, pigs, and human retinal organoids. In RPE-and photoreceptor-specific  Myo7a knockout mice, we could restore MYO7A expression and localization of melanosomes in RPE cells to wild-type levels.  Myo7b activation led to partial restoration of melanosome localization, and the localization of MYO7B protein was largely comparable to MYO7A. These findings indicate that both approaches are in principle suitable for the therapy of Usher syndrome.
abstractZh: MYO7A基因突变导致最严重的Usher综合征亚型，这是导致耳聋失明的主要遗传原因。MYO7A基因的大尺寸要求使用双腺相关病毒（AAV）载体进行基因转移，或采用其他方法治疗视网膜缺陷。在此，我们评估了两种治疗方法：i）通过双mRNA反式剪接AAV补充人MYO7A基因，以及ii）通过CRISPR/Cas介导激活相关的小鼠Myo7b基因。在MYO7A补充后，转基因MYO7A转录本和蛋白在小鼠、猪和人类视网膜类器官的视网膜色素上皮（RPE）和光感受器中表达并正确定位。在RPE和光感受器特异性Myo7a敲除小鼠中，我们能够将MYO7A表达和RPE细胞中黑素体的定位恢复到野生型水平。Myo7b激活导致黑素体定位的部分恢复，且MYO7B蛋白的定位与MYO7A大体相当。这些发现表明，这两种方法原则上都适用于Usher综合征的治疗。

title: Multi-omics, organoid-based modeling reveals an SRC/mTOR-dependent fetal-like stem cell trajectory in colorectal cancer
titleZh: 多组学、类器官建模揭示结直肠癌中SRC/mTOR依赖的胎儿样干细胞轨迹
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Mulholland T, Aybey B, Li Z, Schwarzmüller L, Rindtorff N, Tondo L, Sui P, Karabati E, Albrecht P, Riedesser JE, Petersen Y, Miersch T, Valentini E, Burgermeister E, Zhan T, Dreikhausen L, Schulte N, Belle S, Wiemann S, Boutros M, Ebert MP, Betge J.
abstract:
Background

  Single-cell atlases have described diverse stem cell states in colorectal cancer (CRC), however, the overarching trajectories of those states and the underlying functional mechanisms, including their relevance for drug sensitivity, need better understanding. Methods

  We established 64 patient-derived organoids from microsatellite-stable colorectal cancers, characterized their transcriptomes and genomes, and performed drug screening with 62-140 clinically approved substances. We analyzed additional published transcriptome data from patient-derived organoids (72 patients from three independent datasets), TCGA-CRC data (466 patients), and single-cell transcriptomes of tumor biopsies (123,000 cells from six independent cohorts) to establish a functional and molecular landscape of CRC stem cells. We performed mechanistic follow-up analyses by mass-spectrometry-based proteomics, large-scale kinase inhibition assays and immunofluorescence analyses. Results

  We find a continuous landscape of CRC stem cells that is characterized by distinct developmental programs: adult stem cell-to fetal-like regenerative states and transition between differentiation programs. By large-scale drug perturbations and multi-omics modeling, we identify a regenerative/fetal-like stem cell trajectory characterized by PI3K/mTOR dependency. We find the identified developmental axes conserved in organoid, clinical, as well as single-cell data, and the fetal-like PI3K/mTOR-dependent state to be associated with poor clinical prognosis. Mechanistically, PI3K/mTOR vulnerability is linked to a lack of adaptive capability due to suppressed mRNA translation and associated with an upregulated SRC signaling network. Conclusions

  Our work moves beyond a molecular CRC landscape by combined functional perturbation analyses in organoids. This enables mechanistic modeling of stem cell state regulation and identifies an SRC/mTOR-dependent regenerative state in CRC, which might allow improved therapeutic targeting in the future.
abstractZh:
背景

  单细胞图谱已描述了结直肠癌（CRC）中多种干细胞状态，然而，这些状态的总体轨迹及其潜在功能机制，包括它们与药物敏感性的相关性，需要更好的理解。方法

  我们从微卫星稳定的结直肠癌中建立了64个患者来源的类器官，表征了它们的转录组和基因组，并使用62-140种临床批准的物质进行了药物筛选。我们分析了额外的已发表患者来源类器官转录组数据（来自三个独立数据集的72名患者）、TCGA-CRC数据（466名患者）以及肿瘤活检的单细胞转录组（来自六个独立队列的123,000个细胞），以建立CRC干细胞的功能和分子景观。我们通过基于质谱的蛋白质组学、大规模激酶抑制测定和免疫荧光分析进行了机制性后续分析。结果

  我们发现了一个连续的CRC干细胞景观，其特征是独特的发育程序：从成体干细胞到胎儿样再生状态以及分化程序之间的转换。通过大规模药物扰动和多组学建模，我们确定了一个以PI3K/mTOR依赖性为特征的再生/胎儿样干细胞轨迹。我们发现所确定的发育轴在类器官、临床以及单细胞数据中保守，并且胎儿样PI3K/mTOR依赖状态与不良临床预后相关。机制上，PI3K/mTOR脆弱性与由于mRNA翻译抑制导致的适应能力缺乏有关，并与上调的SRC信号网络相关。结论

  我们的工作通过类器官中的组合功能扰动分析，超越了分子CRC景观。这使得干细胞状态调控的机制建模成为可能，并确定了CRC中的SRC/mTOR依赖性再生状态，这可能有助于未来改进治疗靶向。

abstract: Human pluripotent stem cell-derived cerebral organoids have emerged as a valuable tool for investigating early brain development and modeling neurodevelopmental disorders. However, considerable variation in both organoid size and cellular composition has been widely reported. Moreover, the large-scale production of organoids using conventional methods is a significant challenge, particularly considering that some stem cell lines exhibit variable efficiency in neuroepithelial formation. This heterogeneity of cerebral organoids can complicate experimental reproducibility and comparability in studies of brain development and disease mechanisms. Therefore, we developed a protocol using CERO 3D bioreactors, which enables scalable organoid production and improves size homogeneity compared to conventional approaches. In addition, we conducted a pilot study, utilizing MS-based proteomic analysis of single organoids from two different lines, aiming to explore whether size variability is associated with differences in protein expression within cerebral organoids. The organoids produced in the CERO 3D bioreactors reproducibly form neuroepithelial structures and express key neurodevelopmental markers. The presented protocol provides an efficient way of producing cerebral organoids, supporting reproducibility and high-throughput applications in neurodevelopmental research.
abstractZh: 人多能干细胞来源的大脑类器官已成为研究早期大脑发育和模拟神经发育障碍的重要工具。然而，已有广泛报道指出类器官在大小和细胞组成上存在显著差异。此外，使用传统方法大规模生产类器官是一个重大挑战，尤其是考虑到一些干细胞系在神经上皮形成方面表现出不同的效率。大脑类器官的这种异质性可能使脑发育和疾病机制研究中的实验可重复性和可比性变得复杂。因此，我们开发了一种使用CERO 3D生物反应器的方案，与传统方法相比，该方案能够实现可扩展的类器官生产并提高大小均匀性。此外，我们进行了一项初步研究，利用基于质谱的蛋白质组学分析来自两个不同细胞系的单个类器官，旨在探讨大小变异性是否与大脑类器官内蛋白质表达的差异相关。在CERO 3D生物反应器中产生的类器官可重复地形成神经上皮结构并表达关键的神经发育标志物。所提供的方案为生产大脑类器官提供了一种高效的方法，支持神经发育研究中的可重复性和高通量应用。

abstract: WOREE and SCAR12 syndromes are rare neurodevelopmental disorders caused by WWOX mutations, severely impairing brain development. The pleiotropic nature of WWOX complicates identifying specific mechanisms, thus, the specific molecular pathways affected by WWOX deficiency and how they contribute to disease pathogenesis remain largely unknown. Using neural organoids derived from a broad iPSC cohort, including wildtype iPSCs, CRISPR-edited isogenic WWOX-knockout lines, and patient-derived lines, we applied molecular profiling and single-cell transcriptomics to map the early neurodevelopmental pathways disrupted upon loss of WWOX. We identified radial glial cells (RGs) as preferentially affected, with disrupted cell cycle dynamics leading to an accumulation of cells in the G2/M and S phases, overexpression of the proto-oncogene MYC, and concomitant reduction in neuronal generation. Patient-derived organoids exhibited milder phenotypes compared to knockout organoids, showing functional neuronal impairments like hyperexcitability and delayed differentiation rather than RG dysfunction. Remarkably, gene therapy restored neuronal function, normalizing hyperexcitability and promoting maturation, without disturbing RG populations. We propose a model in which WWOX mutations impair neurogenesis via RG through cell-type specific dysregulation of the MYC and Wnt signaling pathways. These insights highlight potential therapeutic strategies for WWOX-related disorders and open avenues for interventions targeting these key molecular pathways.
abstractZh: WOREE综合征和SCAR12综合征是由WWOX基因突变引起的罕见神经发育障碍，严重损害大脑发育。WWOX的多效性使得识别特定机制变得复杂，因此，WWOX缺乏所影响的具体分子通路及其如何导致疾病发病机制在很大程度上仍不清楚。利用来自广泛iPSC队列的神经类器官，包括野生型iPSC、CRISPR编辑的同基因WWOX敲除系和患者来源的细胞系，我们应用分子谱分析和单细胞转录组学来绘制WWOX缺失后受干扰的早期神经发育通路。我们确定放射状胶质细胞（RGs）是优先受影响的细胞类型，其细胞周期动力学受到破坏，导致细胞在G2/M期和S期积累，原癌基因MYC过表达，并伴随神经元生成的减少。患者来源的类器官与敲除类器官相比表现出较温和的表型，显示出功能性神经元损伤，如过度兴奋和分化延迟，而非RG功能障碍。值得注意的是，基因治疗恢复了神经元功能，使过度兴奋正常化并促进成熟，而不干扰RG群体。我们提出了一个模型，其中WWOX突变通过细胞类型特异性的MYC和Wnt信号通路失调，经由RG损害神经发生。这些见解突出了WWOX相关疾病的潜在治疗策略，并为针对这些关键分子通路的干预措施开辟了途径。

title: Engineering Human Donor Derived Germinal Center-Like Organoids (GCLOs) for Studying Immune Response to Vaccination.

abstract: Germinal centers (GCs) are transient microanatomical structures that coordinate humoral immune responses through dynamic interactions between antigen presenting cells, T follicular helper cells, and B cells. Despite their central importance to immune protection, GC human biology remains difficult to interrogate due to significant inter-species variability, limited experimental accessibility to primary human tissues, and high interindividual variability. We developed a human immune culture platform that supports spontaneous multicellular organization of human peripheral blood mononuclear cells derived from primary CD19+ B cells, memory CD4+ T cells, and monocyte-derived dendritic cells into Germinal Center-like Organoids (GCLOs). These bioengineered GCLOs self-organize into stable clusters that exhibit stimulus and donor dependent differences in cellular composition and function. We observed the emergence of GC-like T and B cell subsets, functional IgG output, and the appearance of plasmablast-like populations. Notably, the age of the donors and the type of stimuli influenced GCLOs architecture, immune subsets, and antibody output. Platform outputs showed correspondence with clinical vaccine responsiveness across human donors, capturing inter-individual differences in humoral GCLO immune responses to the flu vaccine, including age-associated trends consistent with immunosenescence. This platform allows scalable investigation of human GC-associated immune features and provides a tractable framework for studying donor heterogeneity in humoral immunity.
abstractZh: 生发中心（GCs）是瞬时的微解剖结构，通过抗原呈递细胞、滤泡辅助T细胞和B细胞之间的动态相互作用来协调体液免疫应答。尽管GCs对免疫保护至关重要，但由于显著的物种间差异、原代人组织的实验可及性有限以及高个体间差异，人类GC生物学仍难以探究。我们开发了一种人类免疫培养平台，支持由原代CD19+ B细胞、记忆CD4+ T细胞和单核细胞来源的树突状细胞衍生的人外周血单核细胞自发多细胞组织形成生发中心样类器官（GCLOs）。这些生物工程化的GCLOs自组织成稳定的簇，表现出刺激物和供体依赖的细胞组成和功能差异。我们观察到GC样T细胞和B细胞亚群的出现、功能性IgG输出以及浆母细胞样群体的出现。值得注意的是，供体的年龄和刺激类型影响了GCLOs的结构、免疫亚群和抗体输出。平台输出与人类供体的临床疫苗反应性相对应，捕捉了流感疫苗体液GCLO免疫反应的个体间差异，包括与免疫衰老一致的年龄相关趋势。该平台允许对人类GC相关免疫特征进行可扩展的研究，并为研究体液免疫中的供体异质性提供了一个易处理的框架。

title: An open-source pipeline for longitudinal single-cell tracking and cell-cycle/migration coupling analysis for neurotherapeutic screening.
titleZh: 一种用于纵向单细胞追踪及细胞周期/迁移耦合分析的开源流程，用于神经治疗筛选。

abstract:
Background

Imaging-based phenotypic assays are widely used in neuroprotection, drug discovery, and neurorepair studies, but long-term, high-throughput time-lapse datasets remain difficult to analyze because of segmentation noise, photobleaching, crowded fields, cell division, and tracking errors. Fluorescent ubiquitination-based cell cycle indicator (FUCCI) reporters enable live visualization of cell-cycle phases, but their integration with migration behaviors remains limited. This study aimed to developed an open workflow for tracking cycle and motility.Methods

We combined Fiji/ImageJ preprocessing, Cellpose-based deep learning segmentation, and TrackMate-based cell tracking. FUCCI-expressing HEK293 cells were imaged using a Tecan Spark Cyto (Männedorf, Switzerland) every 15 min for 24 h. Cellpose models were retrained using manually corrected masks from brightfield and fluorescence images, and TrackMate parameters were optimized using manually curated tracks. Statistical analyses were conducted using Paleontological Statistics (PAST) software (version 4.0, Natural History Museum, University of Oslo, Oslo, Norway).Results

Iterative cellpose retraining improved segmentation accuracy in both brightfield and fluorescent datasets by reducing false-positive and false-negative errors (Brightfield Type I error improvement: t(10) = 33.323, p = 1.400 × 10-11, Brightfield Type II error improvement: t(10) = 16.066, p = 1.805 × 10-8, Fluorescent Type II errors: U = 0, p = 0.00077). TrackMate optimization improved trajectory continuity, especially through adjustment of frame-to-frame linking distances (Brightfield: χ 2 (2) = 10, p = 0.00077, Fluorescent: χ 2 (2) = 10, p = 0.00077). The workflow enabled single-cell and population-level analysis of migration distance, turning behavior, morphology, division events, and FUCCI-defined cell-cycle progression. Cells showed heterogeneous motility, with lower displacement trends during green-dominant S/G2/M phases than red-dominant G1 phases.Conclusion

This workflow links cell-cycle state with migration dynamics and can be adapted for neuroprotective screening, neural cultures, organoids, and neuron-glia co-culture studies.
abstractZh:
背景

基于成像的表型分析广泛用于神经保护、药物发现和神经修复研究，但长期、高通量的延时数据集由于分割噪声、光漂白、拥挤视野、细胞分裂和追踪错误而难以分析。荧光泛素化细胞周期指示器（FUCCI）报告基因能够实时可视化细胞周期阶段，但其与迁移行为的整合仍然有限。本研究旨在开发一种用于追踪周期和运动性的开放工作流程。方法

我们结合了Fiji/ImageJ预处理、基于Cellpose的深度学习分割和基于TrackMate的细胞追踪。使用Tecan Spark Cyto（瑞士曼内多夫）每15分钟对表达FUCCI的HEK293细胞进行成像，持续24小时。使用来自明场和荧光图像的手动校正掩膜重新训练Cellpose模型，并使用手动整理的轨迹优化TrackMate参数。使用古生物学统计（PAST）软件（版本4.0，挪威奥斯陆大学自然历史博物馆，奥斯陆，挪威）进行统计分析。结果

迭代的Cellpose重新训练通过减少假阳性和假阴性错误提高了明场和荧光数据集的分割准确性（明场I型错误改进：t(10) = 33.323，p = 1.400 × 10^-11，明场II型错误改进：t(10) = 16.066，p = 1.805 × 10^-8，荧光II型错误：U = 0，p = 0.00077）。TrackMate优化改善了轨迹连续性，特别是通过调整帧间连接距离（明场：χ²(2) = 10，p = 0.00077，荧光：χ²(2) = 10，p = 0.00077）。该工作流程实现了单细胞和群体水平的迁移距离、转向行为、形态、分裂事件和FUCCI定义的细胞周期进程分析。细胞表现出异质性运动性，绿色主导的S/G2/M期比红色主导的G1期具有更低的位移趋势。结论

该工作流程将细胞周期状态与迁移动态联系起来，并可适用于神经保护筛选、神经培养、类器官和神经元-胶质细胞共培养研究。

abstract: Drug repurposing represents a rational and resource-efficient strategy to expand the oncological armamentarium by leveraging the established pharmacology, clinical experience, and safety-monitoring frameworks of approved non-oncological agents. Clozapine (CZP), an atypical antipsychotic characterized by broad receptor pharmacology, complex biotransformation, and clinically relevant toxicological liabilities, has emerged as a candidate of interest following preclinical evidence of context-dependent anticancer activity across multiple tumor types. As such, CZP provides an informative case study at the interface between therapeutic drug action and xenobiotic behavior. This review provides a critical and integrated synthesis of the current evidence supporting the repurposing of CZP in oncology, with particular emphasis on the relationship between its molecular mechanisms, dose-exposure requirements, pharmacological complexity, and potential toxicity. Analysis of in vitro and in vivo studies across glioblastoma, non-small cell lung cancer, breast cancer, and melanoma brain metastasis models indicates that CZP can impair tumor cell proliferation and survival through a form of mechanistic plasticity. Rather than acting through a single conserved pathway, CZP appears to disrupt shared upstream processes related to pro-survival signaling, cellular stress tolerance, and metabolic homeostasis, while engaging tumor-specific downstream responses, including autophagic cell death, mitochondria-dependent apoptosis, oxidative stress, and coordinated modulation of survival and angiogenic pathways. Despite this mechanistic rationale, translation remains substantially constrained, most notably by the order of magnitude gap between anticancer-effective concentrations in vitro and clinically achievable plasma exposures, requiring careful distinction between potentially useful anticancer pharmacology and nonspecific xenobiotic-induced cellular stress and clinically unacceptable toxicity. Key limitations include the discrepancy between anticancer-effective concentrations observed in vitro and exposures achievable during standard psychiatric dosing, the limited understanding of how CZP metabolism and metabolite formation may influence efficacy and toxicity, the absence of integrated pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic and toxicokinetic modeling, and the lack of dedicated clinical trial evidence. To address these challenges, this review examines complementary translational strategies, including patient-derived organoids, co-culture systems, microphysiological platforms, pharmacokinetic and toxicological modeling, and computational digital twin frameworks. Together, these approaches may support a biologically informed and risk-aware evaluation of CZP, helping to identify responsive tumor contexts, anticipate exposure-related liabilities, and prioritize rational combination strategies. By integrating therapeutic potential with xenobiotic pharmacology and toxicology, this review positions CZP within the evolving landscape of precision oncology and evidence-driven drug repurposing.
abstractZh: 药物再利用代表了一种合理且资源高效的策略，通过利用已批准的非肿瘤药物的既定药理学、临床经验和安全监测框架，来扩大肿瘤治疗武器库。氯氮平（CZP）是一种非典型抗精神病药，具有广泛的受体药理学、复杂的生物转化和临床相关的毒理学风险，在多种肿瘤类型的临床前证据显示其具有情境依赖性抗癌活性后，已成为一个备受关注的候选药物。因此，CZP为治疗药物作用与外源物行为之间的界面提供了一个信息丰富的案例研究。本综述对支持CZP在肿瘤学中再利用的现有证据进行了批判性和综合性的整合，特别强调其分子机制、剂量-暴露需求、药理学复杂性和潜在毒性之间的关系。对胶质母细胞瘤、非小细胞肺癌、乳腺癌和黑色素瘤脑转移模型中的体外和体内研究分析表明，CZP可通过一种机制可塑性形式损害肿瘤细胞增殖和存活。CZP并非通过单一保守途径发挥作用，而是似乎破坏与促生存信号、细胞应激耐受和代谢稳态相关的共享上游过程，同时参与肿瘤特异性的下游反应，包括自噬性细胞死亡、线粒体依赖性凋亡、氧化应激以及生存和血管生成途径的协调调节。尽管存在这种机制上的合理性，转化仍受到显著限制，最明显的是体外抗癌有效浓度与临床可达到的血浆暴露量之间存在数量级的差距，这需要仔细区分潜在有用的抗癌药理学与非特异性外源物诱导的细胞应激和临床不可接受的毒性。主要局限性包括：体外观察到的抗癌有效浓度与标准精神科给药期间可达到的暴露量之间的差异；对CZP代谢和代谢物形成可能如何影响疗效和毒性的理解有限；缺乏整合的药代动力学-药效学和毒代动力学模型；以及缺乏专门的临床试验证据。为应对这些挑战，本综述探讨了互补的转化策略，包括患者来源的类器官、共培养系统、微生理平台、药代动力学和毒理学建模以及计算数字孪生框架。总之，这些方法可能支持对CZP进行基于生物学和风险意识的评估，帮助识别反应性肿瘤情境、预测暴露相关风险，并优先考虑合理的联合策略。通过将治疗潜力与外源物药理学和毒理学相结合，本综述将CZP定位在不断发展的精准肿瘤学和循证药物再利用的格局中。

abstract:
Introduction

In cartilage-related studies, the existing in vitro cartilage models often fail to simulate the complex pathophysiology involving a hypoxic microenvironment, abnormal intercellular mechanical stress (microstress), and pathological crosstalk between chondrocytes and vascular endothelial cells. he aim of this study was to develop and validate a novel, simplified multi-cell-component cartilage organoid model capable of mimicking these three key OA-related features in vitro, using readily available cell lines.Methods

Organoids were constructed using SW1353 chondrocytes and HMEC-1 endothelial cell lines within low-adhesion grid microchambers. A monosodium iodoacetate (MIA)-induced OA model was developed. Histological and immunofluorescence analyses of the organoids were conducted to examine markers of matrix metabolism, cytoskeletal and intercellular microstress, hypoxic microenvironment, and chondrocyte -endothelial crosstalk. The organoid features were compared with those of standard 2D cell cultures and in vivo cartilages.Results

The multi-cell-component organoids successfully recapitulated critical in vivo features. They exhibited MIA-induced F-actin reorganization and PIEZO1 upregulation, developed a hypoxic core with elevated hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha (HIF-1α) levels, and formed an endothelial shell that invasively disrupted the chondrocyte core upon MIA treatment. This disruption was accompanied by the activation of vascular endothelial growth factor -NOTCH receptor 1 -delta-like ligand 4 (VEGF -NOTCH1 -DLL4) signaling, mirroring the pathological chondrocyte -endothelial crosstalk. Single-cell-component organoids simulated microstress-related changes but not hypoxia or chondrocyte -endothelial crosstalk.Discussion

The multi-cell-component cartilage organoids constructed from tumor-derived cell lines using low-adhesion grid microchambers partially simulated intercellular microstress, hypoxic microenvironment, and chondrocyte -endothelial crosstalk, which was similar to that observed in cartilages in vivo. These organoids provide a new strategy for conducting cartilage-related studies in vitro.
abstractZh:
引言

在软骨相关研究中，现有的体外软骨模型往往无法模拟涉及低氧微环境、异常细胞间机械应力（微应力）以及软骨细胞与血管内皮细胞之间病理串扰的复杂病理生理过程。本研究旨在开发并验证一种新型、简化的多细胞组分软骨类器官模型，该模型能够利用易获得的细胞系在体外模拟这三个与骨关节炎（OA）相关的关键特征。方法

使用SW1353软骨细胞和HMEC-1内皮细胞系，在低粘附网格微室中构建类器官。建立了单碘乙酸钠（MIA）诱导的OA模型。对类器官进行组织学和免疫荧光分析，以检测基质代谢、细胞骨架和细胞间微应力、低氧微环境以及软骨细胞-内皮细胞串扰的标志物。将类器官的特征与标准2D细胞培养和体内软骨进行比较。结果

多细胞组分类器官成功重现了关键的体内特征。它们表现出MIA诱导的F-actin重组和PIEZO1上调，形成了具有缺氧诱导因子1-α（HIF-1α）水平升高的低氧核心，并形成了内皮外壳，在MIA处理后侵入性破坏软骨细胞核心。这种破坏伴随着血管内皮生长因子-Notch受体1-δ样配体4（VEGF-NOTCH1-DLL4）信号的激活，反映了病理性的软骨细胞-内皮细胞串扰。单细胞组分类器官模拟了微应力相关变化，但未模拟低氧或软骨细胞-内皮细胞串扰。讨论

使用低粘附网格微室从肿瘤来源细胞系构建的多细胞组分软骨类器官，部分模拟了细胞间微应力、低氧微环境和软骨细胞-内皮细胞串扰，这与体内软骨观察到的相似。这些类器官为体外进行软骨相关研究提供了一种新策略。

abstract: Researchers worldwide are increasingly interested in methods for reproducing organogenesis by culturing spheroids and organoids. Unlike spheroids, organoids are more closely related to organs in structure and functional activity. Due to the diversity of organoid production protocols and the lack of precise morphological criteria for standardizing these methods, there is a growing need to identify morphological features as significant distinguishing indicators of mature and functionally healthy organoids. Various semi- and automated programs have been developed to address these issues. This review examines programs for the morphometric analysis of spheroids and organoids. Most of these programs utilize images taken with a brightfield microscope and a confocal laser microscope.
abstractZh: 世界各地的研究人员越来越关注通过培养球体和类器官来重现器官发生的方法。与球体不同，类器官在结构和功能活性上与器官更为接近。由于类器官生产方案的多样性以及缺乏标准化这些方法的精确形态学标准，越来越需要将形态学特征识别为成熟且功能健康的类器官的重要区分指标。为解决这些问题，已开发了各种半自动和自动程序。本综述考察了用于球体和类器官形态计量分析的程序。这些程序大多利用明场显微镜和共聚焦激光显微镜拍摄的图像。

abstract: Treatment-induced neuroendocrine prostate cancer (t-NEPC) is the major form of resistance to androgen receptor signaling inhibitors (ARSI) in advanced prostate cancer, characterized by pronounced invasiveness and lineage plasticity. Through in-depth analysis of prostate cancer cohorts, we found that glutamate ionotropic receptor kainate (GRIK) family members, specifically GRIK2 and GRIK5, are highly expressed in neural lineage plastic prostate cancer cells, NEPC patient-derived xenografts (PDX), and NEPC patient samples. Their expression positively correlates with neuroendocrine markers and inversely correlates with androgen receptor (AR) activity. Additionally, functional analyses indicated that AR has a direct transcriptional inhibitory effect on GRIK2 and GRIK5, and the absence of AR signaling leads to the upregulation of GRIK2 and GRIK5. Further RNA sequencing analysis revealed that GRIK5 silencing reprograms the cellular transcriptome, resulting in significant downregulation of AR signaling and fatty acid metabolism, while simultaneously activating immune and inflammatory responses in enzalutamide-resistant prostate cancer cells. In both cell line and NEPC PDX organoid models, loss of GRIK5 impaired proliferation and clonogenic growth. Notably, GRIK5 also contributes to enzalutamide resistance. Pharmacological evaluation revealed that Pan-GRIK antagonists exhibit anti-tumor activity, although the required relatively high concentrations suggest that more potent therapeutic strategies should be developed. Collectively, this study establishes that GRIK family members play critical roles in enzalutamide resistance and NEPC progression, highlighting GRIK signaling as a potential therapeutic target for overcoming lineage plasticity in prostate cancer.
abstractZh: 治疗诱导的神经内分泌前列腺癌（t-NEPC）是晚期前列腺癌中对雄激素受体信号抑制剂（ARSI）耐药的主要形式，其特征为显著的侵袭性和谱系可塑性。通过对前列腺癌队列的深入分析，我们发现谷氨酸离子型海人藻酸受体（GRIK）家族成员，特别是GRIK2和GRIK5，在神经谱系可塑性前列腺癌细胞、NEPC患者来源异种移植瘤（PDX）以及NEPC患者样本中高表达。它们的表达与神经内分泌标志物正相关，与雄激素受体（AR）活性负相关。此外，功能分析表明，AR对GRIK2和GRIK5具有直接的转录抑制作用，而AR信号的缺失导致GRIK2和GRIK5的上调。进一步的RNA测序分析揭示，GRIK5沉默可重编程细胞转录组，导致AR信号和脂肪酸代谢显著下调，同时激活恩扎卢胺耐药前列腺癌细胞中的免疫和炎症反应。在细胞系和NEPC PDX类器官模型中，GRIK5的缺失损害了增殖和克隆形成生长。值得注意的是，GRIK5还参与恩扎卢胺耐药。药理学评估显示，泛GRIK拮抗剂表现出抗肿瘤活性，尽管所需浓度相对较高，提示应开发更有效的治疗策略。总之，本研究确立了GRIK家族成员在恩扎卢胺耐药和NEPC进展中发挥关键作用，强调GRIK信号作为克服前列腺癌谱系可塑性的潜在治疗靶点。

abstract: The nasal epithelium is the first respiratory epithelium that is exposed to inhaled airborne pathogens. As a result, it is crucial to model host-pathogen interactions occurring in this tissue. To facilitate the efficient modeling of these interactions, we have developed a method to generate de novo apical-out nasal organoids from nasal epithelial cell aggregates. Optimization of this method revealed a stark tissue-specific effect of the culture temperature, as organoids were generated in much higher efficiency at 32.5°C compared to more widely used temperatures of 37°C. These organoids recapitulate the native tissue cellular composition of ciliated, basal, and goblet cells, while maintaining high homogeneity in size. Functionally, the system demonstrates susceptibility to viral infection and provides a robust platform for modeling antiviral drug responses. This standardized approach offers a reproducible system with high potential to be utilized in host-pathogen interaction studies and personalized medicine.
abstractZh: 鼻上皮是第一个暴露于吸入性空气传播病原体的呼吸道上皮。因此，模拟该组织中发生的宿主-病原体相互作用至关重要。为了促进这些相互作用的有效建模，我们开发了一种从鼻上皮细胞聚集体从头生成顶端朝外的鼻腔类器官的方法。对该方法的优化揭示了培养温度的显著组织特异性效应，因为在32.5°C下生成类器官的效率远高于更常用的37°C。这些类器官再现了纤毛细胞、基底细胞和杯状细胞的天然组织细胞组成，同时保持大小的高度均一性。在功能上，该系统表现出对病毒感染的易感性，并为模拟抗病毒药物反应提供了一个稳健的平台。这种标准化方法提供了一种可重复的系统，在宿主-病原体相互作用研究和个性化医疗中具有很高的应用潜力。

title: Reprogramming the Brain—iPSC Models Illuminating the Pathogenesis and Treatment of Alzheimer’s Disease and Other Dementias
titleZh: 重编程大脑——iPSC模型揭示阿尔茨海默病及其他痴呆症的发病机制与治疗
dateSource: Europe PMC firstPublicationDate（缺失月日时来源可能补齐）
authors: Širvinskas D, Jash S.
abstract: Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) have revolutionized the research landscape for Alzheimer's disease (AD) and related dementias by providing human, patient-specific neuronal models for studying the genetic and phenotypic diversity of these disorders. This review aims to integrate the latest advances in iPSC-based modeling of AD and dementia across multiple levels of biological organization. After describing the principles of pluripotency, iPSC generation, and quality control (genetic integrity, pluripotency assessment, long-term stability) the review will compare 2D monolayer culture with 3D organoid-based systems regarding their ability to model amyloid-beta, tau, and neuroinflammatory aspects of AD and dementia. The development of global stem cell biobanks and large iPSC collections with genetic diversity will be highlighted as an essential tool for dissecting the complex interplay of multiple genetic risk factors, ethnicity-based differences, and genotype-phenotype correlations. The review will discuss the use of genome editing technology, such as CRISPR/Cas9, for studying the effect of specific AD risk and protective variants in neurons and glial cells, and their implications for cell type-specific roles in neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation. We will highlight the challenges and limitations of iPSCs, such as cellular immaturity, loss of aging signatures, limited vascularization, and batch-to-batch differences, while noting the latest advances in partial/direct reprogramming, biomaterials science, and AI-based phenotypic analysis. Finally, the review will cover the expanding use of iPSC-based systems for high-content screening, functional therapeutic target validation, biomarker discovery, and development, and provide an overview of the future prospects for “clinical-trials-in-a-dish” and precision medicine for AD and other dementia disorders.
abstractZh: 诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）通过提供人类患者特异性的神经元模型，用于研究这些疾病的遗传和表型多样性，彻底改变了阿尔茨海默病（AD）及相关痴呆症的研究格局。本综述旨在整合基于iPSC的AD和痴呆症建模在多个生物组织水平上的最新进展。在描述多能性、iPSC生成和质量控制（遗传完整性、多能性评估、长期稳定性）的原则后，综述将比较2D单层培养与3D类器官系统在模拟AD和痴呆症的淀粉样蛋白-β、tau和神经炎症方面的能力。全球干细胞生物库和具有遗传多样性的大型iPSC集合的发展将被强调为剖析多种遗传风险因素、基于种族的差异以及基因型-表型相关性复杂相互作用的重要工具。综述将讨论使用基因组编辑技术（如CRISPR/Cas9）研究特定AD风险和保护性变异在神经元和胶质细胞中的作用，及其对细胞类型特异性神经变性和神经炎症的影响。我们将强调iPSC的挑战和局限性，如细胞不成熟、衰老特征丧失、血管化有限和批次间差异，同时注意到部分/直接重编程、生物材料科学和基于AI的表型分析的最新进展。最后，综述将涵盖基于iPSC系统在高内涵筛选、功能性治疗靶点验证、生物标志物发现和开发中的扩展应用，并概述“培养皿中的临床试验”和AD及其他痴呆症精准医疗的未来前景。

abstract: Real-time monitoring in organ-on-a-chip (OoC) systems is critical for capturing dynamic drug responses, yet standard gold (Au) electrodes utilized in electrical cell-substrate impedance sensing (ECIS) suffer from opacity, high cost, and poor reusability. Here, we report a transparent, robust, and reusable sensing interface based on iridium oxide-modified fluorine-doped tin oxide (IrOx@FTO). By electrodepositing nanostructured IrOx onto FTO, we exploited its pseudocapacitive properties to significantly improve interfacial properties, enhancing sensitivity while preserving optical clarity. We integrated these electrodes into a 128-channel high-throughput platform to monitor HaCaT keratinocytes. The system successfully resolved acute surfactant-induced barrier disruption and differentiated dose-dependent cytotoxic responses to doxorubicin (DOX) with higher precision than bare FTO. Crucially, cycling tests involving repeated culture and cleaning revealed that IrOx@FTO maintains exceptional baseline stability, significantly outperforming gold electrodes which exhibited severe degradation and delamination. This work establishes a scalable, optically compatible, and cost-effective strategy for long-term, multi-modal monitoring in advanced microphysiological systems.
abstractZh: 在器官芯片（OoC）系统中，实时监测对于捕捉动态药物反应至关重要，然而用于电细胞基底阻抗传感（ECIS）的标准金（Au）电极存在不透明、成本高和可重复使用性差的问题。在此，我们报告了一种基于氧化铱修饰的氟掺杂氧化锡（IrOx@FTO）的透明、稳健且可重复使用的传感界面。通过在FTO上电沉积纳米结构的IrOx，我们利用其赝电容特性显著改善了界面性能，在保持光学透明度的同时提高了灵敏度。我们将这些电极集成到一个128通道的高通量平台中，用于监测HaCaT角质形成细胞。该系统成功解析了急性表面活性剂诱导的屏障破坏，并以比裸FTO更高的精度区分了阿霉素（DOX）的剂量依赖性细胞毒性反应。至关重要的是，涉及重复培养和清洁的循环测试表明，IrOx@FTO保持了卓越的基线稳定性，显著优于表现出严重降解和分层现象的金电极。这项工作为先进微生理系统中的长期、多模式监测建立了一种可扩展、光学兼容且经济高效的策略。

abstract:
Background

Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) in patients with diabetes mellitus (DM) represents a clinically heterogeneous subgroup, yet biomarkers that reflect diabetes-associated tumor biology and chemotherapy response remain limited. In particular, the influence of diabetes duration on treatment resistance in PDAC is poorly understood.Methods

We performed an integrated translational analysis combining reanalysis of public single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) datasets, clinical serum biomarker profiling, and functional validation using pancreatic cancer cell lines and patient-derived organoids. Circulating REG4 concentrations were measured in independent PDAC cohorts and correlated with diabetes duration, overall survival, and response to FOLFIRINOX. Functional relevance was assessed under diabetes-mimicking hyperglycemic conditions.Results

Single-cell transcriptomic analysis demonstrated enrichment of REG4-expressing tumor cells within the classical PDAC subtype specifically in diabetic patients. Clinically, circulating REG4 concentrations were significantly elevated in PDAC patients with long-standing diabetes, and high REG4 levels were associated with poor overall survival and resistance to FOLFIRINOX exclusively in this subgroup. In contrast, no prognostic association was observed in non-diabetic or new-onset diabetic patients. In patient-derived organoids and pancreatic cancer cell lines, chronic glucose exposure induced REG4 expression, activation of WNT/β-catenin signaling, suppression of apoptotic pathways, and increased resistance to FOLFIRINOX, recapitulating key clinical features of long-standing diabetes-associated PDAC.Conclusions

These findings suggest REG4 as a candidate diabetes duration-dependent prognostic and predictive biomarker in pancreatic cancer, warranting validation in larger prospective cohorts. By linking metabolic context to chemotherapy resistance through REG4-associated signaling, this study provides a translational framework for patient stratification and treatment optimization in diabetes-associated PDAC.
abstractZh:
背景

伴有糖尿病（DM）的胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）患者构成一个临床异质性亚组，但反映糖尿病相关肿瘤生物学和化疗反应的生物标志物仍然有限。特别是，糖尿病病程对PDAC治疗耐药性的影响尚不清楚。方法

我们进行了一项整合性转化分析，结合了对公共单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据集的重新分析、临床血清生物标志物谱分析，以及使用胰腺癌细胞系和患者来源类器官的功能验证。在独立的PDAC队列中测量了循环REG4浓度，并与糖尿病病程、总生存期和对FOLFIRINOX的反应进行了相关性分析。在模拟糖尿病的高糖条件下评估了功能相关性。结果

单细胞转录组分析显示，在糖尿病患者中，经典PDAC亚型内表达REG4的肿瘤细胞富集。临床上，伴有长期糖尿病的PDAC患者循环REG4浓度显著升高，且高REG4水平仅在这一亚组中与较差的总生存期和对FOLFIRINOX的耐药性相关。相比之下，在非糖尿病或新发糖尿病患者中未观察到预后关联。在患者来源类器官和胰腺癌细胞系中，慢性葡萄糖暴露诱导REG4表达、WNT/β-catenin信号通路激活、凋亡通路抑制，并增加对FOLFIRINOX的耐药性，重现了长期糖尿病相关PDAC的关键临床特征。结论

这些发现提示REG4是胰腺癌中一种候选的糖尿病病程依赖性预后和预测性生物标志物，值得在更大的前瞻性队列中进行验证。通过将代谢背景与化疗耐药性通过REG4相关信号联系起来，本研究为糖尿病相关PDAC的患者分层和治疗优化提供了一个转化框架。
